qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raijer en Bosma over het stopzetten van het Sinterklaasfeest op een Utrechtse basisschool

MPs Raijer and Bosma (PVV) asked the Minister of Education whether a Utrecht primary school dropping Sinterklaas celebrations sets a precedent and whether the government will pressure schools to keep Dutch traditions. The state secretary answered that schools are free under the freedom of education to shape their own celebrations, declined to intervene, and said Sinterklaas remains widely celebrated.
Within the framework of freedom of education, it is up to schools themselves how they shape their education and the activities and celebrations that form part of it.
In het kader van de vrijheid van onderwijs is het aan scholen zelf hoe zij invulling geven aan hun onderwijs en aan activiteiten en vieringen die daar onderdeel van uitmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het nieuws dat de NPO een pornofilm maakt

An MP asked the state secretary how the NPO/BNNVARA making a pornographic film fits the public broadcasting values in the Mediawet, whether it is the broadcaster's task, what it costs, and how children will be protected. The answer says there is no prior content supervision under Article 7 of the Constitution, that broadcasters are responsible for content within legal and NICAM limits with the Commissariaat voor de Media enforcing, and that the film will only appear online at night with age restrictions.
At the outset, under Article 7(2) of the Constitution there is no prior supervision of the content of programmes of the Dutch public broadcaster.
Voorop staat dat er in Nederland conform artikel 7 lid 2 van de Grondwet geen voorafgaand toezicht op de inhoud van programma’s van de Nederlandse publieke omroep is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over geweldsfantasieën op de NPO

An MP asked the state secretary whether a 9 May 2023 NPO programme in which climate activists voiced violent fantasies crossed a line, why the presenter did not condemn this, and how it fits the Mediawet. The state secretary declined to judge programme content citing public broadcaster editorial independence, and referred the matter to the Commissariaat voor de Media, the Public Prosecution Service and the NPO Ombudsman.
As state secretary for media, it is not appropriate for me to pass judgement on the content of the programming.
Als Staatssecretaris voor media past het mij niet om een oordeel uit te spreken over inhoud van de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de uitgelekte mail van het directieteam van de NPO omtrent omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture and Media about a leaked NPO directorate email on broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland, including the meaning of 'limit of editorial freedom reached' and whether the NPO should have asked the Commissariaat voor de Media to investigate. The State Secretary confirmed the NPO's statements, explained that the NPO has its own statutory power to impose financial sanctions and that the matter is outside her responsibility, and said the Commissariaat decides independently on investigations.
The Commissariaat decides as an independent supervisor itself which matters are investigated.
Het Commissariaat beslist als onafhankelijk toezichthouder zelf over welke zaken worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het niet doorsturen van het ADR-rapport inzake de belangenverstrengeling van Shula Rijxman

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the ADR report on Shula Rijxman's conflict of interest, held by the ministry since 23 August, was only sent to the House a month later, and when it would arrive. The minister answered that intensive consultations with the Secretary-General preceded sending the report with the ministry's reaction on 27 September, and that the MP could receive the report on that date, while denying that it was outdated and referring a related e-mail to a pending Woo request.
I wanted to inform the House about the outcome of this process at the same time as presenting the report.
Over de uitkomsten van dit proces wilde ik uw Kamer tegelijk met het aanbieden van het rapport informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de nauwe banden tussen NPO en D66

An MP asked the state secretary about NPO chair Shula Rijxman's alleged ties to D66, her advice to a party colleague, her paid post after leaving the NPO, and an honour she received. The state secretary answered that he is not aware beyond media reports, that the Mediawet and Integrity Code govern broadcaster conduct, and that revoking the honour falls outside his competence.
As State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science, I am not authorised to revoke a royal honour.
Ik ben als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap niet bevoegd om een koninklijke onderscheiding in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over “het bericht dat het Rijksmuseum de term Bersiap niet langer wil gebruiken"

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asked whether the Rijksmuseum's decision to stop using the term Bersiap, which a guest curator called racist, is acceptable and whether the minister will intervene. The state secretary replied that the museum is not removing the term but will explain it with historical context in the exhibition, and that the minister does not intend to intervene in the museum's curatorial choices.
The Rijksmuseum has stated that the museum is not deleting the term Bersiap, but will explain it and provide historical context.
Het Rijksmuseum heeft laten weten dat het museum de term Bersiap niet schrapt, maar zal uitleggen en voorzien van historische context.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een nep-bijeenkomst die draagvlak moest suggereren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether staged theatre-like participation sessions that suggested public support undermine trust in democracy, and how the minister would respond to the Amsterdam case and the right to challenge. The minister said the Amsterdam matter is a local responsibility for the municipal council, that participation must be representative, and that a legislative proposal strengthening local participation is in preparation.
The issue identified in the article must however be examined by the municipal council of Amsterdam.
De in het artikel gesignaleerde kwestie moet echter bezien worden door de gemeenteraad van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over problemen met software die bij verkiezingen wordt gebruikt

An MP from the PVV asks the Interior Minister about reports that vote iT, linked to a German firm whose counting system was faulted, is connected to the Dutch election counting software OSV2020, and why risky software is used when counting is possible by hand, plus its costs and safeguards. The minister answers that the German software is different, that the Kiesraad owns OSV and tests it through independent audits and open source code, and that the software speeds counting while manual paper counts remain the basis.
To determine whether the software is suitable for use, the Kiesraad has the software examined by independent bodies.
Om te bepalen of de programmatuur geschikt is voor gebruik laat de Kiesraad de programmatuur onderzoeken door onafhankelijke instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een documentaire over D66-lijsttrekker Kaag tijdens de verkiezingscampagne

An MP from PVV asks why the NPO broadcasts a long documentary about D66 leader Sigrid Kaag shortly before the elections, and whether it breaches Mediawet balance rules and campaign finance rules, given links between NPO/VPRO leadership and D66 and Filmfonds funding. The minister answers that broadcasters are editorially independent, the Commissariaat voor de Media supervises afterwards, the Filmfonds is independent, and the documentary was commissioned before Kaag became lijsttrekker.
The broadcasters are editorially independent and themselves responsible for their media output.
De omroepen zijn redactioneel onafhankelijk en zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Martin Bosma over het bericht 'Bol.com verkoopt geen producten en boeken meer waarop Zwarte Piet staat'

MPs Helder and Martin Bosma asked the Justice Minister about Bol.com's decision to stop selling items depicting Zwarte Piet and whether the ministry advised the company, and whether it finds it odd that Mein Kampf and the Koran remain on sale. The minister answered that it is not for him to judge a commercial company's range within the law, that Bol.com only contacted the ministry on its own initiative and was told no general guidelines exist, and pointed to the relevant criminal and civil law provisions.
It is not for me, in my capacity as Minister of Justice and Security, to take a position on the range offered by a commercial company that operates within the limits of the law.

Het is niet aan mij in mijn hoedanigheid als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om een positie te bepalen ten aanzien van het aanbod van een commercieel bedrijf dat opereert binnen de grenzen van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over een gemeentelijk onderscheiding voor Jack Bogers

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a municipal honour for Jack Bogers, who allegedly helped Volkert van der Graaf destroy evidence, is consistent with the dignity of government and whether the municipality of Wageningen should be addressed. The Minister replied that municipal honours are set by municipalities under their own criteria, falling outside the national decoration system, and saw no reason to address Wageningen.
Municipalities also determine their own criteria for awarding an honour.
Gemeenten bepalen ook zelf de eigen criteria voor het verlenen van een onderscheiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het verwijderen van oude tv-programma’s die heel erg kwetsend zijn

An MP asks the Minister whether the removal of older TV programmes such as Fawlty Towers and Gone with the Wind for political-correctness reasons threatens artistic and expression freedom, and whether the NPO should be called to account for asking public broadcasters about older programmes. The Minister answers that the debate on racism is legitimate, that the NPO and broadcasters act on their own public responsibility rather than government instruction, that no content is removed unless broadcasters and makers agree, and that the NPO should be transparent about its considerations.
It goes without saying that the NPO and the public broadcasters take part in that debate and, in that context, reflect on programmes from the past.
Het is vanzelfsprekend dat de NPO en de publieke omroepen deelnemen aan dat debat en in dat kader nadenken over programma's uit het verleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over grote problemen bij de firma die de Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt

An MP asked the Interior Minister about problems at Fox-IT, the firm securing Dutch state secrets, including its takeover by NCC, weak financial results and the suspension of most of its board, and whether secrets were leaked and if Fox-IT can still be trusted. The minister answered that clear continuity and security agreements exist, that oversight is applied, that no leak or interception of state secrets has been found, and that a broader national cryptostrategy is being developed.
As long as these conditions are met, we see no reason why the encryption of state secrets using Fox-Crypto products would be endangered.
Zolang aan deze voorwaarden wordt voldaan, zien wij geen reden dat de versleuteling van staatsgeheimen, gebruikmakend van producten van Fox-Crypto, in gevaar komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het racisme bij de NOS

An MP from the PVV asks the minister about a 'diversity trophy' at the public broadcaster NOS, alleging it sidelines journalistic objectivity, discriminates against white people, and downplays negative news about immigrants, and asks whether the NPO board members should be removed. The minister answers that the NOS's aims and working method are its own responsibility, that the trophy has been discontinued, that the awards are an internal editorial matter, and that the public broadcaster's diversity mandate is in the Mediawet; he sees no reason to doubt the NOS's objectivity.
Government interference does not fit in that.
Daarin past bemoeienis vanuit de overheid niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de zorgwekkende situatie bij een belangrijke IT-dienstverlener van de Nederlandse overheid

MP Martin Bosma asked the Minister of Interior whether the reported financial losses at Centric, a major IT supplier to the Dutch government, pose a serious risk and what the impact of a possible bankruptcy would be. The minister replied that the situation is not considered worrying since Centric corrected its reporting and showed a profit for 2018, that the impact of a bankruptcy lies with the municipalities concerned, and that taking emergency measures is not opportune at this time.
Responsibility for the impact of a possible bankruptcy of a supplier to a municipality lies with the specific municipality that does business with this supplier.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de impact van een mogelijk faillissement van een leverancier aan een gemeente ligt bij de specifieke gemeente die zaken doet met deze leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het besluit om de peildatum voor de ledentelling te verschuiven van 31 december 2019 naar 31 december 2020

An MP asks the minister why he changed the eligibility reference date for broadcaster membership counts from 31 December 2019 to 31 December 2020 by ministerial decision just before the related bill was debated, and whether this was correct. The minister answers that he had announced the intended shift earlier and now exercises his statutory power under the Mediawet to fix the date, to give broadcasters and new initiatives certainty.

Given the desired certainty about the reference date for broadcasting organisations, both existing ones and new initiatives preparing an application for a (provisional) recognition, I considered it necessary to take and publish the decision now, anticipating the completion of the bill, to shift the reference date by one year.

Gelet op de gewenste zekerheid over de peildatum voor omroeporganisaties, zowel bestaande omroeporganisaties als nieuwe initiatieven, die zich voorbereiden op een aanvraag voor een (voorlopige) erkenning, achtte ik het noodzakelijk om anticiperend op de afronding van het wetsvoorstel nu het besluit te nemen en te publiceren om de peildatum met een jaar te verschuiven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het Songfestival

An MP from the PVV asked whether the Netherlands could hold the Eurovision Song Contest budget-neutrally, as Finland reportedly did, and whether the broadcaster should pay to host it rather than receive extra funds. The minister replied that the EBU rules assign hosting to the winning country's broadcaster, that the 2007 Finnish event was not profitable though it raised sponsorship and other income, and that such income can likewise cover costs in the Netherlands within Mediawet rules.
The Eurovision Song Contest is an event of the EBU and the public broadcasters of the participating countries.
Het Songfestival is een evenement van de EBU en de publieke omroepen van de deelnemende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma inzake het in de ban doen van de Gouden Eeuw

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why she has not responded to the Amsterdam Museum's decision to stop using the term 'Golden Age' and why she reacts to other controversies. The Minister answers that the government does not steer museum naming or content, that the seventeenth century has both prosperous and dark sides, and that she rejects the premise of the remaining questions.
As I indicated in my answer to the third question, it is not for the government to steer the naming and content of (historical) exhibitions.
Zoals ik aangeef in mijn antwoord op de derde vraag, is het niet aan de regering om te sturen op naamgeving en inhoud van (historische) tentoonstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het selectief toepassen van Nederlandse grondrechten

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asks the Interior Minister how the right to demonstrate can be reconciled with the bans and restrictions on demonstrations after counter-protests, and why such bans are applied to some groups but not others, citing Articles 1 and 9 of the Constitution. The minister answers that mayors decide case by case, that a ban is a last resort and content can never be the reason, that mayors account to the council and courts, and that criminal law applies equally to all demonstrators.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daar in te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het bericht 'Ambtenaar belt voor € 211.000 maar krijgt geen ontslag'

An MP asked why officials ran up large mobile data bills without being dismissed or prosecuted, and whether the government would file charges, recover costs and change contracts. The minister said a flawed reporting system caused the costs, a conditional dismissal was imposed on the main case, no fraud was found so no charges would be filed, costs would not be recovered, and contract caps were introduced.
Following the ADR report, I have taken measures to prevent excessive data use in the future.
Naar aanleiding van het ADR-rapport heb ik maatregelen getroffen om excessief dataverbruik in de toekomst te voorkomen
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Martin Bosma over de ereplaats voor wetsovertreders bij de viering van Koningsdag

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why Extinction Rebellion was given a prominent place at the national King's Day celebration in Amersfoort, despite unlawful actions in Amsterdam the day before, and about the municipality's contacts, the NOS, and funding. The minister answered that demonstration regulation is a mayoral responsibility under the Wom, that the Amsterdam demonstration caused traffic offences but no public order disturbances, that police and municipality had routine contacts with the group, that the broadcaster is editorially autonomous, and that she has no information on funding beyond public sources.
In light of the above, I am not in a position to account for the manner in which the mayor handles demonstrations by Extinction Rebellion.
Gelet op het bovenstaande ben ik niet in de positie om verantwoording af te leggen over de wijze waarop de burgemeester met demonstraties van Extinction Rebellion omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de mogelijke selectiviteit van de NOS

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the public broadcaster NOS's reporting on Trump and Russia, and its failure to apologise for it, complies with the Mediawet's quality and impartiality requirements. The minister confirmed the facts but said journalistic content and decisions on corrections or apologies are the broadcaster's own responsibility under sector self-regulation, with supervision left to designated regulators.

The journalistic content and quality of reporting, and the decision whether to issue corrections and/or apologies, is the broadcaster's autonomous responsibility and subject to the journalistic norms the sector has set through self-regulation.

De journalistieke inhoud en kwaliteit van berichtgeving en de afweging om tot correctie en/of het aanbieden van excuses over te gaan, is de autonome verantwoordelijkheid van de omroep en onderworpen aan de journalistieke normen die de sector bij wijze van zelfregulering heeft bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de uit de klauwen lopende bedragen die de publieke omroep jaarlijks aan consultants betaalt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the high consultancy and temporary staff costs of the Dutch public broadcaster NPO, the use of Boston Consulting Group, and related figures. The minister answered that the NPO itself decides how to spend its budget and that its supervisory board monitors efficiency, and provided the requested cost figures without a full list of past consultancy payments.
It is up to the NPO to decide for itself how to deploy its available budget as wisely as possible and to what extent it uses (external) advice and temporary staff.
Het is aan de NPO om zelf te bepalen hoe hij het beschikbare budget zo verstandig mogelijk inzet en in welke mate hij bijvoorbeeld gebruik maakt van (extern) advies en inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het verwijderen van een boek uit een bibliotheek omdat het negatieve emoties oproept en aanstoot geeft

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether removing a children's book from the Amsterdam public library (OBA) because it caused offence and negative emotions harms culture and freedom to read. The minister replied that library collection policy is the library's independent responsibility under the Wsob, that the OBA lawfully weighed complaints against public values and withdrew the book from lending while keeping two copies in a museum collection, and declined to meet the Amsterdam mayor.
The Wsob sets out the responsibilities of the various parties in the library system. Collection policy is the responsibility of the library and not of the government.
De Wsob legt de verantwoordelijkheden van de verschillende partijen in het bibliotheekstelsel vast. Het collectiebeleid behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de bibliotheek en niet van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosman over een taalcommissie van de NOS

An MP from the PVV asked the minister about an NOS language committee that reportedly treats the word 'blank' as negative, asking its mandate, members, decisions and scientific basis, and whether this resembles Orwellian control of language. The minister answered that the NOS follows external spelling guidance and internal style rules, that its language committee is a normal editorial body, that the word question is an editorial matter for the NOS, and that in an open democracy the political sphere should keep distance from such editorial choices.
I am of the view that politics must keep its distance from such editorial choices.
Ik ben van opvatting dat de politiek afstand moet houden van dergelijke redactionele keuzes
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Martin Bosma over de roofmoord op een Nederlander in Zuid-Afrika

PVV MPs De Roon and Bosma asked the Foreign Minister about the robbery-murder of a Dutch national on his farm in South Africa, the rising number of farm murders, conviction rates, police follow-up, and pressure on the South African government. The minister confirmed the killing, said official data on a rise is lacking, cited an AfriForum report showing 23 percent of suspects convicted, said the embassy and Dutch police are following the investigation, and said the government raises public order concerns through existing cooperation and the EU human rights dialogue.
The Dutch Embassy in Pretoria is in contact with the Barberton police, the South African police force investigating the murder.
De Nederlandse Ambassade in Pretoria staat in contact met de politie van Barberton, het Zuid-Afrikaanse politiekorps dat de moord onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma en De Graaf over het anti-Zwarte Pietenberaad

The MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the round tables on Zwarte Piet, including attendees, how they were selected, how often they were held, and why participants were asked to sign a statement. The Minister answered that the round tables were convened by him, listed the participating organisations and dates, noted that the Chamber was informed in 2014, and said the statement was drafted at the initiative of participants.
The statement was drawn up at the initiative of the group of participants in the round table.
De verklaring is opgesteld op initiatief van de groep deelnemers aan de ronde tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Martin Bosma over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan

MPs Madlener and Bosma asked whether water boards should stop risky foreign projects and be placed under provinces. The minister replied that water boards invest no money abroad, only limited staff time, that the government wants them to keep sharing expertise, and declined to intervene or restructure water governance.
Under the Netherlands Financing of Decentralised Governments Act, water boards do not invest money abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) investeren waterschappen geen geld in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf  over de actieve bemoeienis van de minister van Sociale Zaken met Zwarte Piet

PVV MPs asked why the Minister of Social Affairs is involved in the Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet debate, which other feasts he engages with, who attended his round table and why a declaration was requested. The minister answered that the government sees a role in facilitating respectful dialogue but rejects a state ban, and listed the round-table participants and said the declaration originated with the participants.
The cabinet is of the view that a state ban on Zwarte Piet is not the way out.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een verbod op Zwarte Piet van staatswege niet de uitweg is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over gesubsidieerde anti-Zwarte Piet-activisten

An MP asked the minister whether deBuren, a Dutch-Flemish cultural centre, should lose its subsidy for its political stance against Zwarte Piet, and whether the minister would stop funding it. The minister answered that deBuren is an independent organisation mandated to host debate, that controversy alone is no reason to withdraw funding, and that the subsidy will continue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en Graus over de Clinton Foundation

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands gave over four million euros to the Clinton Foundation's Clinton Development Initiative, what projects were funded, what evaluations exist, whether any funds went to Clinton's campaign, and whether all money was spent. The State Secretary answered at length, listing project results and impact figures, stating the foundation's audited reports show no campaign use, explaining the initiative was taken by the Netherlands within the Alliance for Climate Smart Agriculture, and confirming the funds were spent on the agreed agricultural projects, while sending correspondence and MoUs.
I hereby send you the correspondence leading up to the signing of the MoUs and the MoUs themselves.
Hierbij stuur ik u de correspondentie in de aanloop naar de ondertekening van MoU's en de MoU's zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een propaganda-offensief van de publieke omroep

An MP asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster NPO has a legal mandate to remove fear of the Arab world and whether it may try to change Dutch opinion, and whether its programmes amount to propaganda. The state secretary answered that the public media mandate is in Article 2.1 of the Mediawet, that broadcasters are programmatically autonomous, and that Middle East coverage is extensive and balanced, without committing to any action.
In any case, it always applies that only the broadcasters themselves are responsible for the form and content of their media output.
Overigens geldt altijd dat uitsluitend de omroepen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over creatie van banen door programma’s voor private sectorontwikkeling

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the claimed 190,000 jobs created or preserved by private-sector development programmes were achieved, asked for verifiable records and quarterly progress reports, and asked why the government destroys jobs at home while claiming to create them abroad. The Minister confirmed a typo (160,000 target for 2017), said the 190,000 figure is reported in the 2016 results report with direct jobs verified by implementing agencies and FMO, pointed to budget websites and annual reporting, and attributed domestic job growth to fiscal and labour-market measures.

Direct jobs in small and medium enterprises are reported to the ministry by implementing organisations and fund managers and verified by implementing organisations through company visits and/or project evaluation.

Directe banen in het midden- en kleinbedrijf worden door uitvoeringsorganisaties en fondsmanagers aan het ministerie gerapporteerd en geverifieerd door uitvoeringsorganisaties bij bedrijfsbezoek en/of evaluatie van een project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het bericht “Arjo Klingens van rockband 'De Staat' geeft € 1 miljoen subsidie aan zichzelf”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a rock band's manager, Arjo Klingens, secured over one million euros in subsidy for the band, questioning whether a rock band should receive such funding and whether procedures were breached. The minister replied that the funding was assessed by independent committees, Klingens was not involved in the assessment, the Fonds Podiumkunsten acted with integrity, and no recovery of the money is warranted.
Arjo Klingens was not involved in assessing the application of De Staat or other applications under the multi-year activity subsidy scheme 2017–2020.
Arjo Klingens is niet betrokken geweest bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag van De Staat of andere aanvragen binnen de regeling subsidie meerjarige activiteiten 2017–2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de vrijheid van meningsuiting van ambassadeurs

An MP asked whether the Dutch ambassador in Kenya deserves praise for speaking out about wasteful aid, why he faces a 'firm talk', and how much aid went to Kenya. The minister said ambassadors are encouraged to speak publicly, that the ambassador was spoken to because his remarks deviated from Dutch policy, and gave aid figures and programme outcomes while declining to say the money is recoverable and rejecting the praise.
In the interview you cite, various remarks were made that deviate from the Dutch position. This gave cause for a conversation with the ambassador concerned.
In het door u aangehaalde interview zijn diverse opmerkingen gemaakt die afwijken van de Nederlandse inzet. Dit is aanleiding geweest voor een gesprek met de betreffende ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf over de weigerburgemeester van Weert

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Minister had requested a factual account from the Commissioner of the King on the 'refusal mayor' of Weert, when it would be ready, whether it would be shared with parliament, and whether maatregelen would be taken if the mayor broke the law. The Minister confirmed requesting the account, received it on 26 May, discussed it with the mayor on 2 June, sent parliament a letter with a factual overview on 16 June, and said no breach of law was found.
On 16 June 2016 I informed your House in writing, based on the Commissioner of the King's factual account and the conversation with the mayor, about the course of events in Weert.

Antwoord 3 en 4 Op 16 juni 2016 heb ik uw Kamer, op basis van het feitenrelaas van de commissaris van de Koning en het gesprek met de burgemeester, schriftelijk 1 geïnformeerd over de gang van zaken in Weert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Beertema en Bosma over de uitspraken van de Koning over de EU

PVV MPs Wilders, Beertema and Bosma asked whether the King's European Parliament speech, which implied opposition to a Brexit, was an improper use of the head of state to influence the British electorate, and whether he should be told the EU threatens Dutch sovereignty. The minister replied that the speech was delivered under ministerial responsibility and that the cabinet holds that the UK staying in the EU is better for all parties.
The aforementioned speech by the King was delivered under ministerial responsibility.
Voornoemde toespraak van de Koning is uitgesproken onder de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Martin Bosma en Helder over het weglaten van cruciale informatie in het programma Opsporing Verzocht

PVV MPs asked why the Opsporing Verzocht broadcast omitted that a robbery victim couple was attacked with antisemitic motives and that the victim named Moroccan perpetrators, and whether NPO coverage is driven by political correctness. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that the broadcast is an official investigative tool controlled by the prosecution service (OM) rather than the NPO, and that only verified information directly relevant to identifying suspects was included.
The criminal investigation covers all aspects of the offence. As this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on its content.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek richt zich op alle aspecten van het strafbare feit. Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over “de implementatie van de sharia in de stembureaus bij het referendum op 6 april”

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a City of Amsterdam instruction for polling station staff at the 6 April 2016 referendum, which reportedly directed that only women check burqa-wearing voters, and whether this was acceptable. The minister replied that the instruction did not come from his ministry but from Amsterdam, pointed to a pending bill on partial face-covering bans, and noted that voters must be identified, with the method left to the municipality.
The instruction does not come from my ministry, but from the municipality of Amsterdam.
De instructie komt niet van mijn ministerie, maar van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het online platform voor 'vluchtelingen' dat de publieke omroep wil beginnen

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a proposed public broadcaster online platform for refugees, including its cost, legal basis under the Mediawet, whether it would give migrants tips to get through the asylum procedure, and whether the minister would stop it and guarantee no subsidies. The state secretary answered that the platform would be an experimental channel of about 320,000 euros per year, justified under article 2.1 of the Mediawet, that no tips were known to be planned, that no prior approval is needed but the broadcaster must explain its fit with the public mission, and that funding comes mainly from the participating broadcasters' own resources.
No prior permission is needed to start an experimental distribution channel, but the public broadcaster must explain how this channel fits within the public media mission.
Voor het starten van een experimenteel aanbodkanaal is geen toestemming vooraf nodig, maar moet de publieke omroep wel uitleggen hoe dit kanaal past binnen de publieke mediaopdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake NPO-voorzitter Hagoort en diens intentie de politiek te beïnvloeden

An MP asked whether NPO chair Hagoort's remarks about influencing public opinion and politics breach the Mediawet, and whether he should resign. The State Secretary replied that the remarks were about public opinion rather than politics, that the NPO must reflect diversity and balance, and that there is no state broadcaster with prescribed opinions; he rejected calls for Hagoort's removal.

It is the task of the public broadcaster to reflect the diversity of convictions, opinions and interests and to report on what is happening in the world in a balanced and journalistically responsible way.

Het is de taak van de publieke omroep om de diversiteit aan overtuigingen, meningen en interesses te weerspiegelen en op evenwichtige en journalistiek verantwoorde wijze te berichten over wat er speelt in de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake de protesten van zwarte racisten tegen Zwarte Piet

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about protests against Zwarte Piet and the Black Panthers, and whether measures would protect children from such protests. The minister answered that some protesters wore black clothing, there is no known indication they identify with the Black Panthers, and everyone may demonstrate against Zwarte Piet.
Everyone in the Netherlands is free to demonstrate against the use of Zwarte Piet.
Het staat een ieder in Nederland vrij om te demonstreren tegen de inzet van Zwarte Piet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake de kritiek van de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid op de inhoud van het programma Pauw

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Media whether the Minister of Social Affairs may criticise the content of a talk show (Pauw) and whether this undermines cabinet unity, and accused the public broadcaster of left-wing bias. The state secretary answered that the minister's remark was within bounds because broadcasters have editorial autonomy under the Mediawet, and that the government will not judge editorial choices.

There can be no misunderstanding on that last point: the Mediawet explicitly provides that broadcasting organisations themselves determine the form and content of their media offering and are responsible for it.
Over dat laatste kan geen misverstand bestaan: de Mediawet bepaalt nadrukkelijk dat de omroepinstellingen zelf de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod bepalen en daar verantwoordelijk voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over hoe de KRO begrip wil creëren voor de islam

PVV MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked whether the public broadcaster KRO's programme 'Bekeerd', intended to create understanding for Islam, is a legitimate task for public broadcasting and whether the state broadcaster is being used to Islamize the Netherlands. The Secretary of State replied that the programme aims to give insight into the lives of young (converted) Muslims, fits the public broadcasters' mandate, and that under the Mediawet broadcasters themselves determine form and content, so it is not for the minister to judge.
It is therefore not for me to pass judgement on that.
Het is dus niet aan mij om daar een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over noodhulp aan Christelijke vluchtelingen in Noord-Irak en Syrië

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether Christian refugees from ISIS are being left last in line for emergency aid and whether Dutch aid reaches them. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, acknowledged food shortages from funding gaps, and stated that aid is allocated by need without discrimination by religion, while promising to press aid organisations to act if any discrimination is found.
I have no basis to assume that the claim by the CEO of Open Doors is correct, that Christian refugees would be disadvantaged when it comes to receiving humanitarian aid.
Ik heb geen basis om aan te nemen dat de bewering van de CEO van Open Doors juist is dat Christelijke vluchtelingen achtergesteld zouden worden wanneer het gaat om het ontvangen van humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over Cyberdreiging vanuit Iran

Two MPs asked the ministers about a rise in Iranian cyberattacks on the West that exploit Western IT systems, and whether sanctions are failing to prevent Iranian access to such systems. The government answered that Dutch sanctions target Iran's nuclear programme rather than internet services in general, that providers bear responsibility for their customers, and that new cyber-specific sanctions are not currently under consideration.
The cabinet is of the view that the existing sanctions instruments are flexible enough to address cyber threats where desired.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het bestaande sanctie-instrumentarium flexibel genoeg is om desgewenst ook cyberdreigingen te kunnen ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over situatie in Jemen

An MP asked the minister about the humanitarian situation in Yemen and about the total Dutch aid spent there, and whether Dutch funding should stop. The minister confirmed the reports, gave the cumulative aid figure of about USD 1 billion and described programme results, and said the development relationship will continue with the programme adjusted to the war, promising to inform the House shortly.
The cabinet will inform the House about this shortly, in line with the commitment in the letter on the temporary closure of the Sana'a post.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer hierover op korte termijn informeren, in lijn met de toezegging in de Kamerbrief over de tijdelijke sluiting van de post Sana’a
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht dat de Nederlandse ambassade in Zuid-Afrika anti-blanke quota’s promoot

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether the Dutch embassy in South Africa promoting a helpdesk on Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment amounts to promoting anti-white quotas, and whether embassies should promote such laws. The minister answered that the helpdesk helps Dutch firms navigate an existing legal reality, that she did not know the cited research, and that embassies do not promote racial laws.
The helpdesk was set up to assist Dutch entrepreneurs in dealing with the BBBEE rules in order to increase their opportunities on the South African market.
De helpdesk is opgezet om Nederlandse ondernemers te assisteren bij het omgaan met de regels voor BBBEE om zo hun kansen op de Zuid-Afrikaanse markt te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht "Remove Paul Kruger statue within 7 days, or else: EFF"

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked about an EFF ultimatum to remove the Paul Kruger statue in South Africa, including whether the Dutch embassy would act to protect it and whether the Culture Minister would seek UNESCO listing. The government answered that the matter is internal to South Africa, that the embassy has taken no action since no Dutch persons or property are involved, and that South African authorities decide on heritage and on responding to the EFF.
This concerns an internal South African matter in which no Dutch persons or property are involved.
Het betreft hier een interne Zuid-Afrikaanse zaak waarbij geen Nederlandse personen of bezittingen betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over censuur bij stripmuseum

PVV MPs Bosma and Wilders asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a municipal council should interfere with exhibition content at a local comic museum, and about the planned Charlie Hebdo cartoon and calls for its removal. The minister answered that government should not interfere in artistic programming except where public order and safety are at stake, stressed free expression and mutual respect, and declined to take sides in the Dordrecht debate.
The government should not interfere with the substantive, artistic programming of a cultural institution.
De overheid heeft zich niet te bemoeien met de inhoudelijke, artistieke programmering van een culturele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het bericht ‘Kunstwereld buigt voor radicalen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she shared outrage that an artist's freedom of expression was curtailed by fear of Muslims, whether she would give the artist Theourgos shelter at her ministry, and why the arts world supposedly stays silent on such cases. The minister answered that free expression is guaranteed within the rule of law, that exhibition decisions rest with museum professionals, that threats can be reported to the police, and that the arts sector does speak out on political matters.
In our current laws and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over het aantal jihadisten

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD chief's figure of a few hundred jihadist participants was consistent with the government's figure of about 160 departed jihadists, and why the AIVD spoke of this in Washington rather than to parliament. The minister replied that the AIVD chief spoke of a few hundred potential participants, that parliament had been informed of the same figures in earlier letters, and that there is no discrepancy or difference in message between the two.
The head of the AIVD, Mr Bertholee, therefore did not disclose any figures in Washington other than those already known to your House.
Het hoofd van de AIVD, de heer Bertholee, heeft in Washington dus geen andere cijfers bekend gemaakt, dan die reeds bekend zijn bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Roon en Bosma over optreden van oproerpolitie in het parlement van Zuid-Afrika

Members De Roon and Bosma (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether South African riot police used force against opposition MPs in parliament and whether it was justified. The minister confirmed police were called to remove an EFF member from the chamber under South African rules, said it is not for the Dutch cabinet to judge the decision, and stated that the South African parliament itself should judge the matter.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether the decision to do so was justified in this case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of het besluit hiertoe in dit geval gerechtvaardigd was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het EO-programma ‘Rot Op Naar Je Eigen Land’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the EO broadcaster would make equivalent programmes confronting PvdA, GroenLinks and D66 voters, and how the EO programme 'Rot Op Naar Je Eigen Land' fits the Mediawet's balance and quality requirements. The state secretary replied that no such programmes are in preparation, that the programme follows an Australian format, and that compliance with the Mediawet will only become clear after broadcast, with the EO responsible for content since the Constitution bars prior supervision.
Whether the programme complies with the various provisions of the Mediawet will become apparent in due course upon broadcast (start in January 2015).
Of het programma voldoet aan de diverse bepalingen van de Mediawet, zal te zijner tijd blijken bij uitzending (start in januari 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bosma over het bericht ‘Ophef om uitspraak Broertjes’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a mayor's remark comparing Israel to ISIS and whether he should be suspended, claiming the remark was sickening and aided the enemy. The Minister answered that the mayor's intended meaning was about the legal grounds required for passport revocation, that the Hilversum council is responsible for judging the mayor's conduct, and that the mayor has already explained himself in a letter.
It is in the first place up to the Hilversum municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Broertjes.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Hilversum om de handelwijze van burgemeester Broertjes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over een nauwelijks bezocht showtje van een gesubsidieerde Zwarte-Pietheater

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a performance by artist Quincy Gario at the Stedelijk Museum, attended by few paying visitors, cost taxpayers money and why the minister listens to such an artist rather than to popular support for Zwarte Piet. The minister answered that the museum is independently run since 2006 and responsible for its own programming, and that she does not intervene in individual artists' work.
The museum has been independent since 1 January 2006 and is itself responsible for programming exhibitions and performances.
Het museum is per 1 januari 2006 verzelfstandigd en is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de programmering van tentoonstellingen en performances.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony Van Dijck en Bosma over het bericht ‘Terrorisme wordt vanuit Nederland gesteund met geld’

PVV MPs asked whether terror groups in Pakistan and Afghanistan received money from the Netherlands over 100 times, why money transfers flagged by exchange offices were not stopped sooner, and what action would be taken against those involved. The government answered that the press report misrepresented the figures: 108 dossiers in 2013 were reported to the authorities after analysis, none yet shown to involve terrorist financing, and prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Under the statutory duty of confidentiality, no further details can be given about the amounts involved.
Uit hoofde van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen geen nadere gegevens vermeld worden omtrent de in het geding zijnde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bosma over stappen van het Openbaar Ministerie tegen GeenStijl

MPs Helder and Bosma asked whether criminal investigations into GeenStijl photos reflect unequal treatment compared with the 'Dood aan de Joden' case, and whether free speech is safe under this cabinet. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service assesses each case on its merits, that both were examined, and that free speech was not breached criminally.
Each case is assessed by the Public Prosecution Service on its own merits.
Iedere zaak wordt door het Openbaar Ministerie op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over vrouwenrechten in “het Nieuwe Zuid-Afrika”

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that a South African public broadcaster executive received a woman as a gift from traditional leaders, and whether this is consistent with women's rights and SABC neutrality, and why Dutch funds went to the ANC. The minister answers that the gifts were part of a customary respect ritual, the woman denied being given as a gift, SABC is bound by neutrality rules under its statute, and the Dutch state did not finance the ANC, with remaining transition funds going to women's position.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over babysterfte ten gevolge van de ANC-rassenwetten

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether South African black empowerment rules, which they call apartheid-style 'racial laws', are causing infant deaths through discrimination in water purification, and why the Netherlands funded the ANC via aid. The minister rejected the 'racial laws' label, described the policy as redress of past inequality, and said the Netherlands funded no party and that aid to South Africa is nearly phased out.
The ANC has not introduced 'racial laws'.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over een nieuwe pro-EU-oproep bij de stempas, ditmaal van de burgemeester van Bergen, NH

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a municipal letter sent with EP election polling cards, which mentioned EU regulation, was unacceptable and whether the mayor of Bergen should be called to account. The minister replied that the letter does not argue for more or less EU involvement, saw no need for a talk with the mayor, and knew of no signals of other municipalities trying to influence voters, so no investigation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the investigation you requested.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om het door u gevraagde onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over verkapt stemadvies van de gemeente Sittard

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that the municipality of Sittard sent residents a pro-EU letter that they considered covert voting advice, and whether the mayor should be made to retract it. The minister answered that the letter describes the EU's importance and does not amount to voting advice for any party, that voters are free to choose, and that a conversation with the mayor is not necessary.
The mayor's letter describes the importance of the EU and therefore cannot reasonably be regarded as voting advice for or against any party contesting the European Parliament election.
De brief van de burgemeester beschrijft wat het belang van de EU is en kan daarmee redelijkerwijs niet worden beschouwd als stemadvies voor of tegen enige partij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over nieuwe voorstellen tot ‘landhervormingen’ in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asks the Dutch minister whether aid to South Africa should stop given proposed land reform that could endanger food supply and mirror Zimbabwe, and whether 90% of redistributed farms fail. The minister says land transfer is slow and mostly unsuccessful due to lack of skills and credit, notes Zimbabwe's negative experience, says aid is winding down to a transition programme and that the government supports flanking measures.
Until the end of 2011, South Africa was a partner country for the Netherlands in development cooperation.
Tot het einde van 2011 was Zuid-Afrika voor Nederland een partnerland in ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de berichten ‘PvdA Zuid-Holland: Geen functies meer voor PVV'ers’ en ‘D66 en SP Brabant willen PVV'er weg als voorzitter’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that PvdA, SP and D66 seek to exclude PVV members from committee chairs and provincial functions, and how this can be prevented. The Minister answered that he does not intervene in party choices unless they breach the law, and that committee composition and chairmanship fall within the autonomy of provincial states and councils.
Since the composition of such committees, including the chairmanship, falls within the autonomy of subnational governments, it is not for the Minister of the Interior to intervene.
Aangezien de samenstelling van dergelijke commissies, met inbegrip van het voorzitterschap, tot de autonomie van decentrale overheden behoort, is het niet aan de Minister van BZK om hierin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over het stemadvies van vice-premier Asscher

Wilders and Bosma asked the Prime Minister whether Vice-Premier Asscher's campaign advice against voting PVV reflected the whole cabinet and whether it was improper. The Prime Minister answered that Asscher did not call on voters to avoid the PVV, quoting his remark that such statements could be countered by making a different choice.
Mr Asscher did not call on people not to vote for the PVV.
De heer Asscher heeft niet opgeroepen niet op de PVV te stemmen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over de voorgenomen benoeming van maoïst Rosenmöller tot commissaris van de Koningin in Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the planned appointment of Paul Rosenmöller as Queen's Commissioner in Utrecht, citing his past Maoist and Khmer Rouge-related activities and his stated lack of regret. The minister confirmed the reported plan in general terms but declined to discuss the named individual, citing full confidentiality in the appointment procedure.
In the procedure to appoint (acting) Queen's Commissioners, full confidentiality is always observed.
In de procedure om te komen tot de benoeming van (wnd.) commissarissen van de Koningin wordt altijd volledige vertrouwelijkheid betracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over de bijdrage aan Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch city becoming European Capital of Culture 2018 could count on a 20 million euro national contribution, whether no promises had been made to candidate cities, and whether the national government should distance itself from or withdraw the bid. The minister replied that no promises were made to the Eindhoven alderman, that the size of any national contribution was not yet known, that provinces and municipalities decide how to spend their funds, and that the Netherlands agreed to the EU title in 1999.
No commitments have been made to the Eindhoven alderman.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen aan de Eindhovense wethouder gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma inzake het weigeren van een journalist van de publieke omroep

An MP asked the education, culture and science state secretary whether he condemns Almere mayor Jorritsma barring a public broadcaster journalist from a town hall event open to other press, and whether he will talk to her. The state secretary answered that Almere governs its own press access, that openness to media is generally desirable, and that he will not intervene since it is a municipal matter accountable to the Almere council.
This is and remains a matter for the municipality of Almere, on which public accountability can if necessary be rendered in the Almere municipal council.
Dit is en blijft een zaak van de gemeente Almere, waarover desnoods in de gemeenteraad van Almere publieke verantwoording kan worden afgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Bosma en Wilders over het bericht “Graaiers moeten inleveren”

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health why top salaries in the public and semi-public sector keep rising, whether pay rises before the WNT pay-cap took effect were improper, and whether executives who sued to escape the cap should be pursued. The minister defended the WNT and its transitional rules, said there is no evidence of pre-emptive pay rises, and stated that challenging government decisions in court is a right.
Anyone is free to have government decisions reviewed by the court.
Het staat een ieder vrij om beslissingen van de overheid door de rechter te laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over de explosieve stijging van lokale lasten

The MP Bosma asks whether the minister will limit local tax increases, especially the OZB property tax rising above 5% while house prices fall, and whether municipalities should be forced to stop spending on aid, sustainability and arts subsidies. The minister replies that the OZB macro norm (effectively 2.7% for 2013) will be checked against the uniform monitor and raised in the Bofv consultation if exceeded, but that further limits are not opportune, municipalities have autonomy over budgets, and tariff setting is their own competence.
Further limiting local levies does not seem opportune to me at this time.
Een verdere begrenzing van de lokale lasten lijkt mij op dit moment niet opportuun.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over gesubsidieerde grootverdieners in de toneelsector

PVV MPs asked the minister whether artistic leaders Ivo van Hove and Jan Versweyveld of Toneelgroep Amsterdam earn above the Balkenende norm and whether salaries will be capped and disclosed in subsidy conditions. The minister answered that neither exceeds the norm, so salaries are not published, and that existing WOPT/WNT rules apply without new subsidy conditions.
Since the salary does not exceed the norm, the salary is not made public.
Aangezien het salaris niet boven de norm uitkomt, wordt het salaris niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever, Graus, Bosma en Van Vliet over het bericht “Topsalaris staatsbedrijven nog ruim boven Balkenendenorm”?

PVV MPs asked whether state-owned enterprise executive pay exceeding the Balkenende norm should be clawed back, and whether the Balkenende norm is high enough. The minister replied that state holdings fall outside the Balkenende pay-cap law because they are not publicly funded, but that the state's pay policy for these holdings is assessed against its own framework, which will be revised.
state holdings do not fall under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, because they are not financed with public funds
staatsdeelnemingen vallen niet onder de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector, omdat zij niet met publieke middelen worden bekostigd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over een intensieve mediacampagne via de Stichting Ether Reclame (STER) gericht tegen Nederlanders die kritisch staan tegenover de massa-immigratie en de islam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a SIRE tolerance advertising campaign on STER airtime, which portrayed critics of mass immigration and Islam as intolerant, is consistent with the public broadcasting pluralism duty and whether STER should be pressed to give both sides airtime. The minister answered that STER must accept third-party ads that meet the Reclame Code Commissie rules, that anyone may offer an ad without government stimulus, and that as minister she will not comment on media content given constitutional and statutory programmatic autonomy.
As minister responsible for the media, I consider it neither credible nor advisable to express myself on media content.
Als minister die verantwoordelijk is voor de media, acht ik het geloofwaardig noch raadzaam om mijzelf uit te spreken over media-inhoud
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de overeenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep en de Nederlandse Postduivenhouders Organisatie

Member Bosma (PVV) asked whether a 100,000 euro payment by the public broadcaster NPO to the pigeon-breeders' organisation, and its new npo.nl domain, fit with the goal of reducing public broadcaster websites and with budget cuts. The minister answered that the NPO is independent, that the domain purchase will not increase the number of websites, and that the NPO is accountable through its financial reports under Commissariaat voor de Media supervision.
The NPO is an independent, autonomous organisation that is itself responsible for how it carries out its statutory public broadcasting mandate.
De NPO is een onafhankelijke, zelfstandige organisatie die zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de wijze waarop hij uitvoering geeft aan zijn Mediawettelijke taakopdracht
Antwoord vragen Bosma naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Beatrixstraat Pretoria op de wip'

An MP asked whether plans by a Pretoria city council to rename streets named after Queen Beatrix and Queen Wilhelmina, and whether the Dutch ambassador should defend the Boer-era Dutch cultural heritage and refuse to use a renamed address. The state secretary replied that street naming in South Africa is for its democratically elected authorities and that the Dutch government trusts that democratic process.
The naming of streets on South African territory is a matter for the democratically elected South African authorities.
De benaming van straatnamen op Zuid-Afrikaans grondgebied is een zaak van de democratisch gekozen Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven, Bosma en Wilders over de Turkse reactie op het in het Rijksmuseum exposeren van een ‘anti-Turkse spotprent’

PVV MPs asked the government about Turkish media criticism of a 1683 anti-Turkish caricature exhibited at the Rijksmuseum, whether Turkish authorities had contacted the Dutch government, and whether the museum's explanatory text was a form of capitulation. The minister answered that the Turkish embassy raised concern via the foreign ministry, that the museum is responsible for its own captions, and that the government does not share the characterization of the museum's conduct.
As for any Turkish contacts with the Rijksmuseum, I refer you to the director of the Rijksmuseum.
Voor wat betreft eventuele Turkse contacten met het Rijksmuseum, verwijs ik u naar de directeur van het Rijksmuseum.

Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vertragen van de film Mocro’s door het Filmfonds omdat deze film «vooroordelen» van Marokkanen zou bevestigen (ingezonden 1

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Film Fund delayed the film Mocro's by a year because it confirmed prejudices about Moroccans, and why the taxpayer should keep funding this group. The state secretary denied the film was delayed for that reason, explaining the maker chose to re-edit the documentary after the Fund criticised its departure from the original filmplan, with no influence exercised by the Fund.
The Film Fund did not exert any influence on this and gave its full cooperation to the committed financing for realisation.
Het Filmfonds heeft hier geen invloed op uitgeoefend en heeft de volle medewerking gegeven voor de toegezegde financiering voor realisering.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Parlement Curaçao neemt omstreden wet aan» (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether a Curaçao law requiring employers to hire at least 80 percent local workers would breach human rights treaties, the Statute of the Kingdom, and the rights of Dutch citizens. The minister replied that the draft ordinance is still with the Curaçao government, that it differentiates among Dutch nationals by origin and may conflict with the equality principle, but that assessing its compatibility is not yet for him and that he expects Curaçao to examine this before ratification.
At this stage it is not for me to assess whether the draft meets the applicable strict requirements.
Het is in dit stadium niet aan mij om te beoordelen of het ontwerp aan de daarvoor geldende strenge eisen voldoet.

Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over SP-financier Sauer die een substantieel aandelenpakket van NRC Handelsblad blijkt te hebben (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she knew that SP financier Derk Sauer holds 9 percent of NRC Handelsblad, and whether editorial independence from ownership should be supervised, and expresses concern about the paper's political leaning. The minister replies that the ministry does not follow share ownership closely, that editorial-ownership separation is regulated by the Raad voor de Journalistiek rather than the ministry, and dismisses the political-bias concerns.
Naturally I consider separation of editorial staff and owner important. But regulation here takes place through the Press Council (Raad voor de Journalistiek).
Vanzelfsprekend acht ik scheiding van redactie en eigenaar van belang. Maar hier vindt regulering plaats via de Raad voor de Journalistiek.

Vragen van de leden Bosma en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over nieuwe gevallen van wetenschappelijke fraude aan het Nexus Instituut, gelieerd aan de Universiteit Tilburg (ing

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether the director of the Nexus Institute misquoted Menno ter Braak in a speech at Lowlands and whether this constitutes scientific fraude warranting an end to subsidy. The minister answered that government does not check the accuracy of quotations, that free expression and academic freedom apply, that no scientific fraud is apparent, and that ending subsidy is not at issue.
The government has no role in checking the accuracy of quotations.
De overheid heeft geen rol in het controleren van de juistheid van citaten.

Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over levenslange subsidie voor een kunstenaar die voor inspiratie zou gaan zorgen (ingezonden 5 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a lifelong subsidy (eregeld) given to a writer, whether it had produced promised inspiration, why it went to female writers, how many artists receive such subsidies, and whether it could be granted to ordinary citizens. The secretary replied that the eregeld is an income supplement for a small group of older authors, that the letter did not promise inspiration, that 23 recipients exist with no new awards, and that such income-type schemes will be discontinued.
In my letter 'Meer dan kwaliteit' I indicated that all subsidy schemes of funds with the character of an income provision will be discontinued.
In mijn brief «Meer dan kwaliteit» heb ik aangegeven dat alle subsidieregelingen van fondsen met het karakter van een inkomensvoorziening zullen worden stopgezet.

Vragen van de leden Bosma en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het molesteren van journalisten door moskeebezoekers (ing

MPs Bosma and Van Klaveren asked about a camera crew being harassed at a mosque in Utrecht, alleged Libyan funding of the mosque, a 2003 NVJ pamphlet on reporting on migrants, arrests, and incident statistics for religious buildings. The minister answered that police investigation is ongoing with no suspects arrested, funding is the initiator's matter, the pamphlet was not NVJ policy, and violent incidents at churches and synagogues are not registered separately.
Violent incidents between believers and journalists at churches and synagogues are not specifically registered.
Geweldsincidenten tussen gelovigen en journalisten bij kerken en synagogen worden niet specifiek geregistreerd.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma, Van Klaveren, en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «WOII moet weer centrale plek krijgen» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Holocaust lessons are being adapted for Muslim pupils and to what extent. The minister said there is no national overview, that lesson design is teachers' professional responsibility, and that a survey indicated one in five history teachers in big cities had sometimes found it hard to raise the Holocaust, without this implying structural problems.
In essence this is the professional responsibility of teachers, in which the government has no involvement.
In essentie is dit de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van leraren waar de overheid geen bemoeienis mee heeft.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de anti-PVV cursus aan de Erasmus Universiteit (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a Erasmus University workshop on framing that he described as an anti-PVV course paid for by taxpayers, and whether the funding should be cut. The state secretary answered that the workshop was not against the PVV, was open to all, was organised by Studium Generale with an outside partner, and that no reduction in funding was warranted.
Enquiries have shown that the Erasmus University did not organise a meeting against the PVV.
Navraag heeft opgeleverd dat de Erasmus Universiteit geen bijeenkomst tegen de PVV heeft georganiseerd.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Bosma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een doodsbedreiging op de website Marokko.nl (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked why threats against a former PVV candidate on the website Marokko.nl were not removed within an hour as promised, whether the operator should be sanctioned, and whether its subsidy had ended. The minister declined to classify the posts as threats (left to police and courts), said the operator promised to remove such posts within an hour and did so after being asked, and confirmed the subsidy was phased out in 2009.

However, it does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to classify the statements in this specific case as threats; that is for the police and justice to assess and ultimately for the independent judge.

Het past mij echter als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om in dit concrete geval de uitingen als bedreiging te kwalificeren; dat is ter beoordeling aan politie en justitie en in laatste instantie aan de onafhankelijke rechter.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Bosma (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitzending «Zet het klimaat op 1» (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Bosma asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a public broadcaster programme on climate change and a graphic 10:10 climate campaign video, and whether public broadcasting should cooperate with the campaign. The minister called the video distasteful, said nobody may be forced to take part, and stated that broadcasters are responsible for their own programming, with the VARA having excluded the video from the broadcast.
Furthermore, it is up to the public broadcasters themselves to decide whether they want to take part in this campaign.
Verder is het aan de publieke omroepen zelf om te beslissen of ze aan deze campagne willen meedoen.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Baklava, dranghekken en muziek, iedereen viert suikerfeest» (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the public broadcaster's costly 'Suikerfeest' broadcast, with a large Arab-style dinner and a rented concert hall, was justified given only 81,000 viewers. The state secretary replied that programme content is up to the broadcasters, gave the cost as EUR 125,000, and defended the programme under the Media Act's pluriformity mandate.
As state secretary of OCW, I do not decide on the content of the programmes.
Als staatssecretaris van OCW ga ik niet over de inhoud van de programma’s.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Zembla-programma «Wilders, profeet van de angst» (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

PVV MP Bosma asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on Geert Wilders, questioning whether public broadcasting should label an elected politician a Nazi and whether balanced programming rules were being followed. The state secretary rejected Bosma's interpretation, noted the broadcaster is independent with oversight by the Commissariaat voor de Media and courts, and declined to act on the other questions, including one about a VARA founder's wartime history.
Supervision of the performance of the task is arranged independently through the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van de taak is onafhankelijk geregeld via het Commissariaat voor de Media.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma, Bosma en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat moslimleerlingen moeite hebben met de holocaust (in

PVV MPs asked ministers about a report that Muslim pupils have difficulty discussing the Holocaust, linking this to Islamisation, rising antisemitism and calling for an immigration stop from Muslim countries. The government answered that teachers can handle sensitive topics, that antisemitism reports do not show a sharp rise, that antisemitic slogans are prosecuted, and that a religion-based immigration stop is rejected as contrary to the rule of law.
The picture painted in the question that this form of antisemitism is not being tackled forcefully, I reject.
Het in de vraag geschetste beeld dat deze vorm van antisemitisme niet daadkrachtig wordt aangepakt, wijs ik van de hand.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verkiezingsbeïnvloeding door de Katholieke Radio-omroep (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An MP asked whether the KRO broadcasting association could lawfully send members a letter urging them to support it electorally, its cost, and whether its subsidy should be withdrawn. The state secretary answered that the letter is a permitted member-communication activity not publicly funded, that it gave no voting advice, and that the law gives no basis to withdraw the subsidy.
No. The law gives me no competence and basis for that.
Nee. De wet geeft mij daarvoor geen bevoegdheid en grondslag.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het lidmaatschap van de VVD van KRO-voorzitter Koen Becking (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether KRO chairman Koen Becking, who is a VVD member, favored his own party in a member letter and whether publicly funded means were used against a VVD competitor just before the elections. The state secretary answered that the letter contained no voting advice, that the content is Becking's responsibility, and that the campaign was financed from association income, not public funds.
I point out again that this activity was not funded with public money, but from association income.
Ik wijs er nogmaals op dat deze activiteit niet met publieke middelen is bekostigd, maar uit verenigingsinkomsten

m: Amendement van het lid Spekman over uitbreiding van het aantal inspecteurs van de Arbeidsinspectie met 100 fte
Increases funding by 5 million euro to add 100 fte labour inspectors, to be partly covered by higher fine revenue.
This amendment aims to expand the number of Labour Inspectorate inspectors by 100 fte.
Dit amendement beoogt het aantal inspecteurs van de Arbeidsinspectie met 100 fte uit te breiden.

Het amendement stelt het normbedrag voor alleenstaande jongeren van 21 en 22 jaar gelijk met dat in de WWB.
Amendement van het lid Spekman om te waarborgen dat voor alle groepen jongeren het bijstandsniveau uit de WWB geldt
Amendment raising the benefit level for 21- and 22-year-olds under the WIJ law to the WWB level in cases of medical or psychological incapacity and for the first two months.
With these changes it is ensured as far as possible that for all groups of young people the assistance level of the WWB applies.
Met deze wijzigingen wordt zoveel mogelijk gewaarborgd dat voor alle groepen jongeren het bijstandsniveau uit de WWB geldt.
