MP Spekman asked the immigration minister whether existing policy suffices for LHBT asylum seekers facing problems in reception centres, and about protection, housing and status criteria. The minister replied that policy is adequate but that COA will study how to lower barriers to reporting incidents, that homosexuals with a well-founded fear of persecution can receive asylum regardless of criminalisation, and that a study will conclude in summer 2011.

That is why, in my conversation with Secret Garden and COC Nederland, I agreed that COA will examine with these organisations how possible barriers to reporting incidents that LHBT people may experience can be removed.

Daarom heb ik tijdens het gesprek met Secret Garden en COC Nederland afgesproken dat het COA samen met deze organisaties onderzoekt hoe mogelijke drempels voor meldingsbereidheid, die LHBT's bij incidenten kunnen ervaren, kunnen worden weggenomen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Knops (CDA), Voordewind (CU) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over Egyptische asielzoekers (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Four MPs asked the immigration minister how many Egyptian asylum seekers had been refused and told to leave, whether Coptic Christians can safely return given recent violence, when updated country reports would appear, and whether deportations should pause amid upheaval. The minister said refusals were indicative only, that individual assessment remains the basis, that no separate country report was needed, and that no departure moratorium applies to Egypt at present.
On the basis of these indicative figures it cannot be concluded that this is also the actual number of former Egyptian asylum seekers who had to leave the Netherlands.
Op basis van deze indicatieve cijfers kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat dit ook het daadwerkelijke aantal Egyptische ex-asielzoekers betreft die Nederland daadwerkelijk moest verlaten.
Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Kooiman en Rik Janssen (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de opvangomstandigheden voor asielkinderen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government shares the view that little has been done since 2009 to improve conditions for about 7,000 children in asylum centres, and about frequent transfers, homework rooms, a child contact person and the 65 Unicef recommendations. The minister rejected the claim that little was done, pointed to ongoing answers to committee questions, said children now mostly stay at one location, that homework rooms exist, and that families have a contact point, so no separate child representative is needed.
I therefore do not share the view of the director of Vluchtelingenwerk, as reported in Spits.
Ik deel de mening van de directeur van Vluchtelingenwerk, zoals die in het bericht in Spits is weergegeven, dan ook niet.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitzendbureaus die knoeien met buitenlandse arbeidskrachten (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MP Spekman asked the minister of Social Affairs about temporary work agencies and posted-worker abuses, including illegal employment through certified agencies, Bulgarian self-employed workers' low rates, and enforcement of the WAGA. The minister answered that certified agencies do break rules, that a bill will exclude offending firms from the certification register, that information exchange with other member states works well, and that inspection capacity is adequate.
In addition, periodic talks take place at official level with the industry on improving the quality of the certificate.
Daarnaast vinden op ambtelijk niveau periodiek gesprekken plaats met de branche over de verbetering van de kwaliteit van het certificaat.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over zijn gesprek met het COC over voornemens van het kabinet die gezinsvorming van partners van hetzelfde geslacht belemmeren

Two PvdA MPs asked the immigration minister whether he conceded to the COC that his claim about same-sex couples marrying abroad or entering on tourist visas was untenable, and whether he would find an exception for same-sex partners. The minister said the route was more complicated than thought, that he would discuss the issue within cabinet and report back, and that the COC would be informed of the outcome.
I have committed to discussing the issue within the cabinet and then coming up with a proposal for a solution.
Ik heb toegezegd de problematiek binnen het kabinet te zullen bespreken en daarna met een voorstel voor een oplossing te komen.

Vragen van de leden Knops (CDA) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel, van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over rechterlijke uitspraken in Afghaanse asielzaken, die mede zijn gebase

MPs Knops and Spekman asked ministers whether court rulings in Afghan asylum cases, partly based on WikiLeaks material, mean the Foreign Affairs country reports on Afghanistan are unreliable and what follows for asylum policy. The government answered that the July 2010 report stands, that WikiLeaks material cannot be verified and will not be used as objective sources, and that it sees no reason to change its policy or pending cases, while appeals are ongoing.
Given the nature of the reports published on WikiLeaks, the information in them cannot be verified for accuracy, and these reports are therefore not suitable for use as objective source material.

Gezien de aard van de berichten die op Wikileaks zijn gepubliceerd, is daarin opgenomen informatie niet op juistheid te toetsen en lenen deze berichten zich derhalve niet voor het gebruik als objectief bronnenmateriaal.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over fraude in het Westland (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the minister of Social Affairs about fraud in the Westland, including whether capacity of the Labour Inspectorate should be expanded, whether a blacklist of repeat offenders should be created, and whether fines should be raised. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, referred to earlier answers for questions 2 to 5, and pointed to the government's broader anti-fraud commitment and a letter sent to the House.
For answering questions 2 to 5, I refer for brevity to my answers to earlier parliamentary questions.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 2 t/m 5 verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de onrechtmatige vreemdelingenbewaring van een voormalige alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoeker in de Kerstperiode (ingezonden 14 januari 2

An MP asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the unlawful detention of a young Angolan former unaccompanied minor over Christmas, including the court's findings, the handling of the hearing and whether lighter measures were considered. The minister disputes parts of the court's account, defends detention as a means to secure removal, declines to appeal, and promises to send the hearing transcript and to examine alternatives to detention.
Of course I am willing, at your request, to send the stenographic record of the hearing to the House of Representatives.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid op uw verzoek het stenografische verslag aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dam (beiden PvdA)aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over oneerlijke concurrentie op de arbeidsmarkt (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked whether unemployed Polish EU citizens can be expelled, why the government emphasised expulsion rather than unfair labour-market competition and exploitation by employers and agencies, and whether they would answer before 28 February. The minister confirmed that EU citizens who become an unreasonable burden on social assistance can lose residence rights, said a package of measures on labour, housing and registration will be sent by 15 April, and promised the answers by 1 March.
I will inform you about this by 15 April at the latest.
Ik zal u hierover uiterlijk 15 april a.s. informeren.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep over het recht op ondersteunin

MPs Spekman and Dijsselbloem asked ministers whether a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling granting AWBZ care to an undocumented minor needing support for special education changes entitlements, whether it affects child rights policy, whether it means the CRC should guide all rulings on children's private and family life, and whether earlier commitments on schooling and care for undocumented children are upheld. The minister replied that the ruling does not change policy, that the CRC has no direct effect beyond taking children's interests into account, and that schooling and necessary medical care remain available to undocumented children.
No, the coupling principle automatically excludes illegally residing foreigners from facilities, permits and benefits.
Nee, het koppelingsbeginsel sluit van rechtswege illegaal verblijvende vreemdelingen uit van voorzieningen, vergunningen en uitkeringen.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het in vreemdelingenbewaring plaatsen van een vreemdeling die aangifte kwam doen van de geboorte van zijn kind (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum why a rejected asylum seeker from Azerbaijan was detained after registering his child's birth at Winterswijk municipality, and whether such detentions should stop, given the risk that children go unregistered. The minister explained the identity check, the lack of valid ID and the detention on public-order grounds, and deferred the broader question to a forthcoming vision on illegal residence.
I expect to send you my vision on illegal residence, of which the criminalisation of illegal residence is part, before summer 2011.
Ik verwacht u mijn visie op illegaal verblijf, waar de strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf onderdeel van uitmaakt, voor de zomer 2011 toe te zenden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de positie van homoseksuele asielzoekers in de asielopvang in Nederland en in het Nederlandse asielbeleid (ingezonden 18 novemb

MPs Spekman and Marcouch asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how homosexual asylum seekers are protected in reception centres and under asylum policy, after a press report of hostility toward a gay asylum seeker. The minister replied that existing safety rules and sanctions are adequate, that homosexuals from Afghanistan, Iraq and Iran receive special protection, and that the COA will work with LGBT and faith organisations to improve reporting of aggression and discrimination.
The existing policy aimed at safeguarding the safety and liveability of all asylum seekers is sufficient to also address group-specific problems.
Het bestaande beleid dat ertoe dient de veiligheid en leefbaarheid van alle asielzoekers te borgen is toereikend om ook groepsspecifieke problematiek aan te pakken.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de legeskosten voor het aanvragen voor een vervangend verblijfsdocument voor een vreemdeling (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the fee for replacing a residence document lost or stolen for non-Dutch residents was raised from 100 to 250 euros, and whether this is disproportionate and unequal compared with Dutch identity documents. The minister confirmed the increase, defended it as cost-recovery reflecting the extra checks needed for foreign residence documents, and refused to reverse it.
I do not consider this increase exorbitant.
Ik acht deze verhoging niet exorbitant.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de notitie van Amnesty International over vreemdelingenbewaring (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Spekman and Voordewind asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the Dutch practice of immigration detention complies with the ultimum remedium principle, whether lighter alternatives are used in practice, whether courts assess alternatives, and how many detainees returned after various detention durations, following an Amnesty International report. The minister rejected Amnesty's conclusions, argued that alternatives such as a restricted location and reporting duties are applied, and supplied return figures by detention length for 2008 to 2010.
However, I am of the view that in recent years much has changed and improved both in the policy on immigration detention and in its implementation.
Ik ben echter van mening dat de afgelopen jaren zowel op het terrein van het beleid inzake vreemdelingenbewaring als de tenuitvoerlegging daarvan, het nodige is veranderd en verbeterd.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van de rechtbank ’s-Gravenhage over de grensdetentie van een alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoeker (ingezonden 25 november 201

An MP asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about a court ruling that border detention of an unaccompanied minor asylum seeker at Schiphol breached Article 5 ECHR, why the government did not appeal, what it will change, and whether detained minors should be compensated. The minister says he is reviewing the procedure to balance border control with child protection, did not appeal due to the court's reasoning on alternatives, and sees no basis for retroactive compensation.

I am currently considering how to organise the procedure so that both the interests served by border control under international agreements and the interests I advocate in my policy for unaccompanied minor foreigners can be combined in the best possible way.

Ik bezie thans hoe ik de procedure zodanig kan inrichten, dat zowel de belangen die in internationaal verband het grenstoezicht dienen als de belangen die ik in het beleid voor alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen voorsta op de best mogelijke wijze kunnen worden verenigd.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de vreemdelingenbewaring van Irakezen (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Voordewind asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about a Council of State ruling that an Iraqi detainee was held unlawfully during the period when the European Court of Human Rights had suspended deportations to Iraq, and whether all Iraqi detainees in that period are entitled to compensation. The Minister rejected the wider conclusions, saying the ruling concerned one individual case, that detention of about 160 Iraqis was continued where deportation remained realistic, and that roughly six cases were wrongly ended and the individual was released.
I have of course released the foreign national to whom the ruling relates.
Ik heb de vreemdeling op wie de uitspraak betrekking heeft uiteraard in vrijheid gesteld.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het rapport van de Inspectie voor Sanctietoepassing over vreemdelingenbewaring (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

MP Spekman asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the Inspectorate's report on immigration detention shows treatment of asylum seekers is too harsh, and whether alternatives to detention and different regimes for vulnerable groups will be developed. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate did not conclude treatment is too harsh, refers to the earlier letter on the recommendations, and says alternatives will be addressed in the return policy letter expected mid-2011.
This conclusion is not drawn by the Inspectorate.
Deze conclusie wordt niet door de Inspectie getrokken.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof in Den Haag over de opvang van minderjarige kinderen van vreemdelingen (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

MP Spekman asks the immigration minister how the government will respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling requiring shelter and subsistence for minor children of rejected asylum-seeking families, and whether it will stop removing such families from reception without guaranteed accommodation, respect the ruling, and set up return houses. The minister says he will appeal to cassation, will comply with the ruling by not putting families with minors onto the street, and aims for a separate sober locality for such families.

I respect this ruling, which means that families with minor children whose procedures have concluded will not be put out onto the street from regular COA reception centres or from the VBL in Ter Apel.

Ik respecteer deze uitspraak, hetgeen betekent dat uitgeprocedeerde gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen niet vanuit reguliere opvangocaties van het COA of vanuit de VBL in Ter Apel op straat zullen worden gezet.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eisen van inburgering in het buitenland voor de gezinshereniging van

MPs Van Dam and Spekman asked whether Dutch pre-departure civic integration requirements block family reunification for two refugee-family cases and whether a hardship clause should be added. The minister answered that no exemption applies to these groups, that the exam is feasible, but that a hardship clause (effective 1 April 2011) has been added and one of the cases is being reconsidered.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand 2000 (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

MPs Recourt and Spekman asked the state secretary about the amendment to the Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand 2000, which removes the possibility of paying legal aid contributions from special social assistance and lowers the contribution for those who first visit the legal counter. The state secretary answered that lower-income people keep access to subsidised legal aid, that the legal counter is free and reduces contributions substantially, and that no hardship exception or special treatment for benefit recipients or alimony cases is planned.
With the amendment of the Bvr, a change is made in that persons who go through the legal counter before engaging a lawyer can benefit from a substantially lower contribution.

Met de wijziging van het Bvr wordt hierin in zoverre verandering gebracht, dat rechtzoekenden die langs het juridisch loket gaan alvorens een advocaat in te schakelen, kunnen profiteren van een substantieel lagere eigen bijdrage.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de nieuwe huisvesting van de provincie Utrecht (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

PvdA MPs Heijnen and Spekman asked the Interior Minister about the Utrecht provincial government's three headquarters buildings, the associated financial risks, and whether provinces should show restraint on housing investment amid planned cuts. The minister answered that housing investment and its financial risks are the province's autonomous responsibility, that supervision focuses on structural budget balance rather than housing policy, and that no imbalance is expected, while the question of tighter supervision of Randstad provinces will be considered once the regional reorganisation plan takes concrete shape.
Supervision of the provinces is aimed at their financial position, as expressed in a structural budget balance and/or multi-year forecast.
Het toezicht op de provincies is gericht op de financiële positie van de provincies, zoals tot uitdrukking komt in structureel evenwicht op de begroting en/of meerjarenraming.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over de pogingen van de Nederlandse Staat om een Angolees gezin uit te zetten (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister whether the Dutch state tried to deport an Angolan family with minor children despite a pending appeals court interim ruling, and whether pressure was applied during departure talks. The Minister replied that the family has no lawful residence, that the interim ruling does not prevent deportation, that no pressure or threats were made, and that the Minister would maintain shelter pending the final ruling.
No pressure was exerted in the conversations with those involved.
Er is bij de gesprekken met betrokkenen geen druk uitgeoefend.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de situatie van asielzoekers in Griekenland (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

MP Spekman asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the situation of asylum seekers in Greece, including Greek detention conditions, the adequacy of Greece's national action plan, the handling of Dublin transfers, and whether Dutch courts' concerns about returns to southern countries were addressed. The minister answered that Greece must resolve problems within its own legal order, that the Greek action plan and EU support are the right route, that the ECHR ruling on Greece is pending, and that transfers to Greece are currently not being carried out.

Without wishing to ignore the concerns about the conditions in Greek penitentiary institutions described in CPT reports, I want to reiterate that problems should as far as possible be raised and resolved within the Greek legal order.

Zonder voorbij te willen gaan aan de zorgen over de, in onder andere CPT-rapporten, beschreven toestand in de Griekse penitentiaire inrichtingen, wil ik nogmaals het uitgangspunt benadrukken dat problemen zoveel mogelijk binnen de Griekse rechtsorde moeten worden aangekaart en opgelost.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Sterk (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Van Klaveren (PVV), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel ov

MPs from several parties asked the immigration minister about a Stichting Gave survey reporting discrimination and threats against Christians and ex-Muslims in asylum centres, and about COA rules, reporting, police complaints, a confidential contact point and detention or revocation of asylum for perpetrators. The minister answered that the survey was methodologically flawed and small, that COA records show only three incidents between Muslims and Christians in two years, that complaints channels already exist, and that a separate confidential contact person is unnecessary; he declined to add a new study or automatic asylum revocation.
The COA will address this survey in the regular consultation with Stichting Gave.
Het COA zal in het reguliere overleg met Stichting Gave aandacht besteden aan deze peiling.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over het mediabericht dat het aantal alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (ama’s) in de cel in 2009 is verdubbeld (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the number of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers held in detention doubled in 2009, why, and how this fits the policy of detention as a last resort and the Return Directive. The minister answered that numbers rose from about 160 to 300 in 2009 before falling again in 2010, that detention is a last resort, and that a review of making the facility more open is underway.
I will inform your House of the outcome once the research is completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst zodra het onderzoek is afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State van 9 september 2010 over de veiligheidssituatie in Mogadishu, Somalië (ingezonde

An MP asks the Minister of Justice whether the Council of State's September 2010 ruling on the security situation in Mogadishu requires changing asylum policy, and whether deportations to Mogadishu should be paused. The minister answers that Mogadishu must now be treated as a situation under Article 15c of the Qualification Directive, so Somali asylum seekers from Mogadishu may get residence permits unless they have an internal relocation alternative, and that no deportations to Mogadishu are currently planned.
As I answered in question 2, a situation as referred to in Article 15c of the Qualification Directive must currently be assumed in Mogadishu.
Zoals ik heb geantwoord op vraag 2, moet op dit moment in Mogadishu een situatie worden aangenomen als bedoeld in artikel 15c van de Kwalificatierichtlijn.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden van arboartsen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

PvdA MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the state secretary about working conditions of occupational physicians, citing reports of work pressure and conflicts with ethics and independence. The state secretary answered that a joint study with VWS is underway, results expected by summer 2011, that employers are responsible for occupational health provision, and that the government will await the study before acting.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of the study into the position of the occupational physician, as mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de positie van de bedrijfsarts, zoals genoemd in antwoord op vraag 2, af.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de situatie van asielzoekers in Griekenland (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister for Immigration and Asylum about the humanitarian situation of asylum seekers in Greece, including the Evros region, low recognition rates, a 2010 ECtHR ruling on detention conditions, and Dutch support for Greek reform. The minister answers that Frontex border teams and a Greek national action plan are underway, that the Netherlands will offer practical support, and gives an average reception cost figure.
The Netherlands offered Greece support in a wide range of areas at that time.
Nederland heeft Griekenland toen het aanbod gedaan om op allerlei gebieden ondersteuning te bieden.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kwaliteit van schuldhulpverlening in gemeenten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked whether municipal debt assistance is failing individuals, how many municipalities have capacity problems, and whether the government will inventory and publish problem cases. The state secretary answered that no national picture exists, that municipalities are responsible for quality, that examining individual municipalities does not fit the division of responsibilities, and pointed to a pending bill setting a minimum quality floor.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten «UNHCR: stuur geen Irakezen meer terug» en «Nederland stuurt Iraakse vluchtelingen naar onveilige

MPs Voordewind and Spekman asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government would suspend forced returns of Iraqi refugees after UNHCR called for a halt, given changed security conditions since the January 2010 country report. The minister replied that the new October 2010 country report gives no reason to change policy, that the general situation does not meet the ECHR Article 3 threshold, and that individual assessment and protection for vulnerable minorities continue, but the question about suspending returns was answered 'Ja' in the document's final repeated question, creating an inconsistency.
I see no reason in this country report to change the existing policy regarding Iraqi asylum seekers.
Ik zie in dit ambtsbericht geen aanleiding om het bestaande beleid ten aanzien van Iraakse asielzoekers te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether 385,000 children (11%) grow up in poverty according to CBS figures, why the government's child-poverty targets are not being met, and how planned cuts to child-related benefits, welfare and income support fit with those targets. The state secretary said the CBS figure measures a 120%-of-minimum-income threshold rather than poverty itself, that the SCP participation measure is still being monitored with results due in early 2011, and that cuts are necessary while work participation of parents is the main policy lever.
Your House will be informed about this as agreed.
Uw Kamer zal daar volgens afspraak over worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verkeerd voorlichten van deelnemers door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en (re)Integratie. (ingezonden 20 se

MPs Vermeij and Spekman asked the minister whether the PWRI pension fund, which won a communication award in 2009, misinformed participants about the AOV supplementary scheme, and whether participants should be fully and clearly informed. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, acknowledged past communication about the AOV was unfortunate that has since been improved, and agreed participants should receive complete, correct and understandable information.
I note that the communication by PWRI about the AOV scheme has been unfortunate in the past.
Ik constateer dat de communicatie door het PWRI over de AOV-regeling in het verleden ongelukkig is geweest.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken, Recourt en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over het opslaan van gestolen of gevaarlijke goederen in professionele opslagplaatsen (i

PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers whether professional storage firms are a hub for stolen or hazardous goods and whether investigative and fire services have enough access to them. The minister said there is no evidence of structural use by criminals, sees no need for a national inquiry or a new inspection power, considers entry without suspicion undesirable for privacy reasons, and rejects extra liability for landlords.
In my view, investigative bodies would intrude too far into citizens' private lives if they could enter and search storage rooms without cause.
Naar mijn mening treden onderzoeksinstanties in te grote mate in de persoonlijke levenssfeer van burgers als er zonder aanleiding opslagruimtes kunnen worden betreden en doorzocht.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegepaste beslagvrije voet (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

MP Spekman asked whether the Utrecht social affairs department applies only the bare basic exempt amount (beslagvrije voet) in third-party garnishment, whether it can and should be raised for housing and health insurance costs, and whether municipalities should be made to pursue this given growing debt problems. Minister Donner answered that he knows of no deviation from the law, that municipalities are legally bound to apply garnishment but need not inform bailiffs of the increase, and that a calculation tool was developed to apply the statutory increase correctly.
I am not aware that the municipality of Utrecht implements a third-party garnishment in a manner other than that prescribed in the Code of Civil Procedure.
Mij is niet bekend dat de gemeente Utrecht op een andere manier – dan in het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering is bepaald – uitvoering zou geven aan een derdenbeslag.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een stijgend aantal medewerkers uit de zorg dat is ingeschreven bij het UWV (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about a rising number of care workers registered with the UWV, and whether reorganisations, company size or fragmented jobs might cause burnout. The minister answered that personnel policy is primarily the employers' responsibility, that labour conditions inspection falls under the social affairs ministry, and that concerns would be raised with social partners and included in a research programme, without committing to a new investigation.
I will ask social partners about this in my contacts with them.
Daarom ga ik sociale partners daar naar vragen in mijn contacten met hen.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het online aanbieden van woekerleningen door een Fins bedrijf dat zich aan Nederlands toezicht en consumenten bescherming probeert

MPs Plasterk and Spekman ask the Finance Minister about online flash loans offered by a Finnish firm trying to avoid Dutch supervision and consumer protection, and about rising debt problems and other providers. The minister confirms awareness, says flash credit is a significant problem case, notes the planned Wet op het financieel toezicht and maximum credit cost rules, but declines a new survey of providers because no licensing register exists and the coming law will reshape the sector.
Given that there is not yet a licensing requirement, and therefore no register of all providers is kept, no overview of all providers can be given at this moment.
Gezien het feit dat er nog geen vergunningplicht is, en dus geen register van alle aanbieders wordt bijgehouden, kan op dit moment geen overzicht gegeven worden van alle aanbieders.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het online aanbieden van woekerleningen door een Fins bedrijf dat zich aan Nederlands toezicht en consumenten bescherming probeert

MPs Plasterk and Spekman asked the Finance Minister about online flash-credit websites run by a Finnish company that advertise loans without BKR checks and may escape Dutch supervision. The minister answered that such short-term loans currently fall outside the Wet financieel toezicht, that the consumer credit directive implementation will bring them under supervision and a 15% cap, and that the AFM has warned providers and can act against unfair practices in the meantime.

After the consumer credit directive implementation bill takes effect, flash credits and all other credits with a term under three months on which more than negligible costs are charged will fall under financial supervision.

Na inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van de richtlijn consumentenkrediet (kamerstukken 32 339 ) vallen flitskredieten en alle andere kredieten met een looptijd korter dan drie maanden waarbij meer dan onbetekenende kosten worden gerekend wél onder financieel toezicht.
Vragen van de leden Arib, Spekman en Dijsselbloem (allen PvdA) aan de ministers voor Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over medische zorg aan asielzoekers (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs from the Labour party asked about the death of a pregnant Somali asylum seeker at the Leersum reception centre, including GP access, out-of-hours care, interpreter use, ambulance response and the Public Prosecution Service inquiry. The minister declined to comment on the circumstances pending the Health Care Inspectorate investigation, explained the care model and interpreter responsibility, and noted the inspectorate and prosecutor inquiries.
Pending this investigation, I make no statements about the circumstances under which the woman died.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraken over de omstandigheden waaronder de vrouw is overleden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de behandeling van Portugese werknemers bij de in aanbouw zijnde RWE-centrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Spekman asked the minister about reports that Portuguese workers at the RWE power plant in Eemshaven were evicted after protesting pay and conditions, and what the government would do to secure their rights. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, said the Labour Inspectorate is monitoring compliance and has started an investigation into minimum wage payments, and pointed to information provision and a memorandum with Portugal.
If supervision of compliance with laws and regulations by the Labour Inspectorate shows that the laws are being violated, action will be taken against it.
Indien in het kader van het toezicht op de wet- en regelgeving door de Arbeidsinspectie mocht blijken dat de wet- en regelgeving wordt overtreden, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Gesthuizen (beiden SP) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over het op straat zetten van een gezin met minderjarig kind (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a family with a five-year-old child was put out of the Ter Apel asylum centre without means on 30 July 2010, and how this squares with a Hague Court ruling that the State acts unlawfully when minors are left on the street, and whether such evictions will stop pending appeal. The minister answered that the family, a Dublin transfer case, was offered temporary shelter in the restricted-freedom location after a night with a private host, and that shelter for families with minor children whose departure cannot be enforced will not be ended pending the court case, though no new shelter will be offered beyond existing rules.

Following the interim ruling of the Hague Court of Appeal, I have decided for the time being not to end shelter in regular asylum centres for families with minor children whose departure from the Netherlands cannot (immediately) be enforced.

Naar aanleiding van de tussenuitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag heb ik besloten vooralsnog opvang in reguliere AZC's van gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen wier vertrek uit Nederland niet (onmiddellijk) kan worden geëffectueerd, niet te beëindigen.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische en van Zaken en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de grootschalige ontslagen bij MSD/Organon te Oss (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs Hamer and Spekman asked ministers about the mass layoffs at MSD/Organon in Oss, including urgent action to limit damage, short-term help for those losing jobs, UWV anticipation of job seekers, and contact with the municipality of Oss. The government answered that it agrees the job losses are serious, that consultations involving the government and other parties are underway to preserve jobs and knowledge via two working groups, that UWV is closely involved, and that it is not yet clear which employees become redundant.
At this moment it is not yet clear for which employees redundancy will arise.
Op dit moment is nog niet duidelijk voor welke medewerkers boventalligheid ontstaat.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het wegpesten van een homostel uit hun huis (ingezonden 15 juni

MPs Kuiken and Spekman asked ministers whether harassment and nuisance against a gay couple in Leidsche Rijn, Utrecht, which led them to move out, should be tackled more strictly, whether existing legal instruments suffice, and what steps Utrecht has taken. The government answered that municipalities, police and justice are jointly responding, that the covert nature of the conduct makes evidence hard to gather, and that a new nuisance handbook and expanded powers for mayors are available.
It is regrettable that matters have escalated to the point where the victims feel compelled to move out.
Het is te betreuren dat het zo hoog is opgelopen dat de gedupeerden zich genoodzaakt voelen te gaan verhuizen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het vernietigen van een samenscholingsverbod door de Hoge Raad (ingezonden 24 juni 2

MPs Kuiken and Spekman asked ministers about the Supreme Court annulling a Utrecht public-assembly ban appeal on a procedural error and whether this affects enforcement. The government answered that the appeal was declared inadmissible due to a clerical error, that no new policy is planned, that the local ban enforcement continues, and that a new group-ban power will be introduced by the pending law.
Unfortunately there has been a mistake.
Er is helaas sprake geweest van een vergissing.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onveilige arbeidsomstandigheden van wegwerkers (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unsafe working conditions for road workers, including whether municipal tendering pushes contractors to cut safety costs. The minister answered that existing Arbo rules and safety plans already protect workers, that the Arbeidsinspectie is already consulting VNG, IPO and Rijkswaterstaat, and that the Interior Minister has no specific role.
The labour inspectorate has already been consulting on this for some time and will continue to do so.
De arbeidsinspectie voert hiermee al langer overleg en zal dat blijven doen.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onderzoek van FNV Jong waaruit blijkt dat de jeugdwerkloosheid niet wordt verholpen met de Wet WIJ (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Social Affairs whether the government will act after an FNV Jong study found that the WIJ law is not reducing youth unemployment, since only a quarter of unemployed youths who register with municipalities get a job or training offer. The minister replies that the WIJ was never meant to prevent youth unemployment, that it is too early to judge its effects, that the study sample was small, and that the government will rely on municipalities and social partners, point to a 250 million euro action plan, and promise an evaluation by 1 October 2011.
The WIJ will be evaluated within two years of entry into force, in line with the Spekman amendment.
De WIJ wordt, conform het amendement Spekman, binnen twee jaar na inwerkingtreding geëvalueerd.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter van de rechtbank Utrecht van 6 april 2010 over noodopvang voor een ui

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers how to read the Utrecht court's interim ruling ordering emergency shelter for a rejected asylum seeker and her minor child under the Wmo, and whether municipalities should provide such shelter in similar cases. The minister answered that the ruling is interim and not binding on the municipality's decision on objection, offered municipalities legal support, reaffirmed that departing foreigners bear responsibility for leaving, and promised to postpone planned evictions of families with children lawfully resident until 1 July.
As the interim judge also states in the ruling, the judgment does not bind the administrative body in its decision on the objection.
Zoals de voorzieningenrechter zelf ook in zijn uitspraak aangeeft, bindt de uitspraak het bestuursorgaan niet in zijn besluit op bezwaar.

Vragen van de leden Timmer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de relatie tussen arbeidsomstandigheden en ziekte dan wel sterfte (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

MPs Timmer and Spekman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FNV figures showing over 3,000 work-related deaths a year, the weak coverage of sector OSH catalogues, under-registration by occupational physicians, and the low inspection frequency. The minister said the figures are not new and reflect past exposures, defended existing policy, and promised continued support for catalogues and registration efforts while rejecting statutory sanctions for lacking a catalogue.
I am of the opinion that the OSH policy is successful.
Ik ben van mening dat het arbobeleid succesvol is.

m: Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer ter vervanging van nr. 101 over het verleggen van het afbouwpunt UAHK
Changes the tax thresholds for the general tax credit payout and the labour tax credit from 2028 and 2039, shifting the phase-out point and offsetting the cost.
This amendment aims to shift the phase-out point from the EUR 36,000 in the Tax Plan 2025 upward.
Dit amendement heeft als doel om het afbouwpunt te verleggen van het in het BP 2025 opgenomen bedrag van € 36.000
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer ter vervanging van nr. 75 over het verleggen van het afbouwpunt UAHK

Lowers the income tax general tax credit phase-out threshold via a split adjustment: reduces the labour tax credit by 27 euro from 2028 and restores it from 2039, while raising the UAHK phase-out point to 175% of minimum wage.
This amendment aims to shift the phase-out point of the UAHK from the €36,000 in Budget Plan 2025 to an expected €55,996 in 2028.
Dit amendement heeft als doel om het afbouwpunt te verleggen van het in het BP 2025 opgenomen bedrag van € 36.000 naar in 2028 naar verwachting € 55.996.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies betreffende invoering van een pseudo-eindheffing voor fossiele leaseauto's
Asks the government to carry out an SME test and a regulatory burden advisory (ATR) opinion on the pseudo-excise tax for fossil lease cars, and to monitor and report to the Chamber regularly.
requests the government to still carry out an SME test and an ATR advice for this measure

Amendement van het lid Stoffer ter vervanging van nr. 20 over 13 miljoen voor het programma Meer Veilig
Shifts 13 million euro from the budget item for explorations and reserves to the main road network to fund road safety on provincial roads under the Meer Veilig programme.
the commitment and expenditure amounts increased by EUR 13,000 (x EUR 1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 13.000 (x € 1.000)
Amendement van het lid Stoffer over uitstel verbod naar 2026
Postpones the effective date of the asbestos roof ban to 1 January 2026 instead of 2024, citing insufficient removal capacity.
This amendment therefore provides that the ban on asbestos roofs does not take effect before 1 January 2026.
Dit amendement regelt daarom dat het verbod op asbestdaken niet eerder van kracht wordt dan 1 januari 2026.
Amendement van het lid Stoffer over aanwijzing risicocategorieën van toepassingen van asbestproducten
Adds a power to designate risk categories of asbestos applications with set removal deadlines, to be set by rules that the executive makes, so later bans can be phased.
In the rules referred to in article 9.2.2.1a, first paragraph, risk categories of asbestos applications may be designated
In de regels, bedoeld in artikel 9.2.2.1a, eerste lid, kunnen risicocategorieën van toepassingen van asbest of asbesthoudende producten worden aangewezen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over gratis aanbieden van kleine hoeveelheden asbest bij de milieustraat
Asks the government to have municipalities offer free disposal of small quantities of asbestos at municipal recycling centres.
to ask municipalities to give private individuals the option of disposing of such small quantities of asbestos free of charge at the municipal recycling centre
gemeenten te verzoeken om particulieren de mogelijkheid te bieden, dergelijke kleine hoeveelheden asbest gratis aan te bieden bij de gemeentelijke milieustraat
Amendement van het lid Stoffer over saneringscapaciteit en de betaalbaarheid
Amendment requiring that asbestos removal capacity and affordability be considered when setting the asbestos roof ban rules.
account is taken of the expected availability of capacity to remove asbestos and asbestos-containing products and the affordability thereof
rekening gehouden met de verwachte beschikbaarheid van capaciteit om asbest en asbesthoudende producten te verwijderen en de betaalbaarheid hiervan
Motie van de leden Ziengs en Stoffer over een eenvoudiger certificering voor bedrijven
Asks the government to explore simpler certification so that companies beyond those already certified can remove asbestos.
requests the government, in responding to the TNO study outcomes, to explore the possibility of simpler certification for other companies
verzoekt de regering, bij de reactie op de uitkomsten van het TNO-onderzoek de mogelijkheid te verkennen voor een eenvoudiger certificering voor andere bedrijven
Motie van het lid Stoffer over landelijk dekkende financiële arrangementen
Asks the government to create nationwide financial arrangements to help property owners pay for removing asbestos roofs and to lower disposal costs.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities and provinces, to arrive at sufficient nationwide financial arrangements
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met gemeenten en provincies met voldoende landelijk dekkende financiële arrangementen te komen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 26 over geen cliëntenraad bij bepaalde vormen van ambulante zorg
Amends the Wmcz so small primary-care providers need not set up a client council unless they exceed a threshold, with an AMvB option for exemptions.

This amendment therefore opens the possibility, by general administrative order, to designate organisations offering certain forms of outpatient care, for whom the duty to establish a client council applies only if they provide care to more than 25 persons.

Dit amendement opent daarom de mogelijkheid om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur organisaties aan te wijzen die bepaalde vormen van ambulante zorg bieden, waarvoor de plicht om een cliëntenraad in te stellen alleen gaat gelden als zij met meer dan 25 personen zorg verlenen.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 23 over alleen redelijke kosten voor juridische bijstand

Amendment limits the costs a works council may charge to the institution for legal proceedings to those reasonably necessary, with prior notice, and allows a binding ruling by a committee of trusted persons on disputes.

Costs incurred by a client council for legal proceedings on the application of this act, and costs of requests under articles 11 and 13, are borne by the institution only if reasonably necessary and the institution was notified in advance.

Kosten die een cliëntenraad maakt voor het voeren van rechtsgedingen over de toepassing van deze wet alsmede kosten verbonden aan het indienen van verzoeken als bedoeld in artikel 11 en 13, vijfde lid, komen slechts ten laste van de instelling indien deze kosten redelijkerwijs noodzakelijk zijn
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over beroep bij de Ondernemingskamer
Moves appeal against decisions of the trust commission under the Wmcz 2018 to the Enterprise Chamber of the Amsterdam Court of Appeal, with a short deadline and no cassation.
the Enterprise Chamber of the Amsterdam Court of Appeal
de ondernemingskamer van het gerechtshof Amsterdam
Amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over alleen redelijke kosten voor juridische bijstand
Limits the costs a client council may charge to institutions for legal proceedings to those reasonably necessary and notified in advance.
only chargeable to the institution insofar as these costs are reasonably necessary
slechts ten laste van de instelling voor zover deze kosten redelijkerwijs noodzakelijk zijn
Amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. over toestemming bij alle besluiten om zwaarwegende redenen
Removes the restriction to business-organisational, business-economic and business-social reasons so the trust committee can give consent for any serious-reason decision of an institution.
In article 8(6)(b), the words 'business-organisational, business-economic or business-social' are deleted.
In artikel 8, zesde lid, onderdeel b, vervalt «bedrijfsorganisatorische, bedrijfseconomische of bedrijfssociale».
Amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. over overleg voor een besluit om niet in te stemmen
Amendment requiring the client council to consult the institution at least once before deciding not to consent to a proposed decision.
The client council may withhold its consent only after consultation with the institution, insofar as reasonably possible, has taken place at least once.
De cliëntenraad onthoudt zijn instemming niet dan nadat daarover, voor zover dat redelijkerwijs mogelijk is, ten minste eenmaal met de instelling overleg is gepleegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 17 over geen cliëntenraad bij bepaalde vormen van ambulante zorg
Amendment exempting certain small outpatient care providers from the duty to set up a client council unless they employ more than 25 people, leaving other participation rights intact.
This amendment therefore opens the possibility, by general administrative order, to designate organisations offering certain forms of outpatient care
Dit amendement opent daarom de mogelijkheid om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur organisaties aan te wijzen die bepaalde vormen van ambulante zorg bieden
Motie van het lid Stoffer over een regeling voor rouwverlof
Asks the government to draft a proposal for a bereavement leave scheme for employees.
requests the government to draft a proposal for a bereavement leave scheme
verzoekt de regering, een voorstel uit te werken voor een regeling voor rouwverlof
Amendement van het lid Stoffer over aanvullende geboorteverlof van een week
Reduces the supplementary parental leave from five weeks to one week in the bill, to balance costs between employees and employers.
This amendment therefore limits the supplementary birth leave from five weeks to one week.
Dit amendement beperkt daarom het aanvullende geboorteverlof van vijf weken tot een week.
Motie van het lid Wiersma c.s. over vroegtijdig in kaart brengen van belemmeringen
Asks the government to monitor use of extended birth leave and partner leave, including by income group and employer burden, and report to the House yearly.
requests the government to monitor the use of both extended birth leave and additional partner birth leave
verzoekt de regering, het gebruik van zowel het uitgebreide geboorteverlof en het aanvullend geboorteverlof voor de partner te monitoren
Amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over beroep bij de ondernemingskamer
Changes the appeal route under the Wmcz so that appeals against decisions of the trust committee go to the Ondernemingskamer instead of the district court.
This amendment therefore proposes giving the Ondernemingskamer this role in the Wmcz as well.
Dit amendement stelt daarom voor om de Ondernemingskamer deze rol ook te geven in de Wmcz.
Amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over geen toepassing van de wet bij eerstelijns zorgaanbieders
Exempts small first-line care providers from the client council requirement of the Wmcz unless they employ more than 25 people.
This law does not apply to an institution where clients never stay, unless the institution generally provides care to more than 25 natural persons.
Deze wet is niet van toepassing op een instelling waar cliënten nooit verblijven, tenzij bij de instelling in de regel meer dan 25 natuurlijke personen zorg verlenen.
Motie van de leden Stoffer en Leijten over het verkleinen van de verschillen tussen een- en tweeverdieners
Asks the government to explore options for reducing the tax burden gap between single-earner and dual-earner households, reporting around Prinsjesdag 2018.
requests the government to map serious options to reduce the differences between single-earners and dual-earners
verzoekt de regering, serieuze opties in kaart te brengen om de verschillen tussen een- en tweeverdieners te verkleinen
Motie van het lid Stoffer over een maximale marginale belastingdruk
Motion asking the government to propose capping the marginal tax burden including benefits at 50% up to a modal income.
requests the government to come with proposals to cap the marginal tax burden including allowances up to a modal income at 50%.
verzoekt de regering, met voorstellen te komen om de marginale belastingdruk inclusief toeslagen tot een modaal inkomen maximaal 50% te laten bedragen
Motie van het lid Stoffer c.s. over wegnemen van pijnpunten in de marginale druk
Asks the government to sketch long-term options to remove marginal tax pressure pain points and report to the House within a year.
requests the government to sketch options for the longer term to remove pain points in marginal pressure
verzoekt de regering, opties te schetsen voor de langere termijn om de pijnpunten in de marginale druk
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de verkoop van het cloudbedrijf van DigiD en MijnOverheid en de dreiging voor onze digitale autonomie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about the sale of Solvinity, the cloud company running DigiD and MijnOverheid, to a US firm and the risks to data sovereignty and digital autonomy, including US legal access and safeguards against future foreign takeovers. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said an investigation into consequences is underway and that contracts will be adjusted, noted existing investment-screening tools, and promised exploration of a sovereign government cloud and periodic reporting.

Therefore, alongside the investigations by the statutory supervisors, research is currently being carried out under my direction into the operational, legal and contractual consequences of the planned takeover.

Daarom wordt momenteel, naast de onderzoeken van de wettelijke toezichthouders, onder mijn regie onderzoek gedaan naar de operationele, juridische en contractuele gevolgen van de voorgenomen overname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over het bericht: ‘Servische regering treitert buitenlandse supermarkten, Ahold Delhaize gaat winkels sluiten’

SGP MPs Stoffer and Flach asked whether Ahold Delhaize closed 25 stores in Serbia due to a retail margin cap, whether the measure breaches the internal market and the Stabilisation and Association Agreement, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Netherlands has raised concerns repeatedly with Serbian ministers, judges the measure market-distorting and at odds with EU accession criteria, and has asked the Commission to raise it, but did not commit to any formal sanction.
The cabinet considers the measure market-distorting and believes it is at odds with the economic criteria for EU accession.
Het kabinet acht de maatregel marktverstorend en is van mening dat deze op gespannen voet staat met de economische criteria bij EU-toetreding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de instandhoudingsopgave

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the growing maintenance backlog for Dutch roads, waterways and bridges, including multi-year financing, prioritisation and contractor incentives. The minister acknowledges the shortfall (about 34.5 billion euros for 2024-2038 per the Court of Audit), points to a maintenance plan and portfolio approach, but states that funding beyond 2030 and extra investment are decisions for a new cabinet.
It is up to a new cabinet to decide on future additional investments in infrastructure.
Het is aan een nieuw kabinet om te besluiten over toekomstige extra investeringen in de infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de situatie in Soedan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the role of gold in the Sudan conflict, Dutch pressure on the UAE over arms and gold trade, Dutch positions at the Foreign Affairs Council, food-security funding via the Dutch Relief Alliance, and pressure on the SAF and RSF to allow humanitarian access. The government answered by describing EU conflict-minerals rules, arms export assessments, Dutch advocacy for ceasefire and sanctions, a EUR 10 million contribution to the UN Sudan Humanitarian Fund, and diplomatic calls on warring parties to allow aid, without committing to new national measures against the UAE.
The cabinet will take a position on this at the moment any possible negotiation result is submitted to the Council for decision.
Het kabinet zal daarover een positie innemen op het moment dat een eventueel onderhandelingsresultaat ter besluitvorming wordt voorgelegd aan de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de NPO en Hamas

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the NOS will investigate its Gaza reporting, how it sources and verifies Hamas-related information, whether Hamas should be seen as a terrorist organisation, and whether NPO should produce classroom material. The minister answers that broadcasters are editorially independent and self-regulated via the Ombudsman, that the government does not direct programming or journalistic methods, that Hamas is an EU-listed terrorist organisation, and that education is part of the public media mandate while schools keep the freedom to choose materials.
The cabinet does not concern itself with the journalistic methods the NOS uses in specific cases.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de journalistieke werkwijze die de NOS in specifieke casussen hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de stroomstoring in de Heinenoordtunnel

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Heinenoordtunnel's emergency power supply failed during a prolonged outage and whether a backup such as diesel generators should be added. The minister acknowledged the failure, said the dual grid connection met the national tunnel standard, and deferred further answers until the cause investigation, expected within the month, is complete.
An investigation into the cause of the failure is currently under way and is expected to be completed this month.
Op dit moment wordt onderzoek gedaan naar de oorzaak van de storing. Dit is naar verwachting nog deze maand afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over christenvervolging in Afrika

MP Stoffer asks the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christian villages in Nigeria, the government's bilateral and EU diplomacy, and the role of the Special Envoy for Religion and Belief. The government acknowledges the religious dimension of the violence, says it raises freedom of religion with Nigeria and in the EU, but gives mostly general answers without firm new commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this shortly.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hier binnenkort over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘2 op 3 kinderen met gescheiden ouders merken daar jaren later nog gevolgen van’

An MP asked the government about a study finding that two in three children of divorced parents still feel effects in adulthood, and about the scale of divorce, whether policy should aim to reduce divorce, and support options such as relationship therapy and reconciliation. The government answered that parents are primarily responsible, pointed to existing support, the DOnS approach, a child-friendly divorce procedures project, and research on systemic therapy, while declining to set a goal of reducing divorce.
Data are not available on the group of people whose parents were ever divorced.
Gegevens zijn niet beschikbaar van de groep mensen van wie de ouders ooit gescheiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘SchoolTV onder vuur over Gaza: ’Hamas is een politieke partij, ze hebben ook mensen die vechten’

MPs Stoffer and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether SchoolTV's lesson material on Hamas and the Israel-Palestine conflict is independent, reliable and neutral, and what oversight and complaint routes exist. The Minister declined to assess the content of teaching materials or of public broadcasting, citing freedom of education and press freedom, and pointed to the Mediawet, the Commissariaat voor de Media and the Ombudsman for the public broadcasters as existing accountability channels, while refusing to commission further review or quality frameworks.
In general I consider it important that schools use proven effective methods.
Ik vind het in algemene zin belangrijk dat scholen gebruik maken van bewezen effectieve methoden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de door China opgelegde importheffingen voor varkensvlees

MPs Stoffer and Flach asked about Chinese provisional anti-dumping duties of 20% to 62.4% on EU pork, their effect on Dutch exporters, the WTO legitimacy of the Chinese claims, and whether the government would seek a delay. The state secretary answers that effects are still unclear but that Dutch exports to China (about 374 million euro in 2024) are at risk, that the Commission is assessing WTO conformity, and that the ministries have submitted written objections and remain in close contact with the sector.
The European Commission is currently further analysing the investigation and the provisional measures for conformity with World Trade Organization (WTO) rules.
De Europese Commissie analyseert het onderzoek en de voorlopige maatregelen momenteel nader op conformiteit met regels van de Wereldhandelsorganisatie (WTO)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 30 doden bij Christenvervolging in Congo

MPs Stoffer and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about a July 2025 attack on a Catholic church in Congo's Ituri province that killed over 30 people, including the state's capacity to prevent such attacks, the appointment of an EU religious freedom envoy, aid programmes, and terror listing of the ADF. The minister condemned the violence, described limited state control and EU/Ugandan efforts, said the envoy selection is in its final phase, and declined to comment on ongoing sanctions processes while promising to inform parliament of progress.
The cabinet makes no statements about ongoing sanctions procedures because of their confidentiality.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over lopende sanctietrajecten i.v.m. de vertrouwelijkheid hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de toegang van overheden tot mogelijk met PFAS-vervuilde bedrijfslocaties

An MP asked whether provinces lack powers to force access to possibly PFAS-contaminated company sites and whether companies must cooperate under the Environment and Planning Act's duty of care. The State Secretary replied that access for pure inventory studies is not enforceable but most firms cooperate voluntarily, while full supervisory powers under the General Administrative Law Act (Awb title 5.2) allow entry, sampling and police-assisted access where there is a concrete basis for supervision.
Thereby it is sufficiently ensured that governments have access to company sites, when the exercise of their supervisory task so requires.
Daarmee is voldoende geborgd dat overheden toegang hebben tot bedrijfsterreinen, als de uitoefening van hun toezichthoudende taak daarom vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer over onnodige trainingseisen voor vissers Wet bemanning zeeschepen

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked whether mandatory additional safety training for fishers under the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen is disproportionate and not aligned with practice on fishing vessels, and asked the government to pause implementation. The minister answered that the only change is a five-yearly refresher for basic safety training required by STCW-F, agreed with sector bodies, with a transition period to 2030, and declined to pause the law, which enters into force on 1 July 2025.
The only substantive change in the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen, which enters into force on 1 July 2025, is a five-yearly refresher obligation for this training.
De enige inhoudelijke aanpassing in de nieuwe Wet bemanning zeeschepen, die per 1 juli 2025 in werking treedt, is een 5-jaarlijkse herhalingsverplichting voor deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over het UN Watch onderzoek naar omstreden VN-rapporteur Francesca Albanese

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about UN Watch allegations that UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese had improper sponsored travel and that complaints were buried. The minister replied that the UN coordination committee found no breach of the code of conduct, that the internal complaint procedure appears adequate, and that the government shares concern about some of her remarks while respecting UN procedures.
Complaints about the conduct of UN Special Rapporteurs are always handled confidentially.
Klachten over het handelen van VN Speciaal Rapporteurs worden altijd vertrouwelijk behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het stopzetten van grootschalige voedselhulp in Ethiopië

Two SGP MPs asked the government about the WFP halting food aid to 650,000 malnourished women and children in Ethiopia due to funding shortfalls, its consequences, risks to peace in Tigray, the funding gap, and Dutch and EU options to help. Minister Klever answered that 3.6 million people risk losing aid, that Dutch contributions (EUR 60 million to WFP, EUR 9 million to the Ethiopia humanitarian fund) cannot offset large US aid cuts, and that the government is raising the issue within the EU and other donor fora.
The Netherlands has managed to keep the humanitarian aid budget at its level, but it is impossible for the Netherlands to compensate for large global reductions in life-saving aid.
Nederland heeft het budget voor humanitaire hulp op peil weten te houden, maar het is voor Nederland onmogelijk om forse wereldwijde reducties in levensreddende hulp te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Boswijk en Kahraman over het bericht 'Nigeria: christenen in deelstaat Plateau keer op keer slachtoffer militante Fulani’s.'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in Nigeria's Plateau state by Fulani militants, including the government's response, the role of religion, EU and UN action, and the ECOWAS ruling against Kano blasphemy provisions. The minister answered that the violence stems from local land and resource conflicts, that the government is cautious about framing it by religion, and that it raises the issue bilaterally, in EU and UN settings, and through existing programmes, while committing only to a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador and noting the EU Special Envoy appointment is ongoing.
The cabinet does not know who instigated the violence or what exactly motivated them.
Het is bij het kabinet onbekend wie de aanstichters waren van het geweld en wat hen exact motiveerde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’’

MPs Stoffer and Martens-America asked the government about disruptions of pro-Israel lectures at Radboud University and Maastricht University, the role of a masked lecturer, risk assessments, and whether institutions take action against staff and students. The minister condemns illegal disruption, describes the universities' risk measures and says institutions should report suspected crimes, while refusing to share confidential information on staff measures and noting that such measures against students are not centrally recorded.
However, I have asked these institutions about this.
Antwoord 4 Ik heb dit nagevraagd bij deze instellingen.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over de toenemende invloed van Iraans gesteunde milities en de positie van minderheden op de Vlakte van Nineve, Irak

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Iran-backed militias displacing Christian mayors on the Nineveh Plain in Iraq, sanctions on Rayan al-Kildani, and minority protection. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels when warranted, and declined to speculate on future sanctions targets.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate further on possible future sanctions targets.
Het kabinet wil verder niet speculeren over eventuele toekomstige doelwitten van sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over calamiteitenroutes in Zeeland

An SGP MP asked the minister about the closures of the Vlaketunnel (A58) in Zeeland, the lack of two-way emergency routes through the tunnel tube, traffic management, and emergency routes in the MIRT. The minister answered that closures were recorded per year, that two-way traffic in a tunnel tube is not permitted under Dutch tunnel law, that cooperation with the province exists, and that no new connections to the N289 are planned.
Yes, it is important that there are adequate emergency routes and that people can leave Zeeland in case of emergencies.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat er adequate calamiteitenroutes zijn en dat mensen in geval van calamiteiten Zeeland kunnen verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Telegraaf ‘Recyclingsector in actie tegen extra plasticheffing: ’Kabinet zoekt geld, afvalsector wordt gepakt’’

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked the government whether a planned plastic levy would fall on the waste and recycling sector, why recycling is struggling, and what the cost burden is. The State Secretary answered that the levy's design is still under review in spring budget decisions, that recyclers face high energy prices and EU rules, and gave tax-rate tables and Belgian and German comparisons, without committing to a final design.
The design of this is part of the spring budget decision-making. One cannot anticipate this.
De vormgeving hiervan is onderdeel van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming. Hier kan niet op worden vooruitgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Basisscholen die weigerden om doorstroomtoets af te nemen krijgen ultimatum'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about primary schools that refused to administer the mandatory end-of-primary transition test and about the risks and parental information involved. The State Secretary answered that the test is legally required and serves students' interests, that schools must be held to the law, and that a new test scenario will be outlined in an April letter to parliament.
If schools do not administer the transition test, I am therefore obliged, in the interest of pupils, to enforce the law.
In het geval dat scholen geen doorstroomtoets afnemen ben ik dan ook genoodzaakt om, in het belang van de leerlingen, de wet te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de mogelijke herbenoeming van de VN Speciaal Gezant mevrouw Albanese

Two MPs from SGP and PVV-aligned Stoffer ask the foreign minister about the possible reappointment of UN Special Rapporteur Albanese, her social media statements, and Dutch involvement in appointments. The minister answers that such rapporteurs act in personal capacity, that Dutch objections were raised with her, that the cabinet does not support her reappointment, and that the decision rests with the UN Human Rights Council.
The cabinet does not support her possible reappointment.
Het kabinet steunt haar eventuele herbenoeming niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
