Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Zanten en Stoffer over het bericht van De Nieuwe Ster ’Hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op UWC’

MPs Van Zanten and Stoffer asked about reports of swastikas, antisemitic remarks by a guest speaker, and a student email at UWC Maastricht, and whether the school and the Inspectorate are protecting pupils. The State Secretary answered that the school has registered incidents, tightened its guest-speaker and email protocols and safety policy, and that the Inspectorate sees no reason for further steps while staying alert, offering support via a school-safety foundation.
The inspectorate is of the view that the board and the school are taking the situation very seriously.
De inspectie is van oordeel dat het bestuur en de school de situatie zeer serieus oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal, Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Nederland geeft roofkunst terug aan Nigeria: Herstel van historisch onrecht'

Three MPs (Van der Wal, Stoffer, Eerdmans) asked why the Dutch government returned 113 looted Benin objects to Nigeria without conditions, when their destination is unknown and Nigeria ranks poorly on corruption, and whether restitution was coordinated with parliament. The minister replied that unconditional return is the policy for looted objects, that the receiving government decides where objects go, that no conservation guarantees were required, and that parliament is informed of policy changes but not of individual restitution decisions.
I do not intend to inform the House of intended restitutions when handling specific cases.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de Kamer te informeren over voornemens tot restitutie bij de behandeling van specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Israëlische gijzelaars in VN-gebouwen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether hostages released from Gaza were held in UN shelters, including UNRWA facilities, and what oversight and information-sharing exists. The government answered that it cannot confirm control of the buildings, that it contacted Israel and UNRWA, that UNRWA cannot verify the claims, and that it supports a full investigation while stating that UN organisations have no intelligence or policing capacity to monitor sites.
The cabinet fully supports the call to leave no stone unturned.
Het kabinet steunt de oproep volmondig om de onderste steen boven te krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Westerveld over de berichten 'Wie betaalt voor zorg op school? In Limburg krijgen ouders van kwetsbare kinderen de rekening' en 'Vage facturen en creatief boekhouden op M

MPs Stoffer and Westerveld asked the state secretary about reports that Limburg schools for disabled children pressure parents to transfer part of their personal care budgets (pgb) to the school, and whether this is lawful and transparent. The state secretary answered that such arrangements are permissible in agreement with parents, that the Inspectorate has not investigated the use of care funds and has no legal task to do so, and that a new care-in-school policy aims to improve transparency.
The Inspectorate of Education has not conducted any investigation into the use of care funds.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft naar de besteding van zorgmiddelen geen onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Plas over de actualisatie van de Beleidslijn grote rivieren

Two MPs from SGP and BBB asked the ministers how the update of the Beleidslijn Grote Rivieren would affect farms in flood-overflow areas such as the Kampereilanden, including investment room, stable renewal and manure use. Minister Madlener replies that grounded agricultural firms keep development options under exceptions, that the update is not seen as a significant obstacle to Kampen, that the government will study boundaries for specific areas and that compensation is available under the Omgevingswet.
For agricultural businesses located in the former flow-carrying regime, almost nothing changes.
Voor agrarische bedrijven, die in de voormalige stroomvoerende regime liggen, verandert er nagenoeg niets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kahraman en Boswijk  over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2025 van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, Nieuw Sociaal Contract and CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2025 persecution ranking, covering Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, Pakistan, Syria, Algeria and related issues. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and commits to continued engagement, but declined to support an international UN inquiry into violence in Nigeria as unlikely to win broad support.
The cabinet currently considers it unlikely that there will be broad support for establishing a UN-mandated international commission of inquiry into religious violence in Nigeria.
Het kabinet acht het op dit moment onwaarschijnlijk dat er brede steun zal zijn voor het oprichten van een VN-gemandateerde internationale onderzoekscommissie voor religieus geweld in Nigeria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over ‘Waarom wordt studenten aan de Erasmus Universiteit verteld dat porno een vorm van kunst is?’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a publicly funded university's Studium Generale event presenting porn-related research was appropriate for student welfare, given negative effects of sexualised media. The minister answered that the event discussed research on pornographic stereotypes, that universities decide their own welfare and event policy under academic freedom, and that the event was lawfully funded.
The aim of this event was therefore not to promote pornography, but to encourage a discussion on this theme based on research results.
Het doel van dit evenement was daarom niet het promoten van pornografie, maar het bevorderen van een discussie over dit thema aan de hand van onderzoeksresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Feministisch Buitenlandbeleid

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the feminist foreign policy handbook, mandatory training, gender focal points, staffing and budget cuts, diversity quotas, the definition of feminism, and SRGR and gender spending targets. The minister answers that the handbook and training are voluntary or aspirational, no extra staff are being hired, staffing cuts will take effect from 2026, and quotas follow government-wide rules.
No, consulting the handbook is done on a voluntary basis.
Nee het raadplegen van de handreiking gebeurt op vrijwillige basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van Zanten en Hertzberger over het bericht ‘Niet-rendabele talenstudies verdwijnen, want studenten doen liever een brede bachelor’

MPs Stoffer, Van Zanten and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that small language programmes such as French and German are being closed at Leiden and Utrecht, and what the government will do to keep a national offering. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to the sector plan Talen & Culturen, says institutions decide on closures under an existing advisory procedure, and commits to talks with the sector and a DLG action plan, while declining to set minimum norms or a numerus fixus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

Two SGP MPs asked whether a pro-Palestine demonstration in Leiden, where persons acting as self-appointed security (Protest Alliance Watch) allegedly enforced their own rules on station travellers, violated the ban on private armed-style organisations and whether NS station staff were adequately trained. The minister answered that the right to demonstrate applies within the law, that local authorities and police, not the minister, judge such conduct, that police did not observe forced removals, that NS conductors (boa's) have limited powers and no specific training is needed, and that a joint escalation framework is being drafted in response to a motion.
The judgment on whether specific concrete conduct constitutes a criminal offence is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court.
Het oordeel of bepaald concreet handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Krul en Stoffer over het onderzoek ‘De herstelopdracht doorgelicht: Een verkenning naar de rechtmatigheid van herstelopdrachten in het funderend onderwijs’

MPs Ceder, Krul and Stoffer asked the Minister of Education about Professor Van Schoonhoven's study questioning whether Inspectorate remediation orders (herstelopdrachten) rest on legal grounds, and how the Inspectorate avoids overreach, distinguishes its supervisory from its stimulating role, justifies orders, and informs school boards of their rights. The Minister replies that the Inspectorate found its orders lawful, tied to statutory adequacy standards, will refine justification and frameworks, and will not withdraw any orders, while describing existing safeguards such as complaint procedures and board responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het snelgroeiende geweld tegen christenen in India

SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the rising violence against Christians in India, its causes, the role of anti-conversion laws, disinformation, caste, and EU action. The minister condemned violence against religious minorities, said Nederland raises freedom of religion in bilateral, EU and UN dialogues including the upcoming EU-India human rights dialogue, but said causes are not clear-cut and gave general answers on several questions.
The Netherlands will continue to do so, including by pushing for this topic to be raised at the next EU-India Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland zal dit blijven doen, onder meer door in te zetten op agendering van dit onderwerp in de eerstvolgende EU-India Mensenrechtendialoog
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de studie naar de ervaringen van Joodse en Israëlische studenten en medewerkers tijdens de protesten na 7 oktober

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a study finding that Jewish and Israeli students and staff faced intimidation and hostility during post-7 October protests, and whether institutions can guarantee their safety and detect such incidents. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, notes there is no reporting obligation for institutions on student safety, points to ongoing monitoring, a complaints-system study, a planned registration duty in a forthcoming safety bill, and an antisemitism taskforce.
There is no reporting obligation for institutions to provide my ministry with information about student safety.
Er is geen rapportageverplichting voor instellingen om informatie aan mijn ministerie te leveren over de veiligheid van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer en Krul over het schrappen van de subsidie op het godsdienstig onderwijs of levensbeschouwelijk vormingsonderwijs

MPs Ceder, Stoffer and Krul asked why the government plans to end the subsidy for religious and life-stance formation education and whether this conflicts with the statutory basis and with pupils' access to such education. The State Secretary answered that about 50,000 pupils receive it, that the subsidy ends from 2027 via a legislative proposal, and that schools' civic and worldview curriculum will cover the needs, but did not expect equal access and gave only partial answers on consultation with parents.
For the termination of the subsidy, a proposal for a legislative amendment will be made.
Voor de beëindiging van de subsidie wordt een voorstel tot wetswijziging gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’

Two MPs from the SGP asked whether the government will act against the planned lecture by Samidoun figure Mohammed Khatib at Radboud University, including through a national terror listing, a travel ban, or a ban on Samidoun. The ministers answered that entry has been refused and the university cancelled the lecture, that they will not intervene in academic debate, that Khatib has been flagged in E&S but the Twbmt cannot bar him from the country, and that they will talk with Germany and the Public Prosecution Service about Samidoun and support an EU listing.
With regard to the organisation Samidoun, other countries have established links with terrorist organisations.
Ten aanzien van de organisatie Samidoun geldt dat andere landen banden met terroristische organisaties hebben vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het onderzoek van de Kinderombudsman naar de gevolgen van scheidingen voor kinderen

An MP asked the government about the Children's Ombudsman's study on the effects of divorce on children, including whether policy should focus more on preventing relationship problems and on family group plans. The government answered that it shares concern, points to ongoing pilots, a new online platform and a forthcoming advice on child-friendly divorce procedures, but sees no need to repeat earlier research or launch a new programme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Francesca Albanese

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese's remarks on 7 October, Netanyahu (including a Hitler comparison), and the 'Jewish lobby', and whether she can still be impartial. The minister answered that such remarks are unacceptable, that special rapporteurs act in a personal capacity, and that the Netherlands raised the matter with her in May and will do so again where needed.
Where necessary, the Netherlands will raise its concerns about the impact of certain statements again.
Waar nodig zal Nederland zorgen over de impact van bepaalde uitlatingen opnieuw opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Gabriëls over de inzet van innovatieve waterzuiveringstechnieken

MPs Stoffer and Gabriëls asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about innovative water treatment techniques for PFAS, medicine residues and other pollutants, including who should pay and whether reuse can be encouraged. The minister answered that existing measures, a fourth treatment stage and an extended producer responsibility are underway, while the choice of technique and cost recovery largely rest with water managers, and that the effects of future substances cannot be fully anticipated.
It is up to the drinking water companies to assess which treatments of the abstracted water are needed to produce drinking water from it.
Het is aan de drinkwaterbedrijven om te beoordelen welke behandelingen van het ingenomen water nodig zijn om hier drinkwater van te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het staatsbezoek van de Emir van Qatar

An SGP MP asked the government about the state visit of the Emir of Qatar, including the royal lunch, whether the Emir would be pressed to free Israeli hostages, and the presence of Hamas leaders in Doha. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the visit followed standard protocol, that the hostage release was stressed in talks, and that Qatar's mediation role requires its ties with Hamas.
During the conversation with the Emir, the importance of releasing the hostages was strongly emphasised.
Tijdens het gesprek met de Emir is het belang van de vrijlating van de gegijzelden sterk benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over samenwerking met de Palestijnse autoriteit

Stoffer (SGP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Dutch security cooperation with the Palestinian Authority, including the Martyrs Fund, the risk of aid reaching terrorist groups, and the role of Hamas and Fatah in Gaza. The government declined to share the MOU text, said no specific budget is attached, stated Dutch budget support via PEGASE was stopped, and outlined risk-mitigation measures such as vetting under USSC and per-activity risk assessment.
International (policy) agreements are not made public, given international and diplomatic interests.
Internationale (beleids)afspraken worden, met het oog op de internationale en diplomatieke belangen, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de vervolging en benarde positie van christenen in Pakistan

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about violence against Christians in Pakistan after blasphemy-linked mob attacks in Sargodha, and about police protection, compensation, support for civil society and contacts with religious leaders and courts. The minister answered that the government is concerned, has raised the issue with Pakistani authorities, describes the trends in blasphemy prosecutions, and outlines Dutch and EU engagement, including monitoring some trials and possible travel by the EU envoy.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about these acts of violence in Sargodha, Pakistan, arising from blasphemy accusations.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over deze gewelddadigheden in Sargodha, Pakistan, als gevolg van beschuldigingen van blasfemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de berichtgeving van de NOS inzake Israël en Gaza

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary whether she knew of a Likud Nederland blackbook alleging one-sided NOS coverage of Israel and Gaza, whether she would act on it, and whether she would encourage the NPO to learn from the BBC. The State Secretary confirmed awareness but declined to review NOS coverage, said NOS is independent and accountable via the NPO ombudsman, and left cooperation with other broadcasters to the NOS.
It is not appropriate for me to assess the NOS's working methods or to direct the NOS.
Het past mij niet om de werkwijze van de NOS te beoordelen of om de NOS aan te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘ME grijpt in bij bezetting gebouw Universiteit Leiden in Den Haag‘

MP Stoffer asks the education minister whether it is acceptable that Leiden University engaged with Students for Palestine and masked activists during an occupation, and whether institutions should adjust policy under pressure from protesters. The minister answers that universities follow a shared protest guideline, that contact with masked protesters was a de-escalation choice not negotiation, that demands to cut Israeli ties conflict with academic freedom, and that protest legality is for mayors and courts to judge.
I will not hold the executive board to account for the decision to seek contact with the protesters who were wearing face coverings.
Ik zal het college van bestuur niet aanspreken op het besluit contact te zoeken met de protestvoerders met gezichtsbedekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Belastingstelsel kost eenverdienersgezin straks ook deel AOW'

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the abolition of transferability of the general tax credit leaves old-age pensioner couples worse off by about 1,000 euro a year, and whether this was foreseen and should be reversed. The State Secretary denies the claim for typical pensioner couples, acknowledges losses in specific cases such as negative business income or non-transferable credits for lower-earning partners, and declines to revise the decision.
The claim that AOW recipients lose around 1,000 euro per year is factually incorrect.
De stelling dat AOW'ers zo'n € 1.000 per jaar mislopen is feitelijk onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanpak van recidive bij verkeersovertredingen

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers how serious recidivism in traffic offences under the administrative enforcement law could be tackled sooner and more strictly, including higher fines, driving bans and criminal-law routes. The minister acknowledged the link between repeat offences and accidents, said the WODC evaluation is ongoing with results expected in 2025, and stated that higher fines or driving bans for recidivists are currently not legally possible under that law.
Depending on the outcomes of this evaluation, follow-up steps must be determined regarding the implementation of the Administrative Enforcement of Traffic Rules Act.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie moeten vervolgstappen worden bepaald ten aanzien van (de uitvoering) van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften.
Antwoord op de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Koptische Christenen in Egypte

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Coptic Christians in Egypt, including Al Minya, and what the Dutch government and EU are doing about religious freedom and impunity. The minister answered that the government shares concern, the embassy is monitoring, Egyptian authorities have responded, and religious freedom is a diplomatic priority raised at various levels, with the Special Envoy for Religion and Belief engaging the Egyptian ambassador.
I do not have independent information about the alleged perpetrators and therefore cannot judge them.
Ik beschik niet over eigenstandige informatie over de vermeende daders, en kan daar dan ook geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de toepassing van de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) in de agrarische sector

Two MPs from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about how the business succession scheme (BOR) applies to crop-lease arrangements in agriculture, including whether the Grondkamer's rules on necessary crop rotation and the exclusion of grass and maize are fair to landowners. The Minister confirmed the rules, explained the rationale for excluding grass and maize, and declined to extend BOR treatment to one-sided crop leases before a planned revision of the Pachtwet.
When the crop lease regime was created, the legislature determined that it was not intended for maize and grass.
Bij de totstandkoming van de teeltpacht is door de wetgever bepaald dat het regime niet bedoeld is voor mais en gras

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Olger van Dijk, Tuinman, De Roon en Stoffer over meldingen in het veiligheidssysteem ECCAIRS over het luchtruim boven Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014, de datum waarop vlucht MH17/KL410

MPs asked the minister for details of three Eccairs safety reports on Ukrainian airspace filed in 2014 before MH17 was shot down, and for the reports to be shared with parliament. The minister declined, citing a pending Council of State case and EU Regulation 376/2014 confidentiality rules, and promised to inform parliament after the ruling expected in Q3 2024.
Because this procedure is still ongoing, no further information can be provided.
Omdat deze procedure nog loopt, kan verder geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga en Stoffer over toegenomen Nederlandse importen uit de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MPs Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga and Stoffer asked whether Dutch imports from Xinjiang rose, whether Oeigoeren forced labour is increasing, and how businesses, consumers and the EU forced-labour regulation and CSDDD address this. The minister could not verify the trade figures, said the government cannot confirm the Zenz findings, expects companies to apply OECD and UN guidance, and said enforcement of the forced-labour regulation will apply from around autumn 2027.
However, the government has no independent information position on the situation on the ground and therefore cannot confirm the specific conclusions of this research.
Het kabinet heeft echter geen eigenstandige informatiepositie over de situatie ter plaatse en kan de specifieke conclusies van dit onderzoek dus niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk en Dijk over de interactieve tablettour van het Nationaal Holocaustmuseum voor groepen leerlingen uit het voortgezet onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the government recognises the value of school visits to the Holocaust Museum, whether it will push all secondary pupils to visit, and whether free museum admission for all Dutch citizens will be explored. The government agrees Holocaust education matters, says schools must take the initiative, points to existing school funding and a forthcoming national Holocaust education plan, and leaves museum pricing to the museum itself.
However, it is up to schools themselves to take the initiative here and to look at which activity fits the school and target group.
Het is echter aan scholen zelf om hier initiatief toe te nemen en te kijken welke activiteit past bij de school en doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Geen straf voor mannen die zich vastlijmden bij 'Meisje met de parel'

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Culture and the Minister of Justice about a court ruling that imposed no penalty on men who glued themselves to the Girl with a Pearl Earring, and about museum costs, protection and whether a special offence is needed. The government condemned the vandalism, noted the court found it criminal, said the museum bore no lost revenue, and declined to review protection or create a new offence.
Museums, however, do not make public the security measures they take for security reasons.
Musea maken de veiligheidsmaatregelen die zij treffen om veiligheidsredenen echter niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de verhouding tussen artikel 6 van de Kaderrichtlijn afvalstoffen en de EVOA-verordening

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether materials that lose waste status under Article 6 of the Waste Framework Directive still fall under the EU Waste Shipment Regulation, and whether export distinctions or explicit receiving-country consent are required. The State Secretary answered that end-of-waste materials fall outside waste law, that in disputes the strictest classification (treated as waste) applies under EVOA Article 28, and that no export distinction or consent requirement follows from Article 6 itself.
In case of disagreement between competent authorities on international waste shipments, Article 28 of the EU Waste Shipment Regulation (EVOA) requires that the strictest classification be followed.

Bij een verschil van inzicht tussen bevoegde gezagen voor internationale afvaltransporten schrijft artikel 28 van Europese Verordening Overbrenging Afvalstoffen (EVOA) voor dat de strengste indeling moet worden gevolgd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Stoffer over Turkse drone-aanslagen op christelijke leden van Noord-Syrische milities en berichten over Turkse betrokkenheid bij misdrijven in door Turkije bezette gebieden

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish drone strikes on Christian members of Northeast Syrian security forces and reports of abuses in Turkish-occupied areas, including whether the government would raise this with Turkey, NATO or the EU. The minister confirmed the strike, said Turkey invokes self-defence, and said the government raises proportionality and civilian protection bilaterally but sees no reason to raise it in NATO, while saying it cannot establish displacement figures or refugee flows.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise these operations within NATO either.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze operaties ook in NAVO-verband aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Noodkreet rijksambtenaren aan kabinet: laat Israël stoppen met geweld'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a letter from civil servants urging the cabinet to press Israel to stop violence fits the civil service rules on expressing opinions. The government answered that officials may hold and voice views within the limits of Article 10 of the Civil Servants Act, that internal, non-public expression of concern does not in itself threaten good performance, and that the ministry has created internal channels for dissenting views.
Voicing concerns internally, or in targeted (non-public) communication, does not in itself give reason to assume that the proper performance of a function would not reasonably be assured.

Het intern uiten van zorgen, of het uiten van zorgen in gerichte (niet openbare) communicatie, vormt op zichzelf geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat een goede vervulling van een functie in redelijkheid niet zou zijn verzekerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder en Tuinman over het artikel 'Rijksambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken demonstreren tegen Nederlands Israëlbeleid'

MPs Stoffer, Ceder and Tuinman asked whether civil servants of the Foreign Ministry demonstrating for a ceasefire during lunch breaks, and their associated petition, conflict with government policy and the Civil Servants Act 2017. The minister answered that the demonstrations fall in the lunch break, that the call for a permanent ceasefire is not government policy, that civil servants have freedom of expression subject to Article 10 of the Act (assessed case by case by the employer), and that the ministry has held internal discussions and reminded staff of guidance.
Civil servants, like all other citizens, enjoy freedom of expression.
Ambtenaren kennen net als alle andere burgers de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over uitingen van UNRWA medewerkers rond 7 oktober en de oorlog in Israël en Gaza

Questions from MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked about social media statements by UNRWA staff praising the 7 October attacks, whether the government condemns them, and whether Dutch funding should be suspended as in 2019. The minister condemned such statements, said Dutch additional funding is suspended pending two UN investigations, and explained UNRWA's unique mandate for Palestinian refugees.
Any additional Dutch funding to UNRWA is suspended until further notice.
Eventuele Nederlandse aanvullende financiering aan UNRWA is tot nader orde opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Boswijk, Kahraman en Ceder over het Open Doors rapport 2024 en het rapport 'Freedom of Thought' van het humanistisch verbond

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2024 and Humanist Association 'Freedom of Thought' reports on religious persecution, including Christian persecution in Nigeria, the Sahel, China and Iraq, and whether policy or diplomacy should be tightened. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, cites existing diplomatic, multilateral and development programmes, and largely points to existing policy without committing to new measures.

The cabinet recognises trends mentioned in the Open Doors report, including an increase in religiously motivated violence in the Sahel and repression of people because of their religion or belief in countries such as Nicaragua, China and India.

Het kabinet herkent trends zoals genoemd in het Open Doors rapport, waaronder toename van religieus gemotiveerd geweld in de Sahelregio en onderdrukking van mensen vanwege hun religie of levensovertuiging in onder andere Nicaragua, China en India.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Christenen in Nigeria rond kerst

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to interpret the deadly late-December 2023 attacks on Christian villages in Nigeria's Plateau state, what Nigerian authorities and the Netherlands are doing about religious violence and foreign financing, and what the Dutch and EU freedom-of-religion envoys are doing. The minister answered that the violence is a broader resource conflict not aimed solely at one group, that Nigerian security capacity is insufficient, that the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally and in UN review, and that its envoys raise Nigeria in FoRB fora.
Nigerian citizens of Christian or Muslim faith have for years been victims of interreligious and intra-religious violence.
Nigeriaanse burgers met een Christelijke of Moslim geloofsovertuiging zijn al jaren slachtoffers van interreligieus en intra-religieus geweld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het achterwege blijven van afspraken met de industrie over reductie van de stikstofuitstoot

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why little has been agreed with industrial peak polluters on nitrogen emission reductions despite reported possibilities, and why talks have not yet produced concrete results. The minister replied that talks have been held with all 19 peak polluters, that existing regulation already drives emission declines, and that concrete reductions take time and cost checks, while committing to continue the approach and report progress to parliament.
I will keep your House informed of progress through the regular customised-agreement letters.
Ik zal uw Kamer via de reguliere maatwerkbrieven van de voortgang op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Paarse Vrijdag? ‘Ongewenste gekkigheid uit de Randstad’

MP Stoffer asked the minister whether parental and student concerns about Paarse Vrijdag are growing, whether schools have apologised for overreach, and whether students may opt out. The minister replied that schools decide how to implement it, that schools have a duty to protect safety and teach diversity, that students are not exempted from diversity lessons, and that no signals of school apologies have reached him.
I currently see no reason to enter into discussion with the sector councils about this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hierover in gesprek te gaan met de sectorraden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Vedder en Grinwis over het sluiten van de nautische verkeerspost Ouddorp en het niet langer inzetten van vuurtorenwachters op vuurtoren Westhoofd

Three MPs (SGP, CDA, ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the nautical traffic post at Ouddorp and the Westhoofd lighthouse watch were closed, raising safety concerns for the Slijkgat channel. The Minister answered that the area is not a VTS zone, that replacing the radar and systems was too costly, that information remains available through other public channels, and that the Slijkgat depth commitments continue, but gave no commitment to restore the post.
Discussions are ongoing with parties about users' information needs and how these can be better served.
Er wordt verder overlegd met partijen over de informatiebehoefte van de gebruikers en hoe daar nog beter in kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Stoffer over de afwezigheid van de NOS bij vertoning beelden van de aanval op 7 oktober 2023 op de Israëlische ambassade

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Stoffer asked why the NOS did not attend an Israeli embassy screening of footage of the 7 October 2023 attack and whether the NOS should play a key role in neutral news coverage. The Staatssecretaris replied that the NOS is editorially independent, that he does not know the reason for its absence, and that it is not his place to assess or steer the NOS's working methods, so he will not discuss the matter with the NOS.
It is not appropriate for me to assess the NOS's working methods or to direct the NOS.
Het past mij niet om de werkwijze van de NOS te beoordelen of om de NOS aan te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de situatie van Nederlanders en van gegijzelde Israëliërs in de Gazastrook

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Dutch nationals and Israeli hostages in Gaza, including evacuation, Egypt's border, PA funding and regional responsibility. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, has evacuated groups of Dutch nationals via Rafah, presses for humanitarian pauses and access, and that EU budget support to the PA is to resume once the review is complete.
In the interest of the matter, the cabinet cannot make further statements about the Dutch commitment.
In het belang van de zaak kan het kabinet verder geen uitspraken doen over de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de knelpunten voor het koppelen van bovenleidingen aan laadpunten voor elektrisch vervoer

MP Stoffer asked about obstacles RET faces in obtaining a closed distribution system (GDS) exemption to connect its overhead rail lines to EV charging points, and whether the new Energy Act would help. Minister Jetten answered that the exemption is possible under current conditions with ACM assessing RET's application, that the draft Energy Act keeps a GDS framework with a broader number of connected parties, and that EU rules leave no special room for public transport networks.
The framework for a GDS is laid down in European law, and there is no special scope for public transport networks to deviate from it.
De kaders voor een GDS zijn Europeesrechtelijk vastgelegd en er is hierbij geen bijzondere ruimte voor OV-netten om hier van af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de brandbrief van de provincie Overijssel inzake de onverwachtse bijstelling van de SDE++ basistarieven voor monomestvergisting

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the Overijssel province letter protesting the unexpected downward adjustment of SDE++ base rates for mono-manure digestion, and whether the rules would be changed. The minister confirmed a calculation error was corrected under PBL advice, said the adjustment was unavoidable under EU state-aid rules and will not reverse it for the open 2023 round, and promised to seek PBL advice for 2024 and decide early 2024.
I was compelled to adjust the base amounts in the SDE++ scheme at a late stage.
Ik was genoodzaakt om in een laat stadium de basisbedragen in de SDE++-regeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op van het lid Stoffer over het opschorten van de export van pvc-recyclaat

MP Stoffer asks the State Secretary why PVC recyclate export, long allowed, is now suspended and how clarity on waste-versus-product criteria will be ensured. The State Secretary answers that waste status is assessed case by case under EU rules, that the inspectorate tightened scrutiny after 2021 changes to the waste shipment regulation, and points to guidance tools and a planned knowledge platform.
The ILT, among other things following this amendment, has sharpened its attention to the export of PVC for environmentally sound recycling.
De ILT heeft onder andere naar aanleiding van deze wijziging de aandacht voor de export van pvc voor milieuverantwoorde recycling verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de vernieling van kerken in Pakistan

Members Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the government about the destruction of over twenty churches in Jaranwala, Pakistan, the failure of local police to protect Christians, and possible Dutch and EU action. The minister acknowledged serious concern, noted that Pakistan has arrested over 130 people and set up an inquiry, and described existing Dutch and EU support including humanitarian aid and human rights engagement, without committing to new diplomatic steps.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no need to also request clarification from the Pakistani authorities, but will closely follow the outcomes and follow-up of the investigation.
Het kabinet ziet daarom vooralsnog geen noodzaak om ook opheldering te vragen aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten maar zal de uitkomsten en de opvolging van het onderzoek nauw volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in de circulaire economie

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the role of waste-to-energy plants in a circular economy, citing an ESB analysis that more recycling requires continued incineration capacity. The State Secretary answered that the analysis rests on unrealistic import assumptions, ignores other circularity strategies and does not distinguish material types, and that the government prefers higher-quality recycling over new incineration capacity.
The cabinet prefers focusing on more and higher-quality recycling over building additional incineration capacity.
Het kabinet geeft de voorkeur aan een inzet op meer en hoogwaardigere recycling boven het bijbouwen van verbrandingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Drost over het bericht ‘Nieuwe functie Snapchat wil met kinderen afspreken: Zie ik je vanavond? Ik ben een echt persoon!’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about Snapchat's My AI chatbot, which presented itself as a real person, suggested meeting children, and retained messages for product improvement and advertising. The government answered that Snap has since changed the feature to identify itself as a chatbot, that privacy compliance is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to assess, and that it will rely on the forthcoming AI Regulation and the Code Kinderrechten Online.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over de financiering van de Stichting Schooldakrevolutie

SGP MPs asked whether central government funding for the Stichting Schooldakrevolutie (a foundation supporting schools with solar panels) is being stopped and why. The minister denies that funding stops, explains the subsidy is being phased out with a final one-off payment in 2024 and that the foundation must operate independently from 2025, while pointing to the Maatschappelijk Vastgoed programme and agreeing to the value of continued work.
A one-off subsidy will still be granted for the year 2024.
Er wordt nog eenmalig subsidie toegekend voor het jaar 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij 'De komst van Marokkaanse staatsimams naar Nederland'

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked whether the Moroccan state-funded Fondation Hassan II sends state imams to the Netherlands, what messages they spread, whether the government was informed in advance, and whether entry could be refused. The government answered that the imams provide religious support to the Moroccan diaspora during Ramadan within permitted diaspora policy and freedom of religion, that visas are assessed individually, that there is no current reason to refuse them, and that it will report on the revamped Taskforce later.
There is currently no reason to take action or to refuse the visa applications of the imams.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om op te treden of de visumaanvraag van de imams te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Cowboy op dak levensgevaarlijk'; Populariteit zonnepanelen heeft keerzijde’

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of fatal and serious accidents among solar panel installers and about labour inspection of this sector. The minister acknowledged the violations found in a recent inspection of 200 construction sites, stressed that employers bear primary responsibility, and described inspection and sector measures without committing to new concrete steps.
Employers are primarily responsible for improving the safety of employees.
De werkgevers zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren van de veiligheid van de werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over eenverdieners en middeninkomens

An MP asks the Social Affairs and Finance ministers about single-earner households with middle incomes ending up with less net income than benefit recipients, and about the tax burden and purchasing-power support for them. The government acknowledges the problem, points to ongoing reviews of tax reliefs and the childcare and benefit reforms, and says it will return with a fuller letter on the single-earner benefit-interaction issue and results of its evaluations.
It is not good that in the seven years this problem has been known, no solution has been reached.
Het is niet goed dat er in de zeven jaar dat deze problematiek bekend is, niet tot een oplossing is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Maatoug over 'de ondergrensindicatie bij Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw-)werknemers'

MPs Stoffer and Maatoug ask about rising WIA applications among Wsw workers, the criteria and frequency of 'ondergrens' (lower limit) indications, and why such workers lose the transition payment and often cannot access an incapacity benefit. The minister answers with figures, explains the criteria and the difference between a lower-limit indication and incapacity, says ambtelijke verkenning of changes is ongoing, and states she is not in favour of abolishing periodic re-indications but will review them with UWV.
However, I want to further explore whether the right routes are available in all cases for people to get the support that fits their situation.
Ik wil echter nader verkennen of in alle gevallen de juiste routes beschikbaar zijn voor mensen om de ondersteuning te krijgen die bij hun situatie past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over abortus als “mensenrecht”

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign and Development Ministers whether abortion is being treated as a human right, whether the right to life of unborn children is protected, and how partner organisations delivering abortion services are monitored for coercion. The ministers answered that international law does not settle whether human rights apply to the unborn, that Dutch policy supports safe abortion as part of SRGR, and that partners monitor care quality against WHO guidelines.
Your questions have been answered with all due care, attention and transparency.
Uw vragen zijn met alle zorgvuldigheid, aandacht en transparantie beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de financiële situatie van gezinnen

An MP asked the ministers about child poverty and family financial support, citing Dutch rankings on family benefits and the rise in cost of living. The ministers answered that child poverty fell from 10.2% in 2013 to 6.8% in 2022, that the child benefit was substantially raised, that the government is committed to halving child poverty, and that a Commission on the social minimum and a study of family policy abroad are underway.
The cabinet remains firmly committed to achieving the target of halving child poverty.
Het kabinet blijft onverminderd gemotiveerd om de doelstelling om kinderarmoede te halveren te behalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Bikker over het bericht dat het gebruik van zelfdodingspoeder Middel X flink steeg nadat Coöperatie Laatste Wil bekend maakte welke stof het bevat

MPs from SGP, JA21 and ChristenUnie asked whether the rise in use of suicide powder Middel X after the Coöperatie Laatste Wil disclosed its substance was causal, whether reporting duties for doctors or a ban on the cooperative were warranted, and about the status of investigations. The minister answered that a causal link cannot be established from NVIC data, that a reporting duty would conflict with medical confidentiality and is not currently appropriate, that prosecution of ten people is being prepared with the investigating judge, and that a dissolution request is for the Public Prosecution Service to judge.
The Public Prosecution Service has previously publicly announced that it intends to prosecute ten persons involved or formerly involved with the Coöperatie Laatste Wil.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft eerder publiekelijk kenbaar gemaakt dat het voornemens is om tien personen te vervolgen die betrokken zijn of waren bij de Coöperatie Laatste Wil.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Woede van Afrikaanse leiders tegen Europa vanwege ‘koloniaal gedrag’

An MP asked whether the EU and Netherlands attach conditions on abortion and LGBTI rights to trade and partnership agreements with African and other third countries, and whether this amounts to neocolonial behaviour. The minister answered that no such preconditions are known, that the commitments referenced are in the Post-Cotonou agreement and framed as dialogue on equal terms, and that universal human rights are not Western values.

As far as is known, there are no requests, demands or conditions to amend legislation on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) and LGBTIQ+ issues as a precondition for concluding (trade) agreements.

Voor zover bekend zijn er geen verzoeken, eisen en/of voorwaarden voor het aanpassen van wet- en regelgeving op het terrein van Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten (SRGR) en LHBTIQ+ als preconditie voor het afsluiten van (handels-)verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de wettelijke belemmeringen voor het koppelen van bovenleidingen aan laadpunten voor elektrisch vervoer

An SGP MP asked whether tram, train and trolleybus overhead lines could be used to supply charging points and relieve the grid, and whether energy law blocks this, and asked about the drawbacks of letting transport operators sell energy. The minister replied that the lines could qualify as closed distribution systems requiring an ACM exemption, that no legislative change is needed, and that talks with stakeholders are ongoing.
As indicated above, it is not necessary to amend legislation for this.
Zoals hierboven aangegeven is het niet nodig hier wetgeving voor aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de regionale zorgen omtrent de afsluiting van de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel in verband met renovatiewerkzaamheden

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about regional concerns over closures of the Haringvlietbrug and Heinenoordtunnel for renovation, including traffic congestion, emergency care access and alternative transport. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mitigation measures, communication with municipalities and emergency services, ferry and toll arrangements, and said Rijkswaterstaat is working with stakeholders without committing to new structural changes.
Rijkswaterstaat informs stakeholders periodically and will continue to do so until the end of the project.
Rijkswaterstaat informeert de stakeholders periodiek en zal dat blijven doen tot het einde van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de mogelijke gevolgen van de boycots op olie uit Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the national oil crisis plan and diesel distribution plan would be finished before the Russian oil import ban, what scenarios and impact analyses exist, and which sectors would be prioritised. The minister answered that the concept plans are nearly ready and will be formally adopted soon, that a concept diesel distribution plan is due before the 5 February 2023 sanctions start, and that the logistics sector and priority users will be addressed through the plan's scenario work, while impact monitoring falls partly under the NCTV and EU-level analysis.
Formal approval and adoption will take place in the short term, after which it will be shared with your House.
Formele goedkeuring en vaststelling zal op korte termijn plaatsvinden, waarna het met uw Kamer gedeeld zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitspraak van het Hof van justitie van de Europese Unie over het UBO-register

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister how the government would respond to the EU Court of Justice ruling invalidating the public-access provision of the UBO register directive. The minister answered that the register was closed for all parties pending a legal analysis, that access for competent authorities will be restored, and that the consequences for obliged entities and for legitimate-interest access, including journalists, remain unclear.
Once the above analysis has been further developed and it is clear which measures will be taken, I will inform your House.
Zodra bovenstaande analyse verder uitgewerkt is en duidelijk is welke maatregelen genomen zullen worden, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Stoffer over het bericht 'Scheepsbouwer IHC zet kroonjuweel in etalage'

MPs Amhaouch and Stoffer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that IHC was offering its profitable subsidiary IQIP for sale, its effect on maritime capabilities, state exposure and financial risk, and whether the Netherlands can keep the knowledge and the shipyard. The minister answered that the state has some influence over the IQIP sale through the 2020 rescue terms but withheld details as confidential, declined to assess the company's viability, gave outstanding exposure figures, and promised a maritime sector agenda by summer.

The State is not a shareholder in IHC. In the 2020 rescue operation the State did secure influence over the sale of IQIP. How far this influence extends is commercially confidential information and is therefore not shared.

De Staat is geen aandeelhouder in IHC. Bij de steunoperatie in 2020 heeft de Staat wel invloed bedongen op de verkoop van IQIP. Hoe ver deze invloed reikt, betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die derhalve niet gedeeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kwart van gecontroleerde truckers bij bloemenveiling Aalsmeer zit mogelijk met drugs op achter het stuur’

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that a quarter of truck drivers checked at the Aalsmeer flower auction may have had drugs in their system, and about enforcement, sanctions and prevention. The government condemned drug driving, said enforcement is local and risk-based, described the testing and sanction process, and said no specific research into causes or public campaign was planned.
The police record information on individual suspects in the context of drug checks in traffic, not on occupational groups or vehicles.
De politie registreert informatie over de individuele verdachten in het kader van drugscontroles in het verkeer, niet over beroepsgroepen of voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de voorgenomen afschaffing van de BPM-vrijstelling voor bestelauto's

Sen. Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about the planned abolition of the BPM exemption for business delivery vans, its CO2 effect, the basis for the 0.7 Mton figure, the switch of the tax base to CO2, the legal basis, alternatives and talks with industry. The state secretary answered every question on substance, explaining the climate and budget rationale, the CO2-based tax base, and that the industry alternative was rejected while the MRB increases for business vans were partly withdrawn.
The 0.7 Mton is the reduction target that the coalition agreement set for this measure for this target group.
De 0,7 Mton is het reductiedoel dat bij deze maatregel voor deze doelgroep in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Stoffer over energie uit water

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of energy from water (wave, tidal and related technologies) in the Dutch economy, the energy transition, EU targets, funding and innovation, and co-use of offshore wind farms. The minister answered that Dutch geography limits the potential, that wave energy and Dynamic Tidal Power warrant further study, that no commitment to the EU 100 MW target will be made, and pointed to existing EU and national funding and an ongoing EU-SCORES research project.
Therefore I will have follow-up research carried out on this.
Daarom laat ik hier vervolgonderzoek naar uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis over uitvoering van de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee (Kamerstuk 32813, nr. 793)

MPs Grinwis and Stoffer asked why motions on researching Dynamic Tidal Power dams and an energy-from-water innovation programme had not yet been carried out. Minister Jetten answers that further research on DTP is being commissioned and that a programme depends on its outcome, with DTP's costs and impacts judged high against other options.
The motion by MPs Grinwis and Stoffer on researching the yield of Dynamic Tidal Power energy dams at sea is being implemented.
Aan de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee wordt uitvoering gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Recordaantal goederentreinen door Overijssel, omwonenden willen rem op groei’

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the state secretary about rising freight train vibration and transport of hazardous substances past Wierden, including forecast growth, monitoring, mitigation and communication with residents. The state secretary answered every question on substance, citing ProRail data, a mitigation plan and an innovation programme, while declining to specify hazardous substances as commercially confidential.
I cannot provide further information on specific substances, because that is commercially sensitive information from the carriers.
Ik kan geen verdere informatie verstrekken over specifieke stoffen, want dat is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van de vervoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Megafraude toeslagen, ouders harkten ’kinderlijk eenvoudig’ zes ton binnen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported childcare-allowance fraud case and whether fraudsters could receive compensation under the restoration operation. The State Secretary answered that convicted parents are assessed integrally with criminal-file information, that 17 convicted parents have received compensation of at least 30,000 euro in other periods, and that intensive fraud supervision was halted in 2020 and is being restarted in phases.
People previously convicted for childcare-allowance fraud, or fined by Toeslagen, are immediately assessed in full within the restoration operation.

Zo worden mensen die in het verleden strafrechtelijk vanwege toeslagfraude zijn veroordeeld of een vergrijpboete opgelegd hebben gekregen door Toeslagen binnen de hersteloperatie direct integraal beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het plotseling afsluiten van afloopsteigers voor de binnenvaart bij Hansweert

An MP asked the minister why eleven of fourteen barge mooring and landing facilities at Hansweert were suddenly closed for overdue maintenance and why the shipping sector and province were not informed earlier. The minister answered that the structures are too corroded for temporary reopening, that the budget is insufficient, that closures cannot be ruled out elsewhere, and that stakeholders were informed from late May.
To prevent unsafe situations for users, it was decided in April 2022 that these jetties must be closed.
Om onveilige situaties voor gebruikers te voorkomen is in april 2022 besloten dat deze steigers moeten worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat veel Oekraïense vluchtelingen geen Nederlandse bankrekening kunnen openen

MP Stoffer asked the Finance Minister about reports that many Ukrainian refugees could not open Dutch bank accounts, due to invalid or non-biometric passports, and what would be done to fix it. The minister answered that about 7,000 adults lacked accounts, that banks from 3 October would accept such documents, and that DNB had been asked to act flexibly.
On 30 September the banks announced that from 3 October they could also provide a bank account to persons with these documents.
Op 30 september hebben de banken bekend gemaakt dat zij vanaf 3 oktober ook personen met deze documenten een bankrekening kunnen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht over 'Oud presentator eerder vrij na gratie - Openbaar Ministerie adviseerde tegen gratie’

The MP Stoffer asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the pardon (gratie) granted to Frank Masmeijer despite a negative Public Prosecution Service advice, including whether the procedure followed the Gratiewet, why the judiciary gave no public advice, and the policy on pardons. The Minister answers that the procedure followed the law, the pardon was conditional, the Court of Appeal's positive advice was decisive, and advice from courts is generally binding in practice, with some advice documents to be published by Justis.
The Court of Appeal gave advice on a pardon request in this case and also had the Public Prosecution Service's advice available to it.
Het gerechtshof heeft in deze zaak een advies gegeven op een gratieverzoek waarin het ook over het advies van het OM beschikte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Stoffer over het bericht 'Vulva maakt nummer over abortus genaamd 'Kill The Baby' en over misbruikers genaamd 'Abusers''

MPs Bikker and Stoffer asked the minister how a song and release party about abortus ('Kill The Baby') relate to the Wet afbreking zwangerschap, to government abortion policy, and whether authorities can intervene. The minister answered that the song is protected artistic expression, that intervention is undesirable, that public broadcasters decide their own content, and that prior content supervision is constitutionally impermissible.
Ik acht ingrijpen dan ook ongewenst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over de aanrijtijden van ambulances

Two SGP MPs asked the Minister of Health about slow ambulance response times in Veluwe villages and what was done after a Gelderland motion. The minister outlined consultations with municipalities, RAVs and insurers, measures taken, and argued that the 15-minute norm applies regionally rather than per location.
I regularly consult with Ambulance Care Netherlands and Health Insurers Netherlands on the quality of ambulance care.
Ik overleg periodiek met Ambulancezorg Nederland en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland over de kwaliteit van de ambulancezorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Achterstanden Kamer van Koophandel frustreren financiële sector’.

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that backlogs at the Chamber of Commerce delay UBO-register entries, leaving financial institutions unable to onboard clients, and whether the 1 September 2022 transitional arrangement should be extended and the register redesigned. The minister answers that institutions can temporarily rely on proof of submission, that the backlog is expected to clear by 1 September, that extension would be announced at least a month ahead, and that the register's privacy impact will be evaluated while the EU proposals are being negotiated.
Should an extension of the aforementioned arrangement prove necessary, this will be announced at least one month before 1 September 2022.
Mocht eventuele verlenging van voornoemde regeling nodig zijn, dan zal dit minimaal een maand voor 1 september 2022 worden aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Inspectie: Stop met aantrekken arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Stoffer and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Labour Inspectorate's warning that labour migration causes societal costs such as housing shortages and inequality, and about whether the government will curb population growth. The minister acknowledges downsides, stresses EU free movement, treats non-EU labour migration as a last resort, and says the implementation of the Roemer committee recommendations and the population study are ongoing.
The cabinet sees labour migration from outside the EU as the last resort in tackling labour market shortages.
Het kabinet ziet arbeidsmigratie van buiten de EU als sluitstuk van de aanpak van krapte op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het toezicht op werken op hoogte

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour inspectorate capacity, violations and fines for unsafe work at height in asbestos removal, construction and solar panel installation, and the effect of extra oversight. The minister answered with capacity splits, a share of violations and fines relating to work at height, and a case example, while saying the inspectorate focuses on outcomes rather than inspection counts.
In line with the motto 'from tallies to effect', the focus of the Labour Inspectorate is not on capacity or the number of inspections but on the effect to be achieved: healthy and safe work.
Overeenkomstig het adagium «van streepjes naar effect», ligt de focus van de Arbeidsinspectie niet op capaciteit of het aantal controles, maar op het te bereiken effect: gezond en veilig werk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 'het bericht KLM stelt vaccinatieplicht in voor nieuwe piloten en stewardessen'

An MP asks the ministers whether KLM may require vaccination of new pilots and cabin crew and whether such refusal-based rejection constitutes unlawful discrimination, and how the government will enforce against employers demanding vaccination status. The minister answers that vaccination is voluntary and employers may not require it, notes a Amsterdam court ruled KLM may not ask candidates about vaccination status, and states no specific legal basis exists but existing labour law protects workers, while declining to create new legislation.
In the Netherlands vaccination is and remains voluntary.
In Nederland is en blijft vaccinatie vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanhoudende wateroverlast bij Sluiskil

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about persistent water nuisance near Sluiskil and whether canal water levels, dam wall length and canal bed profile contribute to it. The minister denied the cited analysis, said additional geohydrological research is under way with results expected in Q3 2022, and promised to involve residents and to explore responsibility for farmland flooding with the province and water board.
The geohydrological research is currently under way. It is therefore still too early to conclude whether there are other insights than those that emerged from the earlier research.
Het geohydrologisch onderzoek loopt op dit moment. Het is daarmee nog te vroeg om te concluderen of er andere inzichten zijn dan uit het eerdere onderzoek naar voren kwamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'NAM zet Rijk onder druk om in Groningen minder huizen te versterken'

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether NAM's pressure on the government to reinforce fewer homes in Groningen has delayed reinforcement, whether the cost-recovery arrangement still holds, and how residents' safety and trust will be protected amid a possible legal dispute. The State Secretary answered that NAM's position does not affect NCG's execution, that the state will recover all costs from NAM with arbitration already started, and pointed to the multi-year reinforcement plan finishing in 2028 with a further letter promised before the debate.

The multi-year reinforcement plan (MJVP), on which the former Minister of the Interior informed the House at the end of last year, contains the planning to complete the reinforcement operation by 2028.

Het meerjaren versterkingsplan (MJVP), waarover toenmalig Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties uw Kamer eind vorig jaar heeft geïnformeerd, bevat de planning om de versterkingsoperatie in 2028 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het bericht 'Agent werd onwel na vermoedelijk contact met zelfmoordpoeder'

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked about a police officer who became ill after possible contact with suicide powder, the safety of responders, the code on chemical substances, and calls for a ban. The ministers answered that the link to the substance is not confirmed, that responder risks are very limited, and that they see no reason to change the voluntary code or legislate, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal investigation.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, the Minister of Justice and Security cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan de Minister van JenV hierover geen mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over de uitwerking van de plannen inzake het toevoegen van ‘hate speech’ onder Artikel 83 Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU)

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked the government how it assesses the European Commission's plan to add hate speech and hate crime to the EU crimes list under Article 83 TFEU, covering necessity, legal basis, proportionality, free speech, and the link to Dutch law. The Minister of Justice answered that the government supports the proposal in principle, considers Dutch law largely adequate but benefits from EU-level harmonisation, and will assess any later directive against fundamental rights and Dutch criminal law when it appears.
The cabinet will guard the balance between, on the one hand, the importance of combating crime and, on the other, a possible infringement of fundamental rights.
