Het kabinet zal waken voor de balans tussen enerzijds het belang van de criminaliteitsbestrijding en een mogelijke inbreuk op grondrechten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over plastickorrels in de Westerschelde

An SGP MP asked the minister about a report on plastic nurdle pollution in the Westerschelde, its implications for the Hedwige polder and Natura 2000 values, and follow-up in Flemish talks. The minister said the conclusions are not yet sufficiently verified, pointed to the Schone Schelde 2022 programme and knowledge investment, and noted Dutch pressure in the International Scheldt Commission.
Although I appreciate the effort of this specific research, I think it is too early to comment on the conclusions.
Hoewel ik de inzet van dit specifieke onderzoek waardeer, vind ik het te vroeg om me over de conclusies uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de onderschatte explosie bij het opblazen van oude Middensluis in Terneuzen

An MP asked the minister about the underestimated blast when the old Middensluis in Terneuzen was demolished, including damage, compensation, causes, and resident communication. The minister said the blast was larger than expected, about 130 damage claims are being handled by the contractor, and an evaluation is underway with results expected mid-April.
That is unfortunately not yet possible at this moment. Despite extensive preparation, the blast was larger than expected.
Dat is op dit moment helaas nog niet mogelijk. Ondanks dat er veel voorbereiding is geweest, was de plof groter dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over omgang met explosieven door overheden

Senator Stoffer (SGP) asked ministers about the handling of explosives by government, after a WWII aircraft bomb exploded on a Wassenaar beach, including steps, coordination, responsibilities, costs and whether a central authority is needed. The government answered that the process runs through municipalities, police and the EODD, that existing coordination suffices, that no central authority or further centralisation is warranted, and it declined to consult additional expert bodies.
Further coordination and centralisation does not lead to more efficient policy, and therefore not to a reduction in costs.
Verdere coördinatie en centralisatie leidt niet tot doelmatiger beleid, en daarmee dus niet tot reductie van kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the low UBO-register registration rate, the privacy risks for beneficial owners, and the pending CJEU case on public access. The minister answered that registration lags but the legal deadline stands, that enforcement will follow, and that the existing privacy safeguards are sufficient for now, pending the Court's judgment.
After the deadline of 27 March I intend to send your House a letter with the state of affairs after the statutory transition period.
Na de deadline van 27 maart ben ik voornemens uw Kamer een brief te sturen met de stand van zaken na de wettelijke overgangstermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over oplossingen voor de stijgende brandstofprijzen

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked whether rising fuel prices burden households and firms, whether excise on fuel should be temporarily cut, whether VAT revenue from higher prices should be frozen, and whether the proposed higher untaxed travel allowance can be brought forward. The State Secretary answered that the government will cut fuel excise by 21% for nine months from 1 April, denied automatic extra VAT windfalls, refused to freeze VAT revenue citing budget rules, and said the travel allowance cannot be raised mid-year for technical reasons.
To cushion the effects, the cabinet announced last Friday, 11 March, that it intends, among other things, to temporarily lower the excise duty on petrol and diesel by 21% from 1 April.
Om de gevolgen te dempen heeft het kabinet afgelopen vrijdag 11 maart aangekondigd dat het onder andere voornemens is om per 1 april de accijns voor benzine en diesel tijdelijk te verlagen met 21%.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Stoffer over "het bericht dat het UWV wachtlijsten op illegale wijze wegwerkt"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV granted WIA disability benefits to sick workers aged 60 and over without a medical assessment in a Zwolle pilot, and whether a larger pilot is planned in Hengelo, raising concerns about legality and inconsistent regional practice. The Minister confirms 19 people received benefits without an insurance physician's assessment, states that a uniform approach is desirable but that local pilots may be tested, accepts that the law requires a medical and labour assessment, and promises an evaluation and information to parliament by spring.

Article 6, first paragraph, of the WIA stipulates that the assessment of whether someone is fully and permanently incapacitated or partially fit for work is based on an insurance-medical and a labour-expert examination.

In artikel 6, eerste lid, van de WIA is bepaald dat de beoordeling of iemand volledig en duurzaam arbeidsongeschikt of gedeeltelijk arbeidsgeschikt is, gebaseerd wordt op een verzekeringsgeneeskundig en een arbeidskundig onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over mogelijke arbeidsongeschiktheid als gevolg van uitgestelde zorg vanwege corona

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked whether delayed care during the COVID-19 pandemic is causing workers to become unfit for work and move from sick pay into the WIA disability scheme, and what is done for them. Minister Van Gennip answered that re-integration is tailored to each worker, that no figures are kept on how many are affected, that wages or benefits continue when re-integration is blocked by external circumstances, and that the 104-week sick pay period can be voluntarily extended by up to one year.
This is not tracked or registered.
Dit wordt niet bijgehouden of geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Stoffer, Segers en Mulder over gewonde burgers als gevolg van Turkse militaire activiteiten in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs asked the government whether Turkish military attacks in northeast Syria injuring civilians, including children, were lawful, and about Turkey's strategy and humanitarian protection of minorities. The government said it lacks details to judge the legality of specific attacks, condemned the Turkish operation, and described ongoing diplomatic efforts and support programmes for religious minorities.

The cabinet states that all countries, including Turkey, must act in accordance with international law, but does not have the details of the attacks in question and therefore cannot make statements on their lawfulness.

Het kabinet stelt voorop dat alle landen en dus ook Turkije conform het internationaal recht moeten handelen, maar beschikt niet over de details van de betreffende aanvallen en kan dus ook geen uitspraken doen over de rechtmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de zorg van TenneT bij het CO2-plafond voor kolencentrales

MP Stoffer asked whether TenneT's concerns about the annual-basis CO2 cap for coal plants, which carries supply-security risks if plants run mostly early in the year, were taken seriously and whether a supplementary risk analysis would be requested. The minister answered that the annual cap was chosen deliberately to protect security of supply, that no extra action is planned for now but developments will be monitored, and that TenneT will make an additional analysis for 2022.
TenneT has meanwhile indicated that it will make an additional analysis for the year 2022 on the Monitoring Security of Supply 2021 regarding the measures for the coal plants.
TenneT heeft inmiddels aangegeven voor het jaar 2022 een aanvullende analyse te zullen maken op de Monitoring Leveringszekerheid 2021 met betrekking tot de maatregelen voor de kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Bikker, Ceder en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Nederland grote abortussponsor'

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and JA21 asked whether the Netherlands funds over 250,000 abortion services per year in poorer countries, how many were actual abortions, and how oversight, reporting and SRGR budgets are handled. The minister says abortion services are not consistently defined or counted, so the figures cannot be verified, and that partners report under general indicators without a separate abortion-service requirement, though audits, evaluations and monitoring apply.
For these methodological reasons, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to stop adding up and tracking the numbers of abortion services from 2017 onward.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft er om deze methodologische redenen voor gekozen om vanaf 2017 de aantallen abortusdiensten niet langer bij elkaar op te tellen en bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de coronamaatregelen voor rijscholen

An MP asked why driving lessons faced passenger and time restrictions during COVID-19 measures while taxis did not, and whether the 17:00 cutoff and two-person limit were mandatory and harmful. The minister answered that the restrictions were lifted (three persons allowed, lessons allowed after 17:00 since 18 December 2021), that the lesson car is a public place under the rules, and that the branch is kept informed.
The regulations have since changed following the decision of 18 December 2021, so driving schools can give lessons during their regular opening hours.
Inmiddels is de regelgeving veranderd door de besluitvorming op 18 december 2021, waardoor de rijscholen gedurende hun reguliere openingstijden les kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ongewenste effecten van strengere regelgeving met betrekking tot het tegengaan van fraude en witwassen

MP Stoffer asks how the effects of anti-fraud and anti-money-laundering rules are monitored, whether research into their negative effects will be done, and how bank account access for charities, churches and associations can be secured. Minister Kaag answers that evaluations are underway (EU, FATF, national, Algemene Rekenkamer), that banks and DNB are working on the knelpunten case by case, and that a general legal right to a bank account for associations is not appropriate, while the evaluation of the Wwft will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2022.
Are you of the opinion that it should be legally mandatory for associations and foundations, including many charities and churches, to be able to open a bank account at every bank?
Bent u van mening dat het wettelijk verplicht moet zijn dat verenigingen en stichtingen ... de mogelijkheid hebben een bankrekening te openen bij elke bank
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat de acceptgiro verdwijnt

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister about the planned discontinuation of the paper acceptgiro, its effects on charities, elderly and digitally excluded people, and how banks' accessibility duties are guaranteed. The minister answered that the acceptgiro ends on 1 June 2023, that paper alternatives exist, that the matter was discussed in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer, and that the phase-out will be monitored.
The Betaalvereniging will, on behalf of Currence, report on practical experiences and statistics, such as stakeholder suggestions, end-user reactions and experiences with the switch to alternatives.

De Betaalvereniging zal in opdracht van Currence rapporteren over de praktische ervaringen en statistieken, zoals suggesties van stakeholders, reacties van eindgebruikers en ervaringen met de overstap naar alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked about the COVID coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) being required at a Deventer inloophuis, in lawyers' training, for journalists and officials, and whether the Van der Staaij amendment exempts public buildings. Minister Grapperhaus replied that CTB obligations apply only to specified venues, that buurt- en wijkcentra are largely exempt, that the occupational exemption in article 58ra covers journalists and officials when their work requires presence at a venue, and that no CTB applies at the town hall.
Buurt- and wijkcentra are exempt from the CTB requirement for events that form part of regular operations.
Voor buurt- en wijkcentra geldt een uitzondering op de CTB plicht voor evenementen die tot de reguliere exploitatie behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht "Steeds meer 55-plussers koersen af op financiële nood"

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on rising financial distress among people aged 55 and over, including how the government will prevent poverty at AOW age and what it will do for older people with disabilities. The State Secretary replies that the social security system already offers income guarantees, that AOW and supplementary schemes protect against poverty, and that new policy on the longer term is for the next cabinet given its caretaker status.
The judgement on the longer-term steps to reduce the risk of poverty and improve the labour market prospects of younger seniors is for the next cabinet.
Het oordeel over de op de lange termijn te zetten stappen om het risico op armoede te reduceren en het arbeidsmarktperspectief van jonge senioren te bevorderen is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht dat Belarus ongeveer 1 miljard euro ontvangt van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked whether the IMF's SDR allocation to Belarus, its conditions, monitoring and sanctions impact were acceptable given Dutch sanctions. Ministers Hoekstra and Knapen answered that SDR allocations are unconditional and generic, that the Netherlands will try to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs on capital markets, and that no reversal of the allocation is planned.

The Netherlands will seek, in line with existing sanctions policy and in contacts with the EU and other international partners, to limit as far as possible Belarus's options to convert SDRs on the capital market.

Nederland zet erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, in contacten met de EU en andere internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor Belarus om SDR's te verzilveren op de kapitaalmarkt zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Stoffer over de afhandeling van bezwaren tegen de spaartaks

MP Stoffer asks why the Tax Authority processes individual objections against the box 3 assessment while the collective mass-objection procedure is pending, and whether it will hold individual objections in abeyance to protect citizens' legal protection. The State Secretary answers that individual and legal questions are separate and must be handled apart, that the Tax Authority will not hold individual objections in abeyance, and that doing so would not increase legal protection.
The Tax Authority does not make use of this possibility.
De Belastingdienst maakt geen gebruik van deze mogelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht "Ministerie kan niets doen tegen bedrijven die vaccinatiebewijs eisen"

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers may require vaccination certificates from employees, whether the ministry can act against such employers, and whether a law should be created to enable enforcement. The State Secretary answered that employers may not require a corona access certificate from employees under current law, that vaccination remains voluntary, and that the government is exploring whether the employee exemption could be lifted under conditions, with results expected in early November.
Enforcement requires a legal basis; this will be taken into account in the exploration of the possible application of corona access certificates in certain sectors.
Handhaven vereist een wettelijke basis, in de verkenning naar de mogelijke toepassing van de coronatoegangsbewijzen in bepaalde sectoren, zal dit worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de (vaststelling van de) NOW

The MP Stoffer asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the cost of accountant and third-party certificates required to verify NOW wage subsidies, their link to VAT and payroll data, and UWV's room for case-specific flexibility and appeal durations. The minister answers that differentiated controls and planned simplifications aim to balance costs with lawful subsidy use, that UWV can filter incidental pay only when objectively verifiable, and that the average appeal takes 32 days.
In designing the NOW control system I deliberately and carefully chose a form of differentiation that matches the size of the business and the amount of the subsidy.

Bij de totstandkoming van de controlesystematiek van de NOW heb ik bewust en zorgvuldig gekozen voor een vorm van differentiatie die aansluit bij de grootte van de onderneming en de hoogte van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de snelheidsverlaging op de Haringvlietbrug

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the 50 km/h speed limit and lane restriction on the Haringvlietbrug, asking about alternatives, reopening lanes and speeding for the bridge's replacement. The minister said two lanes per direction have reopened, a widening and a faster replacement are planned, and alternatives are being considered and tested.
Rijkswaterstaat is doing everything it can to carry out the replacement as quickly as possible.
Rijkswaterstaat doet er alles aan om de vervanging zo snel mogelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat Nederland op de vingers is getikt door Brussel vanwege het niet strafbaar stellen van ontkenning Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the Netherlands has not criminalised Holocaust denial after EU pressure, and whether a bill will be introduced to address it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that such denial is already punishable under Article 137c of the Criminal Code per Supreme Court case law, but that the Commission considers this insufficiently explicit, so a wording amendment via a re-implementation bill is being prepared.
In response, the Commission was informed that the Netherlands sees reason in the Commission's position to prepare a bill.
In reactie hierop is de Commissie bericht dat Nederland in het standpunt van de Commissie aanleiding ziet om een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over haatzaaien in (nieuwe) Palestijnse lesmethoden

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about incitement and intolerance in new Palestinian school textbooks, including martyr-counting exercises, the omission of Israel from maps, altered wording about Jewish history and people, and whether Dutch or EU funds finance these materials. The minister answered that the EU-commissioned Georg Eckert Institute study finds a mixed picture with some problematic and antisemitic passages but improvements in 2020 editions, that incitement is unacceptable and should be removed, that the Netherlands does not fund textbooks directly, and that UNRWA continuously screens materials.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that such examples are removed by the Palestinian Authority as quickly as possible and that it continues to carry out strict review of this.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat dergelijke voorbeelden door de Palestijnse Autoriteit zo snel mogelijk worden verwijderd en dat het hier een strikte toetsing op blijft uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kuik en Van Haga over de brief van 14 januari betreffende vrijwilligersreizen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about orphanage tourism, development policy on orphan care, the UN Child Rights resolution, ANBI charity status rules, timelines for regulatory follow-up, and sector campaigns. The minister answered that orphan care is not a separate policy focus, that ANBI rules are neutral and offer no basis for extra checks, that further regulatory options will be decided in Q4 2021, and that the sector should self-organise with government in an information role.
Several ministries are currently examining which of the listed courses of action are realistic, desirable and feasible, and which concrete actions could be attached to them.
Er wordt momenteel met verschillende ministeries bezien welke van de genoemde handelingsperspectieven realistisch, wenselijk en haalbaar zijn en welke concrete acties hieraan verbonden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over misbruik van Europese donorgelden door Palestijnse Ngo’s

MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked the minister whether Dutch and EU donor funds reach Palestinian NGOs linked to the PFLP, and what controls exist to prevent this. The minister says Dutch and EU funding is subject to risk analysis, audits and monitoring, that Israel's evidence so far is general and unsubstantiated, that OLAF has been asked to look, and that the UAWC contribution stays suspended pending a study to be sent after the summer recess.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the EU request to OLAF.
wacht het kabinet het resultaat van het EU-verzoek aan OLAF af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grote steden verloedering van winkelstraten vrezen nu de leegstand in winkelstraten oploopt

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about rising shop vacancy in city high streets, requesting data, causes, and support measures. The state secretary said complete data is sold commercially by Locatus and withheld, described vacancy as a symptom of structural trends accelerated by COVID-19, and pointed to the Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden (100 million euro over four years) with willingness to consider bringing funds forward.
If I were to make this data public free of charge, it would undermine the business model of Locatus.
Wanneer ik deze gegevens gratis openbaar zou maken, dan zou daarmee het verdienmodel van Locatus worden ondergraven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over de gevolgen van het UBO-register voor ondernemers, kerken en goede doelen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about costs of the UBO register for entrepreneurs, churches and charities, the handling of ANBI board members, and privacy risks. The government answered in detail, describing registration costs, a planned explanatory note on ANBI board members, and measures against scraping and privacy leaks.
To implement the Bruins motion, consultation with SBF examined ways to clarify the position of ANBI (charity) board members.
Ter uitvoering van de motie-Bruins is in goed overleg met SBF bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de positie van (bestuurders van) ANBI's te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grootwinkels aan de rand van de afgrond staan

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that large retail chains face bankruptcy, and whether the government would talk to them, extend aid, and cover their fixed costs. The minister replied that talks with the sector led to a decision not to create an extra subsidy scheme for large firms, pointed to existing measures (TVL, GO-C, Groeifaciliteit, case-by-case support) and said it would review remaining barriers to case-by-case aid.
All things considered, the cabinet has chosen not to introduce an additional subsidy scheme for large enterprises.
Alles overwegende heeft het kabinet ervoor gekozen om geen extra subsidieregeling voor het grootbedrijf in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de budgetstop voor beheer en onderhoud projecten

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of a budget stop halting maintenance contracts, their effect on the construction sector, and the existence of unusable infrastructure due to deferred maintenance. The minister denied any budget stop, said the maintenance budget for 2021 is higher than before with a central check on commitments, and listed bridges and locks with temporary restrictions attributed to technical reasons rather than a direct causal link to deferred maintenance.
There is no question of a budget stop.
Er is geen sprake van een budgetstop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat veel bezwaren tegen de vaststelling van de NOW1-steun worden afgewezen

MP Stoffer asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many objections to final NOW1 wage subsidy assessments are rejected and some firms must repay all support, and about how UWV handles repayment terms and objections. Minister Koolmees answers at length: repayment terms are extended and interest-free, objections are assessed individually with limited room for case-by-case flexibility, and figures on repayments and objection outcomes are provided.
Employers can now also agree online with UWV on a longer repayment period.
Werkgevers kunnen inmiddels ook online met UWV afspraken maken over een langere terugbetaaltermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk en Stoffer over het munitiebudget

MPs Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk and Stoffer asked about a reported cut in the ammunition budget for training from EUR 140 million in 2021 to EUR 80 million in 2023, and its effects on readiness, missions and simulator training. The State Secretary confirmed a structural shortfall of EUR 60 million, partly covered by temporary increases, said cuts would reduce use of expensive munitions while keeping required training levels, and noted that deeper structural fixes depend on future budget room and a future cabinet decision.
It is up to a next cabinet to take a decision on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het maatregelenpakket voor rijexamens

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CBR's package of measures to reduce driving exam backlogs, including doubts about the backlog estimate, limited consultation with driving schools, possible scrapping of intermediate tests and fear-of-failure exams, raising the exam age, and the low pass rates of some schools. The Minister replied that the CBR has already added examiners and overtime, that further measures will be decided end of May depending on pass rates, and that the CBR is pursuing quality improvement and information campaigns while keeping stronger measures as a last resort.
A decision on additional measures (such as the possible temporary scrapping of the intermediate test) will be taken by the CBR at the end of May.
Een besluit over aanvullende maatregelen (zoals het eventueel tijdelijk schrappen van de tussentijdse toets) zal het CBR eind mei nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over noodhulp naar aanleiding van gewelddadigheden in Myanmar

Stoffer (SGP) asked the minister about the military coup in Myanmar, the situation of minorities and the Rohingya, and humanitarian needs and Dutch aid. The minister answered that the coup undermines the whole population, that local aid organisations should be supported, and that the Netherlands gives unearmarked funding to UN and Red Cross partners without yet knowing how much goes to Myanmar.
It is currently not known how much of the Dutch humanitarian contributions can be attributed to the humanitarian response in Myanmar.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel van de Nederlandse humanitaire bijdragen toegerekend kunnen worden aan de humanitaire respons in Myanmar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitrol van 5G

An MP asked the government about the health effects of 5G radiation and whether more independent research should precede rollout, citing a Journal of Epidemiology article calling for the precautionary principle. The government replied that ICNIRP limits, endorsed by the Gezondheidsraad and confirmed by a court, adequately protect health, and that it will pursue further research such as the COSMOS project.
The cabinet will, as advised by the Health Council, pursue more research.
Het kabinet zal zoals geadviseerd door de Gezondheidsraad inzetten op meer onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat president Erdogan een grote rol speelt in opkomst salafisme in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about reports that Erdogan plays a major role in the rise of Salafism in the Netherlands, citing a leaked confidential NCTV analysis. The minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's content, pointed to existing government positions and a forthcoming analysis, and described existing measures against online terrorist content.
As indicated, I cannot go into the content of the draft analysis.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het tekort aan gepantserde voertuigen bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee

MP Stoffer asks about the shortage of armoured vehicles at the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee, its causes and duration, liability for the replacement Toyota Land Cruisers, the cost, effects on the High Risk Protection Platoons, and risks flagged by the Defence Intervention Team. The state secretary replies that there is no current shortage since new vehicles were delivered on 4 March 2021, that the French supplier is in default and legal action is being prepared, that cost is not yet known, and that the platoons could keep operating using older vehicles.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het opkopen van zonneparken door buitenlandse investeerders

Two SGP MPs asked the ministers about foreign investors buying up large solar parks, the resulting outflow of subsidy money, and whether ownership and landscape-integration commitments could be enforced. The minister defended open resale and said there is no generic 50% local-ownership obligation, stating that participation remains voluntary and municipalities can only require good-faith efforts.
I therefore do not take a negative view of reselling solar parks to (foreign) investors.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover het doorverkopen van zonneparken aan (buitenlandse) investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het sluiten van de subsidieregeling energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the SEEH subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, whether all 2020 applications can be honoured, and how the government will support VvE sustainability. Minister Ollongren answers that EUR 70 million will be made available so all valid 2020 applications are paid and the scheme reopens, while acknowledging that early closure may harm trust and promising an evaluation in 2021.
I make EUR 70 million in budget available on the BZK budget for the SEEH.
Ik stel 70 miljoen euro aan budget op de BZK begroting ter beschikking voor de SEEH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het artikel 'If poor countries go unvaccinated, a study says, rich ones will pay'

An SGP MP asked the ministers about a study estimating large global economic losses from unequal COVID-19 vaccine distribution, and about Dutch responsibility and economic impacts. The minister acknowledged the importance of equitable global vaccine access, pointed to Dutch contributions to COVAX and ACT-A, and said exact economic consequences cannot yet be predicted, while committing only to considering such scenarios in future decisions.
In future decisions on the COVID-19 approach, the cabinet considers a wide range of information and possible scenarios.
Het kabinet betrekt bij toekomstige besluiten met betrekking tot de inzet tegen COVID 19 een veelheid aan informatie en mogelijke scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat ondernemers een fors deel van de NOW-steun plus een ‘boete’ moeten terugbetalen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether NOW wage-subsidy recipients must repay extra 'fines' when payroll falls or January payroll was high, hurting small firms. The Minister denies any fine exists, explains the payroll-correction mechanism, rejects individual or systematic relief, but extends the claims window and offers longer repayment terms.
There is no question of a fine.
Er is geen sprake van een boete.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat er mogelijk bezuinigd gaat worden op de kinderbijslag

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why families with children must fund extra costs at the UWV and SVB through non-indexation of child benefit, and whether this fits a reliable government in a crisis. The minister answers that the cuts fund a strengthening of implementation agencies, that the income effect is limited (median -0.1% cumulatively), and that overall family support has been increased.
The cabinet proposes to partly cover this investment by not indexing child benefit in 2022 and 2023, and partly in 2024.
Het kabinet stelt voor om een deel van deze investering te dekken door de kinderbijslag in 2022 en 2023 niet, en in 2024 deels niet te indexeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat een glastuinbouwbedrijf door de verhoogde Opslag Duurzame Energieheffing (ODE) overschakelt van elektriciteit naar gas

An MP asked the ministers whether the rise in the ODE energy levy, which pushes a greenhouse firm back from electricity to gas, undermines electrification and whether compensation will be paid. The government acknowledged the fiscal incentive problem, promised a compensation scheme and an evaluation in spring, but refused to revisit the levy rates in the short term.
I am not prepared to reconsider the rates in the short term.
Ik ben niet bereid om de tarieven op korte termijn te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat Holland Casino wedpartner wordt van de Eredivisie en de Keuken Kampioen Divisie

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Holland Casino's planned multi-million sponsorship deal with the Eredivisie and Keuken Kampioen Divisie while the company receives state COVID support and considers layoffs. The State Secretary replied that the sponsorship supports the company's entry into the online gambling market, that the government approved it, and that Holland Casino must set a responsible-gambling example.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over onterechte en te hoge boetes voor werkgevers

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines on employers, particularly small businesses, and about the legal costs and debt consequences. The minister rejected the premise of disproportionate impact on small firms, defended the inspectorate's case-by-case approach and proportionality rules, and announced a broader review of the system.
I want to answer that question together, in all openness, with employers' and employees' organisations, researchers and stakeholders.
Die vraag wil ik in alle openheid en gezamenlijkheid met werkgevers-, werknemersorganisaties, wetenschappers en stakeholders van een antwoord laten voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Stoffer en Van Raan over stikstofberekeningen

MPs asked the minister about a 2014 review by Arcadis and NLR of nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport, including the review's findings, its commissioning, and the NLR role, with documents to be shared within a week. The minister answered that the concept memo was attached, that flagged points were corrected in a June 2014 addendum, that the commissioning contract is withheld as commercially confidential, and that new project-specific assessments will be done with updated models.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de kosten voor kentekening van landbouwmachines

Stoffer (SGP) asked the minister about RDW fees for identifying and registering new agricultural machines, which exceed earlier communicated costs, and why versnelde inschrijving is not yet available. The minister acknowledges the sector's surprise and regret about the unclear costs, explains the cost structure, and introduces a transition period until 1 July 2021 with a conversion method and work on accelerated registration.
I regret that these costs were not explicitly shared with your House during the legislative process.
Ik betreur dat deze kosten tijdens het wetstraject niet expliciet met uw Kamer zijn gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie een Europees minimumloon wil

Two SGP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the European Commission's plan for a directive on adequate minimum wages, questioning its proportionality, legal basis and possible wage-raising effects. The minister said the Netherlands considers the directive partly proportionate, prefers a Council recommendation, reads the legal basis as leaving the minimum wage level a national competence, and will seek clarification in negotiations.

Given the importance of safeguarding the division of competences between the EU and the Member States, and because this subject may become a point of discussion, the government will ask additional questions during the negotiations.

Het kabinet zal hier wel, gezien het belang van het waarborgen van de bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de EU en de lidstaten en het feit dat dit onderwerp van discussie zal kunnen worden, tijdens de onderhandelingen aanvullende vragen over stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Postma en Stoffer over het bericht 'Zonder meer asfalt staan we straks stil'

MPs Dijkstra, Postma and Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a press report warning that road investment is needed, covering population growth, traffic trends since COVID-19, cost-benefit figures, MIRT budget allocation, freight corridors and the National Growth Fund. The Minister answered substantively on most points, stressing that all modes are needed, that the road budget to 2030 is largely committed, and that new road projects would need extra funding; the Minister did not recognise the cost-benefit figures cited in the article.
Investment decisions are taken together with the region via the Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Your House is involved in this through the Algemene Overleggen MIRT and Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Investeringsbeslissingen worden samen met de regio genomen via de Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Uw Kamer wordt hierbij betrokken in de Algemene Overleggen MIRT en Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de gerenoveerde en afbladderende Waalbrug

An MP asked the minister why the renovated Waalbrug in Nijmegen is still peeling and whether repainting can be brought forward, given residents' disappointment after eighteen months of works. The minister answered that chromium-6 found during the works raised costs to 70-80 million euros, so repainting was postponed about ten years, with inspections in the meantime and coordination with the municipality.

Because research showed the Waalbrug remains structurally safe for 10 more years without preservation of the arch structure, and because the costs of removing chromium-6 are high, I have decided to postpone this work.

Omdat uit onderzoek is gebleken dat de Waalbrug zonder conservering van de boogconstructie nog 10 jaar constructief veilig is én omdat de kosten van het verwijderen van chroom-6 hoog zijn, heb ik besloten deze werkzaamheden uit te stellen.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Stoffer en Postma over het bericht 'Onzekere toekomst voor gebruik oldtimer openbare weg'

MPs Dijkstra, Stoffer and Postma asked the ministers about the future of historic vehicles (oldtimers) on public roads, including a national register of mobile heritage, definitions, innovative fuels and export of cultural goods. The government says it supports a sector-led register with Mondriaan Fund funding, that heritage is defined under the Heritage Act, and that it will engage on fuels and export protection through a planned commission.
I have asked the RCE to continue supporting this process with knowledge and advice.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd om blijvend dit proces te ondersteunen met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘China laat het oog vallen op (verzwakte) Nederlandse bedrijven’

An MP asked ministers about reports that Chinese investors are eyeing weakened Dutch maritime firms, including the role of state aid and risks of takeovers during the COVID-19 crisis. The government denied seeing a rise in such takeovers, pointed to existing protective instruments and forthcoming investment-screening legislation, and committed to monitoring the sector and exploring measures.
The cabinet is developing both sector-specific and generic instruments for this.
Het kabinet ontwikkelt hiervoor zowel sectorspecifiek als generiek instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ondersteuning van mkb-bedrijven tijdens de Corona-crisis

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about support for SMEs during the COVID-19 crisis, covering BMKB loan guarantees, TOGS and NOW subsidy eligibility, payment terms, and tax payment relief. The minister answered most questions with concrete measures such as lower BMKB provisions, extended loan terms, expanded TOGS sector lists, and an extension of the tax payment deferral to 1 October 2020, while declining to make blanket changes such as broad rate alignment or suspending labour law obligations.
The cabinet has decided to extend the term of the BMKB-C to 4 years.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de looptijd van de BMKB-C te verlengen tot 4 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grote stukken strand door de storm Ciara zijn weggeslagen

An MP asked the ministers about storm Ciara washing away large parts of the Walcheren beach, sand nourishment delays caused by nitrogen rules, and whether Natura 2000 rules should be waived for urgent sand nourishment. The minister confirmed awareness, said an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is planned before autumn 2020, and declined any exemption from Natura 2000 and ADC rules as unnecessary.
For the Dishoek location on Walcheren, an accelerated sand nourishment is currently being prepared for water safety reasons, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het signaal dat de nieuwe Merwedebruggen veel te laag dreigen te worden

MP Stoffer asks whether the new Merwede bridges may be built lower than the existing one, and whether the minister will keep navigation clearance at least equal to today's. The minister confirms extra research is underway on the bridges' clearance height, with a decision expected before summer 2020 and consultation with shipping organisations via existing channels.
Yes, a decision on the exact height of the new Merwede bridges is expected to be taken before the summer.
Ja, besluitvorming over de exacte hoogte van de nieuwe Merwedebruggen zal naar verwachting voor de zomer plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat het kabinet de productie van kolencentrales omlaag wil brengen­

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the cabinet wants to reduce coal plant output to meet the Urgenda obligations, asking about the CO2 reduction, budget, timeline, effect of the COVID-19 slowdown, and whether to reconsider. The minister answered that a package of measures including coal plants is being prepared and will be sent to parliament shortly, declined to anticipate it on most questions, and explained that carbon leakage and the ETS waterbed effect will likely play only a limited role.
The cabinet is currently working on a package of additional measures to contribute to implementing the Urgenda ruling.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan een pakket met aanvullende maatregelen om een bijdrage te leveren aan de uitvoering van het Urgenda-vonnis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over ongunstige fiscale regels voor de landbouw

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked about unfavourable tax rules for farmers facing volatile incomes from drought and animal disease, comparisons with Belgium, France, Denmark and Ireland, and whether a tax-free climate reserve or wider use of the reinvestment reserve is possible. The state secretary pointed to income averaging, loss relief, the tax exemption for broad weather insurance, and a sector proposal on a climate reserve that is still being studied.
The proposal was sent by the sector representatives on 16 January 2020 and will be studied further.
Het voorstel is op 16 januari 2020 door de vertegenwoordigers van de sector toegezonden en zal nader worden bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de voornemens aangaande de verhuizing van de marinierskazerne naar Vlissingen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether a proposal to locate the marine corps barracks near Apeldoorn was on the cabinet agenda, despite plans to move it to Vlissingen, and what the regional economic prospects are. The State Secretary acknowledged the process went poorly and that Zeeland's trust was damaged, announced two intended decisions (not building the barracks in Vlissingen and jointly developing a compensation package), but did not directly confirm or deny the Apeldoorn agenda item.
The cabinet therefore takes two intended decisions regarding the relocation.
Het kabinet neemt inzake de verhuizing daarom twee voorgenomen besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de spaarrente van 0%

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's move to a 0% savings rate for ordinary savers and charging wealthy savers was in line with prior talks with banks, whether savings should be protected from zero or negative rates, what it means for saver willingness to keep saving, whether other banks will follow, and whether talks with banks continue. The minister answered that he expects banks to avoid negative rates for small savers, that he will monitor developments and revisit the matter (even considering legislation) if access to non-negative-rate banks is significantly restricted, and that a Box 3 reform bill is planned before summer 2020.

If the options for ordinary savers to bank with a bank that does not charge negative interest are significantly restricted, I will take up the matter again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.

Indien de mogelijkheden voor gewone spaarders om te bankieren bij een bank die geen negatieve rente rekent significant worden beperkt, dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het storten van vervuild baggerslib uit België in Nederlandse zandwinputten

Parliamentary questions from MP Stoffer (SGP) asked how the government would respond to reports that polluted dredging sludge from Belgium and other contaminants were dumped into Dutch sand pits, and about tightening rules and enforcement. The minister replied that the rules are adequate, that enforcement by ILT and Rijkswaterstaat is sufficient, and that she will explore cooperation with Flanders and harmonisation of rules.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the enforcement policy.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het handhavingsbeleid aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Dik-Faber over sanering van ernstig vervuilde bodems in gemeente de Ronde Venen

MPs Stoffer and Dik-Faber asked about lead-contaminated soil in De Ronde Venen, the urgency of remediation above 800 mg/kg, the division of responsibilities between state, province and municipality, and financing. The minister answered that the intervention threshold signals possible need for measures, that the Soil Convenant leaves it to competent authorities to decide, that responsibilities shift to municipalities under the Environment and Planning Act, that funding runs to end-2020, and that a joint taskforce is working on scenarios.
It concerns a signal value, which indicates that measures may possibly be necessary.
Het betreft een signaalwaarde, die aangeeft dat mogelijkerwijze maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aangekondigde importheffing voor afval

An MP asked the government about the risk that a planned import levy on waste would push waste to landfill abroad or in the Netherlands, increasing CO2 emissions, and about its revenue, heat supply and renewable energy effects. The state secretary answered that leakage risks were limited, estimated a 4 Mton reduction package, gave a revenue forecast, and declined to reconsider the measure.
A reconsideration of this measure is, as far as the cabinet is concerned, therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van deze maatregel is wat het kabinet betreft dan ook niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het lekken en illegaal verhandelen van persoonsgegevens uit het kentekenregister

An MP asked whether the government knows of illegal trade in confidential license-plate register data, how it could happen despite stricter privacy rules, who has access, and what will be done. The minister confirms awareness, says a police investigation with the RDW and LIV is underway, describes the legal framework and list of access categories, and says an external review of extra safeguards has been commissioned.
The investigation must establish where the data came from and whether there has been misuse.
Het onderzoek moet uitwijzen waar de gegevens vandaan komen en of er sprake is van misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Transporteurs boos over dure Nederlandse tachokaart: ‘In buitenland veel goedkoper’

MPs asked why Dutch hauliers pay substantially higher prices for tachograph cards than in neighbouring countries and whether this disadvantages Dutch SMEs. The minister acknowledged price differences, said a benchmark study will be sent to parliament after the summer, and promised a revised, more transparent tariff scheme that may lower prices.
This study will be sent to your House after the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal na de zomer naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het verhalen van de opruimkosten van gedumpt drugsafval

MP Stoffer asked the government about the Council of State ruling that municipalities cannot recover clean-up costs of dumped drug waste from landowners who did not commit a legal violation, and whether a national compensation scheme would follow. The state secretary answered that landowners will not pay unless they breached a legal duty, that a national scheme is not planned because responsibility lies with provinces and municipalities, and that the cabinet will provide €1 million per year from 2019 to 2024 to co-finance direct clean-up costs.
Given the responsibilities for preventing possible harm to public health and the environment, responsibility lies with regional and local governments.
Gelet op de verantwoordelijkheden in het voorkomen van mogelijke schade voor volksgezondheid en milieu, ligt hier de verantwoordelijkheid bij regionale en lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Smeulders over "het bericht 'Rouwbegeleiding op het werk vaak onvoldoende'”

MPs Stoffer and Smeulders asked the government about reports that bereavement support at work is often inadequate, sick leave among the bereaved is higher than necessary, and there is no statutory right to bereavement leave. The minister answered that bereavement is individual and that a guidance handbook for employers will be developed, while arguing that a statutory right to bereavement leave is not appropriate and that the evidence cited is not representative.
A statutory right to bereavement leave is currently not on the agenda.
Een wettelijk recht op rouwverlof is nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanbesteding van zware berging

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Rijkswaterstaat's open tender for heavy recovery services, including the reduction from 39 to 17 contracted lots, the cost of 24/7 availability, the risk of price wars and unsafe response times, and the possibility of a floor price. The Minister answered that the tender is on track, quality counts alongside price, and no floor price or revision of the tender rules is planned.
I have no insight into the number of vehicles towed by non-contracted companies.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal versleepte voertuigen door niet-gecontracteerde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Baudet over de twijfels van het bedrijfsleven over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

MPs Stoffer and Baudet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about business doubts over the costs of climate policy, including PBL and Navigant cost estimates, the affordability of home insulation and industry investment, and public support for the energy transition. The minister largely defended the PBL analysis, citing methodological differences, promised cost reduction efforts and further transparency on models, and gave no commitment to new parliamentary oversight measures.
I share the importance of open and testable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ontbrekende oplossing voor belastingvrijstelling asbestdaken bij tussenopslag

MP Stoffer asked whether the Finance Ministry refuses to guarantee that a wrongly exempted asbestos-roof waste load would be back-taxed to the party issuing the false declaration rather than the landfill operator, and whether this blocks the exemption and an affordable 2025 asbestos-roof ban. Staatssecretaris Snel answered that the statutory safeguards are sufficient, that liability depends on circumstances and that he is willing to consult the sector organisations about concerns raised.
Within this framework I am of course willing to enter into consultation with the relevant trade organisations about concerns they have raised regarding the application of the exemption.
Binnen dit kader ben ik uiteraard bereid om in overleg te treden met de betrokken brancheorganisaties over zorgen die zij hebben geuit over de toepassing van de vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het voorlopig akkoord over de import van kippenvlees uit Oekraïne

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked whether the EU-Ukraine provisional deal raising the duty-free poultry quota from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes would mean more Ukrainian chicken fillet on the EU market, and whether the government would push for tighter terms. The ministers answered that the Commission is still negotiating, that the government will assess the draft Council decision and the parliamentary motion before taking a final position, and that it has written to Commissioner Hogan raising concerns.
The cabinet will study the Commission's draft Council decision and on that basis take a definitive position.

Het kabinet zal het concept Raadsbesluit ten behoeve van goedkeuring met ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van de Europese Commissie bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kiwa Register start ‘veel te laat’ met uitgifte nieuwe tachokaarten’

MPs Dijkstra (VVD) and Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about delays in issuing smart tachograph cards, which may leave lorries unable to operate after 15 June 2019. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to capacity shortages at card producer Idemia, said the ILT assesses overmacht case by case rather than suspending fines, and stated that further solutions depend on talks with other member states and the European Commission.
The delay is caused by a shortage of capacity at card producer Idemia.
De vertraging wordt veroorzaakt door tekort aan capaciteit bij kaartproducent Idemia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Werkgevers overstelpt met loonsancties’

An MP asked the minister whether private self-insuring employers faced a sharp rise in UWV sanctions and whether UWV had tightened its guidelines, and how that squares with a level playing field and the coalition plan to lower their risks. The minister answered that no separate figures exist, that policy is unchanged apart from clarified guidance, and that the different re-integration duties follow from the Sickness Benefits Act, while agreeing to talk with private implementers.
Whether the number of sanctions imposed on private implementers has risen so sharply cannot be said.
Of het aantal sancties dat is opgelegd aan private uitvoerders zo fors is opgelopen kan niet gezegd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitvoering van de motie-Stoffer
