MP Stoffer asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the implementation of his motion on the wage-cost allowance (LKV) for employers hiring workers with disabilities, questioning the timing of the transitional leniency scheme and the lack of timely information for schools and young people. The State Secretary maintained that communication was sufficient, that the nine-month leniency period was adequate, and that stagiaires may still qualify for the low-income allowance, while planning to abolish the doelgroepverklaring for the group already on the register.
I therefore announced in my letter of 20 November 2018 that I intend, subject to an implementation test by UWV, to abolish the target group declaration for this group.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief van 20 november 2018 3 aangekondigd voornemens te zijn, onder voorbehoud van een uitvoeringstoets door UWV, de doelgroepverklaring voor deze groep af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de tarieven voor warmtelevering

MP Stoffer asked whether heat tariffs may rise by 164 euro this year due to higher gas taxes, what future gas tax increases mean for heat tariffs, and how the government will prevent heat tariffs from becoming unduly high. The minister confirmed the rise, explained that heat tariff caps follow the gas reference, and said the ACM monitors returns and the government will activate correction powers if returns prove unreasonable, while commissioning research into alternatives to the gas reference.
If necessary, I will then put into effect the provisions of the Heat Act that enable the ACM to correct any above-reasonable returns of heat suppliers in heat tariffs.

Indien noodzakelijk zal ik dan de bepalingen uit de Warmtewet in werking laten treden, die het mogelijk maken voor de ACM om eventuele hoger dan redelijke rendementen van warmteleveranciers te corrigeren in de warmtetarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de belemmering van de 'vaste laag' bij Nijmegen voor de binnenvaart

An SGP MP asked the minister whether the hard layer in the Waal near Nijmegen, which limits inland shipping depth during drought, should be removed, and about its costs, effects and expected droughts. The minister acknowledged the issue, said a study on riverbed erosion will soon be completed and will inform Parliament, and deferred substantive answers on the hard layer to that reaction.
How to deal with the hard layer near Nijmegen, the consequences of bed erosion and the possible solutions will be included in my response to the aforementioned study.
Hoe om te gaan met de vaste laag bij Nijmegen, de consequenties van bodemerosie en de mogelijke oplossingen zal ik meenemen in mijn reactie op het eerder genoemde onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de sterke toename van het aantal ongelukken met vrachtwagens en de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sharp rise in truck accidents in 2017 and the disproportionate involvement of foreign drivers, and whether research would be commissioned and whether phone use at the wheel should be made technically impossible. The minister acknowledged the STIMVA findings, said data sources are hard to compare and no complete picture of causes exists, pointed to the upcoming road safety strategy and agreed that hands-free phone use should be made technically impossible while referring sanctions to the Justice minister.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Private uitvoerders sociale zekerheid eisen 'drastisch aangepaste rol' UWV'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a platform of private social security implementers demanding a drastically changed role for UWV and a more level playing field in the hybrid market for sickness and WGA benefits. The minister answered that he is in talks with UWV, the Tax Administration and private parties, will report on the hybrid market in autumn 2018, and had already met PPUSZ in April.
I will inform you in autumn 2018 by letter about the outcomes of this exploration of the hybrid market for the WGA and the ZW.
Ik zal u in het najaar van 2018 in een brief informeren over de uitkomsten van deze verkenning over de hybride markt voor de WGA en de ZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de vergoeding van kosten voor het opruimen van gedumpt drugsafval

MP Stoffer asked why landowners must bear clean-up costs for illegally dumped drug waste, what the past subsidy scheme provided, and whether a structural or higher-percentage scheme is planned. The State Secretary replied that the ministry's temporary co-financing scheme for 2015-2017 has ended, that no structural scheme from the ministry is planned, and that a sustainable solution must be explored by provinces and municipalities in a working group.
A structural subsidy scheme from the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not on the table.
Een structurele subsidieregeling vanuit het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is niet aan de orde.

Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over onderzoek naar het verhogen van de leeftijdsgrens voor gezinshuizen
Asks the government to study raising the age limit for family homes from 18 to 21 and report to the House before summer 2019.
to conduct research into raising the age limit for family homes from 18 to 21 years
onderzoek te doen naar het verhogen van de leeftijdsgrens voor gezinshuizen van 18 naar 21 jaar
Motie van het lid Peters c.s. over verminderen van de verantwoordingslasten voor kleine jeugdhulpaanbieders

Asks the government to significantly reduce the experienced accountability burdens on small youth care providers, including duplication in annual reporting and direct risk inventories by the Inspectorate, and to present a plan before summer 2019.
asks the government to significantly reduce the experienced burdens for small youth care providers, including households, around duplication in annual reporting and risk inventories

verzoekt de regering, de ervaren lasten voor kleine jeugdhulpaanbieders, waaronder dus die gezinshuizen, rond onder andere de dubbeling in de jaarverantwoording en de risico-inventarisaties significant te verminderen
Motie van het lid Peters c.s. over voorkómen van uithuisplaatsing wegens schulden en armoede
Asks the government to investigate how out-of-home placement of children due to debt and poverty can be prevented and how community-based shelter can be organised.
requests the government to investigate how out-of-home placement of children due to debt and poverty can be prevented as far as possible
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe uithuisplaatsing van kinderen wegens schulden en armoede zo veel mogelijk voorkomen kan worden

Asks the state secretary to map conflicting social support arrangements and set up an interdepartmental working group to align them.
set up an interdepartmental working group tasked with better aligning the arrangements
een interdepartementale werkgroep in te stellen met als opdracht de regelingen beter op elkaar af te stemmen
Motie van de leden Voortman en Peters over de preferente status van de overheid
Asks the government to examine whether the preferential creditor status of the state can be changed within the debt agenda.
requests the government, within the broad debt agenda, to examine whether this preferential status of the government can be adjusted
verzoekt de regering, in het kader van de brede schuldenagenda te onderzoeken of deze preferente status van de overheid aangepast kan worden

Asks the government to promote awareness of the individual study allowance among municipalities and evaluate spending of earmarked budgets by 1 September 2018.
to evaluate and include differences in use across municipalities
te evalueren en daarbij ook de verschillen in gebruik door de diverse gemeenten mee te nemen

Asks the government to explore further developing the job-candidate finder app so employers and job seekers can connect faster.
to examine whether a further development of the candidate explorer is possible
te onderzoeken of een doorontwikkeling van de «kandidaatverkenner» mogelijk is

Shifts budget within the departmental budget for Participation Act and Allowances to fund a single employer contact point in labour market regions.
the submitters of this amendment want to organise a single point of contact for employers in the labour market region
willen de indieners van dit amendement één aanspreekpunt in de arbeidsmarktregio organiseren voor werkgevers
Motie van het lid Peters over de best passende vorm van contractering
Asks the government to clarify for municipalities what room current rules give to choose the best-fitting contracting form and to resolve bottlenecks in EU and national rules.
requests the government to make clear to municipalities what room current rules leave to choose the best-fitting form of contracting
verzoekt de regering om, voor gemeenten duidelijk te maken welke ruimte er binnen de huidige regelgeving is om de best passende vorm van contractering te kiezen
Motie van het lid Raemakers c.s. over een kindervragenuur
Calls on the Tweede Kamer to hold an annual youth takeover with a children's question hour putting questions to cabinet members.
calls on the Tweede Kamer to organise an annual takeover in which Dutch youth take over the chamber for an hour and can ask cabinet members questions in a children's question hour

roept de Tweede Kamer op om jaarlijks een Tweede Kamer-take-over te organiseren, waarbij Nederlandse jongeren voor één uur de zaal van de Tweede Kamer overnemen en via een kindervragenuur vragen kunnen stellen aan leden van het kabinet
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over de dreigende financiële dreun aan het openbaar vervoer in de regio

MPs Krul and Peters asked about a projected cut of about 260 million euros to student public transport budgets, arguing the 2021-2022 base year was unrepresentative due to COVID. The minister answered that the recalibration uses the 2022-2023 measurement period, that the freed-up funds (about 207.5 million) will be used once in 2024 to support public transport, and that a 2025 recalibration is proposed.
I therefore do not share the view that this recalibration study is not representative.
Ik deel daarom niet het standpunt dat dit herijkingsonderzoek niet representatief zou zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Faillissementen dreigen door nieuwe cao'

An MP asked whether youth care institutions risk bankruptcy if a new collective labour agreement raises wages and municipalities do not compensate them, and what measures are needed. The minister said there is no central overview of providers' finances, pointed to municipalities' continuity duty, the Youth Authority's monitoring, transition funding and the continuity subsidy scheme, and noted ongoing consultation.
There is no central insight into the current financial position of youth care institutions to assess this claim.
Er is geen centraal inzicht in de actuele financiële positie van jeugdzorginstellingen om deze stelling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Peters, Kwint, Beertema, Westerveld en Van der Plas over carnaval en de afname van de doorstroomtoets

Six MPs asked the minister why the doorstroomtoets (transition test) was not moved around the carnival period and whether an extra week could be granted to carnival regions. The minister answered that after a stakeholder meeting the test window was extended from two to three weeks, with the extension for 2024 applied to the digital test and to be codified in law after that, while the test timing will be evaluated later.
Based on that conversation, I have decided to extend the period in which schools can administer a transition test from two to three weeks.
Op grond van dat gesprek heb ik besloten de periode waarin scholen een doorstroomtoets kunnen afnemen van twee naar drie weken te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Peters over het alleen schriftelijk beoordelen van asielaanvragen

MPs Brekelmans and Peters asked whether written-only asylum hearings for Syrian, Yemeni and Turkish applicants risk carelessness, wrongful grants and missed security risks, and whether they are reconsidered. The State Secretary defends written hearings as a careful, voluntary IND procedure needed to raise output, notes no evidence they attract more applicants, and states Turkish applicants are dropped from the procedure because it proved less suitable.
For that reason, written hearings are no longer applied to Turkish asylum seekers and are limited to asylum seekers from Syria and Yemen.
Om die reden wordt schriftelijk horen niet langer toegepast op Turkse asielzoekers en beperkt tot asielzoekers uit Syrië en Jemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, De Roon, Klink, Eppink en Omtzigt over de bescherming van mensen die met de dood bedreigd worden door wetten tegen geloofsafvalligheid en godslastering

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands is doing to press states that retain the death penalty for apostasy and blasphemy, including via UN resolutions, UPR reviews, and an international campaign, and how it protects people threatened in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in UN fora, made statements and visits, supports a moratorium in principle, and cited Dutch criminal law and support for ex-believers, but gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands is against the death penalty in all cases and under all circumstances and therefore gives extensive attention to these resolutions and parliamentary motions.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf in alle gevallen en onder alle omstandigheden en geeft daarom uitgebreid aandacht aan deze resoluties en Kamermoties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Universiteit Leiden nam in stilte afscheid van haar omstreden Confucius Instituut’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Confucius Institutes at Dutch universities, their funding, continued cooperation and risks such as Chinese state influence and espionage. The minister answered that academic freedom is important, that some institutions were advised to end cooperation, and that continued contact and knowledge-security measures are in place.
I would like to emphasise that I attach great importance to safeguarding academic freedom and scientific integrity at educational and research institutions.
Ik wil graag benadrukken dat ik groot belang hecht aan het waarborgen van academische vrijheid en wetenschappelijke integriteit door onderwijs-en onderzoeksinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ministerie plant eindtoets basisscholen tijdens carnaval en suggereert: verplaats carnaval maar’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the 2024 end-of-primary test (doorstroomtoets) clashes with carnival and whether the ministry suggested carnival be moved. The minister says the test window is set by law at the first two full weeks of February, that schools can schedule around carnival, and withdraws the ill-chosen wording suggesting carnival be moved, while stating no change to the test window is planned for now.
In answering a citizen's question there was an unfortunate choice of words, which I hereby withdraw.
Bij het beantwoorden van een burgervraag is sprake geweest van een ongelukkige woordkeuze, die ik hierbij wil terugnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Woude en Peters over het recht op studiebeurzen voor EU-studenten in Nederland na herinvoering van de basisbeurs

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the entitlement of EU/EEA students to Dutch student finance after the reinstated basic grant, including worked examples, cumulation with foreign aid, verification of parental income, and European cooperation. The minister answered that a full legal analysis on portable student finance will follow before summer, that cumulation with foreign student finance is not allowed but enforcement is hard without international agreements, and that the questions and related motions are being worked on.
I will include this part in a letter that your House will receive before the summer.
Dit deel zal ik opnemen in een brief die uw Kamer voor de zomer ontvangt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het steeds internationaler worden van kunstacademies

The MP asks whether the recruitment stop for international students and the 2011 art-education volume agreements apply to art academies, and whether Dutch students are disadvantaged by competition with international applicants. The minister confirms the recruitment stop covers art programmes, says the volume agreements do not distinguish by student origin, and acknowledges accessibility concerns while pointing to pre-education and cultural education measures.
Art programmes do not fall within this category and therefore this recruitment stop for international students also applies to this type of programme.
Kunstopleidingen vallen niet binnen deze categorie en daarom is deze wervingstop voor internationale studenten ook voor dit type opleidingen van toepassing.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over seksueel geweld onder asielzoekers en vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Slachtoffers zijn belangrijker dan bewijzen, ook na verkrachting in de oorlog’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether sexual violence against asylum seekers is overlooked in the asylum procedure and whether support is adequate, citing an Amnesty report. The government answered that forensic medical examinations are ordered only when needed for credibility assessment, that individual assessment and training are in place, that medical data falls under confidentiality so numbers are unknown, and that it aims to pay more attention to the issue.
The aim is to pay more attention to this subject in the future.
Het streven is om in de toekomst meer aandacht te besteden aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Beertema over het bericht ‘Steeds meer Nederlandse leerkrachten in Vlaanderen’

Two MPs asked the minister whether the rising number of Dutch teachers working in Flanders is known, and whether Flemish teaching culture (theoretical grounding, teacher authority) explains it. The minister confirms awareness, lists possible reasons (school systems, pay, housing, culture, personal motives, Antwerp/Brussels Dutch communities), says Dutch teacher salaries are generally not lower, and outlines retention measures and a progress letter before summer.
Before the summer, my colleague, Minister Dijkgraaf, and I will inform you of the progress.
Voor de zomer informeren mijn collega, Minister Dijkgraaf en ik u over de voortgang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over het bericht 'MBO-scholen helemaal klaar met stakingen in streekvervoer: 'Sommige klassen zitten maar halfvol'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how MBO students were affected by regional transport strikes, what steps schools and the government would take, and whether the social partners should be urged to resume talks. The minister acknowledged the impact, noted that a collective agreement was reached on 7 April ending the strikes, and said further measures are no longer needed.
I therefore cannot state in general terms what the impact of regional transport strikes on education is.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven wat de invloed is van stakingen in het streekvervoer op het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het artikel van Times Higher Education “CV-blind’ grant review divides Dutch scientists.’

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Times Higher Education article criticising NWO's two-phase, CV-blind grant review and the evidence-based CV. Minister Dijkgraaf defended the changes as reducing workload, said NWO will evaluate and adjust them, and disputed claims about recruiting reviewers and the quality risks.
NWO will test this new way of assessing and also evaluate it and adjust it where necessary.
NWO toetst deze nieuwe manier van beoordelen en zal deze ook evalueren en waar nodig bijsturen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de nadelige positie waarin vaders zich bevinden na een scheiding

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about research suggesting fathers fare worse than mothers after contested divorces, including bias in the professional system and the advice of an expert team on parental alienation. The minister said the full pilot report is still being studied, stated that the state's policy is based on equal parenting, announced further training and a Digiplein platform, and said that decisions on tougher measures await a WODC study expected in April 2023.
The definitive and complete research report I received very recently and it is still being studied.
Het definitieve en volledige onderzoeksrapport heb ik zeer recent ontvangen en wordt momenteel nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en De Hoop over 'En toen was er geen hoogleraar Friese taal en cultuur meer, tegen de afspraken in'

MPs Peters and De Hoop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Groningen university's failed appointment of a Frisian language and culture professor and about legislation to anchor Frisian academic education. The minister said the hiring is the university's own matter, that a legislative proposal is being explored with a letter due in spring 2024, and that the Frisian programme continues within a broader minors programme.

I am currently exploring the possibilities to implement the motion requesting legal anchoring of Frisian academic education and will inform your House further this autumn on the implementation of the motion.

Ik verken momenteel de mogelijkheden om de motie die vraagt om wettelijke verankering van wetenschappelijk onderwijs in het Fries uit te voeren en zal uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘Mensenhandelaren actief bij azc, asielzoekers stappen in geblindeerde busjes: ‘Moderne slavernij’

MPs Kuik and Peters asked the State Secretary about press reports of human trafficking, exploitation and sexual approaches to minors around asylum reception centres, and what is being done to detect and prevent it. The State Secretary answered that COA, police and municipalities cooperate, that the police prioritise trafficking, that COA trains contact persons and visitor controls exist, and that he takes the signals seriously while disputing some reported facts.
I find it serious if concerned residents were no longer reporting because of a lack of action and fear of retaliation.
Ik vind het ernstig als bezorgde omwonenden geen aangifte meer zouden doen wegens een gebrek aan actie en de angst voor vergelding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Pouw-Verweij, Ceder en Van der Staaij over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2023

MPs from CDA, JA21, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the foreign minister about Open Doors' 2023 persecution-of-Christians ranking, Dutch initiatives on violence and impunity, Nigeria, Sahel mercenaries, China, North Korea and dual-use exports. The minister largely acknowledged the concerns, described existing programmes and dialogues, and said that prospects for change in North Korea are small and that dual-use risks are handled by export control and corporate due diligence.
I receive the same signals from the embassies that concern me.
Ik krijg vanuit de ambassades dezelfde signalen die mij zorgen baren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers Almere wachten een half jaar op gesprek over verblijf: wanhoop slaat toe’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in emergency crisis shelters waiting over six months for their first IND interview, asking about numbers, the need for faster transfer to regular centres, communication failures, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that about 60 people had waited over six months, that the shelters are still needed, that a bill is in preparation to expand regular reception, and that the IND has hired staff and is adding capacity.
On 31 December 2022, about 60 asylum seekers in a crisis emergency shelter had been waiting longer than half a year for their first interview (aanmeldgehoor).
Op 31 december 2022 zaten circa 60 asielzoekers in een crisisnoodopvanglocatie die langer dan een half jaar wachten op hun eerste gesprek (aanmeldgehoor).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Peters over de onderwijsbevoegdheid voor de lerarenopleidingen ITEPS en ITESS

MPs Van der Molen and Peters asked whether graduates of the ITEPS and ITESS teacher programmes, which overlap with pabo and teacher training but do not confer a Dutch teaching qualification, can be deployed in classrooms and quickly obtain a qualification given the teacher shortage. The ministers answered that the programmes are separate, were approved on labour-market grounds, that graduates can enter schools under conditions while completing top-up training, and that they will hold a conversation with the institution.
In the conversation we announce in answer to question 5, we will also pay attention to differences between the various programmes.
In het gesprek, dat wij in antwoord op vraag 5 aankondigen, zullen wij ook aandacht hebben voor verschillen tussen de verschillende opleidingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Groep 7/8 van cbs De Wegwijzer moet op zoek naar een andere school'

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the minister whether teacher shortages forcing two classes at a village primary school to seek another school would become more common, how the closure norm should be handled, what distances children may travel, and who is responsible for keeping primary education accessible in regions. The minister acknowledged the concern, said there are no concrete signals of wider effects, pointed to regional cooperation and a national teacher strategy, and stated the acceptable distance limits set by law.
That is why all options must be opened up to tackle the shortages.
Daarom moeten alle registers open om de tekorten aan te pakken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Onderwijs ontsnapt aan chaos met overname schoolboekenleverancier TLN’ en het bericht ‘Schoolboeken te laat geleverd: ‘Rommelig begin van nieuw schooljaar’’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about late delivery of school textbooks to over a million students after supplier problems and about textbook price increases and price transparency. The minister acknowledged delivery failures, blamed logistics and outsourcing, reported 3-4% annual price rises, said pricing is a matter between schools and suppliers, and promised an evaluation and binding agreements with market parties.
Based on the outcomes of this evaluation, I will convene a meeting with school boards, market parties and SEM.
Ik zal op basis van de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie een gesprek beleggen met schoolbesturen en marktpartijen en SEM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht 'Moeder vraagt om hulp: 10-jarige Arianny kan op Bonaire niet naar school'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a news report on a 10-year-old on Bonaire unable to attend school, and about special education and compulsory schooling for children with disabilities in Caribbean Netherlands. The minister answered that the child has been placed, that a specialist facility opened in September 2022, that no new study is needed given the 2020 Berenschot evaluation, and that a new education agenda will explore structural provision.
No, there is a publicly funded primary school specifically aimed at pupils who need extra support, the Strea Briante.
Er is een bekostigde school voor primair onderwijs die zich specifiek richt op leerlingen die extra ondersteuning nodig hebben, de Strea Briante.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Palland, Peters en Bikker over het artikel 'Investeer in preventie en die begint al bij de kinderwens'

MPs from CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about preconception care such as the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, its reach, and whether it should be part of the Kansrijke Start programme and municipal prenatal advice duties. The state secretary answered that Nu Niet Zwanger is already part of Kansrijke Start, available in 172 municipalities, that 272 municipalities have a local Kansrijke Start coalition, and that structural funding and possible anchoring will be explored.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitvoering van het jeugdstrafrecht en het (op tijd) ontbreken van de juiste hulp voor jongeren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times for court-ordered youth treatment and whether this increases reoffending and pretrial detention. The minister acknowledged the problem, said no data exist on youths waiting in detention, found no link to recidivism, attributed waits to municipal procurement gaps, and pointed to a planned law and a support programme.
No figures are available on the number of young people held in detention waiting for treatment.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat in detentie wacht op een behandeling.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Peters over het lerarentekort in Nederland

An MP asked the minister whether qualified Surinamese teachers could be allowed to work in the Netherlands to ease the teacher shortage, and what could be done to make exceptions possible. The minister answered that Surinamese teachers lack full qualifications and need a combined residence and work permit, which requires a labour market test, and pointed to existing routes such as career changers and schools' ability to pursue creative solutions within the rules.
Before the summer, my colleague, Minister Dijkgraaf of OCW, and I will send you a letter on the approach to the shortages, of which career-changer inflow is part.
Voor de zomer sturen mijn collega, Minister Dijkgraaf van OCW en ik u een brief over de aanpak van de tekorten, waar zij-instroom deel van uitmaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij en Peters over het bericht dat enkele tientallen christenen in Noord-Korea standrechtelijk zijn geëxecuteerd

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij and Peters asked the Foreign Minister about reports that dozens of Christians in North Korea were summarily executed, including whether the government can verify this, press for clarification, condemn it, and push for a new EU religious freedom envoy. Minister Hoekstra answered that Dutch information access is very limited, that the government raises human rights violations bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, supports the UN Special Rapporteur, expects an EU envoy appointment soon, and relies mainly on EU sanctions.
The Netherlands has no embassy in Pyongyang, there are currently no EU embassies open in Pyongyang, and the UN no longer has access to the country.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade in Pyongyang, er zijn momenteel geen EU ambassades meer open in Pyongyang en ook de VN heeft geen toegang meer tot het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Peters over het bericht 'Bijlesbedrijven schieten als paddenstoelen uit de grond'

MPs Segers and Peters asked whether the rapid growth of private tutoring firms (schaduwonderwijs) is undesirable, given risks to educational inequality and possible subsidy funding. The minister agreed the growth is undesirable, said NPO funds may be used for private tutoring, and deferred the full research and action plan to later reports.
My intention is not to repeat this research before the National Education Programme has been completed.
Mijn voornemen is om een herhaling van dit onderzoek niet eerder te doen dan na het afronden van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over het artikel 'Osse hospice Oase voert strijd tegen lagere subsidie: ‘Als direct gevolg corona volkomen onterecht gekort''

MPs Werner and Peters asked the minister about a regional report that Oss hospice Oase received lower palliative care subsidy for 2022 because the 2020 COVID-19 dip in client numbers was included in the calculation. The minister answered that the subsidy formula is based on actual client numbers over three years, that no case-specific adjustment is possible to keep the scheme simple, that 111 organisations gained and 90 lost subsidy, and that a one-off COVID compensation was given while 2021 will be considered for 2023.
Despite the coronavirus pandemic, it has been decided to keep the existing method of the subsidy scheme for subsidy year 2022.
Ondanks de coronapandemie is besloten om voor het subsidiejaar 2022 vast te houden aan de bestaande werkwijze van de subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Inge van Dijk en Peters over noodverordening op en rond azc Budel na steekpartijen

MPs Kuik, Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and stabbings at the Budel asylum centre and the emergency ordinance that followed, including causes, short- and long-term actions and consequences for perpetrators' asylum claims. The State Secretary acknowledged serious incidents, listed security measures agreed with the mayor, the Commissioner of the King, and COA, and explained the legal grounds for refusing protection to offenders.
Of course I will inform your House of the outcomes of the research into options for action.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink en Omtzigt over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2022 van Open Doors

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2022 Christian persecution ranking, covering Afghanistan, Nigeria, China, India, Algeria, digital surveillance exports, and religious freedom diplomacy. The minister answered that the trends are worrying, outlined existing diplomatic, UN, EU and export-control measures, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued engagement and a future subsidy policy framework.
The Netherlands, together with like-minded countries, raises publicly and behind the scenes at every suitable opportunity the importance of protecting human rights for everyone.

Nederland vraagt, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, zowel publiek als achter de schermen bij iedere gelegenheid die zich daarvoor leent aandacht voor het belang van het beschermen van mensenrechten voor iedereen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Werner, De Neef en Tellegen over het toezicht van de gemeenten op de zorg

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the state secretary about municipal supervision of care after reports that municipal oversight under the Wmo 2015 is failing, including staffing, coordination with national inspectorates, handling of reports, staff qualifications and fraud. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities have wide discretion and that a study on Wmo supervision is underway with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022, while several answers referred to existing cooperation arrangements and noted that national data was unavailable.
That is why my predecessor decided to commission a study into the functioning of Wmo supervision.
Daarom heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger besloten een onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg faalt: jong kind soms niet meer terug naar ouders door onthechting'

An MP asked whether young children placed out of home are sometimes not returned to their biological parents because of attachment to foster families, and how often this happens. The minister answered that no figures exist on this specific issue, pointed to existing guidelines and the 'acceptable timeframe' criterion, acknowledged that gaps in help and fact-finding can delay returns, and referred to the reform agenda and a planned Inspectorate review of fact-finding quality.
There are currently no figures available on how often children cannot be returned to their parents due to attachment problems.
Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak het voorkomt dat kinderen (niet) kunnen worden teruggeplaatst bij hun ouders vanwege hechtingsproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Belastingdienst gaf advies over omgaan met klagers in Jeugdzorg'

An MP asked whether youth care sought advice from the Tax Authority on handling parental complaints, and about the complaint routes for parents and the SKJ. The minister confirmed the Tax Authority was consulted in a 2019 round table following the Tielen/Peters motion, denied that the advice led to stricter complaint rules, and said parents' complaints must be taken seriously while noting the need to streamline complaint and disciplinary procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het bericht ‘Nederland doet samen met China DNA-onderzoek: 'Fundamenteel fout'’

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked whether Dutch institutions (Erasmus MC, LUMC, NFI) collaborated on DNA research with Chinese researchers tied to police, using Uyghur samples obtained through consent forms of doubtful voluntariness, and what the government has done on knowledge security. The minister says some details are not yet known, that the institutions were involved only in four broader international studies and not in the three police-linked ones, that a dialogue with institutions and a knowledge-security framework are underway, and promises to report back in early 2022.
At this moment not all details and facts about the research studies that recently emerged in the reporting you refer to are known.
Op dit moment zijn nog niet alle details en feitelijkheden bekend rondom de onderzoeken die recent naar voren zijn gekomen in de berichtgeving waar u naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Gemeenten hebben tekorten over zichzelf afgeroepen'

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a report that municipalities caused youth care shortages themselves, and about administrative burdens, dyslexia providers' profits, and tariff differentiation. The state secretary acknowledged the report, pointed to a convenant on reducing administrative burden, a forthcoming Hervormingsagenda, a study on transferring severe dyslexia to education, and joint measures with municipalities on tariff differentiation, without concrete new commitments.
I previously committed that I will, together with the Minister of BVOM, inform the House in 2022 about the outcomes of this study.
Eerder heb ik toegezegd dat ik, samen met de Minister van BVOM, uw Kamer in 2022 zal informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht ‘Tekort aan behandelaren veroorzaakt naast wachtlijsten ook patiëntenstop in de ggz’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that staff shortages in mental health care cause waiting lists and intake stops, asking about shortages, training numbers, complexity, digital care, cross-regional allocation, ANW duties, sickness absence, external hiring costs and training capacity. The State Secretary answered at length with data and policy measures, but said some figures (shortages per profession, unemployed staff, costs of external hires, complexity trends) cannot be provided, and committed to informing parliament on regional allocation power and new waiting-time figures.
It is not possible to state how large the shortage of specific professional groups in mental health care is at present.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoe groot het tekort aan specifieke beroepsgroepen in de ggz op dit moment is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat Tilburgse kappers op blauwe plekken gaan letten in de aanpak tegen huiselijk geweld

An MP from the CDA asked whether Tilburg's plan to train hairdressers to report suspected domestic violence, and the wider idea of organised reporting points, is consistent with government policy on youth care and trust between citizens and professionals. The State Secretary answered that Veilig Thuis is the only reporting point, that reporting must follow the mandatory meldcode with care for trust, and that the government supports Tilburg's initiative to raise awareness without changing the meldcode.
Apart from Veilig Thuis there are no other organised reporting points for reporting domestic violence.
Naast Veilig Thuis zijn er geen andere georganiseerde meldpunten voor het melden van huiselijk geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Peters over Europese Missie voor 100 klimaat neutrale steden tegen 2030

MPs from the CDA asked how the Dutch government will engage with the EU Cities Mission (100 climate-neutral cities by 2030), including its role in the City Climate Contract, selection criteria and funding. The State Secretary answers that BZK and EZK coordinate the mission, that the government will decide later whether to co-sign contracts, that selection is up to cities, and that about EUR 300 million is reserved at EU level without geographic earmarking.
Whether the national government should play a major role in this and how that could take shape is not yet clear at this moment.
Of de rijksoverheid hierin een grote rol moet spelen en hoe dat vorm zou kunnen krijgen, is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Inge van Dijk over studenten die beleggen met een DUO-lening

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that students borrow student loans to invest, and whether this should be prohibited. The minister disagrees that it is sensible, says the loan is not meant for investing and that a ban is unenforceable, but will improve student information and has asked the Nibud to address it.
It is not prohibited to use the student loan to invest in it.
Het is niet verboden om de studielening te gebruiken om mee te beleggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Peters over het artikel 'Mogelijk honderden kinderen uit gezinnen die de dupe waren van toeslagenaffaire, zijn uit huis geplaatst'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked whether children were taken from home as a result of wrongly imposed childcare-benefit repayments, and what the state is doing to reunite families. The government says it does not yet know how many families are affected, that financial problems alone are no legal ground for removal, and that it is working on a recovery programme and a route via municipalities.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had to deal with an out-of-home placement or reinstatement.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over vragen over het bericht 'Buitenlandse studenten keren massaal terug, maar fysieke colleges volgen is nog uitdaging'

MP Peters (CDA) asks the Minister of Education about the return of non-EU students, the growth in their numbers, the budget implications, efforts to regain control over student flows, and an Inspectorate investigation. The minister answers that application numbers are back at pre-Covid levels, that the withdrawn WTT bill's tools to steer international intake cannot now be pursued, that non-EU students are unfunded so budget impact is nil, and that the EU has been approached but other countries do not share the imbalance.
The controversially declared bill on Language and Accessibility (WTT) contained several proposals to steer the intake of international students.
In het controversieel verklaarde wetsvoorstel Taal en Toegankelijkheid (WTT), stond een aantal voorstellen om te kunnen sturen op de instroom aan internationale studenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over het factsheet voor GGD-medewerkers van test- of vaccinatiestraten, van klantcontactcentra (KCC), van bron- en contactonderzoeken en van vaccinatiesessies t.b.v.

CDA MPs Peters and Van den Berg asked the State Secretary for Health about a GGD factsheet for staff at test, vaccination, contact-centre and contact-tracing sites on recognising and reporting child and domestic abuse, questioning under-reporting, the number of reports, and the burden of reports handled by Veilig Thuis. The State Secretary answered that no figures exist on reports from GGD sites, that the factsheet does not steer staff toward reporting, that Veilig Thuis triages most reports to local support, and that a more transparent child protection system is being developed.
There are no figures known on the number of reports made via GGD test or vaccination sites.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend van het aantal meldingen dat via GGD test- of vaccinatiestraten is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over ventilatie

Two CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers about ventilation in schools and buildings, including past instructions, the SUViS subsidy, the Bouwbesluit compliance, and studies such as the Binnenklimaat label. The minister answered that guidance and webinars were provided, that compliance data is not centrally held, that the SUViS funds were exhausted, and that the RIVM advice has not changed; the research motion on air purifiers is still being scoped.
There is no central picture of how many schools comply with the Bouwbesluit.
Er is dus geen centraal beeld hoeveel scholen voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het ondoorzichtige keuringsysteem van de jeugdbescherming

MP Peters asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the certification system for youth protection, including the Keurmerkinstituut's handling of weak client participation at Jeugdbescherming Limburg, access to audit reports, and oversight of the certifier. The Minister answers that the certifier judged client participation sufficient after measures were taken, that audit reports are shared at the discretion of the certified institution, and that the certifier is supervised by the RvA and the inspectorates, so no new measures are planned.
The KMI supervises the certified institutions and is itself checked by the RvA and the Inspectorates.
Het KMI houdt toezicht op de gecertificeerde instellingen en wordt door de RvA en de Inspecties gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het bericht ‘AIVD: hoger onderwijs is zich totaal niet bewust van digitale dreiging'

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions are sufficiently aware of cyber threats from state actors, after the AIVD said they were not. The minister answered that institutions are aware and taking measures such as SURFsoc monitoring and board-level attention to cyber and knowledge security, while acknowledging that security must be raised further.
I will inform the House again in autumn 2021 about the progress being made on knowledge security.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het najaar van 2021 opnieuw informeren over de voortgang die er op het gebied van kennisveiligheid wordt geboekt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de artikelen ‘Inzet UHR-screening kan jaarlijks 1.800 psychoses voorkomen’ en ‘The Clinical High Risk for Psychosis (CHR-P) Model Is Flawed’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about articles claiming UHR screening could prevent 1,800 psychoses yearly and that the CHR-P model is flawed, asking about its origin, age limits, costs, effects and who decides and pays. The State Secretary answered that the Psychose care standard dates from 2017, explained the age range and cost-saving evidence, and argued that the critical article does not oppose screening within the UHR group, with care reimbursed under the basic insurance where it follows the standard.
The Psychose care standard is not a new care standard.
De zorgstandaard Psychose is geen nieuwe zorgstandaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister dwingt universiteiten tot monsterplan diversiteit, anders geen subsidie'

An MP asks why the minister did not mention the EU requirement for gender equality plans in the 2020 national diversity action plan, and whether the Chamber was incompletely informed, plus details of the requirements and NWO's role. The minister replies that the requirement was flagged in the action plan and later letters, explains the mandatory versus recommended elements, and states NWO's assessment criteria fall within its own autonomy.
I informed your Chamber in September 2020 through the action plan about the European Commission's intention.
Ik heb uw Kamer in september 2020 via het actieplan geïnformeerd over het voornemen van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Lerarentekort alleen maar groter door coronamiljarden’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the corona education billions are worsening teacher shortages, especially in disadvantaged and special schools, and whether schools should rely less on extra staff and more on training and other measures. The Minister acknowledges the shortages, points to the menu of measures and a €375 million teacher allowance for schools with complex pupil populations, but gives no new commitments beyond monitoring the programme and informing parliament.
I monitor the approach to the shortages and the National Education Programme as a whole, and will inform you about this.
Ik monitor de aanpak van de tekorten en het Nationaal Programma breed en zal u hier ook over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Internationaliseer de staf wanneer docenten slecht Engels spreken'

MP Peters asks the Minister of Education whether inconclusive research on Englishtaught higher education affects policy, whether internationalising staff is advisable, and whether this would displace Dutch lecturers. The Minister answers that the NRO study yields recommendations for institutions rather than new research, that her policy is not to stimulate English-taught programmes, and that the study does not recommend hiring international staff as a route in itself.
It is not my policy to encourage more English-taught programmes.
Het is niet mijn beleid om meer Engelstalige opleidingen te stimuleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Peters over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid’

MPs Van Kent and Peters asked whether low-income people should build a financial buffer, what asset norms apply to local tax relief (kwijtschelding), and whether the government will raise the asset threshold to match welfare norms. The minister says no general buffer norm exists, asset norms are set per scheme, local municipalities set their own norms, and raising the kwijtschelding asset threshold is not decided by this caretaker cabinet because of poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, leaving the decision to a next cabinet.
Because of that complexity and its caretaker status, the cabinet leaves the decision on this to a next cabinet.
Vanwege die complexiteit en zijn demissionaire status laat het kabinet de besluitvorming hierover over aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in de jeugdzorg stilgehouden’

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Rechtsbescherming about a 2018 internal exploration 'Incident of patroon?' that allegedly showed systematic errors in youth-care files and was withheld from the ministers and the father in a case. The minister answered that it was an exploration rather than a report, that the claim of hundreds of cases per year is not substantiated, that the ministers were not informed, and that the actionplan on fact-finding is in progress with evaluation in 2022.
I am of the view that the method chosen for this exploration is not the right way to answer a broader systemic question.
Ik ben van mening dat de methode, zoals die in deze verkenning is gekozen, niet de juiste manier is om tot beantwoording van een bredere stelselvraag te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “Ministerie schatte aantal studenten jarenlang verkeerd in”

An MP asked the Education Minister whether a flaw in the ministry's student forecasting model had caused student numbers to be underestimated since 1995, and how this was discovered and what it means for the budget. The minister acknowledged past over- and underestimates, said emigration and mortality were overstated and that the method has been corrected, and explained the budget impact was absorbed as a shortfall but did not send a separate letter, pointing to the April 2021 reference forecast report instead.
Due to exceptional circumstances (corona and the method change), the publication of the Reference Forecast 2021 was brought forward to promote transparency.
Vanwege bijzondere omstandigheden (corona en de methodewijziging) is de publicatie van Referentieraming 2021 vervroegd om transparantie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht van een “veroordeelde stalker, neptherapeut, fraudeur en toch jeugdzorgdirecteur”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that a convicted stalker and fraudster heads a youth care company that bills for care allegedly not delivered, and about how inspectorates, municipalities and insurers failed to detect this. The government answered at length that it cannot comment on individual criminal cases or VOG decisions, described the IGJ's 2018-2020 inspections and signals, the pending Wbsrz data-sharing bill, and the ongoing investigation with further inspection visits.
Due to the confidentiality of the information and the privacy of the person concerned, no statements can be made about individual criminal cases.
Omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkene kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de casus van een deurwaarder die loonbeslag legt in relatie tot de geest en strekking van een door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen motie

An MP asked the ministers whether a bailiff's wage garnishment over a 13-year-old 83-euro debt, despite over 800 euro already paid, conflicts with a parliamentary motion calling for improvements to responsible debt collection, and whether concrete measures would follow. The government called the case distressing, explained that interest and costs under the Civil Code can make small debts grow, said themes sessions with stakeholders are underway with papers to be sent to parliament after the summer recess, and referred to existing legislation without committing to new measures now.
Answer 3, 4: The aim of the broad debt approach is to prevent people with (problematic) debts from getting further into trouble when facing collection by public and private creditors.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 3, 4 Inzet van de brede schuldenaanpak is het voorkomen dat mensen met (problematische) schulden verder in de problemen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de hoge werkdruk van jeugdbeschermers

An MP from the CDA asked the government about reports of high workloads, staff turnover and waiting lists among youth protection workers, and about the risks of market mechanisms revealed by the Intervence and Briedis cases. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to multiple causes, and listed legislative and short-term measures while promising a report on the financial position of providers this autumn.
I endorse the importance of sufficient financial resilience.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van voldoende weerstandsvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Goede relatie met China belangrijker voor Universiteit Groningen dan academische vrijheid’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Hong Kong students at the University of Groningen feel unsafe due to the Confucius Institute and worry about academic freedom, the government's role in knowledge security, the status of knowledge-security guidelines and dialogues, and the Hogeschool Zuyd contract with a Confucius Institute. The Minister says institutions must guarantee academic freedom, sets out the knowledge-security measures and timelines, and recommends that institutions decouple from the Confucius Institutes.
I therefore consider it sensible that the institutions concerned reconsider this embedding.
Ik vind het dan ook verstandig dat de betrokken instellingen deze inbedding heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Onveilige sfeer op modeschool AMFI: "Een docent vergeleek mijn Arabische model met een seriemoordenaar".

MP Peters asked the Minister of Education about reports of an unsafe climate at the AMFI fashion school, including a teacher comparing a student's model to a serial killer, and whether accreditation (NVAO) and the Inspectorate could act. The minister said the accreditation framework leaves social safety largely to the institution, that the Inspectorate is awaiting the institution's external investigation and is starting a thematic study on social safety in arts education, and that the arts sector and Raad voor Cultuur are being asked to act.
The inspectorate has informed me that it is awaiting the results of the external investigation that the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences is having carried out.
De inspectie heeft mij geïnformeerd dat zij de resultaten van het externe onderzoek dat de Hogeschool van Amsterdam laat uitvoeren afwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat ruim 10.000 ontvangers van bijstand de dupe zijn geworden van een fout bij gemeenten

An MP asked the minister about reports that over 10,000 social assistance recipients were wrongly subjected to garnishment above the legal protected minimum because municipalities reported holiday allowance irregularly to the UWV payroll database. The minister confirmed the error, estimated 10,000 to 15,000 affected garnishments, said municipalities now set the protected amount manually to 95% of income while an automated fix is developed, and described bailiffs being asked to contact affected people and refund excess amounts.
Municipalities that do not report holiday allowance monthly to the Polisadministratie temporarily raise the protected amount manually to 95% of income.
Gemeenten die de vakantietoeslag niet maandelijks doorgeven aan de Polisadministratie verhogen de beslagvrije voet voorlopig handmatig tot 95% van het inkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het artikel 'Afgewezen zorgaanbieders glippen weer binnen via de achterdeur'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a news report that care providers rejected by municipalities and prosecution services return via the Wlz or PGB route, and about fraud-related data-sharing limits. The Minister answered that existing tools suffice in principle, that a bill on data-sharing against care fraud is pending and controversial, that Wlz indications are set independently by the CIZ, and that data-sharing grounds in the Wlz may need amendment.
There is no registration system for care providers that no longer receive a contract from a municipality and subsequently seek to place clients under the Wlz.
Er is geen registratiesysteem voor zorgaanbieders die geen contract (meer) krijgen bij een gemeente en vervolgens cliënten onder willen brengen bij de Wlz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de korte tijd die scholen krijgen om de coronamiljarden uit te geven

An MP asked the minister whether the 2.5-year window for schools to spend the corona billions is too short, whether schools are being pushed toward commercial providers, and whether the programme will be structurally effective. The minister answered that the timeframe was agreed with parliament, pointed to an intervention menu, support helpdesk and monitoring, said schools keep control over planning, and promised a survey of schools in early next school year.
I will inform your House about the outcomes in the autumn.
Over de uitkomsten informeer ik uw Kamer in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over "studenten met een beperking die nog steeds te weinig studietoeslag krijgen"

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the individual student allowance (IST) for students with disabilities, noting only eleven of the 25 largest municipalities pay the promised 300 euro and few students know of it. The minister said the allowance is municipal responsibility, pointed to a pending bill (Breed Offensief) to harmonise the amount, committed to talks with student organisations and a reminder to municipalities to pay 300 euro from age 21.
The implementation and setting of the amount of the IST is the competence and responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
De uitvoering en het bepalen van de hoogte van de IST is de bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters vragen om compensatie, want ook broeders bijten in coronatijd op houtje'

MPs asked whether monasteries whose income from abbey shops and guesthouses fell due to COVID-19 can access compensation, and whether they should be treated like shops and hospitality businesses. The government answered that these organisations can use the generic COVID schemes (NOW, Tozo, TVL) if they meet the conditions, and it does not plan additional measures specifically for them.
The cabinet is not currently planning to introduce additional support measures specifically for this group, beyond the existing generic support measures.
Het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om, naast de bestaande diverse generieke steunmaatregelen, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen specifiek voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Enquête: Extra lerarengeld is niet op de juiste plek beland’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the extra 150 million euro for secondary education had been spent with teachers and works councils involved, and whether the minister would monitor this and address commercial outsourcing of learning support. The minister answered that the 2020 annual reports will show spending and teacher involvement, a tussenevaluatie found most works councils were involved, and he will discuss the findings with the sector council and use the annual reports, while declining a larger role for the Inspectorate.
I see no reason to give the Inspectorate of Education a larger role in monitoring the involvement of works councils in the use of funds.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de Inspectie van het Onderwijs een grotere rol te geven bij het monitoren van de betrokkenheid van medezeggenschapsraden bij de inzet van middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat de jeugd-ggz een lucratieve markt blijkt te zijn voor durfinvesteerders

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health how he responds to private equity investors treating youth mental health care as a lucrative market, whether he can list such institutions, and what financial incentives leave complex cases unserved. The State Secretary answers that no exhaustive overview of owners exists, estimates five to seven investment firms invest in two to four youth care providers, points to the Wibz bill on profit distribution limits, the youth care availability bill and regional cooperation, and says cost-based reasonable pricing will be set by AMvB.
No; I do not have an exhaustive overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Nee; ik heb geen uitputtend overzicht van de eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de Subsidieregeling Schoolkracht

MP Peters (CDA) asked the minister about school applications for the Schoolkracht subsidy that were fully pre-filled by commercial firms E-WISE and Faqta, and about lessons for the national education recovery programme. The minister answered that about 70 E-WISE applications were estimated, that Faqta only assisted, that a lottery selected applicants, and that the government will monitor outsourcing and is preparing a tender and extra support.
Submitting company-completed subsidy applications without substantive involvement of the school itself is, however, an undesirable development.
Het indienen van door bedrijven ingevulde subsidieaanvragen zonder inhoudelijke betrokkenheid van de eigen school, is echter wel een onwenselijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over paardencoachbedrijven als nieuwe melkkoe van de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rapid growth in revenue of horse-coaching and care-farm organisations funded through youth care, the lack of evidence for their effectiveness, executive pay, cost-reporting rules and municipal steering options. The State Secretary confirmed the revenue growth, explained it by decentralisation and demand, noted that municipalities and inspectorates have instruments to steer and supervise, and pointed to a forthcoming quality framework and planned bill provisions on transparent business operations.
Municipalities must ensure they make good use of their instruments.
Gemeenten moeten zorgen dat zij goed gebruik maken van hun instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Terpstra over het uit zijn huurhuis zetten van een bejaarde man door sociale woningcorporatie Stek in Lisse

MPs Peters and Terpstra asked whether housing corporation Stek should refrain from evicting a 76-year-old man from his social rental home in Lisse, given the COVID-19 agreement not to evict tenants, and what instruments the government has to enforce it. The minister replied that the case falls outside the agreement because the eviction rests on persistent nuisance rather than rent arrears, that an alternative temporary housing solution has been found, and that the eviction was postponed to 5 April.
The specific situation you ask me about falls outside the scope of the agreements in the statement.
De specifieke situatie waar u mij over bevraagt, valt daarmee buiten de reikwijdte van de afspraken in het statement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht 'vertraging ggz-indicaties in de Wlz door hoge aantal aanvragen'

MPs Slootweg and Peters asked why GGZ Wlz indication requests far exceeded the expected 9,500, how long applicants will wait, what the dedicated CIZ team and transitional arrangements involve, and what the shift means for Wmo funding and care hours. The state secretary answered that the initial estimate was too low because ambulant clients and providers were initially hesitant, that over 16,000 clients are expected to receive Wlz GGZ indications, that a noodplan with extra staff is in place, that Wmo decisions were extended to 1 July 2021, and that the Wmo-to-Wlz transfer will be recalculated budget-neutrally for municipalities.
At the end of 2020 I made agreements with the CIZ on an emergency plan containing various measures to clear the backlog of applications as quickly and carefully as possible.
Eind 2020 heb ik met het CIZ afspraken gemaakt over een noodplan, waarin verschillende maatregelen zijn opgenomen om het stuwmeer aan aanvragen zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over hulp aan onverzekerden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether damage suffered by a bystander who gave emergency aid to an uninsured homeless person can be recovered, and whether a guarantee fund for civilian first responders should be explored. The state secretary answered that volunteers are generally covered by municipal insurance and other avenues exist, so no guarantee fund is needed.
For civilian first responders who have registered as volunteers, such as the 225,000 civilian first responders registered through the HartslagNu alert system, a guarantee fund is not necessary.
Voor burgerhulpverleners die zich hebben aangemeld als vrijwilliger, zoals de 225.000 burgerhulpverleners die zich hebben aangemeld via het oproepsysteem HartslagNu, is een waarborgfonds niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van donderdagavond 10 december 2020 'Sterke stijging anorexiapatiënten tijdens coronacrisis'

CDA MPs asked the government about a Nieuwsuur report on a sharp rise in anorexia patients during the coronavirus crisis, rising waiting lists for complex psychiatric care, bed shortages for anorexia treatment, interim care, regional high-complexity care tables, and the Court of Audit's view that long waits worsen conditions. The State Secretary acknowledged the mental health impact, described measures such as a consultation line, transparency rules and an evaluation of high-complexity care, but gave averages rather than specific anorexia waiting-list figures and did not provide case counts.
I will send you this evaluation.
Ik zal u deze evaluatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over kinderen die onterecht uit huis worden geplaatst door slecht feitenonderzoek

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether children are wrongly removed from their homes due to poor fact-finding by youth care workers and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and what measures will prevent this. The minister replied that the statutory duty to report facts fully and truthfully applies, that an Action Plan to improve fact-finding is under way through 2021, and that existing checks (RvdK independence, judicial review, appeal) are sufficient, so no new measures are needed.
Based on the above, I am of the view that the current system already contains sufficient safeguards to address the problem you describe.
Op basis van het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat het huidige systeem reeds voldoende waarborgen bevat om het door u geschetste probleem te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over "BKR registratie bij de start van schuldhulpverlening"

An MP asked whether the Besluit gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening requires BKR registration for debt assistance from the start, and whether this deters people from seeking help and conflicts with the Wgs.
