The minister answered that registration of all debt assistance is intended to support cooperation with creditors, that it is not meant to deter applicants, and that the rule is mandatory for all municipalities, promising only to monitor implementation and clarify the Wgs.
The intention is not that the college can deviate.
De bedoeling is niet dat het college kan afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Peters en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes'

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about press reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines, and about its appeal practice, matching of fines, and remedies for affected employers. The minister denied systematic misinformation, said appeals are decided case by case, and committed to a review of the graduated approach to minor workplace accidents.
No, there is no automatic or maximal pursuit of appeals. It is always a case-by-case weighing.
Nee, er wordt niet automatisch of zoveel mogelijk doorgeprocedeerd. Het betreft steeds een weging per geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Slootweg en Omtzigt over de terugvordering van bijstand

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a benefit recipient was ordered to repay about 7,000 euro for donated food and the hardship of recovery rules, the discretion of municipalities, and the treatment of food-bank parcels. The State Secretary acknowledged concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, pointed to municipal discretion and hardship exceptions, announced working groups and a review of harsh rules, but declined to judge individual cases and promised results in the second quarter of 2021.
From my systemic responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge individual cases.
Vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid past het niet dat ik oordeel over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Peters over het nodeloos procederen van overheidsinstanties

MPs Van Dam and Peters asked the Minister for Legal Protection about unnecessary litigation by government agencies, notably UWV's pattern of filing provisional appeals and withdrawing them, leaving citizens unable to recover legal costs in administrative law. The minister acknowledged the problem, said UWV will discuss compensation with the affected party and that the ministry will examine whether legislative change is needed, but did not commit to creating a statutory basis for cost compensation now.
It is my intention to examine how this problem can be addressed and whether changes to laws and regulations are necessary for this.
Het is mijn voornemen te onderzoeken hoe deze problematiek kan worden ondervangen en of wijziging van wet- en regelgeving hiervoor noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Scouting en jeugd- en jongerenwerk bestolen'

MPs Peters and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether 7.3 million euros earmarked for youth organisations and playgrounds during COVID-19 is being spent as intended, after reports that municipalities were not using it for that purpose. The state secretary confirmed the funds were made available, said the signals had not reached him before, and will raise the issue with the VNG and report back to the House.
If it turns out that the funds are indeed not yet being used for the intended purpose, it is good that the VNG again brings this to the attention of municipalities.
Als blijkt dat de middelen inderdaad nog niet ingezet worden voor het beoogde doel, is het goed dat de VNG dit nogmaals onder de aandacht brengt van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het rapport van de ombudsman 'Blijvende zorg'

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister how the Ombudsman's report 'Blijvende zorg' on people with complex, long-term care needs should be addressed, including the size of the affected group, the role of the Juiste Loket, client support and who is accountable when care is organised across domains. The minister acknowledged the problems, listed ongoing access-improvement projects and client-support pilots, gave figures on Wlz and Wmo recipients, and committed to further monitoring and a forthcoming bill on Wlz client support.
There is no national registration of the number of people who actually use these provisions.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal mensen dat daadwerkelijk een beroep doet op deze voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over kostenoverschrijdingen in de jeugdzorg door wagenwijd openstaande deuren bij gemeenten

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about youth care cost overruns caused by gemeenten (municipalities) opening youth care access too broadly, and whether municipalities should limit youth care scope, contract fewer providers, and receive more funds. The State Secretary largely answers that the Youth Act leaves municipalities room to make choices, announces investigations and a spring 2021 study on municipal approaches, and says extra funds will be weighed in the coming cabinet formation.
Following a commitment by the Minister of VWS, I have commissioned research into the approach of municipalities that indicate they have (more) grip on their youth care.
Naar aanleiding van een toezegging van de Minister van VWS heb ik onderzoek uitgezet naar de aanpak van gemeenten die aangeven (meer) grip op hun jeugdhulp te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Nico viel 5 meter bij hijswerk, ongeluk was wake-upcall voor bedrijf'

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about a news report on a workplace fall and whether the Inspectorate's new national approach to minor workplace accidents, which lets firms draft their own improvement plans instead of facing fines, should extend to serious accidents. The state secretary defended the pilot approach, said it will stay limited to minor injuries for now, and promised to inform parliament after a year of experience.
I will inform your House about that in more detail.
Ik zal uw Kamer daarover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het aanpassen van de kostendelersnorm om dakloosheid te voorkomen

MPs Peters and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the government will amend the kostendelersnorm (co-tenant rule in the Participation Act) to prevent youth homelessness, citing Divosa's advice and the delayed research results. The State Secretary says the cabinet response and research are sent with the answers, agrees that temporary non-application of the norm for vulnerable young adults is sensible, and points to a broader exploration of alternatives.
Precisely for vulnerable young adults, the municipality can apply tailored measures by temporarily not applying the co-tenant rule, provided the stay is temporary until a permanent solution is found.

Juist voor kwetsbare jongvolwassenen kan de gemeente maatwerk toepassen door de kostendelersnorm tijdelijk niet toe te passen mits het gaat om tijdelijk verblijf tot een permanente oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Geen enkele huisarts wil in huis genomen moeder als patiënt.’

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about a Radar report in which no GP would register a mother, living with her daughter after leaving a care institution with a Wlz indication, as a patient, and about who is responsible for her medical care. The minister says GPs must serve Wlz patients, that the insurer should help when problems arise, that a sector covenant and a pending NZa advisory report will address the issue, but that the responsibility is shared and no concrete timed measures are given yet.
Everyone in the Netherlands must, when needed, be able to access general medical care 24 hours a day.
Iedereen in Nederland moet, als dat nodig is, 24 uur per dag terecht kunnen voor medisch-generalistische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over tekorten bij sociale werkvoorzieningen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about deficits at sheltered workplaces (SW-bedrijven) such as Ergon and Wedeka, whether SW companies are financially failing nationwide, and what measures will prevent closures. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual companies, pointed to municipalities' responsibility and the Thermometer Wsw showing a peak deficit in 2020 expected to improve from 2025, and noted the temporary coronavirus compensation of 140 million euro.
I do not deal with the functioning and operation of individual social development companies.
Ik ga niet over het functioneren en de exploitatie van individuele sociale ontwikkelbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Helvert over het bericht 'emoties lopen hoog op bij huisuitzetting: meerdere politiepatrouilles rukken uit'

MPs Peters and Van Helvert asked about a reported eviction in Geleen over rent arrears, in which several police patrols were deployed, and whether evictions for debt could be prevented. The government confirmed the case, declined to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons, and described measures such as early warning of rent arrears, the amended Municipal Debt Assistance Act from 1 January 2021, and the plan 'Een (t)huis, een toekomst' to prevent evictions.
To protect the privacy of those involved, I cannot go into individual cases.
Om de privacy van de betrokkenen te beschermen, kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over gebrekkige transparantie bij particuliere woonzorgbedrijven

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about weak transparency at private care-home operators, including the reported 7% return on dementia housing, foreign ownership, staffing norms, and split of rent and service costs. The minister said the Wlz profit ban does not cover this housing, promised a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution, and said staffing norms and oversight by the IGJ and care offices apply, while many details were left to providers and care offices.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider operations, in which I want to introduce the option of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution for sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Peters, Bergkamp en Diertens over het belang van ventilatie tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the health minister how seriously the government takes airborne transmission of COVID-19 and ventilation, and whether guidance and enforcement of building ventilation rules are adequate. The minister said the RIVM sees insufficient evidence for additional ventilation measures, pointed to existing guidance and to municipalities and building owners for enforcement, and noted that information has been published.
It is uncertain whether a specific ventilation (threshold) as an additional measure actually contributes to preventing or reducing SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
Het is onzeker of een bepaalde ventilatie(drempel) als aanvullende maatregel een daadwerkelijk bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen of verminderen van SARS-CoV-2-transmissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemer betaalde zichzelf tonnen uit terwijl zijn bedrijven in zwaar weer verkeerden’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why the inspectorate tolerated Olcea's poor care for years, whether municipalities and insurers were informed, and how a founder could restart a business after bankruptcy. The minister answered in detail on inspection history, the curator's handling of the sale, contract termination, and planned tightening of entry rules, while stating that some questions fall under other responsibilities or cannot be answered for individual cases.
The Tax Authority itself cannot address individual cases because of its fiscal confidentiality obligation.
De Belastingdienst kan zelf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht ‘Aanpassing Arbobesluit 7.23d werkbakken leidt tot meer ongevallen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether the amended Arbobesluit 7.23d allowing work baskets on crane hooks for personnel transport increases risks, citing TNO and RIVM findings and claimed costs of over 42 million euro per year. The State Secretary defended the amendment as a narrowly conditioned extension that remains exceptional, disputed the cost figure and said the RIVM study did not assess relative risks of work methods.

With the proposed amendment of Article 7.23d of the Arbobesluit, the possibility has been created to use equipment not designed and set up for transporting persons when no suitable equipment or work methods exist to reach the locations safely.

Met de voorgenomen wijziging van artikel 7.23d van het Arbobesluit is de mogelijkheid gecreëerd om een arbeidsmiddel, dat niet bestemd en ingericht is voor het vervoer van personen, in te zetten als er geen geëigende arbeidsmiddelen en/of werkmethodes zijn om de plaatsen veilig te kunnen bereiken.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peters, Van der Molen en Slootweg over de uitgestelde invoering van het nieuwe woonplaatsbeginsel

Three CDA MPs asked why the new woonplaatsbeginsel (residence principle for youth care funding) was postponed and whether municipalities such as Goirle are financially harmed. The minister answered that the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ care is extended by a year and raised to 30 million euros, and that postponement to 2022 was chosen to ensure careful implementation given the COVID-19 workload on municipalities.
Now that the introduction of the youth residence principle has been postponed by one year, the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ is extended by one year.
Nu de invoering van het woonplaatsbeginsel jeugd met een jaar is uitgesteld, wordt de compensatieregeling voogdij en 18+ met een jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Peters over het bericht 'Samenwerking bij verwijderen asbest loopt vast, 'overheid moet ingrijpen''

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a critical report on the asbestos certification system (Ascert, innovation, possible independent authority, risk classes, schemes) and the government answered each question, rejecting an independent regulator for now, pointing to its reform measures and new innovation body VIP, and declining to answer one question because it belongs to another ministry. The answers commit to several concrete steps such as a convenant with Ascert and an upcoming scheme update, while largely restating existing policy.
An independent authority on top of the existing ones is not on the agenda.
Een onafhankelijke autoriteit bovenop de reeds bestaande, is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het verdiepend onderzoek naar ‘inzicht in besteding jeugdhulpmiddelen’

MP Peters (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about industry objections to the representativeness and depth of the study on spending of youth care funds, the follow-up research, data limits and cost drivers. The Minister answered that the study was never meant to be representative, that the follow-up will be representative and involve the sector, and that cost growth and data issues are being addressed, but largely deferred methodological choices to research bureaus.
It was left to the research bureaus that submitted a tender to decide which data they wish to use.
Het is aan de onderzoeksbureaus die een offerte hebben ingediend overgelaten van welke data zij gebruik willen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat Ritalin zonder goede diagnostiek worden voorgeschreven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about research showing Ritalin is prescribed to children without proper diagnosis, and whether guidelines are followed and why prescriptions have fallen since 2015. The minister acknowledged that diagnostics must be careful, noted the increase was fourfold rather than tenfold, and said the 2019 ADHD care standard aims to prevent over- and under-diagnosis.
Careful diagnosis is the basis of adequate medical practice when prescribing medicines.
Zorgvuldige diagnostiek is bij het voorschrijven van medicijnen de grondslag van adequaat medisch handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Nispen over het bericht dat verenigingen voor jeugd- en jongerenwerk in de problemen komen door de coronacrisis

MPs Von Martels, Peters and Van Nispen asked the health minister about youth and scouting associations and playground foundations facing financial trouble due to the COVID-19 crisis, and whether they are excluded from support. The minister replied that some such organisations may qualify for national support schemes, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that the full effects are not yet known.

The municipality is the first responsible government for these associations, and if the situation for scouting or youth work lasts long, these associations will have to look with the municipality at what options exist to keep these facilities from being endangered.

De gemeente is de eerstverantwoordelijke overheid voor deze verenigingen en mocht de situatie voor de scouting of jeugdwerk langdurig voortduren dan zullen deze verenigingen dan ook met de gemeente moeten kijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over een dakloos gezin dat zich niet kan inschrijven bij gemeenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a homeless family reportedly refused registration by several municipalities, and whether the government will enforce the duty to register people without a fixed address. The State Secretary confirmed municipalities have a legal duty to register under the BRP Act, said he was unaware of the specific case, announced a legislative clarification, and offered to look into the situation if the family contacts the RVIG.
Yes, municipalities have the duty to register under the BRP Act.
Ja, gemeenten hebben de plicht tot inschrijving conform de Wet BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Undercover bij Wehkamp’

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act against Wehkamp's instalment-credit practices, including a 14% interest rate, lenient collection and a business model that resembles lending. The minister answered that the maximum credit fee will be temporarily cut to 10%, an external study on a structural cut is under way, and further measures will be assessed at the end of the year, while citing limited data on the direct effect of mail-order credit on debt problems.
To better protect consumers against the high costs of credit in this difficult period, I am temporarily lowering the maximum credit fee from 14 percent to 10 percent.
Om consumenten in deze lastige periode beter te beschermen tegen de hoge kosten van krediet, verlaag ik tijdelijk de maximale kredietvergoeding van 14 procent naar 10 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘MBO Raad waarschuwt: nieuwkomers moeten snelle toegang houden tot mbo’.

MPs Kuik and Peters asked ministers about the COVID-19 impact on language courses and MBO access for newcomers, and whether the government would act. Minister Koolmees answered that remote learning rules were relaxed, the integration deadline extended, MBO schools may admit students without full entry requirements, and no separate budget is planned for now, while monitoring the situation.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and the effects of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de situatie en de uitwerking van de genomen maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over een convenant voor gemeenten en (jeugd)zorgaanbieders om de continuïteit van (jeugd)zorg aan te bieden in tijden van de coronacrisis

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a model agreement between municipalities and youth and care providers to keep care going during the coronavirus crisis, and whether municipalities should guarantee advance payments. The minister confirmed the model was read, said the Rijk and VNG urged municipalities to give financial security until at least 1 June 2020, and said a later April agreement on continued funding superseded the model.
The model agreement dates from March and in its current form is therefore no longer suitable to submit to municipalities.
Het modelconvenant dateert uit maart en is in haar huidige vorm zodoende niet meer geschikt om voor te leggen aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen die niet meer terug kunnen naar de eigen ouders

MP Peters (CDA) asked the ministers whether children placed out of home after parents were evicted for debt or lack of housing could be returned, and what the government does to prevent evictions and support housing. The government answered that no general six-month housing requirement exists, that it is working on early warning and debt-support measures, and that it does not accept a housing guarantee for parents whose children are placed under court order.
There are no figures available on how often this occurs.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over stelende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked the government about trustees (bewindvoerders) who embezzled clients' money in Limburg, including why intervention was slow, prosecution capacity, complaint handling, and whether a blacklist or regional lists should be created. The minister answered that courts dismissed the trustees, criminal proceedings are pending with the OM, quality requirements since 2014 are monitored by the judiciary, and that no blacklist is planned, while complaint routes and a white list are described.
The OM does not have this data because it is not registered by occupational group or profession of the suspect.
Het OM beschikt niet over deze gegevens omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op beroepsgroep of beroep van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Peters, Paternotte en Segers over het zo snel mogelijk invoeren van de inburgeringsplicht van Turkse asielstatushouders

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkish asylum status holders can be made subject to civic integration duties from 1 May 2020 before the new law takes effect, and how COVID-19 measures apply to civic integration. The minister confirmed the duty will apply from 1 May 2020, the opt-in scheme will lapse for new holders, and the civic integration deadline is extended by two months for everyone due to the crisis.
Yes, I will act on this from 1 May 2020.
Ja, ik zal hier per 1 mei 2020 gevolg aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Peters over de kritiek van de toezichthouder op de marktwerking voor deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Peters asked the minister whether the regulator's criticism of market competition among bailiffs (deurwaarders) should change policy and whether a new study is needed. The minister acknowledged the regulator's concerns, kept the market model, and promised a one-off tariff adjustment and a ban on price agreements that endanger bailiff independence, while rejecting a new study.
I also want to, following the Regulation on limits to tariff models for bailiffs, prohibit price agreements between the bailiff and the client that endanger the bailiff's independent position.

Ook wil ik – in navolging van de Verordening Grenzen tariefmodellen gerechtsdeurwaarders 3 – prijsafspraken tussen de gerechtsdeurwaarder en opdrachtgever verbieden die de onafhankelijke positie van de gerechtsdeurwaarder in gevaar brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Peters over het bericht dat het extraatje i.v.m. een 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege de Wajong-uitkering

MPs Palland and Peters (CDA) asked how Wajong recipients can keep extra payments above their monthly income, such as a 12.5-year service jubilee bonus, and why a manual reporting process or an exemption from the wage definition was not feasible. The State Secretary replied that Wajongers keep at least 30 percent of extras under the proposed harmonised rule and fully keep one-off payments under the guarantee scheme, but that UWV lacks reliable data on extras and a manual process carries fraud and enforcement risks.
To deviate for the Wajong by exempting extras above the monthly income, UWV must be able to rely on reliable data on the actual amount of these extras.
Om voor de Wajong af te wijken door extra's boven het maandinkomen vrij te stellen, moet UWV kunnen beschikken over betrouwbare gegevens over de feitelijke hoogte van deze extra's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

CDA MPs asked why youth care provider Pluryn is closing De Hoenderloo Groep, how the roughly 200 youths and 500 staff will be placed elsewhere, and what the financing of special education for the Gelderse Vallei consortium implies. The minister answers that Pluryn has announced the closure citing quality, finances and regional care, that a one-year phase-out plan with individual placements is in preparation under IGJ and education inspectorate supervision, and that funding changes and a planned AMvB on realistic youth care prices are being pursued, while the education funding issue has been corrected by a recovery action.
The IGJ is already involved and will assess this plan and actively supervise the care transfer of the youths currently staying at De Hoenderloo Groep.
De IGJ is reeds betrokken en zal dit plan beoordelen en actief toezien op de zorgvuldigheid van de zorgoverdracht van de jeugdigen die nu bij De Hoenderloo Groep verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over de sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep youth care institution, including inspection signals, staff complaints, Pluryn's finances and governance, and tariffs. The minister answered that the inspectorate had found shortcomings and reviewed an improvement plan, declined to comment on the relationship between the board and supervisory bodies in a specific organisation, and gave financial figures from Pluryn's accountability document.
From my position, I consider it not desirable to intervene in the relationships between the board, supervision and employee participation within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het bericht dat extraatje vanwege 12,5 jarig jubileum moet worden ingeleverd vanwege Wajonguitkering

MPs Peters and Palland (CDA) asked why a Wajong beneficiary's anniversary bonus of a 12.5-year service is deducted from his benefit and whether this can be changed. The State Secretary answered that such bonuses count as wage for tax purposes and UWV must offset them; exempting them would need a change to the wage tax act, which the cabinet considers disproportionate, and within current rules full exemption is not possible, though beneficiaries keep at least 30 percent and those on the guarantee benefit can keep one-off payments in full.
Within the current legal framework it is not possible to fully exempt extras above monthly income such as bonuses and gratuities.
Binnen het huidige wettelijke kader is het niet mogelijk om extra's boven het maandinkomen zoals bonussen en gratificaties volledig vrij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over de financiële toestand van GGZ-instelling Dokter Bosman

MPs Peters and Van den Berg (CDA) asked Minister De Jonge about the financial troubles of GGZ provider Dokter Bosman, including an investor demanding municipal debt write-offs, alleged over-declaration, unfiled accounts, Tax Office claims, and continuity of youth care. The minister answered that profit-taking has no place in care and rules on dividends are being examined, but he lacked insight into the firm's finances, municipalities decide for themselves, the accounts were later filed, and supervisors and the Youth Authority are involved, with the matter now resolved by a takeover.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht, ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet rijksbelastingen, kan niet worden ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het ontbreken van data van arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden in de kandidatenverkenner van het UWV

Two CDA MPs asked why the UWV candidate browser for people with work limitations is not working due to missing data, and why so few such people were helped into work despite IT investment. The minister and state secretary replied that complete profiles are a long-standing challenge, that about 8% of profiles are available for work, that many profiles are incomplete, and that additional measures such as Perspectief op Werk and regional agreements are being taken.

Question 4: Is it true that the makers of the candidate browser system already knew that many necessary data were missing and reported this to the UWV top in 2016, but that nothing was done with this notice?

Vraag 4 Is het juist dat bij de makers van het systeem van de kandidatenverkenner al bekend was dat veel noodzakelijke gegevens ontbreken en dat zij dit in 2016 ook hebben gemeld bij de UWV-top, maar dat met deze mededeling niets is gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over de toename van bedrijfsongevallen door risicovol werk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about a reported rise in workplace accidents in risky jobs, including whether unreported accidents are common, enforcement and reporting efforts, and whether work pressure is a factor. The State Secretary acknowledged under-reporting by employers, announced an Inspectorate study and capacity expansion, listed fines for late reporting, and described ongoing programmes on safety culture and psychosocial workload.
It is known that there are employers who do not comply with the obligation to report work accidents immediately ("under-reporting").
Het is bekend dat er werkgevers zijn die zich niet houden aan de verplichting om arbeidsongevallen direct te melden («de ondermelding»).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Peters over het eindvonnis in zaaknummer UTR 18/3505

Two MPs asked the minister about a court ruling in case UTR 18/3505, where a Turkish refugee challenged being denied a loan available to other refugees for integration courses, and whether the EU-Turkey association law applies to refugees. The minister agreed that Turkish newcomers should integrate quickly and learn Dutch, and concluded that the integration obligation should have applied to Turkish asylum status holders from 2011, referring to a separate letter to parliament.
Based on the current situation, I conclude that the integration obligation should already have applied from 2011 to Turkish asylum status holders.
Op basis van de huidige situatie kom ik nu tot de conclusie dat de inburgeringsplicht reeds vanaf 2011 had moeten gelden voor Turkse asielstatushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het percentage coördinatiekosten van het totale jeugdzorgbudget

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reported claims that around 30% of the youth care budget goes to coordination costs, and about the realism of such percentages, gemeente contract harmonisation, regional cooperation, procurement guidance and removal of avoidable rules. The Minister said the figures are not comparable due to differing definitions, cited a 5% municipal implementation cost benchmark, and described ongoing harmonisation, a deep-dive study, and rule-scrapping sessions.
It is not known which municipal cooperation arrangements have broken up in the last two years.
Het is niet bekend welke samenwerkingsverbanden de laatste twee jaar uit elkaar zijn gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Rog over de geplande opschaling van Respect Education Foundation

MPs Peters and Rog asked the government about the planned scaling-up of the Respect Education Foundation and what it had done on the earlier motion to support the RespectPact. The minister answered that the departments saw no financial room, that the foundation has not yet sent a proposal for immaterial support, and that the cabinet is willing to offer immaterial support once that proposal arrives.
The cabinet is willing to provide immaterial support for the REF's work, but is awaiting a proposal from the REF.
Het kabinet is bereid tot immateriële ondersteuning van het werk van het REF, maar is in afwachting van een voorstel van het REF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Peters en Van den Berg over het gebruik van melatonine als slaapmiddel

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about calls by about 500 scientists to make melatonin prescription-only, its sale and youth use, the rules under which it is sold, and whether labelling and enforcement are adequate. The Minister answered that melatonin products of 0.3 mg or more are treated as medicines by the IGJ, that jet-lag products sold without prescription are not approved for children, that enforcement is being intensified, but that he does not support making all melatonin prescription-only.
From September the IGJ is intensifying enforcement against unregistered medicines containing melatonin, based on a previously drawn-up enforcement plan that has recently been completed.
De IGJ intensiveert vanaf september de handhaving van niet-geregistreerde geneesmiddelen met melatonine, op basis van een eerder opgesteld handhavingsplan dat recent is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Tielen over het bericht 'Salafistische jongerenwerkers actief in Den Haag'

MPs Peters and Tielen asked the ministers about reports that Salafist youth workers operate in The Hague, including one worker who stopped after police warnings, and whether radical influence on youth is widespread. The government confirmed the case was handled locally with the employer ending the worker's contract, said no grounds exist for a wider inventory or new measures on leaked information, and pointed to existing prevention and partnership efforts.
We are not aware of any signals that would require such an inventory.
Er zijn ons geen signalen bekend die een dergelijke inventarisatie nodig zouden maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht dat zorgcowboys binnen twee jaar miljonair worden in de thuiszorg

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about reports that home-care providers are making very high profits, including the Karmel/De Kroon and Faveo/Emmen cases, and about supervision of such profits. The minister said very high margins are unacceptable, pointed to municipal contract oversight and new measures, and acknowledged past unlawful dividend payments while withholding a full overview of sector profits.
I do not have a complete picture of this, but I want to emphasise that achieving very high profit margins is socially unacceptable.
Ik heb hier geen integraal beeld van, maar wil benadrukken dat ik het behalen van zeer hoge winstmarges maatschappelijk onacceptabel vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de dyslexieindustrie

MP Peters (CDA) asked the Health Minister whether dyslexia care providers have become commercial and taken over by investment funds, whether the gatekeeper for dyslexia referrals is independent of commercial providers, and whether quality control and scientific advice are in the hands of commercial actors. The minister answered that data on providers and acquisitions is lacking, announced a study into EED spending and municipal steering, and said a gatekeeper should be independent and an independence guarantee will be examined, but declined for now to make an independent gatekeeper mandatory.
No figures are available on the total number of dyslexia providers or on takeovers of dyslexia providers by (foreign) investment funds.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totaal aantal dyslexieaanbieders of over overnames van dyslexieaanbieders door (buitenlandse) investeringsfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de afbouw en overdracht van de zorg bij jeugdzorginstelling Juzt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about financial and organisational problems at youth care provider Juzt and other providers, how gemeenten and the state proactively respond, and asked for an investigation into Juzt's causes. The minister said continuity of care is leading, the Jeugdautoriteit and early warning instruments are being developed, and he sees no added value in a cause investigation beyond what is already known.
At present I see no added value in an investigation into the causes compared with what is already known.
Momenteel zie ik geen meerwaarde in een onderzoek naar de oorzaken ten opzichte van hetgeen nu al bekend is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Peters over ‘meer dan 100.000 ouders die de komende maanden meer dan 1.000 euro kindgebonden budget krijgen nabetaald en mogelijk geen enkele band meer hebben met hun kind(eren)

MPs Omtzigt and Peters asked about over 100,000 parents receiving retroactive kindgebonden budget payments of over 1,000 euro, including cases where a parent has lost parental authority or been convicted of offences against a child, the position of separated parents, deceased parents, parents abroad, anti-cumulation rules, and seizure. The government answered that only the parent entitled to child benefit receives the payment, that entitled parents may still receive it after losing parental authority or being convicted, that the payment is protected from seizure, and that cross-border anti-cumulation arrangements are still being worked out.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de opnamestop bij de daklozenopvang van het Leger de Heils in Amsterdam

An MP asked whether Amsterdam's cut in subsidy caused the admission stop at the Leger des Heils homeless shelter and what the consequences for neighbouring cities are. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam's budget actually rose and that Amsterdam's own taskforce, not the national government, is responsible for fixing the situation, so no national action was committed.
Amsterdam's executive board has taken its responsibility by freeing up funds to lift the admission stop and by setting up a taskforce.
Het college van B&W van de gemeente Amsterdam heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen door middelen vrij te maken om de instroomstop op te heffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over "opvallend baanverlies binnen banenafspraak"

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported net loss of 1,411 jobs under the jobs agreement for people with disabilities in Q1 2019 compared with Q4 2018, and whether the 55,000-job target would be met. The State Secretary answered that the quarter-on-quarter drop is largely seasonal and due to fewer Wsw workers placed with regular employers, that year-on-year jobs rose by 13,235, and that the target is considered achievable, with simplification of the system to follow.
I therefore consider the target of realising 55,000 additional jobs by the end of 2019 to be achievable.
Ik acht daarom de doelstelling om eind 2019 55.000 extra banen te realiseren, haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de dyslexieindustrie

Peters (CDA) asks the health and education ministers about the dyslexia diagnosis industry, rising dyslexia certificate numbers, and alleged conflicts of interest at the Nederlands Kwaliteitsinstituut Dyslexie (NKD) and in gatekeeper advice to municipalities. The ministers say diagnosis is guided by a multi-step protocol, that exam-accommodation notifications have fallen since 2016, that the NKD is a private sector body rather than an independent institute, and that further research on dyslexia numbers and municipal spending will be commissioned.
The NKD was established by the sector itself with the aim of safeguarding and promoting the quality of diagnosis and treatment of EED.
Het NKD is door de sector zelf opgericht met als doel het bewaken en bevorderen van de kwaliteit van diagnostiek en behandeling van EED
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over mannen die vluchten voor huiselijk geweld en daardoor het contact met hun kinderen kwijtraken

An MP asked whether men fleeing domestic violence lose contact with their children because mothers decide on access, and about shelter numbers and the share of parents bringing children. The minister confirmed the reports, gave 2018 shelter figures without parent-child breakdown, said no data confirm a general pattern disadvantaging men, and promised to bring the issue to a new expert team.
I do not have information that can unconditionally confirm the picture described in the question.
Ik beschik niet over informatie die het beeld zoals verwoord in de vraag zonder meer kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat werklozen uit Amsterdam op gesprek moeten komen

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how she views reports that all 40,000 Amsterdam benefit recipients will be invited to interviews, given that municipalities already have the task and tools under the Participatiewet. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for activation, she makes no judgement on individual municipalities, supports activation through a Perspectief op Werk programme, and commissioned a study of promising municipal approaches due in autumn.
Municipalities are responsible for labour support for people receiving social assistance. I make no statements about individual municipalities.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de arbeidsondersteuning aan mensen met een bijstandsuitkering. Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de bekostiging van Plusopvang vanuit de Jeugdwet

MP Peters asks whether municipalities may use Youth Act funds for free Plusopvang (special after-school care with extra support) and whether this may increase demand, while parents in regular BSO pay themselves. Minister De Jonge answers that municipalities have discretion under the Youth Act, that such use is not contrary to the law, that free provision likely raises demand, and that no figures on the number of municipalities or children are kept.
It is not contrary to the Youth Act for a municipality to use funds for such Plusopvang.
Het is niet strijdig met de Jeugdwet dat een gemeente middelen inzet voor een dergelijke plusopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de extra inzet van Twentse gemeenten om foute zorgbureaus op te sporen

An MP asked the minister about Twente municipalities' traffic-light model flagging 64 of over 300 contracted care providers as red, the low share fully in order, and whether pre-contract controls should be strengthened, including under open-house contracting. The minister says the red providers will be investigated before conclusions are drawn, supports pre-contract control in principle, and agrees to talks with the VNG and municipal partnerships.
Yes, I am willing to do that.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Van Gent en Peters over inning van alimentatie

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the collection of child maintenance owed by ex-partners who do not pay, including whether preferential collection priority should be studied and how other countries handle it. The minister agreed that non-payment is undesirable, promised a study of preference and collection by LBIO to be reported after the summer, and argued that existing enforcement adequately secures payment.
By letter of 27 February I informed you of the advantages and disadvantages of preference for child maintenance claims.
Antwoord 3 Bij Kamerbrief van 27 februari jongstleden heb ik u geïnformeerd over de voor en- nadelen van preferentie voor kinderalimentatievorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Kuik en Peters over het bericht 'Schuldhulpverlening lastig voor studenten met schulden'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the rising number of young people, including students, seeking debt assistance, and about municipal measures, study-stopping rules, DUO paying tuition directly, and a warning banner on DUO's website. The government gave partial answers: it had no exact figures, supported initiatives and dialogue with municipalities, declined the banner and direct tuition payment for now, and pointed to ongoing experiments and measures.
We cannot give you exact numbers and percentages.
We kunnen u geen exacte aantallen en procenten geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over schuldenlast

CDA MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the state secretary about the societal costs of problem debt, a general debt pardon, compulsory administration (bewind) for at-risk people, and the number of young people and children affected. The government answered that the cost figures come from reliable but non-linkable sources, rejected a general debt pardon and compulsory bewind as undesirable, and said national representative data are not yet available, with a CBS study expected in 2020.
Nationally representative figures on the extent of debt problems in the Netherlands broken down by household background characteristics are currently lacking.
Landelijke representatieve cijfers over de omvang van schuldenproblematiek in Nederland uitgesplitst naar achtergrondkenmerken van huishoudens ontbreken op dit moment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over een app die de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet kan versnellen

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked whether an app from Stichting Financieel Paspoort could speed up the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet and whether people can use GDPR access rights to obtain the data needed. The state secretary answered that the app does not replace the implementation trajectory because it cannot cover partner and household data, that interim measures are planned, and that GDPR access alone does not suffice for the calculation.
The foundation's proposal is therefore not a full alternative to the implementation trajectory of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, including accelerating it.
Het voorstel van de Stichting is dan ook geen volwaardig alternatief voor het – versnellen van – het implementatietraject van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over dak- en thuislozen die zich niet kunnen inschrijven bij gemeenten

Peters (CDA) asked the state secretary about homeless people who cannot register with municipalities despite the legal duty, including the status of a planned law change and how homeless people can enforce their right. The secretary confirmed the registration duty already exists under the Wet BRP, said the amendment to clarify it will be sent to parliament in autumn 2019, sent a letter to municipalities, and referred affected people to support organisations and the RVIG.
The duty of municipalities to register already exists under the Wet BRP.
De plicht van gemeenten tot inschrijving is er al vanuit de Wet BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over een groot tekort aan personeel in de kinderopvang en de gevolgen hiervan voor kleine ondernemers

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about a large staff shortage in childcare, its effect on parents, and whether stricter quality rules hurt small childcare providers. The State Secretary acknowledged local labour shortages and longer waiting lists, said the number of small providers is not falling, and promised to keep monitoring and report quarterly.
I am closely monitoring the developments and will share them with your House through the quarterly childcare reports.
Ik houd de ontwikkeling nauwgezet in de gaten en deel deze met uw Kamer middels de kwartaalrapportages kinderopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het datalek bij Jeugdzorg waardoor dossiers van duizenden kwetsbare kinderen zijn gelekt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a data leak at Jeugdzorg Utrecht exposing thousands of children's files, including whether security norms were met and whether Z-CERT participation should be mandatory. The Minister says the leak came from an expired domain name now recovered, that Z-CERT will be asked to register lapsed domains, and that making Z-CERT membership compulsory will be examined in 2019.
As promised in response to the Ellemeet motion, VWS will examine in 2019 making participation of care and youth aid institutions in Z-CERT mandatory.
Zoals toegezegd in reactie op de motie Ellemeet (TK 270529, nr 179) zal VWS in 2019 het verplichtstellen van de deelname van zorg- en jeugdhulpinstellingen aan Z-CERT onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het opheffen van de subsidieregeling «Kansen voor alle kinderen» en de besteding van de hierdoor vrijgekomen middelen aan projecten voor de bestrijding van armoede onder kindere

An MP asked the state secretary whether the freed-up funds from the terminated 'Kansen voor alle kinderen' subsidy would be used to combat child poverty, and about school cost burdens. The government answered that the funds go to the 'Tel Mee met Taal' programme against low literacy, with partial child-poverty ambitions, and that school parental contributions must be voluntary, with schools' codes being tightened.
Following these discussions, it was decided to use these funds for the action programme 'Tel Mee met Taal' aimed at tackling low literacy.
Naar aanleiding van deze gesprekken is besloten om deze middelen in te zetten voor het actieprogramma «Tel Mee met Taal» gericht op de aanpak van laaggeletterdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over ‘Reclame’ op school die tot dure jeugdhulp leidt

A CDA MP asked the health minister about youth care providers holding consultation hours in schools and giving parents pre-printed referral letters, and about rising youth mental-health care use. The minister condemned the practice of providers referring to themselves, said the in-depth youth care study will be sent to parliament around end of April, and described existing municipal-GP cooperation.
Ik keur deze praktijk ten zeerste af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over een dreigende uithuiszetting van een gezin met kinderen vanwege de vondst van 96 gram hennep

An MP asked the state secretary about a family with children facing eviction after 96 grams of cannabis was found in their home, questioning whether this was disproportionate and asking for a national action plan against evictions. The state secretary said municipalities and housing corporations are responsible, that the family was offered alternative housing, and that central government lacks full information on individual cases, so no new action was committed.
Regarding individual cases, central government generally does not have all the necessary information.
Met betrekking tot individuele casuïstiek beschikt de rijksoverheid over het algemeen niet over alle benodigde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bestaan van zogenaamde “spookburgers.”

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about homeless people being refused registration and mail addresses by municipalities despite a 2016 agreement, and whether the government would compel municipalities to register them. The government acknowledged the problem and the duty to register, said it is pursuing guidance, workshops and a legislative clarification making registration on a mail address mandatory, but declined to name the refusing municipalities or to use direct enforcement powers for now.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Peters over de zorg voor en begeleiding van (oud-)topsporters

MPs Bruins Slot and Peters asked about mental health and career-end support for current and former top athletes, including a symposium, prevalence research, whether TeamNL offers structural post-career support, and whether a dedicated programme for former athletes is needed. The minister answered that research shows mental problems comparable to the general population, that TeamNL@Work provides tailored post-career support, and that NOC*NSF will explore enriching it with input from former athletes.
The project is still under development and NOC*NSF will in the coming period look at how current support can be further enriched, with input from former top athletes.
Het project is nog volop in ontwikkeling en NOC*NSF zal de komende tijd dan ook kijken naar hoe de huidige ondersteuning verder verrijkt kan worden, met de inbreng van oud-topsporters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over wachtlijsten bij de jeugdbescherming

An MP asked the minister about long waiting lists at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming (child protection board), with about 3,000 children waiting, and about the causes and remedies. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited causes such as staff shortages and overstretched research capacity, and pointed to an action plan with targets and monitoring by the inspectorates.
Both the Inspectorates and I are closely monitoring the progress of this plan.
Zowel de Inspecties als ik houden de voortgang van dit plan nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over de vertraging van de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

MPs Peters and Omtzigt (CDA) asked why implementation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet was delayed by at least two years, why the Belastingdienst and UWV implementation assessments were not published earlier, and what interim measures will protect debtors. The state secretaries explain that the delay stems from ICT and process redesign, that the revised assessments will be published before the 14 February 2019 debate, and that interim measures are being sought, but give no firm dates or concrete commitments yet.
We aim to publish the Besluit beslagvrije voet before the committee debate on poverty and debt policy scheduled for 14 February 2019, so that you can review the implementation assessments.
Wij streven ernaar het Besluit beslagvrije voet vóór het voor 14 februari 2019 geplande AO Armoede- en schuldenbeleid te publiceren, zodat u van de uitvoeringstoetsen kennis kunt nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over stilzitstraffen bij de Hoenderloo Groep

Peters (CDA) asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about 'stilzitstraffen' (sitting-still punishments) at youth care institution De Hoenderloo Groep, whether they are unlawful, why they were not abolished sooner, and why the IGJ missed them. Minister De Jonge replied that the measure is not unlawful if applied very sparingly, that the institution says it has stopped using it, that the IGJ will make an unannounced visit to verify this, and that the IGJ had not received signals about it and is reviewing a remediation plan.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Agnes Mulder over het instellen van wachttijden door de gemeente Assen om tekorten in het sociaal domein tegen te gaan

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about Assen's plans to introduce waiting times and budget caps in youth care and Wmo to curb deficits in the social domain. The minister confirmed awareness, noted the council removed the waiting-time proposal before adopting the measures, and stressed that municipalities retain a statutory duty to provide youth care regardless of budget overruns.
The mere fact that the municipal youth care budget is (threatening to be) exceeded does not detract from the youth care obligation.
Het enkele feit dat het gemeentelijk budget voor jeugdhulp overschreden (dreigt) te worden doet niet af aan de jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toegang tot schuldsanering

MP Peters asked the state secretary whether the falling inflow into statutory debt rescheduling (Wsnp) while debt problems grow signals that eligible people are not admitted, and how access to help is guaranteed. The government acknowledges the trend, says it will verify the alignment between municipal debt assistance and the Wsnp in a review due in the first half of 2019, but does not yet draw conclusions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het beëindigen van regionale inkoop jeugdzorg in Brabant

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether he is aware that 21 municipalities in Brabant are ending joint regional purchasing of ambulatory youth care, whether this is driven by rising deficits and Eindhoven's budget caps, and whether he will act and use the pending amendment to force regional purchasing. The minister confirms awareness, explains the region is splitting non-statutory purchasing into two regions while keeping core services joint, says he monitors developments and will intervene if care availability is at risk, and sees no reason yet to engage the municipalities.

As system responsible I am following these developments and keeping a finger on the pulse. Should the availability of youth care come under pressure, I will take the steps necessary to nonetheless secure availability.

Ik volg als stelselverantwoordelijke deze ontwikkelingen en houd een «vinger aan de pols». In het geval de beschikbaarheid van jeugdhulp in het gedrang komt, zal ik die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Peters over een aanbesteding jeugdbescherming en de jeugdreclassering in Noord-Holland

MPs Kuiken and Peters asked the minister about a failed open-house tender for youth protection and youth probation in 25 Noord-Holland municipalities, the risk to continuity of care, and time-recording demands. The minister answered that the open-house procedure is ongoing so no conclusions can yet be drawn, that municipalities are responsible for securing provision while the ministry monitors the situation and will intervene if needed, and that the ministry will raise time-recording requirements with municipalities.

If municipalities and institutions still fail to reach agreement together, so that the availability of youth protection and youth probation is jeopardised, we will take the steps necessary to secure availability.

In het geval dat de gemeenten en de instellingen er toch gezamenlijk niet uitkomen, waardoor de beschikbaarheid van jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering in het gedrang komt, zullen we die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het niet kunnen treffen van een persoonlijke betalingsregeling voor gedupeerde ouders in verband met de door de eigenaar van kinderopvang 'de Parel' gepleegde fraude met kindero

An MP asked whether parents defrauded through the childcare fraud at 'de Parel' could obtain a personal payment arrangement from the Tax Authority, after some parents were refused. The State Secretary answered that 15 of 50 requests were granted, refusals depended on individual circumstances such as intent or gross negligence, and the Tax Authority would adjust its notification letter for those refused.
Parents who do not qualify for a personal payment arrangement, for example because of intent or gross negligence, may possibly use the measure for offsetting childcare allowance.

Ouders die niet in aanmerking komen voor een persoonlijke betalingsregeling, omdat er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van opzet of grove schuld, kunnen mogelijk wel gebruik maken van «de maatregel bij verrekening van de kinderopvangtoeslag».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toename van suïcide onder kinderen

An MP asked the government about a sharp rise in youth suicides, whether it is structural, how to detect depressive symptoms early, whether the Transformatiefonds should fund such projects, whether the STORM pilot should be scaled up, and what action is taken against Instagram accounts glorifying suicide. The state secretary answered that a CBS microdata analysis and expert meeting are planned for September, pointed to the Meerjarenprogramma Depressiepreventie, said it is not known whether Transformatiefonds applications address depression, supported STORM-type initiatives as a matter for schools, and agreed to discuss monitoring tools with Facebook.
I share the view that further research is needed to map out the possible causes and explanations.
Ik deel de opvatting dat nader onderzoek aangewezen is om de mogelijke oorzaken en verklaringen hiervan in kaart te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over “Strijdigheid van bepalingen van de verordening Re-integratie en loonkostensubsidie van de gemeente Teylingen en andere ISD Bollenstreek-gemeenten met de Par

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether the Teylingen and other ISD Bollenstreek municipalities' rules limiting wage-cost subsidy hours conflict with the Participatiewet, and what supervisory options exist. The State Secretary confirmed the conflict, said the ISD will propose reversing the policy to municipal councils, and stated that interbestuurlijk toezicht measures are not needed for now.
It is therefore good that the ISD Bollenstreek will propose to the municipal councils, via the college of mayor and aldermen, to bring municipal policy back into line with the Participatiewet.
Het is daarom goed dat de ISD Bollenstreek via de colleges van B&W de gemeenteraden zal voorstellen het gemeentelijk beleid weer in overstemming met de Participatiewet te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Omtzigt over een gezin waarvan de vrouw werkt, de man permanent in een WLZ-instelling verblijft en de kinderen dus geen recht hebben op kinderopvangtoeslag omdat de man niet werk

MPs Peters and Omtzigt asked why a family where the father is permanently in a WLZ care facility and the mother works cannot get childcare allowance, and why statutory articles on social-medical indicators have never entered into force. The Secretary of State acknowledges the rule can be harsh, says she will examine a statutory exception and report this autumn, but declines to comment on individual cases and points to municipalities for SMI.
Unfortunately I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan helaas niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Peters over het bericht 'Kindcentra krijgt ‘extra punten’ in Den Bosch'

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister whether a school admission point system in Den Bosch, which favoured children in certain childcare centres, unduly restricted parental school choice and the level playing field for childcare providers. The minister replied that the policy had already been revised after local debate, that schools may use admission criteria if applied consistently and transparently, and that he saw no reason to instruct school boards further.
I see no reason to do so, see the answers to questions 2, 3 and 4.
Hier zie ik geen aanleiding toe, zie het antwoord op vragen 2, 3 en 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het artikel 'Hulp nieuwe stijl: sámen tegen muren oplopen'

CDA MPs Geluk and Peters asked the health minister about a press report that neighbourhood teams in municipalities, though closer to citizens, hit the same bureaucratic walls as citizens, including tensions with municipal departments and limited mandates to work across rules. The minister answered that municipalities have freedom in organising access to care, that the teams' diversity and expertise gaps need attention, and that he will talk with municipalities about clarity on what local teams can deliver.
I will talk with municipalities and other relevant parties about how access to youth care for children and families can be improved.
Ik ga met de gemeenten en andere relevante partijen in gesprek over de wijze waarop de toegang tot de jeugdhulp voor kinderen en gezinnen beter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de toegang tot de WSNP voor private schuldhulpverleners

An MP asked why courts declare WSNP debt-restructuring applications inadmissible when filed by private debt-assistance organisations, and about the resulting harm to debtors and municipalities. The State Secretary confirmed the courts' reading, citing the Hoge Raad ruling and the rule that debt mediation must be carried out by the municipality or listed persons, and promised consultation with VNG and NVVK with an update to parliament within months.
In that case, a request for admission to debt rescheduling is declared inadmissible, because the requirements of the Bankruptcy Act in conjunction with the Wck have not been met.
Een verzoek tot toelating tot de schuldsanering wordt in dat geval niet-ontvankelijk verklaard, omdat niet aan de vereisten uit de Faillissementswet in samenhang met de Wck is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Wiersma over onterecht betaalde uitkeringen door het UWV

MPs Peters and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefits wrongly paid out by UWV, the causes, and measures to recover every defrauded euro and intervene earlier. The minister said about €420 million in fraud-related claims were imposed in 2013–2017, outlined how extra anti-fraud funds were spent and some programmes ended, and committed to recovering all wrongly paid amounts within the statutory ten-year period.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over het bericht “Koopkracht gezinnen in veertig jaar amper gestegen”

MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the minister about a report that household income has barely risen over forty years, and about child poverty and child benefit spending compared with other countries. The government answered that standardised disposable income is about 25 percent higher than in 1977, that child poverty has fallen since 2014 but is above 2000-era levels in some years, that the Netherlands compares poorly with several neighbours, and listed measures such as higher child benefit and municipal anti-poverty funds.
The coalition agreement made an extra 80 million euro available for combating debt and poverty, particularly in families with children.
In het regeerakkoord is 80 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar gesteld voor de bestrijding van schulden en armoede – in het bijzonder in gezinnen met kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep inzake de bestrijding door gemeenten van bijstandsfraude door vermogende Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asks the state secretary whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that targeting welfare-fraud checks at Turkish-origin beneficiaries is discriminatory undermines municipal fraud enforcement and whether Dutch-nationality beneficiaries face unequal treatment. The secretary answers that municipalities may still investigate foreign assets and use risk profiles based on country of origin, but not on a single nationality, and promises to inform municipalities and improve cooperation with the IBF.
Selecting beneficiaries on the basis of country of origin alone is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

Het maken van een selectie van belanghebbenden op basis van het land van herkomst, als enkele feit, is in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over gezinshuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about research on family-style group homes (gezinshuizen) for children, their social return, numbers of homes and children, registration under the Youth Act, a quality framework, administrative burden and contract types. The minister answered that the research is noted and supports placement in small-scale settings, gave estimates of homes and children, said registration is under legal review, and said a quality framework will be delivered at year end.
I intend to inform the House by letter, before the bill on amending the admission of care providers (Wtza) is debated, about this matter.
aan de TK heb toegezegd, ben ik van plan uw Kamer voorafgaand aan de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel Wijziging toetreding zorgaanbieder (Wtza) bij brief te informeren hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Peters over het bericht ‘Jeugdhulp is online bedreiging beu’

MPs Raemakers and Peters asked the Minister of Health about online threats and false accusations against youth care workers and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the problem is worrying, pointed to existing campaigns and guidance, and said talks with employers, police, prosecutors and internet companies would report back before summer 2018.
Before summer 2018 we will inform you of the results of this consultation.
Vóór de zomer van 2018 zullen wij u informeren over de resultaten van dit overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht «Bijstandsproef is nep experiment»

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about reports that Amsterdam is loosening welfare rules outside the national experiment and whether it is in conflict with the ministry over the tegenprestatie. The answer refers the MP to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 34 352, nr. 75) about the Amsterdam request, without answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Peters (CDA), question number 2017Z15014, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to the request from MP Nijkerken-De Haan, made during the Regeling van Werkzaamheden of 8 November 2017, on an experiment with looser welfare rules in Amsterdam'.

Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Peters (CDA), vraagnummer 2017Z15014 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het verzoek van het lid Nijkerken-De Haan, gedaan tijdens de Regeling van Werkzaamheden van 8 november 2017, over een experiment met soepelere bijstandsregels in Amsterdam» (Kamerstuk 34 352, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het uitsluiten van zelfstandigen van schuldhulp door gemeenten

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt assistance, and asked for figures on liquidated businesses, success rates, debts, benefit dependence and costs. The State Secretary denied the picture could be confirmed, noted that most data is not recorded, and said he expects municipalities to provide appropriate services and is willing to discuss the matter with them.
Data on this point are lacking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Bevel rechter leidt niet tot snellere hulp jongere’

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg asked why juveniles ordered by the juvenile judge to undergo therapy face long waiting lists, and whether this reflects judges imposing specific trajectories unaware of municipal contracts. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for youth care availability, that coordination between the Child Protection Board, probation and municipalities should be improved, and that the Midden-Nederland region will hold talks, with the Board reporting back on follow-up.
The Child Protection Board has informed me that in upcoming talks with municipalities where this is a problem, it will discuss the availability of forensic youth care and will keep me informed.
De RvdK heeft mij gemeld in de komende gesprekken met gemeenten waar dit een probleem vormt, de beschikbaarheid van forensische jeugdhulp te bespreken en houdt mij daarvan op de hoogte.
Antwoord op van lid Peters over “financiële problemen van vrouwen in de vrouwenopvang”

An MP asked the State Secretary about financial problems and debts of women in women's shelters (blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuis) following an Ombudsman report, asking for debt percentages, costs, savings and whether independent client support will be promoted. The government answered that no data on debts in shelters exist, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance with extra funding of 7.5 million euro, and that an integrated policy response including independent client support and debt problems will follow in the October 2017 progress report.
I am not aware of any figures on the number of women with debts specifically in women's shelters, nor on any increase or decrease in this number.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over het aantal vrouwen met schulden in specifiek de vrouwenopvang, noch over toe- of afname van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het laten verwijderen van de registratie vanuit het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR) door bedrijven

MP Peters asked whether BKR credit registrations can only be removed when technical errors were made, whether courts have removed registrations, whether a BKR registration blocks mortgages, and what will be done about firms claiming they can delete registrations. The minister answered that removal is possible only for unlawful registrations, sometimes via settlement or courts, that a registration alone does not bar credit, that lenders must lend responsibly under AFM supervision, and that firms promising deletion without technical errors are misleading consumers.
It is not known how many mortgage applications are rejected or what part of them is (partly) rejected because of a BKR registration.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel hypotheekaanvragen worden afgewezen of welk deel daarvan (mede) vanwege een BKR-registratie is afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het door bedrijven laten verwijderen van de registratie vanuit het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR)

An MP asked the government about a company advertising the removal of BKR credit registrations and whether such third-party intervention is widespread and leads to new debt problems. The Minister answered that creditors alone correct registrations, that no figures exist on third-party involvement or on resulting debt problems, and that a negative registration does not by itself prevent new credit.
There are no figures on the extent to which companies such as Dynamiet Nederland are involved in this.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de mate waarin bedrijven zoals Dynamiet Nederland daarbij worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het voortbestaan van de Kindertelefoon

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary how the continuity of the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor would be secured, what agreements were made with municipalities, and why the interim VNG funding arrangement could not be made structural. The state secretary answered that responsibility for these services will move to central government from 2018 via a deduction from the municipal fund, since municipal payments to third parties from the fund are not in line with the Financiële-verhoudingswet, and that a legislative route will be pursued as quickly as possible.
I will arrange this by law as quickly as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het contracteren van de Kindertelefoon

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why only 29 municipalities had contracted the Kindertelefoon, Luisterend Oor and Vertrouwenswerk Jeugd by mid-May, why these were not financed like other national services, and why the government acted only just before the 1 June deadline. The state secretary answered that the uncertainty and administrative burden of the municipal model are too great, so responsibility will move to the national government, with a withdrawal from the municipal fund in the September 2017 circular, and that the 2018 guarantee by the VNG board is welcomed.
I will arrange this by law as quickly as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Peters over onterechte verdenkingen van kindermishandeling

CDA MPs Keijzer and Peters asked the state secretary about research suggesting that child-abuse screening questionnaires used by doctors lead to mostly unfounded suspicions, and about the training, procedures and data retention affecting wrongly accused parents. The state secretary disputes that the research shows over 90% unfounded suspicions, says screening is only an alert tool, promises to explore having Veilig Thuis itself initiate destruction of files when suspicions are refuted, and notes that training is left to field parties without a separate budget.
Together with the Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis I consider it desirable that Veilig Thuis, when the suspicion has been refuted, itself takes the initiative to destroy the file.
Samen met het Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis vind ik het wenselijk dat Veilig Thuis, als het vermoeden is weerlegd, zélf het initiatief neemt tot vernietiging van het dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de aanhoudende problemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about the continuing problems in youth care, including the Transition Authority's warning about institutional survival and payment practices. The State Secretary answered that the TAJ term was extended, the transition cost subsidy was prolonged, and that the government will pursue standardisation, an escalation ladder and a bill to enforce compliance, though it largely leaves payment arrangements to municipalities and providers.

requests the government to talk with sports associations about what they need to appoint a confidential person
verzoekt de regering om, met sportverenigingen in gesprek te gaan over wat zij nodig hebben om een vertrouwenspersoon aan te stellen
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over financiële ondersteuning voor het platform Uniek Sporten
Motion asks the government to financially support the Uniek Sporten platform in 2018 to raise awareness among people with disabilities.
requests the government to financially support the Uniek Sporten platform in 2018
