verzoekt de regering, het platform Uniek Sporten in het jaar 2018 financieel te ondersteunen
Motie van de leden Westerveld en Dijksma over vog's voor trainers, coaches en sportbestuurders
Motion asking the government to talk with sports associations about increasing the number of trainers, coaches and board members holding a certificate of conduct (VOG).
requests the government to talk with sports associations about increasing the possession of a VOG by trainers, coaches and sports board members
verzoekt de regering om met sportverenigingen in gesprek te gaan over het hebben van een vog door trainers, coaches en sportbestuurders te vergroten
Motie van het lid Westerveld over een jaarlijkse stand van zaken van de implementatie van de wet
Asks the government to report annually to parliament on implementation of the law pseudonymising student identification numbers and on privacy developments.
requests the government to annually provide a status report on the implementation of the law on pseudonymising the personal number
verzoekt de regering om, jaarlijks een stand van zaken te geven over de implementatie van de wet over het pseudonimiseren van het persoonsgebonden nummer
Motie van het lid Becker c.s. over onafhankelijk toezicht bij ieder samenwerkingsverband in het kader van passend onderwijs

Asks the government to ensure independent supervision of every education partnership (samenwerkingsverband) in special-needs education, since current supervision is run by school boards with a conflict of interest.
to ensure that independent supervision is introduced at every education partnership
ervoor te zorgen dat er onafhankelijk toezicht komt bij ieder samenwerkingsverband
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending ‘Het therapietrauma’ van Zembla

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Zembla broadcast on short high-intensity trauma therapy at Psytrec, including reports of harm, expert concerns, monitoring, evidence base and inspection follow-up. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ received earlier signals without intervening, is now investigating post-broadcast reports, and that quality and effectiveness are primarily matters for professionals, guidelines and providers, while describing waiting times and planned capacity measures.
The IGJ is currently investigating the reports received and cannot yet say anything about a possible follow-up.
De IGJ onderzoekt de ontvangen meldingen op dit moment en kan nog geen uitspraken doen over een eventueel vervolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Duitse grenscontroles

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about German police handing people over the border at night, including whether this is lawful and how affected residents and municipalities are supported. The minister says handovers follow bilateral agreements, gives 690 transfers for a nine-month period, notes that some cases are cold handovers, says Dutch and German border authorities are in contact, and states that the legal question is pending in Germany.
The Royal Netherlands Marechaussee does not record whether persons refused by Germany are transferred by a 'warm handover' or a 'cold handover'.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) registreert niet of door Duitsland geweigerde personen worden overgedragen middels een «warme overdracht» of een «koude overdracht».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Chakor over de toegankelijkheid van stembureaus

MPs Westerveld and Chakor asked the Minister of the Interior about accessibility of polling stations, assistance in voting booths for people with intellectual disabilities or low literacy, and concrete steps before the 2026 municipal elections. The Minister said a bill allowing assistance in the booth for all voters is pending, outlined data and an action plan on accessible polling stations, and listed concrete actions for 2026 and later.
The bill Assistance in the voting booth provides that anyone who wishes can receive help voting from a trained polling station member.
Het wetsvoorstel Bijstand in het stemhokje regelt dat iedereen die dat wenst hulp bij het stemmen kan krijgen door een daartoe getraind stembureaulid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Bijna 60 miljoen voor passend onderwijs ligt nog op de plank'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about reported rises in special-education reserves at SWVs, the court ruling that overturned the generic cut, and how truancy and the number of thuiszitters are tracked. The State Secretary answered that reserves fell from €160 million in 2020 to about €59 million, that the 2024 stagnation is undesirable, that the court ruling was accepted without appeal, and that truancy data will improve through a planned bill and regulation.
My predecessor, partly on the basis of legal advice from the State Advocate, decided not to appeal.
Er is door mijn voorganger, mede op basis van juridisch advies van de Landsadvocaat, besloten om niet in hoger beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het voorkomen van massadonatie

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked the State Secretary for Health about 'mass donation' of sperm, a clinic apparently circumventing donor registration, the adequacy of the law, a European register, and remedies for donor children. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 law caps donor sperm at 12 women via a central Dutch register, that cross-border and private-sphere donations remain outside its reach, and that further measures are being explored with a letter promised in Q1 2026.
I am in discussions with various parties about the possibilities and desirability of taking further measures against the use of donor sperm that is used internationally for more than 12 women.

Ik ben in gesprek met verschillende betrokken partijen over de mogelijkheden en wenselijkheid om nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen het gebruik van donorzaad dat in internationaal verband bij meer dan 12 vrouwen wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haage en Westerveld over ' Scholen gaan zelf boeken maken: 'Beter, goedkoper, en duurzamer'

MPs Haage and Westerveld asked the state secretary for Education about a plan by Neon, a non-profit initiative for schools to produce cheaper, better and more sustainable textbooks, and about its cost gap with current publisher prices. The state secretary welcomed the initiative, said schools are free in their choice of materials and that a KPMG study on textbook prices is underway, and promised a letter with the status of the motions before the budget debate.
I will inform your House about that before the budget debate.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar voor de begrotingsbehandeling over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan kinderen en ouders die vallen onder Jeugdbescherming Noord

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that Jeugdbescherming Noord is failing children and families, including staff turnover, long waiting lists, pressure on families who criticise the agency, and insufficient listening to parents and youth. The state secretary acknowledges the inspectorates' critical findings, describes measures on workload, recruitment and retention, and says oversight and a follow-up letter will address the problems, while leaving much of the responsibility with the municipalities.
In this decentralised system it is primarily up to municipalities to listen to the concerns of their residents.
Het is in dit decentrale stelsel in de eerste plaats aan gemeenten om te luisteren naar de zorgen van hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gebrek aan tolken voor mensen die slechthorend of doof zijn en spraakherkenningshulpmiddelen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the shortage of sign-language and writing interpreters for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and about reimbursement of speech-recognition aids such as Speaksee, including differing assessment procedures for workers and non-workers. The State Secretary responds that interim measures (a reorganised standby interpreter pool) are in place, that reimbursement is case-by-case and depends on whether the aid is for private life, work or education, and that answers to all questions could not be provided in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over vervolgopleidingen voor jongeren met een beperking of specifieke ondersteuningsbehoefte

MP Westerveld asked the Minister about lack of suitable follow-on education for pupils with disabilities or special support needs, UN committee criticism, exam retakes, transition support, deelcertificaten and an overview of options. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to existing mbo/hbo/wo support measures, a commissioned study due by year-end, and existing information sources, but made no new binding commitment.
The ministry has therefore asked Oberon and the Beleidsonderzoekers to research effective interventions to improve the transition from special secondary education to mbo.

Het ministerie heeft Oberon en de Beleidsonderzoekers daarom gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar effectieve interventies die bijdragen aan het verbeteren van de overgang van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs naar het mbo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Bushoff en Slagt- Tichelman over het bericht dat gemeenten zorgondernemers nauwelijks op criminaliteit toetsen

MPs Westerveld, Bushoff and Slagt-Tichelman asked the state secretary about reports that municipalities rarely screen care providers for criminal links under the Bibob Act, and about the size of care fraud and measures taken. The state secretary acknowledged limited use of Bibob by municipalities, said the size of fraud cannot be reliably estimated, pointed to pilot projects and a DUS-I review due end 2025, and promised a progress update this autumn.
Yes, I recognise the picture that municipalities to date make limited use of the possibilities offered by the Bibob Act to screen care providers.

Ja, ik herken het beeld dat gemeenten tot op heden beperkt gebruik maken van de mogelijkheden die de Wet Bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur (Wet Bibob) biedt om zorgaanbieders te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Piri over asielaanvragen van lhbtqia+-personen uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Westerveld and Piri asked whether asylum applications from LGBTQIA+ people from the United States have risen, whether the government will engage the US on this, whether US safety for LGBTQIA+ people is reassessed, and whether enough dedicated reception places exist. The Minister said such motives are not registered, applications rose modestly to 35 by July 2025, US safety does not in general justify asylum, and COA places LGBTQIA+ residents together in units when requested but has no fixed quota.
Asylum motives, such as sexual orientation or gender, are not systematically registered and therefore cannot be reproduced at an aggregated level.
Asielmotieven, zoals seksuele geaardheid of gender, worden niet systematisch geregistreerd en zijn dus niet op geaggregeerd niveau te reproduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over problemen bij zorgaanbieders vanwege de onduidelijkheid rondom SKJ-registraties

The MP asks whether youth care providers and EVC bureaus acting in good faith are harmed by the uncertainty over SKJ registrations after fraud, and whether children face waiting lists and unsuitable placements, and what the state will do to speed up the registration review. The Secretary of State says the fraud investigation of EVC certificates justifies holding registrations back, that SKJ is reviewing 512 files with extra staff, and that no temporary authorisation will be given until the EVC route is shown to guarantee quality.
That is not known to me. This data is not kept.
Dat is mij niet bekend. Deze data worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Westerveld, Van Campen en Heite over de staat van lhbti-acceptatie in het onderwijs en scherper toezicht daarop

MPs asked whether the Inspectorate of Education's last thematic study on sexual diversity (2020) should be repeated, how school supervision covers LGBTQ acceptance and civic duties, and what support schools receive. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate has deeper research planned for 2026, that sexual diversity is a standing supervision point with repair orders and funding sanctions for non-compliance, and listed existing surveys, a pending bill on safe education, and support programmes.
Antwoord op van de leden Westerveld en Timmermans over de voorgedragen nieuwe demissionaire minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs Westerveld and Timmermans asked the Prime Minister about past remarks by the proposed incoming acting Minister of Education, Culture and Science comparing rainbow zebra crossings to swastikas, and how such a figure could lead the ministry responsible for emancipation, asking 12 questions. The Prime Minister declined to comment on the candidate, stating that the appointment procedure is still ongoing and that he cannot make statements about candidate ministers until it is completed, referring to a general emancipation letter for other matters.
Until the appointment procedure has been completed, I cannot make any statements about candidate ministers and the process outlined above.
Tot het moment dat de benoemingsprocedure is afgerond, kan ik over kandidaat-bewindspersonen en het proces zoals hierboven geschetst geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de casus van Ymere en Philadelphia en de Stimuleringsregeling Zorggeschikte Woningen

MP Westerveld asks why the Ymere and Philadelphia application for the care-suitable housing subsidy (SGZW) was rejected, given housing shortages and a Chamber motion to widen the scheme to older people with intellectual disabilities, and whether the rules were clearly communicated. The State Secretary answers that the applicants knew the requirement that construction must not have started (needed for state-aid reasons under a DAEB agreement) was not met, that the rejected application cannot be revived retroactively, and that no further options exist within the scheme, while pointing to the broadened scheme and care-provider duties.
Ymere and Philadelphia also submitted an application in this new round.
Ymere en Philadelphia hebben ook in deze nieuwe ronde een aanvraag ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haage en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de Asielnoodmaatregelenwet op het onderwijs

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether the Asylum Emergency Measures Act (Asielnoodmaatregelenwet) would create uncertainty and harm for schools, staff, children and parents without valid residence status, and whether it conflicts with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government answered that all children in the Netherlands keep the right to education, that the Minister for Asylum has asked the Council of State for advice on the criminal liability of humanitarian helpers, and that the matter will be debated with parliament after that advice arrives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanhoudende problemen met leerlingenvervoer en Samen naar School-klassen

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary about persistent problems with pupil transport, the effect of leaving the consultation, monitoring, responsibility split between ministries, uithuisplaatsing cases and the closure of a Samen naar School class. The state secretary answers that municipalities are responsible, points to the interdepartmental improvement agenda and a planned monitor repeat in 2026, and promises further talks and information later this year.
However, since pupil transport has been decentralised to municipalities, where implementation takes place, I cannot directly intervene in problems that arise in implementation.

Gezien het feit echter dat het leerlingenvervoer gedecentraliseerd is bij gemeenten en daar de uitvoering wordt vormgegeven – door het college én de gemeenteraad – kan ik niet direct ingrijpen op problemen die zich in de uitvoering voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan mensen die niet volledig zelfredzaam zijn bij calamiteiten zoals stroomuitval

An MP asks how people who are not fully self-reliant, such as those dependent on electricity for life-sustaining medical equipment, can prepare for prolonged power outages, and what is done to identify and support them. The Secretary of State answers that a plan of action is being prepared, that the group is not yet a mandatory part of emergency plans, that addresses are not centrally registered for privacy and practical reasons, and rejects subsidising home backup generators, favouring emergency shelter at external locations.
For these people I want to draw up a plan of action for the scenario of prolonged power outage, as we recently saw in Spain.
Voor deze mensen wil ik een plan van aanpak opstellen voor het scenario van langdurige stroomuitval, zoals we recent in Spanje hebben gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Westerveld over de voortgang van een passende zorgverlofregeling voor ouders van ernstig zieke kinderen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the ministers about progress on a motion requiring a suitable leave scheme for parents of seriously ill children, and about the lack of paid care leave and financial hardship. The minister says an exploration with stakeholders is underway, results expected this autumn, and acknowledges the difficult situation without committing to specific substance.
This autumn I expect to be able to inform your House further about this exploration.
Dit najaar verwacht ik uw Kamer verder te kunnen informeren over deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het emancipatiebeleid van Nederland en de rol van digitalisering

Two MPs (Westerveld and Kathmann, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked about emancipation policy and digitalisation, covering AI bias and discrimination, gender equality and LHBTIQ+ rights in the EU, Roma and Sinti inclusion, and online radicalisation of young men. The government answered each of the 23 questions in substance, pointing to existing tools, EU regulation and ongoing programmes, without addressing parliamentary oversight of the executive directly.
The cabinet rejects all forms of discrimination.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van discriminatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Westerveld over het bericht 'Transgender teenager is sixth Russian LGBTQ asylum seeker to die in Dutch detention in three years'

MPs Piri and Westerveld asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the death of a transgender Russian asylum seeker in Dutch detention, the safety of LGBTQ asylum seekers, and reporting of incidents. The minister said an evaluation by COA, Nidos and the inspectorates must be awaited before conclusions, that no criminal indications were found, and that data on incidents is not registered for privacy reasons, while outlining existing protection measures.
At this stage it is not appropriate to draw such a conclusion.
Het past in dit stadium niet om een dergelijke conclusie te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over reizen naar de VS als trans- of non-binair persoon

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the risks for Dutch trans and non-binary travellers to the US, the travel advice, and protocols for rebooking or consular help. The minister answers that the travel advice was updated on 25 March to warn of differing US rules (only M or V gender markers), that the ministry offers consular assistance, and that rebooking is handled by travel organisers and insurers.
The ministry plays no role in rebooking or cancelling trips.
Het ministerie speelt geen rol in het omboeken of annuleren van reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vaker advies om van strafzaken af te zien bij jongeren zonder migratieachtergrond'

MPs Lahlah and Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about research showing the Child Protection Board advises dropping juvenile criminal cases more often for youths without a migration background, and what follow-up is planned. The State Secretary acknowledged the difference (not statistically significant overall), said the research cannot establish unequal treatment, and committed to applying the Discriminatietoets for public services at the Board, with a final report expected in mid-2026.
I consider it important to remain alert to this at all times and to take measures where necessary.
Ik vind het van belang hier altijd alert op te zijn en neem indien nodig maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Pleegzorg ver onder de maat bij organisatie die Vlaardings meisje begeleidde'

An MP asks how the government responds to the IGJ's finding that foster care provider Enver falls short on safety of foster children, whether children are safe during remediation, and what the IGJ will do if Enver fails. The Secretary of State answers that the IGJ has placed Enver under heightened supervision with a deadline of January 2026, that the IGJ has not yet confirmed risks are removed, and outlines measures on independent confidants for foster children and the IGJ's thematic inspection.
The IGJ has placed Enver under heightened supervision because the quality of the foster care provided does not meet the required standards.
De IGJ heeft Enver onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld, omdat de kwaliteit van de geboden pleegzorg niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Noodkreet GGZ-instelling de Waag: wachtlijsten plotseling nog langer door aanpassing van beleid'

MP Westerveld asks the minister why roughly 1,000 child and youth psychologists are no longer getting BIG registration as health psychologists despite comparable training, and asks about the impact analysis, the motion on consultation, and possible transitional arrangements. The minister defends not proceeding with the draft bill after negative internet consultation, says child and youth psychologists can keep working in youth care without BIG registration, and rejects a transitional arrangement because of higher costs.
At this moment I see no reason to change the professional structure of mental health care in the BIG Act.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de beroepenstructuur van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in de Wet BIG te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over de uitvoering van een aangenomen motie over landelijke regie pakken op de wijze van financiering van de jeugdzorg en beschikbaarheidsfinanciering de standaard make

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked how implementation of their adopted motion on national steering of youth care financing and making availability-based financing the standard is progressing, including research on which care types need it. The Secretary of State answered that standardisation of care types is underway with municipalities and providers, that availability-based financing is being researched, and that it can support stable, placement-based youth care while cost control limits its use for a fixed home.
Through the Youth Reform Agenda, I am working with municipalities and youth care providers on standardising the care types.
Vanuit de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd werk ik met gemeenten en jeugdhulpaanbieders aan het standaardiseren van de zorgvormen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de ondersteuning van organisaties die zich inzetten voor mensen met een beperking

Westerveld asks about support for organisations working with people with disabilities, including a loneliness-prevention group at risk of closing, funding for ethnic and disability research versus practice, involvement of experience experts in campaigns, and municipal involvement of lonely people. Staatssecretaris Maeijer answers by listing existing subsidies and programmes, explains that research funds are mostly for research with limited compensation pilots, and says municipal engagement has not declined but the survey question changed.
There is no complete government-wide overview available of subsidies that specifically support organisations working for people with a disability.
Er is geen volledig Rijksbreed overzicht beschikbaar van subsidies die specifiek organisaties ondersteunen die zich inzetten voor mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ouders die kind van school houden vanwege geloofsovertuiging worden niet meer vervolgd'

Two MPs (Pijpelink and Westerveld) asked the State Secretary of Education about the Public Prosecution Service's decision to stop prosecuting parents who keep children home on grounds of religious or life-conviction objections to schooling, and the risks this poses for children's right to education. The State Secretary answered that the OM made the decision because the legal provisions are interpreted inconsistently, regretted not being informed beforehand, is examining other enforcement options and a possible removal of the exemption, and provided case figures.
I regret that the OM feels compelled to take this decision and that the Ministry of OCW was not informed in advance.
Ik betreur dat het OM zich genoodzaakt ziet om dit besluit te nemen en dat het Ministerie van OCW hier niet van te voren op de hoogte is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mutluer over buitenlandse beïnvloeding op het emancipatiebeleid

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Justice and Security about foreign influence by extreme conservative lobby groups on emancipation policy, including disinformation, funding flows, and threats to LGBTQ+ and migrant rights. The government answered that lobbying is lawful but that incitement and intimidation fall outside democratic limits, pointed to the pending Wtmo and an anti-SLAPP directive, and said it lacks a legal basis for the requested investigations into funding.
The ministries do not have a legal basis to carry out these kinds of investigations.
De ministeries beschikken niet over een juridische grondslag om dit soort onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over de Week van de Lentekriebels

MPs Westerveld and Pijpelink asked the state secretaries of Education and Health about misinformation campaigns against the Week van de Lentekriebels and its effect on school participation. The government acknowledged the misinformation as harmful, noted participation fell from 43.2% to 35%, and promised continued support, information efforts and curriculum safeguards while stressing school autonomy.
Spreading incorrect and incomplete information is harmful.
Het verspreiden van onjuiste en onvolledige informatie is schadelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Lahlah en Bushoff over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen aan kinderen

MPs asked whether children's basic necessities and healthcare aids, such as incontinence material, glasses, braces and special learning materials, are being left to charities and whether insurers and municipalities are failing to cover them. The Minister says the government knows of rising requests, points to the basic insurance rules, municipal responsibilities and ongoing work on child glasses, but largely defers responsibility to insurers, schools and municipalities.
I consider it important that children have access to sufficient incontinence material when they need it due to a medical indication or disability.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat kinderen toegang hebben tot voldoende incontinentiemateriaal als ze die vanwege een medische indicatie of beperking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over artiesten en concert-/festivalgangers met een beperking

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the accessibility of concerts, festivals and theatre for artists and audiences with disabilities, referring to a manifesto, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and shortages of accessible seating and sign-language interpreters. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps but states that the cultural sector itself is primarily responsible, that the ministry sets frameworks and funds initiatives such as the Routekaart Toegankelijke Festivals and a planned Kennispunt Toegankelijke Cultuur, and that a work agenda on the UN Convention will be sent to Parliament.
The ministry takes its responsibility by setting preconditions and creating frameworks.
Het ministerie neemt zijn verantwoordelijkheid door randvoorwaarden te stellen en kaders te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Elines dochter (10) kreeg anorexia: ‘gewacht op hulp tot ze letterlijk een ons woog’'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports of long waiting times for children with anorexia, the lack of data on waiting times and treatment places, and the response to calls from the sector. The State Secretary answers that waiting times are not registered nationally, points to the Ketenaanpak Eetstoornissen, planned legislation obliging municipalities to cooperate, and ongoing research, while committing to no specific new measures beyond existing initiatives.

Exact numbers of children, young people and young adults in comparable situations are unfortunately not available because waiting times are not recorded nationally and by diagnosis for children and young people.

Exacte aantallen van kinderen, jongeren en jongvolwassenen in vergelijkbare situaties zijn helaas niet beschikbaar doordat wachttijden niet landelijk en diagnosespecifiek worden geregistreerd voor kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Stultiens over hulp aan studenten met een functiebeperking

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Education about uneven support for students with disabilities, the DUO prestatiebeurs scheme, and medical debt forgiveness refusals. The Minister acknowledges growing application numbers, says the decentralised process causes variation, promises research with results by summer 2026, and explains that medical debt forgiveness is reserved for exceptional cases and rejections often stem from missing medical information.
I will therefore investigate this as part of a broader study into tailored provisions for students with support needs.
Dit ga ik daarom onderzoeken als onderdeel van een breder onderzoek naar maatwerkvoorzieningen voor studenten met een ondersteuningsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over bezuinigingen op de jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about municipal cuts to youth care, a harmful abrupt termination of care, workforce and funding pressures, and the Youth Authority's continuity-risk monitoring. Karremans answered that municipalities are responsible for youth care funding, that the 511 million structural cut was dropped but a 1 billion savings target remains, that talks on the Van Ark advice are ongoing with a letter promised before 18 June, and that 17 providers were in continuity-risk procedures in 2024.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their financial position and the adequate performance of the tasks and responsibilities incumbent on them.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de financiële positie en adequate uitvoering van de taken en verantwoordelijkheden die op hen rusten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vergoeden van een passende rolstoel

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health why a Wlz resident with a disability cannot obtain a well-fitting wheelchair, citing VN Disability Convention Article 20 and a crowdfunding campaign. The State Secretary acknowledges the right to suitable aids, says misunderstandings led to no application being filed, promises follow-up talks and a review of the procedure with care offices, and points to complaint routes such as the IGJ, the ombudsman and the courts.
Following these parliamentary questions, my ministry contacted this client and the relevant care office.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is vanuit mijn ministerie contact opgenomen met deze cliënt en het betreffende zorgkantoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ruim honderd vrouwen met spiraaltje van Ballerine tóch zwanger, gros klachten niet gemeld bij inspectie'

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that over a hundred women with a Ballerine IUD became pregnant and that most complaints were not reported to the inspectorate, asking about information, certification, reporting and oversight. The minister answered that the EU certification system functioned adequately, that the 2021 IGJ review found no need for further action, and that she will explore a clearer reporting structure for users and providers.

I want to look into how I can arrive at as clear a reporting structure as possible for users and healthcare providers, so that they always know where to go for complaints and side effects of medical devices.

Ik wil kijken hoe ik tot een zo helder mogelijke meldstructuur kan komen voor gebruikers en zorgverleners, zodat zij altijd weten waar zij terecht kunnen voor klachten en bijwerkingen bij medische hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de recente wachttijdcijfers in de ggz

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary for Health about rising mental health care waiting times, the failure to meet the IZA target of five weeks, possible duty-of-care breaches, and budget cuts. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to structural causes and planned measures to be set out in a letter before the committee debate, while deferring responsibility for enforcement to the NZa and insurers.
As I previously shared with your House, I therefore want to take additional measures to increase the accessibility of mental health care, particularly for people with serious, complex problems.
Zoals ik eerder met uw Kamer deelde, wil ik daarom aanvullende maatregelen nemen om de toegankelijkheid van de ggz te vergroten, met name voor mensen met ernstige, complexe problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de emancipatie van lhbtqia+ personen en vrouwen in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the emancipation of LGBTQIA+ people and women, including rising discrimination, budget cuts to emancipation subsidies, intersex children's medical treatment, parenthood law, asylum shelter safety, X gender markers and evaluation of discrimination detectives. The State Secretary answers that the government takes discrimination seriously, cites monitoring showing mixed but partly hopeful trends, says budget cuts do not affect ongoing subsidies, and promises a letter on intersex treatment, an evaluation of Regenboogsteden, and sharing the discrimination-detective evaluation via a police letter in June 2025, while referring several questions to earlier letters or other responsible actors.
I will shortly send a letter to your House informing you about the follow-up process and the associated timeline.
Ik zal op korte termijn een brief aan uw Kamer sturen waarin ik u informeer over het vervolgproces en bijbehorend tijdspad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over de financiële achteruitgang van mensen met een beperking door kabinetsbeleid

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the state secretaries about financial losses for people with disabilities, including higher Wlz own contributions and lower take-home pay for sheltered-work staff from tax changes and an expired CAO. The government says the Wlz increase follows from the minimum wage rise, that the tax changes cause losses of up to about 15 euro per month, and that it is talking with the VNG about financing sheltered work, but that it is not a party to the CAO negotiations.
The cabinet is not a party to the CAO negotiations for the group working at social development companies and therefore takes a cautious stance on the CAO Aan de slag.
Het kabinet is geen partij in de cao-onderhandelingen voor de doelgroep die werkt bij sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven en stelt zich daarom terughoudend op ten aanzien van de cao Aan de slag.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Westerveld over het toepassen pijnprikkels in jeugdzorginstellingen

Westerveld asks the state secretary to explain how the use of pain stimuli (bokkepootjes) at Woodbrookers can fall under child abuse while the OM found no intentional misconduct, and asks about permitted restraint methods, youth complaint routes, dossier access, and legal support for former residents. The secretary declines substantive comment on the ongoing case, states restraint is only allowed under strict conditions without pain stimuli, notes complaint and civil routes, and promises an evaluation by WODC expected before summer.
The Public Prosecution Service decided in September 2024 to end the investigation into possible abuse.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in september 2024 besloten om het onderzoek naar mogelijke mishandelingen te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het aantal verhuizingen van kinderen in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretary about the high number of placement changes of children in youth care, referencing reports, the UN Children's Rights Convention, earlier promises and motions, and asks what concrete measures will be taken. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, points to monitoring gaps, the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, a bill on regional cooperation, and says the recommendations are endorsed and largely the responsibility of providers and municipalities.
There are currently no national figures available on when and how often a young person is transferred.
Er zijn op dit moment namelijk geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over wanneer en hoe vaak een jeugdige wordt doorgeplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp na seksueel misbruik

An MP asked the state secretary about help for victims of sexual abuse: recognition and training, waiting lists in mental health care, access for vulnerable groups, use of restraint and isolation in closed youth care, the victim website, and access to sexological care. The state secretary described training and platforms, acknowledged long waiting times and pointed to the insurer's duty of care, noted measures on restraint in closed youth care, said the victim website was taken offline, and stated that sexological care is covered when part of GGZ treatment.
The number of girls placed in closed youth care has since decreased by 35%.
Het aantal meisjes dat geplaatst wordt in de gesloten jeugdhulp is sindsdien met 35% afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over onderwijs in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the government about education in youth detention institutions (JJI's), citing Education Council and Inspectorate reports on lack of guaranteed schooling, staffing shortages, examination barriers and detained youths in adult prisons. The government acknowledges the concerns, lists funding increases and a mbo-coordinator, and promises further reactions and letters before the summer recess, though it refers many structural questions to later responses.
That there are ongoing concerns about education in the JJIs we take extremely seriously.
Dat er aanhoudende zorgen zijn over het onderwijs in de JJI's nemen wij uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht dat de genderpoli van het Amsterdam UMC voorlopig geen nieuwe volwassenen in behandeling neemt vanwege overbelasting

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked about reports that the Amsterdam UMC gender clinic stopped inviting new adult patients for intake due to overload, the long waiting times, staff shortages, the state's efforts to address them, and whether patients are being pushed abroad in breach of the duty of care. The minister confirms the pause for adults, says waiting times cannot be predicted, points to a coordinating platform, extra funding for mental health care and the duty of insurers, and says the revised quality standard is due in September 2025.
It is not possible to say anything about the overall duration of the waiting time.
Het is niet mogelijk om een uitspraak te doen over de algehele duur van de wachttijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Westerveld over de toegankelijkheid van het OV

MPs De Hoop and Westerveld asked the state secretaries about accessibility of public transport for people with disabilities, including lift and escalator outages, information provision and train design. The state secretary answered that full accessibility by 2030 is not feasible, that the 2040 target stands, and described ongoing measures with ProRail and operators, while committing to periodic reporting on lift functioning.
Achieving fully accessible public transport by 2030 is not feasible, but the sector has long been working to bring that goal closer.
Het verwezenlijken van volledig toegankelijk openbaar vervoer in 2030 is niet haalbaar, maar de sector spant zich al geruime tijd in om die doelstelling steeds dichter bij te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Westerveld over de berichten 'Wie betaalt voor zorg op school? In Limburg krijgen ouders van kwetsbare kinderen de rekening' en 'Vage facturen en creatief boekhouden op M

MPs Stoffer and Westerveld asked the state secretary about reports that Limburg schools for disabled children pressure parents to transfer part of their personal care budgets (pgb) to the school, and whether this is lawful and transparent. The state secretary answered that such arrangements are permissible in agreement with parents, that the Inspectorate has not investigated the use of care funds and has no legal task to do so, and that a new care-in-school policy aims to improve transparency.
The Inspectorate of Education has not conducted any investigation into the use of care funds.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft naar de besteding van zorgmiddelen geen onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Leerlingen die thuiszitten zonder onderwijs en de financiële reserves van Samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about unspent reserves at special-needs cooperation bodies (samenwerkingsverbanden), where the money went, the number of truants, and their publicly available data. The State Secretary answered that excess reserves have fallen sharply, that the Inspectorate monitors spending and salaries, that the ministry is reviewing how these bodies function, and that data is partly available online.
The inspectorate supervises the spending of funds.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op besteding van middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen en voorzieningen voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about persistent delays in delivering and repairing assistive devices for people with disabilities, the adequacy of monitoring, compliance with the UN Disability Convention, legal deadlines, complaint routes and supervision. The government answered that delays are mainly structural (parts shortages, labour shortages), that no monitor will be set up but developments may be considered in the UN Convention follow-up, that it will not legislate deadlines, and that it will talk with industry and the VNG about compliance with the agreements, reporting before summer 2025.
I am not prepared to include agreements on statutory deadlines in the framework laws (Wmo, Zvw and Wlz).
Ik ben niet bereid om in de stelselwetten (Wmo, Zvw en Wlz) afspraken op te nemen over wettelijke termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdiensten

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about the digital accessibility of government services, citing a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report and raising issues such as the non-compliance of many public websites, IDO funding, accessibility in healthcare and education, and emergency services. The State Secretary responded that the government is working on a work agenda, accessibility standards, a planned 2028 deadline, and reform of IDO financing, while acknowledging compliance is too low but declining to commit to sanctions for now.
The Ministry of BZK considers the number of government websites and apps that meet the legal requirement to be too low.
Het Ministerie van BZK vindt het aantal overheidswebsites en -apps die aan de wettelijke verplichting voldoen te laag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Chakor over ondersteuning voor mensen met een beperking voor hun functie als gemeenteraadslid, Statenlid of lid van het algemeen bestuur van een waterschap

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about support and barriers for people with disabilities who become councillors, provincial members or water board members, including benefit and allowance offsetting and accessibility of council chambers. The minister answered that the government supports more representation, points to existing measures such as an action plan, a pilot and a new online platform, but says it cannot remove all barriers, that benefit rules are complex and case-specific, and that it will discuss council-chamber accessibility with local governments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Westerveld over veilige opvang slachtoffers huiselijk geweld in de knel

MPs Mutluer and Westerveld asked about shortages of safe shelter places for domestic violence victims, who are being housed in hotels and holiday parks, and about the government's responsibility and funding. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible, that capacity data is still being developed, that extra funding has been provided but is not earmarked, and that the government will discuss the issue with municipalities and Valente but rules out returning to national financing for now.
Municipalities do not have to account to the national government for how they have precisely used the funds.
Gemeenten hoeven geen verantwoording te geven aan het Rijk over hoe zij de middelen precies hebben benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over wachtlijsten voor genderzorg

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about waiting lists for gender care after the Mutsaersstichting restricted its gender care to Limburg, and whether budget cuts and service gaps would be addressed. The state secretary answered that gemeenten are responsible for youth gender care, national waiting-time data are not kept, the Mutsaersstichting has a continuity plan with added municipal and subsidy funding, and a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg is being set up with a work agenda expected in early 2025.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including gender care. Figures on the number of waiting lists and average waiting times are therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, dus ook genderzorg. Cijfers over aantallen wachttijden en gemiddelde wachttijden worden daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over passend onderwijs aan kinderen met Long COVID en andere infectieziekten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Health about schooling for children with Long COVID and other infections causing severe energy limitation, including lack of understanding, inadequate support, school ventilation and remote learning. The government answered that data on affected children are limited, it is investing in research, information and tailored education options, and is preparing legislation to expand flexible and digital schooling.
My goal is for digital distance learning to become a full part of the passend onderwijs system.
Mijn doel is dat digitaal afstandsonderwijs een volwaardig onderdeel wordt van het stelsel van passend onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over kinderopvang voor speciaal onderwijs

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of out-of-school care for children in special education and whether a statutory obligation similar to that for primary schools should be extended to special schools. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted that a legal obligation is complex and costly, and committed to discussing the option with the sector and developing a guidance document.
We will discuss and explore the possibilities of a statutory obligation as one of the options with the field.
We zullen de mogelijkheden van een wettelijke verplichting als een van de opties bespreken en verkennen met het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis en de gevolgen voor ggz-patiënten

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked about the disappearance of restitution policies for mental health care and the effects on patients, including waiting lists and contracting. The minister answered that insurers may replace these policies with in-kind combination policies with a one-year transition period, and that insurers' own decisions and contracting are outside her direct control while the NZa supervises the duty of care.
However, it is not for me to change this decision by health insurers; health insurers themselves determine which policies they offer and which they do not.
Het is echter niet aan mij om iets aan dit besluit van zorgverzekeraars te veranderen; zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf welke polissen zij aanbieden en welke niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over ADL-hulp

The MP asks the State Secretary about reports of poor ADL assistance at Fokus, including understaffing, many rotating assistants, male staff for women with prior abuse, unsafe complaint routes, and tariffs. The State Secretary acknowledges concerns, points to IGJ supervision and planned tariff increases and guidelines, but makes no specific measurable commitments on staffing or team continuity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en het lid Westerveld over genderzorg voor jeugd

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the threatened disappearance of gender care for under-18s in Noord-Brabant after BuroJIJ's possible exit, and about waiting lists and measures. The government acknowledged shortages of specialist youth care, pointed to the bill on availability of youth care and the Aanpak Wachttijden, said no current national waiting-list or wait-time data exist, and promised a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg and further work on protocols.
For (specialist) gender care for under-18s, no current figures are known on the number of people waiting or average waiting times.
Voor (specialistische) genderzorg voor jeugdigen onder 18 jaar zijn geen actuele cijfers bekend van aantallen wachtenden en gemiddelde wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over mishandelingen in een jeugdzorginstelling

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the use of pain-inducing restraint (bokkepootje) on minors in a youth care institution, whether such practices are permitted, how they relate to children's rights, and what redress exists for victims. The government answers that pain-inducing measures are prohibited under the Jeugdwet and the UN Convention, that victims can use complaint procedures, criminal complaints or civil action, and that existing recognition measures are being evaluated.
An action aimed at causing pain, such as a bokkepootje, may not be used as a restrictive measure.
Een handeling die erop gericht is pijn te veroorzaken, zoals een bokkepootje, mag niet als vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht «Uithuisgeplaatste kinderen overgeleverd aan hardhandige invalkrachten»

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports on unqualified temporary staff and mistreatment of out-of-home placed children at youth care provider D3 in Hoenderloo, including inspection oversight, municipal responsibility, staffing rules, and remedies for young people. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ inspection report is expected in early 2025, responsibility is shared between municipalities, providers and the IGJ, and that promised measures include a sector conduct code for staffing agencies and a campaign on self-employment, while rejecting reopening the compensation scheme.
Currently the IGJ is conducting oversight of the D3 location in Hoenderloo.
Momenteel loopt er toezicht van de IGJ op de D3 locatie in Hoenderloo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe en Westerveld over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the State Secretary whether budget caps imposed by health insurers on Pro Persona mental health care are effective, why the minister cites treatment-norm safeguards that are often breached, and what the effects of such caps are on patients served and on access. The State Secretary answered that caps help insurers allocate scarce staff, that safeguards exist but are insufficiently effective, that the NZa is monitoring insurers' duty of care, and that no detailed effect data exist, while committing to further measures and talks with the affected client councils.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Wat vrouwen niet mogen weten over hun eigen borsten’

MPs Tielen and Westerveld asked about a Volkskrant article on breast screening for women with dense breast tissue, and whether women's concerns and the option of extra MRI are being taken seriously. The State Secretary says extra MRI capacity is insufficient, that density reporting offers no actionable options, and that he will consult stakeholders and the Health Council on improvements and inform the House.
I find this a difficult dilemma. That is why I will enter into discussion with the parties involved.
Ik vind dit een lastig dilemma. Daarom zal ik in gesprek gaan met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over reclame voor en samenwerking met extern aanvullend onderwijs

MPs Pijpelink and Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Education about schools advertising or cooperating with commercial supplementary tutoring providers despite government guidelines, and about inequality, municipal funding and a possible legal ban. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 Monitor will assess the effect of the guidelines, that further measures will be considered if they prove ineffective, and that no statutory ban or municipal agreements are planned for now.
If it turns out that the guidelines are not sufficiently effective, I will consider possible follow-up measures.
Indien blijkt dat de richtlijnen niet afdoende effectief zijn, zal ik mij beraden op eventuele vervolgmaatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en De Hoop over bouwsubsidie voor ouderen, maar niet voor ouderen met een beperking

MPs Westerveld and De Hoop asked why the Stimuleringsregeling Zorggeschikte Woningen subsidy is open to housing for older people but not for people with disabilities, and whether it will be opened to all Wlz groups. The State Secretary explained the 30% VV4-VV10 condition as part of the shift away from institutional care, said people with disabilities can still live in such homes, and rejected extending the scheme to the disability sector, citing its different institutional capacity situation.
I therefore see no reason to extend the scheme to the disability sector.
Ik zie daarmee geen reden om de regeling uit te breiden tot de gehandicaptensector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over signalen van problemen met woon-zorginitiatieven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about signals that care-home residents face rent increases, whether they are vulnerable because housing and care are contractually linked, and about rent protection, care-level changes and quality of care in care-home initiatives. The Minister answered that rent disputes go to the Huurcommissie, that existing rent rules apply, that residents in Wlz institutions pay no rent and so lack rent protection, and that the IGJ supervises care quality, while committing only to existing measures on PGB-financed initiatives.
The Ministry of VWS has no signals of problematic rent increases for clients in a care home.
Er zijn bij het Ministerie van VWS geen signalen bekend over problematische huurstijgingen bij cliënten in een zorgwoning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderzoeken waaruit blijkt dat de slachtoffers van zorgboerderij Aurora Borealis opnieuw in verkeerde handen terecht zijn gekomen

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that former residents of care farm Aurora Borealis were again placed with a poorly vetted provider, Zorgpro, and why oversight and screening failed. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, described the inspection, contracting and leersessies steps taken and promised tighter provider screening, pgb rules and closer monitoring of the former residents.
I have therefore asked the care offices to tighten their screening of care providers.
Ik heb zorgkantoren daarom verzocht hun screening van zorgaanbieders aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over logeerfaciliteiten voor kinderen met een (zeer) ernstige meervoudige beperking

MP Westerveld asks the government about the shortage of respite care places for children and adults with severe multiple disabilities, the role of the ministry, pgb-funded respite and equipment problems. The state secretary agrees the shortage is real, points to the raised tariff, a pilot allowing pgb teams to accompany clients in care locations, and a forthcoming regulatory change, but says pgb coverage of location costs cannot be realised before 1 July 2025.
From 2022 a considerably higher tariff applies to respite care for Wlz clients with ZEVMB.
Vanaf het jaar 2022 geldt een aanzienlijk hoger tarief voor logeeropvang van Wlz-cliënten met een ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de vergoeding van spraakcomputers voor mensen die zonder hulp niet of moeilijk kunnen communiceren

Westerveld asks the minister how many people were refused or granted speech computers, why the Kamer motion on full reimbursement including hardware is not being implemented, and whether this breaches the UN disability convention. The minister says exact national figures are unavailable, that full reimbursement is assessed case by case with the Zorginstituut working on a structural solution, and that the Wlz funding for 2025 has been set aside.
Health insurers then assess on an individual basis whether an aid is reimbursed.
Zorgverzekeraars beoordelen vervolgens per individuele situatie of een hulpmiddel wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the state secretary about budget caps imposed on Pro Persona GGZ by health insurers and whether this conflicts with insurers' duty of care amid long mental health waiting lists. The state secretary says caps are a legitimate tool for allocating scarce capacity, insurers retain a duty of care and must refer patients elsewhere, and he is discussing improvements with the sector without intervening in contracts.
Making agreements, including on budget caps, is a matter between individual providers and individual health insurers.
Het maken van afspraken, ook over budgetplafonds, is een zaak tussen individuele aanbieders en individuele zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het aanbod van (hoog)specialistische GGZ-behandelingen en de reductie van High Intensive Care-capaciteit bij GGz Breburg

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary about the planned concentration and bed reduction of high-intensive care at GGz Breburg, and whether this conflicts with earlier promises to protect cruciale ggz capacity and with the goal of shortening waiting lists. The state secretary confirms awareness, states the reduction is due to staff shortages rather than finances, says the ministry has contacted the provider and insurer and will discuss the case with partners, but offers no concrete plan to reverse the cut and few data on capacity loss.
There is, however, no data available on the scope, reduction or build-up of cruciale ggz capacity.
Er zijn echter geen gegevens voorhanden over omvang, afbouw of opbouw van capaciteit van cruciale ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de toiletpas

MP Westerveld asked the state secretary about toilet cards for people with bladder and bowel conditions, public toilet access, and accessible Changing Places toilets. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said he would convene the initiators to discuss a single card, offered to raise awareness via the UN Disability Convention role, and noted VNG attention to public toilets.
I do not have figures on how many of these people use one of these cards.
Cijfers over hoeveel van deze mensen gebruik maken van één van deze passen, heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de herkansingsperiode voor leerlingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked why vso pupils whose resits run into early September cannot enroll in higher education on time and what arrangements exist for them. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said institutions decide their own enrolment rules, and committed to arranging resits before 1 September for the affected group and to better communication.
For 2025 onwards I instruct the examination system to make it possible for the specific group of pupils who want to move on to hbo and wo to take their resits before 1 September

Voor 2025 en verder geef ik de examenketen de opdracht om het mogelijk te maken voor de specifieke groep leerlingen die willen doorstromen naar het hbo en wo hun herkansingen af te leggen vóór 1 september
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de berichten van Follow the Money en Pointer over de jeugdzorgbedrijven op het Hoenderlooterrein

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about reports on youth care providers at the former Hoenderloo site, including incidents, unclear municipal oversight of placements, and IGJ inspection of new providers. The state secretary answers that a local platform has been set up, the IGJ conducts risk-based oversight, municipalities remain responsible for data and suitable care, and that the Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg will strengthen regional cooperation.
The IGJ makes no statements about the precise content and handling of reports.
Over de precieze inhoud en de afhandeling van meldingen doet de IGJ geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan jongeren en volwassenen met eetstoornissen

An MP (Westerveld, GroenLinks-PvdA) asks what concrete steps have been taken since 2021 to improve care for people with eating disorders, including the effects of the 2021 €50m acute youth mental health funding, the status of regional expertise networks and Gezondheidsraad recommendations, and rising waiting times. The state secretary answers that K-EET networks, information tools and funding were developed, that national figures on treatment capacity are not kept, that waiting times rose due to structural shortages and a broad approach is needed, and points to a 2026 subsidy and other initiatives, without quantified targets or new monitoring commitments.
These figures are not kept at national level.
Deze cijfers worden niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zelfstandig wonen met ADL hulp

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about problems with ADL assistance for people living independently, including staff shortages, poor treatment, and unclear complaint routes. The State Secretary reported about 1,441 clients in 2023, around ten signals, a 6.9% tariff increase, a planned tariff review for 2025, and explained the complaint and oversight procedures (Wkkgz, IGJ, courts) while giving no data on vacancies' future or on 24-hour care gaps beyond general assurances.
I consider it important that ADL assistance is possible 24 hours a day.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er 24 uur per dag ADL assistentie mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over budget voor de ondersteuning van leerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about Rotterdam's special-needs cooperative (PPO Rotterdam) closing its student support budget for 2023-2024, its large reserves, rising truancy, and whether the generic reserve cut and related motions were working. The minister answers that students still get support through school contact persons, the Inspectorate has no signals of students falling through, the budget closed because it was fully spent, and that the reserve cut and follow-up agreements are being monitored and will be reported in the budget debate.
Should students or parents nonetheless have questions about the application stop or the solutions offered, they can contact the relevant school contact person at PPO Rotterdam.

Mochten er onverhoopt toch leerlingen of ouders zijn met vragen over de aanvragenstop of de geboden oplossingsmogelijkheden, dan kunnen zij contact opnemen met de betrokken schoolcontactpersoon van PPO Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over toezicht op WIC te Balkbrug

The MP asks the Minister how the inspectorate (IGJ) has monitored and improved conditions at the WIC shelter in Balkbrug after a warning that it did not meet safe-care standards, and what happens if no improvement is visible. The Minister says the WIC has been taken over by Elah, the last IGJ visit was on 12 May 2023, the IGJ keeps contact with the provider and will continue to follow whether shortcomings are remedied, without giving concrete new enforcement steps.
The inspectorate has maintained interim contact with WIC to monitor progress on the necessary improvements and the takeover process.
De inspectie heeft tussentijds contact met WIC gehouden om voortgang op de benodigde verbeteringen en het overnameproces te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de vergoeding van medische hulpmiddelen die nodig zijn om onderwijs te kunnen volgen

An MP asked whether necessary medical aids for pupils to follow education should be reimbursed, how reimbursement works across schools, insurers and municipalities, and how to reduce bureaucracy and costs for parents. The minister answered that children can obtain aids via the Zvw, Wmo and UWV school provisions, that parents may face co-payments under the Zvw, that the UWV provided 5,168 education provisions worth 30 million euros in 2023, and that insurers are working on uniform rules from 2025.
It is undesirable that parties point at each other and parents thus do not receive reimbursement for (medical) aids.
Het is onwenselijk dat partijen naar elkaar wijzen en ouders zo geen (medische) hulpmiddelen vergoed krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van Westerveld over Samen naar School Klassen

An MP asks the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the number, funding, and failure of Samen naar Schoolklassen initiatives, age limits, legal barriers to secondary enrolment, and the status of the Westerveld-Kwint motion. The Minister says the number of initiatives is not centrally recorded but exceeds 50, that no specific funding rules exist, that the handreiking and NSGK support are in place, and that secondary-level options and possible legislative changes will be explored.
The number of Samen naar Schoolklassen is not centrally registered by the Ministry of OCW, so these are not known.
Het aantal Samen naar Schoolklassen wordt niet centraal door het Ministerie van OCW geregistreerd, dus deze zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over nieuwe misstanden en toezicht bij zorgboerderijen

MP Westerveld asks the minister about abuses at care farms (Aurora Borealis, Zonnehoeve, United Souls), inspection capacity, PGB-financed care, support for victims and financial transparency of care providers. The minister answers that inspection has been expanded, recounts how the GGD and IGJ handled Zonnehoeve, and announces measures on PGB wooninitiatieven and integrity of financial management while noting that some answers defer to other bodies.
The IGJ is currently investigating the content of these reports and will determine any follow-up actions based on its investigation.
De IGJ onderzoekt op dit moment de inhoud van deze meldingen. Zij zal op basis van haar onderzoek eventuele vervolgacties bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Kwijtschelding studieschuld voor medische gronden

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the number and handling of requests to write off student debt on medical grounds, the criteria used, the processing delays, privacy safeguards and the role of medical advisers. The minister reports a backlog of about 800 applications and processing times of 12 to 14 months, explains the narrow criteria and the discretionary hardship clause, and describes measures to speed up decisions, but gives limited detail on some points such as applicant time investment and does not change the rules.
DUO also faces a sharp increase in the number of applications.
DUO heeft daarnaast te maken met een sterke toename van het aantal aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Renny wordt verwaarloosd in zorginstelling: ‘Onbeschrijflijk lijden’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that a client named Renny was neglected in a care institution, whether this affects other clients, why a 2019 CCE consultation report was not followed up, and whether the IGJ has enough capacity to oversee such cases. The minister answers that the care provider is working on improvement, that the IGJ is informed and prioritises on risk, and declines to give exact numbers of affected clients or of unfollowed reports.
The IGJ makes no further statements about ongoing supervision or reports.
Over lopend toezicht/meldingen doet de IGJ geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply. The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over inclusief onderwijs

An MP asks how the Inspectorate of Education takes inclusive education into account in its supervision, whether inspection frameworks and the new basic skills standard disadvantage small schools or schools moving toward inclusion, and whether schools exempt pupils from the transition test to protect their scores. The minister answers that existing legal standards already reflect inclusion, that exemptions must be justified and are unwelcome, and that supervision, funding and rules will be reviewed with the sector as part of the route to inclusive education by 2035.
If a pupil wrongly does not take part, this can have consequences for the rating on standard OP6 Completion and possibly for standard OR1 Results.
Als een leerling onterecht niet meedoet, kan dit consequenties hebben voor het oordeel op de standaard OP6 Afsluiting en mogelijk voor de standaard OR1 Resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het stoppen van basis geestelijke gezondheidszorg door een grote zorgaanbieder

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister how the regional mental health care provider Lentis's decision to stop basic mental health care in Groningen would affect patients and capacity, and why regional bodies were not informed. The minister acknowledged the decision, said Lentis no longer accepts new basic care clients and referred patients elsewhere, and said that oversight of regional capacity is primarily the task of health insurers, not the Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Tseggai over restitutie les- en cursusgeld mbo-studenten

MPs Westerveld and Tseggai asked why mbo students, unlike hbo and wo students, generally do not receive automatic refunds of tuition fees when they leave their studies early, and about related follow-up on a promised exploration, the use of unrefunded fees, and support needs. The minister answered that mbo refunds are available only under specific conditions such as serious illness, that the difference reflects the aim of encouraging a starting qualification, and that changing the policy is not feasible for 2024–2025 and is left to the next cabinet.
It is not feasible to realise this for the 2024–2025 study year.
Het is niet haalbaar om dit te realiseren voor het studiejaar 2024–2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer meldingen van seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de zorg'

MP Westerveld asked the health minister about rising reports of sexual boundary violations in care, the split between PGB and in-kind care, inspection capacity, and support for victims. The minister answered that the IGJ cannot separate reports by funding type, that the IGJ has 6 extra inspectors, and that the Voortgangsrapportage explains how the motions will be implemented.
This means that the split in the reports you requested cannot be provided.
Dit betekent dat de door u gevraagde splitsing in de meldingen niet te geven is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over de individuele studietoeslag

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked how municipalities grant the individual study allowance under the Participatiewet, whether it is withheld when students spend part of a compulsory curriculum abroad, and whether it should continue in that case. The minister explains the allowance's purpose, notes the government lacks a full picture of municipal decisions, states that a student keeps the right abroad unless the main residence has moved, and says students with a disability should be enabled to gain study-related experience abroad without unnecessary barriers.
It is up to the municipality to assess this.
Het is aan de gemeente om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Westerveld over het gebruik van de term ‘ras’ in de gezondheidszorg

MPs White and Westerveld asked the minister about the use of the term 'race' in health care after a news report that medical guidelines still use it, and whether this risks misdiagnosis and unequal care. The minister agreed etnicity must never justify worse care and should only be used for guidelines when solidly evidence-based, but said a broad check of all medical bodies is not feasible and that discrimination risks exist across the sector, pointing to an existing VWS anti-discrimination programme.
A broad check on all medical institutions is not feasible.
Een brede check op alle medische instanties is niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen en voorzieningen voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asks the Minister of Health about repair delays for mobility aids, the legal service standards that apply, whether a single desk or a hire pool should be set up, and tax and subsidy arrangements for aids. The Minister says no statutory repair deadlines will be introduced, responsibility lies with insurers, municipalities and care offices, and she will urge those parties to clarify their arrangements.
I will call on these parties to make the arrangements they make more transparent to users of aids.
Ik zal deze partijen oproepen de afspraken die zij maken beter inzichtelijk te maken voor de gebruikers van hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
