Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Tom Klaassen belandde in een ‘zorgvacuüm’ en stierf terwijl nog overlegd werd wie hem moest helpen'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked about the lack of care for complex psychiatric patients with addiction, the removal of facilities, palliative care as a suggested solution, a confidential mental health report, and funding. The Minister acknowledges gaps in integrated treatment but disputes many claims, points to existing programmes, rejects palliative care as a substitute for shortfalls, and says the NZa will be asked to look at funding again later.
No national data is collected on the local supply of the various types of shelter places and facilities for people with addiction problems.
Over het lokale aanbod van de verschillende soorten opvangplekken en voorzieningen voor mensen met verslavingsproblematiek wordt geen landelijke data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over de geplande toewijzing van het WK mannenvoetbal in 2034 aan Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked the government about human rights concerns (migrant workers, women, LGBTQI people, press freedom) tied to the planned 2034 men's World Cup award to Saudi Arabia and what the Netherlands would do. The minister acknowledged these concerns, pointed to ongoing human rights dialogue and FIFA requirements in the bid book, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue, but did not commit to a concrete new step regarding the award itself.

The cabinet considers it important that the bid book addresses Saudi Arabia's commitment to the human rights conditions set by FIFA and how it will meet them, and that this commitment is assessed technically.

Het kabinet acht het van belang dat het bidbook ingaat op de inzet van Saoedi-Arabië ten aanzien van de door de FIFA gestelde mensenrechtenvoorwaarden en hoe hieraan te voldoen, en dat deze inzet technisch wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: 'Ik voel me een schooier''

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked about a family with a chronically ill child forced to move because municipal refusal to fully fund home adaptations and rising care costs, and about VN-verdrag Handicap compliance. The minister says Wmo 2015 allows adaptations and municipalities weigh alternatives including relocation allowances, declines to change the law, and gives no data on parents' financial problems or on how many use each scheme.
No, as stated in my answer to question 2, home adaptations can be reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen vanuit de Wmo 2015 woningaanpassingen worden vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Grote jeugdzorgorganisatie investeert miljoenen in bedrijven van eigen adviseur, ondanks megaverlies'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a press report on a large youth care organisation investing millions in companies of its own adviser despite heavy losses, and about poor inspection findings at its Zetten secure youth facility, including use of restraint measures, staff shortages, safety and complaints, and governance conflicts of interest. The government answers that it shares concern, that no unlawfulness can be established from the article, that the inspectorate and accountant had no direct reason to intervene, that Zetten is improving under the inspectorate's watch, and points to the Wibz bill to strengthen external oversight of integrity.
The IGJ cannot give information about ongoing supervision.
Over een lopend toezicht kan de IGJ geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over het bericht 'Percentage kinderen zonder zwemdiploma verdubbeld'

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked the minister about the doubling of children without swimming diplomas between 2018 and 2022 and what policy is being taken. The minister agreed the trend is undesirable and listed initiatives (Nationaal Plan Zwemveiligheid, Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, teacher and pool support, plans with municipalities expected in autumn), without a single definitive solution.
I expect to be able to inform you in the autumn about the plan at municipal level.
Ik verwacht u in het najaar te kunnen informeren over het plan op gemeenteniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over de afname van het aantal restitutiepolissen

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, the effects on GGZ and district nursing care, contracting transparency and patient protection. The minister answered that the number of restitution policies fell from 25 in 2010 to 4 in 2024, attributed mainly to high declared costs, and defended natura and combination policies while promising improved contracting information via NZa.
The NZa will evaluate the contracting process for 2024.
De NZa zal het contracteerproces voor 2024 evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Elk jaar stoppen tienduizenden jongeren zonder diploma met school'.

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Education about reports of tens of thousands of youths dropping out of school yearly, the lack of orientation programmes in vocational education (mbo), and related issues such as pilot design, the binding study advice, and personal development. Minister Dijkgraaf answered most questions substantively, explaining that orientation programmes will be set up within existing law, a policy rule is forthcoming, funding of EUR 14 million per year is available during the pilot, and evaluation will follow.
I do not have a precise picture of the number of students participating in orientation programmes.
Een scherp beeld van het aantal studenten dat deelneemt aan oriëntatieprogramma's heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over beleid voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asked the minister about listening to people with intellectual disabilities, shrinking recreational activities in institutions due to staff shortages and lost funding, and subsidies for outings. The minister answered that consultation rules exist and IGJ oversees them, that outings fall largely outside the ministry's responsibility, and that she will work toward accessible leisure through the National Strategy.
Parties such as the Witte Bedjes Sinterklaas party and the Maak de Droom Waar concert were not organised by my ministry.
Feesten zoals de Witte Bedjes Sinterklaasfeest en het concert van «Maak de Droom Waar» zijn niet door mijn ministerie georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht ‘Opera Zuid luidt noodklok: ‘Reële kans dat we verdwijnen’’

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked whether the state secretary will ensure Opera Zuid's survival given rising wage costs and its limited subsidy share. The state secretary declines extra funding, says the three opera functions and subsidy ceilings are set, and defers the assessment to the Raad voor Cultuur.
I see no room to provide additional support to one or more institutions.
Ik zie geen ruimte om een of meer instellingen extra te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het artikel '‘Verstoorde arbeidsverhouding’ als ontslaggrond ondermijnt sociale veiligheid’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about the use of the 'disrupted working relationship' dismissal ground, its relevance for dismissals in education and for social safety, and whether the employer's culpability plays a role. The minister answered that data on the ground is not registered, that the employer's culpability can weigh in but is not decisive, that no separate research on education is planned, and pointed to existing workplace safety measures and a forthcoming handbook for employers.
This ground is not always explicitly mentioned in the request and is therefore not registered as such.
Deze grond wordt niet altijd expliciet in het verzoek genoemd en wordt dan dus ook niet als zodanig geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het bericht dat twee op de drie werkende Nederlanders zich niet door zijn werkgever gestimuleerd voelen om zichzelf te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van e

MPs Westerveld and Kathmann asked whether workers should receive a lifelong personal learning budget, how government can encourage employers to stimulate training, and how to reduce learning reluctance among practically educated workers, citing STAP-budget lessons. The ministers answer that lifelong learning is important, that employers bear primary responsibility, point to existing schemes (SLIM, leercultuur, LLO collectief, levenlanglerenkrediet) and say a personal learning budget is a decision for the next cabinet, referring to a November 2023 exploration.
Weighing the various pros and cons of introducing a development budget and the further decision-making on it is up to a next cabinet.
Het afwegen van de diverse voor- en nadelen van invoering van een ontwikkelbudget en de verdere besluitvorming daarover is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onrust op de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven over de groeiende invloed van het bedrijfsleven op onderzoek aan de universiteit

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about unrest at TU Eindhoven over growing business influence on research, including academic freedom, governance and supervisory board independence, and the open letter on criticism. The Minister rejected the analysis of structural governance failure, argued existing safeguards and KNAW/Rathenau-type frameworks suffice, and promised no new fund or specific action beyond general reflection.
I do not share your analysis.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over toenemende online lhbti+-haat naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Tijd voor geweld tegen deze lui'

GroenLinks MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked the government about rising online hostility toward LGBTQI+ people, including whether platforms should be responsible, what the DSA and DMA require, and how the government will tackle online hate. The government answered that it finds the trends worrying, lists existing measures (reporting office, DSA obligations, interdepartmental approach, prevention campaigns), and says it is still evaluating policy and awaiting further research.
The cabinet is currently evaluating the measures from the LGBTI Safety Action Plan 2019–2022.
Het kabinet evalueert momenteel de maatregelen uit het Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI 2019–2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cursor op zwart'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the dismissal of the Cursor editor-in-chief at TU Eindhoven and alleged pressure on the independence of university newspapers. The Minister says journalistic independence is a great good, finds the situation undesirable, notes an integrity-commission investigation into alleged censorship at TU/e, and declines to start a broader investigation for now.

I consider it up to the Executive Board, as publisher of Cursor, the editorial board and the Cursor editorial staff to discuss with each other the editorial statute, especially in light of what has happened.

Ik vind het aan het College van Bestuur, als uitgever van Cursor, de redactieraad en de redactie van Cursor om, te meer naar aanleiding van hetgeen is voorgevallen, met elkaar het gesprek te voeren over het redactiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Koerhuis, Van der Plas enWesterveld over dreigende huisuitzettingen van weeskinderen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew of threatened evictions of at least five orphaned young adults from social rental homes before the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act takes effect, and how to prevent them and hold housing corporations to the law's spirit. The minister agreed such evictions must be prevented, said corporations should already act in the spirit of the law and that she is in close contact with Aedes to find solutions, and targets entry into force on 1 January 2024.
I am in close contact with Aedes to ensure a suitable solution in the spirit of the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act in the situations mentioned.
Ik heb nauw contact met Aedes om in de genoemde situaties te zorgen voor een passende oplossing in de geest van de Wet huurbescherming weeskinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de misstanden bij Woodbrookers

An MP asks the state secretary for health about serious abuses at the youth care institution Woodbrookers, including a confidential report, painful restraint techniques, missed incident reporting and possible rights violations of youths. The government answers that Jeugdhulp Friesland has an improvement plan under IGJ monitoring, that the institution will stop closed youth care in its current form by July 2024, and that the inspectorate has brought forward its supervision.
Such an investigation commissioned by the IGJ is in principle never made public.
Een dergelijk onderzoek in opdracht van de IGJ wordt in beginsel nooit openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Peters, Kwint, Beertema, Westerveld en Van der Plas over carnaval en de afname van de doorstroomtoets

Six MPs asked the minister why the doorstroomtoets (transition test) was not moved around the carnival period and whether an extra week could be granted to carnival regions. The minister answered that after a stakeholder meeting the test window was extended from two to three weeks, with the extension for 2024 applied to the digital test and to be codified in law after that, while the test timing will be evaluated later.
Based on that conversation, I have decided to extend the period in which schools can administer a transition test from two to three weeks.
Op grond van dat gesprek heb ik besloten de periode waarin scholen een doorstroomtoets kunnen afnemen van twee naar drie weken te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de hoogte van het collegegeld voor Oekraïense studenten

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education about tuition fees for Ukrainian students, whether institutions should lower fees for new Ukrainian students, the financial consequences, and the number of students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that fee-setting is for individual institutions, that he stands by his call for lower fees, that no separate financial scheme will be created, and that the wider financing question is left to a new cabinet.
I do not intend to set up a financial scheme for this group because it concerns the competence and responsibility of the institution.
Ik ben niet voornemens een financiële regeling voor deze groep op te zetten omdat het hier de bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over "pgb-zorgverleners zonder sociaal vangnet”

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) care workers without social safety nets, including family carers, should receive unemployment, sick-pay and disability benefits after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and what would be done. The minister answered that the ruling covers only employment-contract workers under the Rdah, that family carers working on service contracts lack an employment relationship and are excluded, that possible solutions are being explored with a decision expected in autumn, and that extending benefits to the excluded group would cost about 115 million euro structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Bedreigd maritiem erfgoed

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the illegally salvaged Palmhout shipwreck, the state of Dutch maritime heritage research, the budget for in situ protection, and a proposed maritime archaeology institute under NIOZ. The State Secretary condemned the unlicensed salvage, reported agreements with divers and increased enforcement capacity, and said the €1.5 million annual budget suffices for monitoring but not for excavation, while committing to a further exploration of the wreck by the RCE.
I have indeed followed this case.
Ik heb deze casus inderdaad gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het artikel “Betaald voetbal predikte loonmatiging tijdens corona, maar spelers kregen meer”.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Eredivisie clubs that received NOW wage subsidies while promising wage restraint had acted improperly, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that loonmatiging was not a NOW condition, that UWV checks eligibility and may reclaim subsidy in case of non-compliance with NOW rules, and that no sector-specific agreements with the KNVB or clubs existed.
Wage restraint was not a condition for the NOW and is therefore not a relevant factor in the determination.
Loonmatiging was geen voorwaarde voor de NOW en is dus geen relevante factor in de vaststelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de toename van obesitas onder jongeren

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary and Minister of Health about rising obesity among young people, the cost of overweight, lapsed prevention targets from the 2018 Prevention Agreement, sports affordability, and healthy food in institutions. The government answers that obesity is a complex problem requiring many measures, that the 2040 targets have not yet been declared failed, and that it is continuing and extending prevention policy with extra funds, though several specific measures have not been implemented yet.
The cabinet continues the goals of the Prevention Agreement and has made extra funds available to intensify the effort on overweight and obesity.
Het kabinet zet de doelen van het NPA voort en heeft extra middelen beschikbaar gesteld om de inzet op overgewicht en obesitas te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over zoönoserisico’s en vogelgriep bij mensen

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked about bird flu transmission risks to humans, testing of exposed workers, mixed pig-poultry farms, and the adequacy of voluntary spatial measures under the NPLG. The minister answered that no human infections have been found in the Netherlands, that proactive surveillance of exposed workers starts in summer 2023, and that further research and a plan on mixed farms are under way, with spatial rules being explored rather than binding now.
Surveillance in this group is expected to be operational from summer 2023.
Naar verwachting is deze surveillance vanaf de zomer van 2023 operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over de subsidiëring van jongerenorganisaties

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked about government subsidies and study-grant (bestuursbeurzen) schemes for youth organisations, including who qualifies, representativeness, rejected applications and the treatment of vocational students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that no integral overview exists, explained the eligibility criteria and rejections, and largely declined to change the scheme's scope beyond planned extensions for mbo students.
There is no integral overview of all youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Er is geen integraal overzicht van alle jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cliënten ggz stappen boos uit overleg: ‘Plan dataverzameling schendt privacy’'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked the minister about MIND leaving the zorgvraagtypering advisory committee and the NZa's plan to collect HoNOS+ data from all ggz patients via opt-out, questioning privacy and consent. The minister replied that the NZa has legal authority to request the data, that patients can object via a privacy declaration, that the NZa will talk with MIND, and that the DSM data will be retained for risk equalisation.
The NZa is legally entitled to request the necessary data.
De NZa is wettelijk gelegitimeerd om de benodigde data op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat veel stagiaires aan lerarenopleidingen geen stagevergoeding krijgen

An MP asks the minister about reports that many teacher-training interns receive no internship allowance, and about the union's survey findings, the motion on minimum allowances, LIO contracts and school boards' agreements. The minister agrees the situation is undesirable, points to the mbo internship pact, ongoing talks on higher education and a forthcoming monitor, and calls on employers and unions to agree on allowances.
I agree that it is undesirable when interns do not receive an appropriate allowance.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat het onwenselijk is wanneer stagiairs geen passende vergoeding krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Werner over toezicht op Persoonsgebonden Budget (PGB)-wooninitiatieven

MPs Westerveld and Werner asked the Minister for Long-term Care about IGJ oversight of PGB-funded housing initiatives after undercover footage revealed abuse at Aurora Borealis, including earlier reports that may not have been recorded. The Minister answered in detail on the handling of reports, inspection timing, staffing cuts, lack of registration of PGB initiatives, and victims' legal aid, stating that the earlier reports could not be found and that the IGJ will hold leadership sessions and expand inspection capacity for 2023–2026.
No explanation has been found for the inability to locate the reports that were allegedly made in November 2020 and June 2022.
Er is geen verklaring gevonden voor het niet terug kunnen vinden van de meldingen die in november 2020 en juni 2022 gedaan zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Racismecoördinator: 'Structurele discriminatie van moslims bij banken'

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the national anti-racism coordinator found structural discrimination of Muslims by banks under the anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), and whether the Wwft is applied in a discriminatory way. The minister said she is shocked, is investigating discriminatory elements with banks, DNB and AFM, will report back in an autumn update, and will first gain a better picture before considering changes to Wwft guidelines.
Following the signals from the NCRD, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Mede naar aanleiding van de signalen van de NCRD, wil ik de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de voortgang van de doelen wat betreft het emancipatiedossier

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about progress on the emancipation agenda, including the Rainbow election accord, discrimination enforcement, LGBTQ+ rights, gender equality in the labour market and related measures. The Minister answered most questions with descriptions of ongoing work, timelines and planned reports to parliament, without withholding requested information.
I am only truly satisfied at the moment that emancipation is accomplished.
Ik ben pas echt tevreden op het moment dat de emancipatie volbracht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het belang van zwemvaardig zijn

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport whether the goal of all children obtaining a swimming diploma by 2025 is still held, how the related motion is being implemented, and about waiting lists, pool closures and access for children with disabilities or low-income families. The minister answers that the ambition holds for children physically able, describes a letter to parliament on implementation and waiting lists, notes thin provision in less urban areas, and reports that no clear negative trend in pool closures is visible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld voor gevluchte Oekraïense studenten

An MP asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences have made national agreements for 2023-2024 so Ukrainian students pay the statutory tuition rate rather than the higher institutional rate, and what is being done for affected students. The minister says the sector bodies agreed to lower institutional tuition for continuing Ukrainian students to the statutory level, that institutions can decide case by case, and that a generic measure will be considered within broader cabinet migration discussions that are not yet concluded.
I call on the institutions to also support this group of students where necessary next academic year, using the current powers they have to do so.
Ik roep de instellingen op om deze groep studenten waar nodig ook volgend studiejaar te ondersteunen vanuit de huidige bevoegdheid die zij daartoe hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Studenten vertraagd door long covid: ‘Ik moest mijn spaargeld opeten voordat ik in de bijstand mocht’'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about students delayed by long covid who must spend savings before receiving welfare, and whether more research and support is needed. The minister acknowledged the problem but said privacy rules prevent counting affected students, pointed to existing hardship funds and non-financial support, and saw no reason for extra measures specifically for long covid students.
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), illness is a special category of personal data.
Ziekte is onder de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) een bijzonder persoonsgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de totstandkoming van de Kamerbrief 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs'

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked how the government letter 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs' on supervision of informal education was prepared, including ministry objections, the role of the Inspectorate, the complaint reporting point and a criminal complaint by Islamic organisations. The ministers answered that advice from officials was considered, that the Landsadvocaat's advice was sought, that the Inspectorate will do signal-based oversight, and that the reporting point operates with privacy safeguards, while noting that the Inspectorate still has concerns and that the Public Prosecutor saw no grounds for investigation.
The Minister for Primary and Secondary Education will take the Inspectorate's persistent concerns into account in further elaborating the bill.
De Minister voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs neemt de aanhoudende zorgen van de inspectie in de verdere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het rapport 'State of play of academic freedom in the EU Member. States Overview of de facto trends and developments'

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will respond to a European Parliament report on academic freedom in the EU, including hierarchical university governance, political steering via funding, temporary contracts, online threats, cancel culture, social safety and critique without fear of retaliation. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that further research (KNAW, DJA, an ongoing study on self-censorship) is underway, that existing funding conditions and accreditation protect independence, and that temporary-contract abuse will be addressed via labour law and more structural funding, with results expected in autumn.

I would like to await the results of the ongoing research into self-censorship, academic freedom and the limitation of diversity of perspectives in research and higher education before deciding on the need to sharpen the concept of academic freedom.
Ik wacht graag de resultaten af van het lopende onderzoek naar zelfcensuur, academische vrijheid en beperking van diversiteit van perspectieven in het onderzoek en hoger onderwijs
Antwoord vragen van het lid Westerveld (GroenLinks) over gesloten jeugdinstellingen

An MP asked the state secretary for health about youth in closed youth care institutions, including involving young people in decisions, outdated facilities, staffing, education, internship discrimination and preparation for age 18. The state secretary answered that he talks with youth during visits, will continue this, will raise facilities and education issues with institutions and municipalities, and will work on education and internship measures.
That is why I always do that when I visit an institution.
Daarom doe ik dat altijd als ik op bezoek kom bij een instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over stadionverboden en geweld tegen voetbalspelers

MP Westerveld asked the Minister of Justice and Security how stadium bans can be enforced without a reporting obligation, how they are enforced, why bans are not nationwide, when reporting obligations apply, and how supporters who threw objects at a cup match will be sanctioned. The minister answered that stadium bans are enforced via ticketing controls, camera surveillance and a KNVB taskforce, that reporting obligations are a local mayoral or prosecutorial matter needing case-by-case assessment, and that about 1,747 people currently hold nationwide bans.
Unfortunately, no figures are available for this.
Helaas zijn hiervan geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Westerveld over de rechtszaak van stichting Farma ter Verantwoording tegen farmaceut AbbVie

MPs Ellemeet and Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Health Minister about excess profits on AbbVie's Humira, the pending lawsuit by Farma ter Verantwoording, price transparency, public R&D funding and a binding duty of care for pharmaceutical firms. The minister said the individual case is sub judice, that the state can set maximum prices but not limit company profits, and pointed to tools such as the pricing gateway, transparency efforts and a joint regulator work agenda, while rejecting a binding duty of care for now.
I will not address the individual case of AbbVie and the drug Humira because the case is before the court.
Op de individuele zaak van AbbVie en het medicijn Humira ga ik niet in omdat de zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over spreekkoren bij de halve finale van de KNVB beker

An MP asked the Minister why the Spakenburg-Westerveld cup semi-final was not stopped over homophobic chants, whether clubs have an incentive not to halt matches, and whether discriminatory chants should be tackled regardless of player impact. The Minister called such chants reprehensible, said the rules are set out in the anti-verbal-abuse guideline and clubs are primarily responsible, and said the approach to homophobic chants needs further development with partners.
Together with partners, I want to build on the 'Our football is for everyone' initiative to focus on setting norms for behaviour in stadiums.

Samen met de partners wil ik in het vervolg op «Ons voetbal is van iedereen. Samen zetten we racisme en discriminatie buitenspel» (OVIVI) hier op inzetten en ons richten op het normeren van gedrag in stadions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat zorginstellingen inkomsten mislopen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether care providers lose income when disabled clients miss day care, whether providers may charge a fee for no-shows, and whether a temporary compensation tariff is possible. The minister replied that no-show costs are already built into tariffs, that providers may agree a contribution to reduce avoidable absence, and that tariffs will be adjusted through the NZa cost study from 2025.
I am not aware how many care institutions are currently facing reduced income because clients attend day care less often.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel zorginstellingen momenteel met verminderde inkomsten te maken hebben, omdat cliënten minder vaak naar hun dagbesteding gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over de werkwijze van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO)

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee ask whether DUO misuses the Passport Act to list former students abroad and whether a former student must repay study finance despite timely graduation. The minister denies misuse, explains the conditions for passport signalling, says the hardship clause is theoretically available, and promises a review of statutory deadlines.
I intend to conduct a study into the various deadlines in the law and whether they still fit how we now view our citizens and their capacity to act.
Ik ben voornemens om een onderzoek te doen naar de verschillende termijnen in de wet en of die nog passen bij hoe we nu naar onze burgers kijken en hun doenvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het toezicht op PGB wooninitiatieven

Westerveld asked the minister about IGJ oversight of PGB-funded residential initiatives, the timing of the IGJ's knowledge of abuses at Aurora Borealis, victim support, and the IGJ budget cut. The minister answered that the IGJ was first alerted on 3 October 2022, visited on 14 December, that oversight is shared with care offices, that no national register of PGB residences exists, and that a 5 million euro budget reduction was general and not tied to staff cuts.
There is no registration of PGB-financed residential initiatives.
Er is geen registratie van pgb-gefinancierde wooninitiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de verkrijgbaarheid van plastic rietjes voor medisch gebruik

An MP asked the minister whether the EU single-use plastics ban has made plastic straws for medical use, including 40 cm straws, hard to obtain, and what will be done for people who depend on them. The minister answered that an enforcement waiver keeps straws available via pharmacies, drugstores and wholesalers, that the national decree will be amended to drop the medical-device certification requirement, and that stakeholders will be engaged.
Whether this specifically also applies to 40 cm straws is not known to me.
Of dit specifiek ook geldt voor rietjes van 40cm is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het sluiten van zorglocaties voor mensen die intensieve zorg nodig hebben

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about Pluryn's plan to close two care locations in Horst for residents with intensive care needs, questioning the impact on relocation, social networks, and the financial rationale. The Minister confirmed awareness, explained the closure stems from long-term losses and staffing problems rather than purely financial motives, and said the provider is working with the care office, families and the municipality to find suitable new places, while declining to guarantee residence in Horst and stating no need for new housing-protection research.
I will discuss this topic in consultations with representatives of client organisations, care providers and care offices and ask them to share any signals with me.
Ik zal dit onderwerp bespreken in overleggen met vertegenwoordigers van cliëntenorganisaties, zorgaanbieders en zorgkantoren en vragen om eventuele signalen met mij te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Westerveld en Van den Hil  over het sluiten van Emergis

MPs Van den Berg, Westerveld and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the closure of the autism clinic at Emergis, the availability of ggz beds and outpatient places, definitions of crucial mental health care, GP practice support staff and the zorgprestatiemodel tariffs. The minister answered that regional overviews and an inventory of crucial ggz are being compiled, that bed-level data per patient group is not available, and that remaining patients will be placed at Emergis or in their own region.
Meanwhile the IZA parties are working to map the match between supply and demand of care in the regional pictures.
Wel werken de IZA-partijen aan het in beeld krijgen van de aansluiting van vraag en aanbod van zorg in de regiobeelden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Mohandis, Werner en Sylvana Simons over het ratificeren van het facultatief protocol bij het VN-verdrag voor rechten van mensen met een beperking

Five MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether she would keep her promise to decide by the end of Q1 2023 on ratifying the optional protocol to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and to give clarity within a week. The minister confirmed the commitment, explained that the decision requires broad consultation across the cabinet because the Council of State advised on related protocols, and promised the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023.
My aim is to send you the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023 at the latest.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om u uiterlijk medio mei 2023 het kabinetsbesluit te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kröger over het bericht ‘Studenten eisen dat UvA banden verbreekt met Shell, bezetten universiteitsgebouw’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether fossil-industry research funding (Shell at UvA) is compatible with research integrity codes, what frameworks govern public-private partnerships, and whether universities should cut ties with Shell. The minister answered that universities are autonomous under academic freedom, cited the NGWI code under evaluation and existing independence frameworks, and declined to set content-based restrictions on partnerships.
On the basis of these freedoms, it is not possible to steer substantively the public-private partnerships universities enter into, and no frameworks can be set that infringe on academic freedom.

Op basis van deze vrijheden kan niet inhoudelijk gestuurd worden op de publiek-private samenwerkingen die universiteiten aangaan en kunnen geen kaders gesteld worden die inbreuk maken op de academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Miljoenentekort voor magneten- en laserlab HFML-FELIX, personeel kampt met hoge werkdruk

An MP asked the minister about a multi-million euro funding shortfall for the HFML-FELIX magnet and laser lab, which is currently financed from the Radboud University science faculty pending a structural NWO solution, and about workload pressure on staff. The minister answered that NWO and Radboud are discussing continued funding, that he will inform parliament this year, that funding stability is primarily for the institutions, and that the future institute status is for NWO to decide.
Currently NWO and Radboud University are discussing the possibilities to continue the cooperation and funding. I will inform your House this year about the solution.
Momenteel bespreken NWO en de Radboud Universiteit de mogelijkheden om de samenwerking en financiering voort te zetten. Ik zal uw Kamer dit jaar informeren over de oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poliklinieken moeten patiënten met postcovid weigeren, de zorg is niet meer te betalen’

MPs asked the Minister of Health about news that two academic post-COVID clinics would stop accepting patients because standard reimbursements do not cover costs, and about research funding. The Minister said reimbursement is a matter between hospitals and insurers, that no proven effective treatment yet exists, that over 14 million euros has been allocated to research, a knowledge agenda is due in 2023, and extra budget for multi-year research and an expertise centre is planned.
I expect to be able to give definitive clarity on this in May and will then inform your House.
Ik verwacht daarover in mei definitief uitstelsel te kunnen geven en zal uw Kamer daarover dan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld bij deeltijdstudies in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked whether institutions may charge two times the institutional tuition for two-year part-time programmes, including teacher training, and how a motion on institutional tuition is being implemented. The minister answered that institutions set institutional tuition, that it should not exceed the cost-covering rate, that a subsidy exists for second teacher training, and that the bill is still under consideration.
I am of the view that the institutional tuition fee for a Dutch student taking a second study should not be higher than the cost-covering rate.
Ik ben van mening dat de hoogte van het instellingscollegegeld voor een Nederlandse student die een tweede studie volgt niet hoger zou moeten zijn dan het kostendekkende tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een meldplicht bij stadionverboden

An MP asks whether repeat stadium offenders who already have a stadium ban should routinely also receive a reporting obligation (meldplicht), and why this is not standard practice, plus an update on the digital reporting pilot. The Minister answers that a meldplicht is a mayoral or judicial decision requiring case-by-case proportionality, that routine imposition is neither feasible nor desirable, and that the digital app prototype is still in development with a decision on the next phase expected around summer.
Routinely imposing a reporting obligation is however neither feasible nor desirable and always requires tailored assessment.
Het standaard opleggen van een meldplicht is echter niet haalbaar en niet wenselijk en vereist altijd maatwerk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog altijd homoseksualiteit afwijzen en identiteitsverklaringen hanteren

MPs De Hoop, Kwint and Westerveld asked why reformed schools still use identity declarations rejecting homosexuality, and how this fits with the Inspectorate lifting extra supervision at Gomarus. Minister Wiersma answered that such declarations are not yet banned, that she finds conditioning admission on signing them undesirable, that the Inspectorate will intervene where pupils are rejected, and that she is studying how to implement the motions to ban such declarations, to be reported later this year.
I do not consider it desirable for schools to express themselves in this way and to make admission conditional on signing such a declaration.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat scholen zich op deze wijze uitdrukken en toelating voorwaardelijk maken op het ondertekenen van zo'n verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het verdwijnen van specialistische ggz behandelplekken

An MP asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport about the closure of specialist mental health treatment places and patients stuck on waiting lists, and whether the IGJ should investigate care quality. The minister answered that patients should contact their health insurer for care mediation, that the IGJ saw no reason for further investigation, that a proposal to stop competitive tendering of crucial mental health care is being reviewed, and that workforce programmes are underway.
The IGJ has taken these signals into account in its supervision of how the care providers concerned have fulfilled their duty of care.
De IGJ heeft deze signalen meegenomen in het toezicht naar hoe de betreffende zorgaanbieders de zorgplichten hebben uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het voortduren van het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger, Westerveld and Piri asked about the continuing shortfall in education for children in asylum reception facilities, including delays, placement policy and whether gaps are structurally addressed. The State Secretary answered that data on children missing schooling is not yet available, that placement of families in crisis emergency shelters is undesirable but cannot always be refused, and that a bill and evaluations are in preparation.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Slechtzienden blijven thuis door ov-staking: zorgen over actie op verkiezingsdag’

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how far blind and partially sighted voters must travel to vote, how many polling stations are accessible to them, how many voters would be affected by a public transport strike on election day, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that accessibility varies by municipality, that the government urged unions not to strike on election day and asked VNG municipalities to arrange alternative transport, while stating the Kieswet offers no basis for home voting or early voting.
I have urged the VNG municipalities to try to offer alternative transport to voters who need it because of a possible strike.
Ik heb met de VNG gemeenten opgeroepen om te proberen alternatief vervoer aan te bieden voor de kiezers die dat vanwege een mogelijke staking nodig hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over huishoudelijke hulp

An MP asks the minister about shortages and waiting lists for domestic help (huishoudelijke hulp), the failure to meet the six-week decision norm, and what is being done about the shortages and the planned personal contribution. The minister answers that the number of clients rose about 30% to 2021, that no national waiting-list picture exists, that the planned contribution is expected to reduce demand by about 30,000 clients, and that municipalities are responsible for local measures.
There is no national picture of waiting lists for domestic help.
Er bestaat geen landelijk beeld van wachtlijsten voor huishoudelijke hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Paniek en slaapgebrek door tijdelijke contracten in wetenschap’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports of precarious temporary contracts in academia, including repeated short contracts, job-grading practices and braindrain. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to structural investments and sector plan conditions favouring permanent contracts, but said legal bans on successive contracts are not within his remit and that universities are autonomous employers.
I have not mapped whether, and if so which, institutions apply the practice mentioned in the question, and from my system responsibility I have no role in mapping it.
Ik heb niet in kaart of en, zo ja, welke instellingen de in de vraag genoemde werkwijze hanteren en heb vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid ook geen rol bij het in kaart brengen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Systeemfout in de financiering is een belangrijke oorzaak van dodelijke ggz-wachtlijsten'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that risk equalisation in the Dutch mental health system makes insurers reluctant to cover severely ill mental health patients, and about options to address it. The minister replied that exceptional high-cost compensation for severe mental health patients was introduced in 2020 and raised to 90% in 2021, that further research is planned, and that alternative models and ex-post equalisation would reduce insurers' efficiency incentives.
As we explain in answer 5, it was chosen to have health insurers bear considerably less risk over the costs of the most expensive mental health patients, as an exception.
Zoals wij in antwoord 5 toelichten, is gekozen om zorgverzekeraars bij uitzondering beduidend minder risico te laten lopen over de kosten van de duurste ggz-patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Westerveld en Kwint over Wob documenten aangaande de aanschaf van De vaandeldrager en de informatiepositie van de Staten-Generaal

MPs Teunissen, Westerveld and Kwint asked why the 2018 Call Option Agreement for De Vaandeldrager, the expired 165 million euro option, was not shared with parliament, why parts of documents were redacted, and whether parliament was fully informed before approving the purchase. The State Secretary answered that the option had already expired, the agreement was confidential and not a state contract, the redactions protected the state's negotiating position, and parliament was informed as fully as possible.
Therefore the Sale and Purchase Agreement will be placed confidentially for inspection shortly so committee members can still take note of it.
Daarom zal de Sale and Purchase Agreement op korte termijn vertrouwelijk ter inzage worden gelegd zodat de commissieleden hier alsnog kennis van kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over studenten met Long COVID

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Ministers of Health and of Education about students with Long COVID, including their numbers, dropout, unequal support across institutions, access to and funding of the profileringsfonds and mbo student fund, and reintegration and benefit entitlements. The minister replied that institutions cannot record students' illnesses under the GDPR, that much information is unavailable or pending RIVM research, and that existing rules and institutional support apply, with no new concrete measures announced.
Institutions may not, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), inquire about a student's medical condition.
Instellingen mogen i.v.m. de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) niet informeren naar het ziektebeeld van een student.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Groene GGZ

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the Groene GGZ initiative, nature-based care in mental health, and funding for green approaches to ease pressure on specialist mental health care. The minister answered that sustainability measures exist under the Green Deal and subsidies, but that green-care approaches are for care professionals to judge and receive no specific national subsidy, with sector plans and budgets for the Green Deal still to be developed.
It is up to care professionals to judge whether such deployment can be a valuable addition to the current care offer and working practice.
Het is aan de zorgprofessionals om te beoordelen of een dergelijke inzet een waardevolle aanvulling kan zijn op het huidige zorgaanbod en werkpraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het verdwijnen van specialistische GGZ behandelplekken

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asks the minister about the closure and downsizing of specialist mental health beds, the lack of data on high-complexity care, continuity of care for patients from closed clinics, and the NZa's conclusion that the duty of care was not breached. Minister Kuipers responds that the bed numbers are hard to verify, points to Integraal Zorgakkoord agreements on mapping crucial mental health care, reports that IGJ and NZa received few signals about inadequate replacement care, and defends the ambulantisation policy.
It is up to the NZa, in its role as supervisor, to establish whether the duty of care has been met.
Het is aan de NZa in haar rol als toezichthouders om vast te stellen of er aan de zorgplicht is voldaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Westerveld over het schrappen van honderden banen van jeugdhulpverleners in Limburg

An MP asked the state secretary about Xonar's financial trouble, job cuts among youth care workers in Limburg, when the ministry knew, and how care continuity and oversight are ensured. The state secretary answered that Xonar is at escalation level 3 of the continuity protocol, that a recovery plan is being drafted, that municipalities hold the legal responsibility for adequate youth care, and that several questions cannot be answered further because the process is ongoing.
Because the process is ongoing, I cannot go further into this specific case.
Omwille van het lopende proces kan ik niet verder op deze specifieke casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de eetstoornis ARFID

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about ARFID, an eating disorder: prevalence, treatment capacity, professional training, GP and youth-care knowledge, parent information, and whether free school meals account for it. The State Secretary answered that prevalence and treatment numbers are not known, outlined existing training, guidelines and information websites, and said school meals would be voluntary with school-level arrangements for individual pupils.
It is not known how many children and adults currently receive treatment for ARFID or are on a waiting list specifically for ARFID treatment.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderen en volwassenen momenteel een behandeling voor ARFID krijgen of op een wachtlijst staan specifiek voor een behandeling van ARFID.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Westerveld over het STAP-budget

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about training-subsidy (STAP) budget being captured by course providers through price rises and marketing, and whether the budget should target labour shortages in energy, education and care. The government acknowledges misuse signals, promises price checks, a cap on subsidies per course, a gift/affiliate marketing review, and a study of prioritising shortage sectors, while declining to commit to specific price agreements or a fixed budget split.
Your House will be informed early next year about the outcome and the further approach to this.
Uw Kamer wordt begin volgend jaar geïnformeerd over uitkomst en de verdere aanpak hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over Bijlesbureaus die misbruik maken van ouders

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about commercial tutoring agencies pressuring parents, whether the Chamber's earlier motion against advertising via schools has been implemented, and what rules apply to tutors. The minister acknowledges the problem, promises stricter sector guidelines, a VOG requirement bill, and a monitor, but gives no firm timeline and has not answered the questions before the budget debate.
I will introduce a bill for internet consultation this winter stating that schools may only hire staff from providers of supplementary education who hold a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Daarom breng ik nog deze winter een wetsvoorstel in internetconsultatie waarin staat dat scholen alleen personeel van aanbieders van aanvullend onderwijs mogen inhuren die een VOG bezitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Maatoug, Westerveld en Ellemeet over de inhuur van externe arbeid in publieke sectoren

MPs Maatoug, Westerveld and Ellemeet asked ministers about the use of external and flexible labour in the public and semi-public sectors, its effect on care quality and costs, and government steps to curb it. The government answered that it is pursuing measures to make employment under contract more attractive, tighten rules on self-employment and monitor agency and tariff arrangements, while stating it cannot provide sector-level data on many questions.
Apart from the figures below on external hiring within central government, education and care and welfare, no data are kept for (semi-)public sub-sectors.
Behalve onderstaande cijfers over inhuur van externe arbeid binnen de Rijksoverheid, het onderwijs en zorg en welzijn, worden geen data bijgehouden voor (semi)-publieke (deel)sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over terhandstellingskosten

MPs Westerveld and Ellemeet asked whether pharmacy dispensing fees (terhandstellingskosten), which can exceed the cost of small-quantity medicines, can be capped nationally or excluded from the deductible. The minister replied that pharmacy tariffs are free, so no national caps are set, that excluding dispensing fees from the deductible is not desirable, and pointed to existing measures such as the frozen deductible and the capped cost-sharing for medicines.
I do not consider it desirable to exclude dispensing from the deductible, even in the case of repeated dispensing to the same patient.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de terhandstelling uit te zonderen van het eigen risico, ook niet als het gaat om herhaalde terhandstellingen bij dezelfde patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over Iraanse studenten in Nederland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked how many Iranian students and academics are in the Netherlands, how institutions support them amid protests in Iran, and what consequences the protests have for cooperation with Iranian institutions. The minister gave counts (424 Iranian first-nationality HBO and 475 WO students), described existing support services and cooperation, and provided no commitments to new action.
For staff data, educational institutions are bound by privacy legislation. Nationality is a special category of personal data that may not simply be disclosed.
Voor de personeelsgegevens geldt dat onderwijsinstellingen gehouden zijn aan de privacywetgeving. Nationaliteit is een bijzonder persoonsgegeven dat niet zondermeer mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked the government about discriminatory chants at football matches, including why FC Twente did not stop a match over homophobic chants and how often matches are halted. The minister answered that clubs bear primary responsibility, that the rules do not depend on chant duration, that exact figures are not kept, and that he is willing to talk with supporters' groups and plans a follow-up to the OVIVI action plan.
Exact figures are not known and reports are not centrally registered and kept for a longer period.
Exacte cijfers zijn niet bekend en meldingen worden niet centraal geregistreerd en voor langere tijd bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs en zorg

An MP asked the education and health ministers about children with support needs who do not receive suitable education for financial reasons, the tension with inclusive education ambitions, funding of municipalities and specialist providers, and reserves in schools. The minister responded that the government will pursue inclusive education, promised further letters and action plans, and acknowledged that excessive school reserves are undesirable but described them as temporary.
At national level it is not tracked how many children use support hours to follow education, or how many hours this concerns.
Op landelijk niveau wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel kinderen gebruik maken van ondersteuningsuren om onderwijs te volgen, of om hoeveel uren dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de ontwikkelingen omtrent ouderverstoting

Written questions from MP Westerveld on parental alienation and child contact loss asked what the government is doing to implement the Expert Team's recommendations, including on the Scheiden zonder Schade programme and mindset change. Minister Weerwind answers that a new experiment 'Een goed begin' with a Scheidingsadviesteam is running, that no current figures on child contact loss exist, and that concrete agreements and further letters to Parliament are still forthcoming.
There are no current figures on the number of children who no longer see one of their parents.
Er zijn geen actuele cijfers over het aantal kinderen dat één van beide ouders niet meer ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de misstanden bij de Glind en de Tijdelijke regeling financiële tegemoetkoming voor slachtoffers van geweld in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister about abuse at Jeugddorp De Glind, whether investigations are independent, where victims can report, whether perpetrators still work in youth care, criminal prosecution, safety measures, and whether the compensation scheme should be extended beyond 31 December 2022. The government answers that Pluryn will conduct its own investigation, points to existing reporting channels and the IGJ, notes that the scheme ends in December 2022 and that it sees no reason to extend it, and reports 18,955 applications with long processing delays.
I agree that thorough and independent research must be carried out.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat grondig en onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de stijgende gasprijzen voor de culturele en creatieve sector

MPs Wuite and Westerveld asked the state secretary about the effects of rising gas prices on cultural and creative sector institutions such as museums, and what the government will do about energy costs and sustainability. The state secretary says she shares the concerns, points to general energy price measures, the DUMAVA subsidy and advisory programmes, and promises to inform the House on a motion and to consult the sector further.
At present, the impact of rising energy costs on the OCW sectors, including the cultural sector, is being further mapped.
Op dit moment wordt de impact van de stijgende energiekosten op de OCW-sectoren, waaronder de culturele sector, verder in beeld gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld n Bikker  over de aanpak van zelfbenoemde ‘afvalcoaches” en pro-ana websites

MPs Westerveld and Bikker asked the government about self-declared 'afvalcoaches' and pro-ana websites exploiting vulnerable minors, including the lack of progress on an online investigation strategy, capacity, prior warnings, and blocking sites. The Minister answered that a multi-track approach is in place, the police exploration of an online investigation strategy is ongoing with results expected early 2023, individual cases cannot be discussed, and a blanket ban on pro-ana sites is not deemed opportune.
Unfortunately, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Helaas kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Rente over studielening op komst, vooral mbo'ers gaan meer betalen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Education why mbo students face a different interest calculation on student loans than hbo/university students, and whether this is fair. The Minister defends the separate regimes as justified for now, says the rate follows government bond yields, rejects a fixed low rate, and points to income-based repayment and payment-free months as safeguards.

Partly because of my ambition to eliminate differences as much as possible and increase equal opportunity, I choose to keep the more social repayment conditions in higher education with the reintroduction of the basic grant and to also introduce them for mbo students.

Mede vanwege mijn ambitie om de verschillen zo veel mogelijk weg te werken en de kansengelijkheid te vergroten, kies ik ervoor om met de herinvoering van de basisbeurs de socialere terugbetaalvoorwaarden in het ho te laten bestaan en deze ook in te voeren voor mbo-studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de zorgbonus voor pgb-zorgverleners en de tegemoetkoming voor mantelzorgers naar aanleiding van het antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen

An MP asked whether the care bonus for Zvw-pgb care workers over 2020 and 2021 had been arranged, and what the status was. The minister replied that it is not yet arranged, citing privacy and legal-basis obstacles because the SVB lacks visibility of the Zvw-pgb target group, and promised to report in Q1 2023.
This has not yet been arranged.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Studieschuld niet afbetaald? Dan geen paspoort. 'Ik begrijp niet waarom Duo dit doet''

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the ministers about DUO withholding passports from former students with unpaid study debt, including whether this is a fair pressure tool and how often hardship clauses are used. The government answered that DUO uses passport signalling only as a last resort, that the Paspoortwet legally allows it to protect state finances, and that the Staatssecretaris of BZK will evaluate the system.
DUO does not register how often a tailored solution is reached or how often the hardship clause is applied.
DUO registreert niet hoe vaak een maatwerkoplossing getroffen wordt of de hardheidsclausule wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Westerveld over diverse berichten over het disfunctioneren van het ISR en de negatieve gevolgen voor de sporters/sportsters

MPs Van der Laan and Westerveld asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is failing, harming victims of abuse in sport, including former gymnasts. The minister answers that an independent review of sports disciplinary law is underway with results expected in early 2023, that professionalisation measures and additional subsidy conditions are planned, and that the ministry's powers over sports disciplinary law are limited.
I am willing to inform the House in broad outline about the content of the additional subsidy conditions once they have been sent to the institution with the subsidy award.
Ik ben bereid om de Kamer op hoofdlijnen te informeren over de invulling van de aanvullende subsidievoorwaarden zodra deze in de subsidieverlening aan de instelling zijn verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht 'lucratieve bijverdiensten voor fulltime topbestuurders'

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked whether top executives in the (semi-)public sector who earn above the WNT pay cap through side functions as supervisors should be restricted, and about their workload and transparency. The minister answered that the anti-cumulation rule was deliberately limited to executive posts, that no data on cumulative earnings exist, that a public side-function register would add administrative burden, and that the government will examine tightening the rule within a planned WNT amendment.
As part of the planned WNT amendment that the cabinet recently announced, I am willing to examine the pros and cons of further tightening the anti-cumulation provision.

In het kader van de wetswijziging Wnt die ik namens het kabinet onlangs heb aangekondigd, ben ik wel bereid om nader uit te laten zoeken wat de voor- en tegens zijn van het verder aanscherpen van de anticumulatiebepaling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked the Prime Minister why earlier written answers on informing parliament were summary, and whether the government takes parliament's concerns about timely information seriously. The Prime Minister answered that the cabinet stresses timely information, reminded ministries of the rule that documents reach the Tweede Kamer at least a quarter hour before media release, and said each minister must weigh circumstances case by case.

Since 2013 the working agreement for sending documents to the House of Representatives has been that documents must be delivered to the clerks at least a quarter hour before news is released to the media.

Sinds 2013 geldt hiervoor als werkafspraak voor verzending van stukken aan de Tweede Kamer dat stukken minimaal een kwartier voordat door media nieuws naar buiten wordt gebracht dienen te worden aangeleverd bij de griffies
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulphonden

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the coverage of assistance dogs under the Zvw and Wmo, the evidence for dogs for mental health conditions such as PTSS, and the costs, regulation and oversight of dog training schools. Minister Helder answered that only blind-guide, signal and ADL dogs are covered by the basic health insurance, that therapy and PTSS dogs lack sufficient proven effectiveness, that municipalities have discretion under the Wmo, and that regulation of trainers relies on private standards and a pending European norm.
The Zorginstituut will then consider whether these results give reason to carry out an assessment within the framework of the 'state of science and practice'.
Het Zorginstituut zal dan bekijken of deze resultaten aanleiding zijn om een beoordeling te doen in het kader van de «stand van de wetenschap en praktijk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de GGZ

An MP asks the minister about mental health care waiting lists, a reported suicide while waiting, the Inspectorate's investigation, the legal care duty, and staff retention. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to planned measures via the Integraal Zorgakkoord and NZa oversight, declines to publish the inspectorate's findings, and says a waiting time alone is not a legal violation.
Due to the confidentiality (including professional secrecy) of the information and the privacy of those involved, the IGJ has informed me it will not publish the content of the investigation.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid (o.a. beroepsgeheim) van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkenen heeft de IGJ mij laten weten niet over de inhoud van het onderzoek te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Poetin noopt de RUG tot uitbreiden blended onderwijs'

An MP asked whether the government is concerned that a university's expansion of blended online teaching, driven by rising energy prices, undermines in-person education, and what support and sustainability policy applies to education buildings. The minister replied that institutions themselves are responsible for their teaching vision, that compensation via energy tax and price indexation is available, and outlined the sustainability roadmaps and building rules without committing to new funding or changes.
Educational institutions are themselves responsible for their educational vision and quality.
Onderwijsinstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de onderwijsvisie en -kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Westerveld over het bericht 'Hoe ‘pro-anacoaches’ kwetsbare meisjes misbruiken' en de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s. (Kamerstuk 31015-197)

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked about reports of 'pro-ana coaches' sexually exploiting girls with eating disorders, and the implementation of a motion on online investigation strategy and criminalising pro-ana content. The Minister outlines a range of prevention, support and criminal-justice measures already underway, but declines a blanket ban on pro-ana sites and says an online investigation strategy is still being developed, with details promised before summer.
In addition, I have committed to discuss with the police the development of an online investigation strategy.
Daarnaast heb ik toegezegd met de politie in gesprek te gaan over het ontwikkelen van een online opsporingsstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Zonder DigiD lukt zorgen bijna niet'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the difficulty legal representatives and informal carers face handling government matters online, since DigiD is personal and sharing it is prohibited. The government acknowledges the problem, says it is developing a central service to verify representative authority from court registers, and maintains that DigiD must remain personal for protection reasons.

Under my responsibility, a central solution is now being developed which, after a login request by a representative, queries the necessary source registers and issues a declaration to the service provider concerned.

Onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid wordt nu gewerkt aan een centrale oplossing die, na een inlogverzoek door een vertegenwoordiger, de benodigde bronregisters bevraagt en een verklaring afgeeft aan de dienstverlener in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer sterfgevallen door Groningse aardbevingsstress'
