MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the government about a report linking Groningen earthquake stress to possible deaths, and about actions taken, the link to research, psychological effects on residents and children, and the implementation of a motion on children's wellbeing. The state secretary said he was shocked, committed to ending gas extraction in 2023 or 2024, listed funding for social-emotional support and the Commission for Special Situations, and said the child-wellbeing motion was implemented through a research project and follow-up actions.
I am shocked by these figures and will meet with the researchers in July.
Ik ben geschrokken van deze cijfers en ga in juli met de onderzoekers in gesprek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

Westerveld and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Prime Minister whether the cabinet still holds that Parliament must be informed before the media when cabinet plans are released, and how often ministers were reminded of this. Rutte answered only by reaffirming the principle of timely information to both Houses under article 68 of the Constitution, saying it still guides cabinet members, without giving any concrete figures or new commitment.
This includes that the government informs both Houses as quickly as reasonably possible about relevant matters.
Daarbij hoort dat de regering de Kamers zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk informeert over relevante zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'Nationaal Coördinator tegen Racisme: 'Stop met solliciteren voor stageplek''

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Education minister how the government views the call to have schools arrange internships to combat internship discrimination, and about direct placement pilots and their effects. The minister says stage discrimination must be tackled, points to a revised mbo approach due after summer and ongoing research on matching, but states that no study yet specifically examines direct placement and that effects on workload are not being mapped.
Depending on the outcomes, I will consider whether follow-up research into the effects of direct placement is desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten bekijk ik of een vervolgonderzoek naar de effecten van direct placement wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over maatregelen om hersenschade bij diverse sporten te beperken

Written questions from MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) ask the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about head injuries and brain damage in sports, including current injury figures, high-risk sports, protocols, fight-sport rules, a youth heading study, and a ministry working group. The minister answers that head injury data are from 2021 with no current figures, sport-wide protocols do not exist, the ministry funds no research, and the minister will consider asking the Health Council and report in mid-2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de jeugdzorg

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the State Secretary and Minister about sexual boundary violations in youth care, including 414 reports reported by the Inspectorate, the role of victim protection, supervision and prosecution. The government acknowledges the problem as shocking, describes measures following the De Winter report, the AKJ advocacy system and IGJ supervision, and says it sees no structural gap in prosecution while admitting it cannot count prosecuted cases in youth care.

In addition, extra investment has been made in advocacy work (AKJ) to offer young people a listening ear; they will also more often explicitly ask about experiences of violence during their visits to institutions.
Daarnaast is extra geïnvesteerd in vertrouwenswerk (AKJ) om jongeren een luisterend oor te bieden; zij gaan tevens vaker expliciet vragen naar ervaringen van geweld bij hun bezoeken aan instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Het papieren meisje'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a news report on a young girl lacking specialised youth care, court-ordered treatment not delivered, waiting lists, runaway incidents and closed-youth-care failings. The State Secretary acknowledges the shortcomings, says waiting-time data is not kept nationally, promises regional dashboards and mandatory regional procurement of specialised care, but gives limited data and does not answer one question in time.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care. Information on waiting times is therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp. Informatie over wachttijden wordt daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij de voetbalwedstrijd tussen de nationale mannenelftallen van Nederland en Duitsland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked whether homophobic chants were heard at the Netherlands–Germany football match, why the match was not halted, and how the motion on stopping matches for racist or homophobic chants is being implemented. The minister confirmed the chants, said the organisers acted by sending stewards and the chants stopped quickly, and pointed to the OVIVI plan and KNVB rules as the framework, referring to an earlier letter for details.
Furthermore, I am in discussion with the KNVB to bring chants more to the attention of the professional football organisations.
Voorts ben ik met de KNVB in gesprek om spreekkoren meer onder de aandacht te brengen van de betaald voetbalorganisaties (bvo's).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over misstanden in de turnsport

Two MPs asked the ministers about alleged misconduct in gymnastics and the handling of former gymnasts' disciplinary case by the Instituut Sportrechtspraak, including whether the process was careful and why earlier warnings were not acted on. The minister says the disciplinary commission is independent and cannot be judged by the ministry, but promises a broader evaluation of sports disciplinary law, talks with the former gymnasts and the ISR, and an external study on the line between disciplinary and criminal law.
It is up to the independent disciplinary committee of the ISR to give a substantive judgment and rule on an individual case.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke tuchtcommissie van het ISR om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven en daarmee uitspraak te doen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Zuidaskantoren oefenden invloed uit op publicaties medewerkers belastingrecht’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether law professors at Amsterdam's universities holding paid positions at large law and tax firms undermine academic independence, possibly causing self-censorship on tax topics, and what safeguards exist. The minister agreed that undue influence is undesirable, committed to an independent evaluation of the Dutch research integrity code and the sectoral secondary-employment rules, and said the UvA will have an independent committee examine possible self-censorship, while declining to commission sector-wide research or new rules yet.
Not investigating or publishing certain topics because they are deemed socially, politically or commercially undesirable, self-censorship, I consider undesirable.
Het niet onderzoeken of publiceren van bepaalde onderwerpen omdat deze maatschappelijk, politiek of vanuit commerciële redenen onwenselijk worden geacht, zelfcensuur, vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de reiskostenvergoeding van jonge nieuwkomers

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked about differing municipal rules and amounts for travel-cost reimbursement for school-going newcomers over 12, the indicators used, and the availability of newcomer schools. Minister Wiersma answered that no statutory duty exists for newcomers with a status, that municipalities decide voluntarily, that the government has no overview of municipal schemes, and that around 120 ISK schools provide nationwide coverage.
However, I do not have an overview of which allowances municipalities provide and under which conditions.
Ik heb echter geen overzicht van welke vergoedingen gemeenten verstrekken en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ceder over het aantal doorplaatsingen van uit huis geplaatste kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Ceder asked about the frequency of re-placements of children taken out of their homes, what concrete steps followed the Het Vergeten Kind report and the StroomOp action plan, and whether targets were met. The State Secretary answered that re-placements are not registered nationally, that some targets such as the under-5% overplacement goal were not met though numbers fell, and that a plan for the future of closed youth care will be sent before summer.
The number of re-placements is not registered nationally.
Het aantal doorplaatsingen wordt niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Westerveld over het zo snel mogelijk naar het nultarief brengen van de btw op groente en fruit vanwege steeds duurdere boodschappen

MPs Van Esch and Westerveld asked why the VAT on fruit and vegetables cannot be cut to zero sooner, given rising grocery prices, and whether this could happen by 1 July 2022. The government answers that defining unprocessed produce raises complexity and fiscal-neutrality issues, so it cannot be done by 1 July 2022, and promises a plan of action with a study to the House by summer.
It is therefore not possible to arrange this by 1 July 2022.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om dit voor 1 juli 2022 te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Westerveld, Van den Berg en Bikker over de staat van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

Four MPs asked the minister about financial strain, possible closures, staffing shortages and the new mental health care payment model in Dutch GGZ. The minister answered that insurers and providers must resolve continuity and financial problems through contracting, that the NZa is monitoring and was asked to analyse closures, and that a joint working-arrangement process on freelance staffing was started, while leaving much of the detail to the sector.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me about any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Westerveld over de voorgenomen sluitingen van GGZ-instellingen en centra

MPs Kuiken and Westerveld asked about planned closures of mental health clinics, including the KIB in Amsterdam West and bed reductions at Altrecht's Eikenboom, asking about causes, continuity of care and waiting lists. The minister answered that closures stem from staff shortages and business considerations, that insurers and providers bear care responsibility under supervision by NZa and IGJ, and that the NZa has been asked to examine whether there is a common underlying problem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over antwoorden op eerdere vragen over de tegemoetkoming voor turnsporters

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the compensation scheme for former gymnasts who suffered abuse, including the role of the advisory group, the 30-hour training criterion, the scope and funding of the scheme, alternative treatment, and the follow-up to a motion on disciplinary versus criminal law. The minister replies that the scheme was simplified and made more accessible, the advisory group's advice is non-binding, the 30-hour criterion has been dropped, a motion will be included in a broader study, and that he cannot say who qualifies.
I cannot make statements about who is eligible for the compensation.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen wie in aanmerking komt voor de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een tweede studie op het gebied van zorg of onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about students doing a second degree, how many take one, and whether the higher institutional tuition for second degrees in care or education should be kept given staff shortages. The minister provided enrolment and graduation figures, said students in care or education second degrees now pay statutory rather than institutional tuition, and said there is no evidence the higher fee deters people, while defending the existing framework including the rule for teacher qualifications.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de voorgenomen sluitingen van GGZ-instellingen en centra

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about planned closures of mental health institutions (PsyQ, I-Psy, Pro Persona's Lunteren centre), their effect on availability of specialist care, waiting lists, and what the government will do. The Minister answered that closures are business-driven, that insurers and the NZa/IGJ bear and monitor continuity-of-care duties, that no national overview of closures exists, and that the NZa will analyse recent closures.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me of any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de zorgbonus voor pgb-zorgverleners en de tegemoetkoming voor mantelzorgers

An MP asked the Minister why self-employed PGB care workers still cannot claim the care bonus for 2020 and 2021, when this will be possible, and about municipal cuts to carers' allowances. The Minister explained privacy and subsidy-law obstacles for the Zvw-PGB group, gave no firm date, and said municipalities have discretion and that the government will work with them on carer support.
If these aspects lead to a positive result, the scheme can be published with my approval and the application window for both bonuses (2020 and 2021) can be opened.

Indien deze aspecten tot een positief resultaat leiden, kan de regeling met mijn akkoord worden gepubliceerd en kan tot openstelling van het aanvraagloket voor beide bonussen (2020 en 2021) worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat nog steeds niet alle middelbare scholen duidelijk maken dat de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage echt vrijwillig is

Two MPs asked the Minister why many secondary schools still do not clearly state that the voluntary parental contribution is optional and that children may not be excluded from activities if parents do not pay. The Minister agrees this is unacceptable, reports 88 Inspectorate signals since August 2021 with remedy orders and possible fines, and announces a new communication campaign and extra Inspectorate attention.
The Inspectorate is giving extra attention to the voluntary parental contribution in its supervision this year.
De Inspectie heeft in haar toezicht dit jaar extra aandacht voor de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronabeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Health why airlines dropped mask requirements despite recommendations, why only 3.9 of 10 million self-tests were ordered for social minima, the status of motions, the removal of public transport mask rules, booster eligibility, Novavax promotion, IVDR effects on self-tests, paramedic recovery care, and a letter from #VergeetOnsNietErnst. The Minister answered most questions with policy explanations, stating sanctions on airlines are not needed given agreements, public transport mask rules are dropped for enforceability, and the Health Council's booster advice was adopted; several answers were evasive or deferred.
Following this letter, constructive telephone conversations took place with the airlines.
Naar aanleiding van deze brief hebben constructieve telefonische gesprekken plaatsgevonden met de luchtvaartmaatschappijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Chaos in jeugdzorg is een goudmijn voor adviesbureaus'

MP Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Health about a Follow the Money report that youth care reform has generated large spending on external consultancies, advisers and programmes, and about how effective this spending has been. The State Secretary acknowledged concern, explained that external research and consultation are used for reform, referred to existing procurement and tariff rules, and said the Youth Reform Agenda will be sent to parliament before summer 2022.
Parliament will be informed before summer 2022 about the Youth Reform Agenda and the outcomes of the consultation with the VNG.
De Kamer wordt vóór de zomer van 2022 geïnformeerd over de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd en de uitkomsten van het overleg met de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de tegemoetkomingsregeling van 5000 euro voor (oud-)gymsporters en het artikel Stringente criteria voor aanvraag tegemoetkoming turnleed

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the 5,000 euro compensation scheme for former gymnasts, including its short application window, strict eligibility criteria, the requirement to present their account to a commission, tax and benefit implications, and the lack of a hardship exemption. The Minister largely defends the scheme as based on the Ongelijke leggers report and NOC*NSF advice, while acknowledging burdens, promising monitoring, talks with stakeholders, and a clarification from the tax authority that the payment does not affect benefits.
The progress of the compensation is carefully monitored and in the short term I will discuss this with the parties involved.
Het verloop van de tegemoetkoming wordt zorgvuldig gemonitord en op korte termijn zal ik hierover spreken met de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over PCR-testcapaciteit die in te zetten is voor grootschalig testen

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked why LAMP test lines used successfully by GGD Amsterdam were not rolled out nationally, and about costs, capacity and high-throughput PCR options for mass testing. The minister explained that LAMP lines need highly qualified staff and produce more errors at volume, gave cost figures, and said further assessment is pending; for many questions she said the data are unknown.
Before the test lines can be used again, a research process must first be carried out.
Voordat de testlijnen weer kunnen worden ingezet, moet eerst een onderzoekstraject worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Oekraïense studenten die in Nederland studeren en de wetenschappelijke samenwerking met Rusland

An MP asked the education minister about Ukrainian students in the Netherlands, their financial hardship, and continued scientific cooperation with Russia. The minister said institutions are supported with 1 million euros, that formal cooperation with Russian institutions should be frozen, and that a letter was sent to university and research bodies.
I have asked the higher education institutions to take care of Ukrainian students as well as possible and, where possible, support them financially.
Ik heb de hoger onderwijsinstellingen verzocht Oekraïense studenten zo goed mogelijk op te vangen en waar mogelijk (financieel) te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen voor mensen met een beperking

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about insurance and repair of mobility aids for people with disabilities, long repair waits, administrative burden and whether national rules are uniform. The state secretary answered that gemeenten cover repairs for loaned aids and that casco insurance is not required by law, that repair times and administrative burden are monitored, and that a second monitor is due in autumn 2022.
I have no insight into how much time aid users spend on their administration or how many forms they must fill in; this is not tracked anywhere.
Ik heb geen zicht op hoeveel tijd hulpmiddelengebruikers kwijt zijn aan hun administratie of hoeveel formulieren zij moeten invullen, dit wordt nergens bijgehouden.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat schoolbesturen jarenlange partnerschappen sluiten met commerciële uitzendbureaus voor de inhuur van flexibel onderwijspersoneel

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about school boards outsourcing flexible teacher staffing to commercial temp agencies at high cost, and whether this conflicts with a motion to limit agency use. The minister answered that agency staffing is sometimes needed, that regional procurement can control costs, that stricter rules for private partnerships will be drafted with sector councils, and that data on agency spending and teacher numbers are not available.
This precise information is not available.
Deze precieze informatie is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afname van de zwemvaardigheid onder kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked why the share of children with swimming diplomas is falling and what the minister will do to reverse it, including whether the pool closures during lockdowns were justified. The minister acknowledges concern, explains that pool closures were a deliberate trade-off favouring swimming lessons only from March 2021, and says the backlog is mainly the sector's responsibility, with a letter on progress promised for spring 2022.
That is why on 8 March 2021 the importance of swimming lessons was weighed more heavily than limiting the number of infections.
Daarom is op 8 maart 2021 het belang van zwemles zwaarder gewogen dan de beperking van het aantal besmettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over terugplaatsingen na uithuisplaatsingen

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the ministers how to reduce long out-of-home placements of children, what the government knows about returns home, and whether returns will be registered. The minister answers that reunification is a goal, lists measures and a WODC study, and says registration of returns will be explored with partners, but no reliable national figures on returns currently exist.
I am willing to improve registration on this point.
Ik ben bereid de registratie op dit punt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over coronazelftesten en coronamedicatie

An MP asks the health minister about quality differences between COVID-19 self-tests, validation standards, supply shortages, free distribution and the decision not to order extra Ronapreve. The minister answers that CE marking and notified body review apply, cites independent studies and stricter EU rules from May 2022, says there is no current shortage and no government role in pricing, and explains the choice not to reorder Ronapreve.
Nevertheless, I share the view that insight into the performance of widely available self-tests is important.
Desondanks deel ik de opvatting dat inzicht in de prestaties van ruim verkrijgbare zelftesten belangrijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Westerveld en Kwint over de gevolgen van de veranderende bekostigingssystematiek voor het primair onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the new education funding system from 2023 would force primary school boards to draw down reserves by about 500 million euro, and whether this would reduce money for education. The minister answered that the change is a purely accounting adjustment with 100% of funding still paid out, that the inspectorate will treat affected boards leniently for five years, and that no real funds are lost.
As indicated, this is a technical, accounting exercise and in practice no money disappears from school boards.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het hier om een technische, boekhoudkundige exercitie en verdwijnt er feitelijk geen geld bij besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about Chinese funding of a human rights research centre at the VU, raising concerns about academic independence and Chinese influence in Dutch universities. The minister answered that academic freedom can coexist with third-party funding, that the national knowledge security guideline was published, that the RUG Hanban chair was not renewed, and that the government is concerned about human rights in Xinjiang.
I will, together with other ministries and services, keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal daarbij, samen met andere ministeries en diensten, een vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Omstreden software studenten blijkt onveilig: hackers konden meegluren'

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked the Minister of Education about the Proctorio anti-cheating software, which was found to have a security flaw letting hackers spy on students, and about privacy, use limits and student participation rights. The minister answered that proctoring should be used only when necessary, that the flaw was reportedly fixed within a week, that institutions are responsible for privacy and security, and that no change to the law on works council consent is planned.
There is no intention to change anything in the law on this.
Er is geen voornemen om daar iets aan te wijzigen in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het goochelen met cijfers over vaste contracten in het onderwijs

Kwint and Westerveld ask why the minister presented figures on permanent contracts for recently graduated teachers as a sweeping increase, omitting that the figures include temporary contracts with prospects of permanence and cover only teachers six months after graduation. The minister answers that the figures are accurate, that the sample is defined as recent graduates working six months after graduating, and that combining permanent and temporary-with-prospect contracts is an essential nuance.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over zwemles

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked about long swimming lesson waiting lists caused by COVID-19 restrictions, the classification of swimming lessons, child safety, and the COVID pass requirement at swimming schools. The minister answered at length, estimating 69,000 to 92,000 children lost lesson time and stating the lessons are now possible again, but declined to give exact figures and did not commit to re-seeking OMT advice.
It is difficult to say how many children have not obtained a diploma as a result of the restrictions.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen hoeveel kinderen nu geen diploma gehaald hebben als gevolg van de beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het afnemen van het aantal restitutiepolissen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, premiums, conversions to combination policies, uninsured numbers, coverage details, and whether insurers can cut reimbursement or change conditions for mental and physical care providers. The minister answered with figures on policy counts and premiums, said insurers set their own policies and must inform insureds of changes, and stated that selective contracting by insurers is important for steering to appropriate care.
In the spring I can inform your House about the definitive figures for 2022.
In het voorjaar kan ik uw Kamer informeren over de definitieve cijfers voor 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld van de ontoegankelijkheid van het openbaar vervoer voor mensen met een beperking.

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked about inaccessible public transport for people with disabilities, including broken lifts at small stations, assistance by train staff, rolling-stock seating and the involvement of disability experts. The State Secretary answered that stations are being made accessible by 2030, that platforms on the Maaslijn will follow by 2024, and that staff assistance at all times is not feasible, while promising a transport accessibility agreement and monitoring of lifts.
I share the view that public transport in principle must be accessible to all people with disabilities.
Ik deel de mening dat het OV in beginsel toegankelijk moet zijn voor alle mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over vaccindonaties aan de WHO voor lage-inkomenslanden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Health and Development ministers why the Netherlands had not made firm vaccine donation commitments to COVAX, how it compared with other rich countries, its stockpile and fair share, and what it would do about low vaccination rates in low-income countries. The government answered that firm donation mandates of 22 million doses were already in place, that it would meet 'Get one – Give one', and that it would keep pursuing supply, local production and TRIPS-waiver negotiations, while declining to swap its place in the queue.
Netherlands has thus done what it promised for this year and will continue to make efforts in this regard.
Nederland heeft daarmee gedaan wat het voor dit jaar heeft beloofd en zal zich hiervoor blijven inspannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de handhaving van het coronatoegangsbewijs en zwemles

An MP asked why swimming lessons require a coronavirus pass (CTB), leading to waiting lists, and how sports participation and disabled athletes are protected, and how clubs will enforce the CTB. The state secretary answered that the CTB applies to public indoor sports venues, that children whose parents cannot show a CTB may miss lessons but the effect on waiting lists is expected to be limited, and that clubs can get enforcement support via municipalities.
For the public indoor area of a sports facility (including the changing rooms) a CTB requirement applies to the public from age 18.
Voor de publieke binnenruimte van een locatie voor de beoefening van sport (waaronder ook de kleedkamers) geldt vanaf 18 jaar een CTB-plicht voor het publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het artikel ‘Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers whether they knew of the new Omicron variant spreading in South Africa, whether incoming flights from there face adequate entry rules, and whether quarantine or double PCR testing could be imposed as a precaution. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on the Omicron measures, without addressing the questions in the reply itself.

The written questions from MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh to the ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about the article 'South Africa sounds the alarm: new virus variant spreading' (2021Z21731) are answered by letter <Status of the measures on the omicron variant of the coronavirus>.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over het artikel «Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen» ( 2021Z21731 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken over de maatregelen omikronvariant van het coronavirus>

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending van Argos 'Diagnose bij kindermishandeling komt moeizaam tot stand'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about an Argos broadcast reporting that diagnosing child abuse is slow and that too little has changed in ten years, and raised questions on procedures, referrals, wait times, multidisciplinary cooperation and the closure of the MDCK centre. The government disputes that too little has been done, cites improved outcomes in a study, describes existing procedures and programmes, and promises further work, including a meeting with the LHV and integration of the GHNT programme into a new child and family protection scenario.
The government does not share the conclusion of the Argos researchers that too little has been done in the past 10 years to effectively combat child abuse.
De conclusie van de onderzoekers van Argos dat de afgelopen 10 jaar te weinig is gedaan om kindermishandeling effectief te bestrijden, delen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Van Nispen en Westerveld over het sterker, gerichter en efficiënter fixen van matchfixing

Three MPs (Van der Laan, Van Nispen, Westerveld) asked the ministers about matchfixing, including its prevalence, prosecutability under Dutch criminal law, information sharing between betting operators, investigators and sports bodies, and funding for prevention. The minister answered that the government is reviewing the anti-matchfixing structure, that existing offences like fraud and bribery only partly cover matchfixing, and that monitoring and the Kansspelwet evaluation will follow, with no clear commitment to new legislation yet.
The nature and extent of matchfixing in the Netherlands is not known.
De aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over belemmeringen voor gezinshuizen en pleegouders

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, about obstacles for foster-care and family-home (gezinshuis) providers, covering numbers of children and providers, regional differences, age profile, municipal requirements and tariffs, contract duration, placement moves, fiscal problems for foster parents, legal standing of family-home parents and COVID-related costs. The State Secretary answered at length with data from publications, mostly describing existing policy and pointing to municipalities and the IGJ for local matters, and committed to a study of financial problems for foster parents to be sent to the House in November 2021.
A broad study is currently underway examining which financial bottlenecks foster parents face.
Momenteel loopt een breed onderzoek waarin wordt nagegaan met welke financiële knelpunten pleegouders te maken hebben
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint en Van Meenen over De Monnikskap

MPs asked why the Minister had not kept parliament informed about De Monnikskap, an inclusive education unit facing closure with the Dominicus College, and about the phase-out of its supplementary funding. The Minister answered that the new circumstances arose only recently, that the board guarantees De Monnikskap will continue after 2024, and that the supplementary funding will be phased out from 2023 to 2027.
Only very recently have new circumstances come to light, namely the planned closure of the Dominicus College, which prompted me to inform you.
Er zijn pas zeer recent nieuwe omstandigheden naar voren gekomen, namelijk over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Dominicus College, die aanleiding waren om u te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de distributie van jodiumtabletten

An MP asked the health minister about the distribution of iodine tablets: the status of the July 2021 redistribution near nuclear plants, and why pregnant women and families with young children 20-100 km away are not actively and structurally informed. The minister said the redistribution was completed, that pregnant women already receive information via the 'Zwanger!' leaflet and professional channels, and that he will consider extending outreach (e.g. to apps) in standard consultations with RIVM.
I will consider in the standard consultation structure with RIVM and the partners whether it is necessary and desirable to extend this to, for example, widely used apps.
Ik zal in de standaard overlegstructuur met het RIVM en de partners bezien of het nodig en wenselijk is om dit uit te breiden naar bijvoorbeeld veelgebruikte apps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en De Hoop over het bericht 'Twentse student Peter kreeg kanker, maar moet beurs volledig terugbetalen: ‘Je wordt als fraudeur gezien’'

MPs Westerveld and De Hoop asked whether DUO demands repayment of student grants from seriously ill students, how often home visits and penalties occur, and what changes are needed for hardship cases. The minister confirmed that DUO reclaimed part of a seriously ill student's grant, that home visits and penalties have declined since 2016, and pointed to existing hardship clauses and case-by-case review without committing to new rules.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the specific case.
Vanwege privacyredenen kan ik niet ingaan op de specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Honderden studenten lopen coronacompensatie mis, vaak buiten eigen schuld'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether students who graduated after 31 August 2021 after pandemic-related delays, and pre-master students, are excluded from the COVID study-delay compensation. The minister replied that the cutoff stands, that a full list of affected students is unavailable, that extending the scheme would cost about 24 million euro and would give some students two allowances, and that the halved tuition fee is the generic compensation.

There is no national overview of the study progress of individual students, so it is not possible to identify in advance which students will graduate after 31 August 2021 and could have qualified for the allowance.

Er is geen landelijk overzicht van de studievoortgang van individuele studenten, het is dan ook niet mogelijk om op voorhand in kaart te brengen welke studenten na 31 augustus 2021 studeren en in aanmerking hadden kunnen komen voor de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Plas en Bikker over het bericht ‘coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking’

Three MPs asked the health minister how people who can neither be vaccinated nor tested will get a COVID access certificate, and why no route existed when certificates took effect on 25 September, despite a Bikker amendment. The minister answered that a three-week GGD Utrecht pilot started on 6 October to define the group and test a less burdensome method, with exemption certificates as the eventual fallback, and that the answers were late.
After the pilot ends, it will be evaluated on whether it has found a structural solution.
Na afloop van de pilot wordt deze geëvalueerd op de vraag of met de pilot een structurele oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe gelijk zijn man en vrouw voor gemeenten?’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why women often lack digital access to tax records for property they co-own with men, since municipalities and water boards usually issue tax assessments in one person's name. The minister explained the legal basis and municipal discretion, said there is no legal barrier to addressing all co-owners, and committed to discussing alternatives with municipalities and water boards.
I am willing to discuss with the other tiers of government what the options are for giving all owners of a property insight into the tax records.
Ik ben bereid om met de medeoverheden te bespreken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alle eigenaren van een eigendom inzicht te geven in de belastinggegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over studentenhuisvesting

GroenLinks MPs asked about unhoused international students sleeping in bus shelters, emergency housing, cost of emergency shelter in Groningen, the housing-benefit and cost-sharing rules for hosts, and information given to international students. The minister answers that housing is primarily a local responsibility, lists local emergency measures, explains the rules for taking in students, says the national action plan will be updated with stakeholders while structural solutions await a new cabinet, and admits the answers were not delivered within the requested five days.
It is a local responsibility to ensure there is sufficient housing.
Het is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het artikel 'Het grootste onderwijsprobleem is niet het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the rapid growth of commercial education firms, whether they are linked to learning losses from school closures, how schools spend National Education Programme funds on external providers, and whether marketisation and lump-sum funding have weakened government control and accountability in education. The minister answered that the CBS count is broad and not directly tied to funded schooling, that no direct link to COVID closures is visible, that schools' use of external providers is being monitored, and that accountability for lump-sum funds is being strengthened, but declined to answer the general question on education policy over 30 years.
The research into the scale of supplementary and private education will be repeated in 2022.
Het onderzoek naar de omvang van aanvullend en particulier onderwijs zal in 2022 worden herhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Garantieregeling evenementen

MP Westerveld asks whether event organisers pass on the full government-guaranteed compensation to freelance artists and suppliers, and whether the subsidy conditions should require this. The minister acknowledges signals of underpayment, says it is a private-law matter beyond government's view, explains why pass-through was not made a subsidy condition for administrative reasons, and points to sector outreach and a Taskforce review.
I have no insight into the contractual relationships of individual organisers and their suppliers, including artists and other self-employed workers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de contractuele verhoudingen van individuele organisatoren en hun toeleveranciers, waaronder ook artiesten en andere zelfstandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over herinschrijvingen en restitutie bij pre-masterprogramma’s

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the minister about re-enrolment and refunds for pre-master programmes, including the absence of a legal definition of re-enrolment, whether institutions may charge fees again for remaining parts, reconciliation with WHW article 7.57i, and the impartiality of student complaints committees appointed by the executive board. The minister answered that pre-master programmes are not degrees, that institutions may charge capped fees and may charge again for a second attempt at remaining parts, and that functional independence of committee members provides sufficient impartiality.
This provides sufficient safeguards for impartial judgement.
Dit biedt voldoende waarborgen voor een onpartijdige oordeelsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronabeleid

The MP Westerveld asks the ministers about COVID-19 policy, including presymptomatic transmission of the Delta variant, school reopening, vaccination status checks in schools, the use of coronavirus certificates, mask recycling and support for the cultural sector. The minister answers that transmission by asymptomatic people is already taken into account, that the reopening plan was guided by epidemiological data, and that generic support schemes will not be extended after 1 October 2021 while targeted support for night-time hospitality and unseated events is being prepared.
On the elaboration of these support measures, EZK and OCW are in discussion with the sector.
Over de uitwerking van deze steunmaatregelen zijn EZK en OCW in gesprek met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het vaccineren van arbeidsmigranten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how migrant workers in the Netherlands are being vaccinated against COVID-19, including how many have been vaccinated, what outreach exists, and whether employers and GGDs can vaccinate on site. The minister answered that there is no separate registration for this group, describes multilingual outreach, cooperation with employers' organisations and GGDs, on-site and mobile vaccination options, and a working group led by RIVM, while declining to introduce in-company vaccination.
There is no separate registration for this target group.
Er is geen aparte registratie voor deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Plas over coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking

MPs Westerveld and Van der Plas asked whether people with multiple disabilities who can neither be vaccinated nor regularly tested have any route to a COVID certificate, and whether case-by-case solutions exist. The minister answered that no alternative route exists yet because the procedure is complex, that it would apply only to domestic use and not travel under EU rules, that the group is believed to be very small, and that a decision is aimed for autumn.
At this moment there is therefore still no route for people who cannot be vaccinated and cannot be tested.
Op dit moment is er dus nog geen route voor mensen die zich niet kunnen laten vaccineren en niet kunnen laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over herkansingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

MPs Westerveld, Van Meenen and Kwint asked about staatsexamen retake options for vso (special secondary education) pupils, examiner shortages and recruitment. Minister Slob answered that no exams were cancelled for lack of examiners, that about 450 examiners were recruited mostly to replace last-minute withdrawals, and that a retake option for a specific subgroup will be investigated and reported in autumn.
No, no exams were cancelled due to insufficient qualified examiners.
Nee, er zijn geen examens afgezegd wegens onvoldoende bevoegde examinatoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de eigen bijdrage in de ggz

An MP asked whether mental health patients must pay the deductible twice for treatment spanning a calendar year under the new care-performance model, and whether about 100,000 patients are affected. The State Secretary confirmed that a treatment crossing the calendar-year boundary can trigger the deductible in two years, estimating up to 9% (about 100,000) of patients pay more, while defending the new funding model and listing compensation measures.
For an estimated maximum of 9% of mental health clients there is an effect; this concerns roughly a group of 100,000 people.
Voor naar schatting maximaal 9% van de ggz-cliënten is er wel een gevolg; het gaat bij benadering om een groep van 100.000 mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked whether the GGD Kennemerland director had improperly removed Tata Steel from a lung cancer report, whether a commercial polluter should have seen the report early, and whether the health service's independence is safeguarded. The state secretary answered that an independent investigation (Heskes) found the report was produced with integrity, that early access for Tata Steel was plausible for media preparation, and that no broader investigation is planned, while committing to balancing health against economic interests under existing law.
The research report, carried out by investigator and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de documentaire 'Goede Moeders'

MP Westerveld asks the Ministers about the documentary 'Goede Moeders' on repeated child removals, including reporting of new pregnancies, Veilig Thuis and youth-care investigation procedures, inaccurate case files, and the status of a motion and action plan to reduce out-of-home placements. The government answers that reporting is governed by the Meldcode and sector frameworks without a legal reporting duty, describes fact-finding safeguards and complaint routes, and says the motion's plan is under study with a roundtable planned, though it provides no firm commitment on the plan.

I am aware that in practice parents and children sometimes believe that the organisations concerned, such as Veilig Thuis, the certified institutions or the Child Protection Board, have not conducted proper fact-finding and that incorrect information remains in files and petitions.

Het is mij bekend dat het in de praktijk voorkomt dat ouders en kinderen menen dat door de betreffende organisaties, zoals VT, de GI's of de RvdK, geen goed feitenonderzoek is gedaan en dat onjuiste informatie in dossiers en verzoekschriften blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Westerveld over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg sluit kinderen nog steeds op in isoleercel: belofte ermee te stoppen niet nagekomen'

MPs Simons and Westerveld asked why youth-care JeugdzorgPlus institutions still isolate children despite promises to stop, and what is being done about it. The minister explains the project results, the causes of persistent isolation, and plans such as a new bill (Wet rechtspositie gesloten jeugdhulp) with a 'nee, tenzij' rule and limits on isolation, though not a total ban.
I do not intend to ban forced isolation entirely.
Ik ben niet voornemens om gedwongen afzonderen geheel te verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Westerveld en Kwint over het LinkedIn-bericht ‘Grote flyeractie in boekenpakketten!’ van 'Mr. Chadd'

MPs Segers, Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about a LinkedIn post advertising paid homework coaching via flyers in publicly funded school book packages, and whether such advertising, its money flows and shadow education in general are acceptable. The minister confirmed awareness, said schools choose their suppliers, acknowledged risks to equal opportunity, referred to a planned repeat study and a spring 2022 update, and said the distributor's payments were unknown to him.
This is a matter between the distributor and the provider.
Dit is een zaak tussen de distributeur en de aanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over de vrijwillige of verplichte ouderbijdrage voor kosten voor overblijven op school

Two MPs asked the minister whether parents must pay for lunch-break supervision at school, whether a court ruling affects this, and whether guidelines should be tightened. The minister answered that the ruling confirms current rules, that the school followed consultation and consent procedures, and that no new guidelines are needed.
I see no reason to tighten the rules on whether a compulsory parental contribution may be requested.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de regels over het al dan niet mogen vragen van een verplichte ouderbijdrage aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over overgebleven AstraZeneca-vaccins

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister how many leftover AstraZeneca vaccines would expire, whether they could be donated abroad, and why waste was occurring. The minister answered that expected leftovers are well below 200,000, that donations go mainly via COVAX with limited bilateral donations, and that repacked or opened stock cannot be donated under EU pharmaceutical rules.
It is currently difficult to estimate exactly how many AstraZeneca vaccines will be left over.
Het is op dit moment moeilijk in te schatten wat er precies overblijft aan AstraZeneca-vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Neef en Ouwehand over het manifest toegankelijke festivals dat op 8 juni jl. is gelanceerd

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, VVD and PvdD asked ministers whether festivals should be more accessible for people with disabilities under the UN convention, why many are not, and whether the government will engage with the sector and international examples. The minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen programme addresses accessibility, that gemeenten can set accessibility conditions in event permits, and that the government will raise the manifesto with VNG and VNO-NCW but gave no concrete new measures.
I will put this manifesto and the accessibility of festivals and events on the agenda in the talks I hold with the VNG and VNO-NCW.
Ik zal dit manifest en de toegankelijkheid van festivals en evenementen agenderen tijdens de gesprekken die ik voer met de VNG en VNO-NCW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronavirus

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and education ministers about COVID-19 school self-test uptake, the end of the school self-test ordering scheme, vaccination of homeless people, serological tests for certificates, and the origin of the virus. The government answered that test uptake data is still incomplete, the ordering scheme was under review, vaccination of vulnerable groups is underway, and it would not use serological tests for the certificate, while not fully answering the virus-origin question and missing the deadline.
Answer 8: No, unfortunately, due to the diversity of topics affecting two ministries, it has not proven feasible to answer the questions by 1 July 2021.
Antwoord 8 Nee, helaas is het vanwege de diversiteit aan onderwerpen die twee ministeries raken niet haalbaar gebleken om de vragen voor 1 juli 2021 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Amnesty: 1 op 10 Nederlandse studentes slachtoffer seks zonder instemming'

MPs Westerveld asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an Amnesty report finding that 11% of female students had experienced rape during their studies, and about university responsibilities, reporting procedures, confidential advisers and the new ombudsman role. The Minister said she was shocked, pointed to US and Dutch research and existing support structures, and said the report would be discussed with student organisations, while stating that most such violence occurs in private life and that ombudsman roles mainly concern staff.
The Amnesty report will certainly be discussed with the national student organisations.
Het rapport van Amnesty zal zeker besproken worden met de landelijke studentenorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Ikke prikken – en de rest kan stikken'

MPs Westerveld and Kuiken asked the health minister about a report on the vaccination rollout, including why the most vulnerable were not invited first and why medical-risk invitations were delayed. The minister defended the prioritisation as based on Gezondheidsraad and OMT advice and scarce supply, and said the strategy and sequencing were discussed in parliament.
Because of the limited available quantity of vaccines, the cabinet had to make choices in the order in which people could be vaccinated.
Vanwege de beperkte beschikbare hoeveelheid vaccins heeft het kabinet keuzes moeten maken in de volgorde waarin mensen gevaccineerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over sportprotheses

Two MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether sports prostheses should be covered by health insurance or municipalities, the costs involved, co-payments and waiting or appeal issues. The minister answered that eligibility for insurance coverage is based on clinical criteria, that prostheses for social participation go through municipalities, cited cost estimates and the Uniek Sporten Hulpmiddelen fund, and promised further monitoring and a progress update.
How many cases are currently not reimbursed and the outcomes of appeal procedures are currently not known.
In hoeveel gevallen er momenteel niet vergoed wordt en de uitkomsten van bezwaarprocedures zijn momenteel niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the minister about the compensation scheme for youth-care victims, covering rejected applications, aftercare, the asset test, debt-rescheduling claw-back and ZMOK-school placements. The minister answered in detail, explaining rejection grounds, referral to support lines, the Belastingdienst form process, Wsnp rules and why voluntary placements are excluded, while committing to no new action.
Placement via a ZMOK school does not fall under forced placement within the meaning of the scheme.
Plaatsing via een ZMOK-school valt niet onder gedwongen plaatsing in de zin van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Özütok en Westerveld over de blijvende tekorten voor jeugdzorg bij gemeenten

MPs Kuiken, Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the government should have resolved the chronic youth care funding shortfall at municipalities earlier, and why no extra money was provided now. The State Secretary replied that the government granted temporary funds (over EUR 1 billion for 2021 and EUR 1.314 billion for 2022), agreed savings with municipalities, committed to a reform agenda, and that a new cabinet must decide on structural funding taking the Commission of Wise Men's ruling as a weighty input.
The cabinet makes available an additional EUR 1.314 billion to municipalities in 2022 for the youth care shortfalls.
Het kabinet stelt in 2022 € 1,314 miljard extra beschikbaar aan gemeenten voor de tekorten vanwege de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over proctoring

MP Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about whether student councils should have consent or advisory rights over online proctoring of exams, citing privacy concerns and student experiences. The Minister answered that fraud-prevention measures are not subject to statutory consent rights, that institutions must respect GDPR and privacy guidance, that programme committees have advisory rights over how exams are taken, and that institutions should inform students better and offer alternatives.
With a possible consent right, students would be given the opportunity to (co-)determine by which methods their own possibly fraudulent conduct can be detected.
Met een eventueel instemmingsrecht zouden studenten immers in de gelegenheid worden gesteld (mede) te bepalen met welke methodes hun eigen mogelijk frauduleuze handelen kan worden opgespoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Farmaceut Roche vult zijn zakken met zelftesten, met hulp van minister De Jonge'

An MP asked why the ministry ordered 46.5 million self-tests from Roche without a tender, why Roche received an exemption faster than other manufacturers, and why Roche was prioritised. The minister acknowledged the non-tendered procurement was unlawful (onrechtmatig), explained the urgency and the split across five suppliers, and said the exemption process favours firms already far along with notified bodies, without fully explaining the speed of Roche's approval.
I previously informed your House about this unlawful procurement.
Ik heb uw Kamer eerder over deze onrechtmatige inkoop geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over ventilatie in scholen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether school ventilation policy would change in light of aerosol transmission evidence, why the 2020 motion on school ventilation has not been implemented, how many schools and grants are involved, and what happens with the SUViS budget and the remaining 260 million euro. The minister answered that ventilation guidance from RIVM is followed, that the SUViS subsidy is nearly exhausted, that the remaining funds await the IBO recommendations, and that full adequate ventilation cannot be achieved by autumn.
Er wordt geen centraal overzicht bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het gebruik van commerciële bijlesbureaus en examentrainingen om corona-achterstanden in te halen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spent corona catch-up funds on commercial tutoring and exam-training firms, and whether this should be curbed. Minister Slob replied that schools control how funds are spent, outsourcing is allowed with works council consent, and that accountability runs through school reports, the works council and the inspectorate, while declining to report detailed spending and deferring broader tutoring measures.
There is no obligation for schools to communicate their spending in detail.
Er is geen verplichting voor solen om gedetailleerd over hun uitgaven te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over kinderen die geen zwemdiploma halen

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked why about 1% (later 4%) of children lack a swimming diploma, which groups are affected, what barriers exist including for children with disabilities, and what financial and quality measures the minister will take. The minister cited a Mulier Institute study finding about 45,000 children without a diploma, outlined planned research into motives and barriers due in 2021, referenced municipal fee schemes and the National Swimming Safety Plan, but committed to further study rather than concrete new measures.
I previously commissioned a repeat of the 2018 study.
Ik heb in een eerder stadium opdracht gegeven de studie van 2018 te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Farmaceuten keken niet naar de bij effecten van coronavaccins op vrouwen’

MPs Ellemeet and Westerveld asked whether regulators EMA and CBG examine sex-specific side effects of COVID-19 vaccines, whether halved doses for young women are being studied, and whether interaction effects and raw trial data should be required. The minister answered that sex was recorded and subgroup analyses were done, that a sex-specific safety analysis for AstraZeneca was still awaited, that research on the rare side effect is ongoing, and that full clinical reports are already published so no extra requirement is needed.
An additional requirement is not necessary.
Een extra eis is niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Hijink over het bericht 'Durfinvesteerders zien brood in tieners met lichte psychische klachten, zwaardere patiënten belanden op wachtlijst'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that venture investors target teenagers with mild mental health complaints while severe patients face waiting lists, and about profit limits, foreign investment and the treatment of suicidal youth. The state secretary said gemeenten can set profit caps and tariffs, pointed to the planned Wibz and Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen, and reported that only a few investment firms are active in youth care.
I do not have an overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Ik heb geen overzicht van eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de lerarenbeurs

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the number of teacher grant applications, whether all rejected 2020 applicants would be granted, the DUO website outage, whether the budget would be increased if oversubscribed, and compensation for self-paid courses. The minister answered that final numbers are not yet known, promised all 2020 rejected initial applications can be granted, confirmed a brief outage, declined to raise the budget pending an evaluation due this autumn, and said there is no room to compensate teachers.
We will inform you after the allocation by DUO of the final number of applications and the number of grants for the Teacher Grant for the coming school year (by the end of June at the latest).
Wij informeren u na afloop van de toekenning bij DUO over het definitieve aantal aanvragen en het aantal toekenningen voor de Lerarenbeurs voor het aankomende schooljaar (uiterlijk eind juni).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Vaccineer zo snel mogelijk ook in armere landen om mutaties te voorkomen'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and trade ministers about COVAX vaccine targets, a TRIPS waiver, C-TAP technology sharing and EU contract negotiations, and whether the government would act on these. The minister answered that Nigeria-style supply shortfalls are understandable, that the government supports COVAX financially and in kind, is cautious about a TRIPS waiver and C-TAP, and is consulting Belgium and the EU, without firm commitments.
The cabinet will argue within the EU that Europe contributes constructively to this discussion.
Het kabinet zal binnen de EU bepleiten dat Europa constructief aan deze discussie bijdraagt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Paternotte, Snels en Westerveld ver de financiële middelen voor toegangstesten

MPs Sneller, Paternotte, Snels and Westerveld asked the Health Minister about the roughly 925 million euro for access testing, its legal basis, the outsourcing to a private foundation, board pay, and whether funds were committed before parliamentary authorisation. The minister answered that spending is phased with go/no-go decisions, that funds were committed before formal authorisation under Comptabiliteitswet article 2.27, and that contract texts were shared with parliament, while offering to seek Auditdienst Rijk advice.
Your House was informed of the funds for phase 0 through the fourth supplementary budget of VWS on 12 March.
Uw Kamer is door middel de vierde incidentele begroting van VWS op 12 maart geïnformeerd over de middelen voor fase 0.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Tientallen jongeren de dupe van sluiting De Hoenderloo Groep, beloofde 'passende vervolgplek' is er niet gekomen'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Kwint asked why dozens of youths from the closed Hoenderloo Groep lack a lasting placement after its closure, and whether the promised 'suitable follow-up placement' was broken. The Staatssecretaris answers that all youths had a placement on closure day, that some later placements proved unsuitable and are being addressed by Pluryn, municipalities and the inspectorate, and that the government is strengthening continuity-of-care rules.
I do not share the view of the questioners that Pluryn has broken the promise that every youth would receive a follow-up placement.
Ik deel het oordeel van de vragenstellers niet dat Pluryn de belofte heeft geschonden dat elke jongere een vervolgplek krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat sprake is van tekortkomingen bij het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR)

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Medical Care about shortcomings at the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR), the pace of its professionalisation, handling times and suspended cases in gymnastics abuse complaints, the risk of contact between accused coaches and victims, whether reporting is deterred by sports federation involvement, and aid for former gymnasts including the motion on acute help and access to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The Minister replies that professionalisation is progressing as fast as feasible, handling times are hard to predict, the accused may be instructed by federation measures not to contact complainants, and a Schadefonds route has been explored but victims must meet generic conditions.
The Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) recently appointed a kwartiermaker to help shape the organisation further.
Het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) heeft onlangs een kwartiermaker aangesteld die de organisatie verder gaat helpen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Westerveld over de ontstane situatie bij L1

MPs Sneller and Westerveld asked the minister about reports that the director of broadcaster L1 planned hidden cameras and access to staff email, and about the supervisory board's handling of the conflict with staff. The minister answered that covert monitoring is generally prohibited and conditionally allowed, that the director withdrew his plans, that L1's internal appointment falls under internal procedures, and that the outcome of an enterprise-chamber procedure will be awaited.
Covert camera surveillance and access to email correspondence are in principle not permitted, because they constitute a serious intrusion into personal privacy.
Heimelijk cameratoezicht en toegang tot mailcorrespondentie is in beginsel niet toegestaan, omdat het een grote inbreuk maakt op de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een D66-campagnefoto zes voorpagina’s heeft gehaald

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked about a D66 campaign photo that appeared on six front pages, asking whether photo credits matter for photojournalism, whether political control over journalistic images is desirable, the status of minimum rates for journalists, and the position of freelance photojournalists during COVID-19. The minister answered that source attribution is important, that journalistic independence must be respected, that binding fair practice rules now apply to public broadcasters and talks on a publishing-sector code are ongoing, and that COVID support measures were available to freelancers, without committing to new action.
Journalistic independence is a great good and a strong pillar of our democratic society, in which journalists act as a sound counterweight to politics and government.
Journalistieke onafhankelijkheid is een groot goed en een sterke pijler van onze democratische samenleving, waarin journalisten als een gedegen tegenmacht van politiek en overheid fungeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken en Van den Hul over de vaccinatiestrategie voor kwetsbaren

MPs Westerveld, Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the health minister about the vaccination strategy for vulnerable people, including people in voluntary quarantine, children who cannot attend school, the risk groups, and the timing of vaccinations for those with medical indications. The minister answered that the government does not track the number of people in voluntary quarantine, that schools are expected to keep in contact with vulnerable pupils and find alternative education, and that vaccination for the highest-risk groups has started with the Gezondheidsraad's advice still pending for children.
The behavioural unit does not record who is in voluntary quarantine.
Door de gedragsunit wordt niet geregistreerd wie er in vrijwillige quarantaine is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over proctoring

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the use of online proctoring at universities and colleges, including whether student councils and programme committees must be consulted, and the Erasmus University's second-camera requirement. The minister answered that most institutions use proctoring under AVG rules, that programme committees and student councils have advisory or consultation roles but not formal consent rights over proctoring, and that she will keep discussing alternatives and the second camera with the umbrella bodies.
I therefore do not share the view that there is a right of consent over the way institutions combat fraud.
Ik deel de mening dus niet dat er instemmingsrecht bestaat voor de manier waarop instellingen fraude bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Westerveld over het ontbreken van zwemlessen voor kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked the minister why swimming lessons for children remained suspended and how the risks to child water safety, compensation and reopening were being addressed. The minister acknowledged the sector's disappointment, announced that pools reopen for swimming lessons for children up to 12 from 16 March, and said the Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid is consulted on resumption.
With this adjustment the cabinet wants to prevent a generation of children without a swimming diploma entering the summer.
Met deze aanpassing wil het kabinet voorkomen dat een generatie kinderen zonder zwemdiploma de zomer in gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Westerveld over 'De tentamenzaal in ná de sneltest'

MPs Paternotte and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the COVID-19 rapid-test pilots that would allow more in-person education and exams, covering participating institutions, start dates, testing numbers, data sharing with the GGD and timelines.
