The minister answered in detail that eight regional pilots are starting, results are due by 1 May 2021, data sharing with the GGD is limited to positive results, and the cabinet will decide later on expanding in-person education.
The pilot regions have been asked to deliver results by 1 May 2021.
De pilotregio’s is gevraagd om uiterlijk 1 mei 2021 resultaten op te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Meenen over de digitale toegankelijkheid van lesmateriaal voor kinderen met een leesbeperking

MPs Westerveld and Van Meenen asked the minister about the availability of digitally accessible textbooks for children with reading disabilities, including responsibility for publishers, the GEU, Dedicon funding and school compliance. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with publishers and schools, that the ministry funds conversion only for visually impaired pupils, and that no additional steps or legal anchoring of the right to support are planned.

That responsibility lies with the publishers, who must make the learning materials available, if requested, to entities that can convert them into an accessible form for pupils with reading disabilities.
Die verantwoordelijkheid ligt bij de uitgeverijen, die dienen de leermiddelen wel, indien gevraagd, beschikbaar te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over tekortkomingen bij het Instituut Sportrechtspraak

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortcomings at the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR), including halted cases of former gymnasts, case duration, melder safety, capacity and alternatives for athletes. The minister answered that cases are not halted but under external review, promised extra funding and a kwartiermaker for professionalisation, and said the KNGU talks and aftercare will follow the April investigation outcomes.
The Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is an independent organisation.
Het Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is een onafhankelijke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de effecten van de Coronacrisis op het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked the minister about the effects of the COVID-19 crisis on pupils in special secondary education (vso), including pass and fail rates, class sizes and support measures. The minister answered that pass rates in vso rose in 2020, that no extra measures were needed beyond those already taken, and that the staatsexamen and extraneus figures do not show the feared deterioration.
Based on the 2020 pass rates, I see no reason to assume that the exam performance of vso pupils is worrying.
Op basis van de slagingspercentages van 2020 zie ik geen reden om aan te nemen dat de examenprestaties van leerlingen in het vso zorgwekkend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over het bericht "Geneeskundestudent met migratieachtergrond voelt zich gediscrimineerd door opleiding en patiënt"

MPs Westerveld and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a medical student with a migration background felt discriminated against by the programme and patients, asking about evidence, broader research, the Diversity Action Plan, assessment subjectivity, binding study advice effects, representation, awareness measures and internship discrimination. The minister cited VU research linking discrimination to fewer credits, said broader research is not necessary now, expressed confidence in the Action Plan, and answered the remaining questions mostly with general references, noting no national research on assessment subjectivity and an unclear effect of binding study advice, while committing to ongoing talks on an internship approach.
For that reason I do not consider broader research, in addition to what is already being done, necessary at this time.
Daarom acht ik een breder onderzoek – in aanvulling op wat er al gedaan wordt – op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Van der Graaf over emotionele verwaarlozing en huiselijk geweld als gevolg van de lockdown

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the government about a Leiden study showing more emotional neglect and domestic violence during the lockdown, why official reporting figures did not show the same rise, how professionals and schools can support vulnerable families, and how the findings should inform policy. The state secretary answered that the government is aware of the study, monitors reporting trends through CBS and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, points to helplines and support tools, and agrees the school closures' effects on vulnerable families must be weighed, while stating that secondary schools cannot reopen yet.
We therefore, together with these organisations, closely monitor the (numerical) developments currently and also in the coming period.
Wij houden daarom samen met deze organisaties de (cijfermatige) ontwikkelingen momenteel en ook de komende tijd nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Renkema over de forse stijging van jongeren die kampen met suïcidaliteit en eetstoornissen

MPs Westerveld and Renkema asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in young people with suicidal thoughts and eating disorders, including waiting lists, crisis capacity, lockdown effects and whether crisis beds were cut. The State Secretary answered that a coordination meeting and a survey of capacity by region are under way, that Jeugdautoriteit and the support team are available, that responsibility lies largely with municipalities and that a regional-visions bill is planned, but gave no national capacity data.
Because youth care is organised in a decentralised way, there is no national picture of the number of crisis reports and requests for help in youth care since the lockdown.
Vanwege de decentrale organisatie van de jeugdhulp is er is geen landelijk beeld van het aantal crisismeldingen en het aantal hulpvragen in de jeugdhulp over de periode sinds de lockdown.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld asked why the Schadefonds website still said it was unknown whether the compensation affects benefits, why it should be listed in tax returns, how many claims were filed, how elderly victims can apply, how victims are informed, and for an update on funding a memorial. The minister answered that the compensation does not count as income or assets for benefits and allowances, claims stood at about 1,900, the fund supports applications by proxy and by post, victims are actively informed, and up to 160,000 euros will be subsidised for the memorial.
Victims can ask the Tax Administration/Allowances to disregard this compensation of 5,000 euros for the assets test.
Slachtoffers kunnen bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen verzoeken deze tegemoetkoming van € 5.000,- buiten beschouwing te laten voor de vermogenstoets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de financiering van ventilatie verbetering scholen

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked whether municipalities lacking funds can meet the 70% co-financing condition for school ventilation upgrades and whether this creates inequality between schools. Minister Slob replied that the SUViS scheme is open, co-financing can take other forms, schools and municipalities are urged to talk, and further funding will be shaped later this year.
I closely monitor the applications and signals regarding the SUViS scheme.
Ik monitor de aanvragen en signalen rond de SUViS-regeling nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderalimentatie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about child maintenance: whether income changes can only be adjusted with mutual consent or a court, whether LBIO should review incomes periodically, whether recipients should account for spending, and how child benefit and the child-related budget create inequality. The minister answered that ex-partners should first agree between themselves, that courts remain available, that LBIO should not gain a review power, that periodic accounting is undesirable, and that the Belastingdienst is raising awareness, while rejecting a binding dispute committee.
I therefore see little added value in establishing a dispute committee for maintenance cases, certainly not given the downward trend in the number of court cases.
Ik zie dan ook weinig toegevoegde waarde in het instellen van een geschillencommissie voor alimentatiezaken, zeker niet gezien de dalende trend van het aantal rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over het bericht van NOS Sport op 21 december 2020, 'Sportrechtbank kraakt door machtsmisbruikzaken: dit is groter dan het turnen'

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked the minister, after a NOS report on the Sports Arbitration Institute (ISR) being overwhelmed by abuse-of-power complaints, about funding, volunteer judges, timelines for handling the gymnastics cases, and planned professionalisation. The minister answered that structural funding from 2021 and an extra 1 million euro from 2022 will enable Berenschot's recommendations, while giving timelines and capacity figures but no firm deadlines for the pending cases.
Yes, from 2021 there is structural financial support for the ISR.
Ja, vanaf 2021 is er sprake van een structurele financiële ondersteuning aan het ISR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over studiefinanciering

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education about the student loan system, including average debt before and after the 2015 reform, the number of Dutch students without a basic grant, the effect of student debt on maximum mortgage amounts, and the cost of extending free tuition to second degrees. The Minister answered each question with figures and estimates, noting that some recent-year data are not yet available.
No statements can be made about the years 2020–2021 (the current academic year) and 2021–2022 because these numbers are not yet known.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken gedaan worden over de jaren 2020–2021 (het huidige studiejaar) en 2021–2022 omdat deze aantallen nog niet bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Studenten laten aanvullende beurs vaak liggen’

An MP asks why a quarter of eligible first-year students did not claim the supplementary grant in 2018 and what will be done to inform them. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as poor awareness and stigma, and commits to improved information, a DUO mailing experiment and further studies on automatic entitlement checks.
I find it worrying that not all those entitled make use of the supplementary grant.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat niet alle rechthebbenden gebruik maken van de aanvullende beurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over het verdwijnen van ‘de Zeeuwse IC op het gebied van jeugdzorg’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Zeeland child-protection provider Intervence is being closed by 1 January 2021, whether children and families can be safely transferred, and whether the government is responsible. The government answers that municipalities chose the scenario, that no irreversible steps will be taken until an inspectorate-approved transition plan exists, and that tariff and personnel issues are being addressed.
The proposed decision by the municipalities has a far-reaching impact on the children and their relatives, the Intervence staff and all parties involved in Zeeland.
Het voorgenomen besluit van gemeenten is ingrijpend voor de kinderen en hun naasten, de medewerkers van Intervence en alle betrokken partijen in Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een laptop eisen niet mag, maar scholen ermee wegkomen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister whether schools may effectively require pupils to buy laptops or tablets, and whether devices should fall under the free-textbook law and its funding. The Minister answered that parents may be asked to buy devices only voluntarily, that schools must provide devices themselves where needed, and that the free-textbook law evaluation and policy response on devices will follow in the first half of 2021.
Schools may never oblige parents to purchase a laptop.
Scholen mogen ouders nooit verplichten een laptop aan te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de berichten 'Docent Rotterdams college bedreigd om spotprent' en 'Docent duikt onder om cartoon in de klas'

Two MPs asked the government about reports that a teacher in Rotterdam was threatened over a cartoon and went into hiding. The minister answered that he contacted the school and teacher, supports them, that police and the Inspectorate acted, a criminal investigation is ongoing, and that the Wet veiligheid op school is being evaluated.
Arrests have since been made in this case and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Er zijn inmiddels aanhoudingen verricht in deze zaak en het strafrechtelijk onderzoek is gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister Slob: Pluryn in de fout bij overdragen leerlingen Hoenderloo College'

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked why parliament was only informed in November that some pupils of the Hoenderloo College had no school place after closure, despite earlier assurances. The minister answered that Pluryn wrongly reported places were found, that the Inspectorate issued repair orders and intensive monitoring, and that all pupils were placed by 16 October 2020.
The board has taken its responsibility. This led to the last young person receiving a follow-up education place on 16 October 2020.
Het bestuur heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen. Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat op 16 oktober 2020 de laatste jongere een vervolg onderwijsplek heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de artikelen van Follow the Money en het Brabants Dagblad waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen niet naar jeugdzorg gaan

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that millions in youth care funding were not reaching care, including profit margins, executive pay above the WNT norm, opaque company structures and transparency of municipal oversight. The government acknowledged profit concerns and pointed to planned measures (Wibz, Wtza, youth care bill) but said it would not prevent profits outright, did not know municipal deficits, and deferred some points to later letters.
We must respect that transitional arrangement, even though I would prefer all salaries to already be below the maximum remuneration.
Dat overgangsrecht moeten we respecteren, ook al zou ik liever zien dat alle bezoldigingen nu al onder het bezoldigingsmaximum liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘NOS haalt na aanhoudende bedreigingen logo van satellietwagens’

Two MPs asked the government about the NOS removing logos from its satellite vans after threats, the state of press freedom, measures in other countries, and online disinformation. The ministers answered that press freedom is a serious concern, pointed to existing protocols and prosecutions, and described existing measures against disinformation without announcing new structural steps.
In our democratic society it is of crucial importance that the press can carry out its work in freedom, safety and independence.
In onze democratische samenleving is het van cruciaal belang dat de pers haar werk in vrijheid, veiligheid en onafhankelijkheid kan uitoefenen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over antwoorden op vragen inzake de berichten ‘Tekorten aan jeugdzorgers steeds nijpender’ en ‘Sterke daling nieuwe werknemers in de jeugdzorg: ‘Zo gaat het kapot’

Two MPs (Wörsdörfer, VVD, and Westerveld, GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Health about staff shortages in youth care, the role of the national government, the Arbeidsmarktagenda, tariffs, professional participation, the convenant on stopping time-writing, and simplification of product codes. The State Secretary answered at length, describing ongoing joint programmes and a planned AMvB on reasonable tariffs, but gave mostly general commitments and set a 2022 target for the simplified product codes.
It is not possible to break down the data collected under the Labour Market Care and Welfare research programme by sub-sector.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gegevens die in het kader van het onderzoeksprogramma Arbeidsmarkt Zorg en Welzijn (AZW) worden verzameld uit te splitsen naar subbranches.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over onderzoeken die uitwijzen dat koppen in de sport leidt tot hersenschade

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked the health minister about reports that major sports bodies obstruct research into head-injury damage from heading and fund congresses on the topic. The minister answered that research must be independent, that sports bodies' funding is acceptable if independence is guaranteed, that she is in talks with the KNVB on heading measures, and that the KNVB-AMC/VU heading study results are expected in spring 2021 but delayed.
I believe that scientific research must always be conducted independently.
Ik vind dat wetenschappelijk onderzoek altijd onafhankelijk moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kröger en Van den Berge over maatregelen tegen verspreiding COVID-19 op scholen

MPs from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about poor school ventilation, school closures due to COVID-19 infections, online education for quarantined pupils, mask rules and related guidance. The minister answered that schools are responsible for ventilation improvements supported by €100 million short-term and €260 million long-term funding, and outlined existing monitoring, advice and guidance without committing to new binding measures.
In addition, I call on schools to share the results with staff and parents.
Daarnaast roep ik op de resultaten te delen met het personeel en de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Hijink naar aanleiding van het bericht dat broertjes en zusjes vaak niet samenblijven bij een uithuisplaatsing

MPs Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that siblings are often not placed together when children are taken into care, and about the causes, data, reimbursement of travel costs and pleegouder numbers. The government answered that a WODC study on separated placements will report by autumn 2021, that CBS data is unavailable, that siblings are placed together where possible under existing guidelines, and that travel costs can be reimbursed, while legislation is not planned for now.
The WODC is going to carry out research this autumn into separated placements of siblings in out-of-home placements.
Het WODC gaat dit najaar onderzoek doen naar gescheiden plaatsingen van broers en zussen bij een uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Rutgers: 1 op 3 basisscholen geeft geen les over homoseksualiteit'

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Education whether schools teach about sexual diversity as required by the core objectives, given a Rutgers survey showing a third of primary schools do not, and what action will be taken on lesson methods, mbo and secondary teaching and teacher training. The minister replied that schools have discretion in how they meet the core objectives, cited an inspectorate study finding 86 percent of schools address sexual diversity, pointed to inspection enforcement and a request for further monitoring, and noted the curriculum revision will sharpen the core objective.

I have asked the inspectorate to give further attention in upcoming studies to how schools address sexual diversity, and to keep me informed of the current state of affairs regarding schools' attention to sexual diversity.

Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd de invulling die scholen geven aan seksuele diversiteit in komende onderzoeken verder aandacht te geven, en mij op de hoogte te houden van de actuele stand van zaken rond de aandacht van scholen voor seksuele diversiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Autistische Gijs (11) kan nergens terecht voor zorg: 'Hij zegt zelfs dat hij niet langer wil leven, hartverscheurend''

An MP asked the minister how a parent can find appropriate care for an 11-year-old autistic child who has no suitable placement, and who is responsible when a provider is unable to continue treatment. The government answers that municipalities and providers are responsible, points to regional expertise teams and new expertise centres for complex youth care, and gives no measures specifically for this family.
Municipalities are responsible for organising support and care for children and young people.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van de ondersteuning en zorg aan kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Sterke daling nieuwe werknemers in de jeugdzorg: 'Zo gaat het kapot’

An MP asked the minister about a sharp drop in new staff entering youth care, the risk to waiting lists and the working conditions of youth care workers. The state secretary disputed the 30% figure, cited a 13% drop after correcting for administrative mobility, and outlined sector action on recruitment, pay, workload and administrative burden.
It is important that people choose to work in youth care and that this still happens in considerable numbers.
Het is belangrijk dat mensen kiezen om in de jeugdzorg te werken en dat dat nog steeds met flinke aantallen gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Minister laat Neerlandistiek zichzelf redden’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Molen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why no structural funds are provided for Dutch-language studies (Neerlandistiek) and a sector plan, and about teacher shortages, enrolment decline, the KNAW's recommendations and a Stronks pilot. The Minister answers that only limited one-off funds (around 100,000 euros for coordination and a pilot) are available, that faculties must reprioritise within existing lump-sum money, and that no further sector plan funding exists, while noting ongoing cost-adequacy research and Flemish cooperation.
At this moment no funds are available for a languages sector plan.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor een sectorplan talen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de rol, taken en verantwoordelijkheden van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the role, tasks and responsibilities of the LEBZ expert group on sexual offence cases, the removal of a website sentence about it, and calls for an independent investigation into ritual abuse networks. The minister explained that the LEBZ advises the public prosecutor non-bindingly, that the website change did not alter its role, and that he sees no reason for a new investigation while offering to contact German counterparts.
The advice of the LEBZ is not binding.
De adviezen van de LEBZ zijn niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het meldpunt voor reiskosten zomerstages en zomerles

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a student-union complaints desk on summer travel costs for internships and summer classes, and about compensation, flexible use of the extra travel entitlement, and travel allowances for vavo adult-education students. The minister answered that she will not compensate students, that flexible use of the three extra months is not feasible in implementation, and that a consultation with the VNG on vavo travel costs is ongoing, with results promised by end 2020.
No, I am not prepared to do that.
Nee, ik ben daar niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'Private equity koopt de crèche, de zorgkinderen moeten weg'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the state secretary about reports that private equity owner Blos is ending its plusgroepen for children with special needs, and about oversight of such takeovers. The state secretary said childcare organisations decide their own offer, municipalities hold the care duty, the oudercommissie was not consulted as required, and research on ownership and quality is underway.
The oudercommissies made this omission known to the childcare organisation, and a conversation with each of the three oudercommissies then took place after all.
De oudercommissies hebben deze omissie bij de kinderopvangorganisatie kenbaar gemaakt en daarop heeft alsnog een gesprek met ieder van de drie oudercommissies plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen, Kwint en Rog over de lerarenbeurs

MPs asked why the teacher grant (lerarenbeurs) budget was exhausted in 2020, how many applications were rejected, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The ministers answered that 2,416 initial applications were rejected after renewal applications were prioritised, and that budget cuts from parliamentary amendments reduced the budget from 78 to 49.6 million euros, communicated through several channels.
We could not inform you earlier because applications could be submitted until 30 June, and only afterwards was it clear how many renewal applications had been submitted.
Wij konden u niet eerder informeren omdat er tot en met 30 juni aanvragen ingediend konden worden en het pas daarna duidelijk was hoeveel herhaalaanvragen waren ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over omscholingstrajecten om leraar te worden

An MP asks how career changers into teaching can find routes, how many drop out and why, whether unmet demand causes waiting lists, and why a second education master costs about 9,000 euro for 25 EC. The ministers answer that a national helpdesk and regional points exist, dropout data is incomplete and being studied, the subsidy must be reported if training stops, and a maximum institutional tuition rate will apply from 2022-2023 via a pending bill.
We share your view that more insight is needed into the course of the career-changer route.
Wij delen met u dat er meer inzicht nodig is in het verloop van de route zij-instroom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over berichten in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad over intimidatie en misbruik van jonge turnsters

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of abuse of young gymnasts, including whether an involved coach remains in the Olympic track, support for victims, complaint figures at the CVSN, handling by the ISR, and coach training. The minister answered that the KNGU suspended the Team NL women's programme pending an independent inquiry, outlined the victim support and reporting structures, gave complaint and case figures, and declined to make vertrouwenspersonen mandatory while pointing to federations for coach standards.
I am very reluctant to impose obligations on sports associations.
Ik ben zeer terughoudend met het opleggen van verplichtingen aan sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'UEFA wil maatregelen tegen koppen in jeugdvoetbal'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about UEFA's recommendation to limit heading by children in youth football and about risks of head injuries in combat sports. The minister answered that the KNVB already applies UEFA-aligned measures, that no conclusive evidence of harm exists yet with research due in spring 2021, and that the ban on kicking and punching the head for under-18 combat athletes is enforced by the sector and the Vechtsportautoriteit.
Based on current scientific knowledge, there is no unambiguous evidence of harm resulting from heading.
Op basis van de huidige wetenschappelijke kennis is geen eenduidig bewijs van schade als gevolg van koppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de continuïteit van jeugdhulp en geestelijke gezondheidszorg

GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about continuity of youth care and mental health care during the coronavirus crisis, including treatment and visiting rules, liquidity risks, shortages of protective equipment, the size of postponed care demand, and whether insurers should proactively inventory support. The minister answered that visiting rules are being balanced against RIVM guidance, that continuity payments and compensation schemes are in place, and that the NZa monitors postponed care while insurers retain their duty of care.
A general visitor stop is therefore not desirable.
Een algehele bezoekersstop is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld  en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dertig leerlingen uit het speciaal basisonderwijs noodgedwongen ondergebracht worden bij reguliere scholen

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether a school board could unilaterally move 30 pupils from a special primary school to regular schools without parental consent, and how the Inspectorate handled complaints about the school. Minister Slob answered that the law does not expressly regulate this, that parents were individually consulted and given school visits, that the Inspectorate received 12 complaints and a repair inspection is under way, and that no further action is needed.
The legislation does not expressly regulate this.
In de wetgeving is dit niet uitdrukkelijk geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Van den Hul, Van Meenen, Westerveld en Kwint over selectief aanmeldbeleid bij basisscholen

MPs asked the minister how government and the Education Inspectorate responded to research showing Utrecht primary schools operated pre-registration practices that breached the law and harmed equal access, including for children with migrant backgrounds. The minister said the inspectorate can intervene, that the municipality and school boards are drafting an improvement plan due in October, and that a broader study of admission policy and a policy agenda on segregation will follow.
If it becomes apparent that this is not being complied with, the Education Inspectorate can intervene.
Als blijkt dat daaraan niet wordt voldaan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Westerveld en Renkema over het openbaar vervoer

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about public transport access during COVID-19, including the OV protocol, student timing, support for people with disabilities, and bicycle policy. The state secretary answered that the protocol protects all users, that Reisassistentie is fully available again from 1 June, and that a further letter on accessibility for people with disabilities will follow.
How accessibility will be further guaranteed for this group is a topic of discussion in the OV protocol working group.
Hoe toegankelijkheid verder wordt gewaarborgd voor deze groep is onderwerp van gesprek in de werkgroep OV-protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het leerlingenvervoer in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister about school transport for special secondary education pupils after reports that some municipalities could not arrange it and that taxis refused pupils or required masks. The Minister said municipalities are responsible, that transport has largely gone well with few reports of missed school, and that children who cannot keep masks on should be transported with 1.5m distance, but gave no concrete new step.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport lies with the municipality, because locally it is best assessed what transport is needed.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt bij de gemeente, omdat lokaal het beste kan worden bekeken welk vervoer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Kuiken over jeugdzorg en de (jeugd-)GGZ

MPs Westerveld, Renkema and Kuiken asked the health minister about youth care and mental health services disrupted by COVID-19, including remote care, crisis beds, support for children in unsafe homes, financial stability of providers and shortages of protective equipment. The minister answered that the ministry monitors signals via crisis-structure consultations, supports digital care, reports crisis-bed capacity as sufficient, lists measures for children at risk, and describes agreements with VNG and the Jeugdautoriteit on continued funding.
When signals arrive repeatedly, we place them on the agenda of one of the consultations we set up within the corona crisis structure for mental health care and youth care.
Als signalen herhaaldelijk binnenkomen, agenderen we deze in één van de overleggen die we hebben opgezet in het kader van de corona-crisisstructuur voor de GGZ en voor de jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Jeugdzorgbedden weg in Oss en Boxtel, kan dat wel?’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Westerveld asked the minister about youth care beds closing in Oss and Boxtel, how waiting lists for specialist youth care are monitored regionally and nationally, and whether the inspectorate and providers can make waiting lists transparent. The minister answered that municipalities hold the youth care duty and that waiting-list problems must be addressed regionally, announcing binding inter-municipal cooperation and a regional approach, while declining a national overview and not committing to new agreements beyond existing regional commitments.
They hold the youth care duty and are responsible for sufficient suitable care provision.
Zij hebben de jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor voldoende passend hulpaanbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Expertisecentrum kreeg vorig jaar recordaantal euthanasieverzoeken’ en ‘Jongeren die in 2017 zelfmoord pleegden vaak verstrikt in web van

MPs Westerveld, Ellemeet and Renkema asked the Health Minister about reports on record euthanasia requests at the Expertise Centre and on young people who died by suicide after being caught in the care system, asking about youth euthanasia rules, unrecorded self-harm and suicide prevention policy. The minister answered that most youth requests reflect a need for help rather than a death wish, provided statistics on youth requests and rejections, and said the government will present a new national suicide prevention agenda this year.
The Expertise Centre does not keep data on this.
Hier houdt het Expertisecentrum geen gegevens over bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de sportsector

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked about COVID-19 impacts on sports: whether clubs with payroll staff can use the NOW wage subsidy, whether clubs and event organisers get financial support, municipal compensation and SPUK extension, and how elite athletes without A-status can access aid. The minister answered that the €120 million package and NOW/TOGS/Tozo schemes apply under conditions, that municipalities receive €90 million compensation, that the SPUK will be evaluated before a decision, and that some athletes without KvK registration fall outside existing schemes.
As I have promised the House, the SPUK is currently being evaluated. Based on this, I will in due course take a decision on the continuation of the SPUK.
Zoals ik de Kamer heb toegezegd, wordt de SPUK momenteel geëvalueerd. Op basis hiervan zal ik te zijner tijd een besluit nemen over de voortzetting van de SPUK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de financiële situatie van studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education about financial hardship among students during the COVID-19 crisis, including loan trends, parental income distribution, the supplementary grant system and study duration. The minister reported no increase in loan applications or loan amounts, explained that parental income affects grant eligibility, and provided income and loan breakdowns, though the answers were delayed beyond the requested date.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het rapport ‘Constant nieuwe gezichten, ik crash daarvan’ van Stichting Het Vergeten Kind

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report showing children in youth care face frequent placement moves and high staff turnover, and asked what will be done to reduce both. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says municipalities and providers are primarily responsible, and points to existing programmes, a handbook in preparation, a WODC study and workforce initiatives, while committing to help build better data but without a concrete binding measure.
Primarily, municipalities and providers are the ones to be held accountable for this.
Primair zijn gemeenten en aanbieders hierop aanspreekbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over dwangbehandelingen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about the reduction of coercive and restrictive measures in youth care, including inspection visits, planned legislation on youth legal position, registration of forced seclusion and force-feeding, and inspection oversight. The minister answered that inspections covered closed youth institutions and related facilities, that institutions are not legally obliged to report seclusion data to the inspectorate, and that a bill on the legal position of youths in closed institutions is planned for consultation by July 2020.
Closed youth care institutions have no legal obligation to send this registration to the inspectorate.
Gesloten jeugdhulpinstellingen hebben geen wettelijke plicht om deze registratie aan de inspectie te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'KNVB is nog niet toe aan een kopverbod'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether football heading by children should be restricted in light of studies on head impacts and the English FA's plans, and whether the government would engage the KNVB. The minister said the research is inconclusive, that the KNVB is studying heading with AMC/VU with results expected in early 2021, and that he will await those conclusions.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the KNVB's research.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het onderzoek van de KNVB af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over de verhuisbewegingen en onderwijs aan minderjarige asielzoekers

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether frequent relocations of minor asylum seekers harm their Dutch-language learning and school access, and whether the coalition goal of minimising moves is being met. Minister Slob acknowledges the negative effect of moves, points to mitigation measures (a COA relocation checklist, summer relocations, the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme with implementation planned 2020–2024), says data on move trends are not yet conclusive, and rejects reports of schools refusing children, while noting the two-year funding period.
That is why the focus is mainly on medium-term measures.
Daarom wordt vooral ingezet op middellange termijn maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld op de tweede onderwijsstudie

An MP asked the Education Minister about high tuition fees for a second teacher-training degree, including whether the lower statutory rate should apply to graduates who are not working in education or healthcare. The minister said a limited subsidy scheme was created within budget, declined to abolish the institutional rate or to extend the lower rate to non-practising graduates, and rejected binding agreements with institutions.
Making agreements on lowering institutional tuition rates is not something I currently consider desirable or necessary.
Afspraken maken over het verlagen van instellingstarieven acht ik nu niet wenselijk en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leraren die onder druk worden gezet

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that parents pressure teachers over school recommendations, that too-high placements harm pupils, and about testing and support for pupils. The Minister disputes the DUO study's conclusions, says pressure on primary schools has not risen, cites Oberon/Twente findings on second chances, and announces a school-recommendation handbook to be piloted in spring.
Furthermore, a handbook on school recommendations is currently being developed in cooperation with SLO and other stakeholders in the education sector.
Verder wordt op dit moment, in samenwerking met SLO en andere betrokkenen uit het onderwijsveld, een handreiking schooladvisering ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het manifest van Lijm de zorg

MPs Wörsdörfer (VVD) and Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Health about the Lijm de zorg manifesto on young people and parents who get stuck in the youth care system, including numbers, the number of contact points, and promised follow-up. The Minister acknowledged that some young people do not get timely help, reported about 100 complex youth cases in 2019, outlined new regional expert teams and specialist centres, and said a single clear overview and a referral route to VWS are being set up, while confirming the follow-up letter was already sent.
It is not known how many signals were received in 2017 and 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel signalen er in 2017 en 2018 zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de wijziging woonplaatsbeginsel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Health about the amended residence principle in youth care, including whether youth care providers should get an automated residence check via the BRP and what happens if municipalities miss the two-week deadline to name the responsible municipality. The Minister rejects a BRP access tool on principled, privacy and management grounds, promises a feasibility study, and proposes municipalities pay providers and settle costs among themselves if the deadline is missed.

Following this implementation assessment, further research was conducted into whether it would be possible and necessary for youth care providers to check in the BRP which municipality is responsible.
Naar aanleiding van deze Uitvoeringstoets is er nader onderzocht of het mogelijk en nodig zou zijn dat jeugdzorgaanbieders in de BRP kunnen checken welke gemeente verantwoordelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Futselaar over het rapport van WOinActie ‘Inventarisatie omvang en gevolgen van structureel overwerk aan de Nederlandse universiteiten’

Three opposition MPs asked the government about a WOinActie report on structural unpaid overtime at Dutch universities, including whether it is lawful, the government's responsibility, job insecurity and workload causes. The minister answered that the Inspectie SZW will examine the complaints in its planned inspections of the 14 universities, that the Wml, Atw and Arbowet set the legal limits, and that she will press institutions and VSNU on permanent contracts and workload reduction.
It is up to the Inspectie SZW to investigate whether this is indeed the case.
Het is aan de Inspectie SZW om te onderzoeken of dit inderdaad het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over pleegouders die voortijdig stoppen

An MP asked the health minister about foster parents who stop prematurely, the report 'Waarom stoppen pleegouders', financial barriers, cooperation between child protection and foster care, and unaccompanied asylum-seeking children placed in foster families. The minister answered that better aftercare and support will be addressed within the foster care action plan, with an action-research outcome expected in autumn 2020.

I will therefore engage with all parties involved in implementing the foster care action plan to see where within the plan there are opportunities to further strengthen support, recognition and appreciation of foster parents.

Ik ga dan ook in gesprek met alle partijen die betrokken zijn bij de uitvoering van het actieplan pleegzorg om te kijken waar binnen het actieplan mogelijkheden zijn om de ondersteuning, erkenning en waardering van pleegouders verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het onderzoek van de Erasmus Universiteit over de representatie van mensen met een beperking in de media

An MP asked the minister about an Erasmus University study finding that only 66 of 6,129 talk-show guests had a disability, and what the government would do about representation in public broadcasting. The minister acknowledged the findings, said programming is a matter for the broadcaster under programmatic autonomy, and promised only to raise attention to disability visibility with the NPO.
However, how the public broadcaster fulfils this task in the form and content of its programmes is not for the government or politicians to decide.
De wijze waarop aan deze taak door de publieke omroep invulling wordt gegeven in vorm en inhoud van programma's is echter niet aan de overheid of politiek om te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht dat jongeren met een beperking te vroeg van school worden gestuurd

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister whether young people with disabilities are being removed from special secondary education too early, whether school boards can decide this unilaterally, and whether oversight and legal protection are adequate. The minister answered that the age limit is not absolute, decisions must be based on the pupil's development plan agreed with parents, the inspectorate has been asked to supervise, and existing appeal routes and legal protection are sufficient.
I have asked the Inspectorate to ensure that the partnerships comply with the statutory provisions in this regard.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd er op toe te zien dat de samenwerkingsverbanden zich aan de wettelijke bepalingen in deze houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderen die seksueel zijn misbruikt en onvoldoende hulp krijgen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health and justice ministers about child sexual abuse victims who receive insufficient care, including misdiagnosis, referrals between services, use of isolation, and funding problems at Centres for Sexual Violence. The minister acknowledged difficulties in recognising trauma and referral delays, outlined programmes and pilots, and said the exact numbers are not known while committing to further research and a study with the Dutch Rapporteur.
The requested figures are not known.
De gevraagde cijfers zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘De stagiair is vogelvrij’ op AOb.nl op 19 november 2019

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether the position of teacher-trainee (lio) interns should be better safeguarded and why schools do not follow collective agreement rules on interns, after an AOb report that interns are treated as unprotected. The ministers answer that lio trainees may teach under supervision with a temporary contract, that existing collective agreement rules and a 2018 handreiking govern their deployment, and that they will ask the school boards' associations to inform schools and pay trainees.
We will ask the PO-Raad and VO-raad to inform school boards about this issue and urge them to pay a fee for the internship
We zullen de PO-Raad en de VO-raad vragen besturen te informeren over deze kwestie en erop aandringen een vergoeding te betalen bij de stage
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Brief voor ex-zorgmedewerkers: kom terug!’

An MP asked why health ministers could write to former care workers to return, while privacy law blocked a similar letter to former teachers in the stille reserve. The minister said the Data Protection Authority advised that pension-fund data cannot be used for this purpose, so he will not write to former teachers, and pointed to regional re-integration measures and subsidies instead.
The advice confirms that the purpose for which the ABP collects personal data is not compatible with the purpose for which the data would be used.
In het advies wordt bevestigd dat het doel waarmee het ABP persoonsgegevens verzamelt niet verenigbaar is met waar de gegevens voor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over aanbieders van decentrale selectietrainingen geneeskunde

An MP asked whether commercial training providers for the decentralised medicine selection test, and their effect on equal opportunity, should prompt the government to restrict them or rethink selection policy. The Minister replied that such trainings are legal and do not significantly raise admission chances per ResearchNed, that selection cannot rest solely on a knowledge test, and that the government will critically review selection criteria and limit selection where possible.
I do not know how many providers there are or how much money is spent on the demand side.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel aanbieders er zijn en hoeveel geld er aan de vraagkant in omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het rapport 'FC Twente, Feyenoord en de Europese regels voor staatssteun'

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked the ministers about a report claiming state aid to professional football clubs (FC Twente, Feyenoord) is unlawful and that municipalities are pressured into paying, and whether the EU Commission and national rules adequately police this. The Minister rejects the claims of coercion and unfair advantage, says anyone can complain to the Commission and that the Commission can act ex officio, and explains that municipalities are primarily responsible for state-aid compliance, with the Rijk supporting this through a knowledge centre, but commits to no new action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat een 13-jarig meisje 4 uur lang met handboeien om is vastgehouden

MP Westerveld asked the health minister how a 13-year-old girl could be held for four hours in handcuffs without an available crisis place, and whether this shows too little care is available. The minister answered that a suitable place existed in the girl's own region, that the press report was corrected, that she was placed in her existing institution, and that no national figures are kept on out-of-region crisis placements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Renkema over "de bureaucratie rondom het aanvragen van de dubbele kinderbijslag"

GroenLinks MPs asked the state secretary about bureaucracy in applying for double child benefit for intensive care, including repeat applications and possible simplification. The secretary reported application and appeal figures, said a follow-up study is underway with results due before summer 2020, and committed to simplifying the process if feasible.
I am in favour of simplifying processes, especially when this relieves citizens of burdens.
Ik ben een voorstander van vereenvoudiging van processen, zeker als burgers hiermee ontlast worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld en Wörstendörfer over ‘jeugdzorg wil actie tegen agressie’: ‘je bent gewaarschuwd ik maak je kapot’

MPs Wörstendörfer and Westerveld asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, sentencing, complaints handling, and privacy of professionals' data in the registry. The minister answered that aggression is widespread and measures are underway, that the OM applies a 200% aggravation for such offences, that complaints procedures are being evaluated, and that the registry data leak has been corrected.
I will talk with the sector, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to find out whether additional steps are needed.
Ik ga in gesprek met de branche, de politie en het OM te achterhalen of extra stappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de documentaire TURN!, 2Doc, 8 oktober 2019

MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the 2Doc documentary TURN! showing very young gymnasts pressured into intense training, and about safe-sport oversight, pedagogical training, parental information and complaint channels. The minister acknowledged concern, pointed to the Centrum Veilige Sport, KNGU reforms and the Sportakkoord, and committed to informing parliament on the centre's progress next year, while leaving most responsibility with sports bodies and clubs.
I will inform you next year, before the committee meeting, in more detail about the progress of the Centre for Safe Sport.
Ik zal u volgend jaar voorafgaand aan het AO nader informeren over de voortgang van het Centrum Veilige Sport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over levensbedreigend ziek zijn en lang op de wachtlijst staan

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the health minister about a 13-year-old with a life-threatening eating disorder who waited nine months for treatment, whether the minister knew of similar cases, how many young people are on waiting lists, and what will shorten them. The minister apologised for the late reply, said a treatment place was found after intervention, but has no overview of waiting lists and points to regional arrangements and planned expertise centres.
There is no national overview of waiting lists and waiting times.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van wachtlijsten en wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de stijgende reserves bij samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP asked the minister about rising reserves at special-education cooperative bodies (samenwerkingsverbanden) and what should be done. The minister says reserves are a concern, lists reasons given by the bodies, and defers on acceptable ratios and measures until an Inspectorate study reports in spring 2020.
The Oberon study you will receive by the end of the year is separate from the Inspectorate's study.
Het onderzoek van Oberon, dat u voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt staat los van het onderzoek van de Inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het percentage coördinatiekosten van totaal jeugdzorgbudget

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Health about reports that about 30% of the youth care budget goes to coordination costs, and whether the government has insight into this. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, said the coordination-cost figures are a Berenschot benchmark with varying definitions, committed to a KPMG deep-dive study due end of the year, and described the deregulation ('ontregel de zorg') and schrapdagen efforts to cut avoidable overhead.
To this end, the in-depth study 'insight into the spending of youth care funds' is currently being carried out.
Hiertoe wordt momenteel het diepteonderzoek «inzicht in besteding jeugdzorgmiddelen» uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over het bericht dat sommige jongeren niet kunnen studeren omdat zij dakloos zijn

GroenLinks MPs asked whether homeless young people are excluded from education, how many cannot study or lack a startkwalificatie, where they can get help, and about schuldsanering and student loan barriers. The government replied that lack of a registered address is no bar to enrolment, that no national figures exist on homeless youth without qualifications, that municipalities coordinate support, and pointed to existing action programmes and schuldhulp measures.
DUO does not register who has no fixed residential or residence address.
DUO registreert niet wie er geen vaste woon- of verblijfsplaats heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de kwaliteitsafspraken van de TU Delft

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the government approved the TU Delft quality agreement plans despite a negative NVAO advice, and whether this affects the independence of the approval process and the signal sent to institutions. The Minister answered that NVAO advice carries heavy weight, but that TU Delft's response clarified its concrete, measurable goals, which led to a different weighing of the advice, and denied that independence was affected.
NVAO advice plays a weighty role in my decision-making on the quality agreement plans.
Adviezen van de NVAO hebben een zwaarwegende rol in mijn besluitvorming over de plannen voor de kwaliteitsafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over gezinsvoogden

An MP asked the Minister about a shortage of child-protection guardians (gezinsvoogden), their caseloads, links to out-of-home placements, and unresolved responsibility for pocket and clothing money for children under protective orders. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to an ongoing inspection and to labour-market programmes, and said he would raise the issue of pocket money with municipalities.
The inspection report, including my response, I will send to you before the WGO Youth meeting of 18 November 2019.
Het inspectierapport, inclusief mijn reactie, zal ik u voor het WGO Jeugd van 18 november 2019 toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het stoppen van Stichting De Opbouw met het aanbieden van jeugdzorg door Lijn5

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the decision by Stichting De Opbouw to stop offering youth care through Lijn5, its impact on about 2,000 young people and families, late notification, and whether the funding and organisation of youth care is to blame. The minister answered that Lijn5 remains fully operational, families were informed, care continuity is being arranged with other providers, municipalities bear the youth care duty, and the situation of several youth care providers is being monitored with the Jeugdautoriteit involved.
Lijn5 is fully operational and all treatment appointments are being honoured.
Lijn5 is volledig in bedrijf en alle behandelafspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het terugbetalen van de lerarenbeurs

An MP asked the education minister about students of Open Universiteit education sciences who must repay teacher grants, the number affected, the average repayment, the reasons for clawback, and whether the conditions were unclear. The minister confirmed 573 students with an average repayment of about 4,156 euro, explained the grant is a subsidy subject to clawback rules, and refused to create a special arrangement for those affected.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over schoolkassa van ParnasSys

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether the ParnasSys Schoolkassa brochure and emails wrongly suggest multiple or compulsory parental contributions, implicitly encourage excluding children who do not pay, and whether the minister will discuss this with ParnasSys. The minister answered that schools must state contributions are voluntary, that ParnasSys has already revised the wording, and that schools themselves are responsible for their communications and compliance.
Schools are obliged to state the voluntary nature of the parental contribution in the school guide and to communicate this clearly.
Scholen zijn verplicht om de vrijwilligheid van de ouderbijdrage te vermelden in de schoolgids en daar duidelijk over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Eigen  strenge declaratieregels UU weer opzij’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why Utrecht University dropped its own strict rules requiring prior written approval for business-class flights, and whether a college chair's EUR 8,604.94 business-class claims were proportionate. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found the costs compliant with rules and proportionate, that business class is allowed for intercontinental flights under the national scheme, and that a thematic inspection of expense rules will follow at the end of 2019 before deciding whether further regulation is needed.
I sent this report to the House on 12 September.
Ik heb dit rapport op 12 september aan de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Kinderen in de gesloten jeugdzorg te vaak opgesloten’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister whether he accepts the inspectorate's warning that agreed targets for reducing forced isolation of youths in closed youth care will not be met, and asked what he will do about staff shortages and funding. The minister denies the inspectorate said the targets will not be met, points to a baseline measurement of 860 isolations and a project with providers, and promises further measurement and an labour-market agenda, while not committing to a firm 2022 zero target.
The factsheet does not state that the agreements with the field will not be met.
In het factsheet staat niet dat de afspraken met het werkveld niet gehaald gaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het aanpakken van pro-anorexia websites en ‘anorexiacoaches’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about pro-anorexia websites, the scale of such online communities, and the 'anorexia coaches' who solicit sexual images from vulnerable girls. The government said a research study by CKM and GGZ Rivierduinen is ongoing with results due in autumn, that a ban on pro-ana sites would be ineffective and could reinforce stigma, and pointed to existing criminal law, grooming provisions and the K-EET care chain initiative as its response.
It has not been mapped how extensive the pro-anorexia websites are in the Netherlands, and there is no overall picture of the websites, forums and social media channels.
Er is niet in kaart gebracht hoe omvangrijk de pro-anorexia websites zijn in Nederland en er is geen totaalbeeld van de websites, fora en sociale mediakanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Kwint over de subsidiepot voor zijinstroom in het onderwijs

MPs asked why the subsidy pot for career changers (zij-instroom) in education hit its ceiling for a second year, why DUO sent letters saying applications were on hold, and whether the scheme should become open-ended. The minister says the ceiling has been raised, unfunded applications will be reallocated after the October deadline, the letter wording will be corrected, and budgets will be monitored and reset annually.
The content of the letter will be adjusted.
De inhoud van de brief wordt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Westerveld over geweld in de jeugdzorg

MPs Buitenweg and Westerveld asked whether psychological child abuse is punishable under Dutch criminal law and how prosecutors handle it, and what measures the government will take. The minister answered that Article 300 Sr can cover psychological abuse, that the Public Prosecution Service examines such cases case by case, that no Criminal Code revision is currently considered opportune, and listed ongoing programmes and a pending bill strengthening child abuse liability.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vijf stenen door de ramen bij journalist Willem Groeneveld van stadsblog Sikkom'

MPs Smeulders and Westerveld asked about the stone-throwing attack on journalist Willem Groeneveld, whether a landlord could be barred from the housing market if linked to it, what is being done to protect journalists, and how malicious landlords are targeted. The minister condemned threats against journalists, deferred on the landlord question until police and prosecutors finish, listed press-freedom and journalist-protection measures, and described pilots and ongoing work against bad landlords without committing to a keurmerk or mystery-guest checks.
Once the investigation is complete, I will consider whether further action on my part is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek zal ik bekijken of verdere actie van mijn kant gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in financiële steun die scholieren krijgen voor digitale middelen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about large differences in financial support for pupils' digital learning materials, including whether schools may require expensive laptops and who should pay. The minister replied that schools must fund digital materials from their lump-sum budget, may request but not require a specific device, and that a study on the adequacy of funding will report in March 2020.
I am currently having research carried out into the efficiency and adequacy of the funding.
Ik laat op dit moment onderzoek doen naar de doelmatigheid en toereikendheid van de bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de faciliteiten van jongerenorganisaties

An MP asked the education, health and interior ministers about whether youth organisations deserve facilities, how youth are consulted on policy, which subsidies exist and how board grants (bestuursbeurzen) are allocated. The government answered that youth participation matters, outlined existing consultation channels and subsidies, and defended the current allocation criteria limited to higher-education-relevant organisations.
No, there is no separate overview of youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Nee, er is geen afzonderlijk overzicht van jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht Leraar waarschuwt tegen ‘wurgcontract’ van uitzendbureau

Two MPs asked the minister whether a staffing agency's demand for a buyout fee before a teacher could be hired on a permanent contract, and the resulting teacher turnover, is acceptable and harms pupils. The minister said school boards are responsible for staffing, called the practice undesirable, will raise the case with the PO-Raad and is running a pilot on non-employed staff, but declined to propose new restrictions.
School boards are responsible for appointing temporary agency staff, in line with what has been agreed in the collective labour agreement.
Schoolbesturen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van uitzendpersoneel, in overeenstemming met wat daarover is afgesproken in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over staatsexamens

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the education minister why state examination candidates get their centralized exam results later than regular pupils, why the state exam timetable and reading lists differ, and whether exam results can be released before enrolment deadlines. Minister Slob answered that the staatsexamen timetable is fixed by the availability of examiners, results can only be released once all centralized results are processed, and reading lists are not stricter than for regular pupils.
The CvTE tells me that announcing the results before the start of the college examinations is not possible, because not all centralized exam results are then known and/or processed.

Het CvTE vertelt mij dat bekendmaking van de resultaten voorafgaand aan de start van de college-examens niet mogelijk is, omdat dan nog niet alle resultaten van de centrale examens bekend en/of verwerkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de hoge ouderbijdrage van ouders met hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about very high voluntary parental contributions (up to 500 euro and beyond) charged for gifted-child classes, and about the possibility of parents appealing to schools or subsidies to normalise these fees. The minister agrees that implicit barriers are unacceptable and that a high voluntary contribution can deter enrolment, but points to school complaint procedures, says no maximum amount will be introduced for now, and promises only to discuss the example at a future meeting with the PO-Raad and to raise the monitoring question with researchers.
There is no complete picture of how many gifted-child classes ask for voluntary parental contributions.
Er is geen compleet beeld bij hoeveel hoogbegaafdenklassen vrijwillige ouderbijdragen worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs en leerlingenvervoer aan vluchtelingenkinderen

An MP asks the education minister about pre-school education, schooling, school admission, transport and absenteeism for refugee children. The minister answers that the government will consult VNG and COA, study pre-school provision in asylum reception, and describes existing support and admission rules, without committing to new structural changes.
In addition, I will conduct a study into the provision of pre-school education for toddlers in asylum reception, following the adopted motion by MP Westerveld.
Daarnaast zal ik een onderzoek doen naar het aanbod van voorschoolse educatie voor peuters in de asielopvang, naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie van lid Westerveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over bureaucratie in de jeugdzorg

MP Westerveld asks the Minister of Health about reports that youth-care negotiations with municipalities focus on money, procurement burdens absorbing budget in municipal bureaucracy, and staffing and administrative costs. The minister denies that discussions only concern money, acknowledges procurement burdens, points to extra funding and planned VNG agreements, but declines to provide municipal staffing figures and defers that responsibility to municipalities.
No. This is a responsibility of individual municipalities.
Neen. Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leerlingen die worden uitgeschreven op school

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asks the minister about pupils being unlawfully unenrolled from school, the role of the inspectorate, complaints committee and education consultants, and whether a national complaints point is needed. Minister Slob answers that schools may not expel pupils without parental consent and procedures are strict, that the inspectorate can impose sanctions but the Vossius case was addressed, and that a national point is not planned, while exploring binding advice for the complaints committee.
It is indeed not the intention that school boards evade their duty of care for appropriate education by unenrolling pupils.
Het is inderdaad niet de bedoeling dat schoolbesturen zich aan de zorgplicht passend onderwijs onttrekken door leerlingen uit te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het recht tot zelfbeschikking van intersekse baby’s en kinderen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on intersex children's bodily autonomy, prevalence, unnecessary surgery, and parental consent. Minister Bruins answered that medical decisions rest with professionals, that no IGJ reports of non-consensual procedures are known, that research is insufficient, and that a quality standard for intersex/DSD care is being developed.
I therefore cannot confirm that there are intersex babies and children in the Netherlands who have undergone a non-medically necessary procedure without informed consent.
Ik kan dan ook niet bevestigen dat er intersekse baby's en kinderen zijn in Nederland die zonder dat er sprake is van informed consent een niet-medisch noodzakelijke ingreep hebben ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een zorgorganisatie die leningen verstrekt

An MP asked the health minister whether care organisations may lend money or invest their revenue, whether youth-care funds reach care, and why problems at a Twente care provider surfaced only at the annual accounts stage. The minister confirmed no legal bar exists on such activities for Wmo providers, pointed to municipalities for contract and quality criteria, and said the regional partnership terminated the contract on advice, so no further action is planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further action.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om verdere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Scholen moeten vijf keer zo hard verduurzamen als ze nu doen’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked about reports that schools must decarbonise five times faster, the low number of energy-efficiency upgrades, the Schooldakrevolutie motion, new school-building rules, and a 2016 Court of Audit recommendation on clear national school-housing ambitions. The minister replied that climate agreement commitments, the Activiteitenbesluit energy-saving duty, the Green Deal Scholen, pilot programmes and waterside balancing studies are underway, and that a Berenschot-style housing monitor is planned for 2022.
In the draft Climate Agreement, agreements have been made to achieve CO2 reduction in the built environment.
In het ontwerpKlimaatakkoord zijn afspraken gemaakt om tot een CO 2 -reductie in de gebouwde omgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Onbegrip bij ouders: stelselmatig wangedrag bij topturnclub'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of excessive performance pressure and boundary-crossing behaviour at a top gymnastics club, SV Pax. The minister answered that the Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak found some unwanted behaviour but no structural misconduct, that the KNGU and club agreed measures, and that broader safety and pedagogical improvements are being pursued through existing sports policy without a new investigation.
No, I do not consider this necessary since the ISR has recently investigated this.
Nee, ik acht dit niet nodig aangezien het ISR dit recent heeft onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over examens op Aruba, Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked whether Dutch-language exams disadvantage Caribbean Netherlands pupils whose home language is not Dutch, and whether exams, N-term adjustments or extra time should change. The minister answered that Dutch exam language is set by law and by Aruba and Curaçao themselves, that extra funding for Bonaire language policy is provided, and that adapting exams to other languages or N-terms is not planned.
