I am aware that Dutch is the instruction and examination language of secondary education on Bonaire
Ik ben bekend met het feit dat het Nederlands de instructie- en examentaal van het voortgezet onderwijs is op Bonaire

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kwint en Westerveld over examens van 38 eindexamenleerlingen van de Duin en Kruidbergmavo uit Driehuis aangetekend op weg waren naar de tweede correctie, maar niet op de plaat

MPs asked why exam scripts sent by registered post to second correctors went missing again, questioning the reliability of postal transport and the fairness to pupils who must retake exams. The minister said schools are responsible for dispatch under the protocol, that such losses are rare (six cases this year, mostly theft), that retakes are unnecessary once scores are established, and that scanning and emailing scripts carries fraud and hacking risks.
As a rule, sending exam work by registered post is reliable.
In de regel is verzending van het examenwerk per aangetekende post betrouwbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Westerveld en Özütok over de problemen in de transgenderzorg

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the suicide risk for transgender youth, referrals to a third expert centre, self-medication, and insurers' contracting. The minister acknowledged the long waits, pointed to a care coordinator appointed by insurers and the ministry, said priority for young people was considered but left to insurers and providers, and gave partial information on capacity, timing and insurer contracting.
It is up to the health insurers and care providers, with the coordinator's advice in hand, to reduce the waiting lists for transgender care and, where necessary, set priorities.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders om, met het advies van de kwartiermaker in de hand, de wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg terug te dringen en daarbij zo nodig prioriteiten te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het bericht ‘Gemeente Enschede voorkomt faillissement BVO FC Twente met miljoenensteun’

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked whether Enschede's multi-million euro rescue of FC Twente, a commercial football club, complies with state aid rules, whether it fits the austerity in the social domain, and whether such clubs should receive aid when paying staff above WNT pay norms. The minister answered that municipal autonomy governs the choice, that the municipality itself judges no state aid is involved, that WNT does not apply to FC Twente, and pointed to a national reference framework and factsheet on football state aid.
In this case, the municipality takes the position that there is no state aid involved.
In dit geval stelt de gemeente zich op het standpunt dat er geen sprake is van staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat de maatschappelijke urgentie van de problematiek van laaggeletterdheid is zo hoog dat er geen tijd te verliezen is

An MP asks the Minister of Education about an SER advisory report calling low literacy urgent, and whether the government's extra funding is sufficient, including whether the additional 2 million for digital skills is genuinely new money. The Minister replies that about 7 million per year extra is earmarked for low literacy, that there is no separate digital skills budget, and that she will agree further steps with municipalities this summer while not doubling the budget as the SER recommends.
I therefore do not share the SER's conclusion that there is too little direction at national level.
Ik deel dan ook niet de conclusie van de SER dat er te weinig regie zou zijn op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht ‘Meneer Bouwels moet blijven’

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether LVO, a school board in Limburg, is not renewing temporary teacher contracts amid a teacher shortage, and about the situation at VMBO Maastricht. The minister denied that all temporary contracts are being cut, attributed non-renewals to declining pupil numbers and the board's personnel policy, and said he will report on LVO and VMBO Maastricht in June 2019.
The school board has the responsibility for conducting good strategic personnel policy.
Het schoolbestuur heeft de verantwoordelijkheid voor het voeren van goed strategisch personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht van de Commissariaat voor de Media ‘Commissariaat niet tevreden over beoordeling nevenfuncties KRO-NCRV’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Education and Media about the Commissariaat voor de Media's finding that KRO-NCRV's assessment of a presenter's side job was inadequate, and whether public broadcasters' registers of ancillary activities are complete, mandatory and supervised. The minister answered that the Governancecode requires registers and that CIPO supervises compliance, that KRO-NCRV has revised its procedures, and that the presenter's programmes are not classed as journalistic so the side job need not be published.
The Commissariaat is charged with supervising compliance with the said provisions of the Mediawet 2008.
Het Commissariaat is belast met het toezicht op de naleving van genoemde bepalingen in de Mediawet 2008.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Apple presenteert eigen streamingdienst Apple TV+ voor tv-series en films' (Tweakers)

An MP asked whether the minister knew of Apple's planned video streaming service, whether the ministry had contact with Apple, which Dutch media rules apply, and whether a levy on streaming services should be introduced. The minister answered that there was no contact, that Apple falls under Irish law under the country-of-origin principle unless a member state imposes a financial contribution, and that a study on support measures for Dutch audiovisual content is pending.
We will send the research report to the House before the summer and inform it about which measures will be taken to stimulate the Dutch cultural audiovisual offering.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer het onderzoeksrapport toezenden en informeren over welke maatregelen genomen zullen worden om het Nederlandse cultureel audiovisueel aanbod te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse immigratiedienst bouwde database van journalisten'

The MPs asked whether the Dutch government cooperates with a US immigration agency's reported database of journalists and activists critical of US immigration policy, and whether Dutch and foreign journalists are in it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not cooperate, no Dutch journalists are known to be on the list, and the government will not intervene in a US internal matter unless press freedom there is at stake.
No cooperation with the Dutch government took place in this.
Hierbij is niet samengewerkt met de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vergeten van onderwijs bij de aanbesteding van jeugdzorg in Noord-Holland Noord

MP Westerveld asks how education was left out of the procurement of closed youth care in Noord-Holland Noord, whether education is legally required, and how a fix will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the youth care provider must arrange schooling under the Jeugdwet and Leerplichtwet, that an education branch will open on 1 August 2019 with interim toleration, and that the situation will be reviewed with municipalities and education partners.

In my response to the action plan 'The best suited care for vulnerable young people' of 25 March 2019, I indicated that my colleague for BVOM and I will explore with municipalities, institutions and education partners how the transformation in youth care relates to an appropriate education offer.

In mijn reactie op het actieplan «De best passende zorg voor kwetsbare jongeren» van 25 maart 2019 heb ik aangegeven dat mijn collega voor BVOM en ik met gemeenten, instellingen en onderwijspartners gaan verkennen hoe de transformatie in de jeugdhulp zich verhoudt tot een passend onderwijsaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Buitenweg en Van der Staaij over de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld, Buitenweg and Van der Staaij asked the ministers about youths being placed in closed youth care because no alternatives exist, the acceptability of deprivation of liberty, waiting lists, and compliance with children's rights. Minister De Jonge answered that closed care should be minimised, pointed to a best-fit care plan and expert teams, acknowledged the lack of alternatives and the need for a new legal framework, and said several points are under study.
That young people have experienced stays in a closed institution as a prison, I consider an important signal.
Dat jongeren het verblijf in een gesloten instelling als een gevangenis hebben ervaren, vind ik een belangrijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'ZZP-docent rukt op'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the growing number of teachers working as self-employed freelancers (zzp'ers), its effect on workload, costs and possible sham self-employment. The minister called such self-employment undesirable where aimed at higher pay, said he lacks specific data on teachers as zzp'ers or on sham self-employment, and pointed to planned data collection and regional agreements.
I do not have information about cases of possible sham self-employment.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over gevallen van mogelijke schijnzelfstandigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een inkomenstoets bij jeugdhulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a means-test (inkomenstoets) for youth care, used in Dordrecht, is desirable, lawful and compatible with the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether other municipalities use similar barriers. The Minister said municipalities face dilemmas, promised a study into funding of informal care, and declined to judge legality because the matter is pending before the court.
The working method of Zuid Holland Zuid is currently also before the court. I am therefore awaiting the court's judgment.
De werkwijze van Zuid Holland Zuid ligt momenteel ook bij de rechter. Ik wacht daarom het oordeel van de rechter af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over kindermishandeling

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the finding that nearly half of schools lack clear procedures for suspected child abuse, teacher training on recognising abuse, and how the verbeterde meldcode will be implemented in schools. The minister answered that school boards are legally responsible for the meldcode, the Inspectorate will pay extra attention, and the government is running implementation support, teacher-training reviews and pilots.
Given the implementation of the improved meldcode, I am asking the Inspectorate of Education to pay extra attention to this in the coming years.
Ik vraag de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gezien de implementatie van de verbeterde meldcode de komende jaren hiervoor extra aandacht te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vastlopen van de onderhandelingen over de cao Jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GreenLeft) asked the Health Minister about the stalled collective labour agreement talks in youth care, asking how to make the sector attractive given high workload, low investment in training, staff turnover and sick leave. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to a labour market study and ongoing talks with sector partners, cited sick-leave and workload figures, and said that wage increases reach youth care through municipal budgets, without committing to new binding measures.
VWS is in talks with JenV and relevant sector parties about measures to be taken to tackle the labour market bottlenecks for youth professionals.
VWS is samen met JenV en met betrokken sectorpartijen in gesprek over te nemen maatregelen om de knelpunten op de arbeidsmarkt voor jeugdprofessionals aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leerlingen uit het speciaal onderwijs die willen doorleren maar vastlopen

An MP asked the minister whether pupils moving from special to regular secondary education who have gaps in required subjects can be helped to continue and combine education levels, and whether exceptions are possible in such cases. The minister acknowledged the difficulty, said no national data is kept, argued that enough school options exist, and said no exception is needed since pupils with subject gaps may move up but must repair them at school level.
No, no national data is kept on this.
Nee, hierover worden geen landelijke gegevens bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over te lage tarieven voor pleegzorg, jeugdbescherming en jeugdhulp

An MP asked ministers about allegedly too-low tariffs for foster care, child protection and youth care, and about related cost and funding issues. The minister answered that no broad cost study is planned, that tariffs are a matter for municipalities and providers with escalation routes available, and that a progress report on the youth care action programme will follow in May 2019.
It is primarily up to municipalities and providers to reach agreement on the realistic tariff given the specific circumstances and wishes.
Het is primair aan gemeenten en aanbieders om tot overeenstemming te komen over het reële tarief gegeven de specifieke omstandigheden en wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ook stichting kijkonderzoek verzamelde data met omstreden methode'

GroenLinks MPs Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the audience-measurement method reported by NOS (collecting data via a contested method, with questions on legality, informed consent, and whether public broadcasters should stop participating) is lawful and whether it should be banned. Minister Slob replied that the GDPR question is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to judge, that the AVG rules are adequate, and that he expects the NPO and its contractors to comply with the law.
It is not for me to make a statement on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over promovendi

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the childcare allowance eligibility and legal status of international fellowship PhD candidates, after a court ruling and reports of large repayment claims. The Minister says fellowship PhDs are generally not employees, eligibility depends on the actual relationship with the university and can be pre-checked with the Tax Authority, and promises to publish extra information and map PhD categories.
Fellowship PhD candidates are likewise not employees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geen kinderen meer in de isoleercel? Niet haalbaar, zeggen instellingen’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked about reports that youth care institutions say the goal of ending solitary confinement of children by 2021 is unrealistic, and about the current frequency of isolation, enforcement, and staffing. The minister says no such letter has been received, a uniform definition and registration of forced isolation is being developed with results due May 2019, the Inspectorate will supervise the rules, and staffing shortages are being addressed through a recruitment campaign.
It is not clear whether young people in Jeugdzorgplus are now forcibly isolated more or less often than in previous years.
Het is niet duidelijk of jongeren in de Jeugdzorgplus nu vaker of minder vaak dan in voorgaande jaren gedwongen worden afgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Westerveld over het opstappen van jeugdzorginstelling topman vanwege financiële problemen

MPs Kuiken and Westerveld asked the Minister of Health about the departure of the top manager of youth care provider Juzt over financial problems, including when the ministry learned of the problems, the planned relocation of youths from Lievenshove, staff reductions, and measures against sector-wide financial distress. The minister answered that the ministry was informed in 2016, that the region and Juzt are negotiating, that relocation is delayed by costs and closure is set for mid-April, and that new oversight and mediation bodies have been set up in response to the sector's financial strain.
I am closely following developments and, as the system's responsible minister, I am keeping a very close eye on the situation.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend en houd als stelselverantwoordelijke nadrukkelijk een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Pacemaker Protector (Pace-Pro)

An MP asks whether the Pacemaker Protector (Pace-Pro), which protects a pacemaker during sport, should be reimbursed under the basic insurance package, especially for children, and questions why insurers do not cover it while replacement pacemakers are covered. The minister replies that a protector can be supplied within the hospital DBC if the treating doctor deems it necessary, that insurers have no duty to reimburse it directly, and that no further action is needed.
It is already possible for a medical aid protecting a heart implant to be reimbursed from the basic package.
Het is nu al mogelijk dat een medisch hulpmiddel ter bescherming van een hartimplantaat uit het basispakket wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over peperdure zesweekse schoolreizen van vierduizend euro

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about costly six-week school trips of 4,000 euro organised by 't Wylde Leren, including whether schools may outsource teaching, whether such trips count as lawful education, and whether they may be compulsory or exclude pupils. The minister answered that such trips can fit within the rules if run under school responsibility and approved by the works council, flagged inequality risks, but gave no monitoring inventory and said the school board, not the provider, is accountable for quality.
I currently see no reason for further inventory.
Ik zie op dit moment nog geen aanleiding voor verdere inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over initiatieven voor passend onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the ZON-approach to inclusive education, including whether schools may experiment with it, how to provide education outside school for some children, and the Linawijs initiative. The Minister said schools may choose their method within current law, that existing rules already allow education outside school, and that an evaluation and joint policy work with VWS will follow, but declined to answer the questions before the committee meeting.

As indicated in the education-care letter 2, Minister de Jonge and I are developing education-care arrangements in which we examine whether the current education and care frameworks provide enough scope and clarity to offer tailored support to children with strong support needs.

Zoals aangegeven in de onderwijs-zorgbrief 2 werken Minister de Jonge en ik onderwijs-zorgarrangementen uit waarin wij bekijken of de huidige onderwijs- en zorgkaders genoeg ruimte en duidelijkheid bevatten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over uitreiking Predicaten Excellente School

An MP asked the minister whether the LAKS student organisation's own excellence awards based on student satisfaction are meaningful, and whether student and teacher voices are weighted enough in the Inspectorate's and jury's Excellente School process. The minister defended the existing process, saying students and teachers are consulted in jury and inspectorate visits, declined to change the framework, and said an inspectorate evaluation would follow in 2019.
In 2019 the inspectorate will carry out an overall evaluation of the Excellente Scholen process.
In 2019 zal de inspectie een algehele evaluatie uitvoeren naar het traject Excellente Scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over schoolkosten

Two MPs asked the education minister about extra school costs for bilingual education, sports, trips, devices and tutoring, asking for per-school overviews, 20-year trends, the legal fit with the Dutch secondary education act, and the effect on segregation. The minister said costs are monitored by survey, cited falling average secondary school costs since 2006, stated parental contributions must be voluntary and cannot condition admission, and promised a new cost monitor and talks with the VO-raad.

We periodically monitor school costs in primary, secondary and vocational education through a survey of schools and parents. We therefore do not have an overview of school costs per school broken down by school activity.

We monitoren de schoolkosten in het po, vo en mbo periodiek door middel van een enquête onder scholen en ouders. We hebben dus geen overzicht van de schoolkosten per school uitgesplitst naar schoolactiviteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht dat 20 procent van de kinderen van gescheiden ouders hun vader niet meer ziet

GroenLinks MPs asked about reports that 20 percent of children of divorced parents no longer see their father, requesting research, figures, international data and policy measures. The minister pointed to ongoing UvA/CBS and WODC research, cited a 2017 WODC figure of about 12 percent no contact with fathers, and described existing action plans on shared parenting and a planned review of child benefit rules.
In addition, the WODC is currently conducting research into the non-compliance with contact arrangements.
Daarnaast doet het WODC thans onderzoek naar het niet-nakomen van omgangsregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over straffen en belonen in de jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers whether a silent-sitting punishment and the withdrawal of earned privileges in youth care institutions are still used, whether extra oversight took place after a 2010 ruling, and what is done to protect youths and promote evidence-based methods. The minister answered that Pluryn reports the measure is no longer used, that the IGJ will make unannounced visits and will inspect all closed youth care institutions in early 2019, that advocates reported only minor concerns, and that a knowledge programme on effective methods starts in January 2019.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this as well.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de grote kloof tussen gelukkige en kwetsbare kinderen

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the large gap in wellbeing between happy and vulnerable children found by the Children's Ombudsman, including safety at home, stress, youth care, and participation. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the Ombudsman's follow-up research will be awaited, and pointed to existing programmes on domestic violence, child poverty, education equality and sport, without committing to new measures.
We will await the outcomes of the follow-up research and then weigh whether further research is needed.
We zullen de uitkomsten van het vervolgonderzoek afwachten en vervolgens de afweging maken of er nader onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Hul, Westerveld en Futselaar over de toename van studenten die ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit van universiteiten

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that rapid student growth at some universities is eroding teaching quality, including overcrowded lectures and shortfalls in facilities and assessment. The minister disputed a general quality decline, pointed to institution-level choices under the quality agreements, and said there are no targets for maximum lecture size.
I do not recognise the picture of a negative quality trend caused by strong growth.
Het beeld van een negatieve kwaliteitstrend door forse groei herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanbesteding jeugdzorg in Noord Holland Noord

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Health about a tender for closed youth care in Noord-Holland Noord that led to a court case by provider Transferium, and about the risk to continuity of care and visitation for vulnerable youths. The Minister said he is monitoring the situation, that gemeenten must ensure continuity and closed youth care availability in the region, and that he will intervene if the parties cannot agree.

If the municipalities and the institutions still fail to reach agreement together, so that the availability of closed youth care is jeopardised, I will take the steps necessary to secure availability nonetheless.

In het geval dat de gemeenten en de instellingen er toch gezamenlijk niet uitkomen, waardoor de beschikbaarheid van gesloten jeugdhulp in het gedrang komt, zal ik die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over lessen uit het Belgisch voetbalschandaal

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about lessons from the Belgian match-fixing scandal, including Dutch measures, links to other crime, the role of agents and international cooperation. The minister answered that a national match-fixing platform exists, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot, there are no concrete signals of spread to the Netherlands, and an in-depth study of agents is not planned though international cooperation continues.
To improve this, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot period.
Om hierin verbetering aan te brengen, wordt voor een pilotperiode van twee jaar een informatiecoördinator benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de uitzending van Radar over online kindermarketing

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about online child marketing of unhealthy food shown on Radar, including influencer reach, YouTube disclosure rules and the Jongeren Op Gezond Gewicht programme. The government acknowledged the concern, said it will annually monitor compliance with the food advertising code including social media, and will discuss the results with industry and the Alliantie Stop Kindermarketing.
I will conduct annual research into compliance with these agreements and will explicitly include the influence of social media in it.
Ik zal jaarlijks onderzoek doen naar de naleving van deze afspraken en zal de invloed van sociale media hierin nadrukkelijk meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over verschillen in schooladviezen tussen inkomensgroepen

Two MPs (Westerveld and Van den Hul) asked why school-advice revisions appear to differ by parental income and education level, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister says revision rates are misquoted, that the link with parental education is not linear, that causes will be studied, and that the inspectorate's simulation tool and evaluation will address objectivity.
I am having the causes investigated, and these results will be included in the final evaluation of the Primary School Final Test Act.
Ik laat de oorzaken hiervan onderzoeken en deze resultaten zullen worden meegenomen in de eindevaluatie van de Wet eindtoetsing po.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over begeleiding van pleegouders

An MP asked the Minister of Health about criticism by inspectorates of the supervision of foster parents in the Hannah case, about a critical 'zwartboek' on Jeugdbescherming Brabant, and about complaint routes and further investigation into foster-care support. The minister acknowledged errors in the case, pointed to an internal investigation, inspectorate oversight and a planned joint audit, and described existing complaint procedures and an ongoing evaluation of the foster-parent position law.
Jeugdbescherming Brabant (JBB) and Combinatie Jeugdzorg (CJZ) reported the calamity to the inspectorates and, also at the inspectorates' request, carried out an internal investigation into the case.

Jeugdbescherming Brabant (JBB) en Combinatie Jeugdzorg (CJZ) hebben de calamiteit bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd en de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (hierna inspecties) gemeld en hebben, ook op verzoek van de inspecties, een intern onderzoek naar de zaak uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Hoe onafhankelijk is Yvon Jaspers?’

An MP asked the Minister for Education and Media whether a presenter of the KRO-NCRV programme 'Onze Boerderij' has a paid side job with listed feed manufacturer For Farmers, and whether this creates a conflict of interest with the public broadcaster's independence obligation. The minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating the arrangements, that outcomes cannot be anticipated, and that broadcasters themselves are primarily responsible for managing conflicts of interest under the governance code.
Following recent media reports on this presenter's side job, the Commissariaat voor de Media is examining the arrangements with this presenter regarding this programme.

Naar aanleiding van de recente berichten in de media over de nevenfunctie van deze presentatrice, onderzoekt het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: het Commissariaat) de afspraken met deze presentatrice ten aanzien van dit programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal kinderen met een risico op (taal)achterstand in de voorschoolse educatie in Amsterdam en Rotterdam

An MP asked the government about the reported drop in toddlers at risk of language and education delay attending pre-school in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, and how this fits with the government's aim to reduce inequality of opportunity. The minister replied that the government prioritises combating educational disadvantage, that monitoring and a follow-up study on harmonisation and possible demand drop-out are planned, and that municipalities can already offer free or low-cost pre-school places using existing funds.

Should the outcomes of the aforementioned study show a drop in participation of target-group toddlers in pre-school education, I will enter into discussion with representatives of municipalities and childcare organisations about the policy choices municipalities make.

Mocht uit de uitkomsten van het eerder genoemde onderzoek blijken dat er sprake is van een terugloop in deelname van doelgroeppeuters aan voorschoolse educatie, dan zal ik in gesprek gaan met de vertegenwoordigers van gemeenten en van kinderopvangorganisaties over de beleidskeuzes die gemeenten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de verwachte prijsstijging voor kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary whether the stricter baby staff ratio would cause childcare price rises that hit small providers and low-income families hardest, and what monitoring and intervention was planned. The secretary acknowledged the cost concerns, pointed to a 7.65% increase in the maximum hourly rate and planned monitoring with a mid-2019 update, but did not commit to specific intervention beyond close monitoring.
The Ministry of SZW periodically monitors the development of hourly rates using childcare allowance data made available by the Tax Administration.
Het Ministerie van SZW monitort periodiek de ontwikkeling van de uurtarieven via data over de kinderopvangtoeslag die beschikbaar worden gesteld door de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat veel amateurtrainers niet weten hoe ze met een groep moeten omgaan en het tekort aan vrijwilligers bij sportverenigingen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about amateur coaches lacking training and the shortage of volunteers in sports clubs, and about support for trainers. The minister answered that trainers should be supported through the Sportakkoord, with courses, individual coaching and buurtsportcoaches, and that volunteer shortages are uneven across clubs.
I consider strengthening trainers and coaches important and am actively working on this in the Sports Agreement (sub-agreement on vital sports providers).
Ik vind het versterken van trainers en coaches belangrijk en zet daar in het Sportakkoord (deelakkoord vitale sportaanbieders) actief op in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over gezinshuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about children placed in family-style group homes, frequent relocation of children in care, the tax treatment of foster-home carers, and reducing closed placements. The Minister agreed relocations should be minimised, promised talks on family-style care and a quality framework, and a stepwise approach to fewer closed placements, without giving figures.
Figures on this are unfortunately not available.
Cijfers hierover zijn helaas niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gestegen aantal zelfmoorden van jongeren die Jeugdhulp krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising youth suicides among young people receiving youth care, whether children get timely help, the causes, and whether suicide attempts should be better recorded. The minister answered that a deeper investigation of the 81 cases is pending, that the inspectorate handles calamities, and that a programme to reduce closed placements and improve timely care is underway.
I cannot give an answer to this question at this time.
Op deze vraag kan ik nu geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanhoudende onrust bij LVO Maastricht

An MP asked the minister about reports of wrongly issued vmbo diplomas, grading errors and unreached pupils at LVO Maastricht, and about the school board's self-evaluation and whether the inspectorate will examine board accountability, the works council and the supervisory board. The minister states that the inspectorate found no wrongly issued diplomas, that eight pupils were in doubt and six were granted the diploma, that the grades are correct, and that the board, works council and supervisory board are being questioned in the inspectorate's ongoing investigation, whose outcome he awaits.
Handling of complaints and communication about them is part of the inspectorate's investigations.
Het omgaan met klachten en de communicatie daarover is onderdeel van de onderzoeken van de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het verplicht betalen van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage bij het bestellen van schoolboeken

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether schools may require parents to pay the voluntary parental contribution when ordering textbooks online, and what the minister will do about it. The minister answered that payment must never be a condition for receiving textbooks, that the inspectorate monitors this and sanctions may follow, but declined to guarantee it will not recur and refused to require distributors to change their systems.
It is contrary to the law to make payment of the parental contribution mandatory, for example by imposing it as a condition when ordering school textbooks.
Het is in strijd met de wet om het betalen van de ouderbijdrage te verplichten, bijvoorbeeld door deze als voorwaarde op te leggen bij het bestellen van schoolboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over de uitzending van Zembla getiteld “De Kunstgrasberg”.

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on illegal handling and stockpiling of artificial turf waste, inspection frequency, responsibility for disposal, and sustainable alternatives. The state secretary answered that municipalities and provinces are the competent authorities for licensing and enforcement, that the ILT inspected three firms and issued warnings, and that ownership of the matter remains with local authorities, while committing to follow up with Gelderland and Dongen and to work on sustainability through the sports accord.
I have asked the Province of Gelderland and the municipality of Dongen to keep me informed of the follow-up steps and will actively monitor their implementation.
Ik heb de Provincie Gelderland en gemeente Dongen verzocht mij op de hoogte te houden over de vervolgstappen en zal de uitvoering daarvan actief volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de kosten van digitale leermiddelen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about parents struggling to pay for compulsory laptops or tablets at secondary school and rising ICT costs. The minister said the contributions are voluntary, that schools must provide devices if they go fully digital, and that a new cost monitor and a 2020 evaluation of the Free School Books Act will follow.
Schools may not oblige parents to pay for a laptop or tablet.
Scholen mogen ouders niet verplichten om een laptop of tablet te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over het voortgezet onderwijs in met name Groningse en Drentse krimpregio’s dat bij de nieuwe rijksbekostiging op het hakblok gaat

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked whether the new funding model for secondary education would force school closures and cut vmbo support in Groningen and Drenthe shrinkage regions, and whether a 'krimpcheck' proposed by northern provinces would be adopted. The minister answered that the funding simplification has only limited redistribution effects, that closures stem from pupil decline and regional planning by school boards, that vmbo pupils receive a higher amount so schools are not disadvantaged, and that the provinces' letter was addressed in a separate letter.
This will apply to all types of boards in future, both narrow vmbo schools and broad school communities.
Dit geldt straks voor alle soorten besturen, zowel smalle vmbo-scholen als brede scholengemeenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de loonkloof tussen primair en voortgezet onderwijs, en de om die reden stukgelopen cao-onderhandelingen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the salary gap between primary and secondary teachers, the teacher shortage, and the stalled collective bargaining, and whether dialogue with the sector would resume. The minister answered that salaries in primary education have risen substantially, that the gap has narrowed, that additional measures and funding for workload are being taken, and that talks with employer and employee organisations on the teacher shortage are ongoing, while noting PO in Actie no longer wishes to participate.
I am currently in talks with the employer and employee organisations about the approach to the teacher shortage.
Ik ben op dit moment in gesprek met de werkgevers- en werknemersorganisaties over de aanpak van het lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de positie van medewerkers in de jeugdhulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health why employment in youth care lags behind other sectors, what causes high turnover and sick leave, and whether administrative burden and tendering add to workload. The minister answered that an labour market study of the wider youth domain is underway with results expected in autumn 2018, that the causes lie largely with employers and sector parties, and that administrative burden reduction and a recruitment campaign are being pursued.
I will inform your House about this, as already committed to in the Action Programme Youth Care of the Minister for Legal Protection and me of 16 April 2018.

Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren, zoals ook reeds in het kader van het Actieprogramma Zorg voor de jeugd van de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en mij van 16 april 2018 (Kamerstuk 34 880, nr.3 ) is toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht Miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld gaat naar commerciële bureaus

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spending millions on commercial staffing agencies is desirable given the teacher shortage, and whether the government would cap such spending. The minister said the teacher shortage is urgent, that the government does not know how many schools use agencies, will collect data from agencies in January 2019, and that staffing contracts are a matter for school boards, so no cap is planned.
Recruiting staff is a matter for school boards.
Het werven van personeel is een zaak van besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over onderwijs aan hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about parental contributions of thousands of euros for gifted-children programmes, whether these are lawful, funding adequacy, teacher training and oversight of the additional 15 million. The minister answered that voluntary contributions are allowed but admission may not depend on them, that no recent national figures exist, and that a subsidy scheme with evaluation will be introduced.
No recent national figures are available on developments in parental contributions for support for gifted children.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over (ontwikkelingen in) ouderbijdragen voor ondersteuning van hoogbegaafden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de St. Maartenschool te Nijmegen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the financial and care arrangements of the St. Maartenschool in Nijmegen, including a loan with municipal guarantees, responsibility between the ministries, and whether parents must arrange care funding themselves. The ministers answered that a process to organise care during school hours is underway with a process facilitator, that municipalities provided a bridging subsidy, and that the government is exploring direct funding for complex cases but this will take time.
In the letter we will send to the House of Representatives on this issue, we will also set out how we can support schools and parents in the meantime.
In de brief die wij over deze problematiek aan de Tweede Kamer zullen sturen, zullen we ook opnemen op welke wijze wij scholen en ouders in de tussentijd kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Westerveld, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘Zó ‘helpt’ de televisie kwetsbare tieners’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Basic and Secondary Education and Media about an article on a broadcaster's treatment of vulnerable teenagers in a TV programme, including what rules apply and whether NPO governance rules and the NPO ombudsman's remit should be tightened. The minister replied that media freedom and the Mediawet 2008 leave programme content to broadcasters without prior supervision, that BNNVARA's own code applies, and that he will consult the NPO and College van Omroepen on whether duty of care toward participants can be added to governance rules or the ombudsman's remit, reporting to parliament with the 2019 media budget letter.

I will consult with the NPO and the CvO on how careful treatment of programme participants can be part of the codes of conduct, for example through the governance code or the broadcasters' programme statutes, and whether the ombudsman can have a role.

Ik zal met de NPO en het CvO overleggen op welke manier zorgvuldige omgang met deelnemers aan programma's onderdeel kan zijn van de gedragsregels, bijvoorbeeld via de governancecode of de programmastatuten van de omroepen, en of de ombudsman een rol kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de failliet verklaarde iPadscholen

Written questions from MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked whether the iPad schools received preferential treatment in founding, why DUO and the inspectorate allowed funding to continue for months after the school was effectively closed, and whether money could be recovered. The minister denied preferential treatment, explained the inspectorate's investigation timeline and DUO's legally constrained recovery procedure, and said a claim had been filed with the bankruptcy curator, with recovery depending on the bankruptcy.
There is no question of preferential treatment.
Van een voorkeursbehandeling is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat de ouderbijdrage in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs steeds hoger wordt en daardoor de ongelijkheid tussen leerlingen groeit

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether voluntary parental contributions in primary and secondary schools have risen sharply, widening inequality, and asked for figures by denomination, region and level. Minister Slob answered that the cited data do not show that rise, that a new Schoolkostenmonitor is due end 2018, that per-denomination and per-region figures are not monitored, and that PO-Raad and VO-raad agreements are expected by year end, with legislation possible if they fail.
If no or unsatisfactory agreements come, I will consider whether it is necessary to amend the law.
Mochten er geen of onbevredigende afspraken komen, dan zal ik bezien of het nodig is de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij-instromers die binnen een jaar hun lesbevoegdheid halen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked how a one-year pabo teacher training run by LOI Hogeschool for career changers fits with the regular four-year route and the accreditation and suitability requirements, and how its quality is ensured. The ministers answered that the programme is NVAO-accredited (valid to 2021), is the only such one-year route found, and that the training includes all required outcomes, so teaching requirements are not being compromised.
It is a 240-credit programme. No exemptions are granted.
Het is een opleiding van 240 studiepunten. Er worden geen vrijstellingen verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zwemvaardigheden

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether it is undesirable that children with a migrant background and low socioeconomic status less often hold swimming diplomas, who is responsible for helping them, and whether the national swimming safety plan will address this. The minister replied that parents bear primary responsibility, that the Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid is drafting a plan, and that he will decide on government measures after its advice, with research results due in 2018 and 2019.
The primary responsibility for learning to swim and obtaining the complete Zwem ABC diploma lies with the parents.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het leren zwemmen en het behalen van het complete Zwem ABC diploma, ligt bij de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Rudmer Heerema en Van Meenen over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

Four MPs asked the minister whether school boards are hoarding funds, whether a liquidity upper bound of 1.5 is desirable, and related questions on reserves, the Commissie-Don benchmarks, and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister rejected an absolute upper bound, argued that average liquidity is not a causal result of lump-sum funding and that the 'oppotten' label does not fit, and said the inspectorate uses signalling values as detection tools while committing to adjust the framework.
I see no reason to take a different position.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het predicaat Excellente School

An MP asked the minister about the 'Excellente School' label, including criticism that it is confusing, time-consuming and costly, and why most schools do not apply. The minister rejected the criticism, said the process is voluntary and valuable for improvement, gave cost figures, and declined to change or stop the process.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zwemvaardigheden

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about swimming skills, including whether children with migrant or low-SES backgrounds get swimming diplomas less often and whether the government will act. The minister points to an ongoing national plan (NL Zwemveilig) and says the government will await further research and inform parliament later.
I am awaiting these results and will consult with the National Water Safety Council on which measures the sector itself will take and what role the government can play in this.
Ik wacht deze resultaten af en ga met de Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid overleggen welke maatregelen de sector zelf gaat nemen en welke rol de overheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij instromers

Two MPs asked the ministers about career-entrant teachers who obtain their teaching qualification within a year, after a TV programme showed trainees teaching alone after five weeks. The ministers replied that career-entrants must qualify within two years under individual support, that the TV programme's one-year course is a separate intensive pabo track where trainees are not fully alone in the classroom, and that they will not weaken teaching standards.
We have no plans to tamper with the requirements of the teaching profession.
Wij hebben geen plannen om te tornen aan de eisen van het leraarschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Van Meenen en Westerveld over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint, Van Meenen and Westerveld asked whether Avatar-related ideas spreading in democratic private schools, paid Avatar courses being advertised at schools, and the lack of stricter inspection and diploma requirements are acceptable. Minister Slob answered that the inspectorate will take the signals into its regular supervision of private schools, that paid services may be offered at schools, that no equalisation of inspection with publicly funded schools is planned, and that the qualification obligation remains important though students may take the state exams or pursue other routes.
The signals will be taken into account by the inspectorate in its supervision.
De signalen zullen door de inspectie worden betrokken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs aan vluchtelingenkinderen

An MP asked the education minister whether schools spend many hours obtaining correct information when enrolling refugee children, whether they must repay funds, whether BRON data errors matter, and whether admin procedures hinder access to education. The minister answered that no direct signals were received, that schools face documentation requirements but no repayments are expected after an audit, and that access has not been impeded, while promising a government response to the Onderwijsraad advice.
I have not received any direct signals that primary schools spend a lot of time obtaining the correct information when enrolling refugee children.
Mij hebben geen rechtstreekse signalen bereikt dat basisscholen veel tijd kwijt zijn om de juiste informatie boven tafel te krijgen bij het aanmelden van vluchtelingenkinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld  over het bericht dat ouders steeds meer aan de basisschool betalen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about rising parental contributions to primary schools for trips and extra activities, unclear voluntariness, exclusion of children, and whether contributions should be capped or limited. The minister answered that schools may only request voluntary contributions, that schools must communicate this clearly, that the parental-consent role in school councils governs amounts, and that new measures will be announced in a letter, but declined to cap contributions.
In my letter on the implementation of the Vermue and Van Dijk motion I state that I am also concerned about the parental contribution, based on the signals I receive.
In mijn brief over de uitvoering van de motie Vermue en Van Dijk geef ik aan dat ik me ook zorgen maak over de ouderbijdrage, op basis van de signalen die ik ontvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de mogelijkheden van mensen met een visuele of auditieve beperking om tv-programma’s te bekijken en zorgwebsites te bezoeken

MP Westerveld asked about audio description on NPO television and accessibility of healthcare websites for blind, visually impaired and deaf users. The minister replies that audio description continues in 2018 and is being evaluated, and that digital accessibility of care websites is a responsibility of care providers, to be addressed through the VN Convention implementation programme.

The Minister of VWS has no insight into which websites are or are not sufficiently accessible and therefore cannot monitor whether patients with a disability have sufficient access to care institutions' websites.

De Minister van VWS heeft geen zicht op welke websites al dan niet voldoende toegankelijk zijn en kan dan ook niet in de gaten houden of patiënten met een beperking voldoende toegang hebben tot websites van zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over vroege selectie en prestatiedruk bij jonge sporters

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about early selection and performance pressure among young athletes, including whether half of children quitting sport for lack of fun is linked to pressure, and whether the sports accord and youth football scouting should address this. The minister answered that fun should be central, that sports bodies are responsible for pedagogical safeguards, that the KNVB youth programme controls academies, and that no general data exist on outcomes for scouted players who do not reach professional football.
It is up to the sport itself to monitor and improve these processes.
Het is aan de sport zelf om deze processen te bewaken en te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about education staffing agencies charging high fees to primary schools, zero-hour style contracts and possible government levers. The minister acknowledges the problem and says he will discuss it with the PO-Raad, but states that staffing and contracting are matters for school boards and declines to intervene.
I have no insight into the development of the number of agencies that supply education staff.
Ik heb geen zicht op de ontwikkeling van het aantal bureaus dat onderwijspersoneel aanbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal leerlingen op het vmbo en mbo

An MP asks the education ministers about the decline in vmbo and mbo pupil numbers, the monitoring of havisten entering mbo, implementation of the regeerakkoord measures for vmbo teachers, the status of vmbo-mbo pathway experiments, and ways to improve the esteem of practical education. The ministers answer that the decline is mainly demographic, that havist inflows show no clear increase, that the teacher measures are not in the coalition agreement but teacher training is underway, and that pathway experiments are progressing with a bill planned.
The measures you mention are not in the coalition agreement.
De door u benoemde maatregelen staan niet in het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de “mini-subsidies” om werkdruk tegen te gaan

Westerveld (GreenLeft) asked Minister Slob about the proposed small grants of up to €8,000 for 50 primary schools to reduce workload, criticised by education organisations, and about the involvement of teachers, the Staatscourant publication, and the high consultant costs in sample applications. Slob defended the scheme as a first step alongside €430 million structural investment, said teachers were involved through conditions and co-determination, and declined to add the €400,000 or change the scheme.
I will focus on disseminating the good examples and using them in future policy to reduce workload.
Ik zal inzetten op de verspreiding van de goede voorbeelden en het gebruik daarvan in toekomstig beleid om werkdruk te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

An MP asked the education minister about school boards accumulating reserves instead of spending education funds, and about the inspectorate's financial thresholds. The minister says the inspectorate does not see structural over-saving, explains reasons for reserves, and rejects mandatory reserve clawbacks while pointing to inspectorate oversight and medezeggenschap involvement.
I disapprove if school boards accumulate money year after year without any reason.
Ik keur het af als schoolbesturen zonder enige reden jaar in jaar uit geld oppotten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over transparantie en reserves bij samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about transparency and growing reserves at special-education partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) and whether the Court of Audit's concerns about tracking passend onderwijs funds are being addressed. The minister answers that a bill requiring online publication of annual accounts is planned for 2018, that a new reporting model is being introduced, and that reserve levels are a local matter to be assessed by the inspectorate rather than capped nationally.
I am currently working on a bill that will ensure that all annual accounts of both schools and partnerships in primary and secondary education must be published online.
Momenteel werk ik aan een wetsvoorstel dat ervoor zorgt dat alle jaarstukken van zowel scholen als samenwerkingsverbanden in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs online moeten worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht van het CBS “Kinderen eten te weinig fruit, groente en vis”

An MP asked the ministers whether the CBS finding that most children eat too little fruit, vegetables and fish is worrying, why lower-educated parents' children eat less healthily, what role government plays in healthy eating, and whether VAT on fruit and vegetables should be reduced. The state secretary acknowledged the concern and the socioeconomic gradient, pointed to Voedingscentrum information, school and childcare programmes and a forthcoming Nationaal Preventieakkoord, defended the National School Breakfast and sponsorship rules, and said the IBO found weaker evidence for price measures on food than on tobacco and alcohol.
I will inform your House about this in more detail.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht dat op de ene school de helft van de vmbo'ers doorgaat naar de havo en op de andere niemand

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked why some vmbo schools send over half their pupils on to havo while many others send none, and whether schools' fear of dropout and their performance ratings discourage stapelen. The minister attributes differences to school admission policy and transition programmes, says there are no signals of schools refusing pupils for dropout fears, and defends the statutory vmbo-havo right conditional on one extra exam subject.
I have no signals that havo schools refuse pupils solely because they are negatively assessed on dropout.
Ik heb geen signalen dat havo-scholen leerlingen enkel weigeren om de reden dat zij negatief worden afgerekend op uitval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld en Van den Hul inzake het eindrapport van de Taskforce Voortgezet Onderwijs Zeeuws-Vlaanderen 'Gewoon goed onderwijs!'

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Zeeuws-Vlaanderen secondary education taskforce report, including OCW's role, the funding of about 3 million euro per year, eligibility for island-school status, passend onderwijs deficits and start groups. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that OCW funds only mandatory education and will contribute only one-off transition costs, that the schools do not qualify for the island regulation, and that other items fall to other ministries or to the regional partners.
The national government makes no contribution to the structural additional costs.
Het Rijk levert geen bijdrage aan de structurele extra kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat meer kinderen in een gesloten jeugdinstelling belanden

An MP asked the health minister why closed youth institution placements rose, about budget cuts and staffing, and whether research and extra funding would follow. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, promised an effect monitor study of placements and an evaluation of the Youth Act in spring 2018, but did not accept that the cuts harmed care quality.
I will ask them to investigate this topic within the framework of this effect monitor youth care plus.
Ik zal hen vragen dit onderwerp in het kader van deze effectmonitor jeugdhulp plus te gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Tongeren over het rapport van de Kinderombudsman over aandacht voor kinderen en jongeren in aardbevingsgebied

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Children's Ombudsman report on children and young people in the earthquake area, covering consideration of children's interests in gas extraction and repair decisions, relocation, school building safety, information for children, the earthquake lesson pack, and health research. The minister answered that child safety is central, that a school programme targets completion by 2020, that relocation is arranged with residents where possible, and that the National Coordinator Groningen will improve information and stimulate use of the lesson pack, while leaving broader research on children to be considered.
Figures on the use of the lesson pack are not known, but the findings of the Children's Ombudsman show its added value.
Cijfers over het gebruik van het lespakket zijn niet bekend, maar de bevindingen van de Kinderombudsman laten de toegevoegde waarde ervan zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Voortman over zwerfjongeren

MPs Westerveld and Voortman asked about the rising number of young homeless people (zwerfjongeren), including estimates, possible causes such as the kostendelersnorm and the youth-to-adult care transition, and plans to prevent further growth. The government state secretary disputes the cited figure (citing CBS's 12,400 for 2016), says it is studying the trends, sees no need to change the kostendelersnorm or conduct new research now, and points to ongoing trajectories with results due in early 2018.
This study will be completed at the beginning of 2018.
Dit onderzoek zal begin 2018 worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Westerveld over het massaal delen van verhalen over grensoverschrijdend seksueel gedrag

MPs Voortman and Westerveld asked the ministers of Education and of Health about the mass sharing of #MeToo stories on sexual boundary violations, whether the percentage affected is unacceptable, and how schools, coaches, employers and teacher training will address boundaries, consent and harassment. The minister answered that such conduct is unacceptable, that schools already cover sexual boundaries under the existing core objectives, that teacher training and sport programmes address these topics, and that a sport-sector study is expected in December 2017.
Yes, this is already a task of education.
Ja, dit is al een taak van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gebrek aan medische kennis bij sportverenigingen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the lack of medical knowledge at sports clubs, including whether trainers need first-aid certificates and how many clubs have AEDs. The minister answered that medical responsibility lies mainly with sports federations and clubs, that there is no legal requirement for first-aid training or AEDs, and that no national registry of sport-related cardiac deaths exists.
There is no national policy or statutory rules for medical knowledge at sports clubs.
Er is geen landelijk beleid of wettelijke regels voor medische kennis bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over stigmatiserende lesmethodes

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether a primary-school reading method that describes the 'ng' sound with a Chinese-stereotype gesture is stigmatising, whether similar methods exist, and whether the government will investigate or raise awareness. The minister agrees the gesture is stigmatising, says no similar methods are known, declines to start an investigation because schools and publishers are responsible for teaching materials, and says raising awareness is up to schools and publishers, not the government.
I do not intend to start an investigation into this.
Ik ben niet van plan hier een onderzoek naar te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending ‘Hoe kan het gastouderschap beter?’ van De Monitor

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inadequate oversight of childminders (gastouders) after a De Monitor broadcast, including whether GGD inspection of only about 5% of childminders is enough and whether commercial childminding agencies should inspect them. The Minister says municipalities and GGDs are responsible, that inspection shares range from 5% to 30% by municipality, that a Utrecht University quality study is underway, and that the issue is left to his successor, committing to no concrete step beyond informing parliament later.
Supervision and enforcement of childminding is a statutory responsibility of municipalities and GGDs.
Het toezicht en de handhaving op gastouderopvang is een wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en GGD-en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over het bericht 'FNV: doorgeslagen flex in kinderopvang'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about union FNV's claim of excessive flexible employment in childcare, and whether public provision could bring more permanent contracts. The minister defended market functioning, attributed flexibility to cyclical demand, and declined to study conversion to a public system, leaving that to a successor.
At this moment I am not willing to examine its effects further, partly because such an assessment is for my successor.
Op dit moment ben ik niet bereid de effecten ervan verder te onderzoeken, mede omdat een dergelijke afweging aan mijn opvolger is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, Bruins en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Onderwijsinspectie uitleg wil over fouten in het vwo-eindexamen Frans

MPs asked the Minister about teacher complaints over errors in the VWO French final exam and whether the College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) fixed them via correction-guideline additions and normering. The State Secretary answered that CvTE handled 95 signals, issued a correction-guideline addition changing three questions, and that the Inspectie found the handling correct, while declining to judge the signals substantively.
I myself do not enter into the substantive assessment or evaluation of signals about central examinations.
Zelf treed ik niet in de inhoudelijke beoordeling of waardering van signalen over centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over het artikel "Scholen steken voor onderwijs bedoelde miljoenen in de kachel"

Two MPs asked the government whether it is undesirable that school boards spend education funds on cleaning, maintenance and energy, and whether it will act on school energy use and building sustainability. The State Secretary answered that lump-sum funding gives school boards freedom of spending, that primary school finances are sound, and pointed to existing energy rules and a subsidy scheme for school sustainability advice.
School boards themselves weigh whether to spend more or less on materials or personnel.
Schoolbesturen maken zelf de afweging om meer of minder middelen uit te geven aan materieel of personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Aantal nieuwe pleegouders blijft ondanks hogere vraag afnemen'

An MP asked the state secretary about the reported decline in new foster carers despite higher demand, the reasons foster carers stop, financial support, and whether the campaign will be intensified. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Actieplan Pleegzorg with research into why carers stop, a campaign running to 2018, support projects, and evaluations due in early 2018, while placing the 3,000 annual departures in context.
I share your concerns about the decline in the number of foster families.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de daling van het aantal pleeggezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending van Brandpunt dat stress op middelbare scholen toeneemt

An MP asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting rising school stress and burn-out among secondary pupils, including how many pupils are affected, the role of performance pressure, and measures taken. The government answered that such figures are not structurally tracked, cited OECD data showing relatively low school-related stress in the Netherlands, attributed stress mainly to family and societal factors, and pointed to the Gezonde School programme as the main measure.
Information on these specific topics is not structurally kept at the national level.
Over deze specifieke onderwerpen wordt landelijk niet structureel informatie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de artikelen ‘Noodlijdende St. Maartenschool vindt geldschieter’ en ‘Geldschieter voor school: tijd gewonnen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about press reports that the St. Maartenschool, a special school, faces a two-million-euro cut and was rescued by an outside funder, and whether regular schools must arrange care before pupils transfer. The State Secretary declined to take a substantive position, pointed to earlier answers, said care is shared responsibility of schools, municipalities and insurers, and that no definitive plan had yet been submitted.

It is up to schools, boards and collaborative partnerships in the region to assess which pupils can be placed in (secondary) special education and which, possibly with extra educational support, can go to mainstream education.

Het is aan de scholen, besturen en samenwerkingsverbanden in de regio om te beoordelen welke leerlingen een plek in het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs kunnen krijgen en welke leerlingen, eventueel met extra onderwijsondersteuning, naar het reguliere onderwijs kunnen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Heijnen en Fokke ter vervanging van nr. 5 over de mogelijkheid tot korting van de financiele vergoeding voor volksvertegenwoordigers die (vrijwel) geheel niet meer fu
Lets councils and provincial states cut the allowance of members who are almost always absent, by a two-thirds vote, down to zero.
The decision to reduce must be taken by a qualified two-thirds majority of the council or states.
Het besluit tot korting dient door een gekwalificeerde meerderheid 2/3 van de raad of staten te worden genomen.
Amendement van de leden Heijnen en Fokke over de mogelijkheid tot korting van de financiele vergoeding voor volksvertegenwoordigers die (vrijwel) geheel niet meer functioneren.
Lets councils and provincial states cut the allowance of members who miss over half of meetings without good reason, to zero for up to a year, by a two-thirds vote.
Confidence in politics is in no way served by representatives receiving their financial allowances while delivering no performance in return.
Het vertrouwen in de politiek is er immers op geen enkele wijze mee gediend dat volksvertegenwoordigers wel hun financiële vergoedingen krijgen, maar daar geen prestatie meer tegenover stellen.
Motie van het lid Schouw c.s. over het horen van kandidaat-bewindspersonen door de Tweede Kamer
Asks the Presidium to examine the pros, cons and modalities of the Tweede Kamer hearing prospective ministers and state secretaries.
requests the Presidium to examine the pros and cons and modalities of the House hearing candidate ministers
verzoekt het Presidium, de voor- en nadelen en modaliteiten te onderzoeken van het horen van kandidaat-bewindspersonen door de Tweede Kamer
Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over een verkenning naar een zogeheten parlementaire ondervraging
Asks the Presidium to explore a new instrument of parliamentary interrogation under oath, with short preparation, and to assess needed changes to the inquiry rules.
requests the Presidium to carry out an exploration, preferably in the form of a draft regulation, into a so-called parliamentary interrogation
verzoekt het Presidium, een verkenning uit te voeren, bij voorkeur in de vorm van een ontwerpregeling, naar een zogeheten parlementaire ondervraging
Motie van het lid Heijnen over een plan om ten minste 75% van de scholieren de Tweede Kamer te laten bezoeken
Asks the Presidium to draw up a plan so that at least 75% of pupils can visit the Tweede Kamer through ProDemos before age 18.
Requests the Presidium to draw up a plan ensuring that at least 75% of pupils can visit the House of Representatives via ProDemos before age 18.
verzoekt het Presidium, een plan uit te werken dat ervoor zorgt dat binnen afzienbare tijd ten minste 75% van de scholieren via ProDemos voor hun 18de de Tweede Kamer kan bezoeken
Motie van het lid Heijnen c.s. over het in vaste dienst nemen van de schoonmakers
Asks the Presidium to bring cleaning staff back into permanent employment when the external cleaning contracts end.
requests the Presidium to take the cleaners back into permanent employment when the current contract with external cleaning companies ends
verzoekt het Presidium om bij afloop van het huidige contract met externe schoonmaakbedrijven de schoonmakers weer in vaste dienst te nemen
Motie van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. over het schrappen van de buitenlandvergoeding
Asks the Presidium to propose abolishing the foreign travel allowance for members of the House.
requests the Presidium to come with a proposal in which the foreign travel allowance is abolished
verzoekt het Presidium, te komen met een voorstel waarin de buitenlandvergoeding wordt geschrapt
Motie van het lid Ouwehand c.s. over het per trein reizen voor internationale werkbezoeken tot 750 kilometer
Asks the Presidium to ensure that the House travels by train for international work visits up to 750 kilometres in principle.
requests the Presidium to ensure that the House travels by (fast) train in principle for international work visits up to 750 kilometres
verzoekt het Presidium, te bewerkstelligen dat de Kamer voor internationale werkbezoeken tot 750 kilometer in principe met de (snelle) trein reist
Motie van het lid Heijnen over een wetsvoorstel aanscherping WNT-norm
Motion asks the government to present by 1 January 2014 a bill tightening the WNT salary norm to 100% of a minister's salary and extending it to all staff in the (semi-)public sector.
requests the government to present, by 1 January 2014 at the latest, a bill providing for this tightening
verzoekt de regering, uiterlijk 1 januari 2014 een wetsvoorstel te presenteren dat voorziet in deze aanscherping
Amendement van de leden Taverne en Heijnen dat regelt dat alleen internationale waarnemers kunnen worden toegelaten bij verkiezingen
Deletes the bill provision that would have allowed national as well as international observers at elections, so only international observers may be admitted.
This amendment provides that only international observers may be admitted to elections.
Dit amendement regelt dat er alleen internationale waarnemers kunnen worden toegelaten bij verkiezingen.
Motie van de leden Heijnen en Klein over mogelijke integriteitsschendingen bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 2014
Asks the government to urge mayors, as chairs of polling boards, to watch for integrity violations linked to campaign financing in the 2014 municipal elections.
requests the government to point out to mayors that they should be alert at the 2014 municipal elections
verzoekt de regering, de burgemeesters erop te wijzen bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 2014 alert te zijn
Amendement van het lid Heijnen over het duidelijkheid geven aan herindelingsgemeenten over herindelingsverkiezingen
Fixes the candidate nomination and election timing for merged-municipality elections in the Arhi act and lets provincial executives deviate only for weighty reasons.
Provincial executives may, if weighty reasons relating to the nomination or voting day so require, set a different nomination date

Gedeputeerde staten kunnen, indien zwaarwegende redenen verband houdend met de dag van kandidaatstelling of met de dag van stemming daartoe nopen, bepalen dat de kandidaatstelling op een andere datum plaatsvindt
Motie van de leden Segers en Heijnen over vermindering van de ambtelijke druk op de BES-eilanden

Asks the government, together with the BES islands and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, to set concrete targets to reduce regulatory overload and bureaucratic pressure and to report to the Chamber by May 2013.
requests the government, in consultation with Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, to formulate concrete goals and measures
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius, Saba en de Rijksvertegenwoordiger concrete doelstellingen en maatregelen te formuleren
Motie van het lid Heijnen c.s. over een onafhankelijke instelling voor onderzoek naar integriteitsschendingen in het openbaar bestuur
Asks the government to explore creating an independent institution to investigate possible integrity violations in public administration.
requests the government to explore the possibility of an independent institution for investigating possible integrity violations in public administration
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid te verkennen van een onafhankelijke instelling voor onderzoek naar mogelijke integriteitsschendingen in het openbaar bestuur
Motie Van Gent c.s. over inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe regeling op 1 januari 2013
Motion asking the government to ensure the new civil registry regulation allowing civil servants to refuse certain tasks can take effect on 1 January 2013.
requests the government to act accordingly and ensure the new regulation can take effect on 1 January 2013
verzoekt de regering, conform te handelen en ervoor te zorgen dat de nieuwe regeling op 1 januari 2013 in werking kan treden
Motie Heijnen c.s. over geen nieuwe trouwambtenaren met gewetensbezwaren aanstellen
Motion asking the government to urge municipalities not to appoint new marriage officials with conscientious objections to same-sex marriage while pending legislation is considered.
call on municipalities in the meantime not to appoint new marriage officials with the said conscientious objections
