Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Heijnen ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het behoud van deelgemeenten, maar dan als bijzondere vorm van de in artikel 83 van de Gemeentewet geregelde bestuurscommissies

The minister answered that such personal liability is excluded by immunity provisions, that liability for damage rests with the public body, and that regress against representatives for voting is not possible.
That is not possible. Representatives must be able to speak and decide in their meetings without fear or threat of being personally involved in legal proceedings for doing so.

The minister answered that reports are not always accurate, that portfolio allocation is a political matter for the college, that the governor informed the Rijksvertegenwoordiger in writing, and that integrity measures such as BIOS support and codes of conduct are underway.
It is and remains difficult to make statements with exact certainty about the motives of those involved on Bonaire.

MPs Heijnen and Oosenbrug asked whether the existing international marriage extract model can be used for same-sex marriages and whether Dutch municipalities have a uniform document for this purpose. The state secretary answered that the ICBS revised convention (Convention 34) will include a model form for same-sex marriages, the NVvB has developed a uniform model, and EU-level work is at an early stage.
The intention is to adopt this revised convention at the ICBS General Assembly this coming autumn.
Het voornemen is om deze herziene conventie het komend najaar vast te stellen op de Algemene Vergadering van de ICBS.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Heijnen over de vertrekregelingen van enkele bestuurders in de gezondheidszorg

MPs Van Dijk and Heijnen (PvdA) asked about severance arrangements for hospital executives, including a VUmc executive's pay and whether the WNT top-income cap and transitional rules allow loopholes such as special leave, advisory roles and salary top-ups. The minister replied that the reported figures were incorrect, that the supervisory board is the employer and no rules were judged broken, that the EUR 75,000 cap applies with a four-year transitional regime for pre-2013 agreements, and that top-ups depend on circumstances while paid special leave without work is not allowed.
Articles 2.10 and 3.7 of the WNT prohibit employers in the public and semi-public sector from agreeing a severance arrangement with a top official exceeding EUR 75,000.
In artikel 2.10 en 3.7 Wnt wordt het werkgevers in de publieke en semipublieke sector verboden een vertrekregeling met een topfunctionaris overeen te komen die hoger is dan € 75.000.

MPs Marcouch, Heijnen and Monasch asked whether the government still supports keeping the Oranjehotel monument (Dodencel, Poortje, Gedenkplaat) after the planned closure of the Scheveningen prison, and how its future will be secured. The state secretary confirmed the monument should be preserved, said a future design is being developed with the Stichting Oranjehotel and that the detailed plan will follow once the DJI masterplan decision is taken.

Once the decision-making on the DJI Masterplan is completed, and it is therefore clear whether the PI Scheveningen will continue to exist, the Foundation, in consultation with the state, will further develop the preliminary design of a Oranjehotel Monument.

The state secretary answered that the contractual severance (about 3 million, rounded) was legally binding, that the director has agreed to repay just over two months' salary, and that no legal basis exists to reclaim the full amount since the WNT did not apply at the time; the full scheme will not be disclosed.
This arrangement is an arrangement between employer and employee and as such is not public, not even for VWS.
Deze regeling is een regeling tussen werkgever en werknemer en als zodanig niet openbaar, ook niet voor VWS.

The minister acknowledged the deviation from the circular, argued that council votes on such recommendations should be roll-call under the general rule, and announced a legislative amendment to clarify the rules and a wetsvoorstel with procedural improvements.

MP Heijnen asked the minister of Interior about a court ruling that a municipality may not impose a salary cap on subsidised institutions, and how this relates to the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the WNT does not preclude municipalities from attaching stricter pay conditions to subsidies, that the court found Eindhoven's subsidy conditions contrary to the Awb, and that the appeal is being pursued, with the VNG working on a model subsidy regulation and talks with the VNG planned.
The WNT does not preclude decentralised public bodies from imposing, through subsidy conditions, additional or stricter restrictions on the pay of staff and directors of institutions they subsidise.

Ik zou het echter zorgelijk achten als de aangekondigde bezuinigingen inderdaad gevolgen zouden hebben voor de kwaliteit van de rechtshandhaving, onderzoek en vervolging van (grensoverschrijdende) criminaliteit
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over de verkoop van het voormalig Mobiliteitscomplex (MOB-complex) in Deurne

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Government Service about a 2008 offer by the Deurne mayor to Domeinen, via a private email, to lower the sale price of the former MOB complex in return for ending a legal challenge, and whether such offers are common. The minister said Domeinen did not regard the offer as bribery but would be more restrained in hindsight, called the mayor's secrecy at odds with a trustworthy government, and said such buy-offs are not known to be frequent and would be undesirable.
Otherwise there is a risk that conducting legal proceedings is financially rewarded, because ending the proceedings gives entitlement to financial compensation.
Het risico bestaat anders dat het voeren van juridische procedures financieel wordt beloond doordat het staken van de procedure aanspraak geeft op financiële vergoedingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Heijnen over het ontslaan van Hells Angels in dienst van de overheid

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether dismissing civil servants who belong to outlaw motorcycle clubs such as Hells Angels fits the criminal-justice approach, and whether central government employs such people. The government answered that membership is undesirable for civil servants, that existing integrity and employment law allows measures including dismissal, and that it will promote the norm to other governments and update the integrity code, without a separate investigation.
Since the procedure within the municipality is still ongoing, no further comment can be made on the specific status and functions of the employees.
Aangezien de procedure binnen de gemeente nog loopt, kan verder niet op de specifieke stand van zaken en de functies van de medewerkers worden ingegaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Heijnen over de sluiting van Jellinek Curaçao

MPs Bouwmeester and Heijnen asked whether the closure of Jellinek Curaçao, a rehab clinic funded under a Dutch subsidy programme, shows the project failed its aims, whether the subsidy should be reclaimed, and what lessons follow. The minister replied that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed after final settlement, that the clinic contributed while active, and that the programme's sustainability focus will be strengthened.
Reclaiming after final settlement is inconsistent with the conditions under which the subsidy was granted and is therefore legally impossible.
Terugvordering na vaststelling strookt niet met de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidieverlening is verstrekt en is dus juridisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht “veel overheden missen integriteitsplan”

MP Heijnen asked whether it is concerning that about a third of public bodies lack or have a deficient integrity policy plan, and how the minister would respond given the legal and administrative framework. Minister Plasterk answered that the BIOS study covered 30 bodies with about 10 found deficient, that this is a signal rather than representative, that integrity duties under the Civil Servants Act and agreed basic norms apply, and that he will bring the findings to the umbrella organisations without prescribing how bodies fulfil the framework.
I will therefore also bring this research to the attention of the relevant umbrella organisations.
Ik zal dit onderzoek daarom ook bij de betreffende koepelorganisaties onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Raak en Heijnen over het artikel “Patrick Illidge seen in tape apparently accepting bribe”

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a reported video showing a Sint Maarten official apparently accepting a bribe linked to prostitution, and whether the Kingdom's guarantee function should be invoked. The minister replied that the Sint Maarten Public Prosecutor is investigating and has seized material, that the Dutch Rijksrecherche can only act on Sint Maarten at its request, and that the guarantee function does not apply.
It is for the Public Prosecutor's Office of Sint Maarten to conduct further investigation and determine whether and who should be prosecuted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie van Sint Maarten om nader onderzoek te verrichten en te bepalen of en zo ja wie vervolgd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heijnen over mogelijk opkopen van rijksgebouwen door de provincie Overijssel

An MP asked the Minister of Housing and Central Government Affairs whether the province of Overijssel was buying up central government buildings and whether provincial financial contributions influence where state offices are located. The minister denied knowledge of such constructions, said only Zwolle is interested in two state buildings for housing, and stated that provincial contributions should play no role in location decisions.
Incidentally, the kinds of practices you ask about are objectionable and I will not cooperate with them.
Overigens zijn het soort handelwijzen waarnaar u vraagt verwerpelijk en zal ik er niet aan meewerken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat de provincie Noord-Brabant een meerdaagse vergadering in het Italiaanse Parma gaat organiseren

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a multi-day Brabant provincial States meeting in Parma, Italy, is a wasteful junket, its purpose, costs and funding, and whether a Dutch venue would suffice. The Minister replied that travel decisions are a provincial matter to be accounted for in the provincial States, that costs reportedly are around 50,000 euro, and that suitable venues exist in the Netherlands.
That said, it should be noted that this is a provincial matter.
Vooropgesteld zij dat dit een provinciale aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het manipuleren van burgemeestersbenoemingen en het lekken van geheime stukken

An MP asked whether reconstructions of past mayoral appointments were accurate, whether ignoring selection committee recommendations was common, and how secret appointment files leaked to a journalist. The government answered that the former procedure gave the minister room for its own judgment, declined to assess the historical appointments, and said access was blocked after a misplaced disclosure affecting eight persons' files.
The restrictions on public access to the files transferred to the National Archives were imposed to respect the personal privacy of those concerned.
De beperkingen op de openbaarheid van de dossiers die zijn overgedragen aan het Nationaal Archief zijn gesteld vanwege de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het verzet van zorgbestuurders tegen maximering van hun salaris door de overheid

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether he knows about care-sector executives' legal challenge against the government's cap on their salaries under the WNT, whether he will talk to their association, and what the legal risks and remedies are. The minister said the WNT takes effect on 1 January 2013 and the care sector falls under it, with a transitional regime, and that he will not meet the association, while agreeing to consider sector-specific differentiation later.
No. The issue is not so much the cabinet's position on top incomes, but the content of the Act on the remuneration of top officials in the public and semi-public sector (WNT).
Neen. Het gaat nu niet zo zeer om het standpunt van het kabinet ten aanzien van topinkomens, maar om de inhoud van de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over nieuwe berichten over «middeleeuwse belastingheffing»

MP Heijnen asked ministers about reports that municipalities such as Woerden may face the medieval 'dertiende penning' land levy, including whether it can be imposed at any time and on what legal basis. The government answered that Woerden had not yet received an assessment, that the right persists until 2015 under a 1984 law, that the state's own position is being examined with a commitment to inform parliament, and that the levy rests on a surviving medieval property right.
The position of the State is currently being mapped and it is being examined whether it is opportune for the State to exercise its rights, and if so how.
Momenteel wordt de positie van de Staat in kaart gebracht en wordt onderzocht of het opportuun is dat de Staat haar rechten zal effectueren

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën, de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over middeleeuwse «belastingheffing» (ingezonden 8 augustu

An MP asked the state secretary and ministers whether the medieval thirteenth-penny levy imposed on Kamerik residents has a legal basis, whether residents could have known of it, how it is calculated and challenged, whether the right can still be transferred or has lapsed through non-use. The minister answered that the right is an old unwritten property right, is being abolished from 2015, can be enforced and challenged before the civil court, and that whether non-use applies is for the judge to decide.
Citizens can turn to the civil court when they believe the thirteenth penny is being levied wrongly.
Burgers kunnen zich tot de burgerlijke rechter wenden wanneer zij van mening zijn dat de dertiende penning onterecht wordt geheven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat een computervirus bij zeker 20 instellingen heeft toegeslagen

Rep. Heijnen asked about reports that the Dorifel computer virus hit around 20 institutions, including municipalities, companies and universities, and asked about its consequences, the NCSC response, costs, service impact, prevention, underreporting and the status of a breach-notification duty. The minister answered that the virus encrypts data without destroying it, that at least 30 institutions were hit, that the NCSC issued warnings and disrupted the botnet, that costs were modest and service disruption temporary, and that the breach-notification law is still being drafted.
Since there is not yet a notification duty, a complete picture cannot be given.
Aangezien er nog geen meldplicht bestaat kan geen compleet beeld worden gegeven.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over de behandeling van mensen in Nederlandse en Nederlands-Indische overheidsdienst die indertijd hebben geweigerd mee te doen aan de politionele acties

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked ministers about rehabilitation and treatment of Dutch and Dutch East Indies civil servants and military personnel who refused to take part in the police actions, including how many were punished and whether they will be rehabilitated. The government answered that the numbers of refusers among civil servants and colonial staff are unknown, declined to discuss an individual case, and said it will not reassess past individual conduct against today's norms.

Recognising that the period in question is now viewed in a different light, I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against today's norms and with present-day knowledge.

In het besef dat de desbetreffende periode nu in een ander licht wordt gezien, acht ik het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de kritiek van de Nationale Ombudsman op de benoemingsprocedure van de vice-president van de Raad van State

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked why the government will not implement a motion giving parliament a role in appointing the Raad van State vice-president, and whether the appointment procedure lacked transparency as the Ombudsman found. The ministers answered that appointments are a government power, that a constitutional change would be needed for a parliamentary role, and that the procedure was transparent, with the speculation not proving coordinated conduct.
Giving the Tweede Kamer a statutory role in the appointment procedure, for example in the form of a nomination right, is therefore only possible if the Constitution is amended in this respect.

Het toekennen van een wettelijke rol aan de Tweede Kamer in de benoemingsprocedure, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van een voordrachtsrecht, is daarom slechts mogelijk als de Grondwet in deze zin wordt gewijzigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over vele kiesgerechtigden die mogelijk op 12 september niet kunnen stemmen

An MP asks whether voters who moved to another municipality after the 31 July cutoff can still vote, and how many are affected. The minister confirms voters keep their old municipality's pass, can request a voting pass or proxy by 29 August, and proposes extending the deadlines in pending Kieswet amendments.
For your information, the pending proposal to amend the Kieswet in the House of Representatives extends the deadline for applying for a voting pass or a written proxy.

Voor uw informatie geldt dat in het voorstel tot wijziging van de Kieswet die in de Tweede Kamer ligt, de termijn om een kiezerspas respectievelijk een schriftelijke volmacht aan te vragen wordt verlengd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Van Dam over de vele dienstreizen van Nederlandse ambtenaren naar de BES-eilanden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about the large number of civil servant business trips to the Caribbean Netherlands islands, asking for per-department figures, how trips are assessed, whether limits should be set, and whether trips should be reduced. The minister gave figures only for his own ministry (189 trips, purpose not recorded), said each department decides on necessity, pointed to video-conferencing and twice-yearly meetings to reduce travel, and agreed in principle that trips could be reduced while leaving implementation to each department.
No, I can only provide you with an overview of the number of business trips for my own department.
Nee, ik kan u enkel voor mijn eigen departement een overzicht van het aantal dienstreizen geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat het demissionaire kabinet het openbaar bestuur minder openbaar wil maken

MP Heijnen asked the Minister of Interior whether the government plans to restrict the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) and why, and whether a independent commissioner should rule on disputes over disclosure. The minister says openness remains the starting point, a draft amendment targets abusive and disproportionately large requests rather than restricting access, and an independent commissioner is rejected in favour of informal contact.
Openness of government information is and remains, as far as this cabinet is concerned, the starting point of the Wob.
Openbaarheid van overheidsinformatie is en dat blijft, als het aan dit kabinet ligt, ook het uitgangspunt van de Wob.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over verlies SGP van vrouwenzaak bij Europees Hof

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government will force the SGP to stop excluding women from its candidate lists following the European Court of Human Rights ruling and the 2010 Dutch Supreme Court judgment. The minister said the SGP must first find a way to allow women, that he has asked the SGP leadership for its response and will consult it shortly, and that he will inform parliament by letter about further measures.
I have asked the SGP leadership in writing which consequences it intends to attach to the European Court of Human Rights decision and to consult with me on this.

Ik heb het hoofdbestuur van de SGP schriftelijk gevraagd welke consequenties het voornemens is te verbinden aan de beslissing van het Europees Hof voor de Mensenrechten (EHRM) en om hierover met mij in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Heijnen en Taverne over problemen bij het stemmen in het buitenland

MPs Timmermans, Heijnen and Taverne asked whether Dutch citizens abroad calling the DUTCHHELP line were given incorrect information, including that they could vote online, and why election information was not on all Dutch missions' websites and at counters. The minister answered that no online voting was mentioned, only registration (which can partly be done online), that election links were provided on embassy and consulate sites, and that posts promoted registration and displayed the website at counters.
No. There is no mention of casting a vote via the internet; however, information is provided on how and where one can register.
Neen. Er wordt niet gesproken over het uitbrengen van de stem via internet; wel wordt informatie verstrekt over hoe en waar men zich kan registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over Nederlanders in het buitenland die op 12 september 2012 willen stemmen

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked whether Dutch citizens abroad can register and vote in the 12 September 2012 election, given registration backlogs, staffing, and slow postal delivery of ballots. Minister Donner replied that registration is running normally at about 30,000 requests with roughly 2% rejected, that 36 temporary staff are handling it with capacity expandable if needed, and that ballots will be sent once candidate lists are final, with embassy drop-off points and proxy voting as fallbacks.
If necessary, capacity will be expanded.
Indien nodig zal de capaciteit worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Dijksma over de kosten van het onderzoek naar de toestanden bij het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA)

Two PvdA MPs asked why the COA investigation into conditions at the asylum reception agency cost over €900,000 and questioned the procurement, staffing, consultancy and oversight of those costs. The minister defended the cost as necessary for thorough investigations, explained the expense items and procurement via a tender, and disclosed the COA lawyers' and legal support costs.
Het bedrag is zonder meer omvangrijk.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen over de versobering van het wachtgeld voor politici

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the planned cut to parliamentary severance pay (wachtgeld) would be tightened further, whether the age-55 extended entitlement should be raised to 60, and whether the change would take effect on 1 September 2012. The minister answered that the questions depend on a bill still awaiting cabinet decision after Council of State advice, which will contain the answers, and that the bill to amend the Appa is intended to reach parliament quickly.
The bill and the explanatory memorandum will contain the answer to the implementation questions raised.
Het wetsvoorstel en de memorie van toelichting bevatten het antwoord op de gestelde uitwerkingsvragen.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen over een landelijke beperking van draaideurconstructies voor voormalige ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a revolving-door arrangement, where a former civil servant was hired as a consultant at high hourly rates, is undesirable and whether national rules should be tightened. The minister answered that the case involved a subsidised organisation rather than a ministry, that a 1999 circular already prohibits revolving-door hiring for two years with narrow exceptions, and that no tightening is needed.
There is no reason to tighten the rules contained in the circular; they are very clear.
Er is geen aanleiding om de regels vervat in de circulaire aan te scherpen, ze zijn heel duidelijk.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Jacobi over de dreigende investeringsstop van provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen

MPs Heijnen and Jacobi asked the Finance Minister whether the planned Wet Hof (sustainable public finances act) would hinder infrastructure investment by provinces, municipalities and water boards, and whether it would be adjusted. The minister replied that decentralised governments must contribute to EU deficit targets, that the Act is under Council of State advice, and that the decentralised governments will give a definitive reaction after the spring consultation.
With the Wet Hof, the main principles of trend-based budget policy will be anchored in law.
Met de Wet Hof worden de belangrijkste uitgangspunten van het trendmatig begrotingsbeleid wettelijk verankerd.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Çelik over de Rapportage onderzoek uittreksel GBA 2012

MPs Heijnen and Çelik asked why about 81,000 pupils still risk buying an unnecessary GBA extract for secondary school enrolment, as half of municipalities still require one. The minister says the study's conclusion is premature since municipalities inform applicants the extract is not needed, that DUO and municipal bodies were informed, and that DUO will again be asked to inform school administrators.
Therefore I will again ask DUO to inform school administrators that a GBA extract is not necessary when pupils enrol in secondary education.
Daarom zal ik DUO opnieuw verzoeken schooladministrateurs op de hoogte te brengen van het feit dat bij inschrijving van leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs een GBA-uittreksel niet nodig is.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de inspanningen van de rijksoverheid om re

MPs Heijnen and Hamer asked the ministers how central government will directly strengthen the labour market position of Wajong and WSW beneficiaries, including targets, quotas and social return in procurement. The minister answered that a 1% reserved-places quota applies, that a range of support measures and a 2012 study on bonus-malus incentives are underway, that no separate target exists for these groups, and that social return will be evaluated in 2013.
From 1 July 2011, social return is part of the central government procurement policy.
Vanaf 1 juli 2011 is social return onderdeel van het Rijksinkoopbeleid.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Hamer over de effecten van het social return beleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would follow the long-term effects of social return policy independently, like Rotterdam, and how it applies case-specific tailoring and possible Rotterdam-style methods. The minister replied that central government reports annually and will evaluate social return in 2013, sees no added value in an extra independent monitor for now, and points to existing knowledge-sharing and case-by-case design of social return clauses.
In addition, the social return policy at central government will be evaluated in 2013 on its effects as well as the implementation costs for both the contracting authority and the contractor.
Daarnaast wordt het social return beleid bij het Rijk in 2013 geëvalueerd op de effecten alsmede de uitvoeringslasten voor zowel de opdrachtgever als de opdrachtnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over het tekort aan capaciteit bij de College bescherming persoonsgegevens

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked the state secretary about the Dutch data protection authority's (CBP) shortage of capacity, reports that over half its cases remain unhandled, whether companies should self-report data breaches, and whether CBP fines could fund its staffing. The state secretary answered that enforcement must fit available resources, expects around 66,000 breach notifications a year under the planned duty, and said fine revenue cannot be directly used by the CBP under budget rules, while studying a broader administrative fine regime.
As stated in the attached draft explanatory memorandum, the notification duty is estimated to lead to 66 thousand notifications per year.
Zoals in het daarbij gevoegde concept van de Memorie van Toelichting wordt vermeld zal de meldplicht naar schatting leiden tot 66 duizend meldingen per jaar.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over corruptie in de publieke sector (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that anti-corruption measures in the public sector are insufficient, organisational culture is neglected, learning capacity is weak, and top appointments need stricter screening. The minister answered that there is no reason to think current measures are ineffective, that the underlying study was not yet published, that integrity policy already addresses culture and learning, and that existing AIVD screening, declarations of ancillary positions and VOG procedures for top officials and mayors provide adequate safeguards.
That assessment means I have no reason to believe that the current measures to safeguard integrity in the public sector are insufficiently effective.
Die beoordeling houdt in dat ik geen redenen heb om aan te nemen dat de huidige maatregelen ter waarborging van de integriteit in de publieke sector onvoldoende effectief zouden zijn.

Vragen de leden Wolbert en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat toezichthouders in de zorg de bezoldigingsnorm overschrijden (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether supervisory board members in care institutions exceeding the NVTZ pay norm, and how this relates to the WNT pay-cap amendment. The minister answered that only about 2.5% exceed the norm, that consequences of the amendments are being inventoried, and that under the WNT the accountant reports overruns and she could enforce corrections via a dwangsom or dwangbevel.
I cannot verify whether the remuneration of supervisory board members in an unknown but selected sample has doubled over two years.
Ik kan niet verifiëren of de beloning van toezichthouders in een mij onbekende, maar selecte steekproef in twee jaar is verdubbeld.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen, Dijsselbloem en Recourt (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mogelijkheden om veroordeelde gemeenteraadsleden uit

PvdA MPs asked whether convicted municipal councillors can be removed from office, how article 28 of the Criminal Code applies to elected representatives, whether prosecutors know of a suspect's mandate, and whether councils should be able to appeal or the Electoral Act should include integrity rules. The government answered that removal from office of representatives can only occur via loss of voting rights under article 28(1)(3), that a council cannot appeal a sentence because prosecution has a monopoly, and that integrity checks beyond disenfranchisement would be an unconstitutional restriction of passive suffrage.
Removing a people's representative from "office" can therefore only take place on the basis of article 28, first paragraph, under 3, of the Criminal Code.
Het uit »het ambt» ontzetten van een volksvertegenwoordiger kan derhalve alleen geschieden op basis van artikel 28, eerste lid, onder 3, van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over commissarissen die de beperking in de Wet bestuur en toezicht aan het aantal toezichthoudende functies proberen te omzeilen (ingezonden 16

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether supervisory directors are circumventing the new statutory limit on the number of supervisory positions by taking advisory roles or registering with foreign subsidiaries, and whether such positions should be counted. The minister replies that the limit is not yet in force, that advisory roles and foreign positions fall outside Dutch regulation, and that the law will be evaluated after three years.

To be able to assess whether the law leads to unwanted side effects, I have promised the Senate that I will evaluate the entire bill, including the amendments, after the law has been in force for three years.

Om na te kunnen gaan of de wet leidt tot ongewenste neveneffecten, heb ik aan de Eerste Kamer toegezegd om het gehele wetsvoorstel, met inbegrip van de amendementen, te evalueren nadat de wet drie jaar in werking is getreden.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over de wenselijkheid van schatkistbankieren voor decentrale overheden (ingezonden 14 okt

MPs Heijnen and Groot asked whether provinces and municipalities investing surplus funds in a troubled financial institution shows unnecessary risk-taking, and whether mandatory integral treasury banking should be reconsidered. The minister answered that decentralised governments are autonomous within the statutory framework, only one province uses integral treasury banking, and he will consult local government bodies on barriers to participation.

Under the Regulation on investments and derivatives of decentralised governments (Ruddo), provinces and municipalities are not permitted to take out loans for the sole purpose of investing the borrowed funds at a higher return.

Op basis van de Regeling uitzettingen en derivaten decentrale overheden (Ruddo) is het niet toegestaan voor provincies en gemeenten om leningen aan te gaan met het enkele doel de aangetrokken gelden tegen een hoger rendement uit te zetten.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de informatieverstrekking over de prijzen van ID-kaarten per 1 januari 2012 (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Interior why the 2012 budget sets aside 16.3 million euro for youth ID cards while the youth ID price is raised to 30 euro, whether freed-up funds compensate municipalities for free adult IDs in 2011, and why parliament was not informed. The minister explained the budget shortfall stems from a larger-than-expected drop in youth ID demand, the price rise is needed to make the service cost-covering, and compensation to municipalities will be financed from the 2011 budget via the Najaarsnota, with no firm commitment on how parliament was informed of the budget change.
I intend to fully finance the coverage for this compensation from the current 2011 budget.
Ik ben voornemens de dekking voor deze compensatie volledig uit de lopende begroting van 2011 te financieren.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over dubbelfuncties van politieke ambtsdragers (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether PVV provincial councillors who also work as paid staff for their own party group in Noord-Holland and Limburg are lawful and whether the minister approved such arrangements. The minister answered that no national rule explicitly bans the dual role, that the Noord-Holland presidium found no conflict with provincial rules, that he gave no approval for Limburg, and that provinces may regulate the issue themselves.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de website zorgtoeslag.nl (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Groot and Heijnen asked the State Secretary of Finance whether a commercial website charging fees for applying for healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag), which they say imitates the Tax Administration, should be tackled and whether a legal framework exists. The State Secretary replied that the site transparently discloses its paid services, that a legal framework exists where misleading, and that after legal analysis the site does not imitate the Tax Administration, while the operator agreed to make its commercial nature clearer on its homepage.
Moreover, JSKS has committed to adjust the homepage of their site so that it immediately becomes clear that it is a site of a commercial service provider.
Overigens is door JSKS toegezegd, dat zij de homepage van hun site zodanig zullen aanpassen dat al direct duidelijk wordt dat het om een site van een commerciële dienstverlener gaat.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen (PvdA), Koopmans (CDA), Van Raak (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bemoeienis van het college van B e

MPs asked whether the Roermond municipal executive improperly interfered in the sale of a former prison and court complex, and whether the state lost money when a developer with a lower bid obtained it. The state secretary replied that the highest bidder won after a second round, the state suffered no financial loss, the municipality cancelled the planned meeting with bidders after objections, and the evaluation report by the RijksAuditdienst was attached.

Although I distance myself from the wording he chose in the article, a meeting at the time could have led to unclarity about the State's position as seller of the complex and the transparency of the sales process.

Hoewel ik afstand neem van diens gekozen bewoording in het artikel, had destijds een gesprek kunnen leiden tot onduidelijkheid over de positie van de Staat als verkoper van het complex en de transparantie van het verkoopproces.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister president, de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de forse t

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about large increases in tourist tax and permit fees by municipalities, including whether gemeenten should be stopped from setting excessive rates and whether lokale lasten are used to offset cuts at the expense of entrepreneurs. The minister answered that municipal councils set these rates democratically, that transparency tools and a monitor will be developed, and that no specific intervention or separate tracking of business burdens is planned.
The tariffs are set by the municipality. The municipal council decides on tariff setting as a democratically legitimised body.
De tarieven worden vastgesteld door de gemeente. De gemeenteraad beslist als democratisch gelegitimeerd orgaan over de tariefstelling.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toekomstige beloning van de huidige korpschefs (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether high police officers who lose their top posts keep their pay under the new national police, and how this relates to regional chiefs earning less. The minister replied that these officials keep pay through the police legal-status safety net but not all allowances, that a new, simpler and more modest pay arrangement for the police top is being negotiated, and that the reorganisation will reduce top management.
I will have to enter into negotiations with the police unions for this. It is my intention to considerably simplify and moderate that new policy.
Ik zal hiervoor in onderhandeling moeten treden met de politiebonden. Het is mijn voornemen om dat nieuwe beleid aanzienlijk te vereenvoudigen en te versoberen.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kritiek op het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked the state secretary about press reports that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) barely protects privacy, its limited powers and budget, and whether individual complaints are handled poorly. The state secretary rejected the picture, said the CBP has successes and adequate staff and budget relative to other EU states, and noted planned powers to impose administrative fines.
I cannot confirm that the CBP is relatively underfunded compared with supervisory authorities in other EU countries.
Ik kan niet bevestigen dat het CBP relatief onderbedeeld is in vergelijking met toezichthouders in andere EU-landen.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over grootschalige fraude door middel van DigiD met kinderopvang-, huu

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Interior Minister about large-scale fraud with childcare, rent and care allowances via DigiD, including whether the Tax Authority deliberately did not check DigiD use, how victims would be compensated and how fraudsters would be pursued. The government answered that about 2,500 victims were involved in recent prosecutable cases, that measures blocking third-party applications and requiring written confirmation of account changes were introduced, that victims would be compensated, and that ongoing criminal investigations prevent discussing specific cases.
Victims receive a letter from the Tax Authority stating that they are victims of fraud.
Gedupeerden krijgen van de Belastingdienst een brief waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij slachtoffers zijn van een fraude.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Buitenlandse Zaken over de snelle en zorgvuldige administratieve afhandeling van een overlijden in

MPs Heijnen and Timmermans asked why the registration of a death abroad in Tunisia was delayed by a lengthy legalisation process and whether foreign death certificates could be provisionally registered. The minister acknowledged the delay was regrettable, explained the legalisation steps and the lost application, but declined to change the procedure, citing its long-standing reliability.
There is therefore insufficient reason to reconsider such a fundamental revision of the process.
Er bestaat derhalve onvoldoende aanleiding om een dergelijke fundamentele herziening van het proces te heroverwegen.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de informatie over grote ICT projecten bij het Rijk (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Heijnen asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Rijks ICT-dashboard gives a transparent picture of large government ICT projects, including how traffic-light colours are set and whether the site is kept up to date. Minister Donner answered that the dashboard mirrors the annual report, that colour ratings compare against the last formal re-estimate, and that he is considering adjustments such as comparing against original estimates and adding contractor information.
I am considering an adjustment to the ICT dashboard so that the colour is determined not only by the deviation from the latest re-estimate, but also takes into account all intermediate re-estimates.

Ik beraad me wel op een aanpassing van het ICT-dashboard waarbij de kleur niet alleen wordt vastgesteld op basis van de afwijking ten opzichte van de laatste herijking, maar waarbij ook alle tussenliggende herijkingen in beschouwing worden genomen.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister-president over de toezeggingen aan de heer Robesin ten aanzien van ontpoldering in Zeeland (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether an open letter from Provincial Councillor Robesin showed that a promise had been made to him in exchange for his vote against depoldering in Zeeland, and whether his claim that no commitments were made holds. The Prime Minister answered that the government will keep the coalition agreement's commitment to develop an alternative to depoldering the Hedwigepolder, that he will not comment on a confidential meeting, and that no commitments were given to the councillor.
It concerned a confidential conversation. I wish to confirm once again that no commitments were made to those involved.
Het betrof een vertrouwelijk gesprek. Ik wil bij deze nogmaals bevestigen dat er geen toezeggingen zijn gedaan aan betrokkenen.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de rechtsbesche

MPs Heijnen and Hamer asked ministers about legal protection of civil servants at AgentschapNL, who work via a payroll company and may be dismissed without a social plan due to budget cuts. The government answered that payroll workers are employees of the payroll firm, not civil servants, that the VPO-CAO applies, and that the firm bears employer responsibility, while AgentschapNL will act within the Rijk social flanking policy.
These are not civil servants but employees of a payroll company.
Het betreft hier geen ambtenaren maar werknemers in dienst van een payrollbedrijf.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het accres van het gemeentefonds voor de komende jaren (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether a letter on the Gemeentefonds reported a wrong negative accres from 2012 and how gemeenten will be informed about financial developments. The minister admits the letter wrongly suggested a negative accres, says it was corrected, and states the May circular will show a EUR 128 million increase in the accres.
Nevertheless, a picture deviating from the December circular was mistakenly created.
Abusievelijk is niettemin dat van de decembercirculaire afwijkende beeld gecreëerd.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verlaging van de administratieve lasten bij de inschrijving v

MPs Heijnen and Çelik asked whether schools must require a GBA extract (municipal population register extract) when enrolling pupils, and how administrative burdens can be cut. The minister answered that schools are only required to hold such extracts for one subsidy scheme, that other documents can be used, that information campaigns will be used to correct misinterpretation, and that the government is working to remove the GBA-extract requirement from other procedures.
I will use the communication channels between DUO and the schools for this.
Ik zal daarvoor de communicatiekanalen tussen DUO en de scholen gebruiken.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het voornemen tot opheffing van de gemeente Millingen aan de Rijn (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister about the proposed dissolution of the municipality of Millingen aan de Rijn, its neighbours' refusal to merge, and what the province had done as supervisor. The minister confirmed the municipality's request for a merger, said Groesbeek opposes merging, described the province's preventive supervision and budget scans, and said the province bears primary responsibility for solving the problems.
Promoting a solution to the problems of the municipality of Millingen aan de Rijn is a primary responsibility of the Gelderland provincial executive.
Het bevorderen van de oplossing van de problemen van de gemeente Millingen aan de Rijn is een eerste verantwoordelijkheid van het provinciebestuur van Gelderland.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kwaliteit van inschrijvingen in de Gemeentelijke Basis A

MPs Heijnen and Vermeij asked the ministers of Interior and Social Affairs about address discrepancies between the UWV insurance register and the municipal GBA population register, whether the UWV may refuse to analyse them under the SUWI law, and why some agencies do not yet report back to the GBA. The minister answered that the UWV lacks grounds to report or analyse without reasonable doubt, that a joint Amsterdam–UWV review of 5,000 addresses is planned, and that the GBA quality action plan will be evaluated and reported to parliament by December 2011.
I will inform your House by December 2011 at the latest about the outcomes of the evaluation and any follow-up steps.
Ik zal uw Kamer uiterlijk december 2011 over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie en eventuele vervolgstappen informeren.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over duizenden verdwenen Kamerstukken en de toegankelijkheid van parlementaire informatie (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about thousands of missing parliamentary documents, including throne speeches, on the official publications website, and about public access to parliamentary information. The minister admitted about 2,200 Handelingen from 1995-1997 are missing from the state database, regretted the omission and promised to add them, but declined to comment on parliament's own content and structuring of its publications.
The missing publications will be added as soon as possible.
De ontbrekende publicaties zullen zo snel mogelijk worden toegevoegd.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over burgemeesters die stoppen vanwege de FPU (ingezonden 5 janu

PvdA MPs asked whether mayors and civil servants eligible for the FPU early-retirement scheme are leaving office early to avoid pension loss, and whether the government will act so they can finish their terms. The ministers answered that retirement is an individual choice, that the bonus for working past the early-retirement age is designed to encourage later exit, and that no changes are planned because the transitional rule ends in 2015.
The moment of leaving employment is a personal choice.
Het moment van uittreden is een persoonlijke keuze.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bezuinigingen bij het Rijk (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MP Heijnen asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would reorganise more drastically than known, whether jobs at implementing agencies would be lost, why the Compacte Rijksdienst implementation plan was late, and whether the motion on crisis regions would be respected. The minister denied deeper cuts beyond the coalition agreement, said departments would detail the cuts and that the plan was sent on 14 February 2011, and said regional employment is considered alongside efficiency.
No. The plans to achieve a compact central government give effect to the spending target from the coalition agreement under the heading 'smaller government'.
Nee. De voornemens om te komen tot een compacte rijksdienst geven invulling aan de taakstelling uit het regeerakkoord onder het kopje «kleinere overheid».

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mogelijkheid om de woonplaats van de moeder als geboorte

MPs Heijnen and Jacobi asked whether the mother's residence could be recorded as the birthplace when a birth occurs in a neighbouring hospital, and whether Terschelling could get a birth enclave in Leeuwarden. Minister Donner answered that recording the mother's residence conflicts with the Civil Code, that the Wet arhi does not allow the enclave, and that the civil registry advisory commission will be asked about possible conditions.
Recording the mother's residence as the child's birthplace, instead of the actual place of birth, conflicts with the Civil Code.
Antwoord 6 Het opnemen van de woonplaats van de moeder als de geboorteplaats van het kind, in plaats van het opnemen van de feitelijke geboorteplaats, is in strijd met het Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een alarmerende stijging van identiteitsfraude (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported rise in identity fraud, including whether police register it separately, whether government databases are easy to breach, public awareness, police powers and whether a separate criminal offence is needed. The minister answered that existing data-protection rules apply, awareness campaigns already exist with no need for further measures, police act within current capacity, and a separate offence is not needed for now.
There is no reason for me to take additional measures.
Er bestaat voor mij geen aanleiding voor het nemen van aanvullende maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de administratieve lasten van commercieel getinte Wob-verzoeken (ingez

MPs Kuiken and Heijnen asked whether commercial FOI (Wob) requests drain scarce police capacity and what the government would do about it. The minister said he has no overview of Wob request purposes, that the Wob lacks a proportionality test, and promised a letter on curbing abuse and reducing police workload.
As previously promised to the House, I will send you a letter shortly with proposals to prevent improper use of the Wob.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer toegezegd, stuur ik u op korte termijn een brief met daarin voorstellen om oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob te voorkomen.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over regelgeving in de Nederlandse paspoortwet met betrekking tot biometri

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked ministers whether EU rules and the UK's abolition of its national ID card change the Dutch plan to centrally store biometric passport data, and asked for the UK's reasons and the timeline for the Dutch reorganisation (ORRA). Minister Donner answered that the EU regulation leaves storage choices to member states, that the UK keeps a central passport register with biometrics, and that the ORRA orientation needs about two more months.
Yes, I still expect to need at least the next two months to complete this orientation.
Ja, ik denk nog zeker de komende twee maanden nodig te hebben voor de afronding van deze oriëntatie.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over accountantsdiensten bij gemeenten (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal audit costs are known and whether municipalities are breaking the mandatory tendering rules for accountants, with possible effects on control quality. The minister said he has no overview of total audit costs per municipality, sees no reason for a study, and referred the tendering questions to earlier answers without substantive new information.
I have no insight into the total costs per municipality, and inquiries with the VNG revealed that it also has no insight into these costs.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale kosten per gemeente en navraag bij de VNG leerde dat deze ook geen inzicht heeft in deze kosten.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over beperkingen door werkgevers aan het passief kiesrecht (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether employer-imposed limits on candidacy for local councils, as in a journalist's labour dispute, are acceptable and whether rules should be tightened. The minister agreed passive voting rights are important, said the court's ruling on the employment contract needed no challenge, declined to urge employers to change practice, and saw no need for new statutory limits.
No, based on this case I see no reason to take such a step.
Nee, op grond van dit geval zie ik geen aanleiding om hiertoe over te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dreigende sluiting van school voor voortgezet onderwijs in de Haagse Schilderswijk (ingezonden 9 december 2010)

MPs Çelik and Heijnen asked whether closing a havo/vwo school in The Hague's Schilderswijk, part of the Johan de Wittcollege, would harm opportunities in a disadvantaged neighbourhood, and whether the ministry would intervene. The minister replied that the school board is only relocating the vwo branch elsewhere in The Hague due to new building, that the decision belongs to the school board and the works council, and declined to request a municipal report or to investigate keeping the programme.
Whether or not to close (branch) locations are decisions taken primarily by the school board, which is entitled to make them.
Het al dan niet sluiten van (neven)vestigingen zijn beslissingen die primair door het schoolbestuur worden genomen, het schoolbestuur is hiertoe gerechtigd.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de toegankelijkheid van overheidswebsites (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the poor accessibility of municipal websites for disabled people and seniors, whether legislation would be introduced to force compliance, and about costs of upgrading. The minister said municipalities are responsible, no legislation is planned, BZK will monitor national government websites, and it will not pursue most of the report's recommendations.
I do not intend to introduce legislation.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving in te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over gedwongen ontslagen bij de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Tax Administration director-general warned of forced dismissals, the size and cost of any social plan, and whether an independent body such as the Court of Audit should examine if tax collection can be maintained under the budget cuts. The state secretary confirmed the cuts of about EUR 400 million structural by 2015, said no decision on implementation had yet been taken and that an independent study was not appropriate, but promised to inform parliament once clearer.
An independent study into the consequences of the budget cuts for the Tax Administration's performance is therefore not appropriate.
Een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de consequenties van de taakstellingen voor de taakuitoefening van de Belastingdienst is dan ook niet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het WRR-rapport «Happy Landings, het biometrisch paspoort als black box» (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether the government will respond to a WRR-commissioned publication on biometric passports, whether it will pause preparations for a central biometric data store, and whether other EU states' implementation can be reported. The minister says the publication is not a WRR report, a WRR report on ICT and government is expected in spring 2011, he will look into the central database options for several months before informing the Chamber, and he will check whether information on other member states is available.
I want to look into this file in order to reach a judgment on how the ORRA could be shaped.
Ik wil mij op dit dossier oriënteren om tot een oordeel te kunnen komen over de wijze waarop de ORRA vorm zou kunnen krijgen.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van een informatiseringproject van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichti

MPs Heijnen and Bouwmeester asked ministers about the halting of the DJI information system Cajis, its costs, project governance, and the information given to parliament. The government answered that the project was stopped after a June 2010 review found its design outdated and costs would exceed 20 million euro, that parliament was not informed because the project did not meet the large-ICT threshold, and that existing systems continue to be used.
The Tweede Kamer was not informed about the planning and progress of the Cajis project, because this is not usual for projects that do not meet the criterion for designation as a 'large ICT project'.

De Tweede Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de planning en voortgang van de ontwikkeling van het Cajis-project, omdat dit niet gebruikelijk is voor projecten die niet voldoen aan het criterium voor aanwijzing tot «groot ICT project».

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het ondersteunen van mantelzorgers (ingezonden 22 septembe

MPs Wolbert and Heijnen asked the ministers of Health and Interior about a reported Erasmus study on care-giver support delaying nursing-home admission, the number of care offices with case management, and the government's own care-friendly employment policy. The minister said he did not know the study, answered that all care offices include dementia care in procurement with varying regional coverage, and described awareness campaigns and partnerships with employers, plus a planned conference on care-friendly HR policy for government departments.
This study is not known to me.
Dít onderzoek is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over forse overschrijdingen van budgetten voor IT-projecten bij de overheid (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether a report claiming public-sector IT budgets are overspent by EUR 675 million a year, and related claims about overspending rates and central government, is accurate, and whether a full response would be provided. The state secretary replied that the report's data come from contacts and public information, that the ministry did not buy it because it costs EUR 1,500 and its value is doubtful, and that oversight covers only central government ICT projects, not the wider public sector.
I have no view of ICT projects in the public sector outside central government.
Op ICT-projecten van de publieke sector buiten het Rijk heb ik geen zicht.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat minister Huizinga zich

PvdA MPs asked whether minister Huizinga used a private jet from Italy at ministry expense, and what rules govern ministerial travel and the meaning of 'necessary facilities'. The minister confirmed a government flight was used to attend a budget debate and a scheduled flight home, maintained the decision was within article 6 of the Voorzieningenbesluit, and declined to tighten the rules.
Do you consider it desirable to tighten the aforementioned Voorzieningenbesluit regarding business travel other than by car?
Vraag 9 Acht u aanscherping van het genoemde voorzieningenbesluit ten aanzien van dienstreizen anders dan per auto gewenst?

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over het verstrekken van

MPs Heijnen and Klijnsma asked whether municipalities can issue an international marriage certificate to same-sex couples, why not, and whether national rules will be changed. The minister replied that the ICBS model extract cannot yet be used for same-sex marriages, that an amended model is expected in 2011, and that interim options exist, including a uniform model developed by the NVvB.
That no international extract can currently be issued for same-sex marriages based on the Vienna Convention does not mean that it would not be possible to accommodate the citizens concerned.

Dat er op dit moment nog geen internationaal uittreksel kan worden afgegeven voor huwelijken tussen personen van gelijk geslacht dat gebaseerd is op de Overeenkomst van Wenen, betekent niet dat het niet mogelijk zou zijn om burgers in kwestie tegemoet te komen.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het recht van grensarbeiders op AOW (ingezonden 31 augustus

MPs Vermeij and Heijnen asked ministers about cross-border workers' AOW pension rights after a report that a Belgian-resident entrepreneur must prove entitlement despite SVB assurances. The minister answered that verification via registrations is required, premiums are refunded or compensated, and points to existing checks, portals and the border ombudsman, without committing to new measures.
Verification takes place on the basis of registrations of, for example, UWV and the Tax Authority, which will (have to) show the claimed work in the Netherlands.
Verificatie vindt plaats aan de hand van registraties van bijvoorbeeld UWV en Belastingdienst waaruit de gestelde arbeid in Nederland zal (moeten) blijken.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het lage niveau van burgerschapscompetenti

Labour MPs Çelik and Heijnen asked ministers about low civic competence scores of Dutch pupils in the IEA/ICCS study, the inspectorate's repeated criticism of slow progress on citizenship education, and what would be done. The government answered that schools have legal duties on citizenship with room for their own approach, that the inspectorate's recommendations will inform later decisions, and that the Huis voor democratie en rechtsstaat and parents' involvement are being addressed in future plans.
Whether and how policy is deployed to further stimulate citizenship is left to the next cabinet.
Of en hoe beleidsmatig wordt ingezet om burgerschap verder te stimuleren wordt overgelaten aan het volgende kabinet.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bestrijding van natuurbranden (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Heijnen asked the Minister of Interior about the firefighting of nature fires, including whether the brigades are equipped, whether volunteers and Defence can help, and whether there is a shortage of material. The state secretary answered that risk-calculation methods are unsuitable and a new model is being studied, that the Inspectorate will investigate preparedness and material shortages with a report expected in autumn 2010, and that Defence can be requested for military assistance.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Depla (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over fraude op de huizenmarkt (ingezonden 28 april

MPs Heijnen and Depla asked why housing fraud still requires a sample study when municipalities can already share GBA data with housing corporations, and why corporate data are not systematically linked to population, cadastre, telephone and postal records. The minister answered that the Eindhoven pilot goes further than GBA linkage, that municipalities must weigh cost-effectiveness and privacy themselves, that a Basisregistratie personen bill is being prepared (delayed beyond summer), and that neighbourhood investigations are a municipal choice with the national government mainly informing and stimulating.
Systematically linking data can indeed be a good method for tackling housing fraud.
Het stelselmatig koppelen van gegevens kan inderdaad een goede methode zijn om woonfraude aan te pakken.

Vragen van de leden Vos, Heijnen en Vermeij (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Belastingdienst als slechte werkgever (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MPs Vos, Heijnen and Vermeij (PvdA) asked the Finance and Interior ministers whether the Belastingdienst is a poor employer, questioning lower pay, the lack of permanent contracts for agency workers at Belastingdienst Toeslagen, and their costs. The minister denied the pay gap claim, said agency work is tied to temporary tasks that will end once the new benefits system is rolled out, and gave cost figures per hour.
The answer to this question depends on the nature of the work.
Het antwoord op deze vraag hangt af van het karakter van de werkzaamheden.
Vragen van het lid Heijnen (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de voortgang van de invoering van de Rijkspas (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

An MP asks the State Secretary about the delayed rollout of the Rijkspas government access card, its costs, the durability of its chip, ministries' discretion over its functionality, and a dispute with the data protection regulator CBP over using the citizen service number. The State Secretary says the rollout is back on schedule for 2010, denies that ministries' costs are a multiple of the purchase price, and maintains that using the BSN for building access is lawful while acknowledging the disagreement with the CBP.
The CBP stated on 26 January 2009 that the use of the BSN in the internal operations of the central government is not lawful.

not to take no-regret measures before the stress test has shown that our fresh water supply remains adequate
geen «no regret»-maatregelen te nemen alvorens de stresstest heeft uitgewezen dat onze zoetwatervoorziening op peil blijft
Motie van de leden Visser en Hoogland over de handhaving in verband met de rode kruisen boven de weg
Asks the government to explain how enforcement of red crosses above motorway lanes can be intensified and to inform the House before January.
to indicate how enforcement of the red crosses above the road can be intensified
aan te geven hoe de handhaving van de rode kruisen boven de weg geïntensiveerd kan worden

Asks the government to map bottlenecks in the transport and logistics sectors under different growth scenarios by mid-2015.
requests the government to map by mid-2015 the bottlenecks in the logistics and transport sectors

Asks the government for an international comparative study of penalties for drink driving and a stricter policy with a proposal to the House.
requests the government to carry out an international comparative study of the height of penalties for drink driving
verzoekt de regering om, een internationaal vergelijkend onderzoek uit te voeren naar de hoogte van straffen voor rijden onder invloed

Asks the government to adopt a stricter policy and lower the blood alcohol limit for the drink-driving recidivism rule from 1.3 to 0.8 per mille.
introduce a stricter norm of 0.8 per mille for the recidivism scheme
een strengere norm, van 0,8 promille, voor de recidiveregeling in te voeren

The Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within two years of its entry into force.

Onze Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu zendt binnen twee jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.

Asks the government to map the economic effects of the new environmental and nature laws on construction firms and quickly propose building regulation changes to improve the business climate.
requests the government to map the economic effects on construction entrepreneurs when developing the Environment Act and Nature Conservation Act
verzoekt de regering om bij de uitwerking van de Omgevingswet en Natuurbeschermingswet de economische gevolgen voor bouwondernemers in kaart te brengen

Amendement van het lid Verhoeven c.s. over het wijzigen van de wijze waarop de opbrengst van Wet herziening behandeling fiscale behandeling eigen woning wordt teruggesluisd.

Motion asks the government to talk with banks and municipalities about further simplifying the Leegstandwet rules and differences in leges, and to inform the House.
requests the government to enter into talks shortly with the Dutch Banking Association and the Association of Dutch Municipalities
verzoekt de regering, op korte termijn met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NVB) en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) in gesprek te gaan

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Visser ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het aansluiten van de vergunning voor tijdelijke verhuur op basis van de Leegstandwet bij de termijn van de tijdelijke ontheffing

Daarom is het wenselijk dat de vergunning voor tijdelijke verhuur op basis van de Leegstandwet aansluit bij de termijn van de tijdelijke ontheffing van het bestemmingsplan.
Amendement van het lid Visser over het direct verlenen van een vergunning voor vijf jaren zonder verlenging ten aanzien van tijdelijke verhuur van te koop staande woningen

Amendment to let a permit for temporary letting of homes for sale run for five years, non-extendable, instead of the default term.
Deze vergunning kan niet worden verlengd.

wordt in artikel 15, vijfde lid, «zeven jaren» vervangen door: tien jaren.

in article 15, fifth paragraph, five years is replaced by ten years
wordt in artikel 15, vijfde lid, «vijf jaren» vervangen door: tien jaren

Amendement van het lid Visser over het loslaten van de huurprijsbescherming voor alle verhuur op basis van de Leegstandswet

Motie Monasch en Visser over investeren in huurwoningen in de vrije sector
Asks the government to discuss with DNB barriers to pension fund investment in private-sector rental housing and remove other regulatory obstacles.

Asks the government to explore options to simplify the energy performance certificate system and its sanctions to reduce administrative burden.
requests the government to explore options for simplifying the energy performance certificate system and its sanctioning

requests the government to send, on behalf of the Member State Netherlands, a letter of concern to this Stoiber commission

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de bescherming van het koraal tegen de zandstorting van het Chogogo Dive and Beach Resort op Bonaire

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked ministers about a sand dumping project by Chogogo resort on Bonaire that allegedly lacked a permit and damaged coral, including a verbal tolerance decision and an unpaid penalty. The government answered that a natural permit was belatedly granted in January 2022 with conditions, that the island authority is responsible for enforcement and collecting the penalty, and that enforcement programmes will be strengthened, though impacts on coral are still unknown.
The public body is responsible for this.
Het openbaar lichaam is hiervoor verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de Zembla uitzending over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen op Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked the government about the Zembla broadcast on toxic emissions at Schiphol and the health risks for platform workers, including accountability, Arbowet compliance, and liability. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to sector-wide steps and ongoing Labour Inspectorate investigation, but largely placed responsibility on employers and stated that data on life expectancy and some emission assessments are unavailable or pending.

It is up to the employer and the client to ensure this. The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate started an investigation at the end of 2021 into compliance with working conditions legislation at Schiphol.

Het is aan de werkgever en de opdrachtgever om daar zorg voor te dragen. De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie is eind 2021 onderzoek gestart naar de naleving van de arbeidsomstandighedenwet- en regelgeving op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Mogelijk grote rol voor zonne-energie op de Noordzee'

An MP asked the government about TNO research and pilots for solar energy on the North Sea, its alignment with the Routekaart Zon op water, ecological effects and possible tenders combining wind and solar. The government answered that ecological effects are not yet known, that only small pilots exist, that NWO research and monitoring are planned, and that it will discuss the matter in the Noordzeeoverleg.
There is still much unknown about the ecological effects of solar energy on water.
Er is nog veel onbekend over de ecologische effecten van zon op water.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de coronamaatregelen voor rijscholen

An MP asked why driving lessons faced passenger and time restrictions during COVID-19 measures while taxis did not, and whether the 17:00 cutoff and two-person limit were mandatory and harmful. The minister answered that the restrictions were lifted (three persons allowed, lessons allowed after 17:00 since 18 December 2021), that the lesson car is a public place under the rules, and that the branch is kept informed.
The regulations have since changed following the decision of 18 December 2021, so driving schools can give lessons during their regular opening hours.
Inmiddels is de regelgeving veranderd door de besluitvorming op 18 december 2021, waardoor de rijscholen gedurende hun reguliere openingstijden les kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'Deltacommissaris: woningbouw houdt veel te weinig rekening met klimaatverandering'

An MP (Van Esch, PvdD) asked the ministers about a report that the Delta Commissioner finds housing construction takes too little account of climate change, including whether new homes are planned in flood-prone or unstable areas, and what action will be taken on climate-adaptive building, nature-inclusive building, subsidence and coastal/river development. The minister answers that a formal response to the Delta Commissioner's advice will follow in Q1 2022, that a national climate-adaptation action programme and a building-criteria framework will be produced, and that the government commits to these steps while describing many measures as ongoing or to be explored.

In the response to the Delta Commissioner's advice we will indicate how we will tackle this challenge of quickly realising affordable homes on the one hand and taking account of the consequences of climate change on the other.

In de reactie op het advies van de Deltacommissaris zullen we aangeven hoe we aan de slag gaan met deze uitdaging om enerzijds snel betaalbare woningen te realiseren en anderzijds rekening te houden met gevolgen van klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector
