CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de onbetrouwbaarheid van flitsapparatuur

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether digital speed cameras are unreliable and whether mobile radar problems and manual filtering errors lead to wrongful fines, and asks about the figures involved. The minister denies a general reliability problem, says a single storage fault was isolated and fines annulled, and states no percentages or counts are kept, while noting correction requests and appeal as remedies.
A percentage cannot be given because this is not recorded.
Een percentage is niet te geven omdat dit niet wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over fraude op Schiphol

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Infrastructure State Secretary about fraud, cost control, investment and building-quality problems at Schiphol Group, following a NRC article. The government answered that Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own integrity and asset management, that an external review and KPMG study found procurement market-conform, and that existing building issues, including the Hilton case, were addressed with the competent authorities.
Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own business operations and integrity policy.
Schiphol is primair verantwoordelijk voor de eigen bedrijfsvoering en het integriteitsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de problemen met het digitale Kiwa-loket

An MP asked the minister about problems with the new Kiwa digital portal for tachograph cards, including complaints, causes, and whether drivers were harmed. The minister acknowledged delays affecting 52 drivers caused by migration problems, said Kiwa was warned and apologised, and described a planned new tariff regime.
The ILT has held Kiwa to account for the problems identified.
De ILT heeft Kiwa aangesproken op de geconstateerde problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Visser over het bericht 'Opzeggen vissersakkoord door Britten kan ramp zijn voor Nederland'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about the UK's notice to terminate the London Fisheries Convention and its consequences for Dutch fishers, including the 6-12 mile zone and the Brexit negotiations. The government confirmed the termination was filed on 3 July 2017, said Dutch-flagged vessels barely fish that zone, and noted the issue will be part of the wider EU-UK relationship talks.
The Convention has a two-year notice period and ceases to apply to the United Kingdom on 3 July 2019.
Het Verdrag heeft een opzegtermijn van twee jaar en verliest zijn werking jegens het Verenigd Koninkrijk op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van der Molen over het bericht “IFKS: comedy met Europese regels” in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Aukje de Vries, Visser and Van der Molen asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about EU certification (CvO) and AIS obligations affecting race skûtsjes reported in the Leeuwarder Courant. The minister says a clear transitional regime exists, enforcement only starts after 1 January 2019, and no legal basis exists for exemptions from the AIS or CvO obligations.
However, I am convinced that a clear and workable transitional arrangement exists for the vessels concerned.
Ik ben er echter van overtuigd dat er voor de betrokken schepen een heldere en werkbare overgangsregeling bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Visser en Jetten over het vliegveld Teuge

MPs asked whether the province of Gelderland pushed for a new flight route over the Teuge airport, whether provinces were consulted and informed about the planned airspace connections for Lelystad Airport, and what alternatives exist. The state secretary denied that Gelderland pushed for a route over Teuge, said the provinces were involved and informed, that a consultation procedure starts in September, and that she is exploring with Teuge and the parachute centre how to limit the effects.
There is no question of the province of Gelderland having pushed for a flight route over Teuge.
Er is geen sprake van dat de provincie Gelderland op een vliegroute boven Teuge zou hebben aangestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht forse toename boetes voor kleine snelheidsovertredingen

An MP asked why fines for minor speeding offences rose sharply, whether the cause is new speed cameras or more section controls, and how this affects road safety and police credibility. The minister says many factors influence offence numbers, partly points to the abolition of the 4 km/h threshold on 130 km/h roads and more such roads, defends enforcement of small speeding offences, and reports the progressive fines study was sent to parliament.
It is possible that part of the increase is due to the replacement of the digital poles and section controls and part to the expansion of the number of sections where 130 km/h may be driven.

Het is mogelijk dat een deel van de stijging komt door de vervanging van de digitale palen en trajectcontroles en een deel door de uitbreiding van het aantal trajecten waar 130 km/u mag worden gereden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Van Helvert en Jetten over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de situatie op Schiphol

MPs Visser, Van Helvert and Jetten asked the state secretary about long queues at Schiphol airport, including slot allocation, KMar staffing, selectiveness policy and Lelystad. The government replied that Schiphol committed to fully staffing security lanes over summer, extra KMar capacity is planned, and most questions were answered with policy restatements and referrals to other bodies.
Soon I want to discuss in a follow-up meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN which actions these parties can take to work towards a more structural solution in the medium term.
Binnenkort wil ik in een vervolggesprek met Schiphol, KLM en BARIN bespreken welke acties deze partijen kunnen nemen om op middellange termijn naar een meer structurele oplossing toe te werken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Genoeg van Faalsluitdijk”

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports on repeated breakdowns of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, stand-by staffing, repair plans and economic damage. The minister explained the heat-related failures, announced continuous cooling and a bridge superstructure replacement in 2023-2025, but declined to quantify economic damage since it is not recorded.
Should the situation change, I will consider which measures are needed.
Mocht de situatie wijzigen dan bekijk ik welke maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de berichtgeving over Schiphol

Visser (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about reports of queues, baggage, gate and runway capacity problems at Schiphol, KLM's concerns, the selectivity policy and the ongoing growth debate. The State Secretary answered that a meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN led to agreed opening of security lanes in summer 2017, that the government is coordinating border-control measures, and that the selectivity policy and the MER/safety analysis on growth beyond 2020 are in progress.
On 8 May I held a meeting with the CEO of Schiphol, the CEO of KLM and the chair of BARIN about the situation that has arisen.

Ik heb 8 mei jl. een gesprek gevoerd met de president-directeur van Schiphol, de president-directeur van KLM en de voorzitter van de Board of Airline Representatives In the Netherlands (BARIN) over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Letselschade-uitkering verkeersslachtoffer moet belastingvrij'

MPs from the VVD asked whether personal injury compensation for road accident victims should be exempt from the asset income surcharge that affects Wlz and Wmo co-payments, following a call by insurers and victim groups. The government answered that the surcharge applies in principle, that only compensation for non-material damage and claims fixed before 11 October 2010 are excluded under the hardship clause, and that it is consulting stakeholders with findings promised before summer.
I expect to be able to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these consultations.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-de Haan en Visser inzake de Duitse tol

MPs Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-De Haan and Visser asked whether the German Bundesrat's approval of the road toll (vignette) removes obstacles to its introduction, what its effects are for Dutch motorists, transport and border regions, and what the minister will do, including a border-impact assessment. The minister answered that the EU-required changes were adopted, that the infringement procedure continues, that he opposes the toll, will seek clarification from the Commission and Austria, and will carry out a border-effects assessment once the German law is final.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Ten Broeke over vliegen boven conflictgebieden

MPs Visser and Ten Broeke asked the State Secretary about aviation over conflict zones, including ICAO measures, information sharing, the Ten Broeke motion on safety management certification, and airspace closure powers. The State Secretary answered that ICAO has adopted measures with implementation timelines, that a convenant on threat information sharing works well with a formal evaluation planned, and that the government is pushing for further ICAO and EU rules.
As laid down in the Convenant, a formal evaluation will take place this year before the summer.
Zoals in het Convenant is vastgelegd vindt een formele evaluatie dit jaar voor de zomer plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over uitbreiding trajectcontroles naar de Provinciale wegen

Visser (VVD) asked the ministers about extending average-speed (trajectory) controls to provincial roads, including pilot results, selection criteria and the role of parliament. The minister answered that 15-20 N-road locations are being assessed by the OM, police and road managers, that provinces are responsible for road safety and that parliament has no formal role beyond its oversight of national policy.
Beyond its supervisory role over national policy, I see no role for the House here, since road safety on provincial roads is a responsibility of the provinces.
Buiten haar controlerende taak op het rijksbeleid zie ik hier geen rol weggelegd voor de Kamer, aangezien de verkeersveiligheid op provinciale wegen een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht ‘Meer fijnstof achter het fornuis dan langs de snelweg’

MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary about a TNO study showing indoor fine-particle peaks from cooking that exceed outdoor levels, and about its representativeness, health implications, follow-up research and fit with the national air quality programme. The government answered that the study covers only nine homes, that indoor peaks are not covered by outdoor norms, that TNO and TKI Urban Energy research is underway, and that indoor ventilation rules in the Bouwbesluit apply.
TNO has indicated that an exploratory study will be carried out next year to determine emission factors for cooking meals.
TNO heeft laten weten dat er komend jaar een verkennende studie wordt gedaan naar bepaling van emissiefactoren van het koken van maaltijden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het besluit van de Belgische regering om te investeren in het spoortraject Antwerpen-Weert

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about Belgium's plans to electrify the Antwerp–Weert rail line, its CEF funding application, cost-benefit analysis, Brabant route relief, and a possible 4 million euro national contribution. The state secretary answered that Belgian federal decision-making is pending, no Dutch financing is involved, no cost-benefit analysis is yet available, the existing line has sufficient capacity, and electrification is not a national priority so no infrastructure fund reservation is appropriate.
I therefore conclude that electrification of the route is not a national priority.
Ik constateer daarmee dat elektrificatie van het tracé geen nationale prioriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-De Haan en De Boer over een werkbezoek aan de provincie Limburg d.d. 6 februari 2017

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about commitments on a rail connection and Carhandling Terminal Swentibold in Limburg, including the status of studies, ProRail's cost validation, provincial guarantees and whether national funding would be provided. The state secretary confirmed the agreements, said the connection now costs about EUR 40 million rather than EUR 20 million, and offered up to EUR 10 million in national funding (EUR 5 million each from the ministries) subject to conditions such as public access, job effects, a one-off contribution and a validated business case.
It has been agreed that the definitive cost estimate for the public connection of this rail terminal will be validated by ProRail according to the standard requirements.
Afgesproken is dat de definitieve kostenraming van de openbare aansluiting van deze railterminal door ProRail zal worden getoetst conform de standaard eisen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Ten Broeke en Azmani over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

VVD MPs asked the minister why Overijssel appears to contribute the most provincial co-financing to national motorway projects, and how investment priorities and the Infrastructure Fund figures were determined. The minister answered that investments follow the SVIR and NMCA bottleneck analyses and File Top 50, that the table reflects cash flows (inflated for Overijssel by a 2015 transfer), and listed 2006-2015 and upcoming Overijssel projects with co-financing amounts.
The table was compiled from the annual reports of the Infrastructure Fund (IF).
De tabel is tot stand gekomen vanuit de jaarverslagen van het Infrastructuurfonds (IF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over gebrek aan snelheidscontroles in diverse gemeenten

An MP asked whether police in several municipalities are not enforcing speed limits on 30 and 60 km/h roads and whether this policy should be tightened for road safety. The minister replied that enforcement is decentralised to local tripartite arrangements, that police and prosecutors set national enforcement priorities including speed, and that no overview exists of how many municipalities include road safety in their plans.
I do not have an overview available of the total number of municipalities that have included road safety as a priority in their safety plans.
Ik heb geen overzicht beschikbaar van het totaal aantal gemeenten dat de verkeersveiligheid als prioriteit in de veiligheidsplannen heeft opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Potters en Veldman over de A73

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the A73 motorway, including accident figures, traffic congestion, the German truck toll, and whether extending the A77 would help. The Minister said accident risk on most of the A73 is below average, but the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch is above average, so Rijkswaterstaat was asked for an analysis; she also gave congestion and maintenance details and said extending the A77 is not foreseen.
That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this stretch in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Nijkerken-De Haan over de Duitse tolheffing in grensregio’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch Infrastructure minister about German road tolls affecting border regions, including whether he would act and whether he would go to court with Austria. The minister said he has objected to Germany's plans, that the German plan was amended after his objections, that consultations with Austria and the European Commission are ongoing, and that going to court is not currently an option.
Going to court is therefore not currently an issue.
Een gang naar de rechter is nu dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat de Nederlandse visser niet op bijvangst zit te wachten

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Dutch fishers do not want bycatch landed under the landing obligation, and about a EUR 75,000 commission to promote undervalued fish species via the VISwijzer/Good Fish Foundation. The state secretary answers that the commission is an assignment, that market improvement is only one part of a broader package for making the landing obligation workable, and that he has no reason to doubt the objectivity of the VISwijzer.
This concerns not a subsidy but an assignment, with a total value of EUR 75,000.
Dit betreft geen subsidie maar een opdracht, met een totale omvang van € 75.000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het ongeval bij de stuw bij Grave

MPs of the VVD asked the minister about the causes and consequences of a ship colliding with the Grave weir on the Maas, including damage claims, repair timing, responsibility for coordination, and an evaluation. The minister answered that the cause awaits police findings, damages are unknown and claimable from the ship owner, repairs take at least six months, and an independent evaluation will be delivered by spring 2017.
Pending the results of the police investigation, I cannot make statements about the precise cause of the accident.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek door de politie kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘NVWA kapittelt afslag Urk vanwege condens’

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, and the answer came from Minister Schippers, about the NVWA closing three cold cells at Visveiling Urk and imposing a penalty order over condensation, which they argued is a natural phenomenon with no bacteriological danger. The government answered that condensation is a food-safety hygiene requirement that Visveiling Urk has failed to fix despite years of warnings, and it declined to intervene in the dispute between the NVWA and the company.
No, I am not willing to get involved in this discussion between the NVWA and Visveiling Urk bv.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid mij te mengen in deze discussie tussen de NVWA en Visveiling Urk bv.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Visser over de brief Drinkwatertarieven Evides Recreatieparken Zeeland

MPs Ziengs and Visser asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the sharp water-tariff increases for holiday parks at Evides, caused by fixed charges per address in the BAG register, were justified and compatible with the Drinkwaterwet, and whether gemeenten would remove wrongly registered stacaravans by 1 December 2016. The Minister answered that the tariff matter is for the courts and Evides, that the ILT exercises system-level oversight only, that most parks gain while 36 lose, and that municipalities are responsible for cleaning the register, with monitoring ongoing.
It is now up to the court to judge whether the tariff methodology of the drinking water company is soundly argued and fair in the individual case.
Het is nu aan de rechter om te oordelen of de tariefsmethodiek van het drinkwaterbedrijf deugdelijk is beargumenteerd en rechtvaardig is in het individuele geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser inzake de staat van de bruggen (ook wel kunstwerken) in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about bridge failures in Noord-Holland, inspection and maintenance priorities, funding for bridge upkeep in the Infrastructure Fund, and the Merwedebrug. The Minister rejects the claim that maintenance has been deprioritised, describes inspection routines and flexible planning, reports how maintenance budgets were increased since 2011, and says the Merwedebrug inspection approach is under evaluation without concluding that the whole system must change.
Financial damage caused by traffic jams due to failures is unpleasant. However, this type of damage is not registered by Rijkswaterstaat and I cannot provide information on it.

Financiële schade die ontstaat door files als gevolg van storingen is vervelend. Dit type schade wordt echter niet door Rijkswaterstaat geregistreerd en ik kan hierover dat ook geen informatie aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over fraude met de WRM-bevoegdheidspas

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about fraud with WRM competence cards held by driving instructors, including whether the CBR's checks are adequate, why spot checks rather than checks on every candidate, and how many instructors have been found without a valid card. The minister answered that the CBR checks are only an extra instrument alongside police enforcement, that the ILT will take on an enforcement role under a pending bill, and that the CBR's limited checks do not allow conclusions about the scale of unlicensed teaching.
Depending on the ILT's experiences, I will take further action where necessary.
Afhankelijk van de ervaringen van de ILT zal ik zo nodig verdere acties ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de gevolgen van het sluiten van de Merwedebrug A27 voor vrachtverkeer

MPs Visser and Van Helvert asked the Minister about the closure of the Merwede bridge on the A27 to heavy traffic, its causes, traffic diversions, compensation for transport firms and repair timing. The Minister explained that fatigue in the steel main girders led to a ban on vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, that repairs were planned to allow heavier traffic again around late November or early December, that diversions and compensation procedures were in place, and that the situation was not expected to affect the broader A27 planning.
The decision not to allow traffic heavier than 3.5 tonnes was taken to safeguard the safety of (waterway) road users.
Het besluit om geen verkeer zwaarder dan 3,5 ton toe te staan is genomen om de veiligheid van (vaar)weggebruikers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het onderhoud van sloten door waterschappen

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the minister whether they share farmers' concerns about Vechtstromen water board reducing ditch maintenance and abolishing inspections, and how this fits the motion on flood prevention and the Water Framework Directive. The minister says the board is following a careful procedure with public consultation and appeal, that maintenance responsibility for the smallest waters shifts to owners, and that water-quality and flood risks are not expected to rise.
Furthermore, it applies a careful procedure in which public participation and appeal are possible.
Voorts hanteert ze daarbij, een zorgvuldige procedure waarbij inspraak en beroep mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over het beginnersrijbewijs

Two MPs from VVD and PvdA asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure about weak enforcement undermining the beginners' driving licence, including stops, points, and police capacity. The government reported few suspensions since 2011, admitted unrecorded cases and capacity gaps, and promised an improvement trajectory and an evaluation of the scheme.
As indicated in the covering letter, there is an improvement trajectory regarding the beginners' scheme and the scheme will be evaluated.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief is er een verbetertraject met betrekking tot de beginnersregeling en zal de regeling geëvalueerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over gebrek aan informatie binnen de transportsector over ‘inklimmers’ en de oproep om de 'jungle' van Calais te ontmantelen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about the transport sector's lack of information on migrants climbing into lorries at Calais ('inklimmers') and calls to dismantle the Calais 'jungle'. The State Secretary answers that information is shared with TLN through periodic consultation, that the French authorities are primarily responsible for Calais, and that the government will keep raising the issue in European and bilateral channels.
The claim that information would not be shared with TLN is not correct.
De stelling dat informatie niet met TLN zou worden gedeeld klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Veen naar aanleiding van het bericht kartelvorming Europese truckfabrikanten

MPs Visser and Van Veen asked whether the government had noted the European Commission's truck cartel fine, and how much direct and indirect subsidy went to the truck makers and Dutch operators during the cartel period. The minister confirmed awareness, listed modest direct subsidies to DAF, Scania, Volvo and Renault, and programme subsidies to operators, and said clawback was not possible because no grounds existed and the subsidy rules were not affected.
There are therefore no indications that the cartel agreements affected or violated the relevant subsidy rules.
Er zijn dan ook geen aanwijzingen dat de kartelafspraken de betreffende subsidieregels heeft geraakt dan wel heeft overtreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Visser en De Boer naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten cha

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about NS timetable changes on the Kennemerlijn, overcrowding, and complaints about chaos in regional rail from April 2016. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for the timetable, reported falling complaint numbers after extra trains were added, stated the concession terms are met, and noted NS will add Intercity and Spitsintercity stops in the 2017 timetable.
Responsibility for designing the timetable for the main rail network and consulting stakeholders such as regional governments, other operators and consumer organisations lies with NS.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen van de dienstregeling voor het hoofdrailnet en het overleg daarover met belanghebbenden als decentrale overheden, andere vervoerders en consumentenorganisaties ligt bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Visser en Bruins over het bericht ‘Drenthe naar Tweede Kamer om borden TT en Wildlands’

MPs asked why Rijkswaterstaat enforced a 1.5 million visitor threshold to deny signposting to the TT circuit and Wildlands, despite exceptions elsewhere and public investment in the access road. The minister answered that the rule is uniform for verkeersveiligheid reasons, kept the southern sign, ordered the others removed, and rejected renewed talks.
An exception is therefore made for the signpost coming from the south on the A28; that sign may remain.
Voor het verwijsbord komend uit zuidelijke richting op de A28 wordt daarom een uitzondering gemaakt; dat bord mag blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over brugstoringen in Friesland

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated breakdowns of the Skarster Rien bridges in Friesland, including their causes, prevention, whether traffic jams increased, and maintenance plans. The minister answered that there is no increase in breakdowns or traffic jams, explained the July 2016 pump failure and the inspection and maintenance regime, and noted major maintenance is scheduled for 2024.
No, there is no question of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving inzake Amerikaanse rivierkreeftjes

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the upcoming EU ban on commercial catching of American crayfish, including past subsidies, why the management plan is not yet ready, and what enforcement and transition arrangements apply for fishers. The State Secretary answers that management plans for crayfish and Chinese mitten crab are being prepared with the sector and will be adopted soon, that current fishing may continue in the meantime as the NVWA acts in line with the coming plans, and that the policy line has been published on the NVWA website.
Other authorities or organisations may provide subsidies or contributions. These are not known to me because these money flows are not registered by my ministry.
Mogelijk worden door andere overheden of organisaties subsidies of bijdragen verstrekt. Deze zijn mij niet bekend omdat deze geldstromen niet door mijn ministerie worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers, Visser, De Boer en Van Veen over het bericht ‘Nederland traag met investeren via Europa’

VVD MPs asked why the Netherlands uses relatively little EFSI investment funding, whether projects were rejected, and whether EFSI should be extended beyond 2018. The minister replied that seven Dutch EFSI transactions worth EUR 287 million have been approved, that rejections are not recorded, that the NIA was set up to help pipeline projects, and that the government will assess any extension constructively, demanding budget clarity and evaluation.
The number of rejections for EFSI is not recorded, because that may contain business-sensitive information.
Het aantal afwijzingen voor EFSI wordt niet geregistreerd, omdat dat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over het bericht ‘Miljoenenstrop door kosten aan Botlekbrug’

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister for a full account of the costs from the recurring Botlek bridge faults, borne by Rijkswaterstaat, other authorities and the contractor, and why the state pays some of them. The minister itemised costs (about 1.3 million euro for tug escorts, 1.37 million for monteurs, 37,500 for the SMS service, 24,500 for the review), said the state pays costs it chose to incur as network manager, and said repair costs fall to the contractor and that fault repairs are being finetuned.
Rijkswaterstaat has no knowledge of costs incurred by other authorities or other parties.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft geen kennis van kosten die gemaakt zijn door andere overheden of andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Aukje de Vries en Visser over de uitgave van Dagblad van het Noorden 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the navigability of the Westgat channel serving the port of Lauwersoog, whether vessels are diverting, and whether dredging or other action is justified. The minister acknowledged limited depth and possible future deepening, but argued that the situation is not urgent, that the port remains reachable, and that dredging would be costly with a low chance of payback, while offering to discuss the issue with the region.
I do not share your view that there is an urgent situation requiring action in the short term.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat hier sprake is van een urgente situatie welke noopt tot actie op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over het bericht “Docu over haatimams schokt Denen”

Two MPs asked whether foreign imams preaching hatred could also speak in Dutch mosques, what the government does to prevent incitement, and why Denmark's measures such as a watchlist and entry bans cannot be applied in the Netherlands. The minister responded that local authorities and institutions bear primary responsibility under a three-track approach, that visa-required preachers can be refused and EU alerts shared via the Schengen system, and that Denmark's measures are still being drafted so their applicability cannot yet be judged.
The Netherlands closely follows developments in Denmark and contact takes place at expert level.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Denemarken nauwgezet en op expertniveau vindt contact plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over files bij de Afsluitdijk

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their cause, the repair measures taken and a planned event closing the road. The minister reports 17 unplanned closures in the first half of 2016 versus 8 in 2015, explains the causes and additional measures, and confirms the event has been moved to 4 September with the road closed from 2:00 to 12:00.
In this period there were a total of 17 closures outside the planned obstructions.
In deze periode zijn er in totaal 17 afsluitingen buiten de geplande stremmingen geweest.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer inzake een werkbezoek aan een internationaal bedrijf dat zich richt op het ontwikkelen, ontwerpen en bouwen van schepen en materieel voor de bagger- en offshore- industri

MPs Visser and De Boer asked whether the government has policy supporting Dutch firms in international deep-sea mining, and whether a national legal framework is needed for such activities beyond national jurisdiction. The minister answers that deep-sea mining is embedded in the Topsector Water innovation agenda, that a national law is being considered through the Integraal Afwegingskader without commitment, and that Dutch influence in the International Seabed Authority does not depend on national legislation.
The preparatory process for a possible Dutch legislative process has started, in the form of applying the Integral Assessment Framework (IAK).
Het voorbereidingstraject voor het eventuele Nederlandse wetgevingsproces is gestart, in de vorm van het toepassen van het Integraal Afwegingskader (IAK).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Visser over overschrijding van geluidsnormen op de A8 bij Zaanstad

MPs Smaling (SP) and Visser (VVD) asked whether noise and air-quality limits are exceeded along the A8 near Zaanstad, residents' concerns, screen adequacy, traffic and modelling methods. The minister answers that legal noise production ceilings are not exceeded, air quality meets limits, screens are adequate, and a Schinkelbrug-based noise measure study will be checked for the Coenbrug, with several technical follow-ups.

Although the noise production ceilings are not exceeded, I have committed to examining whether the measures proposed from the noise reduction study on the comparable Schinkelbrug are also applicable to the Coenbrug.

Hoewel de geluidsproductieplafonds niet overschreden worden, heb ik toegezegd om te onderzoeken of de maatregelen die aangedragen worden uit het onderzoek naar geluidsreductie aan de – vergelijkbare – Schinkelbrug, ook toepasbaar zijn voor de Coenbrug
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over aanhoudende problemen met de Botlekbrug en de Spijkenisserbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked about repeated breakdowns of the Botlek bridge and the Spijkenisser bridge, including whether design faults exist and why Rijkswaterstaat cannot recover detour costs from contractor A-Lanes. The minister answered that the bridge was built as contracted, contractual penalties apply but detour damage cannot be recovered, Rijkswaterstaat has spent about 2.7 million euros on mitigation, and the integral analysis and design decision are due in autumn 2016.
Detour damage, however, cannot be recovered from the contractor on the basis of the contract.
Omrijschade kan op basis van het contract echter niet op de opdrachtnemer worden verhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht 'Nederlandse overheid wil meer visgebied sluiten dan nodig van Europa'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Dutch government wants to close more fishing ground than EU law requires on the Frisian Front and Central Oyster Grounds, and what the consequences are for the Dutch fleet. The government replies that the measures serve the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, that the economic impact on fisheries is limited (under 1% of yearly catch value), and promises to send a letter on the outcomes of the 10 May meeting.
I disagree with the claim that the Dutch government wants to close more fishing ground than necessary.
Ik ben het niet eens met de stelling dat de Nederlandse overheid meer visgebied wil sluiten dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Lodders en Veldman over de berichtgeving over de Nijkerkerbrug

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the one-year delay in renovating the Nijkerkerbrug, why the experimental tender approach was kept despite an agreement to revert to the classic method, the safety and economic consequences, and whether the renovation will be sped up. The Minister attributes the delay to technical and procedural risks and the new market-oriented tender approach, says the temporary safety and weight-limit measures are in place, and promises to explore partial recovery of the delay when the contract is awarded in spring 2017.
I have chosen to put the Nijkerkerbrug on the market in a different way, in a form suited to the recently presented Market Vision.
Ik heb ervoor gekozen om de Nijkerkerbrug op een andere manier op de markt te zetten, in een vorm passend bij de onlangs gepresenteerde Marktvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving inzake halvering van het aantal flitspalen

An MP asks why the number of speed cameras (flitspalen) in the Netherlands has halved, whether this reduces road safety, and how placement and removal decisions are made. The minister explains that placement follows the Openbaar Ministerie policy framework, that the number fell mainly because analogue cameras were replaced by digital ones (642 suitable locations identified), and that digital cameras enforce around the clock, so enforcement has in fact increased.
I do not have the precise number of speed cameras that were actively enforcing in 2011.
Het precieze aantal van het aantal flitspalen dat in 2011 in handhaving stond heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Bosman over de berichtgeving over het Vlaamse voornemen om tol te heffen op personenauto’s

MPs Visser and Bosman asked the minister about Flemish plans to levy road tolls on passenger cars, Belgian truck tolls, the Eurovignette, and German car tolls. The minister said there are no concrete Flemish plans yet, that discrimination is not allowed under EU law, that Flemish roads are a Flemish responsibility, and that she will raise kilometre charging with her Flemish counterpart.
At my next meeting with Minister Weyts, which is not yet scheduled, I will certainly put the kilometre charge on the agenda.
Ik zal bij het eerstkomend gesprek met Minister Weyts, dat nog niet gepland is, zeker het onderwerp kilometerheffing agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert en Visser over het besluit om het alcoholslot op te heffen

MPs Van Helvert (CDA) and Visser (VVD) asked why the government abolished the alcohol interlock programme (ASP) after court rulings, questioning its cost, recidivism effects and whether alternatives were examined. The minister defended the abolition on cost and legal grounds, saying the programme could not be kept in administrative law and would add little in criminal law, while pointing to other measures and pending WODC research.

Weighing everything, we conclude that placing the ASP in criminal law offers too little added value beside existing instruments to tackle drink-driving, and that it is therefore not expedient to maintain the ASP.

Alles afwegende komen wij tot de conclusie dat het onderbrengen van het ASP in het strafrecht te weinig meerwaarde biedt naast het bestaande instrumentarium om rijden onder invloed aan te pakken en dat het derhalve niet opportuun is om het ASP in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de bestuursrechtelijke uitspraak inzake de Utrechtse milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the government to respond to a court ruling that found the Utrecht environmental zone decision insufficiently reasoned, questioning the proportionality of environmental zones for passenger cars and the evidence on their air-quality effects. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible for such zones, that the ruling leaves the zone in force, that the proposed extension to passenger cars would be dropped in line with a motion, and that effects and alternatives are for the municipality to assess, with an evaluation expected.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposal to extend the environmental zone sign to passenger cars will be removed from this planned amendment.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit deze voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, De Boer en Visser over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten chaos in het (openbaar) vervoer in Noord-Kennemerland vanaf

Three VVD MPs asked the government about NS's 2017 timetable request for Noord-Kennemerland, the planned Velsertunnel closure and the risk of rail and road disruption and overcrowding in the region. The State Secretary answered that NS will adopt some stopping changes at Heiloo and Castricum, that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat has a mitigation plan, and that NS is monitoring capacity without having quantified combined economic impacts.
The timetable is the responsibility and expertise of NS.
De dienstregeling is de verantwoordelijkheid en deskundigheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de uitwerking van de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte (SVIR) voor de bereikbaarheid van Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, in 14 questions, how the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte (SVIR) is being implemented for national accessibility, covering congestion, road widths, separation of through and local traffic, financing, real-time travel information and the Infrastructure Fund extension. The Minister answered that investments are proceeding within limited budgets, that some 2x4 and 2x3 targets are conditional on demonstrated need, that further studies are under way, and that she expects to inform parliament about the Infrastructure Fund extension on Prinsjesdag.
I therefore expect to be able to inform you on Prinsjesdag about the elaboration of the Harbers motion.
Ik verwacht u dan ook bij Prinsjesdag te kunnen informeren over de uitwerking van de motie Harbers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over verzakkingen rond de A4

An MP asked the minister about subsidence near the A4 motorway, including criticism that Rijkswaterstaat dismissed risks to houses and pressured the water board. The minister rejected that criticism, said subsidence is not caused by groundwater extraction, and described a monitoring and reinjection plan reported to the water board and municipality.
Rijkswaterstaat does not conduct research into possible other causes.
Rijkswaterstaat doet geen onderzoek naar mogelijke andere oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Visser en De Boer over het bericht ‘Naar een duurzame energiehuishouding met LNG’ in het NEN magazine van februari 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article on building an EU-wide LNG refuelling network, who is responsible for it, who pays, and how the Netherlands can use LNG opportunities. The minister answered that the market should build alternative fuel stations with government setting conditions, that the Netherlands supports the internal energy market, and that various LNG safety, Green Deal and promotion efforts are underway.
In principle the market is responsible for realising the networks of alternative fuel and charging stations.
In principe is de markt aan zet om de netwerken van alternatieve tank- en laadstations te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat te hard rijden in Frankrijk je een rijverbod kan opleveren en antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake geflitste buitenlandse bestuurders

An MP asks whether French points-based licence penalties for speeding would affect Dutch drivers, and asks follow-up questions on enforcement of cross-border traffic fines, parking fee collection and access to flash photos. The minister answers that the French system only applies to CBE offences, does not strip Dutch licences, and that enforcement gaps and data retention questions are being addressed through technical changes and ongoing procedures.
The system does not infringe on the Netherlands' competence to conduct road safety policy for its own territory.
Het systeem maakt geen inbreuk op de bevoegdheid van Nederland om een verkeersveiligheidsbeleid voor het eigen grondgebied te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de koppositie van Nederland in transportcriminaliteit

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the Netherlands' leading position in cargo theft, citing a TAPA report showing high figures and falling reporting willingness. The Minister answered that police figures show a 20 percent drop in cargo theft from 2014 to 2015, explained differences with TAPA's methodology, outlined reporting facilitation, enforcement cooperation, secured truck parking efforts and cross-border cooperation, while defending ANPR camera use.
Based on the reported figures for 2014 and 2015, it can be stated that the number of cargo thefts in the Netherlands has decreased by 20 percent.
Afgaande op de aangiftecijfers van 2014 en 2015 kan worden gesteld dat het aantal ladingdiefstallen in Nederland met 20 procent is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’

Two MPs asked the minister whether raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h complies with environmental and safety norms, and questioned RIVM and TNO statements on air quality. The minister answered that the speed increases were tested against safety and environmental conditions, that monitoring shows no norm exceedances after the increase, and that the RIVM and TNO statements do not contradict the NSL 2015 report.
The speed increases of 5 February were – as with previous speed increases – tested against safety and environmental preconditions.
De snelheidsverhogingen van 5 februari zijn – evenals voorgaande snelheidsverhogingen – getoetst aan randvoorwaarden van veiligheid en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving omtrent louche rijscholen die frauderen met theorie-examens

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that driving schools use tricks to help tens of thousands of candidates pass theory exams fraudulently, including whether candidates can be made to retake, how exams leak, and whether driving schools can be excluded. The minister answered that no overview exists, that the CBR has taken many anti-fraud measures and can cancel contracts with schools, that fraud is reported to police, and that quality standards for instructors will be tightened.
There is no overview of how candidates completed their training.
Er bestaat geen overzicht van de wijze waarop kandidaten hun opleiding hebben gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van lid Visser over het lakse beheer van verkeerslichten

Visser (VVD) asks whether the minister will act on a survey showing lax traffic light management by road managers and whether CROW guidelines bind municipalities and provinces. The minister says the survey draws no conclusions, that CROW guidelines are not binding and municipalities cannot be held to them, and that she will only remind local authorities of the benefits of good management.
I cannot hold provinces and municipalities to account for that.
Ik kan provincies en gemeenten daar niet op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser inzake spitsstroken

An MP asked the minister about peak-hour lanes: the top ten most-used lanes in 2015, whether they become permanent lanes, a stricter opening regime, safety and aggressive driving, driver awareness of the rules, and risky manoeuvres. The minister listed the top ten, said most will get or are being prepared for permanent measures, announced a follow-up study on the opening regime with first changes expected in Q2, and answered the safety questions mostly by pointing to existing reports and general campaigns.
The follow-up study into further improvement options for the opening regime, which I promised, has been started.
Antwoord 4 Het door mij toegezegde 1 vervolgonderzoek naar verdere verbetermogelijkheden van het openingsregime is in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over de controle op de aanlandplicht

MPs Visser, Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a confrontation between Dutch North Sea fishers and German inspectors over the landing obligation and reported widespread ignorance among inspectors. The State Secretary replied that German protocols matched EU rules, that Germany acted quickly, and that harmonisation of enforcement across North Sea states is ongoing but slow.
I have asked the other North Sea member states to share their inspection instructions more widely with one another.
Ik heb de andere lidstaten rondom de Noordzee verzocht om de controle-instructies breder met elkaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de aanpak van de N35, naar aanleiding van haar werkbezoek aan de gemeenten Raalte en Hellendoorn

An MP asked the minister about the N35 road upgrade, the Bos crossroads, traffic growth, the 2x2 widening and safety measures at Wijthmen-Nijverdal. The minister answered that the province's request for extra funding was declined, traffic monitoring and forecasts are in place, and the safety measures will be realised by 2018 after a participation process.
The administrative agreement stipulates that the measures will be realised by 2018 at the latest.
In de bestuursovereenkomst is afgesproken dat de maatregelen uiterlijk 2018 worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Garnalenvisser in clinch met overheid’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that a shrimp fisher faces restrictions because his environmentally friendly catch method conflicts with current rules, and what the government will do to help him. The State Secretary said the company's exemption request was incomplete and is being assessed, that innovation will be accommodated where possible, but that an exemption requires careful analysis and may be limited by directly applicable EU rules.
Of course I want to offer room for meaningful innovations. We are studying the request and will give room for it where possible.
Uiteraard wil ik zinvolle innovaties ruimte bieden. We bestuderen het verzoek en zullen als het mogelijk is daartoe ruimte geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over minder toezicht op de veiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether oversight of aviation safety in the Netherlands has been reduced and whether defects are under-reported, citing an AEI executive and an EASA report. The state secretary rejected claims of reduced oversight, said inspections found no elevated risk, and pointed to the Basic Regulation proposal, promising a BNC-fiche.
I do not recognise the claim that governments are increasingly withdrawing and no longer have a good overview, at the expense of safety.
Ik herken me niet in de uitspraak dat overheden zich steeds meer terug trekken en geen goed overzicht meer hebben ten koste van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt onkruidmiddel dat slecht is voor water’

MPs Lodders and Visser asked why Rijkswaterstaat may use glyphosate-based weedkiller (Roundup) on tree stumps in hydraulic structures when the planned pesticide ban would apply to everyone else, and what alternatives were considered. The minister answered that glyphosate remains legally permitted, that a planned exception for situations without feasible alternatives will be written into a ministerial regulation, and that the same rules will apply to all parties including Rijkswaterstaat.
Rijkswaterstaat uses plant protection products for stumps in hydraulic structures only when no feasible alternatives exist.
Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt alleen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor stobben in waterbouwkundige constructies als er geen uitvoerbare alternatieven zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland inzake storingen Botlekbrug

MPs Visser and Hoogland asked about recurring malfunctions of the Botlek bridge since its July 2015 opening, including costs to businesses, causes, a review team, diversion of hazardous goods traffic, and whether pressure from Rijkswaterstaat contributed to premature opening. The minister answered that the faults are being fixed and a review is underway, but declined to hold the contractor financially liable and said no commitments on hazardous goods exemptions had been made.
Rijkswaterstaat cannot hold A-Lanes liable for compensating the costs resulting from the detours.
Rijkswaterstaat kan A-Lanes niet aanspreken op het vergoeden van de kosten ten gevolge van het omrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Hoogland en Visser over onnodige files als gevolg van tunneldoseren

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister whether tunnel metering (tunneldosering) causes unnecessary traffic jams, citing VID findings, and asked about its purpose, effectiveness, use in new tunnels, and communication to drivers. The minister maintained that metering prevents jams inside tunnels, admitted uncertainty about side effects, and committed to further research into the effects on traffic flow.
Because doubts remain in the media and among road users about the effect of tunnel metering on traffic flow (a side effect), I am however willing to investigate this further.

Omdat er in de media en bij weggebruikers twijfels blijven bestaan over het effect van tunneldoseren op de verkeersdoorstroming (een neveneffect) ben ik echter wel bereid dit nog nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat steun voor KLM schadelijk is voor Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands is undermining a common EU front on Gulf aviation by refusing landing rights, whether Emirates' second A380 is compatible with the bilateral agreement, and about Schiphol's reward programme and cross-national regulation. The secretary answered that the second A380 was approved as a modest capacity increase under the liberal 1990 agreement, that Schiphol's reward programme is open to all airlines and its cost is confidential, and that Dutch policy follows an EU-coordinated approach via a pending Commission mandate.
The financial scope of this programme is classified by Schiphol as commercially confidential.
De financiële omvang van dit programma wordt door Schiphol als bedrijfsvertrouwelijk aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de voorgenomen proef met een peilverhoging in het Lauwersmeer

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a planned two-year trial raising the water level at Lauwersmeer, including risks to residents, entrepreneurs and its role as a water storage area, and compensation for damage. The minister answered that the trial follows from the Natura 2000 management plan, stays within existing safety margins and is subordinate to water safety, that the matter is regional competence to be raised with the province, and that damage claims can be made under provincial compensation schemes.
I will forward the concerns and questions you have to the province of Groningen.
Ik zal de zorgen en vragen die u heeft aan de provincie Groningen doorgeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het bericht ‘Uitleg over de discardban’

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fishing-sector uncertainty over the landing obligation (discard ban) from 1 January 2016 and about NVWA statements that it would not disclose enforcement strategy in advance. The State Secretary replied that a step-by-step plan and information sessions provide clarity, that the NVWA's enforcement details are not disclosed in advance as usual, and that the NVWA engages constructively with the sector.
It is not customary to provide information about this in advance.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat hierover vooraf informatie wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over verkeersboetes in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that traffic fines raised in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were unlawfully high, and what follow-up steps and a new fine system would involve. The minister said the ruling has no wider effect on fines already imposed, that the Public Prosecution Service will not appeal in the interest of the law, and that the motion on a progressive fine system continues with information promised before the Christmas recess.
The Arnhem sub-district court ruling has no wider effect and does not directly affect traffic fines already imposed.
De uitspraak van de kantonrechter Arnhem heeft geen bredere werking en is niet direct van invloed op eerder opgelegde verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over grote hoeveelheden lekkend grondwater aan de aangelegde A4

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about groundwater leakage at the newly built A4 Midden-Delfland road, its effect on the planned opening, responsibility for errors, and information for residents. The minister answers that the water board decision is expected mid-December, that the contractor is responsible for design and construction, and that the full answers to the questions could not be provided in time.
It was known at the design stage that the walls of the sunken section would be somewhat permeable.
Het was bekend bij het ontwerp dat de wanden van de verdiepte ligging enigszins doorlatend zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een geflitste buitenlandse bestuurder vaak vrijuit gaat

MPs Visser (VVD) asked follow-up questions on foreign drivers escaping fines for traffic offences, including EU CBE directive enforcement, French blockades, and collection of parking and traffic fines from non-Dutch plate holders. The minister answered that enforcement and collection depend on directive implementation, bilateral treaties and technical adaptations, that some collection routes are working while others (Belgium, France, other EU states) are not yet effective, and that a law amendment is planned by year-end.
We aim to bring a proposal amending the Act on mutual recognition of financial sanctions into procedure by the end of the year.
Wij streven er naar voor het einde van het jaar een voorstel tot aanpassing van Wet wederzijdse erkenning van geldelijke sancties en beslissingen tot confiscatie in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over berichten in de media dat buitenlandse verkeersovertreders de dans ontspringen

A Dutch MP asks why photos of traffic offences by foreign-plated vehicles were destroyed and whether foreign offenders escape fines, and asks about research access and road safety. The minister explains that fines are issued to foreign drivers caught at the roadside, that digital enforcement fines are not yet sent to most foreign plate holders pending EU cross-border agreements, that the photos contain personal data under privacy rules and the law will not be changed, and that the government has not committed to new research access beyond the data's availability.
The flash photos contain privacy-sensitive data to which privacy legislation applies.
De flitsfoto’s bevatten privacy gevoelige gegevens, waarop privacy wetgeving van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries inzake Franse verhuizing Transavia

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked whether Transavia Nederland would sell its 40% stake in Transavia France and whether governance changes would weaken KLM's independence and Schiphol's hub role. The government answered that talks between the companies are ongoing, that no formal Dutch or French government role exists, and that it stressed KLM's independent position and Schiphol's network quality.
No definitive answer can yet be given on changes to Transavia Nederland's governance structure, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A2 en de inwerkingtreding van de PAS (Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof) per 1 juli aanstaande

An MP asked whether the speed limit on the A2, including the Holendrecht-Vinkeveen stretch, can be raised to 130 km/h now that the PAS nitrogen programme takes effect, and for a list of eligible stretches. The minister said most of the A2 may later be raised as air quality and noise ceilings allow, that a court ruling on Vinkeveen-Maarsen is awaited, and that a draft decree for speed increases on several stretches was published.
I will inform the House about this this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hierover dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over trajectcontroles en boeteregen op de A2

An MP asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister why the A2 tops speeding-fine lists, whether speed limits on the A2 and A4 should rise to 130 km/h, and for an overview of section speed checks and their safety rationale. The minister answered that the A2's high traffic volume explains the fines, that limits below 130 km/h rest on air quality, noise or safety grounds, and that studies on raising limits on the A2 and A4 will be sent to parliament.
This year I expect to be able to inform you of the outcomes for the A2, and in the first half of 2016 about the options for the A4.
Nog dit jaar verwacht ik u te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de A2 en in de eerste helft van 2016 over de mogelijkheden op de A4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over overlast onderhoud Afsluitdijk

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about traffic nuisance, accidents and queues caused by maintenance on the Afsluitdijk, including the coordination of bridge and lock operations. The minister answered in detail, describing the works, the accident audit and extra signage, and the information given to road and shipping users, but did not concede that the works had caused a clear rise in accidents or offer structural changes.
Based on current insights, I note that on the carriageway from Den Oever to Kornwerderzand, from 3 km before the works up to the works on the bridge, the number of accidents has increased.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten constateer ik dat op de rijbaan van Den Oever naar Kornwerderzand van 3 km voor de werkzaamheden tot aan de werkzaamheden op de brug het aantal ongevallen is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over boeteregen op spitsstroken

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that speed-limit camera fines on hard-shoulder lanes opened as peak-hour lanes were rising, and whether the rules on opening such lanes are clear and how many fines are issued when they open. The Minister answered that the rules are clear, that the cited police figures are too limited to show more violations when lanes are open, and that the ministry does not record whether a lane was open when a fine was issued, so it would not provide that breakdown.
When recording violations, it is not tracked whether a plus or peak-hour lane is open.
Bij de registratie van overtredingen wordt niet bijgehouden of een plus- of spitsstrook open is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over vertraging van de aanpak van de verkeersveiligheid op de N35

MPs Visser (VVD) and Hoogland (PvdA) asked why improvements to road safety on the N35 between Wijthmen and Nijverdal are delayed, whether Rijkswaterstaat is blocking local 'Raalte mobiel' initiatives, and what the planning is. The minister admitted a delay caused by limited staffing of the project team, said work is expected to start in December with a participation process and reprioritisation, and insisted the 2018 realisation target and the 2014 administrative agreement still stand.
It is correct that a delay has arisen in the start of the elaboration of the measures from the administrative agreement.
Het klopt dat vertraging is ontstaan in de start van de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit de bestuursovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker kritisch over aanlandplicht’

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a Flemish researcher's finding that the EU landing obligation (aanlandplicht) may harm seabirds and scavengers and young fish, and what the government will do with it. The state secretary said the study cannot yet quantify the effects, that monitoring is under way, and that exemptions for high-survival species are being piloted and sought in regional discard plans.
Monitoring will be needed to detect any changes.
Monitoring zal nodig zijn om eventuele veranderingen te constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het rapport van het PBL en ECN

An MP from the VVD asks the minister about a PBL/ECN quick scan of possible additional emission-reduction measures for the Urgenda climate case, including transport charges such as road pricing, an car-free Sunday and the 130 km/h motorway limit. The minister replies that the scan is a technical estimate without social cost or political feasibility analysis, that most measures are not government policy, that the cabinet does not choose road pricing, and that no further burden analysis is planned.
The PBL itself states in this quick scan that it did not take into account, among other things, (indirect) social costs of the measures, such as welfare loss.
Het PBL geeft zelf in deze quickscan aan geen rekening te hebben gehouden met o.a. (indirecte) maatschappelijke kosten van de maatregelen, zoals welvaartsverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over “de manipulatie van modellen aangaande luchtkwaliteit”

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary whether Utrecht officials manipulating local air-quality traffic data, and the lack of local discretion over national models, undermine NSL air-quality reporting and measures such as milieuzones. The State Secretary answered that statutory models are fixed by the Regeling beoordeling luchtkwaliteit 2007 and managed by RIVM, that municipalities only supply traffic inputs which RIVM audits annually by sampling, and that no concerns about Utrecht's data were found.
To ensure the quality of the inputs, RIVM, on behalf of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, annually checks the quality of the input data used in NSL monitoring on a sample basis.

Om de kwaliteit van de invoer te borgen controleert het RIVM, in opdracht van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu, jaarlijks steekproefsgewijs de kwaliteit van de invoergegevens die gebruikt worden in de NSL-monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving dat Rotterdam tegen de huidige plannen voor de A13/A16 is

An MP asked the minister about reports that Rotterdam opposes the current A13/A16 road plans, including claims of the least funding and a failed participation process. The minister rejected that characterisation, said the participation trajectory was carried out with regional partners, and described the funding of extra-legal measures as the regions' responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens, mede naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan Calais

MPs Visser and Azmani asked the government about stowaways hiding in lorries near Calais, the damage to Dutch transport, and whether France and the UK enforce EU asylum and immigration rules. The government answered that the damage is evident, that a meeting with French authorities and TLN is postponed to autumn, that extra Franco-British measures and joint enforcement commitments were agreed, and that it will raise secondary migration with France.
In my meeting with the French authorities this autumn I will raise attention to combating secondary illegal migration flows.
In mijn gesprek met de Franse autoriteiten dit najaar zal ik aandacht vragen voor de bestrijding van secundaire illegale migratiestromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over borden ter verduidelijking van de milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked whether Rijkswaterstaat would display milieuzone information on motorway matrix signs and who should bear the cost of signage for local low-emission zones. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat has no such plans, that informing drivers about local zones is a municipal task, and that the existing legal framework does not allow permanent signs on motorways, pointing instead to personalised navigation information.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore inform the municipality of Utrecht that no fixed signs with milieuzone information may be placed along the motorways.
Rijkswaterstaat zal de gemeente Utrecht dan ook melden dat er geen vaste borden, met informatie over de milieuzone, langs de snelwegen geplaatst mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders inzake schade door waterplanten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about waterplant obstructions on the Zuidelijke Randmeren, including a rescue boat hampered during a storm, and whether incidents are tracked and what maintenance responsibilities apply. The Minister confirmed the incidents, reported 9 waterplant-related incidents nationally in 2012-2014 (2 significant), said safety comes first and fairway maintenance is Rijkswaterstaat's responsibility while other maintenance lies with third parties, and committed to monitoring developments without further inquiry.
Given the low number of significant accidents and the fact that shipping routes are regularly available, I see no reason to make further inquiries.
Gezien het lage aantal significante ongevallen en het feit dat de scheepvaartroutes regulier beschikbaar zijn zie ik geen aanleiding hier verdere navraag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over storingen aan de Botlekbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister about repeated malfunctions of the new Botlek bridge since its opening, including traffic impact, the adequacy of Rijkswaterstaat's testing, cost responsibility under the DBFM contract, and the division of responsibilities. The minister acknowledged 18 malfunctions were too many, defended RWS's handling and testing as adequate, stated that the contractor bears repair costs and that no design errors were found, and announced corrective measures and a further evaluation of the testing process.
RWS has no insight into the costs incurred, because these are for the account of the contractor.
RWS heeft geen inzicht in de gemaakte kosten, omdat deze voor rekening van de opdrachtnemer zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het verschuiven van langeafstandsvluchten van Air France KLM van Schiphol naar Parijs Charles de Gaulle

An MP asked the state secretary whether Air France KLM is shifting long-haul flights from Schiphol to Paris Charles de Gaulle and how the balance between the two hubs is secured under state guarantees. The government answered that the data show Schiphol's network growing faster, that intercontinental flights from both hubs rose in 2014-2015, that future plans are confidential, and that the state could refer disputes to the State Assurances Committee, which has never been needed.
Such information is commercially confidential, and moreover the flight offering will be continually adjusted to concrete market developments and to the company Air France KLM.
Dergelijke informatie heeft een bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter en bovendien zal het vluchtaanbod voortdurend worden aangepast aan concrete ontwikkelingen in de markt en de onderneming Air France KLM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser inzake berichtgeving over “monsterfile” op de A2 door ongeval bij Everdingen

An MP asked whether Rijkswaterstaat creates artificial traffic jams through tunnel metering (tunneldosering) on the A2 at Utrecht, and about its legal basis, costs and alternatives. The minister answered that metering only shifts existing queues out of the tunnel, that it rests on administrative agreements rather than the 2013 tunnel safety law, and that she sees no urgent reason to revise them, while promising better public communication about the measure.
Options are being examined to improve traffic flow on the connecting road network.
Er wordt gekeken naar mogelijkheden om de doorstroming op het aansluitende wegennet te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser naar aanleiding van de acties van de Franse boeren

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked ministers about French farmers' blockades that disrupted Dutch transport, the lack of French police action, damages, state aid and whether Dutch inspections could allow derogations from driving-time rules. The government condemned the actions, protested to France and the Commission, said damages are a civil matter, and said it would raise the issue at the 7 September Agriculture Council.
We condemn these actions. Like the Spanish government, the Netherlands has also protested.
Wij keuren deze acties af. Net als de Spaanse regering heeft ook Nederland geprotesteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about drivers being fined in the UK for stowaways found in their trucks and about the Calais migrant problem, including whether Dutch drivers are penalised twice for rest-time violations caused by queues. The minister answered that the UK fines follow the Code of Practice, the number of affected Dutch drivers is unknown, EU rest-time rules leave room for exceptional situations, the government has raised the issue with the Commission and UK/French counterparts, and it has intensified border controls and consulted the transport sector.
The number of (possibly) affected Dutch drivers in 2014 and 2015 is not known.
Het aantal (mogelijke) Nederlandse gedupeerde chauffeurs in 2014 en 2015 is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Visser over diverse berichten in de media de afgelopen maanden omtrent het innen van financiële sancties
