MPs Van Oosten and Visser asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about media reports on collecting financial penalties, including payment arrangements, detention orders, and enforcement measures such as vehicle impoundment and licence seizure. The State Secretary answered that all penalties must be collected, outlined existing payment and enforcement instruments with statistics, and announced an interim payment-instalment measure, a follow-up study on coercive instruments, and administrative improvements.
The starting point is and remains that all financial penalties must be paid in full.
Het uitgangspunt is en blijft dat alle financiële sancties geheel moeten worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Tellegen en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Verkeershufters worden minder vaak gepakt”

Three VVD MPs asked whether speed trajectory controls are justified for environmental goals (CO2, fine dust, noise) and how their boetes and effects are documented, given reports that traffic offenders are caught less often. The minister answered that the purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the posted speed limit, that environmental and safety considerations shape the limits themselves, and gave a fine table for 2010–2014 and noise-cost figures.
The purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the applicable speed limit.
Het doel van trajectcontroles is naleving van de geldende snelheidslimiet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Visser en De Boer over het bericht «Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen»

Three VVD MPs asked why the hydrogen bus pilot in Amsterdam would not be repeated, what it contributed, how zero-emission buses fit climate policy, whether returning the buses after three years was a sound use of public money, and whether the project goals were SMART. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot served as an alpha test that led a bus manufacturer to invest in hydrogen buses, that the new subsidy projects continue in five regions, and that selection criteria and reporting obligations apply.
Na afloop wordt de regeling geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over meer risico’s voor de staat bij het megaproject Zuidas

The VVD MP Visser asks whether the government's new risk allocation and minimum price for the Zuidasdok megaproject shifts more risk onto the state, and whether it reduces competition and is a precedent for other projects. The minister replies that the risk split is standard for D&C contracts, the minimum price is project-specific and only applies to Zuidasdok, and competition is adequate though only two consortia bid.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining, partly based on experience with Zuidasdok, whether this method can be applied more often.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt – mede op basis van de ervaringen bij Zuidasdok – of deze methode vaker toegepast kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de slechte samenwerking bij grote infrastructuurprojecten

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about poor cooperation on large infrastructure projects, citing five criticisms in a NRC article and asking what steps will be taken and what happens to ongoing projects and DBFM contracts. The Minister responds that Rijkswaterstaat is in ongoing dialogue with the construction sector, addresses each criticism (project size, risk allocation, tender costs, relations, low bids), and says changes to ongoing tenders will be considered carefully, though no concrete new commitments are made.
Rijkswaterstaat is continuously in discussion with the construction sector about all aspects of projects and tendering.
Rijkswaterstaat is voortdurend in gesprek met de bouwsector over alle aspecten van projecten en aanbesteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema over de beantwoording in mijn brief van 3 maart 2015 van eerdere vragen over oversteekplaatsen voor otters

MPs Visser and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about measures, costs, targets and monitoring for otter crossings following a court ruling requiring 21 urgent road-otter conflict points to be resolved by 1 May 2017. The government answered that seven urgent points are being prepared, that Rijkswaterstaat budgets €665,000 for four of them, that the 79 potential hotspots carry no court-imposed deadline, and that the population target is a sustainable size defined by a 5% extinction risk over 100 years.
In the run-up to 1 May 2016 and 1 May 2017, when the 14 remaining points must be resolved, I expect to be able to inform you further about my consultations with the provinces.
Ik verwacht u in de aanloop naar de datum van 1 mei 2016, respectievelijk 1 mei 2017 waarop de 14 knelpunten opgelost moeten zijn, nader te kunnen informeren over mijn overleg met de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam en over het bericht dat Utrechtse lucht beter is

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether expanding municipal environmental zones (Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam) is justified given Utrecht's improved air quality, cost-effectiveness, and the Rijk's role in subsidies and a vehicle replacement scheme. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on and must demonstrate the cost-effectiveness of zones, the Rijk funds a subsidy scheme for van replacement in neighbouring municipalities, and an action plan is pending.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone for certain vehicle categories is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone voor bepaalde categorieën voertuigen een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Met twintig camera's loeren op vieze auto's’, ‘Al bijna tweeduizend vieze auto's verwerkt tot schroot’ en ‘Cameratoezicht voor milieuzone Arnhem

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked about camera enforcement of low-emission zones in Arnhem and Utrecht, the cost of cameras, privacy of plate data, and the higher fine. The state secretary answered that the zones and their justification are municipal responsibilities, that the fine follows standard Public Prosecution tariffs with a heavier sanction for the zone, and that a Utrecht NO2 exceedance is expected to be resolved by new calculations.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de terugkeer van files op de verbrede en deels verdiepte A4

An MP asked the minister why congestion on the widened A4 near Leiden has returned to the top-10 list, whether accidents and jams are being monitored, and what short-term fixes are planned. The minister attributes the return mainly to high traffic on a busy Randstad route and recent resolution of other bottlenecks, reports a sharp fall in congestion after widening, announces continued monitoring and an investigation into small-scale measures expected by autumn, and points to the Rijnlandroute for a longer-term improvement.
I am having research carried out into whether an improvement in traffic flow on this road section is possible in the short term through small-scale layout and utilisation measures.
Ik laat nog onderzoeken of een verbetering van de doorstroming op dit wegdeel met kleinschalige inrichtings- en benuttingsmaatregelen op korte termijn mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichten “Met keien vissers pesten”, “Een kei op zijn kop moet de zeenaaktslak beschermen” en “Aangifte tegen Greenpeace om zwerfkeien in zee”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether she condemns Greenpeace's dumping of stones in the Klaverbank area, whether it endangers fishers, whether damages will be recovered, and the timetable for designating the Klaverbank as a Natura 2000 site. The State Secretary condemned the action, said no damage to government is yet established, and gave the expected timeline for the designation decision.
Once that is completed, I will, in accordance with Article 10a(6) of the Nature Conservation Act 1998, submit the draft decisions to the House of Representatives and the Senate.
Zodra dat is afgerond zal ik, conform artikel 10a lid 6 van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998, de ontwerpen van de besluiten voorhangen bij uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Stop met vissen in de Waddenzee”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a newspaper article calling for an end to fishing in the Wadden Sea, including whether that view fits the Rijke Waddenzee programme. The state secretary answered that fish stock trends show decline since the 1980s with causes still unclear, that sustainable fishing fits the Wadden Sea, and that fishers can add value, with measures being pursued via a fisheries strategy and existing agreements.
Through the development of a fisheries strategy, more insight should be gained into the necessary (trilateral) studies to fill the knowledge gaps.
Via de ontwikkeling van een visstrategie moet er meer zicht komen op de benodigde (trilaterale) onderzoeken om de kennislacunes op te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht “Stad is klaar met tunnelmalaise”

MPs Visser and De Boer asked about reports of frequent tunnel closures at the Coentunnel and Schipholtunnel caused by overheight trucks, fire alarms and power failures, and their economic cost. The minister confirms 25 to 30 weekly overheight stoppages at the Coentunnel, lists six Schiphol tunnel disruptions in Q1 2015, says no damage cost estimate exists, and promises intensified monitoring and further study.
For this reason I will intensify the monitoring of the closures at the Coentunnel.
Om deze reden zal ik de monitoring van de stremmingen bij de Coentunnel intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Mei Li Vos, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de situatie bij Air France-KLM

MPs from the PvdA and VVD asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the French state's increase of its stake in Air France-KLM, its double voting rights, possible break-up or sale of KLM, governance changes and Qatar landing rights. The minister replied that the French stake increase is not a fundamental shift, no agreement exists on joint share purchases, no break-up is on the agenda, and the reports of a 'plan B' sale are unsubstantiated speculation.
I have no indication whatsoever that such a plan B is on the agenda.
Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat een dergelijk plan B aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Visser en Leenders over de berichtgeving inzake Qatar Airways

MPs Visser and Leenders asked the Staatssecretaris whether he knew of the Qatar Airways CEO's threat to block Dutch firms' contracts in Qatar over landing rights, whether the CEO contacted him, what he would do, and whether he shares EVO's concern that the landing-rights freeze harms the Netherlands as a distribution country. The Staatssecretaris answered that he was not approached, that Dutch policy does not specifically target Gulf carriers, that Qatar was informed, and that talks with EVO and a Seabury study on air cargo are ongoing, without committing to new legal changes.
I have not been approached by Mr Al Baker.
Ik ben niet benaderd door de heer Al Baker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een geflitste buitenlandse bestuurder vaak vrijuit gaat

An MP asked the government whether EU member states have implemented the cross-border vehicle registration directive, how foreign-plated drivers can be fined and collected from, and what a 2014 Raad van State ruling means for enforcement. The minister answered that enforcement against foreign plates is not yet fully operational because IT and procedural changes are needed, that the Raad van State ruling requires changes to the collection framework, and that private collection use is possible but limited.

To be able to fine vehicle holders from countries other than the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France and Switzerland, the systems and processes in the enforcement and execution chain must be adapted.

Om kentekenhouders uit de andere landen dan Nederland, België, Duitsland, Frankrijk en Zwitserland te kunnen beboeten, dienen de systemen en processen in de handhaving- en executieketen te worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht “bodemvissers worstelen met verbod op teruggooien bijvangst”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the Dutch government will implement the landing obligation for bycatch in demersal fisheries, given sector concerns about costs and survival, and why bycatch cannot be used for human consumption. The State Secretary answered that she is seeking maximum room for exemptions within the CFP, proposed postponing the landing obligation for plaice in the tongue fishery to 2018 pending survival research, and sent a letter to the European Commission proposing a definition allowing high-value bycatch for human consumption.
I am committed to maximising use of the exemption possibilities offered by the basic CFP regulation.
Ik zet mij in voor maximale benutting van de uitzonderingsmogelijkheden die de basisverordening van het GVB biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht “Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen”

MPs Dijkstra and Visser (VVD) asked the State Secretary about subsidies of 4.25 million euro for hydrogen and hybrid buses, including a 1.3 million euro top-up for Rotterdam, and whether the subsidies are effective and technology-neutral. The government answered that the grants aim to gain practical experience with zero-emission buses for future procurement rather than to solve air quality problems directly, that the GVB pilot's buses have been returned, and that it has no plans to repeat the scheme while maintaining the zero-emission technology direction.

The aim of the contributions is to support decentralised governments responsible for public bus transport that are considering becoming launch customers for hydrogen buses in gaining practical experience in the short term.

Het doel van de bijdragen is om decentrale overheden die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het openbaar busvervoer en die overwegen launching customer te worden van waterstofbussen te ondersteunen bij het op korte termijn opdoen van praktijkervaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht “Ministeries zijn het nog niet eens over alle details in Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof”

MPs Lodders and Visser asked whether ministries disagree on details of the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof and whether new recalculations are needed, with consequences for timing and consultation. The State Secretary answers that the Rijk and 12 provinces reached agreement on finalising the programme, with entry into force on 1 July 2015 and a partial amendment by 15 December 2015 after an AERIUS Monitor update, subject to public consultation.
The Rijk and the 12 provinces have reached agreement on the finalisation and entry into force of the programme aanpak stikstof.
Het Rijk en de 12 provincies hebben overeenstemming bereikt over de afronding en inwerkingtreding van het programma aanpak stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over Ballast Nedam dat zich terugtrekt uit infrastructurele projecten

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about Ballast Nedam withdrawing from the A15 and A2 Maastricht road projects, whether project deadlines, costs, replacement contractors, the A9 Gaasperdammerweg, claims against Rijkswaterstaat, and splitting megaprojects are affected. The minister answered that deadlines and costs are not expected to change, that Strukton and Strabag take over stakes, that an arbitration procedure is ongoing over A15 costs, and that the Aanbestedingswet and DBFM contract models are under evaluation with results due in summer and autumn 2015.
There is no reason to assume that Ballast Nedam's decision leads to higher costs for these projects.
Er is geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat het besluit van Ballast Nedam leidt tot hogere kosten voor deze projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Bosman en Visser over het strandvissen met kleine fuiken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether the ban on recreational eel fyke-netting in Zeeland's beach fishing could be reconsidered given its heritage status and the Waddeneilanden exception. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies nationwide, enforcement would be disproportionate, and the eel stock remains critical, so there is no reason to reopen the ban or consult again.
I therefore see no reason to revisit the position of my predecessors or to enter into consultation on this again.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op het standpunt van mijn ambtsvoorgangers terug te komen en hierover opnieuw in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een man die is veroordeeld voor het doodrijden van een meisje een opgelegd rijverbod negeert

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a convicted drink-driver who ignored a driving ban after killing a girl, and how repeat offenders can be stopped, including the recidivism rule, the Danish car-seizure model and perceived enforcement risk. The minister answered that the rules and police measures are already in place, that the recidivism scheme is being evaluated with a policy response promised before the summer recess, and that some questions (such as recidivism statistics) will be answered in that evaluation.
I will answer this question in the evaluation of the recidivism scheme for alcohol offenders that I have promised to send to the House.
Het antwoord op deze vraag zal ik geven in het kader van de aan uw Kamer toegezegde evaluatie van de werking van de recidiveregeling voor alcoholovertreders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over verkeershufters die minder vaak worden gepakt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why traffic offenders are caught less often, and whether this undermines the effectiveness of the beginner-driver and repeat-offender measures and road safety. The minister attributes the decline mainly to reduced traffic during the economic crisis and the abolition of ticket quotas, states that stopping offenders remains important but that no effectiveness-of-stop research exists, and reports on the status of enforcement experiments and speed camera systems, promising to monitor the experiments.
After that period, all final results will be mapped out and decisions will be taken on any further steps to be taken.
Na afloop van die periode zullen alle eindresultaten in kaart worden gebracht en beslissingen worden genomen over eventuele te zetten verdere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht ‘Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig.’

An MP asked whether fining drivers who passed on a parking ticket is fair, and whether enforcement is consistent across municipalities after a Gelderland court ruling. The minister answered that passing on a ticket is not valid payment of parking tax, that the ruling only applies to this case, and that such misuse is not normally detectable.
Passing on a parking ticket can never lead to paying that parking tax; it is merely a proof of payment.
Het doorgeven van een parkeerkaartje kan nimmer leiden tot het voldoen van die parkeerbelasting, het is slechts een betaalbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de Staat de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

VVD MPs asked the minister whether the state shifts nearly all project risks onto construction firms under DBFM(O) contracts, whether projects have become too large, and how contracts reflect the Aanbestedingswet evaluation and bankruptcy risk. The minister rejects the criticism, says risks are allocated to the party best able to bear them, and promises to review contracts after the evaluation in summer.
I do not recognise myself in the criticism.
Ik herken me niet in de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de Zaanse spoorlijn

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the State Secretary about the high number of complaints (712) on the Zaan railway line, its structural lack of peak capacity, plans for more frequent Randstad services, and the role of the concession in enforcing improvements. The State Secretary answered that NS is under a concession obligation to improve capacity, the Zaandam-Amsterdam line is one of ten focus routes, train extensions and new rolling stock are planned, and the ministry is in ongoing discussion with NS, with sanctions possible if needed.
On the implementation of that programme my department is in discussion with NS and, if necessary, enforcement will follow under the concession.
Over de uitvoering van dat programma is mijn departement in gesprek met NS en zo nodig zal hierop conform de concessie worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een man die is veroordeeld voor het doodrijden van een meisje een opgelegd rijverbod negeert

An MP asked the Justice Minister how a man convicted of fatally drunk-driving a teenage girl could repeatedly be stopped driving despite a driving ban, and what enforcement tools exist. The minister answered that the conviction is not yet final, that police cannot physically prevent banned drivers from driving, that vehicle seizure was tried but cars were registered to others, and that prosecution has been instituted and victim support maintained.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot prevent a person from driving despite a driving ban or a withheld licence.
Politie en OM kunnen een persoon niet beletten om, ondanks een rij-ontzegging of een ingehouden rijbewijs, toch te gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over de vervanging van de Borgbrug in Groningen

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the lengthy closure of the Borgbrug in Groningen after a ship collision, the delay in reopening, alternatives such as using the ring road, and safety on the Driebondsweg. The minister explained the damage and repair timeline (reopening expected mid-July), said alternative routes and bus transport were arranged, and reported police and municipal measures on safety.
Rijkswaterstaat expects to be able to put the bridge back into use around mid-July.
Rijkswaterstaat verwacht de brug op medio juli weer in gebruik te kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema met betrekking tot oversteekplaatsen voor otters

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to a Hague appeals court ruling requiring measures for otter road crossings, including which bottlenecks will be fixed, when, at what cost, and how this relates to the national ecology programme and provincial responsibilities. The government answered that seven urgent bottlenecks will be addressed immediately, the other 14 urgent ones by about 2016 and all 21 by mid-2017, funded from the Economic Affairs budget, with provinces responsible for nature policy implementation and some costs and measures still undetermined.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (Rijkswaterstaat) and the provinces of Friesland and Overijssel will immediately start on the seven most urgent bottlenecks named in the ruling.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (Rijkswaterstaat) en de provincies Friesland en Overijssel starten direct met de zeven meest urgente knelpunten zoals benoemd in het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about expanding municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, questioning their proportionality, costs, cost-effectiveness analyses and the lack of a uniform access regime. The secretary answered that local municipalities decide on zones, a subsidy scheme for van replacement in border municipalities was set up with 4 million euro of NSL funds, no cost-benefit analysis of green deals is possible, and that a joint exploration with the G4 cities is underway.
The cost-effectiveness of the environmental zone is weighed in local decision-making on any expansion of the zone.
De kosteneffectiviteit van de milieuzone wordt bij de lokale besluitvorming over eventuele uitbreiding van de milieuzone meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over het bericht dat truckchauffeurs ecocombi’s bij de grens moeten splitsen

MPs Visser and Verheijen asked the minister about reports that trucks carrying flowers and longer combined vehicles (ecocombi's/LZVs) must be split at the border, and whether this reflects protectionism and obstructs the EU internal market, along with questions on Benelux and German cooperation. The minister answered that member states disagree on cross-border LZVs, that a compromise on Directive 96/53 allows bilateral arrangements, that a Benelux decision and a Netherlands-Flanders pilot are being prepared, and that North Rhine-Westphalia does not permit LZVs at all.
From May 2013 negotiations were held on the revision of Directive 95/53/EC.
Vanaf mei 2013 is onderhandeld over de herziening van richtlijn 95/53/EG
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Afsluitdijk gaat dicht”

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked the minister why the Afsluitdijk must be closed for ten weekends, what alternatives were considered, what the impact on transport and public transport is, and how communication will be handled. The minister confirmed the closures are needed for heavy hoisting work on sluice complexes, that alternatives with more disruption were rejected, that public transport will not be affected, and that stakeholders will be consulted and informed in advance, though costs are unknown and the contractor selection is still pending.
It is not known what additional costs this will entail for motorists and the transport sector.
Het is niet bekend tot welke extra kosten dit leidt voor automobilisten en de transportsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht dat de Duitse regering nu ook tol wil op het water

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the minister about reports that Germany wants to introduce tolls on waterways, and about the consequences for Dutch inland shipping, ports, competitiveness and EU internal market goals. The minister replied that the German plans are still in preparation and cannot yet be assessed, that she opposes tolls on other waterways than the Rhine because they could shift cargo to other modes, and that she follows the matter actively and will raise it with her German counterpart when warranted.
There is as yet no clarity whatsoever about the content and publication of a specific regulation for toll charging on waterways.
Over de inhoud en publicatie van een specifieke regeling voor tolheffing op vaarwegen bestaat nu nog geen enkele duidelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the proposed expansion of municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, arguing for uniform national rules, the burden on businesses, and the effectiveness versus source-based policy. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on zones within a national framework, that zones remain needed for air quality hotspots, and that the national government supports source-based measures, innovation and uniform access regimes.
There is no overview available of all itemised expenditure related to specific measures in the NSL by national government, provinces and municipalities.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van alle uitgesplitste uitgaven in relatie tot specifieke maatregelen in het NSL door rijk, provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de automobilist de klos is in de Randstad

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary whether the G4 cities' proposed air-quality measures, such as more lane-section controls, are symbolic, ineffective and costly for motorists. The State Secretary answered that the G4 letter will be discussed on 29 January, that the NSL approach has worked and was extended, that source policy is most effective, and that lane controls add little to urban air quality; costs were referred to the answer on question 2.
What the additional approach will look like I cannot say at this point.
Hoe de aanvullende aanpak er uit zal zien kan ik nu nog niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat de Duitse Ministerraad heeft ingestemd met het tolplan

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about the German plan to introduce a road toll (vignette) for passenger cars, its discriminatory effects on Dutch drivers and border residents, possible legal action, and whether Dutch registration data could be used for German enforcement. The minister opposed the plan, said talks with Germany continue and that the plan was softened for local border traffic, noted no court action is currently on the table, and confirmed the RDW may provide registration data to foreign authorities on request.
At this moment, taking the matter to the European Court of Justice is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is een gang naar het Europese Hof van Justitie niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over het gebruik van verkeersdata

MPs Visser and Tellegen (VVD) asked about sharing traffic data by road managers and about warning systems for approaching emergency services. The minister says the national data databank and Beter Benutten projects improve data quality, that a radio-warning trial was not scaled up, and that no regulatory barriers exist so no new legislation is planned.
There are no regulatory barriers to applying such technologies.
Er liggen geen belemmeringen op het gebied van wet- en regelgeving voor het toepassen van dergelijke technieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat er plannen zijn om een vismigratierivier ter waarde van meer dan 80 miljoen te maken in de Afsluitdijk

An MP asked the minister about reports that a fish migration river costing over 80 million euro is planned at the Afsluitdijk, asking about effectiveness, necessity, consequences if not built, funding, management, dike safety and comparable projects. The minister replied that the project is effective and estimated at about 55 million euro, that it replaces a required EU Water Framework Directive fish passage, that the region bears most of the funding with limited Rijk contributions, and that dike safety is not weakened.
The Ministry of IenM has not yet received a request from the region and therefore has not yet made a decision on the contribution.
Het Ministerie van IenM heeft nog geen verzoek van de regio ontvangen en dus ook nog geen besluit genomen over de bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de flessenhals van de A4

An MP asked the minister why speed was limited to 80 km/h and a lane closed on the A4 near Leiden, whether contractor costs could be recovered, and why road users were not informed proactively. The minister answered that the final three-lane layout opened in late 2014, that remaining works until March 2015 keep the 80 km/h limit, that repairs are at the contractor's expense, and that road users were informed through press releases, newsletters and other channels.
Recovering costs from the contractor is not an issue.
Het verhalen van kosten bij de aannemer is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Visser over benzinedieven

MPs Tellegen and Visser asked whether police fail to catch fuel thieves because paper reports are not entered in the national digital system, and what measures are being taken. The Minister of Security and Justice said paper reports are not automatically recorded, that pomphouders are encouraged to use the digital reporting facility, that camera footage upload will be possible by year-end, and that the database contains repeat offenders.
Therefore, before the end of this year, the digital reporting facility will offer the option to upload images that support the report and may help with the investigation.

Daarom wordt nog voor het einde van dit jaar binnen de digitale aangiftefaciliteit de mogelijkheid geboden om beelden te uploaden die de aangifte ondersteunen en die behulpzaam kunnen zijn bij de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters, Van der Linde en Visser over het bericht ‘Social return kost taxichauffeurs baan’

MPs Potters, Van der Linde and Visser asked the State Secretary about reports that social return requirements displaced taxi drivers, including KNV's claim that 5,000 drivers lost jobs, and about the expertise and monitoring of such placements. The State Secretary acknowledged displacement concerns, said she cannot calculate social costs or judge individual firms, stated that re-integration is a municipal responsibility, and that no central data exist on sustainability of placements, while noting that the central government drops social return where displacement risk is real.
With the introduction of the WWB in 2004, implementation of the law became the responsibility of municipalities.
Met de introductie van de WWB in 2004 behoort de uitvoering van de wet tot de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van 't Wout en Visser over het bericht “Gehandicapte niet welkom in Utrecht door milieuregels”

MPs Van 't Wout and Visser asked the state secretary about reports that people with mobility-aid vehicles are excluded by Utrecht's environmental zone rules. The secretary said the zone targets vehicles rather than users, that the municipality offers subsidies and possible exemptions, and that the specific case is under municipal review.
I am of the view that measures benefiting the environment should in principle apply to both people with and without a disability.
Ik ben van mening dat maatregelen die ten goede komen aan het milieu in beginsel zowel voor mensen met als zonder een beperking dienen te gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over storingen bij de Coentunnel

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about breakdowns, height-detection false alarms and traffic jams at the Coentunnel, including whether measures taken in 2013 worked and what they cost. The minister disputed the criticism, listed the 2013 measures (cost EUR 235,000), said there were no jams in the peak hours since reopening but short stoppages from overheight trucks and some incidental faults, and declined to add technical measures while describing enforcement fines and contacts with the transport sector.
I see no reason yet to take additional (technical) measures, because the height detection systems are well set up and functioning correctly.
Ik zie nog geen aanleiding om aanvullende (technische) maatregelen te nemen, omdat de hoogtedetectiesystemen goed staan ingesteld en juist functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Visser over de introductie van de dienst UberPOP in Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the launch of UberPOP in Amsterdam, the ILT's enforcement, the legal basis for banning it, tax treatment, taxi maximum tariffs, enforcement capacity and the Taxiwet evaluation. The state secretary answered that unlicensed UberPOP driving is illegal taxi transport that the inspectorate rightly tackles, outlined the tax and liability position, and committed to evaluating the Taxiwet and informing the House around the turn of the year.
Private drivers who operate without a licence and driver's card, including via UberPOP, as a result carry out illegal taxi transport.
Particuliere chauffeurs die zonder een vergunning en chauffeurskaart opereren, ook via UberPOP, verrichten als gevolg daarvan illegaal taxivervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Verheijen over de voornemens inzake tolheffing op de Duitse wegen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about German plans to extend a road toll (vignette) to local roads, including its effects on cross-border residents, transport, EU law and possible joint action with neighbouring countries. The minister opposed the plan, said the Commission will be asked to assess it under EU law, and said Nederland will consider joint action with other countries if useful.
I will ask Commissioner Kallas to examine whether this planned measure and its implementation are compatible with EU law.
Ik zal Eurocommissaris Kallas verzoeken na te gaan of deze voorgenomen maatregel en de uitwerking ervan verenigbaar is met het EU recht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over het aan te leggen stuk spoor bij Beverwijk en overige werkzaamheden naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de leden van de VVD-fractie aan Tata Steel in IJmuiden

Two VVD MPs asked about extending the Beverwijk rail head track to 750 metres, the cost of rail freight, and coordination of overlapping infrastructure works in the North Sea Canal area. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for the track extension due in 2016, that rail freight measures are in the Long-Term Rail Agenda, and that Rijkswaterstaat coordinates works through annual multi-year planning and regional consultation.
It is of great importance for businesses that infrastructure works are well coordinated with one another.
Het is voor bedrijven van groot belang dat werkzaamheden aan de infrastructuur goed op elkaar worden afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Ruim baan voor verkeershufters’ en ‘Oom agent is onzichtbaar’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the number of traffic stops had halved, whether traffic offenders are getting free rein, and about the effectiveness of speed cameras and section control. The minister replied that traffic enforcement remains a police priority, that stops rose by over 50,000 in 2013, that the planned 2015 harder approach to repeat traffic offenders is in preparation, and that automated enforcement changes behaviour, while rejecting the claim of free rein.
I will inform you shortly in more detail about the preparations for this new approach to repeat offenders.
Ik zal u op korte termijn nader informeren over de voorbereidingen voor deze nieuwe veelplegeraanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Dieselbendes roven tanks leeg’

MPs Visser and Dijkhoff asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of gangs stealing diesel from truck tanks, including the scale of the thefts, whether the gangs come from former Eastern Bloc countries, whether night-time checks on vans are warranted, whether licence-plate and camera tools are used, and whether police have sufficient legal powers. The Minister answered that diesel theft is rising, that police lack enough information to confirm organised Eastern Bloc involvement, that incidents mostly occur at night and suggest targeting checks, that plate recognition is not yet used for this, and that existing legal powers are sufficient.
There are sufficient (legal) possibilities for the police to successfully combat mobile banditry.
Er zijn voldoende (juridische) mogelijkheden voor de politie om met succes mobiel banditisme te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht «Antifraudecomputer in taxi zo lek als mandje»

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the taxi onboard computer (BCT) is leaky, privacy-invasive, fraud-prone and late, and about the deadline extensions. The state secretary answered in detail, defending the BCT's fraud-resistance and privacy safeguards, acknowledging the deadline shifts, and explaining the subsidy extension and costs.

My ministry has regularly consulted with representatives of the taxi sector, KNV Taxi and individual entrepreneurs, the manufacturers, the RDW and the Tax Administration on the specifications of the BCT.

Met vertegenwoordigers van de taxibranche, KNV Taxi en individuele ondernemers, met de fabrikanten, met de RDW en met de Belastingdienst heeft mijn ministerie regelmatig overleg gevoerd over de specificaties van de BCT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht «Boeren en waterschappen koppelen grondgebruik aan waterbeheer»

MPs Lodders and Visser asked about reports that farmers and water boards are launching 30 new area projects under the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer, and whether this creates overlapping regulation with the Nitrates Directive and crop protection rules. The State Secretary answered that LTO leads the initiative with water boards, that the government plays a supporting role, and that equivalent measures could give farmers exemptions from generic use norms from 2015, without adding new binding regulation.
I do not foresee that this will lead to an accumulation of regulation.
Ik voorzie niet dat dit leidt tot een stapeling van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Steur over verschillende torenhoge boetes die het afgelopen jaar geïnd zijn

MPs Visser and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about very large unpaid fines collected in the past year, asking how many people are involved, why arrears grew so high, whether police enforcement and ANPR are used effectively, and whether gijzeling is adequate. The Minister answered that the cases involve confiscation orders, that 178 persons have open debts of 300,000 euro or more, that police enforcement and ANPR are used successfully and will expand, and that the approach to collecting financial sanctions will be reviewed with a letter to parliament in June 2014.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I have previously indicated that we are examining how the collection of financial sanctions, including the use of coercive measures, can be improved.

De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik hebben eerder aangegeven dat bekeken wordt op welke wijze de inning van financiële sancties, inclusief de inzet van dwangmiddelen, verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de problemen bij de Coentunnel

An MP asked the minister about incidents, breakdowns and criticism of the Second Coen Tunnel project, including contract penalties and who pays for extra measures. The minister said incident numbers have returned to pre-opening levels, that contractual norm times and penalties apply, that extra costs fall outside the DBFM contract, and that an internal evaluation is planned for next year.
After opening, an internal, project-specific evaluation will take place.
Na openstelling zal er een interne, projectspecifieke evaluatie plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries (over het bericht tienduizenden huizen nog altijd onverkoopbaar door erfpacht

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about reports that tens of thousands of homes on leasehold land remain unsaleable because banks refuse financing. The minister defends the banking guideline agreed between the notaries and the banks as self-regulation, says he will consult stakeholders shortly, and rules out bringing leasehold contracts under financial supervision or declaring the guideline generally binding.
I will shortly consult with the parties involved about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met betrokken partijen over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Visser en De Caluwé over de organisatie ‘Dutch International Guarantees for Housing’ (DIGH)

MPs Visser and De Caluwé asked whether Dutch housing corporations guaranteeing DIGH loans for social housing in developing countries amounts to an implicit state guarantee, whether these fall under ODA rules, whether guarantees are reviewed for necessity and fee cover, and whether such activity belongs to corporations' core tasks. The minister answered that corporations guarantee loans with their own capital, the state is not directly liable, no new guarantees have been issued since mid-2012, and the Herzieningswet novelle will address corporations' activities abroad.

In my proposals within the novelle to the Herzieningswet, in light of this cabinet's aim that corporations serve the public interest in their area, I will further address the limits arising from this for corporations' activities abroad.

Ik zal bij mijn voorstellen in het kader van de novelle bij de Herzieningswet, mede in het licht van de doelstelling van dit kabinet dat corporaties dienstbaar zijn aan het publieke belang in hun werkgebied, nader ingaan op de beperkingen die hieruit voortvloeien voor activiteiten van woningcorporaties ten behoeve van het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over nieuwe erfpachtvoorwaarden van de gemeente Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister about Amsterdam's proposed new ground-lease (erfpacht) conditions, including whether municipal leases serve as a revenue product, whether they affect mortgage financing and valuation, and whether they amount to a burden on homeowners and comply with property rights and legitimate expectations. The minister answered that municipalities are bound by general principles of good governance and civil-law reasonableness, that the choice of land policy is a local political matter, and that the municipal council and courts provide the checks, without committing to new national action.
It is for the local government to ensure, in its decision-making, the relationship between the Charter, the principle of legitimate expectations and their applicability when conditions are changed.

Het is aan het lokaal bestuur zich bij zijn besluitvorming te vergewissen van de verhouding tussen het Handvest, het vertrouwensbeginsel en de toepasselijkheid hiervan bij een wijziging van voorwaarden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over het besluit van de gemeente Assen om zelf huurwoningen te bouwen

An MP asks the housing minister about Assen municipality's decision to build social rental housing itself, given that housing corporations have stopped doing so, and about implications for corporate duties, the WSW guarantee and market distortion. The minister answers that municipal building is permitted but not a core municipal task, carries financial risk, and that corporations should keep their role, with the government strengthening municipalities' position toward corporations through the Woningwet revision.
It is preferable that the municipality reaches agreement with one or more housing corporations about building social rental housing.
Het verdient de voorkeur als de gemeente tot overeenstemming komt met één of meerdere woningcorporatie(s) over de bouw van sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Visser over het bericht «Huiseigenaren richten hun woede op bankdirecteuren»

MPs De Vries and Visser asked whether banks are earning excess profits on mortgages, why Dutch mortgage rates exceed those in neighbouring countries, and whether more competition or transparency is needed. The minister says he awaits the NMa's update on mortgage margins, notes structural differences that make cross-country comparison difficult, and points to transparency measures and lifting ING's price-leadership ban as steps toward more competition.
I do not have this insight, so I cannot give you this explanation.
Dit inzicht heb ik niet, waardoor ik u deze toelichting niet kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over het bericht “Woningen speciaal voor Moslims in Amsterdam”

MPs Visser and Azmani asked whether housing corporation Eigen Haard's renovation of 188 flats in Amsterdam was tailored to Muslim residents' wishes (shoe cabinets, ritual-washing taps, sliding doors, satellite reception) and whether this constitutes misuse of public funds and segregation. Minister Blok answers that the reported details are largely inaccurate, the extra cost was only about 25 euro per tap, the flats are allocated under regular rules, and he finds religion-specific housing undesirable and will raise it with Aedes and, if needed, use legal instruments.
I will discuss this with Aedes.
Ik zal hierover met Aedes in contact treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht over het buitenspel zetten van makelaars bij tijdelijke verhuur

An MP asked whether banks, including ABN AMRO, effectively exclude commercial estate agents from temporary letting by requiring owners to use a few selected intermediaries, and whether this is proportionate and should be regulated. The minister answered that banks may set conditions for consent, that a duty to use specific intermediaries is undesirable, and that banks should be encouraged to create a competitive market and objective criteria, while no change to the Leegstandwet is needed.
I will consult with the banks concerned on this.
Ik zal hierover in overleg treden met de betreffende banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Visser over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter te Groningen inzake de strafrechtelijke ontruiming van krakers op grond van art. 551a Sv.

MPs Van der Steur and Visser asked the ministers about a Groningen interim judge's refusal to allow criminal eviction of squatters under art. 551a Sv, and how this affects enforcement of the squatting ban. The minister said the case is under appeal so he will not judge it, that enforcement is not undermined since other courts allowed evictions, and gave statistics showing most court challenges to criminal evictions succeeded for the state.
As long as the case is before the court, I refrain from passing judgment.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is, onthoud ik me van een oordeel.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over de berichten 'Grote zorgen kabinet over Schiphol, aantal vluchten mogelijk fors omlaag' en 'Laagvliegroute van Lelystad Airport over Vechtdal en Zwolle blijft bestaan, prov

An MP asks the minister about reports on legal concerns over Schiphol flight numbers and the continued low-altitude approach route of Lelystad Airport over the Vechtdal and Zwolle, and whether this makes opening Lelystad unfeasible. The minister says the legal situation's consequences for Lelystad are unclear, a decision on opening is due in 2022, and the remaining 30 km of the route cannot be raised to higher altitude, while noise, nature and air quality impacts were studied and committing to continued efforts on the route.

The answer to this question will be included in a cabinet letter on Schiphol, in response to the request during the committee procedure meeting of 15 December 2021 for a letter on the media coverage about Schiphol.

Het antwoord op deze vraag wordt betrokken in een brief van het kabinet over Schiphol, naar aanleiding van het verzoek tijdens de procedurevergadering van de vaste commissie voor Infrastructuur en Waterstaat van 15 december 2021 waarin uw Kamer een brief gevraagd heeft over de berichtgeving in de media over Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over reddingsmiddelen bij het te water raken van auto’s

An MP asks ministers about drowning deaths when cars enter water, the adequacy of safety hammers, and the REGS automatic window-breaking system tested on police cars in 2012. The minister acknowledges the deaths and rising concern, notes the pilot was stopped due to spontaneous activations, and declines to pursue further research or implementation.
As indicated in answer 6, the experiences were not such that we would want to proceed to implementation.
Zoals aangegeven bij vraag 6 waren de ervaringen niet zodanig dat we over zouden willen gaan op implementatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Schiphol en KLM al 15 jaar op de hoogte van gezondheidsrisico’s medewerkers'

The MP De Hoop asks the minister whether Schiphol and KLM knew for 15 years of health risks from exhaust and ultrafine particles for platform workers, why little action was taken, why the Labour Inspectorate only now investigates, and whether affected workers should be compensated. The minister answers that employers bear responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that sector taskforces and an independent steering committee are being set up, that the Inspectorate is investigating since late 2021, and that a compensation scheme for serious occupational diseases is being prepared with a target start of 1 July 2022.
It is the responsibility of the employer to ensure safe and healthy working conditions.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever om te zorgen voor veilige en gezonde werkomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Alkaya over het nieuws dat medewerkers van Schiphol ernstige gezondheidsrisico’s lopen als gevolg van blootstelling aan ultrafijnstof

MPs asked the minister about reports that Schiphol workers face serious health risks from ultrafine particles, including inspection history, research, employer responsibility, and compensation. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate has two investigations ongoing, that employers bear primary responsibility, and that a sector taskforce and independent committee are being set up while several requests are deferred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Limburgse grensgemeente verrast door volstorten recreatieplas”

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that a Flemish Maas lake near the Dutch border was designated for dumping excavated soil from Antwerp, possibly polluted like the Westerschelde, and about risks to Dutch municipalities, boaters, agriculture and drinking water. The State Secretary answered that no soil is currently being applied, the Flemish authority is responsible, the permit excludes heavily polluted soil, no monitoring report or MER exists yet, and that the Netherlands will be closely involved in monitoring approval.
It is not possible to send you a report regarding ecological or environmental requirements.
Het is niet mogelijk om u een rapportage met betrekking tot ecologische of milieueisen toe te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het niet handhaven van het vuurwerkverbod

An MP asks the Justice and Interior ministers whether the government anticipated enforcement shortages before imposing a temporary fireworks ban, whether mayors and police warned of enforceability problems, and how the ban affected cross-border purchases, hospital figures and public trust. The minister replies that the ban was needed to relieve healthcare pressure, that police and prosecutors deliberately prioritised citizen safety over enforcing the ban, that casualty figures fell 40% compared with the last pre-COVID year, and that detailed hospital data will follow in a separate report.
Data on ICU admissions are not available. The report with an additional analysis of the injury figures for the past New Year's period will be sent to your House in the second quarter of 2022.

Gegevens over IC-opnamen zijn niet beschikbaar. De rapportage met een aanvullende analyse van de letselcijfers van afgelopen jaarwisseling zal in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 naar uw Kamer verzonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Alkaya over de uitvoering van motie Alkaya/Van der Plas over het zo spoedig mogelijk beëindigen van tolheffing voor de Westerscheldetunnel

MPs Van der Plas and Alkaya asked the minister how the motion to make the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free as soon as possible is being implemented, and why the toll-free date, road-traffic effects, and funding are unclear. The minister answered that toll removal requires funding first, which has not been found, that the timeline depends on the coalition plan for a pay-per-use system around 2030, and that the Draaiboek and internal advice are being shared.
I agree with that, provided the condition of funding the costs of abolishing the toll can be met.
Daar ben ik het mee eens, mits aan de voorwaarde voor dekking van de kosten van afschaffing van de tol kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het artikel 'Experts niet verbaasd over grote legionella uitbraak. Derde in paar jaar tijd in deze regio'

MP De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a legionella outbreak in Schijndel, whether it was linked to stagnant water systems during lockdown, its causes, national trends, prevention steps, monitoring of non-pneumophila species, and research on water treatment technologies. The minister answered that no link to lockdown-related water stagnation was found, the outbreak likely came from a wet cooling tower, prevention rules and a handbook for wastewater plants are being revised, and a research study will be started in 2022 with an update by end 2022.
At the end of 2022 I will inform you about the status of this.
Eind 2022 zal ik u informeren over de stand hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderhoud aan vuurtoren in Den Helder, die op instorten staat en de staat van onderhoud van andere (rijks)monumenten bij Rijkswaterstaat

Omtzigt asked the minister about cracks in the Lange Jaap lighthouse in Den Helder, earlier knowledge of those cracks in an internal memo, contacts with the municipality and heritage bodies, Rijkswaterstaat's maintenance policy for monuments and whether other state monuments are neglected. The minister partly answered: cracks in floors and flanges were known earlier, Rijkswaterstaat did not meet its own monument-maintenance framework, but documents, the full list of monuments and other details will follow only in spring.
No, the framework mentioned in the answer to question 7 was insufficiently followed in the maintenance of this monument.
Nee, het kader genoemd bij de beantwoording van vraag 7 is onvoldoende gevolgd bij het onderhoud van dit monument.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boulakjar over de berichten '3000 lege vliegtuigen in België de lucht in om landingsrechten te behouden' en 'Knotsgekke drempels in Europese lidstaten bemoeilijken treinreis

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of empty flights run to preserve airport slot rights during the pandemic and about rail cross-border obstacles, and asked how many empty flights were operated, whether the slot waiver would be extended, and what was being done on international rail. The minister replied that no empty flights were needed at Dutch slot-coordinated airports, that the EU slot relief rules are expected to continue for summer 2022 with a request for clarity beyond, and outlined ongoing EU and national rail initiatives without committing to a new legal change.
The ministry has no access to load factors per airline or per flight movement.
Het ministerie heeft geen inzage in de bezettingsgraden per luchtvaartmaatschappij en of per vliegtuigbeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar veiligheid grondafhandeling Schiphol tegengewerkt’

MPs De Hoop and Alkaya asked why a survey of ground-handling workers was replaced by a data analysis in the NLR study on safety at Schiphol, and whether the data and safety-culture findings are reliable. The minister defends the study's conclusions, says the survey was dropped by the researchers themselves, and rejects a new survey while pointing to a sector CAO and other measures without committing to social establishment requirements.
It is up to the contractor to determine how the research is set up.
Het is aan de opdrachtnemer om te bepalen hoe het onderzoek wordt opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paternotte en Van der Laan over sporters van teamNL, die met corona besmet zijn geraakt

MPs Omtzigt, Paternotte and Van der Laan asked whether lessons were drawn after TeamNL athletes caught COVID-19 on the Tokyo flight, what measures China imposes, and whether flying on a single pre-departure test is safe. The minister replied that NOC*NSF evaluated the trip and adopted adjusted travel measures for Beijing, that no approach can reach zero risk, and that the cabinet considers a single test sufficiently safe while leaving the operational responsibility with NOC*NSF.
It is up to NOC*NSF to ensure that the TeamNL delegation can be sent to the Games in a safe manner.
Het is aan NOC*NSF om ervoor te zorgen dat de TeamNL-delegatie op een veilige manier kan worden uitgezonden naar de Spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Grondpersoneel geweerd bij veiligheidsonderzoek Schiphol’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that ground-handling staff were excluded from a state safety and working-conditions study at Schiphol, and about incidents, unreported occurrences and staff shortages. The minister answered that the researchers judged detailed safety-culture insight unnecessary, outlined ILT inspections and incident-reporting efforts, and noted that ILT had handled a small number of staff-shortage reports.
NLR, as lead of the research team, states that during the study it became clear that detailed insight into the degree of safety culture would not contribute to answering the research question.

Het NLR geeft hierover als trekker van het onderzoeksteam aan dat gedurende het onderzoek is gebleken dat gedetailleerd inzicht in de mate van veiligheidscultuur niet zou bijdragen aan het beantwoorden van de onderzoeksvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het schrappen van de groeidoelstelling voor de internationale luchtvaart uit Artikel 44a van het Verdrag van Chicago

An MP asked the minister why she called amending the Chicago Convention's growth objective for international aviation nearly impossible, and whether ICAO's rules and objectives block such a change. The minister answered that amendments need a two-thirds vote and ratification, that ICAO objectives are balanced rather than fixed, and that she will focus on concrete climate policy at the 2022 Assembly instead of proposing a treaty change.
It is better to deploy the available manpower and resources to make concrete policy at international level that contributes to combating climate change from aviation
Het is beter om de beschikbare menskracht en middelen in te zetten om in internationaal verband concreet beleid te maken dat bijdraagt aan het tegengaan van klimaatverandering door luchtvaart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Zorgen en boosheid na plotseling afblazen contractondertekening voor verbreden A2, Rijkswaterstaat meldt miljoenentekort’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sudden cancellation of contract signing for widening the A2 near Vonderen-Kerensheide due to a cost shortfall, and about its timing, size, effect on planning and the nitrogen issue. The minister acknowledged the late and poorly handled communication, apologised, but withheld the exact size of the shortfall pending validation and said the planning remains on track with a tender in spring 2022.
The outcome of the validation and the follow-up will be communicated to you through the regular channels under the MIRT.
Over de uitkomst van de validatie en het vervolg wordt u via de reguliere kanalen volgens het MIRT geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over duisternis en stilte

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the government about protecting darkness and quiet (light and noise pollution), the number and loss of quiet areas, and hunting in them. The Minister answered that darkness and quiet are recognised as important, that protection relies on existing law and provincial competence, that about 14,000 hectares of land quiet area were lost net, and that no new national rules are planned.
The cabinet is currently not intending to draw up new, additional rules on this, partly because of its caretaker status.
Het kabinet is op dit moment, mede vanwege zijn demissionaire status, niet voornemens hierover nieuwe, aanvullende regels op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de afhandeling van de schade van de wateroverlast in Limburg en Noord-Brabant van juli 2021

An MP asked the government about the slow handling of flood damage claims in Limburg and Noord-Brabant after July 2021, including delays, strict procedures, insurance exclusions and unclear rules for farmers. The minister said payments had started, defended the procedure and the 13-week and 4-6 week timelines, refused to extend the deadline or make advance payments, and declined to intervene in private insurance policies.
I consider it of great importance that those affected are helped adequately and as quickly as possible.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat gedupeerden adequaat en zo snel mogelijk worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over drugsgebruik in het verkeer

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about drug driving enforcement, including THC thresholds, saliva tests, medicinal users, licence suspensions and possible discriminatory policing. Minister Grapperhaus defended the uniform per se limits, explained the saliva-then-blood procedure and licence rules, and said he would not comment on individual cases.
The NFI will re-evaluate the scientific insights on this in 2022.
Het NFI zal in 2022 de wetenschappelijke inzichten hieromtrent opnieuw evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de invoering Richtlijn beroepskwalificaties binnenvaart

MPs asked why the Netherlands has not implemented the EU inland shipping qualifications directive four years after entry into force, and about the impact on small passenger boats and ferries and on Dutch training approvals. The minister answered that the implementation is complex and needs more time, that a transitional arrangement and interim national scheme are planned, and that an adapted certificate for sightseeing boats is under discussion with the sector.
In addition, I am conducting international consultations to reach mutual acceptance of documents by 17 January 2022.
Daarnaast voer ik internationaal overleg om voor 17 januari 2022 tot wederzijdse acceptatie van documenten te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over de berichten 'Brug over Prinses Margrietkanaal in Kootstertille onveilig: bussen en vrachtverkeer moeten omrijden' en 'Wijkertunnel (A9) op slot voor vrachtverkeer'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sudden weight restriction on the Kootstertille bridge and the closure of the Wijkertunnel to freight, including why the bridge was deemed unsafe earlier than expected and why traffic was closed without a set end date. The minister answered that inspections required a load restriction for safety, that the tunnel closure followed defective ventilators with no available replacement parts, and that the bridge replacement was postponed due to budget shortfalls.
To minimise the risk of fire in the tunnel and the associated safety risks, it was decided to temporarily prohibit lorries and coaches from the Wijkertunnel.
Om brand in de tunnel en daarmee veiligheidsrisico's tot een minimum te beperken is besloten om tijdelijk geen vrachtwagens en touringcars toe te staan in de Wijkertunnel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries'

An MP asked the State Secretary and ministers why the Saba/Sint Eustatius ferry service failed to start on 1 November 2021, whether customs and Marechaussee were unprepared, and about affordability and remaining obstacles. The government answered that the start slipped to 14 November due to tender extensions and missing safety certificates, that the ferry started on 1 December 2021, and that ministries coordinated with the island authorities.
Due to the extension of the tender period at the request of the participating parties, the target start date had to be adjusted to 14 November 2021.
Door verlenging van de aanbestedingstermijn op verzoek van de deelnemende partijen moest de streefdatum van de start echter worden bijgesteld naar 14 november 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en de Hoop over de Nederlandse aanvraag bij het EU Solidariteitsfonds naar aanleiding van de overstromingen in Limburg

MPs Ploumen and De Hoop asked the minister about the status of the Dutch EU Solidarity Fund application after the Limburg floods, the intended use of any funds, a commitment that funds go to Limburg public infrastructure, and access to the application. The minister answered that a preliminary damage estimate was submitted, a decision from Brussels is expected early 2022, the Wts compensation is independent of the fund, any contribution will go to public infrastructure in Limburg, and the form will be shared with parliament once final.
Once it is final, the House of Representatives will be further informed.
Zodra deze definitief is, wordt de Tweede Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het artikel ‘Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries’

An MP asked why the Saba/Statia ferry service failed to start on schedule and whether the ministries involved, including the Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland, were responsible. The government answered that tender delays, missing safety certificates and late agreement on the sailing schedule with the Marechaussee and Customs caused the postponement, and that the service started on 1 December 2021.
In its coordinating role, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations initiated consultation with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management to resolve this.
Vanuit de coördinerende rol heeft het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties overleg geïnitieerd met het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat om dit op te lossen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over ‘het nieuws dat de beveiliging van Schiphol zo lek is als een mandje’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister whether fake QR-code boarding passes allowing unauthorised access past Schiphol gates, and related security weaknesses, were known and whether they threaten passengers and staff. The minister answered that automated checks cannot fully exclude non-passengers, but that this is not a security gap since the separate weapons and explosives screening still applies, and that the airport is responsible for the access controls under KMar oversight.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about the form and frequency of testing of the access control systems.
Vanwege veiligheidsreden kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de vorm en frequentie van de testen van de toegangscontrolesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de vuurtoren 'Lange Jaap' in Den Helder die dreigt in te storten

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Lange Jaap lighthouse in Den Helder, which risks collapse, and the causes, repair plans, maintenance history, inspections and why earlier consultant advice was not followed. The minister replied that corrosion caused the cracks, that most repair scenarios are infeasible, that short-term shoring is the priority, and that an external review of the process over past years, including the failure to act on earlier advice, will be commissioned and reported to parliament.

To clarify these gaps, identify possible external signals and draw lessons from what happened, I have asked the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management to commission an external investigation of the process followed in recent years.

Om deze hiaten op te helderen, mogelijke externe signalen te achterhalen en om lessen te trekken uit de gang van zaken, heb ik de Secretaris-Generaal van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gevraagd om een extern onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Scheuren in wanden vuurtoren Lange Jaap. Groot gebied rondom toren afgesloten, ook de doorgaande weg.'

An MP asked the minister about cracks in the walls of the Lange Jaap lighthouse, why Rijkswaterstaat did not intervene earlier, and how to prevent similar damage elsewhere. The minister acknowledged inadequate maintenance under Rijkswaterstaat's duty of care, announced an external review, a structural-support study and a decision by end January 2022.

To my regret it must be concluded that Rijkswaterstaat did carry out regular inspections and in-depth studies and some repairs, but took no structural measures to counter or limit the degradation of the structure.

Tot mijn spijt moet worden geconcludeerd dat Rijkswaterstaat weliswaar reguliere inspecties en verdiepende onderzoeken heeft uitgevoerd en enkele herstelmaatregelen heeft gedaan, maar geen structurele maatregelen heeft getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de afgegeven opsporingsvergunningen voor aardwarmte in (huidige en toekomstige) drinkwatergebieden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked why geothermal exploration licences were granted in current and future drinking water areas despite warnings from the Court of Audit and the State Supervision of Mines, and what safeguards exist. The Minister replied that a bill amending the Mining Act is pending, that licences are market-ordering concessions with no drilling rights until an environmental permit is granted, that provinces normally exclude mining in protected drinking water zones, and that no specific restrictions were attached to the licences.
The Court of Audit investigation took place in mid-2019.
Het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) heeft medio 2019 plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Minhas over het bericht 'Meer incidenten met asielzoekers in trein Emmen-Zwolle, personeel ziek thuis'

MPs Valstar and Minhas asked about rising incidents involving asylum seekers on the Emmen-Zwolle train line, sick leave among staff, and measures taken, including bodycams, travel bans, guards and funding for a shuttle bus. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, described measures such as limited enforcement powers for supervisors and the HTL placement option, but said incident data do not record residence status and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
The police and transport operators do not register the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Grenzen van baggeren in Waddenzee nabij’

MPs De Vries and Heerema asked the minister about the limits of dredging in the Wadden Sea, the risk that the Natura 2000 dredging volume is exceeded around 2023, and the accessibility of Wadden islands and ports. The minister answered that the Natura 2000 plan caps dredging, monitoring anticipates possible exceedance, and alternative access solutions and a Ameland decision around 2023 are being studied, with a Boontjes evaluation pending.
It is established that the task regarding accessibility is to make mobility sustainable and to continue guaranteeing accessibility in the long term.
Vastgelegd is dat de opgave met betrekking tot bereikbaarheid is om de mobiliteit te verduurzamen en de bereikbaarheid ook op de lange termijn te blijven garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) naar de vliegramp in Faro, waarbij 56 mensen omkwamen en 106 mensen zwaargewond raakten

Mr. Omtzigt asked the minister about the OVV's investigation into the 1992 Faro air crash, including the 2021 court ruling on state liability, the scope of the OVV's renewed investigation, and what documents the state supplied. The minister answered that the OVV is independent, that the state made documents available and had no interest in the outcome, that no documents were classified as state secret, and that the OVV's limited investigation was published on 18 November 2021.
Pursuant to Annex 13 to the Chicago Convention and the Dutch Act on the Safety Board, the above-mentioned documents cannot be made public.
