Ingevolge Bijlage 13 bij het Verdrag van Chicago en de Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid, kunnen de bovengenoemde stukken niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het artikel ‘Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers whether they knew of the new Omicron variant spreading in South Africa, whether incoming flights from there face adequate entry rules, and whether quarantine or double PCR testing could be imposed as a precaution. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on the Omicron measures, without addressing the questions in the reply itself.

The written questions from MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh to the ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about the article 'South Africa sounds the alarm: new virus variant spreading' (2021Z21731) are answered by letter <Status of the measures on the omicron variant of the coronavirus>.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over het artikel «Zuid-Afrika slaat alarm: nieuwe virusvariant grijpt om zich heen» ( 2021Z21731 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken over de maatregelen omikronvariant van het coronavirus>
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika

Two D66 MPs asked the health and transport ministers about a new COVID variant spreading fast in South Africa, including monitoring, travel testing, vaccine donations and border checks. The minister answered by referring the parliament to a separate letter on the omicron measures, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Paternotte and Hagen to the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the rapid rise of a new virus variant in South Africa (2021Z21733) have been answered by way of a letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van leden Paternotte en Hagen aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de snelle opmars van een nieuwe virusvariant in Zuid-Afrika ( 2021Z21733 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het varend ontgassen op het Markermeer en de randmeren van Flevoland

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the legality of venting gas from ships on the Markermeer and Flevoland lakes, the ILT map that appears to allow it, and the division of responsibilities with the province. The minister replied that the provincial bans do not apply on national waters, that the Dutch ban awaits ratification of the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag, and that a taskforce and ambassadorial efforts are pushing for faster ratification.
Unfortunately, the Netherlands cannot bring the ban into force on its own.
Helaas kan Nederland het verbod niet eigenstandig in werking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het varend ontgassen van kankerverwekkend gif

An SP MP asks the Infrastructure minister why the ban on in-transit gassing of carcinogenic cargo gases is not yet enforced, why a 2020 motion for a July 2020 ban was not executed, and why a map of permitted gassing routes exists. The minister replies that a national ban requires ratification of the CDNI convention by all parties, that enforcement is by the ILT with monitoring via e-noses, and that the sector will be engaged to reduce gassing in the meantime.
At Netherlands' initiative a national ban on in-transit gassing will come about on the basis of international agreements.
Op initiatief van Nederland gaat er een nationaal verbod op varend ontgassen komen op grond van internationale afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over varend ontgassen in Flevoland

An MP asks the minister why the ban on onboard gas release (varend ontgassen) in Flevoland waters has not yet taken effect, despite a Chamber motion, and questions the health risks and enforcement gaps. The minister explains the international treaty ratification delay, notes ILT enforces existing rules, and agrees with provinces to pursue earlier emission reductions.

Meanwhile we are not standing still: within the Taskforce 'Varend Ontgassen' the central government works with the provinces, petrochemical, inland shipping and port industry associations on preparing the introduction of onboard gas release ban.

Ondertussen zitten we niet stil: binnen de Taskforce «Varend Ontgassen» werkt het Rijk samen met de provincies, brancheorganisaties uit de petrochemie, de binnenvaart en de havens aan de voorbereidingen van de invoering van het varend ontgassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over varend ontgassen in Flevoland

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of structural venting of carcinogenic gas from ships in Flevoland lakes, the apparent tolerance shown on a ministry map, the enforcement gap between provincial bans and national waters, the ratification status of the CDNI waste convention, and the readiness of venting alternatives and enforcement. The minister answered that there is no toleration policy, that provincial bans do not apply on national waters, that the ban depends on ratification by all states (Belgium, France and Switzerland still pending), and that enforcement and alternatives are being prepared with the sector and provinces.
There is no question of a toleration policy.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over mogelijke dataverzameling van Chinese drones

Written questions from MP Kathmann asked whether data from Chinese DJI drones used by the police and Rijkswaterstaat could flow to Chinese servers, and why Defence avoids them. The government answered that risks are assessed per case, that data safeguards were applied, that police and Rijkswaterstaat will keep using the drones for non-confidential tasks, and that it sees no reason to change course.
Should we nonetheless see cause to discuss this with the police and/or Rijkswaterstaat, we will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Mochten wij alsnog aanleiding zien om hierover in gesprek te gaan met de politie en/of Rijkswaterstaat, dan zullen wij uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de bestuurscrisis bij het Waterschap Hollandse Delta

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she was aware of, analysed, and would take a leading role in resolving the governance crisis at Waterschap Hollandse Delta. The minister acknowledged the situation, noted the board resignations and new appointments, and declined to intervene because the water board is an autonomous body.
The water board is an autonomous public body. I note that the situation is being taken seriously and the various parties are fulfilling their own responsibilities.
Het waterschap is een autonoom overheidslichaam. Ik constateer dat de situatie serieus wordt genomen en de verschillende betrokkenen invulling geven aan hun eigen verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het overschrijven van een voertuig op een andere naam na overlijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether a vehicle can be re-registered after the owner's death using only the registration card and code, without checks on how these were obtained, and whether a blockade requiring a certificate of inheritance should be introduced. Minister Visser answered that the RDW does not check how the card and code were obtained, that a certificate of inheritance is required only when the code cannot be shown, and that a blockade would not fully solve the problem and would impose costs and delays on heirs.
I am not in favour of introducing a block on re-registration after death.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om een blokkade voor overschrijving op te werpen na overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over vervuild slib in de Kaliwaal

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about K3-Delta's plan to deposit PFAS-contaminated dredging sludge in the Kaliwaal depot, the drinking water risks, the applicable norms, and why the permit could not be refused. The State Secretary answered that the permits are still under review, that higher PFAS levels are acceptable at this site according to the province and Rijkswaterstaat, that the handling framework will be published after the summer recess, and that residents can object during the permit procedure.
Both the province and Rijkswaterstaat state that higher PFAS levels are indeed justified in this case.
Zowel de provincie als Rijkswaterstaat geven aan dat hogere PFAS-gehalten in dit geval inderdaad verantwoord zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Vliegverkeer Schiphol blaast zorgelijk veel ultrafijnstof de lucht in'

An MP asked the minister about TNO measurements of ultrafine particles at Schiphol, which were taken when the airport ran at about 60% capacity, and about health risks for airport workers and residents. The minister answered that the RIVM will report in Q1 2022, that the sector is considering a health study for platform workers, and that further steps will be sent to Parliament by end 2021.
In the first quarter of 2022 the RIVM will publish its final report, after which the ministry will consider what the RIVM's conclusions mean for policy and possible measures.

In het eerste kwartaal van 2022 zal het RIVM zijn eindrapportage publiceren, waarna het ministerie zal bezien wat de conclusies van het RIVM betekenen voor het beleid en mogelijk te nemen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Rudmer Heerema en Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: riolen en bruggen kwetsbaar voor hackers’ in het Financieel Dagblad op 14 oktober 2021

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that sewer, bridge and lock control systems are vulnerable to hackers, including a case of a good-faith hacker taking over a city sewer system and delayed patching, and what the government has done on patching, procurement, threat sharing and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister acknowledges the vulnerabilities, reports no successful attacks or Wbni notifications at Rijkswaterstaat or ProRail in the past two years, and describes existing programmes, regulation and ongoing cooperation, while stating no specific case could be confirmed.
Inquiries show no further information is available about a case of a good-faith hacker who was able to take over the sewer system of a large municipality.
Uit navraag blijkt geen nadere informatie beschikbaar over een casus van een goedwillende hacker die het rioleringssysteem van een grote gemeente kon overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de kwetsbaarheid van bruggen en riolen voor hackers

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about hacking vulnerabilities in bridges and sewers, the Court of Audit's earlier criticism, and planned security measures. The minister answered that local authorities are responsible for risk management, reported progress on connecting Rijkswaterstaat objects to a security operations centre with full connection expected by 2023, and noted no known incidents in the Netherlands.
I have received no signals from the sector or umbrella organisations VNG, UvW or IPO that Industrial Control Systems of bridges and sewers at decentralised governments are vulnerable on a large scale

Ik heb geen signalen van de sector of koepelorganisaties VNG, UvW of IPO ontvangen dat Industriële Controle Systemen (ICS) van bruggen en rioleringen bij decentrale overheden op grote schaal kwetsbaar zouden zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vervuilende afscheidsvlucht van de KDC-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a 550 km farewell flight with an old KDC-10 tanker, emitting about 50,540 kg CO2, was justified given climate ambitions and its cost. The minister replied that the flight was a fitting farewell to a plane that transported veterans and supported missions, that it cost about 7,042 euro within the regular budget, and that the non-CO2 effects were insignificant due to low altitude.
The flight was a fitting farewell to the transport aircraft that since 1995 have carried tens of thousands of veterans to various mission and deployment areas and flown them home again.

De vlucht was een passend afscheid van de transporttoestellen die sinds 1995 tienduizenden veteranen naar verschillende missie- en inzetgebieden hebben gebracht en vervolgens weer naar huis hebben gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verbreding van de A4

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the widening of the A4 motorway and a new aqueduct at Roelofarendsveen could start by 2026, whether it could be brought forward, and how congestion will be tackled. The minister gave no guarantee on timing, citing a new 25 km emissions reference distance and procedural requirements, and stated that widening is necessary and that a broader package of congestion measures is being pursued.
At this moment, unfortunately, no guarantees can yet be given about the planning of the motorway construction programme.
Op dit moment kunnen er helaas nog geen garanties gegeven worden over de planning van het aanlegprogramma snelwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Landbouwgif in Maas gedumpt'

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch asked the minister about reports that glyphosate was dumped into the Meuse for about 74 days, and why monitoring at Eijsden did not detect it earlier. The minister confirmed the drinking-water criterion was exceeded, explained that glyphosate is not in the continuous monitoring package and that monthly sampling and lab analysis caused a delay, and described coordination and cross-border warning measures, while the source of the discharge remains unidentified.

In consultation with, among others, the drinking water companies, it is now being discussed how the taking of water samples by different organisations can be better coordinated and timed to follow on from one another.

In overleg met o.a. de drinkwaterbedrijven wordt nu besproken hoe het nemen van watermonsters door verschillende organisaties beter gecoördineerd en aansluitend in de tijd op elkaar kunnen worden ingepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over het vasthouden van water in natuurgebieden om overstromingen te helpen voorkomen

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about retaining water in nature areas to help prevent floods, including the role of agriculture, river space, and responsibilities across government tiers. Minister Schouten answered substantively, describing existing policy, river-widening measures and groundwater frameworks, and committing to further letters on climate adaptation for nature later this autumn.
Action lines on climate adaptation for nature will be communicated to you later this autumn.
Actielijnen klimaatadaptatie natuur u later dit najaar wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat TUI lege vliegtuigen laat overkomen tussen Schiphol en Eindhoven Airport

An SP MP asked the minister about TUI flying empty aircraft between Schiphol and Eindhoven Airport, questioning the noise and emissions impact and asking about structural nature, frequency, and whether operators would be pressed to stop it. The minister answered that such flights are undesirable, are not structural (aircraft expected back at Eindhoven for 2022), gave annual counts, and said the ministry will raise the issue with airlines and promote rail alternatives.
Carrying out flights with empty aircraft is undesirable from the standpoint of energy use (emissions) and nuisance (noise).
Het uitvoeren van vluchten met lege toestellen is vanuit het oogpunt van energiegebruik (emissies) en hinder (geluid) ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht ‘Onnodige tussenstops’ op Eindhoven Airport zetten kwaad bloed bij omwonenden’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about empty repositioning flights between Schiphol and Eindhoven Airport, their emissions and noise, and how they could be banned. The minister said such flights are undesirable, that CO2 share is very small, that EU rules allow only limited restrictions requiring Commission approval, and that airlines will be urged to limit them.
In our contacts with the airlines, my ministry will address them on the undesirability of these flights and the importance of limiting them as much as possible.
In onze contacten met de luchtvaartmaatschappijen zal mijn ministerie hen aanspreken op de onwenselijkheid van deze vluchten en op het belang van het zoveel mogelijk beperken ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht 'Provincie en gemeente Utrecht: 80 km/u alternatief voor verbreding A27

An MP (D66) asked the minister about the Utrecht provinces' proposal for an independent commission on alternatives to widening the A27, the effect of working from home on the need for road expansion, and whether the A27 plans should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the Tracébesluit is pending before the Raad van State, that a new alternatives study is not appropriate for a demissionary cabinet, and that infrastructure investment remains necessary despite more home working.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing and the cabinet is caretaker, a renewed alternatives study, or the establishment of a commission, is not on the table.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt en het kabinet demissionair is, is een hernieuwd alternatievenonderzoek, of instelling van een commissie niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Stikstofdeal met zes boeren die stoppen, A15 kan volgens ministerie daardoor alsnog doorgaan’ in de Gelderlander

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether deals with six livestock farmers allow the A15 extension to proceed despite the 25-km nitrogen limit, and why farms were bought out where external netting is not permitted. The minister confirmed agreements were signed (some before the 25-km rule was set), stated only businesses with a realised capacity were included, cited the Rijk's lifted netting limits and the province's permit withdrawal, and said no irreversible steps will be taken until the Raad van State rules.
Are you willing to take no irreversible steps on the A15 until this has been discussed in the House of Representatives during the MIRT committee consultation?
Bent u bereid geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten op de A15 tot hierover is gesproken in de Tweede Kamer tijdens het notaoverleg MIRT?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Aukje de Vries en Grinwis over het bericht op NOS.nl getiteld ‘Spoorbrug over Van Harinxmakanaal bij Leeuwarden nog wekenlang defect’

MPs Heerema, De Vries and Grinwis asked the minister about a defect that left the Leeuwarden railway bridge over the Van Harinxmakanaal unable to open for shipping for weeks, its causes, repair timeline, communication, inspection frequency, and whether a replacement study is needed. The minister and state secretary answered that the bridge was repaired and reopened in early October, that ProRail sees no need for early replacement or a quickscan, and that inspections and repair costs were addressed.
ProRail did its utmost to restore the functioning of the railway bridge as quickly as possible and was in constant contact with the ministry, the province and the municipality.
ProRail heeft haar uiterste best gedaan de werking van de spoorbrug zo spoedig mogelijk te herstellen en heeft daarbij voortdurend in contact gestaan met het ministerie, de provincie en de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Meer thuiswerken, minder files; is die verbreding van de weg dan wel nodig?' en het PBL-rapport 'Thuiswerken en de gevolgen voor wonen, werken en mobiliteit'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure whether, given the PBL report on telework, seven motorway MIRT projects should be reconsidered and the funds redirected. The minister replied that reconsideration is not for a demissionary cabinet, that infrastructure investment remains necessary, and that the brede welvaart approach is supported.
In general terms, reconsiderations are not something for a demissionary cabinet.
In algemene zin geldt dat heroverwegingen niet aan een demissionair kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de meldingen die gedaan zijn bij het Bewoners Aanspreekpunt Schiphol (BAS) maar zijn ‘kwijtgeraakt’

Van Raan asks the minister about aircraft noise complaints lost from the Schiphol residents' contact point BAS and whether this undermines trust. The minister confirms a small share of 2020 complaints was mis-registered during a system migration, says an independent review is underway and the annual report will be corrected, and points to other trust-building efforts.
Depending on the outcome of the independent investigation, BAS must correct its annual report.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onafhankelijk onderzoek dient BAS haar jaarrapportage te corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over de quarantaineplicht voor gevaccineerde reizigers

Two D66 MPs asked why vaccinated travellers from very-high-risk areas without a variant of concern must quarantine while vaccinated household contacts of positive cases need not, and whether the government will reconsider. The minister answers that from 22 September vaccinated travellers from such areas are exempt from quarantine (a negative test is still required), that quarantine remains for unvaccinated travellers, and that the amendment Paternotte/Kuiken provides the legal basis.

Given the strongly increased vaccination rate in the Netherlands and the limited risk that vaccinated travellers pose to public health for transmission of the coronavirus, the cabinet has decided to exempt vaccinated travellers from the quarantine obligation from 22 September.

Gezien de sterk toegenomen vaccinatiegraad in Nederland en het beperkte risico dat gevaccineerde reizigers voor de volksgezondheid vormen voor de transmissie van het coronavirus, heeft het kabinet besloten gevaccineerde reizigers per 22 september uit te zonderen van de quarantaineplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het toelaten van elektrische steps

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why electric scooters (e-steps) and similar light electric vehicles remain unlicensed in the Netherlands, asking about rental platforms, enforcement, fines, and timelines for legalisation. The minister answered that a national licensing framework is planned for 2023, that enforcement is by police with fines of 280 euro, and that a study on hoverboards and similar devices is expected in spring 2022.
The police do not keep a separate record of enforcement against e-steps.
De politie houdt geen aparte registratie bij van de handhaving op e-steps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de lopende bestelling van Scania vrachtwagens door Defensie en het doorwadingsvermogen van deze voertuigen

Member Van der Plas asked why Defence ordered 2,473 Scania Gryphus trucks with only 75 cm wading capacity, and why only 73 have 150 cm, given the need for flood evacuations, and whether the order will be adjusted. The Minister replied that the ordered trucks serve operational roles for the first and second main tasks, that about 115 have 150 cm wading capacity mainly for amphibious operations, that they can be used for evacuations when conditions allow, and that no change to the order is planned.
No, Defence is receiving with the Scania Gryphus from the subproject Vehicles 50kN, 100kN, 150kN vehicles that fit within the new wheeled vehicle fleet
Nee, Defensie krijgt met de Scania Gryphus uit het deelproject Voertuigen 50kN, 100kN, 150kN voertuigen die passen binnen het nieuwe wielvoertuigenbestand
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Voor vrouw is sfeer op KMA giftig’

An MP asked the Defence State Secretary about reports that the atmosphere at the Royal Military Academy (KMA) is toxic for women, asking how long problems with social safety have been known, what action plans exist, who is responsible, and what is being done about women's position. The minister answered that structural measures under a social-safety plan of action are being embedded, that the KMA-specific Taskforce plan is being implemented over three to five years, and that a planned evaluation of the independent reporting point is due by mid-2022.
The plan of the NLDA, and therefore also specifically for the KMA and the KIM, is currently being implemented.
Het plan van de NLDA, en daarmee ook specifiek voor de KMA en het KIM, wordt op dit moment geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over sociale rechten van personeel in Nederlandse Defensiewinkels in Duitsland

An MP asked the State Secretary about social rights of staff in Dutch Army Shops in Germany, including whether TVAL II contracts reduce AOW pension accrual and whether the shop staff would receive full AOW later. The minister answered that accrued insurance periods are not lost, that workers are insured in Germany under EU rules, that the Netherlands does not accept the claim of compensation, and that the shops no longer exist.
These temporary workers are not included in Defence's personnel administration; therefore it is also not known how many partners of Dutch military personnel stationed in Germany are involved.
Deze inhuurkrachten zijn niet opgenomen in de personeelsadministratie van Defensie; derhalve is ook niet bekend om hoeveel partners van in Duitsland gelegerde Nederlandse militairen het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over het bericht ‘De F-35 fersteurt it libben fan Friezen’

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that F-35 noise causes stress, sleeplessness and disturbance for residents near Leeuwarden air base, and whether the noise norms should be reconsidered. The State Secretary acknowledged the nuisance, said the 35 Ke norm is respected and noise measurement networks and local consultation committees exist, but declined to change the norm and only offered to explore operational adjustments.
Defence is certainly willing to look for ways to limit the nuisance, for example by adjusting flight procedures during take-off and landing.
Defensie is zeker bereid om te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om de hinder te beperken, bijvoorbeeld door het aanpassen van vliegprocedures tijdens start en landing.
Antwoord op vraen van het lid Jansen over de voortgang van de CAO-onderhandelingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the delayed revision of the military pay structure (loongebouw), the timing of a new structure, the refusal of a 2% extra pay margin demanded by unions, and the reliance on market wage developments. The State Secretary answered that the revision was delayed due to complexity and failed negotiations, that talks resumed in July 2021, and that pay follows the market-based wage development set by cabinet policy.
The pay structure is a particularly complex subject, as a result of which the agreed date of 1 July 2020 proved unrealistic and social partners have been unable to reach agreement on it.

Het loongebouw is een bijzonder complex onderwerp, waardoor de afgesproken datum van 1 juli 2020 niet realistisch is gebleken en sociale partners geen overeenstemming hebben kunnen bereiken over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over inkoop van materieel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the procurement of nearly 3,000 Scania Gryphus trucks, their production status, height limits for containers on public roads, the review of the purchase, consultation with end users, procurement rules, and sports shoes for personnel. The government answered that the purchase is deliberate and not an error, that the vehicles meet road rules with adapted containers, that end users were consulted, and that the sports shoe allowance is not a current priority.
There is no question of an error.
Er is geen sprake van een fout.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over herkomst van materieel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence for a list of standard military clothing and equipment with the country of production for each item, and whether more materiel should be produced in the Netherlands. The government answered that there is no single standard kit, that a full country-of-origin overview cannot practically be generated, and that procurement follows EU and Dutch rules while aiming for Dutch industry involvement.
Due to the intertwining of more than ten thousand article-supplier combinations across hundreds of different clothing and equipment packages, it is not possible to generate a total overview.

Door de vervlechting van meer dan tienduizend artikel-leverancier combinaties in honderden verschillende kleding- en uitrustingspakketten is het niet mogelijk hiervan een totaaloverzicht te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over militair vastgoed

An MP asked whether Defence has only 60-65% funding for its property portfolio, whether a 40% reduction is being studied, whether the army was asked to shrink its portfolio, and about links to emissions reduction and renewable energy on military land, and whether defence sites should be exempt from building and environmental permits. The State Secretary confirmed an interdepartmental review recommends a 35-40% reduction, that an internal exploration is underway with decisions left to the next cabinet, and that Defence will follow environmental and permit rules.
Decision-making on this is up to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming hierover is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Belhaj en Piri over het uit de vaart nemen van een marineschip door een ernstig tekort aan personeel

MPs asked the State Secretary why technical staff shortages forced the navy to take Johan de Wit and Van Speijk out of service, and how Defence plans to create specialist career paths to retain personnel. The government attributes the decommissioning to staff shortages and to redeploying crews to other ships, and sets out HR transition measures including specialist career paths that still need union agreement.
The temporary removal from service of Johan de Wit and Van Speijk is driven by two causes.
Het tijdelijk uit de vaart halen van Zr. Ms. Johan de Wit (JWIT) en Zr. Ms. Van Speijk (VSPK) wordt door twee oorzaken ingegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het munitietekort van militairen

Van Haga asks whether the defence ammunition budget for training falls structurally from 140 to 80 million euro from 2023, what the consequences are, and how training quality, staff morale and vacancies (over 9,000) will be safeguarded. The State Secretary says there is no structural cut, that a 40 million euro top-up is used for 2020-2022 with a structural fix still being sought, and that vacancies and HR measures are addressed in a separate letter.
To fully solve the mismatch structurally, further steps will be considered depending on the room in the Defence budget.
Om de volledige mismatch structureel op te lossen, worden afhankelijk van de ruimte op de Defensiebegroting, verdere stappen bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Stop procedure voor de radar in Herwijnen’

MP Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence why the ministry still suggested the radar might be placed in Herwijnen despite a parliamentary motion to stop that procedure and seek another site, and whether the website wording could be changed. The State Secretary answered that the intention to implement the motion stands, that the Herwijnen site remains the best available on current studies, that the alternative-site and radiation studies are still ongoing with results expected after summer 2021, and that no irreversible steps will be taken in the meantime.

At the same time, due care requires that I have better insight into the consequences of stopping the RCR procedure, so that it is clear how the surveillance of Dutch airspace could otherwise be provided for.
Tegelijkertijd vereist de zorgvuldigheid dat ik meer zicht heb op de gevolgen van het stoppen van de RCR-procedure
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de verkoop van Nederlandse MP5’s in een Maltese wapenhandel

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Defence about the sale of 2,084 surplus Dutch firearms (Glock pistols, m2.50 and MP5 submachine guns) to a Dutch dealer apparently destined for a Maltese arms shop, questioning the sale method, export implications and EU compliance. The government answered that the sale was lawful under EU and Dutch rules, that policy is being tightened to exclude sales of firearms to private parties, and that it bought back only the unsold weapons, arguing it lacks a legal basis to recover the rest.

That is why I have instructed that a new assessment framework be drawn up for disposing of surplus Defence materiel, tightening policy by excluding sales of firearms to private parties other than the manufacturer or a manufacturer's licence holder.

Daarom heb ik ook opdracht gegeven om een nieuw afwegingskader op te stellen voor het afstoten van overtollig Defensiematerieel, waarin het beleid wordt aangescherpt door de verkoop van handvuurwapens aan private partijen, niet zijnde de fabrikant of een licentiehouder van de fabrikant, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het tekort aan gepantserde voertuigen bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee

MP Stoffer asks about the shortage of armoured vehicles at the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee, its causes and duration, liability for the replacement Toyota Land Cruisers, the cost, effects on the High Risk Protection Platoons, and risks flagged by the Defence Intervention Team. The state secretary replies that there is no current shortage since new vehicles were delivered on 4 March 2021, that the French supplier is in default and legal action is being prepared, that cost is not yet known, and that the platoons could keep operating using older vehicles.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Palland over het bericht 'Gaat de Nederlandse industrie aan boord van Nederlandse onderzeeboten?'

MPs Van Helvert and Palland (CDA) asked about concerns that Dutch industry may not be included in the new submarines given the three-yard competition, the cost burden on SMEs, and knock-out criteria for industrial participation. The government replied that essential security interests and strategic autonomy will be secured through primary and secondary requirements in the procurement, that a parallel industrial cooperation agreement led by EZK will pursue broader Dutch involvement, and that no fixed participation percentage is imposed in advance.
Defence will, after testing in the dialogue, set requirements in the D-phase to safeguard essential national security interests and strategic autonomy.
Defensie zal daarbij, na toetsing in de dialoog, in de D-fase eisen stellen ter borging van het wezenlijk nationaal veiligheidsbelang en de strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over eventuele registratie homoseksualiteit bij Defensie

MPs Bergkamp and Belhaj asked about the treatment of LGBTI personnel in the Dutch armed forces, including past S5 unfitness markings for homosexuality and whether restitution is possible. The Secretary of State answered that no current cases of discharge or refusal for sexual orientation have surfaced, that the S5 marking was used only at pre-1974 conscription screening, and that individual cases will be reviewed while awaiting ongoing historical research.
I am always willing to look at individual cases, however there is so far no reason to conduct large-scale research into this.
Ik ben altijd bereid te kijken naar individuele gevallen, echter er blijkt vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zijn om hier grootschalig onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de gewijzigde vliegroute van straaljagers boven Vliehors

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the changed fighter-jet flight route over the Vliehors range, the legal challenge by Texel organisations, consultation of Texel municipality, noise impact, and whether the Wadden area is being designated a NATO exercise area. The government answered that the change responds to a 2013 safety incident, noise stays within permit limits, Texel's alternative route was rejected for safety reasons, and the court ruling is pending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over chroom-6 in PC-7 lestoestellen in Woensdrecht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether chromium-6 had been found in 13 PC-7 training aircraft at Woensdrecht, why it was investigated, and how this squares with the 2018 letter on chromium-6 paint. The State Secretary confirmed chromium-6 dust was found in an avionics bay, flying was briefly halted, aircraft were cleaned and flying resumed, and the interior chromium-6 paint is not replaced because no chromium-free system is certified for enclosed parts.
The interior paint system will not be replaced, because no chromium-free paint system has been certified for enclosed parts.
Het verfsysteem aan de binnenzijde wordt niet vervangen, omdat er geen chroomvrij verfsysteem is gecertificeerd voor afgesloten delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Nieuwe radar in Wier maakt 's nachts te veel geluid'

An MP asked why residents near the new Wier radar were not warned earlier about night-time noise, whether any prior study was done, and how long operational problems will last. The Secretary of State said no information sessions were held because the project fit the existing zoning plan, a digital session was held in January 2021, and operational use is planned for early April, while many specifics were referred to earlier answers.
Defence works intensively with the manufacturer Thales to investigate the cause of the noise problem and the interference with WiFi/TV signals and (outdoor) lamps.
Antwoord 6 Met de fabrikant Thales wordt intensief samengewerkt om de oorzaak van de geluidsproblematiek en de verstoringen van de WiFi/TV-signalen en (buiten)lampen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het ’s nachts uitschakelen van de SMART-L-radar in Wier

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence why the SMART-L radar at Wier is switched off at night, its distance from the village, and the status of finding an alternative site to Herwijnen. The government answered that night operation exceeds noise norms and is unnecessary during testing, that at least two radars are needed for structural airspace surveillance, and that a new alternative-location study is being started.
Compensating for the lost radar coverage with temporary and limited alternatives is not a structural guarantee of airspace surveillance.
Het opvangen van de weggevallen radardekking met tijdelijke en beperkte alternatieven is geen structurele borging van luchtruimbewaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over overlast door nieuwe SMART-L radar in Wier

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Defence about nighttime noise and other complaints from residents near the new SMART-L radar in Wier, and about the plan for the second radar at Herwijnen and a motion to find another site. The State Secretary answered that the radar is switched off at night, that Defence will work with Thales to meet noise norms, that the permit was granted in 2020, and that the second radar's permit is pending, though the answers on Herwijnen and the motion were partly deferred or evasive.
At all times Defence must comply with the applicable noise standards laid down in the environmental permit, including at night.
Te allen tijde moet Defensie voldoen aan de geldende geluidsnormen, zoals opgenomen in de omgevingsvergunning, ook ‘s nachts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de disfunctionerende nieuwe radar te Wier

Fritsma (PVV) asks the state secretary of Defence how a new radar at Wier emits more noise than expected, why the defect surfaced late, how and when residents' nuisance will be fixed, and whether air surveillance is reduced. The state secretary explains the noise was only found in on-site tests, a fix is being investigated with the manufacturer over the coming weeks, and radar coverage is reduced during the transition but compensated only partially.
Currently it is being investigated which measures can be taken to reduce the noise load of the radar.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke maatregelen kunnen worden genomen om de geluidsbelasting van de radar te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de MQ-9 Reaper drones en over vergunningen voor vliegbasis Leeuwarden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about the armed potential of MQ-9 Reaper drones, civilian harm, and environmental permits (nitrogen and noise) for Leeuwarden air base, and whether residents can access full study information. The state secretary said arming the MQ-9 is not yet in defence plans but is being considered, stated that classified noise data are withheld while the permit authorities decide what is published, and said there are no significant effects on Natura 2000 areas.

If Defence states in the permit application that parts of the information supplied are classified, the competent authority includes a justification in the decision and those parts are not made available for public inspection.

Als Defensie bij de vergunningsaanvraag stelt dat delen van de geleverde informatie geclassificeerd zijn, dan wordt door het bevoegd gezag in de beschikking een motivering opgenomen en worden die delen niet ter inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de stand van zaken rond de gebreken aan de F-35 vliegtuigen (Joint Strike Fighters)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the status of design and software defects in the F-35, the number of unresolved and category 1 defects, the fault-bearing and cost recovery from the manufacturer, and whether the aircraft purchase was a mistake. The government answered that defect lists are snapshots, nine category 1 defects remain for the F-35A with mitigation measures in place, the fuel-line problem is still under investigation, costs follow the cost-share ratio, and the project remains on track for operational milestones.
Due to the classification of this information, I cannot provide your House with details on the specific nature of the category 1 deficiencies and the measures taken.
Vanwege de classificering van deze informatie kan ik uw Kamer in deze brief geen details verstrekken over de specifieke aard van de categorie 1 tekortkomingen en de getroffen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Slootweg over het bericht 'Militairen betaalden te veel voor pensioen’

MPs Van Helvert and Slootweg asked whether seven former military personnel who sued over pension premiums charged from 2004 to 2018 were overcharged, and whether Defence should compensate them. The State Secretary answered that the correct premiums were charged under annual agreements with the unions, rejected compensation, and promised to inform the House of the court outcome.
Defence takes the position that the correct pension premium was always charged, as agreed annually with the unions.
Defensie stelt zich op het standpunt dat altijd de juiste pensioenpremie in rekening is gebracht, zoals die (jaarlijks) is overeengekomen met de vakbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Ellemeet, Kerstens en Ploumen over de anti-abortus lobby van de Krijgsmacht Bisschop

MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence whether the Military Bishop's letter calling abortion 'child sacrifices' fits Defence norms, whether the Military Ordinariate is funded by Defence, and whether he will talk to the bishop about using his title for political lobbying. The government answered that the statements do not fit Defence values, that the title is not an official Defence title and the bishop is responsible for his own statements, that the Ordinariate receives no Defence funding, and that it will not separately engage with the bishop on the matter.
No, these statements do not fit within the norms and values of Defence.
Nee, deze uitlatingen passen niet binnen de normen en waarden van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het luchthavenbesluit Gilze-Rijen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether changed plans for the Gilze-Rijen air base mean the airbase decision should start over, and whether the noise and rattle-noise research was properly conducted. The State Secretary replied that the plans have been adjusted with measures agreed with local officials, that prioritising the De Peel decision postpones the Gilze-Rijen decision, that an Information Note will be published, and that consultation with residents continues.
This Information Note answers a large number of the questions raised in the submissions responding to the EIA and the draft airbase decision.
Deze Informatienota geeft antwoord op een groot aantal van de vragen zoals die in de zienswijzen in reactie op het MER en het ontwerpluchthavenbesluit zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het lopende onderzoek van de FIOD naar scheepsbouwbedrijf Damen Shipyards

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Defence and Finance when the FIOD investigation into alleged corruption at Damen Shipyards would conclude, whether criminal investigations into other defence suppliers are known, whether the appeal on disclosure of documents is resolved, and whether pending criminal investigations should be considered in defence procurement. The government declined to comment on ongoing investigations, reported that the Wob appeal was withdrawn and the documents disclosed in September 2019, and stated that pending investigations and suspicions are not grounds for exclusion under procurement rules, which require a final conviction, citing the presumption of innocence and proportionality; it also described compliance measures taken at Damen after the World Bank sanction.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het rapport "Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol" van de Algemene Rekenkamer (20

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about the Court of Audit's report on cybersecurity of border control at Schiphol, covering approval procedures, security testing, critical systems, crisis exercises and transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol. The government answered that approvals and added security measures are underway with full implementation expected by end 2020, that annual testing is not feasible given staffing, that not all critical systems are yet connected to the SOC, that an exercise and an update of guidelines will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before any transfer of the self-service system.
The cabinet will inform the Chamber further about the intended decision and the conditions under which it takes place before the transfer takes place.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer nader informeren over het voorgenomen besluit en de voorwaarden waaronder dit gebeurt voordat overdracht plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Bellingcat: Bierapp Untappd kan gebruikt worden om militairen te volgen'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that the beer app Untappd could be used to track soldiers, raising concerns about leaked personal data and national security. The minister acknowledged the risks, said existing defence security policy from 2018 still applies, and stated that Defence relies on awareness, risk assessment and mission-specific rules rather than new concrete measures.
Defence is aware of the vulnerabilities that smart devices bring.
Defensie is zich bewust van de kwetsbaarheden die smart devices met zich meebrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Defensie vliegt langer zonder vergunning'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence why the permit application under the Nature Conservation Act for military flying activities has been delayed since 2008, what consequences the delay has, and whether the application will be filed by October 2020. The State Secretary answered that the environmental analyses are largely complete, the Vliehors application is expected by 1 August 2020 and all applications by 1 October 2020, while legal and financial consequences are deferred to the enforcement body, which decided on 20 May 2020 that no enforcement was warranted.
Regarding the legal and financial consequences, I do not wish to anticipate the decision of LNV on this enforcement request when answering this question.
Voor wat betreft de juridische en financiële gevolgen wil ik bij de beantwoording van deze vraag niet vooruitlopen op het besluit van LNV op dit handhavingsverzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ‘losse eindjes ten aanzien van de compensatie van het AOW-gat van gewezen militairen’

SP MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary for Defence about outstanding issues in compensating former military personnel for the AOW gap, whether the government accepts their claim of disadvantage, whether the UGM benefit should run to the AOW age, and the costs. The State Secretary replied that the AOW gap is structurally resolved for new personnel, that the compensation of 100% of the justified entitlement is an adequate arrangement, that formal regulation is pending consultation with unions, and that continuing the UGM to AOW age would cost about 2 billion euro.
It is my intention to schedule a concluding conversation with Mr Van den H. as soon as that is possible.
Het is mijn intentie om een afrondend gesprek met de heer Van den H. in te plannen zodra dat mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over de leefbaarheid rondom AWACS-basis Geilenkirchen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about noise nuisance from AWACS flights at Geilenkirchen, including the promised livability fund, flight timing, flight statistics and quieter engines. The State Secretary answered that noise is declining and flight counts have halved since 2004, that a livability fund is still under discussion with the region and will be revisited after COVID-19 measures are lifted, and that engine replacement is not pursued because the business case has weakened.
I will also send these to you.
Ik zal u deze ook doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Justitie wil eind aan juridische lijdensweg voor agent met trauma’

An MP asks the Defence minister whether police and military PTSD experiences are comparable, whether soldiers deserve the best treatment, and how often traumatised soldiers must litigate against Defence and how long that takes. The minister says the Regeling Volledige Schadevergoeding (2014) has made claims largely unnecessary, that settlement takes about 2.5 years, and that a review of the scheme is underway.
The percentage asked about is therefore effectively zero.
Het percentage waarnaar gevraagd wordt is derhalve feitelijk nul.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de uitbreiding van vliegbasis Leeuwarden

An MP asked whether Leeuwarden air base lacks the required permits yet continues to expand, and whether the ministry follows the law. The state secretary acknowledges missing items and an overdue revision request, says a nature permit is expected by 1 October 2020, and states that projects proceed only once the required permissions are obtained.
For these projects, the necessary permits have been requested on behalf of Defence by the Central Government Real Estate Agency and issued by the competent authority.
Voor deze projecten zijn de benodigde toestemmingen namens Defensie door het Rijkvastgoedbedrijf aangevraagd en door het bevoegd gezag afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Defensie klimaatactivisme en werken als reservist onverenigbaar vindt

An MP asked whether Defence considers climate activism incompatible with serving as a reservist, and whether this restricts the right to demonstrate. The government answers that climate activism is not in principle incompatible with reservist service, that the right to demonstrate applies to military personnel subject to limits in the Wet ambtenaren Defensie, and that individual cases cannot be discussed publicly.
Taking action for a liveable planet is in principle not assessed by Defence as incompatible with working as a reservist.
Actie voeren voor een leefbare aarde wordt bij Defensie in beginsel niet als onverenigbaar met het werken als reservist beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Defensie-medewerkers mogen werkelijke schade chroom-6 claimen'

MP Kerstens asked whether the State Secretary of Defence would forgo further appeal against a court ruling that chromium-6 victims may claim actual damages beyond the flat-rate compensation, and whether that ruling would be applied to all recipients, and asked how much of the reserved budget has been paid out. The State Secretary answered that the government is still studying the ruling and cannot yet decide on appeal, that individual claims beyond the flat rate will be assessed case by case, and that 2.7 million euro (Coulance scheme) and 1.6 million euro (Uitkeringsregeling) net has been paid out, with the reserved budget being an estimate rather than a maximum.
Defence is still studying the ruling, however, and I cannot yet say whether or not an appeal will be lodged.
Defensie bestudeert de uitspraak echter nog en ik kan nog geen uitspraak doen over het al dan niet instellen van een rechtsmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de RVU-boete

The MP asked the State Secretary of Defence how many soldiers since 2010 used the early retirement scheme (RVU), the total amount Defence has had to pay in RVU levy, and how much the 2008 Marine Air Service merger saved. The government answered that 6,971 soldiers left under compulsory age dismissal since 2010, gave the levy paid across the FLO, UGM and AOW-gap schemes, and stated that the merger had no savings targets and its efficiency cannot be assessed.
The merger of the Marine Air Service into the Defence Helicopter Command (DHC) in 2008 had no savings targets.
Het opgaan van de Marine Luchtvaartdienst in het Defensie Helikopter Commando (DHC) in 2008 had geen bezuinigingsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de voortgang van het project Grensverleggende IT (GrIT)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Defence about the delayed GrIT IT project, the possible damages claim from IBM, operational risks, the single-contractor decision, governance and cost limits. The State Secretary answered that scenarios are being validated and will be shared confidentially, that the chosen scenario will be checked by ADR and a BIT test, and that cost details remain confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
During the tender, Defence makes no statements about commercially confidential information.
Tijdens de aanbesteding doet Defensie geen uitspraken over commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de ICT vernieuwing bij Defensie compleet mislukt is

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why the Kamer has not yet been informed about the GrIT ICT renewal, what the consequences of delay or cancellation are, whether underlying documents will be published, and how many misconduct incidents must occur before order is restored. The State Secretary replies that a closed technical briefing took place on 12 March, that financial details are withheld for commercial confidentiality during an ongoing tender, that the government rejects the characterisation of the situation, and that a reorganisation is underway.
I am not disclosing any financial details, because of the confidentiality of this information.
Ik breng hierbij geen financiële gegevens naar buiten, vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de berichten ‘Cruciaal IT-project bij Defensie dreigt te mislukken’ en ‘In een digitale oorlog doet de Nederlandse krijgsmacht er nu niet toe’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the GrIT IT project may fail, including the reported price ceiling, the exclusive rights bought from IBM/Atos, threatened damage claims, the continuity of Defence IT, and the BIT advice. The State Secretary answers most questions, largely by referring to commercial confidentiality, the ongoing tender and a confidential briefing, while promising a confidential letter and a BIT review expected in Q3 2020.
During the procurement I make no statements about commercially confidential information.
Tijdens de aanbesteding doe ik geen uitspraken over commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Friesland op achterste benen om laagvliegroute F-35’

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary for Defence why the province of Friesland was not consulted before the dormant low-flying route Linkroute-10A was to be reactivated for F-35 training, and whether Defence would hold open consultation and inform Parliament. The State Secretary answered that a Natura 2000 effects analysis is still pending, that the route was suspended in 2002 due to safety and noise concerns which remain, that a decision on its future is promised before 1 June 2020 after informing the provinces and stakeholders, and that the questions could not be answered before the 4 February consultation meeting.
At the consultation meeting of 18 February I promised your House to provide clarity on the future of Linkroute-10A before 1 June 2020.
Tijdens het VAO op 18 februari heb ik uw kamer toegezegd om voor 1 juni 2020 duidelijkheid te bieden over de toekomst van de Linkroute-10A.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de JSF wederom teleurstelt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the F-35's gun has accuracy flaws, including the financial and safety consequences and whether costs could be recovered from the manufacturer, and asked for a full list of defects and costs. The State Secretary confirmed the GAO-reported gun deficiency, said mitigation measures reduce the safety risk to acceptable levels, and refused to publish the full list of defects because it is classified.
An overview as requested cannot be made public.
Een overzicht zoals gevraagd kan niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over bestaan van een onderzoek naar Nieuw-Milligen als nieuwe locatie voor een marinierskazerne

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether a study exists on Nieuw-Milligen as a new location for the Marine Corps barracks, whether all completed location studies will be sent to parliament, and what steps will be taken toward affected municipalities. The government refers to its letter of 14 February 2020, enclosing four memos on the selection process, says it regrets the flawed process and will take two voorgenomen besluiten, and says talks with Apeldoorn have been held confidentially.
Enclosed with that letter you will find four memos describing the step-by-step selection using the assessment framework.
Bijgesloten bij die brief vindt u een viertal nota’s die de stapsgewijze selectie aan de hand van het afwegingskader beschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de voornemens aangaande de verhuizing van de marinierskazerne naar Vlissingen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether a proposal to locate the marine corps barracks near Apeldoorn was on the cabinet agenda, despite plans to move it to Vlissingen, and what the regional economic prospects are. The State Secretary acknowledged the process went poorly and that Zeeland's trust was damaged, announced two intended decisions (not building the barracks in Vlissingen and jointly developing a compensation package), but did not directly confirm or deny the Apeldoorn agenda item.
The cabinet therefore takes two intended decisions regarding the relocation.
Het kabinet neemt inzake de verhuizing daarom twee voorgenomen besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie 1800 mariniers wil huisvesten in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether the reported plan to house 1800 marines in Apeldoorn is accurate, requested all underlying documents, and asked that the Doorn barracks be kept open. The State Secretary answered that the matter is set out in a letter to the House of 14 February, without giving substance in this answer.
I refer you for this to my letter 'proposed decisions regarding the relocation of the Marine Corps and compensation Zeeland' which was sent to your House on 14 February.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn brief «voorgenomen besluiten inzake verhuizing Korps Mariniers en compensatie Zeeland» die op 14 februari aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over een bijna-kamikazeactie met een helikopter

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister and State Secretary about a reported near-collision of a military helicopter with a riding stable during an exercise, and whether Defence would apologise and respond to complaints. The State Secretary denied any near-accident, said the flights were within the permit, that the stable owner was contacted by phone, and that no apology was due, while promising to examine incidents.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat militairen kampen met een kledingtekort

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether he was aware of reports that soldiers face a clothing shortage, whether the union's claims are accurate, why Parliament learns of problems via the media, and why the government spends on other projects. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, described ongoing clothing projects and supply measures, said a complete list of shortages cannot be given because stocks fluctuate, and pointed to existing reporting channels while refusing to provide a full overview of all problems.
Because stocks fluctuate, the articles that are not sufficiently in stock change, and no exhaustive overview can be provided.
Omdat de voorraden fluctueren, wisselen de artikelen die niet afdoende voorradig zijn en kan geen limitatief overzicht worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht 'Weer gedoe bij kleding defensie’

An MP asks the state secretary for Defence about reported shortages of winter jackets, uniforms and other clothing and equipment, soldiers buying items themselves, and whether budgets were exceeded. The government acknowledges shortages and delivery problems, describes ongoing projects and interim measures, but gives no guarantee and no firm timeline.
To ensure timely delivery, measures are being taken to make better use of framework contracts, apply existing emergency procedures in time, and improve planning and management of demand and supply.

Om te zorgen voor een tijdige levering zijn en worden er maatregelen genomen om beter gebruik te maken van raamcontracten, bestaande noodprocedures tijdig toe te passen en de planning en het beheer van vraag en aanbod te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over niet-Nederlanders in de krijgsmacht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether Marechaussee job postings via Randstad omit the Dutch nationality requirement required by the AMAR, and how often article 11 AMAR exceptions to that requirement have been used. The State Secretary answered that the postings concern civilian border guard jobs governed by the BARD, not the AMAR, and that seven non-Dutch interpreters were appointed under article 11 in 2004-2007.

A search in the personnel system on appointment article 11 AMAR shows that in the past seven persons with a non-Dutch nationality were temporarily appointed as military personnel on the basis of this article.

Uit een zoekslag in het personeelssysteem op het aanstellingsartikel 11 AMAR blijkt dat er in het verleden zeven personen met een niet-Nederlandse nationaliteit tijdelijk als militair zijn aangesteld op basis van dit artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over jarenlange sabotage van auto’s van militairen

An MP from PVV asked the Defence minister about reported long-running sabotage of military personnel's cars (loosened wheel bolts), whether earlier incidents were made public, what damage and costs resulted, and whether soldiers were compensated. The minister said the Military Police is investigating on behalf of the Public Prosecution Service, gave limited details on incidents and no findings, and noted a nationwide alert was issued.
I cannot make statements about the content of this investigation; that is up to the Public Prosecution Service.
Over de inhoud van dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraken doen, dat is aan het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat het JSF-project opnieuw honderden miljoenen duurder uitvalt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the F-35 programme's further cost overruns, linked to unhedged currency risk and alleged poor procurement, were acceptable, and whether the investments should be reversed. The State Secretary answered that the currency reserve is exhausted, unit prices in dollars are falling, the additional F-35s are a NATO priority, and the cost-benefit analysis was validated by the Court of Audit, without committing to reversing the investment.
The cabinet is examining how the Defence budget can be further made resilient against currency fluctuations.
Het kabinet onderzoekt op welke manier de schokbestendigheid van de Defensiebegroting tegen valutaschommelingen verder kan worden vergroot.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de zaak van klokkenluider Victor van Wulfen en een arts van Defensie die een consult en ziektebeeld verzon, opschreef in zijn medische dossier en daarvoor beris

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why a Defence doctor who recorded a non-existent consultation and diagnosis in a whistleblower's file was only publicly reprimanded, and whether the Inspectorate's findings and document access were adequate. The State Secretary answered that the disciplinary ruling is noted, declined to comment further while appeal was possible, rejected independent re-investigation and found no evidence of fraud, but gave limited reasons for withholding some documents from the complainant.
I do not consider it opportune to go further into the ruling of the Regional Disciplinary Board, partly because the period for appeal is still running.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om nader in te gaan op uitspraak van het Regionaal Tuchtcollege, mede omdat de termijn om daartegen beroep in te stellen nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over de vertraging van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Frisokazerne in Assen

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked why the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen is delayed by a year, despite earlier promises of operation in summer, and what is being done about food safety and meal quality. The state secretary acknowledges the one-year delay, explains it by a switch to a new interim kitchen location after the old building proved unfit, and states the kitchen is expected in the second half of 2020 while meals are supplied from elsewhere.
Is it correct that the placement of the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen has been delayed by one year?
Klopt het dat de plaatsing van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Friso kazerne in Assen met een jaar vertraagd is?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de omvorming van onze krijgsmacht tot een vreemdelingenlegioen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary of Defence whether the Coalition for Security's call to open the armed forces to non-EU nationals, which it calls a foreign legion, is credible and whether it should be dismissed. The State Secretary answers that opening to non-Dutch nationals is a political choice, that a feasibility study on opening to EU citizens is underway, and that the government will instead pursue unused domestic recruitment potential, not the coalition's proposal.
I will not adopt the CvV's suggestion to open Defence to citizens from outside the EU.
Ik zal de suggestie van de CvV om Defensie voor burgers van buiten de EU open te stellen niet overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat straaljagers van Defensie zonder vergunning boven het Wad vliegen

MP Wassenberg asked whether Defence jets fly over the Wadden Sea without the required nature permit, why earlier promises were not met, and whether flights should be suspended. The government answered that permit applications for military flight activities are being prepared for submission in Q1 2020, that flights at standard altitudes need no further assessment, and that suspension is not necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat naar aanleiding interne memo’s op het gebied van een corruptieaffaire bij Damen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries whether Damen breached anti-corruption rules after incorrect information on agent payments in 14 cases, whether such conduct is systematic, whether Damen should be excluded from Atradius DSB guarantees, and whether corruption should weigh in the submarine tender. The government declined to judge while the criminal investigation runs, described corrective measures (reassessed cases, lifted World Bank listing, enhanced supervision), and saw no reason to exclude Damen from guarantees or the tender.
Because a criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about that.
Omdat er nog sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan Defensie gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the Defence Ministry for the costs attributable to people with a non-Western migration background, including Marechaussee enforcement of removals, chaplaincy and halal catering, and the benefits those groups bring. The government answered that Defence has no insight into costs by migration background, gave Marechaussee Vreemdelingenwet costs of EUR 184.8 million in 2018 without any breakdown by origin, and described the chaplaincy and catering arrangements without attributing costs to specific groups.
Defence has no insight into the costs arising from the presence of citizens with a (non-Western/Western) migration background in the Netherlands.
Defensie heeft geen inzicht in de kosten die voortvloeien uit de aanwezigheid van burgers met een (niet-westerse/westerse) migratieachtergrond in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over onderzeeboten van Nederlandse makelij

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence whether he knows that unions and VNO-NCW favour Dutch-built submarines, and whether he will stop the procurement process and choose the Saab-Damen design to boost Dutch industry. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the reports and said the submarine replacement project follows the agreed Defence Materiel Process, with a B-letter to the House later this year, and declined to pre-empt that decision.
As stated in the Defence project overview of 17 September, the House will receive the B-letter for this project later this year.
Zoals vermeld in het Defensieprojectenoverzicht van 17 september jl. zal de Kamer later dit jaar de B-brief ontvangen van dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat gemeente Utrechtse Heuvelrug de marinierskazerne wil omvormen tot een groen dorp

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the government would disregard the municipality of Utrechtse Heuvelrug's call to keep the marine barracks in Doorn open to the Mariniers and halt consultation on converting it into a green village, and whether municipalities fail military personnel and veterans. The State Secretary answered that Defence and the municipality keep each other informed, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is coordinating the site's future with local parties, and that development work in Doorn was suspended in consultation with the municipality and province, while denying that municipalities neglect veterans.
Of course we will continue to consult with each other.
Uiteraard blijven we in overleg met elkaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de burnpits doofpot

The PVV MP Popken asks the defence minister why a TNO study on burn pits was not made public, requests a full overview of military health risks, and asks whether officials should be punished and victims compensated. The minister says the study was a toxicology R&D programme whose results could not support health conclusions and that it would have been better to publish it, while medical secrecy limits a full overview, a health monitoring system is planned, and the link between burn pit emissions and health complaints is not yet clear enough to warrant compensation or accountability measures.

It is not possible to give an exhaustive overview of all reported and known health problems and health risks among military personnel, because much of this information falls under medical confidentiality.

Het is niet mogelijk om een limitatief overzicht te geven van alle gemelde en bekendstaande gezondheidsproblemen en gezondheidsrisico's bij militairen omdat veel van deze informatie valt onder het medisch geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het feit dat Defensie liever investeert in een zonneauto dan in veilige Defensie-gebouwen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Defence why the ministry invests in a solar car while barracks are fire-unsafe, and questions costs, documents, and whether this breaches transparency and duty of care. The State Secretary answers that fire-safety works and fire watches are budgeted and reported, that the car cost EUR 144,000 and is available to all staff for learning, and that the ministry denies neglecting duty of care while acknowledging backlog maintenance.
During a tender procedure, no commercially confidential information is given to the media.
Ten tijde van een aanbesteding wordt er geen commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie aan de media gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over “het bericht dat militairen twijfelen of zij een ijsje moeten meenemen voor een collega met een Arabisch klinkende achternaam tijdens de Ramadan”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about Defence's support for the Multicultural Network Defence (MND), its advisory role, whether diversity is placed above quality, and why veterans' initiatives receive less attention. The State Secretary answered that support is part of broader support for diversity networks, that MND advice is informal and cannot be listed exhaustively, that quality is the leading principle, and that veteran care is handled through the Veteraneninstituut and related channels.
Such advice is not formalised and it is also not my intention to formalise it in the future.
Dergelijke adviezen zijn niet geformaliseerd en het is ook niet mijn voornemen om dit in de toekomst te formaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de rookcultuur bij Defensie

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretaries of Defence and of Health about reports of a smoking culture within the armed forces, including smoking rates, the exclusion of tobacco prevention from the 'Duurzaam Gezond Inzetbaar' policy, the closure of the smoking-cessation clinic, and very cheap cigarettes at the Brunssum NATO base. The government replied that smoking in vehicles and workplaces is banned, that smoking behaviour is a personal choice so no study is planned, that cessation support has been moved to Defence health centres, and that the low Brunssum prices follow from NATO status-of-forces rules, with illegal resale to be addressed by the Royal Marechaussee if signals arise.
Research into the smoking behaviour of military personnel is therefore not something I consider necessary.
Onderzoek naar het rookgedrag van militairen vind ik daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat mariniers te maken hebben met slechte maaltijden en een ziekmakende keuken

MP Popken (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that marines face poor meals and an unhygienic barracks kitchen, including why parliament learned of it via the media, the number of kitchens with hygiene problems and related illnesses, and calls for pay rises and cancelling a relocation.
