The State Secretary answered that the poor maintenance was raised in earlier letters and debates, listed reporting channels and measures for food safety, withheld diagnoses under medical confidentiality, attributed the backlog to past budget choices, announced kitchen renovation, and rejected the claim of breaching duty of care.
For sick reports in the registration system of the Defence Health Care Organisation, the diagnosis falls under medical confidentiality.
Bij ziekmeldingen in het registratiesysteem van de Defensie Gezondheidszorg Organisatie behoort de diagnose tot het medisch geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het falend munitiebeleid

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence why ordering ammunition takes years, whether the Dutch ammunition industry was abandoned in favour of foreign suppliers, and whether European procurement rules could be bypassed for Dutch industry. The State Secretary attributed delivery times to supplier lead times, care and spreading of orders, denied that the Dutch industry was deliberately sidelined, and said procurement choices follow best product at best price with industry consultation through NIDV.
There are good and explainable reasons for the lead times of ammunition projects, such as supplier delivery times, care, and considerations of spreading orders.
Er zijn goede en verklaarbare redenen voor de doorlooptijd van munitieprojecten zoals levertijden van leveranciers, zorgvuldigheid en overwegingen van spreiding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over vervangende onderzeeboten

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence whether Dutch jobs and defence personnel safety should weigh heavily in buying replacement submarines, whether past foreign procurement was neglected, and whether Saab-Damen should be chosen. The State Secretary answered that Dutch industry involvement is a goal within best-product, best-price procurement, that the Defence Industry Strategy sets out capabilities, that the B-letter will announce the procurement strategy later, and agreed to answer the questions separately.

As reported in the letter of 24 April (Kamerstuk 34 225, no. 23), the House will be informed in the B-letter about decisions for the continuation of this replacement project, including the procurement strategy.

Zoals gemeld in de brief van 24 april jl. (Kamerstuk 34 225, nr. 23 ) zal de Kamer in de B-brief worden geïnformeerd over besluiten voor het vervolg van dit vervangingsproject, waaronder de verwervingsstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Popken over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris meer openheid wil bij Defensie

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why she only now sees the importance of openness, whether earlier promises were empty, and whether she will fully answer earlier questions on misconduct and European defence cooperation spending, and commit to deploying the military for border control, compensating victims, punishing offenders and ending diversity policies. The State Secretary replies that openness is essential for learning from mistakes, that earlier questions were answered and she sees no reason to change those answers, and that the other points were addressed in earlier letters.
I see no reason to amend the answers.
Ik zie geen reden om de antwoorden aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland acht of negen extra F-35 straaljagers gaat kopen

An MP from the PVV asked the defence ministry why the Chamber learned of plans to buy 8 or 9 extra F-35 jets through the media, about the costs, the US/NATO talks, and whether information would be shared. The government answered that the Chamber will be informed in advance of any change in F-35 numbers, including a confidential cost annex, and that the intention was already shared, but it did not disclose the actual number or costs now.
When the extra numbers of F-35 aircraft are actually determined, your Chamber will be informed in advance, in line with the recently amended guidance note on the major F-35 acquisition project.

Bij de daadwerkelijke invulling van de extra aantallen F-35 vliegtuigen zal uw Kamer daarover vooraf worden geïnformeerd, conform de (recent gewijzigde) uitgangspuntennotitie groot project Verwerving F-35
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Popken over dat Defensie investeert in een zonneauto

An MP from the PVV asks the Secretary of State for Defence 14 questions about unsafe military barracks, whether the costs of fire watches are disclosed, and the investment in a solar car, including requests for documents and a call to reverse the investment. The answer is only a procedural notice that the reply will be delayed until after the summer recess, with no substantive information given.
I will send you the answers to these questions before the end of the summer recess.
Ik zal u de antwoorden op deze vragen voor het einde van het zomerreces doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat “Defensie blijft teleurstellen op het gebied van veiligheid”

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Defence why Defence handles safety matters slowly, why it cannot give a limitative overview of health problems linked to military duties, and why it has not answered earlier questions fully. The State Secretary answers that a case-by-case assessment applies, that medical-secret data cannot be released, that investigations are launched when a causal link is plausible, and that a pay and conditions agreement was reached on 2 July 2019.
Health problems reported to a doctor fall under medical confidentiality and are therefore not available.
Gezondheidsproblemen die aan een arts worden gemeld, vallen onder het medisch geheim en zijn daarmee niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie een miljoenenclaim boven het hoofd hangt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that Defence faces a multi-million claim from Full Circle Compliance, why Parliament learned of it through the media, and for a full overview of legal disputes and case documents. The State Secretary declined to discuss the dispute, citing that it is before the courts, and gave only general statements on the number and types of disputes.
The case is currently before the courts, so I make no statements about this dispute and do not provide access to the documents you requested.
De zaak is momenteel onder de rechter waardoor ik geen uitspraken over dit geschil doe en geen inzage geef in de door u gevraagde stukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries and Foreign Minister about Atradius export-credit insurance for shipbuilder Damen, alleged fraud and irregularities, and whether the submarine replacement decision should wait for clarity on Damen. The government confirmed 67 policies worth 1.89 billion euro, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and said suspicion of fraud is not grounds for exclusion from tender under the Defence procurement law.
Because this case involves an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further statements on this.
Omdat er in deze casus sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de verhuizing van de mariniers opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the postponed relocation of the marines would finally be cancelled after reports of a large outflow of personnel. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the report and explained that the contract award for preparatory works was suspended again, pending a consultation with the works council and at the Chamber's earlier request to avoid irreversible steps before a debate.
I have decided to again suspend the contract award for the preparatory construction works for the new barracks
heb ik besloten om de gunning van de bouw voorbereidende werkzaamheden ten behoeve van de nieuwe kazerne opnieuw op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten korting hebben gekregen op de F-35-toestellen

The PVV MP Popken asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Netherlands is entitled to a discount on the F-35 jets, given that the US reportedly obtained one, and asked about the costs incurred. The State Secretary answered that unit prices are negotiated by the US Joint Program Office for all partners, that the formal prices for the Dutch LOT 12-14 aircraft are still pending and will be communicated later, and that the cost overview will be provided in the annual progress report on Prinsjesdag.
The formalisation between the JPO and the American industry regarding the unit prices of the F-35 fighter aircraft in LOT 12, 13 and 14 ... is however still ongoing.
De formalisering tussen het JPO en de Amerikaanse industrie over de stuksprijzen van de F-35 jachtvliegtuigen in LOT 12, 13 en 14 ... is echter nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de voortgang van het programma Grensverleggende IT (GrIT)

An MP asked the state secretary for Defence about the progress of the GrIT programme, including the new ICT assessment advice, business case, costs and timing of contract signing. The government confirmed it will inform parliament before irreversible steps, shares the advice and response, but defers details on costs, the business case and timing until a decision is made.
As you can read in the response to the BIT advice, I am deliberating on the future course of the programme. Once I have decided on this, I will inform the House.
Zoals u in de reactie op het BIT-advies kunt lezen, beraad ik mij over het vervolg van het programma. Nadat ik hierover heb besloten zal ik de Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Broshuis een miljoenenorder in de wacht sleept van de Amerikaanse Defensie

MP Popken asked the State Secretary of Defence why Parliament learned via the media of a large US Defence order won by Broshuis, and whether the government supported it, and questioned Dutch procurement policy and ties to the defence industry. The State Secretary answered that Defence informs Parliament only through the agreed Defence Materiel Process, that Broshuis won the order without direct government support, and that procurement follows best-product-best-price with the Defence Industry Strategy applied.
That does not alter the fact that Defence only informs the House about materiel projects according to the Defence Materiel Process as agreed with the House.
Dat laat onverlet dat Defensie de Kamer alleen informeert over materieelprojecten volgens het Defensie Materieelproces zoals met de Kamer overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over ongerustheid over een grote militaire oefenzone

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked about concerns over a large military exercise zone in the north of the Netherlands, its consultation, decision-making roles, environmental and Wadden Sea effects, and links to Lelystad Airport. The ministers answered that the zone is still being designed within the Luchtruimherziening programme, that participation and Plan-MER procedures will follow, and that the decision is due in 2020.
It is too early in the design process to give clarity on the positioning of the exercise area and the consequences for airspace use.
Het is te vroeg in het nog te doorlopen ontwerpproces om al duidelijkheid te geven over de positionering van het oefengebied en de gevolgen hiervan voor het luchtruimgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het stilzetten van nieuwe gepantserde SUV’s van de Marechaussee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the grounding of 18 newly armoured SUVs for the Royal Marechaussee, covering the procurement process, the supplier's expertise and other clients, who bears the costs, safety guarantees, and the six additional vehicles. The government answered that the vehicles were procured through a regular tender, the supplier is in default and must bear repair costs, the repaired vehicles will be safety-checked by an independent third party, and delivery of six extra vehicles is suspended.
The supplier has now been placed in default. The costs of repairing the defects are entirely for the supplier's account.
De leverancier is inmiddels in gebreke gesteld. De kosten voor het herstellen van de gebreken komen geheel voor rekening van de leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat achttien nieuwe marechausseevoertuigen onveilig zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that eighteen new armoured military police vehicles were unsafe and subject to a driving ban, and whether Dutch defence industry should have been involved. The State Secretary confirmed the driving ban over steering, fuel and braking problems, said the armouring added by a French supplier caused the defects, paused six extra vehicles, and denied any improper procurement motive.
Problems have been identified with, among other things, the steering system, the fuel system and the braking system.
Er zijn problemen vastgesteld met onder meer de stuurinrichting, het brandstofsysteem en het remsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over  het  schenden van de beantwoordingstermijn van schriftelijke vragen

Popken (PVV) asks the State Secretary for Defence why her written questions on eighteen new military police vehicles reported unsafe were not answered within the deadline, why no reason for delay was given, and whether she will answer promptly. The State Secretary replies that the deadline is known, Defence always aims for swift answers, the answer took longer than planned, and the answers were sent that day.
The answer deadline is known and Defence always strives for as swift an answer as possible.
De beantwoordingstermijn is bekend en Defensie streeft te allen tijde naar een zo snel mogelijke beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het gebruik van chroom-6 houdende verf bij de krijgsmacht

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence whether the labour inspectorate's critical findings on chromium-6 paint use in the armed forces are acknowledged, what measures will tighten control and when chromium-6 use will end. The State Secretary accepts the inspection's findings, attributes responsibility to local commanders, and points to an improvement plan with deadlines running to 2020-2022, while stating that full phase-out is not yet possible.
Of course we take the violations seriously, want to solve them and prevent them in the future.
Uiteraard trekken we ons de overtredingen aan, willen we deze oplossen en in de toekomst voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het item ‘Inspectie tikt Defensie op de vingers voor omgang gevaarlijke stoffen’

An MP asked why the state secretary of Defence had not made clearer the many warnings from the labour inspectorate on carcinogenic substances and chromium-6 exposure, and what would be done about them. The minister acknowledged the inspectorate's findings, said they were partly expected within an ongoing improvement programme with completion targeted for end 2020, and declined to comment further on the open enforcement process.
This is an ongoing process on which I cannot make a statement.
Dit is een lopend traject waarover ik geen uitspraak kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over “het bericht dat Defensie wederom teleurstelt bij het CAO-overleg”

MP Popken asked whether the Defence State Secretary knows that Defence keeps its CAO proposal secret while unions want it published, why it is kept secret, and whether it will give the House and personnel more openness. The State Secretary answered that both sides agreed not to communicate externally during negotiations under the Besluit Georganiseerd Overleg Defensie, but that staff were informed of Defence's position on 14 May.
In line with the Defence Organised Consultation Decree (art. 26), it was agreed at the start of negotiations not to communicate externally about the negotiating position.
In lijn met het Besluit Georganiseerd Overleg Defensie (art.26) is bij de start van de onderhandelingen afgesproken niet extern te communiceren over de inzet van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het binnen korte tijd neerstorten van twee gevechtsvliegtuigen van het type F35 (Joint Strike Fighter)

Krol (50PLUS) asked whether the two F-35 crashes (US Marines F-35B in 2018, Japanese F-35A in 2019) warranted grounding flights like the Boeing 737 MAX, and how the Netherlands would be involved in the investigations and whether deliveries would be delayed. The Secretary of State answered that the US crash cause was identified and fixed via fuel line replacement, the Japanese cause is still under investigation with Japan grounding its fleet, and the Netherlands sees no reason to halt operations or expects delivery delays, being kept informed under programme arrangements.
There is currently no reason to assume that the cause of the accident with the Japanese F-35A is related to the cause of the crash of the American F-35B.
Er is momenteel geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat de oorzaak van het ongeluk met de Japanse F-35A verband houdt met de oorzaak van het neerstorten van de Amerikaanse F-35B.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het tegengaan van ongewenste toegang tot het Netherlands Armed Forces Integrated Network (NAFIN)

MP Bruins Slot asked about protecting the Defence NAFIN fibre network from unwanted state and non-state influence, espionage and sabotage, including ownership, shared use by other government bodies, supply chain risks and a risk analysis. The Minister answered that NAFIN is autonomously managed by Defence, that shared use is virtually separated, and that a risk analysis exists but cannot be made public, while committing to no new report.
A risk analysis is part of the existing information security plan of NAFIN. This is not suitable for public disclosure.
Een risicoanalyse is onderdeel van het bestaande informatiebeveiligingsplan van het NAFIN. Dit leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Paternotte over het bericht 'In paniek naar de grond om 'vreemde' actie met Boeing en F-16’s'

D66 MPs Belhaj and Paternotte asked the Defence Minister about a surprise F-16 flyby over Amsterdam with a Boeing 777 and whether it was deliberately kept quiet, including its safety assessment and costs. The minister said no secrecy was intended, the flight stayed within minimum altitudes, safety was guaranteed under existing procedures, and the costs were standard training, while leaving the future use of fighter jets for societal events to case-by-case judgement.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the air show.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over het bericht dat de VS Turkije uit F-35 programma dreigen te gooien om Russische raketten

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked whether the US halting F-35 equipment deliveries to Turkey over its planned purchase of Russian S-400 air defence systems is accurate, whether Nederland agrees with the US reasoning, and whether Dutch industry could take over Turkish F-35 work. The government confirmed the US decision, shared US concerns, said it has raised them bilaterally and in NATO, and declined to speculate on further steps while Turkey remains a partner.
At this stage it is undesirable to speculate openly about possible follow-up steps in the programme.
Het is onwenselijk om in dit stadium openlijk te speculeren over mogelijke vervolgstappen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Aantal klachten over Eindhoven Airport stijgt sterk’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked about the sharp rise in noise complaints about Eindhoven Airport, whether the environmental impact assessment's runway split was breached, how the government will reduce complaints and enforce the MER, and how complaints feed into the Eindhoven Airport pilot case. The State Secretary answered that complaints rose to about 45,000 in 2018, that the MER contains no enforceable norms (the enforceable standard is the 35 Ke noise contour in the airport decree), that 63 percent of departures went south in 2018 due to wind conditions, and that route adjustments and a pilot case are underway.
The percentage of 65 to 75 percent used is therefore not a legal norm, and there is accordingly no obligation to have aircraft take off and land according to this percentage from the MER.
Het gebruikte percentage van 65 à 75 procent is dus geen wettelijke norm en er bestaat dan ook geen verplichting om vliegtuigen te laten opstijgen en landen volgens dit percentage uit de m.e.r.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Belhaj over het bericht "Angst voor lekken giftige stoffen uit 30 miljoen kilo munitie in Oosterschelde: 'Er moet echt wat gebeuren'

MPs Schonis and Belhaj asked about fears that 30 million kilos of old wartime munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde and North Sea could leak toxic substances and harm the environment and public health. The State Secretary of Defence answered that monitoring studies since 1998 show the risk is very small, that monitoring will continue, and that a regional information session and a summary of past reports are planned.
Rijkswaterstaat and Defence will jointly prepare a summary overview of all research reports and letters previously submitted to the House of Representatives.
Rijkswaterstaat en Defensie zullen daartoe gezamenlijk een samenvattend overzicht maken van alle in het verleden aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden onderzoeksrapporten en Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over antidrone maatregelen bij vliegvelden

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about counter-drone measures at airports, covering current capabilities, near-term additions, a knowledge programme, cooperation with partners and other countries. The minister answered that Defence has radar and electronic jamming capabilities but use within the Netherlands is limited by legal frameworks, that procurement and a 2019-2022 knowledge programme are underway, and that cooperation with the Justice and Security ministry and foreign partners continues, withholding operational details for sensitivity reasons.
Regarding the number of systems and specifications, I cannot make a statement due to operational sensitivity.
Over aantallen systemen en specificaties kan ik vanwege de operationele gevoeligheid geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederland de JSF met serieuze gebreken koopt en deze informatie achterhoudt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether US reports show 102 critical deficiencies in the F-35, fifteen endangering personnel safety, only four of eight reliability targets met, and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether purchase will be stopped. The State Secretary answered that fifteen Category 1 deficiencies remain, mitigation measures are in place, the annual report is a tailored version of foreign reports, and the purchase continues as committed.
The annual report on the F-35 acquisition project is therefore not an exact copy or bundling of foreign reports.
De jaarrapportage over het project Verwerving F-35 is daarom geen exacte kopie of bundeling van buitenlandse rapporten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over niet gemelde gebreken bij de F-35

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked the State Secretary for Defence about unreported defects in the F-35A, including gun accuracy, the ALIS maintenance system, reliability metrics, maintenance cost estimates and why critical US oversight findings were not in the progress reports. The government answered that the annual report reflects agreed committee arrangements, that identified issues are being addressed by the programme office without operational impact, and that it will report cost updates and test results in the annual report later.
Once there is clarity about any differences, this will be reported in the annual report on the F-35 acquisition project.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over eventuele verschillen zal dit worden gerapporteerd in de jaarrapportage over het project Verwerving F-35.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘De JSF: een ongeluk in slow motion’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports on serious F-35 deficiencies found by US testing bodies, including the number of critical limitations, safety risks, ALIS maintenance problems, cost consequences and reliability targets. The State Secretary answered that 15 Category 1 deficiencies remain (ten on the F-35A), mitigation measures are in place, cost effects are not yet foreseeable, and further reporting will follow in the annual project report.
The identification of deficiencies is a snapshot, so the number of shortcomings fluctuates.
De vaststelling van de deficiencies is een momentopname waardoor het aantal tekortkomingen wisselt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Kazerne moet lang wachten op keuken'

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder asked why the kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen faces a long wait for new construction and whether it could be accelerated. The State Secretary answered that new building requires several lengthy steps, that an interim kitchen will open in the second half of 2019, and that procurement and appeal rules leave no room to speed up construction.
Based on the laws and regulations on procurement, objection and appeal, there are no options to speed up the new construction.
Op basis van de wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van aanbesteding, bezwaar en beroep zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de nieuwbouw te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Behoud gebouwen schietbanen Leusderheide’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether it values the former Leusderheide shooting-range buildings as cultural-historical military heritage and what Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are doing to preserve them. The minister replied that no specific reuse or demolition plans exist, the buildings are in the maintenance programme, and a final position will follow a broader heritage vision and action plan.

Based on the coherent vision and action plan for management, preservation, research and public presentation of Second World War heritage and archaeology that I promised you, I will determine my position.

Op basis van de samenhangende visie en het actieplan voor beheer, behoud, onderzoek en aan een breed publiek tonen van erfgoed en archeologie uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog dat ik u heb toegezegd, zal ik mijn standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over het bericht 'Defensie vervroegt vervanging vipvliegtuig'

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked whether Defence plans to replace the government Gulfstream IV early, why parliament was not informed, the cost and business case, and whether this priority is morally defensible while staff lack a collective agreement. The State Secretary confirmed earlier replacement (before 2022) due to ageing and groundings, said parliament will receive the A-brief, stated the purchase will be under 100 million euro, and said procurement is not linked to pay negotiations.
In the A-brief I will inform the House about the replacement of the Gulfstream IV.
In de A-brief zal ik de Kamer informeren over de vervanging van de Gulfstream IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Defensie ziet liever geen windmolens naast munitieopslag'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Defence whether wind turbines should be kept out of the A-zone around the Staphorst ammunition depot for safety reasons, what the legal limits in that zone are, and how this fits with Defence's sustainability goals. The State Secretary answered that Defence raised concerns in a zoning submission requiring quantitative safety research, that no explicit legal ban exists on wind turbines in the A-zone, and that turbines could be allowed if a risk analysis shows no negative effect on external safety.
There is therefore no explicit prohibition in law on placing wind turbines in the A-zone.
Er is in de wet dus geen expliciet verbod op de plaatsing van windmolens in de A-zone opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat een fataal ongeluk met een Apache veroorzaakt werd door een verbogen onderdeel

An MP asked whether an internal report on the fatal Apache crash in Mali gave a different cause than the one sent to parliament, whether shortage of equipment, funding and training contributed, and why the incident was not communicated openly. The government answered that the Commission of Inquiry found a bent and then fractured probe as the technical cause, rejected any link to shortages, and explained that the full report is confidential under export-control and personal-data rules, while the summary was shared with parliament.
The report is confidential because it contains, among other things, technical data falling under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control rules.

Het rapport heeft een vertrouwelijk karakter, omdat het rapport onder andere technische gegevens bevat die vallen onder de International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) regelgeving voor exportcontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Honderden militairen slapen in hotels omdat barakken Huis ter Heide te slecht zijn’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why hundreds of soldiers at Huis ter Heide were sleeping in hotels because barracks were unfit, and about safety, costs and renovation. The government confirmed the barracks failed minimum requirements, explained the phased demolition, renovation and fire-safety programme, and reported about 700,000 euro spent on temporary hotel rooms, while costs for renovation and new build are not yet known.
After complaints from personnel housed at the Walaardt Sacré Camp in Huis ter Heide, it was established that the accommodation does not meet the minimum requirements.
Na klachten van personeel gelegerd op het Walaardt Sacré Kamp te Huis ter Heide is vastgesteld dat de legering niet voldoet aan de minimale eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Fataal defect crash Mali niet door ontwerp maar verbogen onderdeel’

An MP asked the Defence minister about press reports that the Mali Apache crash was caused by a bent component during maintenance by an external US party, and whether the full crash report and liability claims would be shared or pursued. The minister confirmed the component was bent but that the cause of bending could not be established, declined to share the full confidential report citing ITAR and personal data, and said liability was excluded under FMS conditions.
The report is confidential because it contains, among other things, technical data falling under International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control rules.

Het rapport heeft een vertrouwelijk karakter, omdat het rapport onder andere technische gegevens bevat die vallen onder International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)-regelgeving voor exportcontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeluk met een Apachehelikopter in Mali

MP Karabulut asks whether the 2015 Apache crash in Mali was caused by a chain of factors including the servo actuator, poor maintenance and safety awareness, and why the cause was not reported earlier, plus whether a 2013 recommendation on the logistics chain was ignored. The minister answers that the Commission of Inquiry found a technical failure of a bent LVDT probe, no causal link to safety culture, that the probe type has been removed from the fleet, and describes safety measures taken.
The report on the Chinook incident, except for staff-confidential information and technical data falling under ITAR export control rules, has been on the government website since 10 September 2018.

Het rapport over het Chinook-voorval, uitgezonderd personeelsvertrouwelijke informatie en de technische gegevens die vallen onder International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)-regelgeving voor exportcontrole, staat sinds 10 september 2018 op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de erbarmelijke staat van de vliegschool in Woensdrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the poor condition of the flight school buildings at Woensdrecht, including mould, the decision to sign a new-build permit, chromium-6 paint, meteorological systems and airfield closures, and whether a property overview would be given. The government answered that the new build is delayed, interim repairs are underway with no unsafe conditions found, the chromium-6 risk is limited, a property plan will follow by June 2019, and that the questions could not be answered before the budget debate.
As promised in, among others, the WGO-P, the House will receive the Strategic Real Estate Plan by 1 June 2019 at the latest.
Zoals u is toegezegd in o.a. het WGO-P, krijgt de Kamer uiterlijk 1 juni 2019 het Strategisch Vastgoed Plan toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat in de nieuwe verf dubbel zo veel Chroom-6 zit

MP Popken (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that new paint for military aircraft contains twice as much chromium-6, and whether Defence is acting wrongly by not moving faster to chromium-6-free systems. The State Secretary answered that the higher percentage reflects a change in solids content, not added chromium-6, that a roadmap for further reduction is due by 1 March 2019, and that safe working with chromium-6 is ensured.

A concrete and feasible plan for further reducing the use of chromium-6 in aviation systems and aviation-related ground equipment will be ready by 1 March 2019, after which decisions on its implementation can be taken.

Een concreet en uitvoerbaar plan met betrekking tot initiatieven voor verdere reductie van gebruik van chroom-6 in luchtvaartsystemen en in luchtvaart gerelateerde gronduitrusting is uiterlijk 1 maart 2019 gereed, waarna besluiten over de realisatie ervan kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Belhaj over het aanhoudend gebruik van chroom-6 bij de Koninklijke Luchtmacht

MPs Karabulut and Belhaj asked the State Secretary of Defence about the continued use of chromium-6 in High Solids Primer on Royal Netherlands Air Force aircraft, including whether it contains double the chromium-6 of the earlier paint, whether Belgium and Norway use chromium-free paints, and why certification of alternatives stalled. The government answered that the higher solids percentage does not mean more chromium-6 added, that a roadmap toward chromium-free systems is due by 1 March 2019, and that exposure stays below legal limits with protective equipment.
This plan will be ready by 1 March 2019 at the latest.
Dit plan is uiterlijk 1 maart 2019 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat twee derde van de mariniers uitstroomt als de verhuizing naar Vlissingen door gaat

MP Popken asked the State Secretary of Defence whether two-thirds of marines would leave if the relocation to Vlissingen proceeds, and about its direct and indirect consequences, vacancies, economic impact and whether Defence should halt the move. The State Secretary answered that the survey measured intention to leave (68% of respondents who answered), not actual outflow, listed the operational consequences of a two-thirds drop, reported 566 vacant posts, declined to speculate on vacancy filling and said Defence has no data on regional economic effects, while opening dialogue with the works council and pausing the PPS tender.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bijna helikoptercrash met tien militaire passagiers in Afghanistan in 2009

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a near-crash of a Cougar helicopter in Afghanistan in 2009, including the communication restrictions placed on passengers, the cockpit voice recorder, the adequacy of aftercare and the depth of past investigations, and whether the Dutch Safety Board should investigate. The minister acknowledged poor communication and insufficient aftercare, apologised and organised an information session, but rejected a new independent investigation.
Defence has no reason to doubt the results of the investigation report and therefore sees no reason for a new investigation.
Defensie heeft geen reden om te twijfelen aan de resultaten van het onderzoeksrapport en ziet dan ook geen aanleiding voor een nieuw onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over voedingskosten van militairen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about new rules requiring soldiers to register their own food costs, including whether daily clocking-in and attendance tracking are needed and what is being done about bureaucracy fatigue among personnel. The government answered that the new allowance regulation removes the own-household condition, introduces a declaration scheme, requires only a monthly check on a self-chosen time that takes about ten minutes, and that rules are being simplified and powers delegated to lower commanders.
The soldier can check the pre-filled declaration for accuracy once a month, at a self-chosen time.
De militair kan één keer per maand, op een zelfgekozen tijdstip, de reeds voor hem ingevulde declaratie op juistheid controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over onvermogen Defensie om uitrusting te verzorgen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why he learned from the press about the procurement problems with cold-weather clothing for a battalion exercise, what internal conclusions he drew, and whether the exercise should have been cancelled. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement, pointed to steps taken on stock levels and internal communication, and said cancellation was not needed because the required cold-weather gear was supplied in time to participants who needed it.
As stated in the question hour of 25 September, the course of events is open to improvement.
Zoals verwoord in het vragenuur van 25 september jl. is de gang van zaken voor verbetering vatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Bescherming Defensiepersoneel tegen chroom-6 onvoldoende’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about internal documents and a media report stating that protection of defence personnel against chromium-6 remains insufficient despite earlier commitments, and whether this undermines Defence's credibility as an employer. The State Secretary answered that concrete measures are underway, that remaining exposures above limit values are handled with personal protective equipment, that delays are due to capacity and industry dependence, and that Defence has failed in its duty of care in the past.
Defence naturally aims to improve working conditions so that wearing respiratory protection is no longer necessary.
Defensie streeft er uiteraard naar om de werksituaties zodanig te verbeteren dat het dragen van adembescherming niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de inkoop van materieel

Baudet (FvD) asked why Defence's clothing and equipment bureau KPU failed to buy enough winter jackets before an exercise in Norway, whether soldiers must buy equipment themselves, and how procurement is supervised. The Secretary of State answered that the underwear layer was delivered, that soldiers buy items themselves only in exceptional cases with permission, and described existing internal oversight and budget figures without committing to new structural measures beyond referring to earlier letters.
It is not known how often this exactly happens because it is not registered.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dit precies gebeurt omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de bescherming van het personeel tegen Chroom-6 onvoldoende is

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that protection of defence personnel against chromium-6 was insufficient, including the spray-cabin situation, gas-mask filter buses, the internal safety staff documents and the meaning of apologies. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging past failings, describing measures and replacement plans, and making the internal documents available via a link, though the reply largely restates existing policy and continuing investigation.
For this I offered, on behalf of Defence, my apologies when the RIVM research results were announced.
Daarvoor heb ik bij de bekendmaking van de onderzoeksresultaten van het RIVM namens Defensie mijn excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over het nieuws dat de bescherming van defensiepersoneel tegen chroom-6 nog steeds onvoldoende is

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked whether defence personnel are adequately protected against chromium-6 exposure, whether measured levels exceed the 1 µg/m3 limit, and whether protective measures and equipment (spray booths, gas-mask filters) are adequate. The State Secretary answered that spray-booth air concentrations can exceed the limit but personnel wear protective masks, that replacement booths and chromium-free alternatives are planned with long timelines, and that the AMF-12 filters were replaced as a precaution, with a full-risk elimination not possible and structural measures targeted for end 2020.
Defence naturally aims to improve working conditions so that wearing respiratory protection is no longer necessary.
Defensie streeft er uiteraard naar om de werksituaties zodanig te verbeteren dat het dragen van adembescherming niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Belhaj over het bericht 'Jassenblunder gevolg van ‘inschattingsfout’'

MPs Bruins Slot and Belhaj asked the Defence State Secretary about cold-weather injuries among soldiers in exercises Bison Drawsko and Enhanced Forward Presence, and about winter clothing procurement for Trident Juncture. The State Secretary answered that about 35 cold injuries were reported in each case, that winter clothing is being supplied centrally, and that the procurement rules already allow exceptions in urgent situations.
The Ministry of Defence, including the KPU company, has all the options available in tenders that are included in the Procurement Act 2012 and the Procurement Act for the defence and security sector.

Het Ministerie van Defensie, inclusief het KPU-bedrijf, beschikt bij aanbestedingen over alle mogelijkheden, die in de Aanbestedingswet 2012 en de Aanbestedingswet op defensie- en veiligheidsgebied zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Karabulut over het recht op vakbondswerkzaamheden door defensiepersoneel

MPs Karabulut asked whether the Defence Ministry effectively blocked union activity by the ODB by withdrawing its facilities after the ODB left its confederation CMHF, and whether the rules should change. The State Secretary answered that the ODB lost its facility rights because it is no longer affiliated with an admitted confederation, that he will not interfere in the internal affairs of a confederation, and that he sees no reason to amend the regulations.
I cannot and will not interfere in the internal affairs of a confederation, and on the basis of the current situation I see no reason to amend the regulations.
Ik kan en wil niet treden in de interne aangelegenheden van een centrale en zie op basis van de huidige situatie geen aanleiding om de regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Militairen zonder handschoenen in ijskoud Polen’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers lacked gloves and used body armour past its expiry date, and about fire-resistant clothing, cold-weather gear and weapon stocks. The government answered that armour is replaced when damaged rather than at a fixed expiry, that TNO testing found most plates intact, and that extra gear was ordered, while the Bison Drawsko cold-weather shortage was acknowledged and addressed through later procurement.
After questions from KCT staff at the end of August 2018 about the warranty date of the ballistic plates in KCT's individual ballistic protection, immediate action was taken.
Na vragen van medewerkers van het KCT eind augustus 2018 over de garantiedatum van de kogelwerende platen in de individuele ballistische bescherming van het KCT is direct actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat het materiaal van de commando's niet voldoet

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that commando equipment (helmets and jackets) fails to meet requirements, including a 2016 memo, how it was handled, and whether it reflects Defence's poor state. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the complaint was handled through the commander's line and resolved with DMO and KCT staff, admitted material readiness is not fully in order, and pointed to planned measures and investment.
As already reported, including in the operational readiness report, the (material) readiness of units, including KCT units, is not fully in order.
Zoals reeds gemeld in o.a. de inzetbaarheidsrapportage is de (materiële) gereedheid van eenheden, waaronder eenheden van het KCT, niet volledig op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over één meldpunt voor alle klachten bij Defensie

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the external reporting point of the Giebels commission closed on 1 October 2018, whether a new single complaints desk for Defence personnel will handle the same complaints, and how the government implements a motion to keep the external point open. The Secretary of State confirmed the closure, said the new desk is a practical-problems point distinct from the Giebels investigation and will be set up through a separate letter, and referred to a June 2018 letter saying the commission would keep its point open during its investigation.
The desk has a brokering function between staff questions and solutions the Defence organisation can offer.
Het loket heeft daarbij een makelaarsfunctie tussen vragen van de medewerkers en oplossingen die de Defensieorganisatie kan bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de legionella uitbraak op de kazerne te Schaarsbergen

An MP from FvD asked the State Secretary of Defence about a Legionella finding in building 107 at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the lack of working toilets and showers, complaints from soldiers, and budget for remediation. The State Secretary answered that a standard precautionary test found non-pneumophila Legionella without a health risk, that affected taps were taken out of use and thermally flushed, and that remediation is handled by the property agency under standard procedures.
However, with every exceedance of the norm, Defence takes measures.
Bij elke overschrijding van de norm neemt Defensie echter maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de zaak van VDL-RUAG Shelters B.V. tegen de Staat der Nederlanden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about a court ruling in the VDL-RUAG Shelters kort geding and about CBRN, electromagnetic and climate-control certification of the containers in a procurement. The government answered yes to all questions, referred to the tender evidence and the Programma van Eisen, and agreed to hold off irreversible purchase steps until the Chamber has considered the D-brief.
As usual, Defence will not take irreversible steps until the Chamber has considered this D-brief.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal Defensie geen onomkeerbare stappen zetten totdat de Kamer deze D-brief heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de verhuizing van de marinierskazerne op losse schroeven staat

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the relocation of the marine corps barracks was uncertain, including rising irregular outflow of marines, the effects of halting a Raiding Squadron, the basis for the 1 October date and costs of postponed construction work, and why marines should trust the defence staff. The State Secretary answered that outflow is being monitored and retention measures are being taken, that the squadron stop reduces operational capacity until 2021, that postponed work costs are borne by Defence, and that a process facilitator has been appointed to resume consultation with the works council.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Nederlandse producenten misgrijpen bij grote defensie-orders

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that Dutch producers risk losing large defence contracts, including the Vector vehicle's performance, why the procurement is at risk, why Dutch industry is not better protected, and whether Article 346 TFEU is interpreted generously. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, said the Vector delivery was delayed but expected to deliver from 2019, declined to comment on the ongoing tender, and stated the Defence Industry Strategy would follow and that the national security exception is interpreted generously.
As this tender is still ongoing, I cannot provide any information on it.
Aangezien deze aanbesteding nog loopt, kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘430.000 gulden voor onderzeeër’

An MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs state secretaries about reports on the submarine replacement project and the new Defence Industry Strategy, including timing and industrial participation. The government answered that the strategy will be published in Q4 2018, that market consultation with potential suppliers was held, and that the B-brief on submarines is delayed to early 2019 but the strategy will be sent to parliament before it.
The DIS will be sent to the House earlier than the B-letter on replacing submarine capacity.
De DIS zal eerder aan de Kamer worden aangeboden dan de B-brief voor de vervanging van onderzeebootcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de betekenis van de Amerikaanse schorsing van Turkije in het F-35 project

The MP asks whether the US has suspended Turkey from the F-35 programme, what the NDAA measure means, and what consequences follow for the Dutch industry and the Block Buy contract. The State Secretary replies that Turkey remains a project partner, that the NDAA only bars F-35 deliveries to Turkey pending a Mattis/Pompeo report due in November, that the Netherlands was not consulted, and that the Block Buy contract is not yet signed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van den Berg over de bodemverontreiniging en explosieven op terrein marinierskazerne Vlissingen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about soil contamination and unexploded WWII ordnance on the planned Vlissingen Marines barracks site, including whether earlier agreements exist and how much land is affected. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known since 2012, only about 2 of 70 hectares will be remediated, the rest carries use restrictions, and clearance and cost-sharing agreements with the region exist and are largely public.

These agreements were shared by the province with the provincial states and are publicly available, except for the agreements on the buy-out sum for preparing the land, which the province shared with the provincial states under confidentiality.

Deze overeenkomsten heeft de provincie gedeeld met de provinciale staten en zijn openbaar in te zien, met uitzondering van de afspraken over de afkoopsom voor het bouwrijp maken van de grond, die de provincie onder geheimhouding heeft gedeeld met de provinciale staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over bodemverontreiniging op de locatie van de te bouwen marinierskazerne in Vlissingen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Defence why an October 2017 provincial order on soil contamination at the Vlissingen marine barracks site was not shared with parliament, and what health risks the contamination poses to marines. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known earlier, that the order was shared with Defence in October 2017 but not with parliament, and that only about 2 of 70 hectares will be remediated before construction while the rest is deemed safe for the intended use.
The order itself indeed was not shared with the House of Representatives.
De beschikking zelf is inderdaad niet met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over bodemverontreiniging op de locatie van de te bouwen marinierskazerne in Vlissingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether he knew of reports that the planned Vlissingen marine barracks site was contaminated, why this was not shared with parliament, and whether the Doorn barracks would be renewed instead. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, argued that contamination had been disclosed in successive briefings and that remediation under soil law will precede construction, and did not commit to changing the plan.

In this report it is concluded that the land, due to contamination and the presence of unexploded ordnance, does have use restrictions, but that soil quality is not an obstacle to developing the new barracks.

In dit rapport wordt geconcludeerd dat de grond vanwege vervuiling en de aanwezigheid van niet-gesprongen explosieven weliswaar gebruiksbeperkingen kent, maar dat de bodemkwaliteit geen belemmering vormt voor de ontwikkeling van de nieuwe kazerne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel 'Gemor over steun aan majoor Kroon'

MP Kerstens asked the Defence State Secretary whether a newspaper report about Defence paying legal costs for Major Kroon was accurate, whether the agreements were precedent-setting, and how such payments are justified to other staff. The minister confirmed the agreements, said they were based on AMAR article 115 and assessed case by case, and declined to provide an overview of legal-cost payments because Defence keeps no central registration.
Defence does not apply a uniform and central form of registration of the costs of legal assistance provided.
Defensie hanteert geen eenduidige en centrale vorm van registratie van de kosten van juridische bijstand die verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Chroom-6 verf aangetroffen op speedboten Koninklijke Marine’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence how the government will respond to reports that chromium-6 paint was found on Royal Netherlands Navy FRISC speedboats, whether affected staff will be contacted, whether the existing compensation scheme covers them, and whether RIVM research will be extended. The State Secretary says staff were informed and can register, workshops were closed and cleaned, a calamity procedure applies, the compensation scheme currently covers only POMS-location workers, and RIVM research on other defence locations is being prepared with the joint committee to set its scope.
Once the research design and timeline have been set by the joint committee, I will inform your House in the usual way.
Zodra de onderzoeksopzet en de tijdsplanning voor dit onderzoek door de paritaire commissie is vastgesteld zal ik uw Kamer hierover op de gebruikelijke manier informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de blootstelling aan chroom-6 bij de Koninklijke Marine

The MP asked whether the supplier of Navy FRISC boats guaranteed the vessels were free of Chromium-6, what follows if chromium-6 was found, and whether future purchase contracts will ban chromium-6 paint. The State Secretary confirmed the supplier declared no carcinogenic substances would be used, that an investigation into chromium-6 treatment is ongoing with liability and maintenance measures to follow, and that Defence already restricts chromium-6 coatings in procurement, with a few aviation-related exceptions.
An investigation is currently underway into which components have been treated with chromium-6.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht welke onderdelen met chroom-6 zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verwerving van gevechtsvesten in het kader van het VOSS-project door het Israëlisch concern Elbit

An MP asks the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the procurement of combat vests from Israeli firm Elbit under the VOSS project, including whether a contract option bypassed competition and whether differentiation policy on Israeli settlements should apply. The government answers that using a contract option is standard, the DMP procedure was applied correctly, and Elbit's activities do not contribute to settlements, so there is no reason to revise the relationship.
Defence is using an option within the contract concluded with Elbit under the VOSS project.
Defensie maakt gebruik van een optie binnen de overeenkomst die met Elbit is gesloten in het kader van het project VOSS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ongelukken met de SM-2 raket op Duitse en Amerikaanse oorlogsbodems

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about SM-2 missile incidents on the German frigate Sachsen (June 2018) and the US destroyer The Sullivans (2015), their causes, and whether the Dutch LC frigates' SM-2 missiles are safe to use. The government answered that the Sachsen damage is still being assessed, the 2015 cause was a motor defect, Dutch missiles are essentially identical, and Defence has paused SM-2 training firings as a precaution pending the investigation.
As a precaution, Defence has decided that no SM-2 missiles will be fired for exercise and training purposes until more clarity exists on the cause of the incident aboard the Sachsen.

Uit voorzorg heeft Defensie besloten dat geen SM-2 raketten voor oefen- en trainingsdoeleinden worden afgevuurd totdat er meer duidelijkheid is over de oorzaak van het incident aan boord van de Sachsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat Defensie klagers nog altijd niet serieus neemt

An MP asks whether Defence still fails to take complaints from current and former staff seriously, as the Veterans Ombudsman reported little improvement since 2016, and about registering oral complaints, protection of complainants against reprisals, and the effect on Defence's image. The minister acknowledges remaining shortcomings, lists new complaint-registration and reporting measures, defends limiting oral complaint registration, and promises an external evaluation of complaint handling.
To enable further improvement, an external party will be asked to carry out an evaluation of complaint handling.
Om een verdere verbetering mogelijk te maken, zal een externe partij worden gevraagd een evaluatie van de klachtbehandeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Luchtmacht klaar voor bewapende drone’

MP Belhaj (D66) asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Air Force commander's interview about arming the MALE UAV drone was coordinated with or approved by the ministry, and whether arming drones is consistent with earlier statements and the Defence White Paper. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of and consent to the interview, stated that arming the MALE UAV is not under consideration and does not appear in the Defence policy, and declined to address ethical or budgetary questions beyond that.
I was aware of his interview and permission was given for it.
Ik was op de hoogte van zijn interview en er is toestemming voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Jong en Helder over het bericht 'Bizar probleem defensie: Schietende jassen'

MPs asked about a report that winter jackets issued to military and police personnel could accidentally fire weapons via loose cords, and about the injury, measures taken, the Inspectorate SZW investigation, and whether the jackets remain in use. The government said the injured soldier has recovered, the Marechaussee banned firing in these jackets, about 4000 soldiers still have them with elastic removal required, the police do not use them, and it announced a plan for a safer defence organisation while withholding the inspectorate's timing and dates.
Making working conditions safer is therefore a top priority for the coming years.
Het veiliger maken van de werkomstandigheden is dan ook topprioriteit voor de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de opties rond de verhuizing van de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne te Doorn

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Defence about the costs of cancelling the relocation of the Van Braam Houckgeest barracks from Doorn to Vlissingen, the option of keeping Doorn, cost overruns, facility shortfalls and the impact on partners and families. The State Secretary answered that cancellation would cost at least 36.8 million euro in sunk and related costs plus possible consortium claims, that the 2012 decision cannot easily be reversed, and gave partial, largely substantive answers while withholding the detailed cost figures as commercially confidential.
For the answer to this question I refer to the commercially confidential annex to this letter.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de commercieel vertrouwelijke bijlage bij deze brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht “Veiligheid schiet tekort bij veel munitiedepots”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports of serious safety shortcomings at ammunition depots and requested a detailed overview of problems, remedies and timelines. The government acknowledged infrastructure deficiencies, mainly lightning protection, said local fixes were done and a plan with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and I-SZW is being prepared, and rejected the claim that the procurement organisation should be purged.
A plan of action is currently being drawn up for this in close cooperation with the RVB and submitted to the I-SZW.
Op dit moment wordt hiervoor, in nauwe samenwerking met het RVB, een plan van aanpak opgesteld en voorgelegd aan de I-SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over verwaarloosde veiligheidsmaatregelen in en om munitieopslagplaatsen van Defensie

Karabulut (SP) asked why Defence's ammunition depots were not checked against the strictest lightning-protection norm, which tekortkomingen remain, whether fines were passed on to the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and whether the DMO-RVB division of responsibility should change. The State Secretary said the norm was clarified on 23 April 2018, that remaining defects depend on RVB works with a plan due and inventory by July 2018, that fines were paid by Defence until the agreement was amended, and that no structural reorganisation is planned, only better cooperation.
To end this, it was decided on 23 April that all ammunition storage facilities must meet the newest standard.
Om hieraan een einde te maken is op 23 april jl. besloten dat alle munitiemagazijnen aan de nieuwste norm moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat marechaussees hun baan dreigen op te zeggen als protest tegen inzet van burgers bij grensbewaking

An MP asks whether marechaussees threatening to resign over the use of civilians in border control is a sign of understaffing and a cost-cutting measure, and asks about the training for civilian border guards. The state secretary answers that 417 FTE extra will be available by late 2019, that civilians are an additional two-year pilot and not a substitute for regular staff, and that civilian border guards always work alongside a military colleague.
It is not a cost-cutting operation but rather a way to align capacity more flexibly with the workload, especially at peak moments.
Het is geen bezuinigingsoperatie maar juist een manier om op meer flexibele wijze de capaciteit af te kunnen stemmen op het werkaanbod, met name bij piekmomenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bijna helikoptercrash met tien militaire passagiers in Afghanistan in 2009

An SP MP asked the Defence State Secretary about a near helicopter crash in Afghanistan in 2009, including alleged gag orders, missing documentation and a 2015 TV appearance by the pilot. The government acknowledges that communication with passengers was wrongly handled and that the handling was regrettable, but denies a gag order and says there was no policy change.
Looking back, it must be concluded that the way passengers were then informed about releasing information wrongly gave the impression that they could not speak about the incident at all.

Terugkijkend moet worden vastgesteld dat de wijze waarop destijds richting de passagiers is gecommuniceerd over de vrijgave van informatie bij hen ten onrechte de indruk heeft gewekt dat zij helemaal niet over het incident zouden mogen spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Belhaj over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a court ruling that Schiphol must release about 2,500 slots, and about its consequences for passenger flows, border control queues, security and the 500,000-movement cap. The minister replied that the ruling has no policy consequences for the 2017/2018 season, that the cap through 2020 stands, and that Marechaussee capacity is being expanded, while declining to comment on Schiphol's reasoning.
I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the justification of this decision by Schiphol, because the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not a party in this case.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om commentaar te geven op de onderbouwing van dit besluit door Schiphol omdat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen partij is in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de leegloop bij het Korps Mariniers in verband met de kazerneverhuizing naar Vlissingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about rising unplanned departures of marines linked to the planned relocation of the Doorn barracks to Vlissingen, and whether the move could be reversed. The government answered that the tender is ongoing with award planned for July 2019, that departures are rising and their causes are being examined, that reversing the move would cost tens of millions of euros and the space problem remains, and that the Chamber is kept informed through periodic property reports.
I am of course at all times prepared to discuss this with the Chamber.
Ik ben uiteraard te allen tijde bereid daarover met de Kamer in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Mariniers Vlissingen niet zien zitten en massaal weglopen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that marines are leaving the corps rather than accept a move from Doorn to Vlissingen, and how large the departures must become before operations are endangered. The State Secretary answered that operational commitments can still be met, that the corps must be refilled, and listed retention measures such as adjusted allowances and retention premiums.
However, the Marine Corps remains able to meet its current operational commitment.
Maar het Korps Mariniers blijft in staat aan zijn huidige inzetverplichting te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat Defensie gevechtsonderdelen opheft wegens personeelstekort

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that military units were being disbanded due to staff shortages, and about rising unplanned departures from the Marines and Commando Corps. The government answered that no units were disbanded for staff shortages, that some units are being temporarily merged or left unfilled, and that retention measures are underway.
In recent years, no Defence units have been disbanded due to staff shortages.
In de afgelopen jaren zijn er geen eenheden van Defensie opgeheven vanwege personeelstekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over potentiële gevaren bij de nieuwe vliegroutes Lelystad

An MP asked the ministers about staffing shortages at the military air traffic control station, whether it can safely handle extra traffic from Lelystad Airport, bird strike risks and flight routes, and who is responsible for airspace safety. The government answered that staffing gaps exist but traffic will be managed within a year, that bird-strike monitoring and studies are underway, and that the two ministers share responsibility with the air traffic service providers and the inspectorate.
To this end, already qualified and trained air traffic controllers will initially be deployed.
Daartoe zullen in eerste instantie reeds gekwalificeerde en getrainde verkeersleiders worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over het personeelstekort bij de militaire luchtverkeersleiding

MPs asked the state secretary of Defence about staff shortages at military air traffic control, including suspended services, limited flight information, and whether flight safety is at risk. The government acknowledges chronic shortages and service suspensions, says safety is preserved by suspending services, and outlines training, retention and cooperation measures with LVNL, while rejecting a pay rise.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) has struggled with staff shortages for years. Currently 17 of the 73 established posts are vacant.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) kampt al jaren met een personeelstekort. Momenteel zijn 17 van de 73 organieke functies vacant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de brief inzake de bevindingen van het intern onderzoek van de misbruikzaak uit 1982

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the internal investigation findings on a 1982 sexual abuse case, asking whether perpetrators should be dismissed even when the offence is time-barred and whether the privacy of the accused is protected while the victim had to go public. The State Secretary called the conduct unacceptable, said criminal and disciplinary measures are blocked by the passage of time, and pointed to a commission reviewing the reporting system.
This abuse case is criminally time-barred. The passage of time also prevents taking administrative or disciplinary measures.
Deze misbruikzaak is strafrechtelijk gezien verjaard. Het tijdsverloop in deze zaak staat ook het nemen van bestuursrechtelijke of tuchtrechtelijke maatregelen in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over twee laagvliegoefeningen in het oosten van Nederland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about complaints over noise and low-flying military helicopter exercises in eastern Netherlands, the timing and publication of the permit, possible violations of its conditions, whether such exercises should take place in the Netherlands, and communication with residents. The State Secretary defended the exercises as necessary for crew readiness, said conditions were not breached, promised earlier publication of major permits and better communication with farmers' organisations, but rejected that communication was deficient.
Decisions announcing large-scale exercises will from now on be published at the earliest possible stage and preferably at least 4 weeks before the start of an exercise.

Beschikkingen waarmee grootschalige oefeningen bekend worden gemaakt, zullen voortaan in een zo vroeg mogelijk stadium en bij voorkeur uiterlijk 4 weken voor de aanvang van een oefening worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat ‘Wees een voorbeeld, geen bullebak’

MP Ploumen asked the State Secretary for Defence about a doctoral study finding that initiation rituals at the Royal Military Academy go too far, and whether rules and a ban on hazing should be tightened. The government answered that harmful practices have been changed, that some rituals remain useful, that a defence-wide directive from 2013 is being revised to sharpen commander responsibility, and that the study has been sent to the social safe workplace commission.
This 2013 directive is currently being revised.
Deze aanwijzing uit 2013 wordt momenteel herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de misstanden op de kazerne in Schaarsbergen omvangrijker waren dan bekend was

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence why abuses at the Schaarsbergen barracks lasted so long, whether they will be included in the independent inquiry, whether reporting procedures for vandalism will be reviewed, and why the Chamber was not fully informed about an internal 2015 risk analysis. The State Secretary answers that an independent commission is investigating, that the reporting procedure will be reviewed, and that the risk analysis is a confidential preventive instrument, referring to a separate letter.
It is precisely the confidentiality of this instrument that increases the chance that matters can be prevented and resolved.
Juist de vertrouwelijkheid van dit instrument verhoogt de kans dat zaken kunnen worden voorkomen en opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat er te weinig geld is voor alle 37 JSF-toestellen

MP Popken (PVV) asked whether the government will abandon the F-35 program after reports that the 37 planned jets are underfunded due to the dollar exchange rate, and why the Rekenkamer's earlier warnings were not acted on. The Secretary of State says the 37 jets will be bought as planned, that currency risk was reported to parliament in recent progress reports, that about 1.5 billion euro had been spent by end 2016, and that the F-35 is the best replacement for the F-16.
Defence recognised the risk of currency fluctuations from the start of the F-35 acquisition project.
Defensie heeft het risico van valutaschommelingen vanaf het begin van het project Verwerving F-35 onderkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat militairen vernederd zijn tijdens ontgroening op de KMA in Breda

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that military recruits were humiliated during hazing at the KMA in Breda, and whether a culture discouraging reporting of misconduct exists. The State Secretary said the facts are still being investigated and will be reported later, announced an independent commission on a socially safe environment within Defence, and stated that hazing is prohibited while initiation rituals are permitted under Defence-wide guidelines.
At this moment this is being investigated. The House will be informed about this matter later.
Op dit moment wordt dit uitgezocht. De Kamer wordt later over deze zaak geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Visser en Azmani over de gevolgen van toenemende agressie van verstekelingen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about reports of rising aggression by stowaways targeting truck drivers near Calais, the scale of harm to Dutch drivers and transport firms, and whether the government will re-engage France and EU partners. The minister says the government has received no signals of increasing problems, cannot provide figures on driver victims, points to French responsibility for Calais security and existing EU rules, and sees no need for new talks now.
I have no figures on the number of Dutch drivers who have fallen victim to violence and threats since 2015.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over aantallen Nederlandse chauffeurs die sinds 2015 slachtoffer zijn geworden van geweld en bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen, Visser, Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over paspoortcontroles door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs from VVD and CDA asked whether airlines must check passengers' identity on intra-Schengen flights, how responsibilities are divided, and how the EU PNR directive would help detect terrorists. The minister explained that border checks are a KMar task only at external borders, that airlines may but need not perform conformity checks, and that PNR implementation (deadline 25 May 2018) and a feasibility study on mandatory conformity checks are the planned responses.
Figures on how many airlines check the identity of their passengers are not kept.
Cijfers over hoeveel luchtvaartmaatschappijen de identiteit van hun passagiers controleren worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat militairen mishandeld zijn bij ontgroeningsritueel

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers were abused during an initiation ritual, including whether soldiers were barred from speaking to outsiders, how many complaints and sexual-abuse reports had been filed since 2014, and what measures were taken. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the 2013 incident and internal inquiry, explained the non-disclosure rule as protecting investigation integrity and promised to revise the rules, gave complaint counts, and referred to a separate letter on measures.
Given the lack of clarity that may arise, the rules will be amended.
Gelet op de onduidelijkheid die kan ontstaan zullen de regels worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Militairen mishandeld bij ontgroeningsritueel’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports of soldiers being abused during initiation rituals at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the union's call to abolish such rituals, and related reporting, measures, complaint channels, drugs use and prosecution. The government answered that a domestic investigation was conducted with prosecutor consent, rights-related measures were taken, an independent external inquiry is underway, and that it sees no reason to change prosecution policy.
The way reports and reporters are handled is part of the independent external investigation.
De wijze waarop met meldingen en melders wordt omgegaan maakt deel uit van het onafhankelijk externe onderzoek.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de publicatie 'Understanding Anti-Christian Hate Crimes and Addressing the Security Needs of Christian Communities'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the government how it responds to the OSCE/ODIHR publication on anti-Christian hate crimes, including monitoring, under-registration, and international advocacy. The government welcomed the report, said discrimination against Christians is a small share of complaints so no specific policy exists yet, and pointed to planned public communication on anti-discrimination reporting and ongoing diplomatic advocacy.
Because of the small number of reports, there is currently no specific policy to combat discrimination against Christians.
Vanwege het geringe aantal meldingen is er op dit moment geen specifiek beleid om discriminatie van christenen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het uitblijven van actie bij seksadvertentiewebsites met ernstige vermoedens van uitbuiting

MPs Bikker and others asked why no action has been taken against sex-advertising websites with serious suspicions of exploitation, including the lack of a legal age-verification obligation despite an adopted motion.
