The Minister says a working group and a WODC study are underway, a plan of action will follow in 2026, and no national age-verification law is planned yet, while acknowledging the platforms' shortcomings.
For this reason I want to complete the process with the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the G4 municipalities and await the results of the WODC study mentioned above.
Om deze reden wil ik het traject met de politie, het OM en de G4-gemeenten doorlopen en de resultaten van het hierboven genoemde WODC onderzoek afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul  en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Coöperatie Laatste Wil komt met nieuwe  levenseindemethode'

MPs Bikker, Krul and Diederik van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the Coöperatie Laatste Wil's new assisted-dying method, its risks for vulnerable people, and possible legal action. The government called the dissemination of suicide methods undesirable, said it is checking whether the activities are criminal under article 294 Sr, declined to confirm any ongoing investigations, and said the prosecutor would act if criminal limits are crossed while the minister sees no reason to use a special instruction power.
In general, the Minister of Justice and Security can neither confirm nor deny whether criminal investigations are ongoing against certain natural or legal persons.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan bevestigen noch ontkennen of tegen bepaalde natuurlijke of rechtspersonen strafrechtelijke onderzoeken lopen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de berichten ‘Leider sadistisch onlinenetwerk vast op verdenking van terrorisme’ en ‘Sadistische online chatgroepen actief, verdachte vast op terrorisme-afdeling’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to reports of sadistic online networks such as '764' and whether the detection, prosecution and victim support frameworks are adequate. The minister condemned the networks, said their scale in the Netherlands cannot be reliably estimated, and pointed to existing tools (TOI regulation, DSA, ATKM, Versterkte Aanpak Online), possible EU-level measures and victim support, promising a further letter on online extremism before year-end.
Before the end of the year I will go into further developments in the approach to online extremism and terrorism in the progress letter on the Versterkte Aanpak Online.
Nog voor het einde van het jaar zal ik in de voortgangsbrief Versterkte Aanpak Online nader ingaan op de verdere ontwikkelingen in de aanpak van online extremisme en terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over meer meldingen van minderjarige slachtoffers van criminele uitbuiting

MP Bikker asked the Justice Minister about the rise in reported minor victims of criminal exploitation, the low number of police investigations into sexual exploitation, police capacity, and cooperation with Latin American countries. The minister answered that awareness campaigns, the BUIT e-learning, the Keerpunt portal and police and international cooperation are being pursued, but that more reports do not automatically mean more investigations and that capacity constraints apply.
The number of police investigations into national and international sexual exploitation has fallen.
Het aantal politieonderzoeken naar nationale en internationale seksuele uitbuiting is gedaald
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over illegale gokaanbieders die zich richten op jongeren

MP Bikker asked the Justice Minister about illegal online gambling operators targeting young people, including minors being able to register, deposit money and see gambling ads, and rising youth gambling. The State Secretary answered that illegal offers are unacceptable and that the Gambling Authority (Ksa) is pursuing an alliance, prevention measures, fines enforcement, and new legislation to allow faster takedown of illegal sites, while rejecting reversing legalisation.
I find it very worrying that minors have such easy access to illegal online gambling.
Ik vind het heel zorgelijk dat minderjarigen zo makkelijk toegang hebben tot illegale online kansspelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Jongeren verslaafd aan online gokken kloppen massaal aan voor hulp: 'Soms al vanaf 16 jaar’

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports that young people, some from age 16, are seeking help for online gambling addiction, including in regions outside the Randstad, and what is being done. The government answers that minors' online gambling has risen sharply in 2025, that the Ksa is investigating minors' participation at legal operators, that regional treatment figures are noted with caution, and that the gambling-policy measures and a multi-year prevention agenda are being prepared.
The Gaming Authority (Ksa) is currently conducting in-depth research into minors' participation in online gambling at legal providers.
Momenteel doet de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) verdiepend onderzoek naar deelname van minderjarigen aan online kansspelen bij legale aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over beleid rond inclusiviteit op hogescholen

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the Minister of Education about whether institutions may rename or drop Christian holidays in the name of inclusivity, and about the government's role in such policy. The Minister replied that institutions are autonomous in designing inclusivity policy and calendars, that the government will keep naming official holidays, and that she will raise the topic in talks with institutions.
Because of this institutional autonomy, the Ministry of OCW has no policy on how universities of applied sciences and universities should name holidays.
Vanwege deze institutionele autonomie heeft het Ministerie van OCW geen beleid op hoe hbo- en wo-instellingen feestdagen moeten noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over suïcidepreventie

An MP asked the State Secretaries for Health and for Infrastructure about suicide prevention measures at the Merwedebrug, national policy on barriers at dangerous sites, the role of municipalities under the Wet integrale suïcidepreventie, and AI chatbots and suicide risk. The government answered that rail barrier programmes run to 2026, that Rijkswegen has no suicide prevention programme, that municipalities will be supported in defining risk locations, and that AI-specific suicide prevention policy is still being explored.
I endorse the message that AI chatbots must be developed in accordance with applicable regulations so that they are applied responsibly.
Ik onderschrijf de boodschap dat AI-chatbots overeenkomstig geldende regelgeving ontwikkeld moeten worden, zodat zij op een verantwoorde manier worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de jaarrapportage 2024 Wet afbreking zwangerschap (Wafz)

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the 2024 annual report on the Dutch abortion act, including the stable abortion count, registration gaps, treatment shifts, early abortions, aftercare and contraception. The State Secretary answered each question, explained the causes given by the abortion doctors' association, declined to pursue more aftercare checks, and promised a new unwanted-pregnancy policy letter by mid-November.
I will therefore not steer towards carrying out more aftercare checks.
Ik zal daarom niet aansturen op het uitvoeren van meer nacontroles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het VN-rapport dat oproept tot wereldwijde afschaffing van draagmoederschap

An MP asked the government to respond to a UN report calling for a global ban on surrogacy, citing harms such as trafficking, financial coercion and forced abortion. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the risks and pointed to existing criminal law, a forthcoming trafficking-law amendment and the pending Kind, draagmoederschap en afstamming bill, but rejected a ban as ineffective.
I do not consider a ban on surrogacy to be meaningful.
Ik acht een verbod op draagmoederschap niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Is er geen vervolging in Nederland?’ Yerani werd zondag ruw over de straat gesleurd wegens evangelieprediking

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the Justice Minister about a reported assault on an evangelist in Amsterdam, how widespread violence against street preachers is, and whether the government will act to protect them and engage municipalities. The minister condemned such violence, said police arrested a suspect, stated no data on attacks against street preachers are kept, and said there are no signals requiring a guidance document, noting police maintain public order under the mayor.
The police do not keep data on violence against specifically evangelists or street preachers.
Gegevens over geweld tegen specifiek evangelisten of straatpredikers houdt de politie niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over nieuwe berichten over aanvallen op christenen in West- en Centraal-Afrika

ChristenUnie MPs Ceder and Bikker asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in West and Central Africa, whether perpetrators are mainly Islamist groups, whether the government will press Nigeria on specific demands, and on the status of EU and parliamentary motions. The minister condemned the violence, said it affects both Christians and Muslims with different dynamics per country, reaffirmed religious freedom as a priority, and said no date is known for an EU special envoy and the motion follow-up will be reported later.
The cabinet will inform your House about this shortly.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hier binnenkort over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bikker over het bericht Meisje (3) kan glimlachen en kijkt Peppa Big, maar van rechter mag haar beademing stoppen

MPs Hertzberger and Bikker asked about a court ruling allowing a hospital to stop ventilation for a severely ill three-year-old, and about the criteria for medically futile care, parental rights, reanimation policy and appeal procedures. The minister answered that the hospital's assessment of futility was shared by second opinions, that the court weighed the rights involved, that parents need not be removed from parental authority, and that appeal and review of the court's marginal test are matters for the courts.
It is not for me, as Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, to sit in the judge's chair.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, om op de stoel van de rechter te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Bikker over recente incidenten rond Joodse Nederlanders

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about recent incidents against Jewish Dutch people and institutions, the resulting intimidation, whether the government will cover community security costs, and what is being done against antisemitism on social media. The minister confirms the concern, calls on victims to file reports, points to the Strategy Combating Antisemitism 2024–2030 and a 1.3 million euro Security Fund now open for applications, and refers to an online discrimination action plan.
I have no national overview of all the security costs borne by the Jewish community.
Ik heb geen landelijk overzicht van alle beveiligingskosten die door de Joodse gemeenschap gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe cijfers van het Landelijk Alcohol en Drugs Informatie Systeem (LADIS)

MPs asked the government about the rising number of people seeking treatment for gambling addiction (many young, mostly online), the lack of a ban on online gambling advertising, the minimum gambling age, drug addiction trends including cannabis and new substances, and the cost of cannabis-related addiction care. The minister acknowledged the trends as worrying, pointed to planned gambling law revision with consultation in 2026 and a planned raise of the minimum age to 21, and listed prevention measures while declining to ban gambling outright and giving no cost breakdown for cannabis treatment.
The aim is to put the relevant bill out for consultation in 2026.
Het streven is om het betreffende wetsvoorstel in 2026 in consultatie te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de berichten 'Joodse studenten voelen zich onveilig en buitengesloten op UvA en VU: "De universiteit adviseerde me niet meer te komen"' en 'Antisemitisme drijft leerli

Christian Union MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the education minister how the government responds to reports that Jewish students feel unsafe at Dutch universities and that antisemitism drives pupils to Jewish schools, and what measures exist. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures (Strategy Against Antisemitism, guidance, planned security duty, monitoring plans) and said further steps would be considered after a task force reports in early 2026, while declining to register religion or monitor the handbook's use.
Institutions do not register religion for privacy reasons.
Instellingen registreren religie wegens privacy redenen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Diederik van Dijk over ‘De geëscaleerde demonstratie bij een bijeenkomst van Christenen voor Israël’

MPs Bikker and Van Dijk asked how the government views an escalated pro-Palestinian demonstration at a Christenen voor Israël gathering in Barneveld, including intimidation of attendees, the role of the mayor and police, and whether freedom of assembly is safeguarded. The government answered that the gathering went ahead, that intimidation is unacceptable, and that the mayor is responsible for facilitating and intervening, while referring to a WODC study on how demonstration rights relate to other fundamental rights due in summer 2025 and a government response in autumn.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester, om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitputtingsziekte ME/CVS

An MP asked the Minister of Health about doubts over the evidence for cognitive behavioural therapy for children with ME/CVS, reports of harm and coerced treatment, and whether guidelines and reports to Veilig Thuis were appropriate. The Minister largely deferred to the medical profession (NVK), said the government does not decide on treatment, and only committed to continued funding of biomedical research and the ZonMw programme.
As Minister I do not decide on the diagnosis or treatment of patients, because that is the doctor's domain.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de diagnose of de behandeling van patiënten, want dat is het terrein van de arts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over privatisering van zorgvastgoed

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the sale of Pro Senectute's care group and its real estate to investment companies, questioning effects on care quality, client rights and whether the Wibz would prevent such situations. The State Secretary answers largely in general terms, says quality of care must come before financial interest, notes the Wibz tightens the definition of profit distribution and conditions it, and declines to comment on the individual case or on use of sale proceeds.
I want to be reticent in responding to individual cases, especially when I do not know all the details.
Ik wil terughoudend zijn met het reageren op individuele casuïstiek zeker wanneer ik niet alle details ken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach en Diederik van Dijk over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 22 april in Lelystad

MPs Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach and Van Dijk asked whether a counter-demonstration at a Christians for Israel lecture in Lelystad, which forced attendees to stay inside for about three quarters of an hour, was announced or permitted, what support municipalities get, and how safety will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the municipality was informed only shortly before, that the mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations, and that a research study on the legal framework is expected at the end of summer.
In the Netherlands the mayor is responsible for facilitating the right to demonstrate.
In Nederland is de burgemeester verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van het demonstratierecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 17 april in Zaltbommel

MPs Eerdmans and Bikker asked whether the government would guarantee safety at a Zaltbommel event after a counter-demonstration intimidated attendees, and why organisers were not warned in advance. The Minister answered that the demonstration was not announced, that safety is a matter for the mayor and police, and that a WODC study on the demonstration right will report later this year.
It is a local matter and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council for it.
Het is een lokale aangelegenheid en de burgemeester legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht dat Eurojackpot de nieuwe hoofdsponsor van de KNVB Beker wordt

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether it is acceptable that Eurojackpot, part of the state-owned Nederlandse Loterij, became the main sponsor of the KNVB Cup, whether the deal falls outside the online gambling advertising ban, and whether legislation and dialogue with the KNVB are planned. The Secretary of State answered that lotteries are not covered by the sports sponsorship ban, that organisations should weigh their social responsibility, that stricter online gambling advertising rules are planned, and that no talks with the KNVB are foreseen because no rules are broken.
Since the agreement has already been concluded and no advertising rules for lotteries are being breached, I see no reason to hold a conversation with the KNVB about this.
Aangezien de overeenkomst reeds is gesloten en geen reclameregels voor loterijen worden overtreden, zie ik geen aanleiding om hier een gesprek met de KNVB over te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Patijn, Bikker en Saris over de vertraging van het UWV-onderzoek naar de beoordeling van post-COVID-patiënten

MPs asked why the UWV study into how post-COVID patients were assessed for WIA benefits was delayed, and what is being done about knowledge gaps among insurance physicians and the duration-capacity standard. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the study is expected to finish in September, outlined a handbook and casuistry being developed with the NVVG, and rejected the view that the problem is structurally underestimated.
I regret that the study has been delayed.
Ik betreur dat het onderzoek vertraging heeft opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de verjaring van kindermisbruik op de BES-eilanden

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked why serious sexual offences against minors can still become time-barred on the BES islands while they cannot in the European Netherlands, and whether the rules will be aligned. The government confirms the twelve-year limitation period on the islands, explains it stems from a policy of restraint in legislation for Caribbean Netherlands, and says the limitation rules will be reviewed alongside accepting the Istanbul Convention, with acceptance expected by 2027 at the earliest and possible inclusion in a justice omnibus bill.
It is being considered whether the limitation periods can be adjusted as quickly as possible by including them in the justice omnibus bill for the BES that is currently being prepared.

Bezien wordt of een aanpassing van de verjaringstermijnen zo snel mogelijk kan worden verwezenlijkt, door deze op te nemen in het verzamelwetsvoorstel Justitie voor de BES dat op dit moment wordt voorbereid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over het onderzoek ‘Met een schone lei beginnen. Onderzoek naar schulden bij slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting’ en het bericht ‘Slachtoffers uitbuiting blijven vaak met

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about a study on debts of victims of sexual exploitation and whether victims of trafficking are actually compensated through criminal or civil proceedings and the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The Secretary of State answered that the Netherlands meets its Council of Europe obligations, cited figures on compensation measures and Schadefonds applications, acknowledged obstacles such as courts declaring victim claims inadmissible, and pointed to planned improvements and a forthcoming Meerjarenagenda Slachtofferbeleid.
The Judiciary has no information on the full amount awarded or how many applications were rejected.
De Rechtspraak heeft geen informatie over het volledige toegekende bedrag of hoeveel aanvragen zijn afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de uitbreiding van militaire trainingsfaciliteiten op ’t Harde

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked how long permit procedures for expanding military training facilities take, whether this slows defence readiness, and how regulations, nature protection and noise concerns will be handled. The government acknowledges lengthy permit procedures and the tension with defence urgency, outlines short- and long-term steps such as accelerating existing permits, the NPRD programme and a planned bill, but gives no average processing time.
An average processing time for permit procedures for expanding Dutch military facilities cannot be given.
Een gemiddelde doorloopsnelheid van vergunningsprocedures voor uitbreiding van de Nederlandse militaire faciliteiten is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Paulusma, Bikker en Krul over het beëindigen van de VWS-subsidie aan het IKNL Trialbureau

MPs asked why the minister is ending the VWS subsidy for the IKNL trial bureau, its amount, timing, alternatives and impact. The minister confirmed the subsidy for trial activities ends on 1 January 2026 on state aid grounds, stated the 2025 amount, and declined substantive answers on alternatives and timing because an objection by IKNL is pending.
Because of this ongoing objection procedure, I cannot make any further substantive statements.
Vanwege deze lopende bezwaarprocedure kan ik daarom verder geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over reclames van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor een Vrijwillig Levenseinde (NVVE)

An MP asked the state secretary about NVVE billboards reading 'it is enough' and 'what if your life feels complete', arguing they suggest euthanasia on grounds of a completed life and are unsuitable near vulnerable young people. The state secretary rejected the suggestion, pointed to the Advertising Code Commission complaint route and limited municipal powers over ideological advertising, and said the government promotes careful messaging on end-of-life and mental health.
Ideological advertising falls within the scope of the right to freedom of expression.
Ideële reclame valt onder de reikwijdte van het recht van vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de herbeoordeling van bouwtechnische rapporten als grond voor een besluit 'op norm' door ander bouwtechnisch bureau

An MP asked the Staatssecretaris about implementing the Bikker motion, under which residents can request a re-assessment of a structural-safety report by another engineering firm, and why such requests are refused until the full objection and appeal process is exhausted. The Staatssecretaris answered that a re-assessment as a final safety net is being prepared with NCG for summer 2025, that it comes after all other steps, and that she prefers not to bring it earlier in the process.
I am making a re-assessment of a structural report as a basis for an 'on-norm' decision possible with NCG by summer 2025.
Ik maak een herbeoordeling van een bouwtechnisch rapport als grond voor een besluit op-norm voor de zomer van 2025 mogelijk met NCG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Burgemeester bezorgd over uitkomst onderzoek illegale prostitutie en mensenhandel: ‘Misstanden aangetroffen”

An MP asked the ministers about reports of serious abuses found in illegal prostitution during a Hague inspection, and about the scale of victims of exploitation, shelter capacity and protection of migrant sex workers. The government answered that the abuses are serious, that cooperation with municipalities is being supported through the Action Plan, and that it is preparing further steps such as a vision letter, a review of the motion on talks with countries of origin, and a study on decoupling victim status from prosecution.
The abuses found as described in the report are serious.
De aangetroffen misstanden zoals benoemd in het bericht zijn ernstig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de toekomst van hospicezorg

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for health about the imminent closure of the Rotterdam hospice De Vier Vogels, shortfalls in hospice capacity, non-cost-covering day tariffs for small hospices, and funding after 2026. The state secretary regretted the closure, pointed to multiple causes and ongoing talks with insurers, said capacity in Rotterdam is adequate for now, and deferred decisions on additional funding and on the subsidy scheme to the spring budget decision and a 2026 evaluation.
After the summer of 2025 an integral evaluation of the subsidy scheme will start, which will also include the funding system for the deployment of volunteers.
Na de zomer van 2025 start een integrale evaluatie van de subsidieregeling, waarin ook de bekostigingssystematiek voor de inzet van vrijwilligers wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Geen baby's anoniem achtergelaten in eerste jaar vondelingenkamer: "Nul is een mooi cijfer"'

MPs Bikker asked the state secretary about anonymous abandonment of babies in a foundling room, the fate of a migrant worker dismissed after giving birth, and support for vulnerable pregnant women. The state secretary replied that the foundling rooms are a private initiative outside government control, that Fiom is examining the situation of migrant workers and will report before summer, and described existing support and aftercare arrangements.
The fact that the foundling rooms are not used can be regarded as confirmation of the effectiveness of the current procedure for adoption relinquishment.
Het feit dat de vondelingenkamers niet worden gebruikt kan worden beschouwd als een bevestiging van de effectiviteit van de huidige procedure rondom het doen van afstand ter adoptie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Bikker, Krul en Van der Plas over abortus vanwege geslacht

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA and BBB asked whether sex-based abortion after prenatal sex disappointment is discriminatory, whether it conflicts with the Embryowet ban on sex selection, and whether verification or regulation of pre-technical sex-determination ultrasounds is possible. The state secretary answered that such abortions are rare and multi-motivated, that a study of reasons would be unreliable and undesirable, and that private ultrasounds fall outside state regulation and cannot be influenced by law.
I have made inquiries with the professional groups of midwives (KNOV), sonographers (BEN) and abortion doctors (NGvA) on this.
Ik heb hierop navraag gedaan bij de beroepsgroepen van verloskundigen (KNOV), echoscopisten (BEN) en abortusartsen (NGvA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Dijk en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur’

MPs from four parties asked the state secretary for health about reports that insurers refuse to pay for home-based terminal palliative care because of budget caps, and about causes, insurer practices, and remedies. The state secretary disputes the specific case, says insurers report no such refusals, and points to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care programme as the way forward.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over informatie van FIOM over abortus

Two MPs (SGP and ChristenUnie) question the state secretary about FIOM's web page on abortion, asking whether its petri-dish photos and its claims on fetal pain are misleading and whether the subsidy-funded content is neutral. The state secretary defends the photos as accurate, says FIOM and the NGvA may clarify the accompanying text, and states that fetal pain is a matter for clinicians rather than legislation.
Fiom and the NGvA are considering whether this can be further clarified in the accompanying text on the website.
Fiom en het NGvA bekijken of dit verder kan worden verduidelijkt in de begeleidende tekst op de website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht ‘‘Den Haag laat kinderen op straat slapen’, woede over beperken opvang van dakloze gezinnen’

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about The Hague's decision to restrict shelter for non-entitled homeless families, and whether it conflicts with children's rights and national homelessness ambitions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for solutions, that the ambition of no children on the street is essential, and that the government is mapping homeless families and discussing regional housing measures.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to arrive at appropriate solutions for (threatened) homeless persons, including cases involving minor children.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te komen tot passende oplossingen voor (dreigend) dakloze personen, inclusief gevallen waar dat minderjarige kinderen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het NOS-item 'Ondanks verbod toch gokreclame op Belgische voetbalshirts, 'kan ook hier gebeuren''

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Belgian clubs' circumvention of gambling advertising bans could happen in the Netherlands, and whether clubs should be held to account for keeping gambling sponsorship until the ban takes effect. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Dutch ban on sports sponsorship by licensed online gambling operators takes effect on 1 July 2025, that new legislation will tighten advertising rules, and that he sees no ground to address clubs on existing contracts.
I therefore see no reason to address clubs now regarding these contracts.
Ik zie dan ook geen grond om clubs nu aan te spreken op deze contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over Unibet die de weg naar de rechter voor gedupeerden blokkeert en traineert

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether Unibet, licensed only since recent legalisation, is obstructing Dutch gamblers' court claims by refusing transaction records, and whether its licence should be suspended. The Secretary of State answered that the AVG and betrouwbaarheid questions fall to the Data Protection Authority, the court and the Ksa, that the state does not intervene in civil disputes, and that the Ksa cannot yet judge whether the conduct is an antecedent, while committing only to inform the regulators.
It is not for me to decide to suspend or revoke a licence.
Het is niet aan mij om te besluiten over te gaan op het schorsen of intrekken van een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over Chileense en andere illegale adopties en archivering adoptiedossiers

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked about the status of the Chilean criminal investigation into illegal adoptions, state recognition of victims' suffering, and how adoption files are stored and made accessible after provider licences expire. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Chilean investigation is ongoing with no outcome yet, outlined existing support services (INEA) and a planned transfer of adoption archives to the Nationaal Archief, and noted that the government apologised in response to the Joustra commission report.
Furthermore, the National Archives was not previously involved in adoption and is not burdened with any past misconduct.
Daarnaast is het Nationaal Archief in het verleden niet betrokken geweest bij adoptie en is het niet belast met eventuele misstanden uit het verleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Vandaag gestolen, morgen in Polen: ‘De hele polder wordt leeggeroofd'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about a news report on mass theft of farm machinery in rural areas, asking about its scale, registration, cross-border organised crime, funding for rural trust persons and ANPR cameras. The minister answered that theft shows no rising trend in police figures, outlined existing prevention and cross-border cooperation measures, and said budget for trust persons is secured through brancheorganisaties while police capacity is under strain.
The police have no insight into the amounts of the stolen vehicles.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de bedragen van de gestolen voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap is geen geld in de opvang’

MP Bikker (ChristenUnie) asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that care providers for people with intellectual disabilities and intensive care needs (VG7) are refusing clients and lack adequate funding, and about tariffs, waiting lists and alternative funding. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, points to a 6.2% VG7 tariff increase for 2025 based on NZa cost research, says no 15% increase is warranted now, and promises joint work with sector parties, a possible split of the VG7 tariff, and progress reports.
I find it painful that when you have a very intensive care need (or someone in your family does), appropriate care and support are not available.
Ik vind het pijnlijk dat wanneer je een zeer intensieve zorgvraag hebt (of iemand uit je familie deze heeft), passende zorg en ondersteuning niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned. The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Bikker over het bericht ‘Deze zes mensen zien het vuilste van wat op internet rondgaat’ en ‘Politie waarschuwt honderdvijftig bezitters van kinderporno

MPs Van Dijk, Krul and Bikker asked why Dutch hosting providers are slow to remove child sexual abuse material, why police only warn downloaders rather than arrest them, and what legal tools exist. The minister acknowledges that only about 26% of Offlimits reports were handled within 24 hours in 2023, points to the new ATKM powers since July 2024, and explains that police prioritise producers and networks, using warning campaigns for downloaders.
In 74% of cases no or insufficient follow-up was given to a report, and the child pornography material remained visible for at least 24 hours.
In 74% van de gevallen werd geen of onvoldoende opvolging gegeven aan een melding en blijft het kinderpornografisch materiaal op zijn minst langer dan 24 uur zichtbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder en Kahraman over het artikel 'Aramese christenen in Syrië vrezen voor hun bestaan en erfgoed: 'Massale uittocht moet worden voorkomen'' en 'Israël waarschuwt voor gevaren v

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about reports on threats to Aramaic Christians in Syria, changes to Syrian school curricula, a curfew in Homs and Israeli warnings about the interim authorities. The minister replied that the situation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises minority protection and an inclusive transition in EU and regional fora, and that Nederland supports the UN evidence bank and the Commission of Inquiry, while stating that no concrete signs of specific minority danger exist and that the curriculum remains unchanged pending new commissions.
At follow-up contacts the cabinet will continue to stress the importance of a role in the political process for all population groups, including Christians.
Het kabinet zal bij vervolgcontacten het belang van een rol in het politieke proces voor alle bevolkingsgroepen, waaronder christenen, blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht 'Geboortezorg voor asielzoekers van 'onacceptabel' niveau, concluderen onderzoekers'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about a report finding worse birth outcomes (higher perinatal mortality and low birth weight) among asylum seekers, and about transport, transfers and medical handover for pregnant women in reception. The government acknowledges the disparities and the problems with emergency shelter, points to existing arrangements such as Musselkanaal and taxi transport, and promises further study of the report's recommendations without committing to new funding.
If so, do you consider this cause for serious concern and can you provide the House with a comprehensive response?
Zo ja, vindt u dit reden tot grote zorg en kunt u de Kamer van een uitgebreide reactie voorzien?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over het bericht dat de Campagne van Platform Zorg voor Leven geweerd is vanwege “te veel negatief commentaar”

MPs Van Dijk and Bikker asked whether the government considers it acceptable that schools and education bodies refused an anti-abortion campaign from Platform Zorg voor Leven that was not in conflict with advertising rules, and how students are informed about alternatives to abortion. The State Secretary said schools decide their own advertising and curricula under constitutional autonomy, pointed to existing sexual education, counselling and information services, and did not commit to any new action.
Schools and educational institutions themselves determine how they shape their education.
Scholen en onderwijsinstellingen bepalen zelf hoe zij hun onderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat vier op de tien vrouwen die abortus kiest niet deed aan anticonceptie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that 41% of women undergoing abortion had not used contraception, and about contraception access, sex education, support for pregnant women and wait lists. The State Secretary answered that the findings are not surprising, outlined existing sex-education and contraception programmes, said no extra policy on affordable contraception is needed, and promised a new approach to unintended pregnancy in spring 2025.
So I cannot say whether waiting times for this specific form of supervised housing have risen nationally.
Ik kan dus niet aangeven of wachttijden voor deze specifieke vorm van woonplekken met begeleiding landelijk gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de wereldwijde gevaren van gokken voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked how the government views the Lancet Commission's warnings that gambling poses a global public health threat, and whether Dutch policy (led by the Ministry of Justice and Security) sufficiently protects vulnerable people. The State Secretary responded that player protection is being strengthened through new rules on deposit limits and contact moments, a tougher KSA responsible-gambling policy rule, a planned law revision after the Wet koa evaluation, and continued international cooperation, while rejecting a WHO resolution as currently unnecessary.
Protecting people from the negative effects of gambling is my primary concern.
Het beschermen van mensen tegen negatieve effecten van gokken staat voor mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bikker over het bericht ‘Wachttijden ggz niet goed vastgelegd, zeggen onderzoekers’

MPs Van den Hil and Bikker asked the Secretary of State for Health about research finding that ggz waiting times are poorly recorded, and about how the NZa monitors and enforces data delivery and whether insurers can get waiting-list information. The Secretary of State acknowledged the research, described ongoing NZa monitoring and improvement efforts and a pilot using declaration data, and promised to inform the House by spring 2025 on privacy-bound options, while declining to commit to a specific recalculation of incorrect waiting times.
I intend to inform the House further on this before spring (planned Q1 2025).
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor het voorjaar (planning Q1 2025) hierover verder te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Vooral bewoners zorginstellingen slachtoffer van mensenhandel, hulpverleners moeten makkelijker kunnen melden'

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about a report that vulnerable residents of care institutions and supported housing in Groningen are recruited for sexual and criminal exploitation, and whether national research, stronger protection measures and better cooperation are needed. The minister says the problem is serious but there is no evidence yet of a structural national problem, so no national study or new interventions are planned, pointing to existing measures, the Samen tegen Mensenhandel action plan and regional cooperation.
As the research shows, suspected victims of criminal and sexual exploitation often live in supported housing or reside in care institutions.
Zoals uit het onderzoek naar voren komt, wonen vermoedelijke slachtoffers van criminele en seksuele uitbuiting vaak in een begeleide woonvorm of zijn zij woonachtig in zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Boomsma, Tseggai en Diederik van Dijk over de aanpak van klanten die betaalde seks hebben met minderjarige slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police and prosecution capacity for pursuing clients who buy sex from minors, after the OM Limburg reportedly declined to target them, and about sentencing, online age verification on sex-advertisement sites, and effective enforcement. The Minister denied any national policy of not pursuing clients, cited the higher statutory maxima and capacity investments, and committed to talks with police, the OM and advertising platforms, plus a policy response to the CKM report before the Christmas recess.
There is no decision that no capacity will be deployed in any case for the investigation of customers of human trafficking.
Er is geen besluit dat er sowieso geen capaciteit wordt ingezet voor de opsporing van klanten van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Bikker over de eerste veroordeling van een klant die willens en wetens heeft bijgedragen aan mensenhandel

MPs Boomsma and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about the first conviction of a client under article 273g Sr for knowingly contributing to trafficking, and about minors being offered via legal sex-advertising platforms. The minister confirmed the first conviction, reported 4 registered and 3 prosecuted suspects under 273g and 31 registered/22 prosecuted under 248b, and said the ministry will talk with platforms and the Fieldlab Tulpafslag organisations, but ruled out mandatory online age verification for now.
It is correct that the Action Plan of the Together Against Human Trafficking programme contains no measures targeting sex advertising platforms.
Het klopt dat in het Actieplan programma Samen tegen mensenhandel geen maatregelen zijn opgenomen die zien op seksadvertentieplatforms.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bikker over het artikel 'Brede welvaart nu gaat steeds meer ten koste van latere generaties'

MPs Sneller and Bikker asked the Minister of Interior how often the generation test (generatietoets) has been applied since the Segers-Jetten motion, whether it has been evaluated, and how future generations' interests can be weighed structurally. The Minister answered that the test is still being developed in an interdepartmental working group, has not been evaluated yet, will be embedded in the Beleidskompas, and promised to inform the House in Q1 2025.
Ik ben het hier volmondig mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Psychiater Boudewijn Chabot introduceert eigen stikstofgasmethode voor mensen die humaan willen sterven'

An MP asked the government about a psychiatrist's film promoting nitrogen gas as a self-death method and media and cultural responsibility. The state secretary condemned the film as dangerous, said prosecution is for the OM and courts, and refused to ban it on free-expression grounds while pointing to existing media guidelines.
Taking measures to restrict in advance the publication of interviews and films about suicide is, however, not desirable in my view because it is disproportionate.
Het nemen van maatregelen door op voorhand de publicatie van interviews en films over zelfdoding te beperken, acht ik echter niet wenselijk omdat het disproportioneel is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Een leeg shirt voor de 20-jarige voetballer, want die mag geen reclame maken voor een gokwebsite’

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the July 2025 ban on online gambling sponsorship in sport also covers amateur clubs and whether loopholes like Belgian-style foundations are closed. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies to amateur clubs too, that public advertising including sports venues is also prohibited, and promised a policy response on the Wet kansspelen op afstand evaluation before year end.
Under article II, paragraph 1, sub a of the Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand, from 1 July 2025 licensed remote gambling providers are prohibited from sponsoring sport.

Op grond van artikel II, lid 1, sub a van het Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand (Besluit orka) is het vanaf 1 juli 2025 verboden voor vergunde aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand om de sport te sponsoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Holland Casino maakt forse verliezen en dreigt met agressieve gokcampagnes'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked whether state-owned Holland Casino would pursue aggressive gambling advertising to offset losses, how this squares with public health responsibility, and whether closures or reduced hours were planned. The State Secretary of Finance replied that Holland Casino has no plans to significantly increase marketing, that aggressive campaigns are unacceptable, that the government expects a role model from the state-owned company, and that the advertising framework will be assessed in an evaluation due in October 2024.
Holland Casino has confirmed to the Ministry of Finance that it has no plans to significantly increase its marketing expenditure.
Holland Casino heeft richting het Ministerie van Financiën bevestigd dat het geen plannen heeft om zijn marketinguitgaven significant te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘KNVB sloot sponsordeal met omstreden gokbedrijf dat onderdeel was van Chinese georganiseerde misdaad’

An MP asked the State Secretaries whether the KNVB had a responsibility to check the source of money in a sponsorship deal with a gambling company linked to Chinese organised crime, and whether sports bodies and clubs should review such deals. The State Secretary replied that the KNVB handled its own due diligence and was not legally obliged to publish sponsorship contracts, that the government will examine EU anti-money-laundering rules, and that it has informed NOC*NSF and the KNVB about the research.
The KNVB is responsible for its own sponsorship contracts.
De KNVB gaat over zijn eigen sponsorcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het verzet tegen de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum in de gemeente Nijkerk

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether she advised a Nijkerk municipal councillor on questions about a proposed asylum centre, and how such advice fits her responsibilities. The minister denied ongoing contact since taking office, said councillors vote without binding instructions, and said she only discusses her own policy field in her official capacity with local officials.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked ministers about the enforcement of labour exploitation, including prosecution figures, UWV's failure to revoke work permits in the Cornwall case, information sharing between ministries, housing tied to employment, inspectorate capacity and the scope of the criminal definition. The minister answered with figures on prosecutions, the legal limits on revoking permits, the new trafficking bill and the expansion of inspection capacity, while saying some earlier recommendations were not adopted.
On 25 April, the bill on modernising and extending the criminalisation of human trafficking was therefore submitted to the House of Representatives.
Op 25 april jl. is daarom het wetsvoorstel modernisering en uitbreiding strafbaarstelling mensenhandel bij de Tweede Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat opvallend veel scholieren online gokken

Opposition MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the government about reported rises in people in treatment for gambling addiction, linked to the legalisation of online gambling, and what it will do. The Secretary of State answered that a direct causal link to online legalisation cannot be shown, while acknowledging the increase is worrying and pointing to new speed limits, advertising restrictions, a planned evaluation and unchanged treatment capacity policy.
On the basis of the available figures and studies, I cannot endorse that the increase in people in treatment for gambling addiction is in large part due to the legalisation of online gambling.

Op basis van voorliggende cijfers en onderzoeken kan ik niet onderschrijven dat de toename van het aantal mensen dat in behandeling is voor gokverslaving daadwerkelijk voor het grootste gedeelte te wijten is aan het legaliseren van het online gokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Boswijk over gokverslavingen door illegale gokreclames en de negatieve rol die illegale gokbedrijven hierin spelen

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Boswijk asked about illegal targeting of online gambling ads at young people, Holland Casino's role, rising gambling addiction among youth and related suicide and poverty risks. The Secretary of State answered that the ad ban is strict and the Kansspelautoriteit enforces it, that Holland Casino made a human error and has taken structural measures, and that new play-limit rules take effect on 1 October 2024 while further research is planned.
The Gambling Authority (Ksa) supervises compliance with this and enforces where necessary.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) ziet toe op de naleving hiervan en handhaaft waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over een voorgenomen volledige risicobeoordeling van LSD en MDMA

MP Bikker asked why the former minister ordered a full risk assessment of LSD and MDMA by the CAM, despite the CAM seeing no urgency for LSD and the low prevalence, and asked about consultation with justice bodies and international obligations. The State Secretary answered that, following the CAM's conclusion that LSD research is not urgent, no full assessment of LSD will be requested, LSD stays on List I, and that a response on MDMA will follow after the summer.
I follow the CAM in its conclusion and will therefore not ask the CAM for a more extensive further study now.
Ik volg het CAM in haar conclusie en zal het CAM daarom nu niet verzoeken om een nader uitgebreid onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Bushoff en Bikker over het bericht ‘Overheid wilde vooral niet te veel uitgeven aan compensatie ‘zorghelden’ met long covid’

MPs Dijk, Bushoff and Bikker asked whether the government deliberately limited compensation for healthcare workers with long COVID to contain costs, and why the claim process was so burdensome and so few were compensated. The minister answers that the scheme was a gesture of recognition rather than driven by cost or litigation, acknowledges the application process was strict, and announces a reopened application window with a higher amount and wider sick-leave period.
The cost aspect never played a central role in this.
Het kostenaspect heeft hierbij nooit vooropgestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Gasbedrijf wil boren en kijkt naar minister, Woerden blijft tegen gaswinning in Papekop'

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Vermilion's plans to extract gas from the Papekop field in a peat meadow area opposed by local municipalities, covering project procedure, subsidence, compensation for damage, pipeline routing and information to parliament. The state secretary answered that the request for the national project procedure is under study, explained the legal criteria and the mining damage compensation system, and committed to informing the House about the decision.
I will inform the House of my decision on whether or not to declare the project procedure applicable to Vermilion's application, and of my considerations.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer informeren over mijn beslissing over het wel of niet van toepassing verklaren van de projectprocedure op de aanvraag van Vermilion en mijn afwegingen daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Mila woont met haar pasgeboren baby in een auto in Noord, urgentieverklaring afgewezen'

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked the ministers how they view Amsterdam refusing an urgency declaration for a mother and newborn living in a car, and whether they would act against such policy. The minister answered that municipalities hold discretion over urgency criteria, that Amsterdam says it tried to prevent the situation, and that he will not discuss the case specifically for privacy reasons.
It is up to the municipal council to set criteria for determining which housing seekers qualify for urgency.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om criteria vast te stellen aan de hand waarvan kan worden bepaald welke woningzoekenden in aanmerking komen voor urgentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Hertzberger  over perinatale zorg

MPs Bikker and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Medical Care about the 24-week lower limit for active neonatal care of extremely premature babies, international comparison, and whether guidelines should change given new evidence. The minister answered that the guideline keeps the 24+0 week threshold, that clinicians may deviate in individual cases after consultation with parents, and that the guideline was published in March 2024 with a new revision planned from 2025.
In the previous and revised guideline, the lower limit for offering active care is an estimated gestational age of 24+0 weeks.
In de vorige en herziene richtlijn is de ondergrens voor het bieden van actieve opvang een geschatte zwangerschapsduur van 24+0 weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de gevolgen van een mogelijke sluiting van de afdeling verloskunde in Zoetermeer

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the consequences of a possible closure of the obstetrics department in Zoetermeer, including longer travel times, workload, and the Kansrijke Start programme. The Minister answered that no decision has yet been taken, that the hospital must follow the AMvB acute care closure procedure with municipal and public involvement, and that impact studies are being prepared by the GGD, the regional network and SiRM, with the IGJ supervising the procedure.
This type of matter must be discussed in the Regional Acute Care Chain Consultation (ROAZ).
Dit soort zaken dient in het Regionaal Overleg Acute Zorgketen (ROAZ) te worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en PSV in zee gingen met dubieuze Aziatische gokbedrijven'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Ajax and PSV's sponsorship deals with Asian gambling firms were adequately vetted for money-laundering risks, and about the legal framework, supervision, the planned gambling sponsorship ban and Curaçao's gambling reform. The government answered that football clubs are not gatekeepers under the Wwft, that supervisors' investigations are confidential, that the sponsorship ban applies from 1 July 2025 with no acceleration, and that the Curaçao law is delayed but being monitored.
Whether supervisors are investigating particular cases or entities is supervisory-confidential information.
Of toezichthouders onderzoek doen naar bepaalde casussen of entiteiten is toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’'

MPs asked whether the government will prevent extremist preacher Mohamed Hoblos from spreading his message online after being denied physical entry to a Utrecht event, and why the venue and mayor could not stop it. The government answered that an online approach is being developed, that terrorist content can be removed, and that under existing law a mayor can only ban a speaker in concrete and serious threat cases, while the organiser and Jaarbeurs assured the speaker would not speak.

Through various pillars, such as dialogue with the internet sector, the local approach and an ambitious international effort, the Minister of Justice and Security is making every possible effort in this regard, nationally and internationally.

Via diverse pijlers, zoals een dialoog met de internetsector, de lokale aanpak en een ambitieuze internationale inzet spant de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zich hier, nationaal en internationaal, zo maximaal mogelijk voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over antisemitisme in Nederland

MPs Bikker and Ellian asked about rising antisemitism in the Netherlands after the Hamas attack on Israel, including Jewish pupils' safety, reporting channels and EU cooperation. The minister answered that the government is in close contact with the Jewish community, that the NCAB and police monitor the situation, and that schools are encouraged to hold dialogue, though the answers largely restate existing policy and do not give concrete numbers or new measures.
I have tried to comply with your request. However, gathering the necessary data took some time.
Ik heb getracht aan uw verzoek te voldoen. Met het verzamelen van de benodigde gegevens ging echter enige tijd gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat online casino’s spelers misleiden om overmatig te gaan gokken

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that major online casinos mislead players into excessive gambling, including high default stakes, hidden bonus conditions, unwanted bonus harassment and state-owned operators' conduct. The minister responded that the Kansspelautoriteit is responsible for enforcement, that talks with operators and the Consumentenbond are underway, that stricter rules and a responsible-gaming package are being prepared, and that the Wet koa will be evaluated before drawing conclusions.
The Consumentenbond has not made its research data public.
De Consumentenbond heeft haar onderzoeksgegevens niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het artikel 'Commerciële buitenlandse route voor donorzaad voorziet meer dan helft van wensmoeders'

The ChristenUnie MP Bikker asks the minister whether the rise of foreign commercial sperm donation, used by more than half of intended mothers, is worrying for donor-conceived children, and what options exist following the adopted motion on clinics that do not exclude anonymous foreign donation. The minister answers that donor-conceived children may have relatives worldwide and that information via LIDC and the Sdkb is being provided, and that he is exploring how other European countries regulate this and will report on the motion's implementation in Q1 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuik en Bikker over het bericht dat influencers via Telegram slachtoffers voor duizenden euro’s oplichten door neppe sportuitslagen te helpen promoten

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that influencers promote fake sports results on Telegram to defraud young people, and about the harms of matchfixing and gambling. The minister answered that the influencers are described as inciting followers to crimes, that fraud prevention campaigns and gambling-integrity rules are in place, that the online gambling law will be evaluated in 2024, and that further measures on advertising and responsible gambling are planned.
I am aware of the report about influencers who lure young people into the arms of fraudsters.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker  en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Keer op keer werd de minister gewaarschuwd, en nu heeft Nederland 450.000 nieuwe gokkers'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the government was warned about online gambling advertising increasing youth gambling after the 2021 Kansspelen op afstand law, and about the Finance Ministry's dealings with Nederlandse Loterij and the gambling sector. The minister declined to answer the historical questions substantively, promising a Kamerbrief after a document search, and summarised later advertising restrictions and the Finance Ministry's shareholder pressure on Nederlandse Loterij.
Answering these questions is only possible after a thorough search of information and communication systems and archives within my ministry.
Beantwoording van deze vragen acht ik alleen mogelijk na een grondige zoekslag in informatie- en communicatiesystemen en archieven binnen mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen en Kuik over de handhaving van het aanstaande verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen door de Kansspelautoriteit

MPs asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit's chair signalled soft enforcement of the upcoming ban on untargeted online gambling advertising, and whether the regulator should fine every breach. The minister replied that enforcement is the regulator's responsibility, that normative talks precede fines, that operators had enough preparation time, and declined to discuss the chair's statements with the regulator.
It is up to the Ksa to give further substance to how it supervises and enforces compliance with the advertising ban.
Het is aan de Ksa om nader invulling te geven aan de wijze waarop zij toezicht houdt en handhaaft op naleving van het reclameverbod.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over de uitzending van Het Misdaadbureau waarin wordt gesproken over het project 'Onder mijn Ogen' dat wordt gebruikt op een aantal mbo-scholen in Noord-Brabant

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked about a broadcast on the 'Onder mijn Ogen' game used at Brabant vocational schools to spot criminal exploitation, and about data, teacher training, reporting duties and prevention. The Minister answered that no national picture exists, that schools bear safety duties while lacking investigative tasks, that the game is being evaluated and may be funded one more year, and that a reporting duty for serious incidents is being prepared for 2025.
At present there is no (total) picture of the number of signals or of the way and extent to which pupils and students are recruited by criminals.
Op dit moment bestaat er geen (totaal)beeld van het aantal signalen of op welke manier en in welke omvang scholieren en studenten worden geronseld door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over het bericht 'OM gaat ‘schokkend’ Hamas-filmpje bij De Kuip onderzoeken, CIDI doet aangifte'

MPs Ellian and Bikker asked about antisemitic chants at the Feyenoord-Ajax match and why stadium police and the club did not intervene immediately. The government condemns the chants, says the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and the club is cooperating, and promises to discuss stricter anti-discrimination measures with the KNVB.
No statements can be made about ongoing or newly initiated investigations.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over lopende of nieuw op te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van der Laan, Mohandis en Bikker over het lekken van cijfers over misbruik in de danswereld

MPs asked the minister why figures from the dance-sector abuse investigation leaked before the victims were informed, and who held the figures. The minister answered that the leak is regretted, that only the ministries of VWS and OCW received the draft conclusions, and that the government will respond after studying the final report due 22 May.
I have not yet responded substantively, but I think it is important to state that my concern is with the victims.
Ik heb nog niet inhoudelijk gereageerd, maar vind het wel belangrijk om aan te geven dat mijn zorg uitgaat naar de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Meer geld naar gokreclames in aanloop naar verbod’

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Mutluer asked why gambling advertising spending rose despite industry self-regulation promises, and when the promised ban would take effect. The Minister said a ban on untargeted online gambling advertising takes effect by 1 July 2023, that self-regulation is insufficient, and that he has repeatedly urged restraint from state-owned gambling companies.
The ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling will be adopted shortly and takes effect by 1 July 2023 at the latest.
Het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen wordt binnenkort vastgesteld en treedt uiterlijk per 1 juli 2023 in werking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Bikker over het bericht dat het gebruik van zelfdodingspoeder Middel X flink steeg nadat Coöperatie Laatste Wil bekend maakte welke stof het bevat

MPs from SGP, JA21 and ChristenUnie asked whether the rise in use of suicide powder Middel X after the Coöperatie Laatste Wil disclosed its substance was causal, whether reporting duties for doctors or a ban on the cooperative were warranted, and about the status of investigations. The minister answered that a causal link cannot be established from NVIC data, that a reporting duty would conflict with medical confidentiality and is not currently appropriate, that prosecution of ten people is being prepared with the investigating judge, and that a dissolution request is for the Public Prosecution Service to judge.
The Public Prosecution Service has previously publicly announced that it intends to prosecute ten persons involved or formerly involved with the Coöperatie Laatste Wil.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft eerder publiekelijk kenbaar gemaakt dat het voornemens is om tien personen te vervolgen die betrokken zijn of waren bij de Coöperatie Laatste Wil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij en Mutluer over het bericht 'Zorgen om online gokken in de klas: ‘Ze denken snel geld te verdienen’'

MPs from four parties asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health how minors gain access to online gambling accounts, whether gambling operators take age checks seriously, and when a ban on gambling advertising takes effect, including whether a two-strikes model should apply. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the Kansspelautoriteit has received no signals of circumvention, promises awareness activities and a ban on untargeted gambling ads by 1 July 2023, but rejects a two-strikes model as not fitting proportionate enforcement.
That is why I am doing everything I can to bring the ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling into effect as soon as possible.
Daarom stel ik alles in het werk om het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen zo snel mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Staaij, Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Hulpverleners zien alarmerende groei probleemgedrag met online gokken’

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Bikker, Kuik) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising gambling addiction after the online gambling market was opened, and about enforcement, the Cruks self-exclusion register, and the gambling advertising ban. The minister answered that reliable data are not yet available, promised a monitor with first results in autumn 2023, said the Kansspelautoriteit is investigating operators' duty of care and that stricter limits may follow, noted a Cruks redesign due April 2023, and said the advertising ban decision is being finalised after Council of State advice.
That is why I want to monitor developments over a longer period to strengthen the information position and to be able to form a reliable picture.
Daarom wil ik de ontwikkelingen over een langere tijd monitoren om de informatiepositie te versterken en een betrouwbaar beeld te kunnen vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Mohandis en Bikker over het uitgesteld betalen bij het online afrekenen van alcoholische dranken

MPs Kuik, Mohandis and Bikker asked whether online alcohol shops offering buy-now-pay-later payment undermine the Alcohol Act and encourage overconsumption, and whether the state will stop or ban it. The state secretary agrees with the concerns, notes that the Alcohol Act still applies, says some shops are already exploring alternatives, and will examine legal measures if shops do not stop.
If the liquor stores do not stop, I am willing to examine legal measures and discuss this with my colleagues in the cabinet.
Als slijterijen niet stoppen, dan ben ik bereid om wettelijke maatregelen te onderzoeken en hierover in gesprek te gaan met mijn collega’s binnen het kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened.
