The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Bikker en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Centrum tegen Kinderhandel slaat alarm: 'Pa of ma soms pooier eigen kind''

MPs Kuik, Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report by the Centre against Child Trafficking (CKM) showing rising, younger victims of exploitation, some exploited by their own parents, and whether official data and support reach them. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that registered figures underestimate true victim numbers, and promises further talks with partners, a 2023 follow-up on the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme and a research and reporting process.

I will discuss the research results with the CKM/Fier and other relevant chain partners, such as other victim organisations, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, to interpret each other's information further and reach appropriate follow-up steps together.

Ik zal met het CKM/Fier en andere betrokken ketenpartners, zoals andere slachtofferpartijen, politie en OM, in gesprek gaan over de onderzoeksresultaten om elkaars informatie nader te duiden en samen tot passende vervolgstappen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over uitbetalingen van geld en speelwinst door online kansspelaanbieders

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether online gambling operators deliberately delay payouts, whether they should pay out instantly, and whether cancelling a withdrawal after requesting it should be banned. The Minister for Legal Protection replied that delays may be justified by fraud checks, that operators must pay 'without undue delay' under the Bkoa, that the Kansspelautoriteit supervises this and has an ongoing investigation into the duty of care, and that no intervention such as banning cancellation is warranted for now.
It is up to the Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) to supervise whether gambling providers comply with this.
Het is aan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) om toezicht te houden op dat kansspelaanbieders zich hieraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld n Bikker  over de aanpak van zelfbenoemde ‘afvalcoaches” en pro-ana websites

MPs Westerveld and Bikker asked the government about self-declared 'afvalcoaches' and pro-ana websites exploiting vulnerable minors, including the lack of progress on an online investigation strategy, capacity, prior warnings, and blocking sites. The Minister answered that a multi-track approach is in place, the police exploration of an online investigation strategy is ongoing with results expected early 2023, individual cases cannot be discussed, and a blanket ban on pro-ana sites is not deemed opportune.
Unfortunately, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Helaas kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Ellian en Bikker over het bericht 'Justitie Den Haag schrapt 53 zaken: Wietkwekers en drugsdealers ontlopen straf'

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Ellian and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Den Haag public prosecution service had requested inadmissibility in 53 old drug-related cases, and whether this signals impunity and why cases were left pending. The minister called it a bad signal, explained the cases were mostly confiscation and older drug cases with no direct victims, that the prosecution service had discretion, and that backlog and capacity measures are underway.
The prosecution service cannot state what the sentencing demand in the cases would have been.
Het OM kan niet aangeven wat de strafeis in de zaken zou zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over wettelijke maatregelen om de kans op gehoorschade te beperken

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about legal measures to limit hearing damage, including whether the voluntary prevention convenant should become a statutory duty of care and how to enforce volume limiters on earpods. The state secretary declined to pre-empt the Health Council's advice, said the convenant will be extended by a year and that more sectors should join, and said the NVWA will further investigate earpod risks.
I have asked the Health Council to advise on possible further measures that could be taken in the context of preventing hearing damage.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om te adviseren over mogelijke verdere maatregelen die genomen kunnen worden in het kader van de preventie van gehoorschade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Stoffer over het bericht 'Vulva maakt nummer over abortus genaamd 'Kill The Baby' en over misbruikers genaamd 'Abusers''

MPs Bikker and Stoffer asked the minister how a song and release party about abortus ('Kill The Baby') relate to the Wet afbreking zwangerschap, to government abortion policy, and whether authorities can intervene. The minister answered that the song is protected artistic expression, that intervention is undesirable, that public broadcasters decide their own content, and that prior content supervision is constitutionally impermissible.
Ik acht ingrijpen dan ook ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bikker over Het artikel 'Bonden dagen Helder voor rechter om uitblijven longcovidfonds zorg'

MPs Paulusma and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about unions suing over the government's failure to set up a long-COVID fund for healthcare workers, and about the delayed letter promised under their motion. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said a legal review by the Raad van State is needed before deciding on support for this group, and promised an update this autumn.
After receiving the advice, the cabinet will decide on the follow-up to the exploration and will inform your House about this by letter as soon as possible.
Na ontvangst van de voorlichting beslist het kabinet over het vervolg op de verkenning en zal uw Kamer daarover zo spoedig mogelijk per brief informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het rapport 'In Europa uitgebuit nergens beschermd', het bericht 'Nederland stuurt slachtoffers mensenhandel terug naar Italië ondanks risico op herhaalde uitbuiting'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a Salvation Army report on Nigerian trafficking victims, a report on returns of trafficking victims to Italy, and implementation of the Segers/Buitenweg motion. The State Secretary answered that the government relies on mutual trust among member states, that the B8/3 residence scheme was amended in 2019 with an evaluation due in 2023, and that the IND's multidisciplinary pilot had limited reach, while committing to further study and possible follow-up.
It is then up to the receiving member state to organise appropriate care.
Het is dan aan de ontvangende lidstaat om gepaste zorg te organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘ADO Den Haag vindt in Funland nieuwe hoofdpartner jeugdopleiding’ en over het aangekondigde verbod op sponsoring van sportclubs door aanbieders van kansspelen in he

An MP asked whether gambling operators (Hommerson Funland and Sir Winston) sponsoring ADO Den Haag youth kits and shirts breaches the ban on gambling advertising aimed at minors, and asked about the scope and timing of the planned sponsorship ban. The ministers acknowledged that such sponsorship must not target minors and that the Gambling Authority can intervene, but said the planned sponsorship ban covers only online gambling and that a two-year transition period is proposed.
If a licence holder does not comply with these rules, the Gambling Authority (Ksa) as supervisor can intervene.
Indien een vergunninghouder zich niet houdt aan deze regels kan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) als toezichthouder ingrijpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bikker over het bericht 'Veel schoolleiders hebben geen idee wanneer de ventilatie in de klas op orde komt'

MPs Segers and Bikker asked about reports that many school leaders do not know when classroom ventilation will be fixed, and about CO2 meters, subsidies and the risk of a new COVID wave. Minister Wiersma acknowledged the urgency, explained the ventilation subsidy scheme of 140 million euros and said schools themselves are best placed to choose CO2 meters.
I acknowledge the urgency of getting ventilation in schools where insufficient steps have been taken recently up to standard as quickly as possible.
Ik erken de urgentie om de ventilatie op scholen waar de afgelopen tijd nog onvoldoende stappen zijn gezet zo snel mogelijk op orde te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht Prijsexplosie GHB vanwege oorlog in Oekraïne, verslaafden stoppen met de drug

MPs Bikker and Mutluer asked whether the government will expand outreach and addiction care for GHB users after reports of a price spike that could push users to stop abruptly or switch to other drugs. The State Secretary answered that substitution is undesirable, pointed to existing addiction-care initiatives, online information and monitoring, and to the government's drug-prevention and organised-crime policy, without committing to new concrete steps.
Given the concern raised by Novadic-Kentron, we remain alert to signals that give cause for intervention.
Gelet op de vrees van Novadic-Kentron blijven we alert op signalen die aanleiding geven tot ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de sponsordeal van Ajax en Unibet

An MP asked the ministers whether the Ajax-Unibet online gambling sponsorship deal, and the normalisation of gambling it may cause, is acceptable given the planned ban on gambling advertising. The minister answered that sponsorship is currently lawful within the rules, that the ban on role models in gambling ads applies from 30 June 2022, and that sponsorship by online gambling operators will be phased out via amendments to the Besluit Wrvk.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I have no view on individual sponsorship agreements.
Ik heb als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen opvatting over individuele sponsorovereenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Verkuijlen over het rapport ‘Jonge Nederlandse slachtoffers criminele uitbuiting witte vlek in aanpak ondermijning van Centrum kinderhandel en mensenhandel’

MPs Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about the CKM report on young Dutch victims of criminal exploitation, its link to organised crime, recognition of victims and the Dutch versus UK definitions. The government acknowledges the report, commits to a broader prevention approach, to working with the UK, and to a follow-up letter on the second report and the modernisation of article 273f Sr.
We endorse the findings of the report and the recommendation to anchor the approach to criminal exploitation and make it part of the approach to organised and undermining crime.

Wij onderschrijven de bevindingen uit het rapport en de aanbeveling om de aanpak van criminele uitbuiting te verankeren en deze onderdeel te maken van de aanpak georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Palland, Peters en Bikker over het artikel 'Investeer in preventie en die begint al bij de kinderwens'

MPs from CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about preconception care such as the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, its reach, and whether it should be part of the Kansrijke Start programme and municipal prenatal advice duties. The state secretary answered that Nu Niet Zwanger is already part of Kansrijke Start, available in 172 municipalities, that 272 municipalities have a local Kansrijke Start coalition, and that structural funding and possible anchoring will be explored.
Antwoord op vragen van het Ceder en Bikker over het bericht ‘Curaçaos roulette’

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about the Argos report on weak supervision of Curaçao's online gambling sector, its risks, Dutch involvement, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government acknowledged insufficient oversight, pointed to Kingdom package measures H.2 and H.19 for reform, and said licensing and enforcement fall under Curaçao's autonomy, with technical assistance offered.
The cabinet nonetheless recognises the statements made in the broadcast and endorses the finding that there is insufficient effective control and supervision of the online gambling sector in Curaçao.

Het kabinet herkent evenwel de uitlatingen die in de uitzending zijn gedaan en onderschrijft de constatering dat er onvoldoende effectieve controle en toezicht is op de online kansspelsector in Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat ’Haagse moskee wilde meewerken aan kortstondig uithuwelijken voor seks en geld’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that a Hague mosque was willing to help arrange short-term marriages for sex and payment, and how this relates to criminal and civil marriage law. The minister confirmed that only civil marriage is legally recognised, that religious marriage without a prior civil marriage is prohibited, and that the relevant offences are enforceable, while stating no signals of such marriages elsewhere and pointing to existing victim support channels.
To date, the cabinet has received no signals that so-called pleasure marriages are being concluded in the Netherlands.
Tot op heden heeft het kabinet geen signalen ontvangen dat er in Nederland zogenaamde plezierhuwelijken worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Westerveld over het bericht 'Hoe ‘pro-anacoaches’ kwetsbare meisjes misbruiken' en de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s. (Kamerstuk 31015-197)

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked about reports of 'pro-ana coaches' sexually exploiting girls with eating disorders, and the implementation of a motion on online investigation strategy and criminalising pro-ana content. The Minister outlines a range of prevention, support and criminal-justice measures already underway, but declines a blanket ban on pro-ana sites and says an online investigation strategy is still being developed, with details promised before summer.
In addition, I have committed to discuss with the police the development of an online investigation strategy.
Daarnaast heb ik toegezegd met de politie in gesprek te gaan over het ontwikkelen van een online opsporingsstrategie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat het aantal gokverslaafden is toegenomen sinds de opening van kansspelmarkt en dat inmiddels al 100 miljoen euro aan gokreclames is uitgegeven

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether gambling addiction has risen since the online gambling market opened and whether gambling advertising, speed limits and fragmented spending limits are adequately controlled. The Minister answered that no baseline existed, LADIS data will return by autumn, that speed limits are being studied, that untargeted ads are being restricted and role-model advertising banned from 30 June 2022, and that a cross-operator limit is under investigation.
I see no added value in separately requesting data from addiction clinics outside this system in the meantime.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in het tussentijds buiten dit systeem om uitvragen van gegevens bij verslavingsklinieken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Bikker over het PGB

MPs Sahla and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care why small-scale residential initiatives that function as care in kind are no longer structurally eligible for personal budgets (PGB), and how this affects beneficiaries' self-direction. The Minister defends the policy as aimed at budget holders who truly self-direct, says the government will work with care offices on contracting while keeping PGB where self-direction is real, and promises further consultation and a self-direction checklist.
My ambition for the PGB in residential initiatives starts from the perspective of the client.
Mijn ambitie met het pgb in wooninitiatieven start vanuit het perspectief van de cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over het bericht 'Gevaar loert voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: 'Prostitutie, gedwongen adoptie en uitbuiting''

MPs Kuik (CDA) and Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked how Ukrainian refugees are protected against exploitation, trafficking, and unclear coordination of private reception, and whether a reception ambassador is needed. The State Secretary answered that the government works with partners on awareness, flyers, EMPACT information sharing, and a new reception organisation, while noting dozens of registered incidents and one investigation, with no trafficking found in controls.

The cabinet works with various chain partners, such as civil society organisations (including the Red Cross and the Salvation Army) and churches, to make displaced persons from Ukraine aware of the risks of exploitation when staying with private individuals.

Het kabinet zet zich met de verschillende ketenpartners, zoals maatschappelijke organisaties (zoals het Rode Kruis en het Leger des Heils) en kerken in om ontheemden uit Oekraïne bewust te maken van de risico's op uitbuiting als ze bij particulieren gaan verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Bikker over de aflevering van Undercover in Nederland over uitbuiting en illegale prostitutie

MPs Knops and Bikker asked the Minister of Justice about exploitation and illegal prostitution exposed by a Undercover in Nederland broadcast, including prosecution of pimps, municipal enforcement against facilitators, cooperation with municipalities and housing corporations, and sexual health care for sex workers. The State Secretary answered that prosecution requires coercion or abuse of vulnerability, cited prosecution statistics and municipal enforcement tools, reported that 80% of municipalities have a contact officer, and described the pending Wrs regulation bill and existing sexual health services.
The cabinet is fully committed to tackling all possibilities for abuses in the sex industry.
Het kabinet zet zich ten volste in om alle mogelijkheden tot misstanden in de seksbranche tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over bedreigingen aan het adres van de Russisch-Orthodoxe kerk in Nederland

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice Minister about threats against Russian Orthodox churches in the Netherlands and whether the government would engage with the communities and local authorities. The minister condemned the threats, said local authorities and police are responsible for security and protection, and visited a Russian Orthodox parish in Amsterdam.
It is therefore up to the local triangle to decide how threats are handled and how this is communicated to those involved.
Het is dan ook aan de lokale driehoek om te bepalen hoe met bedreigingen wordt omgegaan en hoe daarover met betrokkenen wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bikker over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrische kampen

Two MPs asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syrian Kurdish camps, including their numbers, access to education, radicalisation prevention and repatriation. The government answered that about 60 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that the Netherlands supports humanitarian aid without direct control over services, and that repatriated children are placed in youth care facilities.
I cannot make statements about individual cases, the numbers per camp and the ages.
Over individuele gevallen, de aantallen per kamp en leeftijden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over ‘de voortgang omtrent de autoriteit terroristische content en kinderporno’

The MP asked about the state of the authority for terrorist content and child pornography, the implementation of the EU TOI regulation from 7 June 2022, and the administrative-law bill on online child pornography. The minister answered that the authority is being set up and aims to be operational in autumn once the implementing act enters into force, that interim arrangements are legally impossible or undesirable, and that the child pornography bill will be submitted to parliament after the Council of State advice is processed, aimed for this summer.
The draft Implementation Act is now ready, has received advice from the Council of State and is ready to be sent to your House.
Het voorstel van de Uitvoeringswet is inmiddels gereed, door de Raad van State van advies voorzien en gereed voor verzending aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het apenpokkenvirus

MP Bikker asked the health minister about the mpox epidemiology in the Netherlands and Europe, transmission risk, vaccine and medication stocks, EU cooperation and global support. The minister answered that cases are limited, mpox is now a notifiable A-disease, Dutch stocks of a third-generation smallpox vaccine exist, and EU joint procurement is being explored.
The cabinet closely follows developments around the mpox virus and the reporting and guidelines of the World Health Organization on this matter.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen rond het apenpokkenvirus en de berichtgeving en richtlijnen van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) daarover op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Bikker over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars investeren in fastfoodketens

MPs asked whether health insurers' investments in fast-food chains are a wrong signal given the obesity problem, and whether fast food should be an exclusion category. The minister replied that insurers decide their own investment policy, that the holdings are small (about 8 million euros), that dialogue with chains like McDonald's has produced commitments, and that prevention talks and an upcoming letter will follow.
As private parties, health insurers themselves decide on their investment policy.
Als private partijen gaan zorgverzekeraars zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat de Belgische overheid gokreclames aan banden gaat leggen

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Belgium's plan to restrict gambling advertising and about the status of Dutch measures to curb risky gambling ads, speech limits, bonus communication and youth gambling. The Minister answered that the Besluit werving, reclame en verslavingspreventie will be amended for consultation before summer, that the rolmodel ban takes effect 30 June 2022, that sector self-commitments are still being implemented with new figures promised in autumn, and that the Ksa has sufficient capacity.
The draft decree is currently being worked out and is on track to go to consultation before the summer.
Het conceptbesluit wordt momenteel uitgewerkt en ligt op koers om voor de zomer in consultatie te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Annelies zit al twee jaar in isolatie, maar Nederland is traag met medicatie voor kwetsbaren’

MPs Bikker and Van den Berg asked the health minister about the treatment of immunocompromised people with COVID-19, including medication access and the balance between opening society and protecting the vulnerable. The minister answered that vulnerable groups were consulted, sectors are asked to consider them, and several COVID drugs are or will be available, with Paxlovid procured via the EU because of delays and unacceptable conditions set by Pfizer.

I continuously seek advice on possible new treatments and will assess case by case whether the treatment is a useful addition to the available treatment arsenal and what the best procurement route is.

Ik laat me doorlopend adviseren over eventuele nieuwe behandelingen en zal per geval beoordelen of de behandeling een nuttige aanvulling is op het beschikbare behandelarsenaal en wat de beste aankooproute is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Grondeigenaren moeten opdraaien voor drugsafval op hun terrein’

MPs Bikker and Van Esch asked whether landowners stuck with costs of large-scale drug waste dumping (exceeding the 25,000 euro subsidy cap) should be protected, and about subsidy adequacy and underspending. The minister answered that the Rijk has no statutory duty but co-funds costs via a regulation, that talks with IPO, BIJ12 and Noord-Brabant are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
I will inform your House, on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, before the summer about the state of affairs.
Ik zal uw Kamer, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, voor de zomer informeren over de stand van zaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Westerveld, Van den Berg en Bikker over de staat van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

Four MPs asked the minister about financial strain, possible closures, staffing shortages and the new mental health care payment model in Dutch GGZ. The minister answered that insurers and providers must resolve continuity and financial problems through contracting, that the NZa is monitoring and was asked to analyse closures, and that a joint working-arrangement process on freelance staffing was started, while leaving much of the detail to the sector.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me about any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de vergunningsprocedure voor nieuwe toetreders tot de online kansspelmarkt

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the minister about the licensing of new online gambling operators, including an overview of pending applications, transparency about applicants, and welcome bonuses for young players. The minister declined to name applicants with pending licence requests (citing reputational harm), explained the Ksa's criteria and six-month timeline, rejected public consultation on applications, and said the Ksa supervises bonus rules for 18-24 year olds.
The Ksa cannot provide the requested overview of names.
De Ksa kan het gevraagde overzicht van namen niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Bikker over het niet opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Van Esch and Bikker asked why a large drug-waste dump in the Brabantse Wal nature area, found in March 2021, remains unremediated, and about health risks, cost recovery from the landowner, and dump statistics. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Brabant is the competent authority, that partial clean-up has occurred, that remaining remediation is complex and under investigation, and that the Interior and Justice ministries are discussing whether the 25,000 euro compensation cap should be raised.
Removing the waste is a responsibility of local and regional governments; I have no insight into that.
Het opruimen van het afval is een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale en regionale overheden, daar heb ik geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over PCR-testcapaciteit die in te zetten is voor grootschalig testen

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked why LAMP test lines used successfully by GGD Amsterdam were not rolled out nationally, and about costs, capacity and high-throughput PCR options for mass testing. The minister explained that LAMP lines need highly qualified staff and produce more errors at volume, gave cost figures, and said further assessment is pending; for many questions she said the data are unknown.
Before the test lines can be used again, a research process must first be carried out.
Voordat de testlijnen weer kunnen worden ingezet, moet eerst een onderzoekstraject worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat veel ondernemers zich laten uitbetalen voor hun werkzaamheden door middel van ruilprostitutie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that many entrepreneurs in several sectors offer services in exchange for sex, and about the lack of measures, the number of complaints, sex-for-favours websites, and a possible ban. The government answered that such misuse of vulnerable people is reprehensible, that exchange of sex between consenting adults is not prohibited, and that it will raise awareness and rely on branch responsibility and a pending bill on sexual offences.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service have no insight into the phenomenon of exchanging sex for favours.
Er is bij de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geen zicht op het fenomeen ruilseks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over voortgang en problemen rondom vaccindonatie

MPs Hammelburg and Bikker asked the government about rejected COVID-19 vaccine donations, unused stock, the status of Dutch donations to COVAX, and financing. The minister answered that rejections stem from storage, shelf-life, supply and hesitancy problems, that COVAX reallocates refused doses, that about 14 million of 17.8 million donated doses had arrived, and that further calls for funding will be made in the coming months.

The implementation of the Hammelburg motion on mobilising business support for COVAX will be explained in the letter 'Global COVID-19 efforts', which will be sent to the House before the debate of 10 March 2022.

De uitvoering van de motie Hammelburg betreffende de inzet op het mobiliseren van steun van bedrijven voor COVAX zal worden toegelicht in de kamerbrief «Wereldwijde inzet COVID-19», die voor het debat op 10 maart 2022 naar de kamer wordt gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘Meer verkeersongelukken in 2021, politie maakt zich zorgen’

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked about police concern over rising traffic accidents in 2021, including risky behaviour, nitrous oxide use in traffic, and the road safety targets and funding for dangerous N-roads. The minister outlined prevention and enforcement measures, said the nitrous oxide ban cannot take effect by 1 July 2022 due to procedure, and committed to a road safety target and prioritisation of N-road investments.
The cabinet is committed to reducing traffic participation under the influence of all drugs, and specifically nitrous oxide.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om verkeersdeelname onder invloed van alle drugs, en ook specifiek van lachgas, terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Medewerkers van GGD moeten weg na drie tijdelijke contracten’

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about reports that GGD staff on test and vaccination sites must leave after three temporary contracts, and whether covid financing could allow permanent contracts. The government answered that GGD organisations are responsible for their own personnel policy, that permanent contracts and redundancy procedures are possible, that VWS will finance certain extra costs under a cost-reimbursement scheme, and that talks will continue.
I have asked the GGDs whether they can quickly map the size of the group(s) of employees, as well as the financial implications that follow from this.
Ik heb aan de GGD’en gevraagd of zij op korte termijn de omvang van de groep(en) werknemers in kaart kunnen brengen, evenals de financiële implicaties die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Bikker, Ceder en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Nederland grote abortussponsor'

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and JA21 asked whether the Netherlands funds over 250,000 abortion services per year in poorer countries, how many were actual abortions, and how oversight, reporting and SRGR budgets are handled. The minister says abortion services are not consistently defined or counted, so the figures cannot be verified, and that partners report under general indicators without a separate abortion-service requirement, though audits, evaluations and monitoring apply.
For these methodological reasons, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to stop adding up and tracking the numbers of abortion services from 2017 onward.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft er om deze methodologische redenen voor gekozen om vanaf 2017 de aantallen abortusdiensten niet langer bij elkaar op te tellen en bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van den Berg over de boostercampagne voor mensen onder de 60 jaar met een kwetsbare gezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van den Berg asked the minister why the booster campaign for under-60s with vulnerable health moved from the planned 'seventh month after last vaccination' timing to an age-based order and was later accelerated, leaving some people without the promised schedule. The minister answered that rising vaccine effectiveness loss and the omicron variant led to an accelerated, simplified campaign in which everyone aged 18 and over could book a booster from 4 January, abandoning the earlier seventh-month rule.
To enable everyone to get a booster vaccination as quickly as possible, the implementation has been simplified.
Om zo snel mogelijk iedereen in staat te stellen een boostvaccinatie te halen is de uitvoering vereenvoudigd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over gokreclames op www.vi.nl

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister for Legal Protection about gambling advertisements, including live sports betting odds, on the website of Voetbal International, and whether they comply with advertising and youth-protection rules and the Kansspelautoriteit's oversight. The minister answers that the advertising rules apply to affiliates, that the regulator is responsible for supervision and enforcement, and that the website was adjusted, without judging the specific case.
It is not for me, but for the Kansspelautoriteit, to make statements on compliance with laws and regulations in a specific case.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de Kansspelautoriteit om uitspraken te doen over naleving van wet- en regelgeving in een concreet geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Dealen op scholen heel normaal, harddrugs vaker op gymnasiums’

An MP asks the Justice, Health and Education ministers about reports that drug dealing at schools is becoming normal, and about normalisation of drug use, youth addiction numbers, and prevention such as the Icelandic model. The government says there is no clear trend in dealing or drug use among pupils, points to €82 million for prevention, the planned revival of the LADIS addiction database in 2022, and the Helder op School programme, while declining to expand the Preventie Akkoord for now.
There is no precise data on the number of cases of dealing at school.
Over het aantal gevallen van dealen op school zijn geen precieze gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Enquête: klant moet sekswerker vragen naar de leeftijd’

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked the government about an survey showing many sex workers say clients should check age and identity, the sentences in the Valkenburg case, and measures to deter clients. The Staatssecretaris answered that a client-focused package and campaign are coming, that the Penal Code will treat paid sex with minors as aggravating, and declined to discuss individual court sentences citing the separation of powers.
I attach great importance to the separation of powers and consider it inappropriate, from my position as Staatssecretaris of Justice and Security, to give an opinion on individual judicial rulings.

Ik hecht sterk aan de scheiding der machten en acht het vanuit mijn functie als de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet passend over individuele uitspraken van de rechter een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

An MP asked whether COVID-19 closure measures and high infection rates would push sex workers into unsafe work and whether support schemes would reach them. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said support schemes including VLN and bijstand zelfstandigen are open to sex workers who meet the conditions, and promised continued monitoring with municipalities.

Furthermore, the cabinet, together with the VNG, Divosa and municipalities, is monitoring whether additional measures or funds are needed to bridge this limited lockdown for people facing a sudden drop in income.

Verder houdt het kabinet samen met de VNG, Divosa en gemeenten vinger aan de pols of er aanvullende maatregelen of middelen nodig zijn om deze beperkte lockdown te overbruggen voor mensen die te maken krijgen met een plotseling terugval in inkomsten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over vaccindonatie

Two MPs (Hammelburg, D66, and Bikker, ChristenUnie) asked the health minister about donating COVID-19 vaccines via GAVI, legal obstacles, the EU Team Europe approach, and comparisons with Germany, the US, Sweden and Norway. The minister answered that the Netherlands has signed donation mandates for AstraZeneca, BioNTech/Pfizer and Janssen doses and aims to donate roughly 25-27 million doses, but the answers largely restate policy and give limited detail on legal barriers and comparative figures.

The Netherlands has now signed the donation mandates under which all remaining AstraZeneca doses (about 7.9 million) and all remaining BioNTech/Pfizer doses for 2021 (about 2.8 million) will be donated to Covax.

Nederland heeft inmiddels de donatiemandaten ondertekend waarmee alle nog te ontvangen doses van het AstraZeneca vaccin (circa 7,9 miljoen doses) en alle nog te ontvangen doses uit de contracten met BioNTech/Pfizer voor 2021 (circa 2,8 miljoen doses) aan Covax zullen worden gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de valse start van het online gokken en de storing in het Centraal register uitsluiting kansspelen

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked why the Cruks gambling self-exclusion register malfunctioned at the launch of legal online gambling on 1 October 2021 and why the Kansspelautoriteit allowed licensed operators to accept players before registration worked. The minister acknowledged the start was flawed, explained the technical causes and the decision to allow play from 2 October as the safer alternative to illegal sites, and said Cruks now functions stably and the regulator will evaluate the start-up problems.
The Kansspelautoriteit has informed me that consumer privacy was not at risk at any point in the entire process.
De Kansspelautoriteit heeft mij bericht dat de privacy van consumenten in het gehele proces niet in gevaar is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitzending van Omroep Gelderland ‘In het vizier van de Jager’ en het artikel ‘Dit is moderne slavernij: politiek wil vrouwen van brandmerk afhelpen'

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about women branded or tattooed by loverboys and whether they must pay for removal, plus data on victims and insurance coverage. The minister answers that no victim counts exist, that victims can claim compensation via the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, and that removal is not covered by basic insurance without a medical indication, while promising to consider alternative funding.
It is terrible when a young woman is exploited and, under pressure, has a tattoo or brand applied.
Het is vreselijk als een jonge vrouw wordt uitgebuit en onder druk een tatoeage of brandmerk aangebracht krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Leaseplan: alleen volledig gevaccineerden weer welkom op kantoor’

MP Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers of Health and of the Interior about a report that Leaseplan would admit only fully vaccinated staff to the office, raising concerns about coercion, bodily integrity, remote work options, transmission data and employers' legal basis for recording vaccination status. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination is voluntary, employers may ask but not require vaccination or register status under the GDPR, and that the government is consulting sectors and will ask the OMT for advice if policy changes are warranted.
An employer may not require an employee to be vaccinated against corona.
Een werkgever mag een werknemer niet verplichten om zich te laten vaccineren tegen corona.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Plas en Bikker over het bericht ‘coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking’

Three MPs asked the health minister how people who can neither be vaccinated nor tested will get a COVID access certificate, and why no route existed when certificates took effect on 25 September, despite a Bikker amendment. The minister answered that a three-week GGD Utrecht pilot started on 6 October to define the group and test a less burdensome method, with exemption certificates as the eventual fallback, and that the answers were late.
After the pilot ends, it will be evaluated on whether it has found a structural solution.
Na afloop van de pilot wordt deze geëvalueerd op de vraag of met de pilot een structurele oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Bikker, Ceder en Segers aan over de Afghaanse heroïnehandel en de rol van Nederland

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Segers asked ministers about the Taliban's income from Afghan heroin trade and whether the Netherlands, as a Europe-wide transit hub, bears responsibility and can act. The government said the Netherlands plays an unintended role in the heroin market, that a causal link to Taliban financing is hard to establish, and that it is pursuing a joint EU and national approach through EMPACT, the drugs strategy and a security dialogue with Turkey.

Because of its infrastructure, its current role as a producing and transit country for drugs, and the role of Dutch criminals in the drug industry, the Netherlands unintentionally also plays a role in the European heroin market.

Nederland vervult vanwege haar infrastructuur, huidige rol als productie- en doorvoerland van drugs en de rol van Nederlandse criminelen in de drugsindustrie, ongewild ook een rol in de Europese heroïnemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Gezondheidslobby casht jackpot in gokbranche'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about reports that health-sector organisations such as MIND promoted state-run lotteries, the role of the Nederlandse Loterij, gambling reclame rules, and monitoring of gambling addiction. The government answered most questions substantively, committing to talks with MIND and asking the Kansspelautoriteit to act, while noting data gaps (LADIS not operational) and that some questions fall under other ministries or are commercially confidential.
Regarding the budgeted financial returns of any participation, we do not share information because it may concern commercially sensitive and competition-sensitive business information.
Over begrote financiële opbrengsten van welke deelneming dan ook, delen wij geen informatie omdat dit mogelijk bedrijfs-commerciële en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Segers over de motie Bikker c.s. inzake hybride onderwijs

MPs Bikker and Segers asked the Minister of Education about follow-up to their motion on hybrid education for students with support needs, carers and chronically ill students, including dialogue with sector bodies, knowledge gaps, unreachable obligations for teachers, reports of studies being postponed, and advice for affected students. The minister answered that the issue was raised with sector councils and will be in service documents, that institutions are responsible for finding individual solutions, that the group-size limit of 75 was lifted, and that students can seek help from student organisations and the support body.
At a next administrative consultation I will ask both sector councils and student organisations what their experiences have been so far.
In een volgend bestuurlijk overleg zal ik, zowel aan sectorraden als aan studentenorganisaties, vragen wat de ervaringen in deze tot nu toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Bikker over het bericht 'Geen Friese tolken meer beschikbaar vanwege 'magere vergoeding''

MPs Romke de Jong and Bikker asked about reports that Frisian interpreters are no longer available due to low fees, and how the right to use Frisian in court (Wet gebruik Friese taal art. 11) is guaranteed. The minister answered that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors exist, interpreters can be used, new tariff and procurement arrangements are being introduced, and a baseline survey and future bestuursafspraken are planned.
It is for my successor to give these arrangements concrete form and record them.
Het is aan mijn ambtsopvolger deze afspraken concreet vorm te geven en vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de toename van drugsgebruik onder studenten

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Justice and Health about rising student drug use, cocaine in particular, and how the care system and monitoring respond. The State Secretary answered that no national student-specific data exist yet, pointed to a monitor due in autumn 2021, acknowledged missing addiction-care data due to a stalled LADIS database, and described prevention programmes and funding.
There are currently no national figures on drug use specifically among the student population.
Er zijn op dit moment geen landelijke cijfers over het middelengebruik onder specifiek de studentenpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het sinds 1 januari 2021 geldend verbod van Zilveren Kruis om medische hulpmiddelen via apotheken en apotheekhoudende huisartsen te verstrekken

MP Bikker asked the minister about Zilveren Kruis's 2021 rule that medical supplies such as incontinence material and test strips may only be ordered from contracted specialist shops and delivered home, with high extra costs and patient harm concerns. The minister confirmed awareness of the change, said insurers must meet their duty of care under the Zorgverzekeringswet monitored by the NZa, noted the insurer set service terms, and declined to intervene as long as the insurer stays within legal limits.
I regularly organise consultations with health insurers. That does not alter the fact that I also hear your concerns.
Ik organiseer regelmatig overleggen met zorgverzekeraars. Dat neemt niet weg dat ik ook uw zorgen hoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Achterstand van honderden zedenzaken bij politie Midden-Nederland’

MPs Bikker, Michon-Derkzen and Ellemeet asked about reported backlogs of sexual offence cases at the Midden-Nederland police, the progress of the motion-Klaver capacity funding, support for victims and police staff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that 820 cases nationally (233 in Midden-Nederland) have been pending over six months, that capacity expansion and shortened training are underway with full staffing targeted for 2023, and that victim support and staff welfare measures exist, while acknowledging the backlog persists.
Of course, I will inform your House about progress in this area.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer over de voortgang op dit terrein informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Er woedt een machtsstrijd boven het euthanasiebed’

Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a dispute between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees (RTE) over how the Euthanasia Act should be interpreted, including the November 2020 euthanasia code, legal certainty, and the position of incapacitated patients. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged the lack of uniform interpretation as undesirable, stated the RTE and OM have distinct statutory roles, noted ongoing consultation and that the fourth evaluation will examine the issue, while showing restraint given the cabinet's caretaker status.
In view of this, I consider it important that the RTE and the OM interpret the Wtl unambiguously.
Gelet daarop acht ik het van belang dat de RTE en het OM de Wtl eenduidig uitleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Meerdere mensen overleden door zelfdoding-middel, verkoper uit Eindhoven (28) opgepakt’

An ChristenUnie MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports of deaths from a suicide agent (Middel X) sold via the Coöperatie Laatste Wil and an Eindhoven seller, and whether sale to individuals should be banned. The government answers that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that existing voluntary industry monitoring is kept, that a ban is not pursued because legal regulation is complicated and possibly counterproductive, and that the VWS ministry will consult the industry code parties again.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide any information on this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Werf, Kuik, Bikker en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the investigation into protection of Peter R. de Vries should be broadened to earlier victims and whether the inquiry commission should be fully independent with an additional criminal-law expert. The minister answered that the Safety Board (OVV) will investigate lessons from protection of the brother, lawyer and confidant of the Marengo witness, and that the broader scope fits an OVV inquiry rather than the previously planned commission, while not doubting the commission members' suitability.

I have asked the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) to take on an investigation into the lessons that can be drawn from the security situations of the brother, the then lawyer and the confidant of the crown witness in the Marengo trial.

Ik heb de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid (OVV) gevraagd om het op zich te nemen in een onderzoek na te gaan welke lessen getrokken kunnen worden uit de beveiligingssituaties van de broer, de toenmalig advocaat en de vertrouwenspersoon van de kroongetuige in het Marengo-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over de verplichte acceptatie van een coffeeshop door ABN AMRO als klant

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked whether coffee shops buying cannabis in cash fall under the Dutch anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), how many unusual-transaction reports coffee shops filed, whether prosecutions followed, and why supervision differs from other traders. The minister says coffee shops may fall under the Wwft above EUR 10,000 but that Wwft supervision of their soft-drug purchases is not applied in line with the tolerance policy, no coffee shop reports appear in FIU data, and a regulated cannabis supply experiment is planned.
Wwft supervision of coffee shops is carried out in line with the tolerance policy.
Het Wwft-toezicht op coffeeshops wordt in lijn met het gedoogbeleid uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Palland over de kleinschalige detentievoorziening De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the small-scale detention unit De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel, including its outcomes, funding, possible nationwide rollout and reported closure. The minister answered that it is a pilot with promising recidivism and financial indications but no full cost-benefit analysis, that its elements will be built into the BBA concept, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before informing the House after the summer recess.
I will inform your House about this after the summer recess.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover na het zomerreces informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeal

MPs Kuiken, Paternotte and Bikker asked the Minister about the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including stock levels, objections raised by the LCH, alternative suppliers, contacts between ministers and RGA, and advance payments. The Minister answered mostly by pointing to a forthcoming Deloitte review, shared some documents, withheld details of the other large contracts pending receipt, and committed to passing many questions to the researchers.
I will ask the research bureau to include this question in the supplementary investigation and also to address the reason why protest was lodged where this happened.
Ik zal het onderzoeksbureau vragen om deze vraag mee te nemen in het aanvullende onderzoek en dan ook in te gaan op de reden waarom er protest werd aangetekend indien dit gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bikker en Pouw-Verweij over sterke toename van het aantal gevallen van euthanasie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bikker and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the sharp rise in euthanasia notifications in 2020 is worrying, whether the RTE commissions' ethical review is weak, whether video consultations and the RTE's narrowed 'questions-raising' selection undermine safeguards, and whether isolation in care homes is driving requests. The minister answered that the rise tracks the overall increase in deaths, that COVID-19 played only a minor direct role, that deviation from in-person consultations is allowed under the KNMG/ministry COVID arrangements, that no signals of rising euthanasia wishes in Dutch care homes were found, and that an evaluation will examine physician attitudes.
I see no reason for further investigation into the increase in the absolute number of euthanasia notifications to the RTE in 2020.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar de stijging van het absolute aantal euthanasiemeldingen bij de RTE in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitstel van de invoering van het verbod op lachgas en designerdrugs en het bericht ‘Woede om uitstel drugswet: ‘Echt grote onzin’’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Health ministers why enforcement of a ban on nitrous oxide and designer drugs such as 3-MMC was postponed, and why such substances remain easily available. The government answered that the delay stems from a lack of financing for police, prosecution and forensic enforcement costs, so the decision is left to a new cabinet, while it is preparing a separate 3-MMC ban and prevention measures.
The decision on both initiatives is therefore left to a new cabinet, as stated in the letter of 31 March on this subject.
Het besluit over beide initiatieven wordt dus overgelaten aan een nieuw kabinet, zoals vermeld in de brief van 31 maart jl. over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de mondkapjesdeal

Three MPs (Kuiken, Paternotte, Bikker) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the face mask purchase deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including overpayment, contacts with the initiators, disclosure of documents, and the role of the minister and secretary-general. The minister answered that the prices fell within the reasonable range at the time, shared a timeline of contacts and two purchase orders, but declined to publish the general conditions and deferred disclosure of the initiators' presentation to the company.
I have no objection to sharing this, but VWS is not the owner of this document.
Ik heb er geen bezwaar tegen om deze te delen, maar VWS is niet de eigenaar van dit document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de NOS-berichten inzake matchfixing

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked the government about rising gambling addiction during the COVID crisis, the expected effects of opening the online gambling market, and matchfixing risks. The Minister answered that addiction trends cannot be verified because the LADIS database is not operational, that the market opening on 1 October 2021 will proceed with stricter prevention rules, and outlined existing matchfixing cooperation and reporting arrangements.
Unfortunately it is not possible to determine whether the number of people with a gambling addiction seeking help has increased.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om in beeld te brengen of het aantal mensen met een gokverslaving dat zich heeft gemeld bij hulpverlening is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Van Nispen en Bikker over de ontstane onduidelijkheid bij de detentiefasering door invoering van de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Smeets, Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about uncertainty over when the Wet straffen en beschermen (Wet SenB) takes effect and how it affects detainees' phasing and casework before that date. The Minister answered that the law partially takes effect on 1 July 2021 and the penitentiary programme rules on 1 December 2021, that DJI will communicate the changes to detainees, and that current rules apply until then.
These entry-into-force dates (1 July and 1 December 2021) will be given effect in an entry-into-force decree to be published by mid-June 2021.
Deze inwerkingtredingsdata (1 juli en 1 december 2021) krijgen hun beslag in een inwerkingtredingsbesluit dat uiterlijk medio juni 2021 zal worden gepubliceerd.

m: Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Keijzer en Veldkamp ter vervanging van de nrs. 12 en 13 over het bieden van regels over eigen bijdragen voor ontheemden bij inkomsten uit arbeid
Requires rules under a delegation for mandatory own contributions by displaced persons who have income from work, to be set in the regulation.
The regulation referred to in the first paragraph shall in any case provide for rules on a mandatory own contribution by a displaced person toward the costs of their provisions.
In de regeling, bedoeld in het eerste lid, wordt in elk geval voorzien in regels over een verplichte eigen bijdrage van een ontheemde in de kosten van zijn verstrekkingen
Amendement van het lid Veldkamp over het uiterlijk per 1 juli 2024 voorzien in een regeling voor eigen bijdragen voor werkenden
Requires a ministerial regulation setting an own contribution for displaced persons' work income toward reception costs, with entry into force by 1 July 2024.
By ministerial regulation, rules are set on an own contribution from the displaced person toward the costs of their reception.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld over een eigen bijdrage van de ontheemde inzake de kosten van diens opvang
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Veldkamp ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het uiterlijk per 1 juli 2024 voorzien in een regeling voor eigen bijdragen voor werkenden

Amends the Ukrainian displaced persons bill so that a ministerial regulation sets an own contribution for displaced persons toward reception and other provisions, with rules to take effect by 1 July 2024.
By ministerial regulation, rules are set on an own contribution by the displaced person
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld over een eigen bijdrage van de ontheemde
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Piri c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 33 over middelen voor het MATRA-Programma
Shifts 2 million euro within the budget from one article to another to fund the MATRA programme for democracy and rule of law.
To that end, the funds on this article are reduced by 2 million euro in 2024.
Daarvoor worden in 2024 de middelen op dit artikel verlaagd met € 2 miljoen.
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Veldkamp over het inrichten van een geopolitieke raad
Asks the government to set up a geopolitical council of ministries, intelligence services and business representatives to coordinate national security and geopolitical resilience.
requests the government to establish a geopolitical council consisting of relevant ministries, intelligence services and business representatives
verzoekt de regering een geopolitieke raad in te richten, bestaande uit betrokken ministeries, inlichtingendiensten en relevante afgevaardigden uit het bedrijfsleven
Motie van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over jaarlijks een migratierapportage opstellen
Asks the Foreign Ministry to publish an annual migration report on its efforts to gain grip on migration and make migration agreements with origin and transit countries.
requests the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to draw up an annual migration report
verzoekt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om jaarlijks een migratierapportage op te stellen
Amendement van het lid Paternotte c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 36 over het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds in 2024
Proposes reversing the 2024 cut of 2 million euro to the Human Rights Fund by moving the same amount from another foreign affairs budget article.
we ask the Minister to reverse the cuts to the Human Rights Fund for budget year 2024.
vragen we de Minister om bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds voor het begrotingsjaar 2024 terug te draaien.
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over ook in 2024 minstens 50 studiebeurzen beschikbaar stellen voor Belarussische studenten
Asks the government to continue offering at least 50 study scholarships to Belarusian students in 2024.
requests the government to continue making at least 50 study scholarships available to Belarusian students also in 2024
verzoekt de regering om het beschikbaar stellen van minstens 50 studiebeurzen voor Belarussische studenten ook in 2024 voort te zetten
Motie van de leden Piri en Veldkamp over de versterking van de Nederlandse diplomatieke slagkracht middels het postennetwerk
Asks the cabinet to map whether and how the embassy network should be shifted or expanded given the geopolitical situation.
requests the cabinet to map whether, and if so which, shifts within the current embassy network or expansion would be sensible
verzoekt het kabinet om in kaart te brengen of en, zo ja, welke verschuivingen binnen het huidige postennetwerk of opschaling verstandig zouden zijn
Motie van het lid Dobbe c.s. over de bevroren Russische tegoeden inzetten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne en het onder druk zetten van Rusland om de agressie te staken
Asks the government to explore using frozen Russian assets for Ukraine's reconstruction and to pressure Russia to stop its aggression.
requests the government, also internationally, to explore possibilities to use the frozen Russian assets
verzoekt de regering om, mede in internationaal verband, mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de bevroren Russische tegoeden in te zetten
Motie van het lid Dobbe c.s. over landen aanspreken op ernstige vrouwenrechtenschendingen en met name feller stelling nemen tegen Saudi-Arabië
Asks the government to raise women's rights violations consistently with all states, including allies, and to take a firmer stance against Saudi Arabia.
requests the government to take a firmer stance against Saudi Arabia on violations of women's rights
verzoekt de regering in het bijzonder tegen Saudi-Arabië feller stelling te nemen als het gaat om het schenden van vrouwenrechten
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over onderzoek doen naar de opzet van een democratiefonds
Asks the cabinet to study the design of a democracy fund supporting civil society, media, NGOs and unions worldwide in promoting democracy.
to conduct research into the design of a democracy fund
onderzoek te doen naar de opzet van een democratiefonds
Amendement van de leden Paternotte en Veldkamp ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds in 2024
Amendment shifts 2 million euro within the foreign affairs budget from security and stability to the human rights fund, reversing a planned cut.
the commitment and expenditure amounts increased by 2,000 (x 1,000 euro)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 2.000 (x € 1.000)
Amendement van de leden Piri en Veldkamp over middelen voor het MATRA-Programma
Shifts EUR 5 million from the unallocated budget to the MATRA programme supporting democracy and rule of law in neighbouring countries.
The submitters therefore aim to free up an amount of EUR 5 million for the NFRP-Matra programme for 2024.
De indieners beogen daarom om voor 2024 een bedrag van € 5 miljoen vrij te maken voor het NFRP-Matra-programma.
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Veldkamp over transnationale mensensmokkelorganisaties en daartoe behorende mensensmokkelaars op de sanctielijst van de EU plaatsen
Asks the government to push within the EU framework for transnational smuggling organisations and their smugglers to be placed on the EU sanctions list.
requests the government to work within the EU framework to place transnational criminal smuggling organisations on the sanctions list
verzoekt de regering zich binnen het EU-kader in te zetten om transnationale criminele mensensmokkelorganisaties
Motie van het lid Veldkamp c.s. over de rechtsmacht voor mensensmokkel zodanig inrichten dat criminele mensensmokkelaars effectiever kunnen worden opgespoord, vervolgd en bestraft
Asks the cabinet to work to extend jurisdiction so that human smugglers can be more effectively pursued and prosecuted.
requests the cabinet to work towards arranging and extending jurisdiction for human smuggling in such a way
verzoekt het kabinet zich ervoor in te zetten om de rechtsmacht voor mensensmokkel zodanig in te richten en uit te breiden
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over mogelijkheden verkennen om antisemitisme als weigerings- of intrekkingsgrond zwaarder mee te wegen
Asks the government to explore giving antisemitism greater weight as a ground for refusing or revoking asylum, residence, integration and naturalisation, following Germany's example.
requests the government to explore various options for how antisemitism can be given greater weight as a ground for refusal or revocation
verzoekt de regering om verschillende mogelijkheden te verkennen hoe antisemitisme als weigerings- of intrekkingsgrond zwaarder kan worden meegewogen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldkamp, Olger van Dijk en Van Hijum over de toegenomen onveiligheid op de treindienst Zwolle-Emmen

Three NSC MPs asked why incidents of fare evasion and violence against rail staff on the Zwolle-Emmen line rose in early 2024, and what measures, cameras, travel bans and COA-related steps are being taken. The government answered that the rise largely reflects more systematic checks by the service team, that Arriva is reinstating two stewards per train, that camera discussions will continue, and that a national travel ban was ruled out on proportionality grounds while operators explore faster temporary bans.
No figures are available on the nationalities of the persons causing the incidents.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de nationaliteiten van de personen die de incidenten veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem
