MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldkamp over het artikel 'IND hield lage ‘nareis op nareis’-cijfers maandenlang achter'

Veldkamp (NSC) asks whether the IND withheld low 'nareis op nareis' figures for months and whether a draft memo on the matter reached the Minister or State Secretary of Justice and Security between July and October 2023. The government answers that the draft note did not reach either of them, based on the process sketch, and confirms the earlier letter.
Based on the information presented in the process sketch, we conclude that this is not the case.
Op basis van de in de processchets weergeven informatie komen wij tot de conclusie dat dat niet het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Veldkamp over het informatieverzoek inzake de coördinator nationale aanpak overlast

MPs Podt and Veldkamp asked why the ministry bypassed tendering for Snel Beveiliging Nodig's mobile supervision teams, why the Chamber was not informed, and about the coordinator's project plan, budget and evaluations. The government admits tendering was skipped due to urgent need, says the Chamber was informed later, and defends the pilot evaluation and monitoring arrangements.
The Chamber was not informed promptly about deviating from the tendering rules, because it is customary to inform the Chamber of this in the financial accountability.
Over het afwijken van de aanbestedingsregels is uw Kamer niet terstond geïnformeerd, omdat het gebruikelijk is uw Kamer daarover te informeren bij de financiële verantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over gewelddadigheden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Justice Minister about violence within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands, including whether the government knows the groups involved, whether they are linked to the Eritrean regime, whether violent organisations can be banned, and whether involvement should affect residence status. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing and details of suspects and group membership cannot be disclosed, that the government has no signals of regime direction, that the Public Prosecution Service could petition for a ban under civil law, and that existing residence rules are already strict.
I cannot make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik kan geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Sneller en Veldkamp over het artikel 'Gemeenten bereiden zich voor op ‘paspoortpiek’, vacatures staan open en noodplannen liggen klaar'

MPs Paternotte, Sneller and Veldkamp asked about a expected peak in passport renewal applications, its effect on applications from abroad and voting in the European elections, and whether a French digital passport renewal experiment could be adopted in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that demand will be two to three times higher through 2028, capacity and information campaigns have been expanded, voters need only a valid ID by 31 May, and remote biometric renewal is not yet secure enough, with the government monitoring developments.
The French government website states that from 1 March 2024 an experiment takes place in Canada and Portugal.
Antwoord 8 Op deze website 3 van de Franse overheid is te lezen dat met ingang van 1 maart 2024 een experiment plaatsvindt in Canada en Portugal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen en Koekkoek over gestapelde gezinshereniging

MPs Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen and Koekkoek asked the Minister of Justice and Security why she claimed thousands of people were affected by chained family reunification (nareis-op-nareis), given IND's uncertainty and expert signals of a marginal phenomenon, and how this squares with the cabinet's fall. The Minister answered that her conclusion rested on general family reunification figures and IND's Stand van de uitvoering 2023, that the law leaves room for misuse, that a broad migration package could not be agreed and the change is left to a next cabinet.
I concluded, based on the general figures on family reunification plus the total inflow figures and the IND's Stand van de uitvoering, that chained family reunification is a problem.
Ik heb op basis van de algemene cijfers over nareis plus de totale instroom cijfers en de Stand van de uitvoering 5 van de IND geconcludeerd dat nareis op nareis een knelpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Veldkamp over het omzeilen van sancties op Rusland via geografische U-bochtconstructies

MPs Paternotte and Veldkamp asked the government about Dutch goods reaching Russian weapons and surging exports to Russia's neighbours used to evade sanctions. The ministers answered that circumvention is a shared concern, cited EU measures and enforcement, but declined to give a definitive account of the export-surge cause and said the answer to question 10 could not be provided in time.
The cabinet is committed to taking restrictive measures against companies in third countries that circumvent EU sanctions, also in line with the Van der Lee motion.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan het nemen van beperkende maatregelen tegen bedrijven in derde landen die EU-sancties omzeilen, ook in lijn met de motie Van der Lee

Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Veldkamp, Kahraman en Van Hijum over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp dat sinds de zomer 2021 fungeert als opvanglocatie voor Afghaanse vluchtelingen

Three NSC MPs asked why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp, a Defence-owned Afghan refugee reception site, is being closed and whether closure will be reconsidered. The government answered that, following a motion, the site will wind down gradually to July 2024 in agreement with COA, the municipality and Defence, and that Defence will keep looking for temporary reception support while the site is needed for its own units.
In agreement with COA and in consultation with the municipality of Zeist, Defence has decided to make the site available for longer.
In overeenstemming met het COA en in samenspraak met de gemeente Zeist heeft Defensie besloten om de locatie langer beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over de Turkse militaire aanvallen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Dutch ministers about Turkish air and drone strikes in Syria and Iraq in late December 2023, including civilian casualties, damage to civilian infrastructure, consistency with international law, NATO coordination, asylum effects and protection of minorities. The government acknowledged Turkey's security concerns and stressed proportionality and avoiding civilian harm, but said it could not independently verify infrastructure damage, declined to assess Turkish compliance with humanitarian law as too complex, and gave evasive answers on asylum impact.
The cabinet has not been able to independently verify whether critical civilian infrastructure was hit in the drone and air strikes.
Het kabinet heeft niet eigenstandig kunnen verifiëren of bij de drone- en luchtaanvallen kritieke civiele infrastructuur is getroffen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Pool over nieuwe aanvallen op vrachtschepen in de Rode Zee

MPs De Roon and Pool asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about renewed Houthi attacks on shipping in the Red Sea, including a sinking, and whether the Houthis should be listed as terrorists, whether threat levels and protection measures should change, and what sanctions target Iran. The government confirmed the attacks, condemned them as violating international law, said there is no EU support yet for a terrorist listing but it keeps pursuing that option, noted the highest threat level has applied since December 2023, pointed to ongoing EUNAVFOR Aspides contributions and existing Iran UAV sanctions, but withheld details of further sanctions for confidentiality reasons.
Due to confidentiality, no further sanctions will be discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid wordt niet ingegaan op eventuele verdere sancties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Ook de EU heft economische sancties tegen Syrië op' en het artikel 'Kabinet houdt rapport geheim dat terugkeer van tienduizenden Syriërs kan betekenen'

An MP asks whether Syria readmission talks are underway, whether the new Syria country report allows refusing asylum claims and reassessing granted statuses, and whether ambtsberichten and IND working instructions should be less public. The ministers answer that returns proceed via assisted voluntary return, forced return talks are being prepared, individual assessments continue under the existing country policy, and status revocation is not yet justified.
At this moment it cannot yet be concluded in general terms that the positive changes in the current security and human rights situation in Syria are sufficiently far-reaching and non-temporary.

Op dit moment kan nog niet in algemene zin geconcludeerd worden dat de positieve wijzigingen in de huidige veiligheids- en mensenrechtensituatie in Syrië voldoende ingrijpend en niet-voorbijgaand zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Paternotte over het bericht ’UEFA gaf clubs in Rusland 10,8 miljoen euro, maar weigerde steun aan Oekraïense clubs’

MPs asked whether the UEFA should stop paying solidarity money to Russian clubs and whether Ukrainian clubs should receive the same support as others, given Russia's war against Ukraine. The government answered that UEFA is not a state body and sanctions compliance is UEFA's responsibility, that it will use informal channels and contact the KNVB, and that UEFA says it never refused Ukrainian clubs but bank blockages prevented payments.
The cabinet will use all available informal channels to bring its position on this matter to the fore and will also be in contact with the KNVB about it.
Het kabinet zal alle beschikbare informele kanalen aangrijpen om zijn standpunt in deze voor het voetlicht te brengen en hierover ook contact hebben met de KNVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over ‘de berichtgeving dat een derde in Gaza al dagen geen eten heeft’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a third of people in Gaza were going days without food, including how much food is needed, causes of distribution failures, GHF and Hamas roles, and Israeli shooting at aid points. The minister answered at length, acknowledging famine conditions and blockade effects, stating the government has no reliable evidence of systematic Hamas aid theft, and largely declining to quantify or verify several claims while promising continued diplomatic pressure.
The cabinet has no reliable evidence for the allegation that Hamas systematically or on a large scale diverts humanitarian aid since 7 October 2023.
Het kabinet heeft geen betrouwbaar bewijs voor de aantijging dat Hamas zich systematisch of grootschalig schuldig maakt aan ontvreemding van humanitaire hulp sinds 7 oktober 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gezamenlijke verklaring inzake de humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP asked why the government opposes Israel's new NGO registration requirement, why it does not act through the EU jointly, and what Dutch NGOs are affected and what safeguards Dutch aid funding requires. The minister answered that the law risks arbitrary refusals harming civil society and that the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and with EU partners, while also describing risk-management and screening requirements for funded NGOs.
For more information, the House was informed today (24 September 2025) by means of a confidential letter.
Voor meer informatie is uw Kamer vandaag (24 september 2025) middels een vertrouwelijke brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gezamenlijke verklaring inzake de humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP asked why the government opposes Israel's new NGO registration requirement, why Dutch involvement in Israel's internal security policy is justified, and why the Netherlands did not act through an EU-wide statement. The minister answered that the law risks arbitrary refusals harming humanitarian aid, that the Netherlands is pressing the issue bilaterally and multilaterally with other countries, and that Dutch NGOs' essential aid is at risk, with vetting procedures for partners described.
For more information, your House was informed today (24 September 2025) by way of a confidential letter.
Voor meer informatie is uw Kamer vandaag (24 september 2025) middels een vertrouwelijke brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over dat Israël humanitaire hulp Gaza verder gaat beperken met registratiesysteem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's new INGO registration system that could restrict humanitarian aid in Gaza, including grounds for refusal, collection of staff personal data, and what the Netherlands will do. The government answered that it shares serious concerns, has raised the issue bilaterally and with partners, considers the personal-data demands likely in breach of the GDPR, rejects a unilateral arms embargo, and outlines limited sanctions and medical evacuation measures.

The cabinet is not in favour of an arms embargo, partly because it wishes to continue allowing exports of components for purely defensive systems that do not affect Gaza or the West Bank, in line with the Kahraman motion, as long as such transactions pass the regular EU arms export criteria test.

Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een wapenembargo, mede omdat het kabinet de uitvoer van onderdelen voor systemen met een puur defensieve werking, die niet raakt aan de situatie in de Gazastrook of op de Westelijke Jordaanoever, conform de motie Kahraman (motie 21 501-02, nr. 3170 ) wil blijven toestaan zolang dergelijke transacties de reguliere toets aan de Europese wapenexportcriteria doorstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Nederlandse en Europese inzet m.b.t. de burgeroorlog en humanitaire catastrofe Soedan

Dobbe (SP) asks the Foreign Minister about Dutch and EU action on the war and humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan, including siege of El Fasher, Colombian mercenaries and UAE links, and possible sanctions or arms embargo. The minister answers that the Netherlands pushes diplomacy, humanitarian funding and EU measures, but cannot confirm reports about mercenaries or UAE involvement and sees no need for an arms embargo on the UAE.
An arms embargo on the UAE is not an option.
Een wapenembargo op de VAE is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Permanente Vertegenwoordiger bij de Europese Unie

An MP asked how often the Permanent Representative to the EU substituted for Dutch cabinet ministers in Council configurations over the past year, whether the PR negotiates on behalf of the Netherlands, and whether the Chamber can receive correspondence on the CSAM ('chat control') proposal before a committee debate. The minister answered that the PR substituted in 10 of 46 ministerial meetings, that the PR presents the cabinet's positions but cannot vote, and declined to share the confidential instructions and PR correspondence on the CSAM regulation, citing diplomatic relations and negotiating position, while stating no correspondence with the European Council or Council Secretariat is known.
The instructions are part of diplomatic correspondence. To protect the Dutch negotiating position and diplomatic relations, I cannot share these with the Chamber.
De instructies maken deel uit van het diplomatieke verkeer. Om de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en de diplomatieke betrekkingen te beschermen kan ik deze niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel ‘Economic sanctions now the EU is Israel’s largest investor

An MP asks the government about a SOMO article claiming the Netherlands is Israel's largest investor and about possible national economic sanctions, a review of the tax treaty and suspension of the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister says Dutch direct investment in Israel is largely foreign capital routed through the Netherlands, that the government favours EU-level action but is pursuing national measures such as discouraging activity in settlements, and that it is not yet suspending the tax treaty.
The government has limited influence on this.
Het kabinet heeft hierop beperkte invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Ceder over het bericht dat investeren in ontwikkelingssamenwerking gunstig is voor de Nederlandse economie

MPs Hirsch and Ceder asked the government about a study claiming Dutch aid boosts exports and jobs, whether cuts to development cooperation were properly assessed, and whether it will commission research on the broader costs and benefits. The Staatssecretaris called the econometric findings a reasonable but non-conclusive indication, said the cabinet sees no added value in a new study of the cuts, and gave no answer on commissioning research on wider effects beyond referring to an OECD report and a letter.
For the aforementioned reason, the cabinet sees no added value in a study of the broader societal costs and benefits of the recent cuts to development cooperation in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet ziet om voornoemde reden geen toegevoegde waarde van een onderzoek naar de brede maatschappelijke kosten en baten van de recente bezuinigingen op ontwikkelingssamenwerking in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een baggerproject in de Filipijnen

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked about the 1.5 billion euro export credit insurance for Boskalis's Manila Bay land reclamation, environmental impact reports, harm to fishers and coral, and compensation. The minister answered that the insurance was approved with conditions, that monitoring and an independent second opinion found the project adequate, and that compensation is primarily the project owner's responsibility, while refusing to comment on unrelated projects.
Export credit agency Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) only takes note of environmental impact reports for projects for which an insurance application has been submitted.
Ekv-uitvoerder Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) neemt alleen kennis van de milieueffectrapportages voor projecten waar een verzekeringsaanvraag voor is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het krantenartikel van de Volkskrant “Powerplay bewindspersonen BBB: landbouwpost in Rome blijft voorlopig leeg”

An MP asked why the Permanent Representative post in Rome (FAO, WFP, IFAD) has stayed unfilled since December 2024, whether agriculture ministers rejected selection-committee candidates, and what this means for Dutch influence. The government said the selection procedure is still ongoing after reopening to candidates outside the civil service, declined to comment on candidates or internal ministerial discussions, and acknowledged reduced visibility and influence while the post is vacant.
The discussions of the Council of Ministers and the appointments before it are not public, and what is discussed is confidential.
De besprekingen van de ministerraad en de benoemingen die voorliggen zijn niet openbaar en hetgeen besproken wordt, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over opnemen van Palestijnse patiënten uit Gaza

MPs Bamenga, Paternotte and Paulusma (D66) asked why the Netherlands has not admitted any Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment, while many Western European countries have, and whether this breaches international obligations, including the ICJ ruling and the WHO appeals. The government answers that it prioritises regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support for medical evacuations, cites funding amounts, and says it will continue pressing Israel to allow more evacuations, without committing to bring patients to the Netherlands.
The cabinet focuses on treating seriously ill patients in the region.
Het kabinet zet in op behandeling van ernstig zieke patiënten in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de inzet om patiënten die urgent medische behandeling nodig hebben, uit Gaza naar functionerende behandelcentra te brengen

An MP asks the government about the evacuation of seriously ill patients from Gaza for treatment, including whether the Netherlands will treat them domestically and whether Israeli approval for evacuations can be pursued. The government answers that it focuses on regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support, that no patients without residence rights have been evacuated to the Netherlands since October 2023, and that it will pursue wider evacuation options with Israel and regional partners without giving a precise count of Israeli-approved requests.
This figure is not known to the cabinet.
Dit cijfer is bij het kabinet niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over medische evacuaties uit Gaza

D66 MPs asked the government to release a study by two former ambassadors on medical evacuations from Gaza, to explain why the Netherlands does not take patients while many European states do, and to take in a contingent of patients. The government refused to share the study, said it prioritises support for care in the region over evacuation to the Netherlands, and listed financial contributions and a contact point for medical professionals.
The exploration discussed during the RDINEV is confidential and will not be shared with your House to protect the unity of Cabinet policy.
De verkenning die tijdens de RDINEV werd besproken is vertrouwelijk, en wordt niet met uw Kamer gedeeld ter bescherming van de eenheid van Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het artikel Schaduwvloot onder valse vlag

Two MPs asked the government about reports that tankers in Russia's shadow fleet sail under flags of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and what the Kingdom will do to stop sanctions evasion. The minister answered that the Kingdom is working on the issue through maritime administrations, the Coast Guard and IMO, that Kustwacht has contacted sanctioned vessels, and that legal and operational options are being explored.
Preparations are being made to enable inspections at anchorages of ships under the non-existent ship registers of countries in the Kingdom.
Voorbereidingen worden getroffen om inspecties op ankerplaatsen mogelijk te maken van schepen onder de niet-bestaande scheepsregisters van landen in het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de veiligheidssituatie van christenen in Syrië

The MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers about the safety of Christians in Syria, the return policy, and whether minority groups should get a risk profile. The government answered that it shares concern, that individual assessment remains the basis for asylum decisions, that no group-wide risk profile for Christians is justified by the current country report, and it described sanctions relief, support against IS, and an unchanged school curriculum for now.
However, an application by a Syrian Christian will always be assessed individually on the merits of the case, measured against the situation in the country of origin.
Een aanvraag van een Syrische christen zal echter altijd individueel beoordeeld worden aan de hand van de merites van de zaak, afgezet tegen de situatie in het herkomstgebied.
Antwoord op de leden Dassen en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Baudet ontkent contact met Rusland, maar FVD-Kamerlid Ralf Dekker videobelt met Poetins partij Verenigd Rusland’

Dassen (Volt) and Paternotte (D66) asked the government whether contacts between Forum voor Democratie MPs and sanctioned Russian politicians from Putin's party pose security risks, whether such contacts will be condemned, and whether financial ties and election interference can be ruled out. The government answered that MPs are free to maintain contacts, that Russian influence and the risk of covert interference are recognised, that AIVD awareness briefings and warnings exist, that absolute certainty about sanctions compliance cannot be given (investigation would follow signals), and that election-security measures and EU cooperation are in place.
MPs, like everyone else, are free to maintain contact with anyone.
Kamerleden, net als iedereen, vrij zijn om met eenieder contact te onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 30 doden bij Christenvervolging in Congo

MPs Stoffer and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about a July 2025 attack on a Catholic church in Congo's Ituri province that killed over 30 people, including the state's capacity to prevent such attacks, the appointment of an EU religious freedom envoy, aid programmes, and terror listing of the ADF. The minister condemned the violence, described limited state control and EU/Ugandan efforts, said the envoy selection is in its final phase, and declined to comment on ongoing sanctions processes while promising to inform parliament of progress.
The cabinet makes no statements about ongoing sanctions procedures because of their confidentiality.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over lopende sanctietrajecten i.v.m. de vertrouwelijkheid hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat aan ISIS-gelieerde terroristen christenen onthoofden en kerken platbranden in Afrika

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about reports of ISIS-linked attacks on Christians and church burnings in Mozambique and Congo, including whether this amounts to a 'silent genocide'. The minister confirmed awareness, said victims span religious and non-religious groups, declined to qualify the violence as genocide under the cabinet's restrictive policy, and listed monitoring, JISRA dialogue programmes and multilateral advocacy as responses.
The cabinet acknowledges and deplores the violence and remains committed to protecting religious freedom and upholding human rights.
Het kabinet erkent en betreurt het geweld en blijft zich sterk maken voor de bescherming van religieuze vrijheid en de naleving van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over doorvoer van wapenonderdelen naar Israël via de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about F-35 component shipments to Israel via the Rotterdam port, including whether exports had been stopped since the 2024 court ruling, the discrepancy between Maersk and Rotterdam's statements, and whether licences to Israel would be revoked. The government answered that exports were halted after the court ruling, that transit without transshipment is only notifiable, that three licences were revoked in July 2025 due to changed security risks, and that it sees no need for an EU or national arms embargo.
That is why the three licences were revoked at the end of July 2025.
Daarom zijn de drie vergunningen eind juli 2025 ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk berichten dat Laos militairen naar Rusland stuurt voor hulp bij mijnenruiming

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Laos is sending military engineers to Russia's Kursk region for demining, and whether EU or Dutch demining aid had trained them, and what sanctions or reviews would follow. The minister said the reports are unconfirmed, described past EU and Dutch demining aid as civilian and not used for military structures, and saw no reason yet for review, sanctions or further diplomatic steps.
The reporting that Laos is sending soldiers to Russia at Moscow's request to help with demining has so far been confirmed neither by Laos nor by other sources.
De berichtgeving dat Laos op verzoek van Moskou militairen naar Rusland stuurt voor hulp bij mijnenruiming is tot op heden noch door Laos, noch door andere bronnen bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over The Hague Group

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the newly formed The Hague Group of Global South states, Dutch engagement with it, US sanctions on UN rapporteur Albanese, and whether the Netherlands would arrest Netanyahu. The minister answered that the Netherlands was informed in January 2025, has not been formally invited to join, and will comply with ICC arrest obligations while regretting other European states' refusals.
The Netherlands is obliged, both under the Rome Statute and the Dutch ICC Implementation Act, to process a request for arrest and surrender.
Nederland is, zowel op basis van het Statuut van Rome als de Uitvoeringswet Internationaal Strafhof, verplicht om een verzoek tot aanhouding en overlevering in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het volgen van Duitsland in een wapenexportboycot naar Israël

MP Teunissen asked whether the Netherlands will follow Germany in halting arms and dual-use exports to Israel that could be used in Gaza, and about the status of a motion on exports of attack dogs. The minister says the Netherlands already refuses such licences, has withdrawn three navy spare-parts licences, and refers to an earlier letter on the dog motion.
For the answer to these questions I therefore refer you to the relevant letter.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u dan ook naar desbetreffende brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Piri over de dood van Al Jazeera-journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked the government about the killing of Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza, Israel's claim he was a Hamas member, and press freedom and journalist access to Gaza. The minister said Israel has not substantiated its allegations, that Nederland calls for evidence to be shared and for independent investigations, and listed diplomatic steps and support for press freedom.

For this reason the Netherlands wants Israel to share evidence with the international community in cases where attacks on journalists are justified by claims of membership of a terrorist organisation.

Nederland wil daarom dat Israël bewijs deelt met de internationale gemeenschap in het geval dat aanvallen op journalisten worden onderbouwd met claims van lidmaatschap van een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Dobbe, Teunissen en Piri over het bericht 'Nederland schrapt marineleveringen aan Israël, 'risico op ongewenst eindgebruik’

MPs Dassen, Piri, Dobbe and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about the withdrawal of three export licences for naval parts to Israel and related licensing and reporting questions. The government answered that the licences were revoked because the transactions no longer passed EU arms-export review given the risk of use in Gaza, while providing lists of remaining and refused licences and acknowledging some reporting delays.
The government will provide the relevant licences with a short explanation of the revocation.
Het kabinet zal de betreffende vergunningen voorzien van een korte toelichting op de intrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Negen Nederlandse universiteiten doen gezamenlijk onderzoek met defensie-industrie van Israël'

MP Dassen asked ministers about reports that Dutch universities collaborate on dual-use research with Israeli defence industry partners under Horizon Europe, and whether the government would act or stop such funding. The government answered that universities decide on partnerships within their autonomy, that it cannot fully assess the scope of dual-use research, and that it supports the Commission's proposal to suspend Israel's participation in the European Innovation Council.
The cabinet cannot, however, independently determine the scope of that.
Het kabinet kan de reikwijdte daarvan echter niet eigenstandig vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Oekraïne wapenexporteur wil worden.

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Ukraine wants to become a weapons exporter, the risks of human rights violations, possible Dutch investments in Ukrainian arms production, and whether the export criteria should now apply. The minister answered that export policy is a national competence, that the Dutch MoU covers only purchases for the Ukrainian armed forces with use and transfer restrictions, and that Dutch export criteria and weapons treaties still apply.
Arms export policy is a national competence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichtgeving - Sudan lijdt onder ongeziene hongersnood

MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of famine in Sudan, including steps to deliver food (such as airdrops), EU coordination, the scale of the crisis, conflict minerals, and French arms exports to Sudan. The minister answered that Dutch funding supports UN and NGO relief, that airdrops are not a real alternative to land transport, that the EU contact group is operational, and that the government checks arms licences for diversion risk while not commenting on the French inquiry.
The cabinet has confidence in the French arms export control policy. It is not for the cabinet to comment on the outcomes of the French investigation.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in het Franse wapenexportcontrolebeleid. Het is niet aan het kabinet om in te gaan op de uitkomsten van het Franse onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zakenmannen verkopen voor tientallen miljarden aan Israëlische wapenindustrie’

MP Van Baarle asked ministers about reports that Dutch businessmen supply electronic components via SASMOS to Israeli arms firms, raising prosecution, export control, and complicity questions. The government mostly declined to comment on individual companies, stated that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and reaffirmed Dutch export control and the 2025 measures on Israel.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether conduct that may be criminal and over which the Netherlands has jurisdiction is involved.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van gedragingen die mogelijk strafbaar handelen opleveren en waarover Nederland rechtsmacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over het bericht van SOMO over Israëlische wapenindustrie

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked whether the government will act on SOMO reporting that Dutch businessmen direct SASMOS, which exported arms components to Israel, and on Israel-related genocide and international-law obligations. The minister answered that the government does not comment on individual companies, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and described existing export restrictions and a broader policy of discouraging trade with settlements.
In principle, the cabinet does not make public statements about individual companies or persons.
Het kabinet doet in beginsel geen publieke uitspraken over individuele bedrijven of personen.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat Europese subsidies mogelijk hebben bijgedragen aan de sluiting van Vredestein in Enschede

An MP asks whether EU-approved Hungarian state aid to Apollo Tyres, which may have contributed to the closure of Vredestein in Enschede, is acceptable and what can be done about job losses and staff support. The minister replies that the Commission approved the aid under the rules then in force and found no direct causal link, acknowledges a possible indirect effect, and promises to monitor the application of anti-relocation rules and to explore European support for affected workers.
The cabinet critically monitors the application of these provisions and is attentive to the risk of relocation resulting from expanded possibilities for EU member states to grant state aid.

Het kabinet volgt de toepassing van deze bepalingen kritisch en heeft aandacht voor het risico op relocatie als gevolg van verruimde mogelijkheden voor de EU-lidstaten om staatssteun te kunnen verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de aanval op Druzen in Syrië

MPs Kahraman and Ceder asked the foreign and justice ministers about attacks on Druze in Syria, government responsibility, sanctions, minority protection, Dutch fighters and Syrian-Dutch citizens' safety. The minister answered that responsibility is unclear, pointed to the UN Commission of Inquiry report and EU sanctions options, and said the government will keep monitoring and refer individual cases to existing procedures.
We are following this closely and if follow-up is lacking I will not hesitate to increase pressure on the transitional government, for example through the sanctions instrument.
Wij volgen dit nauwlettend en bij gebrekkige opvolging zal ik niet schromen om de druk op de overgangsregering op te voeren, bijvoorbeeld via het sanctieinstrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Van Zanten over het artikel Visumvrij reizen 85 miljoen Turken stap dichterbij

BBB MPs asked whether the European Commission is seriously considering visa-free travel for all Turkish citizens despite Turkey's non-fulfilment of benchmarks, and what this means for migration control and sovereignty. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is not on the table because six of 72 criteria remain open, that the Schengen cascade model change only extends visa validity for frequent travellers, and that the government firmly maintains full fulfilment of the benchmarks.
See the answer to question 2. There is no question of visa-free travel.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2. Er is geen sprake van visumvrij reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Israël dat verdere stappen neemt in etnische zuivering

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn Israel's plans to confine and expel Gazans as ethnic cleansing, act on the ICJ genocide case, and support an international protection mechanism. The minister replied that such a plan would violate international humanitarian law, that the government uses pressure and dialogue with Israel, and that joining the ICJ case as a party is not possible, while giving no concrete new sanctions or commitments.
What urgent actions and sanctions will you take to pressure Israel to stop the expulsion, further ethnic cleansing and genocide, now that it is still possible?
Welke spoedacties en sancties gaat u ondernemen om Israël onder druk te zetten om de verdrijving, verdere etnische zuivering en genocide te stoppen, nu het nog kan?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Israël richt bloedbad aan bij medische kliniek: ‘Doden vrouwen en kinderen gewetenloos’’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to a reported Israeli strike near a Gaza clinic, whether it has sought clarification or pushed for an independent investigation, how it ensures Israel takes precautions, and whether it trusts the EU-Israel humanitarian access agreement and will expand Dutch aid. The minister condemned the strike, said no contact was held on this specific incident, pointed to Israel's own investigation and the Dutch request to share outcomes, and described monitoring of the EU-Israel agreement and additional Dutch humanitarian funding.
The Israeli army has indicated that it is investigating the incident.
Het Israëlische leger heeft aangegeven het incident te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Van der Burg en Diederik van Dijk over de uitvoering van de motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. ten aanzien van erkenning en schadevergoeding voor Indische slachtoffers van Nederlandse

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the promised local disclosure of the NIMH victims list and claims handling for Indonesian victims of Dutch abuses has not yet happened two years after the Sjoerdsma motion. The minister answers that privacy assessments under the GDPR are slow, that a foundation has been funded to promote the scheme locally, and that the list is expected to be shared this autumn.
It is expected that the data overview can be shared with the Indonesian foundation this autumn.
Naar verwachting kan het gegevensoverzicht dit najaar worden gedeeld met de Indonesische stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over dat visumvrij reizen voor Turken wordt versoepeld

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether visa rules for Turkish citizens were being loosened and whether this could bring millions of Turks to the Netherlands. Minister Brekelmans answered that the change only adjusts the Schengen cascade model for repeat, bona fide travellers, that visa conditions are unchanged, and that visa liberalisation for Turkey is not on the table because Turkey still has to meet six outstanding conditions.
It concerns an adjustment of the existing Schengen cascade model for Turkish travellers who have previously used their visa correctly.
Het gaat om een aanpassing van het bestaande Schengen cascademodel voor Turkse reizigers die eerder op de juiste manier gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun visum
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over een Israëlische raketinslag op de Holy Family Church in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli strike on the Holy Family Church in Gaza, the government's assessment, international humanitarian law, Christian minorities' access to aid, and press access to Gaza. The minister condemned the attack, said no information was received from Israeli authorities beyond a claimed technical error, and described existing diplomatic and multilateral efforts while giving no new concrete commitments.
The cabinet has not received any information from the Israeli authorities about this attack.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie van de Israëlische autoriteiten over deze aanval ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de aanhoudende aanvallen op het dorp Taybeh op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about repeated settler attacks on the Christian village of Taybeh in the West Bank, including damage to a church, injuries, threats to clergy, the role of the Israeli army, and prosecution of perpetrators. The minister condemned the attacks, said Israel as occupying power is responsible for protecting the population, reported contact with local churches, but gave no concrete information on prosecutions and no new measures beyond existing diplomatic and EU sanctions efforts.
The cabinet does not have information to confirm the statement of the Greek Orthodox Patriarch of Jerusalem.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie om de uitspraak van de Grieks-orthodoxe patriarch van Jeruzalem te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Der Werf en Bamenga over de mobilisatie in Venezuela en de veiligheidsontwikkelingen nabij Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about US naval deployment near Venezuela, its implications for the ABC islands (Cooperative Security Location, Kustwacht, NOTAMs, travel advice, involvement of Aruba and Curaçao) and whether Parliament would be informed. The government answered that the US deployment is nationally directed and the Kingdom is not involved, that existing defence and aviation arrangements remain unchanged, and that it will inform Parliament promptly if the security situation changes.
If the situation in the region leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, the government will inform your House without delay.
Indien de situatie in de regio leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal de regering uw Kamer daarover onverwijld informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het met 3D printers maken van wapenonderdelen voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Danish volunteers making weapon parts for Ukraine with 3D printers, whether Dutch civilians could contribute similarly, and whether a centralised 3D-printing programme should be set up. The government answered that producing weapon parts without recognition under the Weapons and Ammunition Act is a criminal offence, that only licensed manufacturers may produce such parts, that Defence sees no quick opportunity for a centralised programme, and that the Weapons Act is under revision.
Taking the initiative to print such a weapon or part without the required permit is therefore a criminal offence and is treated as such by the authorities.

Het initiatief nemen tot het afdrukken van een dergelijk wapen of onderdeel zonder de vereiste vergunning te hebben verkregen, leidt derhalve tot een strafbaar feit en wordt door de autoriteiten als zodanig aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Paulusma en Bamenga over een mogelijk naderend staakt-het-vuren in Gaza

MPs from D66 asked the government about a possible Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation model, medical evacuations and dual-use restrictions on prosthetics. The minister answered that Nederland demands unhindered humanitarian access through UN-led channels, rejects the GHF model, and will support medical capacity in the region and the WHO, but does not consider evacuation to the Netherlands desirable at present.
The cabinet cannot verify these figures.
Het kabinet kan deze cijfers niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Timmermans en het lid Piri over de aankondiging van Frankrijk om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen

MPs Timmermans and Piri asked whether the government welcomes France's announced recognition of a Palestinian state, whether the international community should pressure Israel, and whether Nederland should recognise Palestine. The minister said recognition must be part of a political process toward a two-state solution, that the occupation is unlawful per the ICJ, and that the Netherlands currently has no plans to recognise Palestine.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering recognising the Palestinian state.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet niet om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over coalition of the willing inzake alternatief plan humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about humanitarian access to Gaza, a coalition-of-the-willing distribution plan, airdrops, sea deliveries, Egypt's Rafah crossing, sanctions and the EU's role in ceasefire talks. The minister answered that the war must stop, that Israel must grant humanitarian access, that the Netherlands is joining airdrops and EU measures, and that Rafah remains closed despite pressure, while largely restating existing policy.
The war in Gaza must stop.
De oorlog in Gaza moet stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zélf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Israël’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government has been silent on sanctions against Israel after a leaked EU report documented serious international humanitarian law violations in Gaza, and why it took so long to act on the report. The minister replied that the EU report was reviewed, the Article 2 evaluation was completed and discussed in June 2025, and the government announced concrete measures including backing suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, banning two Israeli ministers, and tightening export and divestment policy.
The cabinet took the content of the reports into account in deciding to initiate an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement.
Het kabinet heeft de inhoud van de rapporten meegewogen bij het besluit om een evaluatie van Israëls naleving van artikel 2 van het Associatieakkoord te initiëren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dassen, Dobbe en Teunissen over het artikel 'Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zèlf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Is

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked EU report on alleged war crimes in Gaza and the lack of sanctions against Israel. The minister answered that the report does not itself draw the conclusions, but the government considers bombing civilian objects and starvation as methods of warfare violations of humanitarian law, has initiated an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement, and supports suspending the trade part of the agreement.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over ‘Israëlische minister Katz wil van Gazaanse stad Rafah een gesloten kamp maken’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported Israeli plan to confine Gaza's population in a closed camp in Rafah breaches international humanitarian law, and what the government would do about it including sanctions. The minister replied the plan was not shared with the Netherlands, called an army-sealed zone for civilians unacceptable and a likely violation of international law, said Israel was pressed bilaterally, and pointed to a broader package of EU and national measures.
However, the plan has not been shared with the Netherlands. The cabinet therefore has no knowledge of the content of the plan.
Het plan is echter niet gedeeld met Nederland. Het kabinet heeft daarom geen kennis van de inhoud van het plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de EU Israëls grootste investeerder is

MP Dobbe asks the Foreign Minister about reports that the EU is Israel's largest investor, whether EU and Dutch economic leverage and export trends undermine pressure on Israel over Gaza and the occupation, and whether the EU-Israel association agreement should be suspended, Dutch firms barred from economic activity in occupied territory, and a full arms embargo imposed. The minister confirms Eurostat figures showing EU investment of 72.1 billion euro, notes Dutch investment is largely routed through multinationals and shell entities, describes existing pressure and dialogue efforts, commits to suspending the trade part of the association agreement at EU level and to expanding the discouragement policy, but declines a full arms embargo, citing existing export controls.
At EU level the Netherlands is working towards suspending the trade part of the Association Agreement with Israel.
Op EU-niveau zet Nederland zich in voor opschorting van het handelsdeel van het Associatieakkoord met Israël
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘EU-ministers nemen geen maatregelen tegen Israël, houden opties op tafel’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands pushed for at the 15 July EU Foreign Affairs Council on Israel, whether it proposed sanctions, what concrete humanitarian aid commitments were agreed with Israel, and what action follows if Israel fails to comply. The minister answered that the Netherlands backed implementation of the EU-Israel humanitarian access deal, announced national measures (ambassador summoned, two ministers declared persona non grata, support for trade measures and a third sanctions package), and listed the agreed access commitments, though the answer on the source of the truck figures was vague and did not address military operations.
As announced in the letter to the House of 28 July, the cabinet has decided to proceed to concrete measures.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli jl. heeft het kabinet besloten over te gaan tot concrete maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de economische belangen met Israël en het uitblijven van actie tegen genocide tegen de Palestijnse bevolking

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch and EU economic ties with Israel, whether these sustain alleged genocide, and why the government does not use its influence or impose trade and arms restrictions. The minister rejected the claim that Netherlands is the largest investor, said the government supports suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement and discouragement of settlement activity, but declined to halt trade or impose a full arms embargo, citing existing EU frameworks and Israel's right to self-defence.
As explained in the letter to parliament of 28 July 2025, the cabinet is working at EU level for a suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement.
Antwoord 11 Zoals aangeven in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli 2025, spant het kabinet zich in EU-verband in voor een opschorting van het handelsdeel van de Associatieovereenkomst tussen de EU en Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het aangevraagde CAVV-advies inzake de verplichting van het voorkomen van genocide

An SP MP asked whether the government had received the CAVV advice on third states' duty to prevent genocide and, if so, whether it would send it to parliament within two weeks. The minister confirmed receipt on 4 August and said the advice is being studied, with a reply to follow as soon as reasonably possible.
The cabinet will send this CAVV advice to the House together with a cabinet response.
Het kabinet stuurt dit CAVV advies tezamen met een kabinetsreactie aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Frankrijk zal Palestina erkennen als staat.’

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would follow France in recognising a Palestinian state, and about Israeli annexation calls and the 2024 ICJ advisory opinion. The minister answered that recognition must be part of a political process toward a two-state solution, that it is a national competence, and that the occupation is unlawful and annexation calls are condemned, but gave no commitment to recognise Palestine now.
Erkenning vraagt om een zorgvuldige afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het afketsen van het staakt-het-vuren tussen Israël en Hamas

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister how the cabinet judges the collapse of Israel-Hamas ceasefire talks, who is responsible, the status of hostages and aid, and what role the Netherlands and EU can play. The minister answered that the cabinet urges a ceasefire, sees Hamas as bearing significant responsibility, pushes Israel to allow humanitarian access, and supports further EU sanctions while stating it cannot confirm some claims or details of the talks.
The cabinet cannot make exact statements about the positions of the parties during the negotiations.
Het kabinet kan geen exacte uitspraken doen over de opstelling van de partijen tijdens de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de gemaakte afspraken tussen EU en Israël t.a.v. humanitaire hulp in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about EU-Israel agreements on humanitarian aid to Gaza, including whether agreed aid routes and truck volumes were met and whether terms should be shared with parliament. The minister answered that Israel has not fulfilled the agreements, announced EU-level measures such as suspending the trade part of the Association Agreement, but declined to publish the detailed terms to protect diplomatic effectiveness.
The High Representative and EEAS, with a view to maximising the chance of swift and successful implementation of the EU-Israel agreements, did not make the specific details of the agreements public.

De Hoge Vertegenwoordiger en EDEO hebben, met oog op het zoveel mogelijk vergroten van de kans van slagen op spoedige en succesvolle implementatie van de afspraken tussen de EU en Israël, de specifieke details van de afspraken niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief van hulporganisaties en gebrekkige voedseldistributie in Gaza

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Foreign Minister why food aid in Gaza is not reaching people, how many trucks are cleared, whether the GHF distribution is adequate, and whether independent investigation into hunger deaths will be demanded. The minister acknowledges serious aid obstacles, attributes the distribution failure mainly to Israeli military action, blockade and bureaucratic procedures, but declines to take a position on several questions, citing UN responsibility and lack of information.
The cabinet is not aware of details of correspondence between GHF and the UN and cannot make statements about it.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met details over correspondentie tussen GHF en de VN en kan hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Gaza krijgt voedsel uit de lucht’

Van der Burg (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU should press Israel to admit far more aid into Gaza, and what Dutch and EU steps follow, including the Dutch role in airdrops of food. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government backs suspending trade parts of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, joins a multinational airdrop operation from 8 August, and keeps pressing for ground access, while stating that airdrops cannot replace land aid and that Nederland does not work with the GHF.
At EU level the Netherlands is working for suspension of the trade part of the Association Agreement with Israel.
Op EU-niveau zet Nederland zich in voor opschorting van het handelsdeel van het Associatieakkoord met Israël
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de kabinetsbrief afspraken met Israël over verantwoording over de situatie in Gaza

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Foreign Minister how and when the government will act on suspending the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, why it ties this to the humanitarian access deal, and about summoning the Israeli ambassador, sanctions on individuals, humanitarian funding, the ban on settlement trade and medical evacuations from Gaza. The minister answered that the Netherlands will keep lobbying in Brussels for suspension, that the humanitarian deal was a step in the right direction, that the ambassador was summoned on 29 July, and that settlement trade measures are better taken at EU level, while committing to explore medical evacuation support.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in the appropriate Brussels forums and in bilateral contacts with other EU member states.
Het kabinet zal zich hiervoor blijven inzetten in de daarvoor geëigende Brusselse gremia en in bilaterale contacten met andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over kabinet wil extra maatregelen tegen Israël en roept ambassadeur op matje

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch government plans for additional measures against Israel, the ambassador summons, humanitarian access in Gaza, Hamas's role, and EU-US coordination. The minister answered at length, reaffirming the goal of a ceasefire and hostage release, pointing to Hamas responsibility, outlining an EU review of Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, and declining to share the Commission's list of potential measures.
Sharing parts of it would undermine trust in the Netherlands and thereby Dutch diplomatic leverage.
Delen daarvan zou het vertrouwen in Nederland en daarmee de Nederlandse diplomatieke slagkracht ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte en Boswijk over een lijst met mogelijke sanctiemaatregelen tegen Israël

MPs Piri, Paternotte and Boswijk asked the government about a list of possible sanctions against Israel leaked to the press, including whether arms and national boycott options were considered, whether the list would be shared with parliament, and why the military export reporting was delayed and which dual-use licences remain valid. The minister confirmed the list was shared with participants, refused to disclose the internal note citing cabinet unity and diplomatic interests, said the export reports were delayed by workload and published up to May 2025, and argued that a boycott of settlement goods is more effective at EU level.
The cabinet will not share the note prepared for the ministerial consultation with the House and invokes the protection of the unity of cabinet policy and the protection of diplomatic interests.

Het kabinet zal de opgestelde notitie voor het bewindspersonen overleg niet met de Kamer delen en beroept zich daarbij op de bescherming van de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid en de bescherming van diplomatieke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over wapenexportvergunningen voor het Israëlische Iron Dome-systeem

An MP asked the ministers about the minister's remark on two export licences for parts of Israel's Iron Dome system and what exports were involved. The government answered that two licences (January 2024 and March 2025) covered radar components made in Canada, transited via the Netherlands to Germany, and were not exported directly to Israel.
These are goods that were not produced in the Netherlands but in Canada.
Het gaat hier om goederen die niet in Nederland, maar in Canada zijn geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Remco S. loopt nog altijd vrij rond in India na de moord op José

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that a suspect in the murder of a Dutch woman remains free in India, and about extradition, diplomatic contact, victim information and compensation. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that India has primary jurisdiction and extradition depends on facts and procedures, said Nederland's influence over foreign procedures is very limited, and noted victims of crimes abroad are not eligible for Schadefonds compensation, though the law may be revised.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts, I cannot provide information.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de permanente vertegenwoordiger bij de Europese Unie

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister about the role and tasks of the Permanent Representative to the EU, who may stand in for the Prime Minister at the European Council, and asked for correspondence between the Permanent Representative, the cabinet and the European Council for the past year. The minister explained the PV's coordinating role and that the PV cannot replace the Prime Minister, but declined to supply the correspondence on short notice, citing the time needed to review it for state-confidential content while promising to reassess targeted requests.

It is unfortunately not feasible to inventory, within a short timeframe, all documents that played a role in this and to check them for information whose disclosure must be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is helaas niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld op korte termijn te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Russisch oorlogsschip escorteert olietankers van schaduwvloot door Noordzee.’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Russian warship escorted two sanctioned shadow-fleet tankers through the North Sea, why one tanker is sanctioned only by the UK, and what legal and practical options Netherlands has to block such passages and enforce sanctions. The minister answered that Defence does not normally comment on specific incidents, that freedom of navigation applies in the EEZ, that enforcement is possible when sanctioned ships fall under Dutch jurisdiction such as entering a Dutch port, and that a technical briefing on the legal framework is planned for 11 September.
In principle, the cabinet does not make public statements about specific incidents, the related level of knowledge, the methods or the sources of the intelligence services and/or the armed forces.

In principe doet het kabinet over specifieke voorvallen en het daaraan gerelateerde kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de inlichtingendiensten en/of de Krijgsmacht in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over christenvervolging in Indonesië

An SGP MP asks the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians in Indonesia, permit requirements for worship, and what the government will do about administrative discrimination and social intolerance. The minister acknowledges the problems, says gatherings should be possible without permits, and points to dialogue programmes such as JISRA and embassy projects, without committing to a specific new step.
The Netherlands will continue to stress this principle in dialogue with the Indonesian authorities.
Nederland zal dit uitgangspunt blijven onderstrepen in de dialoog met de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Piri over kritische demonstranten die bij een bezoek aan de Chinese vicepremier buiten het zicht werden geposteerd

MPs Lahlah and Piri asked about protesters being kept out of sight during the visit of the Chinese vice-premier, camera use, transnational repression and a planned ban on face coverings at demonstrations. The minister replies that the Hague municipality found no restriction tied to content, that demonstrations were not limited by the Chinese delegation, that camera use is for public order under the Municipalities Act, and that a WODC study on the right to demonstrate is pending.
Restriction of the right to demonstrate, or consideration of it in the context of this visit, has not been an issue.
Beperking van het demonstratierecht of overweging daartoe in het kader van het onderhavige bezoek is niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de nieuwe EU strategie voor de Zwarte Zee regio

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about the new EU Black Sea strategy and whether Dutch ports, notably Rotterdam, should build ties with Black Sea ports including Odessa, including on security and a Denmark-style partnership. The minister affirms the strategy's importance, says port cooperation is mainly for port companies and EU channels, and states willingness to facilitate exploratory talks, noting an exploratory meeting already took place and that Dutch support for Ukraine uses bilateral and multilateral channels.
It is further up to the port companies themselves to give shape to port cooperation, such as in the context of port development or pursuing green shipping corridors between ports.
Het is verder aan havenbedrijven zelf om invulling te geven aan havensamenwerking zoals in het kader van havenontwikkeling of inzet op green shipping corridors tussen havens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitspraak van de rechter ten aanzien van het ambtsbericht inzake Syrië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a court interim ruling requiring publication of a Syria country-of-origin report, and whether the government would appeal and withdraw its policy of not publishing such reports. The minister said the ruling is being studied, the new Syria report was already published on request under the Woo, and any appeal falls to the Asylum and Migration Ministry.
The cabinet is studying the ruling and will take it into account in the new approach to non-public country reports.
Het kabinet is de uitspraak aan het bestuderen en zal deze betrekken bij de nieuwe werkwijze inzake niet-openbare ambtsberichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de bouw van 22 nieuwe Israëlische nederzettingen op illegaal bezet Palestijns land

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli approval of 22 new West Bank settlements, Israeli statements about preventing a Palestinian state, the ICJ advisory opinion, and possible sanctions, trade halts and recognition of Palestine. The minister condemned the approval and the statements, said the Dutch position on settlements is unchanged, described existing discouragement policy and EU-level efforts, and declined to commit to recognition or a full trade ban, citing EU competence.
The cabinet continues to exert pressure on Israel, both bilaterally and within the EU, to reverse this decision and the settlement policy more broadly.
Het kabinet blijft zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband druk uitoefenen op Israël om dit besluit, en het nederzettingenbeleid in den brede, terug te draaien en stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over reizen naar de VS als trans- of non-binair persoon

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the risks for Dutch trans and non-binary travellers to the US, the travel advice, and protocols for rebooking or consular help. The minister answers that the travel advice was updated on 25 March to warn of differing US rules (only M or V gender markers), that the ministry offers consular assistance, and that rebooking is handled by travel organisers and insurers.
The ministry plays no role in rebooking or cancelling trips.
Het ministerie speelt geen rol in het omboeken of annuleren van reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Krul en Boswijk over het bericht “Wake-up call: Microsoft sluit e-mail ICC zonder pardon af”

Three CDA MPs asked whether Microsoft cut off the ICC prosecutor's email on US orders, what the government is doing to restore access and protect the court, and whether dependence on US digital services undermines democratic institutions. The minister declined to confirm the reported cut-off, condemned the sanctions, said talks with the US and business are ongoing, and stated that digital dependence is a policy issue being addressed through a planned digital autonomy vision rather than an acute threat to democracy.
It is not for the cabinet to confirm or deny reporting on the implementation of sanctions imposed by other states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om berichtgeving over de implementatie van sancties die door andere staten zijn opgelegd te bevestigen of te ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het bericht dat het Internationaal Strafhof hard geraakt is door de sancties

MPs Dobbe, Piri and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister whether the government's claimed effectiveness in supporting the International Criminal Court holds, given US sanctions reportedly crippling its work, and what concrete steps it has taken including EU blocking statute activation and asylum for affected staff. The minister answered that the Court continues most of its work, that Nederland is lobbying the US and EU partners and banks, but declined to detail confidential mitigation measures and deferred the EU anti-boycott decision to the Commission and Council.
To be successful, this work must take place in a confidential context, and therefore it cannot be discussed in much detail.
Om succesvol te kunnen zijn, is het noodzakelijk dat dit werk in een vertrouwelijke context plaatsvindt en daarom kan hier niet teveel over in detail worden getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de nieuwsberichten rondom de paasviering in Jeruzalem

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about restrictions on Christian and Muslim access to holy sites in Jerusalem, including Easter and Ramadan permit limits, and whether Dutch policy would defend the status quo and freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concerns, reaffirmed the status quo and freedom of religion as Dutch priorities, and said Nederland raises these issues bilaterally, with Jordan and in multilateral fora, while supporting the EU statement.
The cabinet considers it essential that believers have free and unhindered access to the holy sites in Jerusalem and that the status quo of the holy sites is respected.
Het kabinet acht het essentieel dat gelovigen vrije en onbelemmerde toegang hebben tot de heilige plaatsen in Jeruzalem en dat de status quo van de heilige plaatsen wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat Netanyahu de bewapening van aan ISIS-gerelateerde groepen in Gaza heeft goedgekeurd

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns reports that Israel armed ISIS-affiliated militias in Gaza, and whether Netanyahu should be sanctioned if the reports are true. The minister said the government disapproves of arming such groups but cannot verify the ISIS link, so it sees no reason yet to pursue sanctions against Netanyahu.
The cabinet cannot independently establish whether the reporting on arming local groups rival to Hamas, whether or not affiliated with ISIS, is accurate, but acknowledges these reports are worrying.

Het kabinet kan niet eigenstandig vaststellen of de berichtgeving over de bewapening van met Hamas rivaliserende lokale groepen die al dan niet zijn geaffilieerd met ISIS klopt, maar erkent dat deze berichten zorgelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het oppakken en uitzetten van de deelnemers van de March to Gaza

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn Egypt's arrest and deportation of March to Gaza participants and what it was doing to press Egyptian authorities. The minister replied that expulsion is a sovereign right, that the Netherlands had urged proportionality, and that the travel advice already warned against demonstrating there.
The travel advice for Egypt explicitly warns of the risk of arrest for participating in demonstrations, even if they are peaceful.
In het reisadvies voor Egypte wordt expliciet gewaarschuwd voor het risico op arrestatie bij deelname aan demonstraties, ook als deze vreedzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over de uitzetting van Nederlandse deelnemers aan de Mars naar Gaza

MPs from SP, PvdD and Volt asked the Foreign Minister about the Egyptian expulsion of Dutch participants in the March to Gaza, including passport confiscation, legal grounds, Israeli involvement, detention of demonstrators and consular assistance. The minister said the expulsion is a sovereign Egyptian matter, consular help was given, privacy prevents confirming detentions, and the government urges Israel to allow humanitarian aid.
Because of the privacy of those involved, I cannot say whether Dutch demonstrators have been detained.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen kan ik niet mededelen of er Nederlandse demonstranten zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de betrokkenheid van CSO’s bij het Global Gateway-programma
