An MP asked the foreign minister about civil society participation in the EU Global Gateway programme, including membership, selection, consultation and oversight of the CSO/LA Platform, and the Global Gateway Forum. The minister answered that the government will push for a role for civil society once the new MFK proposals arrive, describes the platform's membership and selection criteria, and says concrete plans for expansion do not yet exist and that the forum's details are not yet known.
The cabinet is committed to properly involving civil society in the implementation of Global Gateway projects to which the Netherlands contributes.
Het kabinet zet in op het goed betrekken van het maatschappelijk middenveld bij de uitvoering van Global Gateway -projecten waar Nederland aan bijdraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht 'FNV-economen: Europese bedrijven in de knel? De winsten zijn nog nooit zo hoog geweest'

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a newspaper report claiming European regulation harms productivity, citing the Draghi report, EIB investment survey data, OECD PMR benchmarks and productivity gaps with the US. Minister Karremans answers that regulation is one factor among several, that EU-level regulation and market fragmentation are a real burden, and that the cabinet pursues a competitiveness agenda while defending the value of proportionate regulation.
I intend to take further steps in this area in the coming period.
Ik ben voornemens om hier de komende periode verdere stappen op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Burg over ‘anti-emancipatoire beïnvloeding’

MPs Becker and Van der Burg asked about foreign lobby and funding aimed at influencing Dutch public and political debate on anti-emancipatory themes, including US, Russian and Islamic-linked funding, and what the government will do. The government answered that lobbying is legitimate but that incitement and discrimination are not, pointed to the Nationale Extremismestrategie, said it has no legal basis to map funding flows from most countries, noted the pending Wtmo law as a possible tool, and said it is willing to raise the issue in the EU.
The ministries have no legal basis for processing personal data in addressing problematic conduct and unwanted foreign financing.
De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe en Dassen over het bericht ‘Trump wil duizenden illegalen naar Guantánamo Bay sturen, ook Nederlanders’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, SP and Volt asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government knew of US plans to detain illegal immigrants, including Dutch nationals, at Guantánamo Bay without due process, whether it had contacted the US, whether consular assistance was given, and whether EU partners would press the US. The minister replied that the report appeared premature, that the US had no apparent plans to detain Dutch citizens there, and deferred the remaining questions to the answer to question 1 while promising a reply within the deadline.
There are also no indications that the United States intends to deport Dutch nationals via Guantánamo Bay.
Er zijn ook geen indicaties dat de Verenigde Staten voornemens is Nederlandse staatsburgers uit te zetten via Guantánamo Bay.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over hulpverlening aan Nederlanders die vastzitten in Israël

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch nationals stranded in Israel after airspace closed, including how many there are, what help is provided, and when they can return. The minister answered that about 200 stranded persons registered, over 100 were repatriated by bus to Egypt and charter flight, and a second organised departure was planned.
A second departure organised by the ministry is therefore planned later this week so that the remaining repatriates who have registered can leave Israel.
Later deze week wordt daarom een tweede door het ministerie georganiseerde uitreis gepland waarmee de overige repatrianten die zich hebben aangemeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over evacuatie van Nederlanders uit Israël

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the US embassy in Jerusalem is preparing evacuation plans for its nationals leaving Israel and what the Netherlands is doing for Dutch nationals wishing to leave. The minister replied that Dutch travellers have received security updates, that over 100 were repatriated by bus via Egypte and charter flight, and that a second organised departure is planned later that week.
A second ministry-organised departure is therefore planned later this week so that the remaining repatriates who have registered, and who still wish to, can leave Israel.

Later deze week wordt daarom een tweede door het ministerie georganiseerde uitreis gepland waarmee de overige repatrianten die zich hebben aangemeld, en zulks eventueel nog wensen, uit Israël kunnen vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over genocide in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government recognises growing calls that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza, what obligations the Genocide Convention imposes on the Netherlands, and what concrete steps it has taken since October 2023. The minister answered that the government is reluctant to qualify situations as genocide, affirmed the duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and listed diplomatic and export measures, while referring to earlier letters for detail and giving no full overview of the measures asked for.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Paternotte, Dobbe, Teunissen en Van Baarle over het gehouden rondetafelgesprek over de situatie in Gaza en bijbehorende position papers

MPs from Volt, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether there is a serious risk of genocide in Gaza, when the Dutch state became aware of it, and what concrete steps the Netherlands has taken to prevent or end it under the Genocide Convention, including on arms exports, sanctions and an EU association agreement review. The minister answered that the Netherlands is cautious about qualifying situations as genocide, that the duty to prevent arises upon knowledge of a serious risk without a court ruling, and listed diplomatic steps taken such as the EU review of Israel's association agreement, sanctions on two ministers, and the arms export policy, while declining to join the South Africa case.
The Netherlands is generally cautious about qualifying situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend met het kwalificeren van situaties als genocide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Idsinga over het nieuwsbericht 'Brussels approves Poland's use of post-COVID funds for defence'

MPs Kahraman and Idsinga asked the Finance and Foreign Ministers about the Commission's approval of Poland reallocating nearly EUR 6 billion of recovery fund money to defence and whether the Netherlands would seek similar changes. The minister answered that the Dutch plan contains only already-budgeted defence spending, that no contact on reallocating funds to defence has taken place with the Commission, and that remaining payments face implementation risks.
So far, Poland is the only member state that has explicitly added a measure to its original plan allocating funds to defence-related purposes by amending its recovery plan.

Tot op heden is Polen de enige lidstaat die middels een aanpassing van het HVP expliciet een maatregel heeft toegevoegd aan het originele plan om middelen toe te wijzen aan defensie-gerelateerde doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dassen, Van der Burg, Paternotte en Piri over het bericht dat Nederland de Russische oorlogskas spekt en mogelijk spionnen binnenlaat

MPs asked the government whether it would press the EU for a full ban on Russian LNG and condensate imports, and act against vessels with Russian crews or ties that may carry Russian intelligence officers into Dutch ports. The minister answered that the EU lacks unanimity for an import ban, that the Commission's RePowerEU roadmap phases out Russian LNG by end-2027, that a national ban is opposed, and that Russian-flagged ships are already barred while sanctioned ships are refused and inspected, but declined to comment on intelligence use of crews.
The cabinet cannot make statements on whether Russia uses the crews of LNG and condensate tankers as cover for Russian intelligence officers.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of Rusland gebruik maakt van bemanning van LNG- en aardgascondensaattankers als dekmantel voor Russische inlichtingenofficieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'From pipe dream to NATO pitch: Meloni tries to rescue long-awaited bridge to Sicily'

MP Van Campen asked the minister about using EU defence-related funding for civil infrastructure such as the Sicily bridge, and whether criteria for 'defence-related' projects are sharp enough. The minister answered that CEF dual-use rules, military mobility requirements and Commission assessment guard against misuse, and that he will urge the Commission to prioritise military urgency in a future financial instrument.
I therefore call on the Commission to look closely at the criteria for projects eligible for financing from the EU budget.
Ik roep de Commissie daarom op goed te kijken naar criteria voor projecten die in aanmerking komen voor financiering vanuit de EU-begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over een Nederlands monument ter nagedachtenis aan de Holodomor

MPs asked whether the government would support a Dutch memorial to the Holodomor and attend the annual commemoration, citing Russian denial and the Kremlin's historical revisionism. The minister answered that Russian historical revisionism is opposed where it arises in international fora, that a memorial is not a core task of the ministry and would more likely be an initiative of the Ukrainian community via municipal decision, and that the ambassador in Kyiv represents the Netherlands at the commemoration.
Realising a memorial is not a core task of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het realiseren van een monument is geen kerntaak van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Timmermans over de erkenning van de Palestijnse Staat

Opposition MPs Timmermans and Piri asked the government about recognition of a Palestinian state, Israeli threats of annexation, and Israeli settlement expansion. The minister answered that no contact with Israel on recognition has occurred, that the government condemns settlements and supports EU measures, and that recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Erkenning is voor Nederland op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Campen en Boswijk over het gevaar van Russische inmenging bij de aanstaande verkiezingen in Moldavië

MPs Van der Burg, Van Campen and Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister about Russian interference risks ahead of Moldova's September 2025 elections, including support measures, EU/NATO security cooperation, observation missions and sanctions. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off and broader interference are being countered through cyber, anti-corruption and media resilience aid, bilateral security cooperation and EU sanctions, and committed to keep Parliament informed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Nederlandse militairen samen met Israëlische troepen deelgenomen hebben aan een door de VS geleide militaire oefening

An SP MP asked whether Dutch soldiers exercised alongside Israeli forces in the US-led African Lion 25 exercise, and whether defence cooperation with Israel should stop given alleged war crimes in Gaza. The minister replied that Dutch units trained in Senegal while Israeli units trained in Morocco without interaction, that defence cooperation is limited to materiel and knowledge exchange within pre-1967 borders with combat training excluded, and that the Israel status agreement is suspended in the Senate while arms export and import decisions are assessed case by case.
The cabinet has no insight into the precise manner in which the knowledge present within the Israeli defence industry is developed, as is the case for the defence industry in any country.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de precieze wijze waarop de aanwezige kennis binnen de Israëlische defensie-industrie tot stand komt, zoals dat geldt voor de defensie-industrie in ieder land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het burgerschip de Madleen dat met humanitaire hulp richting Gaza vaart

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the civilian ship Madleen carrying humanitarian aid toward Gaza, including threats of interception, the legality of aid blockades, and consular protection for a Dutch national aboard. The minister confirmed Israel was urged not to use force, consular assistance was given, Israel should allow sustained humanitarian access, and no further safe passage was currently possible.
The structural blocking of humanitarian aid to the suffering population of the Gaza Strip constitutes a violation of international humanitarian law.
Het structureel blokkeren van humanitaire hulp voor de noodlijdende bevolking van de Gazastrook vormt een schending van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de Freedom Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Freedom Flotilla's Gaza voyage, Israeli threats of military action, whether the government would condemn them and sanction Israel, and how it monitors the situation. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands had alerted Israel to a Dutch citizen aboard and urged no force, noted the ship was intercepted on 9 June with no current signs of violence, and said consular assistance was provided on request.
There are currently no indications of the use of force by Israel against the ship and its crew.
Er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen voor geweldgebruik van Israël tegen het schip en zijn bemanning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel `Organisatie meldt dat Israëlische marine zeilboot Greta Thunberg heeft geënterd’

Two Volt MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Israeli forces intercepted and boarded the Madleen, the sailboat carrying Greta Thunberg toward Gaza, asking whether this violates international law and what the government has done. The minister confirmed the interception, said consular assistance was given to the Dutch national aboard, declined to judge the incident definitively pending information from the flag state, the UK, and did not commit to summoning the Israeli ambassador.
Because of the privacy of the person concerned, the cabinet cannot currently go further into the substance of the matter.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkene kan het kabinet op dit moment niet verder ingaan op de inhoud van de zaak.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Israël burgers op het schip De Madleen associeert met terroristen en zegt alle nodige maatregelen te nemen tegen het schip en zijn passagiers

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's threat to intercept the Madleen aid ship bound for Gaza, the Dutch citizen aboard, and possible Dutch diplomatic and legal responses. Minister Veldkamp answered that consular assistance is being provided, the ship was intercepted and taken to Ashdod, and that the government urges land access for professional aid organisations, while declining detail on the individual case for privacy reasons and saying the interception needs investigation before judgement.
For reasons of the privacy of the person concerned, the cabinet cannot go further into the substance of the case at this time.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkene kan het kabinet dit moment niet verder ingaan op de inhoud van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht “AIVD beschuldigt Iran van liquidatiepogingen Haarlem en Madrid”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the AIVD's attribution of two attempted assassinations in the Netherlands and Spain to Iran, and about the reception of the Iranian foreign minister, protection of the diaspora, and the ambassador summons. The minister called the findings very worrying, said intelligence matters are not discussed publicly, referred protection to the NCTV-coordinated approach, and said the consequences were shared confidentially.
Your question concerns the knowledge level and functioning of the intelligence and security services. No public statements are made about that.
Uw vraag betreft het kennisniveau en het functioneren van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten. Daarover worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar de naleving van artikel 2

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why no deadline has been set for the EU review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, what consequences follow if a breach is found, and how credible Dutch positions are without a timeline. The minister replies that the review is for the High Representative and Commission, that the Netherlands will press for urgency ahead of the 23 June Foreign Affairs Council, and that follow-up measures would be proposed to member states if a breach is confirmed, without committing to a fixed deadline.
It is up to the High Representative and the European Commission to carry out the evaluation.
Het is aan de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger en de Europese Commissie om de evaluatie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Troops fire warning shots in air as foreign diplomats tour West Bank’s Jenin

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about reported Israeli warning shots fired near a diplomatic delegation touring Jenin, including whether Israel was notified and whether the Netherlands would sanction or summon the Israeli ambassador. The minister condemned the incident, said Israel was asked for clarification and promised written findings from its own inquiry, but did not summon the ambassador or announce sanctions and said the Netherlands is awaiting the investigation.
It is first and foremost up to Israel to investigate the incident and share the outcomes with the international community.
Het is allereerst aan Israël om onderzoek te doen naar het incident en de uitkomsten te delen van de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de nieuwe regels en controles op (wapen)export naar Israël

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the government only now amended general export licences for Israel, what changed in the security situation, which goods were exported under those licences, and whether individual licences remain. The minister answered that the ceasefire breakdown and Israeli operations in Gaza drove the changes, that Israel is now excluded so all transactions require prior individual review, and that seven individual military licences remain valid while the cassation appeal against the F-35 parts ruling continues.
With this change, all individual transactions of strategic goods to Israel are checked before export and transit.
Met deze wijziging worden alle individuele transacties van strategische goederen naar Israël voorafgaand aan uitvoer en doorvoer getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de uitvoering van de motie-Ceder (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2948) en het ´Pay-for-Slay-programma´ van de Palestijnse Autoriteit

Dutch MPs Ceder asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funding conditions tied to the Pay-for-Slay payments to Palestinian Authority families were implemented under the Ceder motion, and about Abbas's reported statements and the shift of the program to another entity. The minister answered that the Commission withheld part of a tranche for insufficient reform progress, that a new needs-based system replaced the prior law, that the EU was not formally notified, and that the Netherlands condemns the statements and keeps urging reforms.
The EU has not been formally notified of this.
De EU is hierover niet formeel op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Dobbe over de beschieting van diplomaten op de Westoever door het Israëlische leger

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Israeli forces fired on a diplomatic delegation in the West Bank, whether Dutch diplomats were present, and whether the government would condemn it, summon the Israeli ambassador, or revise cooperation. The minister confirmed shots near the delegation and a Dutch diplomat's presence, condemned the incident and asked Israel for clarification and its investigation outcome, but did not summon the ambassador and only said further steps are being considered.
The cabinet condemns the shooting incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over het UN Watch onderzoek naar omstreden VN-rapporteur Francesca Albanese

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about UN Watch allegations that UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese had improper sponsored travel and that complaints were buried. The minister replied that the UN coordination committee found no breach of the code of conduct, that the internal complaint procedure appears adequate, and that the government shares concern about some of her remarks while respecting UN procedures.
Complaints about the conduct of UN Special Rapporteurs are always handled confidentially.
Klachten over het handelen van VN Speciaal Rapporteurs worden altijd vertrouwelijk behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de nasleep van de moord op een Nederlandse vrouw in India

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs minister why a victim's family was never informed about the investigation into the 2012 murder of a Dutch woman in India, what the status of the case is, and what the government can do given the suspect remains free. The minister answered that consular help is given on request, that the ministry will not comment on individual cases for privacy reasons, that Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign legal process, and that without a request from a Dutch citizen it has no power to act toward a lawyer or local authorities.
On individual consular matters, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make statements out of consideration for the privacy of those involved.
Over individuele consulaire zaken doet het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken geen mededelingen omwille van de privacy van betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Stultiens en Heite over een vragenlijst van de Amerikaanse overheid

MPs Paternotte, Stultiens and Heite asked the Dutch government about a US federal questionnaire sent to Dutch researchers, probing cooperation with communist or totalitarian parties, gender ideology and benefits to American industry, and about possible US influence on academic freedom. The minister expressed concern, said Dutch institutions must protect academic freedom and that the government would raise the matter with the US and inform parliament before summer, but gave no detail on how many researchers were affected.
Before the summer I will inform your House by letter about academic freedom.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer informeren middels een brief over academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about attacks on aid workers in Sudan and Gaza, EU sanctions and trade talks with the UAE, accountability and the scope of Dutch jurisdiction under the International Crimes Act. The Minister condemns attacks on aid workers, says accountability is primarily a matter for the states concerned and international courts, and declines to commit to new sanctions, extra funding or state liability claims due to budget constraints and legal conditions.
Given the sensitive nature of such considerations and discussions at European level, I cannot make further statements on this.
Gezien de gevoelige aard van dergelijke overwegingen en besprekingen in Europees verband kan ik daar geen verdere uitlatingen over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de Verenigde Staten en The Metals Company om diepzeemijnbouw mogelijk te maken, buiten het internationale rechtskader van de Internationale Zeebodemautoriteit (ISA) om

An MP asked the government how it views the US executive order and TMC's plan to mine the deep seabed outside the ISA framework, and whether the Netherlands will join calls for a moratorium. The government says it finds these developments worrying, upholds UNCLOS and the ISA's exclusive competence, but declines to adopt the 'moratorium' label, saying its substantive position matches the countries that use it.
The cabinet finds these developments worrying and is following them closely.
Het kabinet vindt deze ontwikkelingen zorgelijk en volgt deze nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het stopzetten van grootschalige voedselhulp in Ethiopië

Two SGP MPs asked the government about the WFP halting food aid to 650,000 malnourished women and children in Ethiopia due to funding shortfalls, its consequences, risks to peace in Tigray, the funding gap, and Dutch and EU options to help. Minister Klever answered that 3.6 million people risk losing aid, that Dutch contributions (EUR 60 million to WFP, EUR 9 million to the Ethiopia humanitarian fund) cannot offset large US aid cuts, and that the government is raising the issue within the EU and other donor fora.
The Netherlands has managed to keep the humanitarian aid budget at its level, but it is impossible for the Netherlands to compensate for large global reductions in life-saving aid.
Nederland heeft het budget voor humanitaire hulp op peil weten te houden, maar het is voor Nederland onmogelijk om forse wereldwijde reducties in levensreddende hulp te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de mensenrechtensituatie in Libië

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about Libyan authorities ordering ten international humanitarian NGOs to stop work, the criminalisation of such organisations, Dutch and EU responses, Russia's role in smuggling, and the closure of the Tripoli embassy. The minister rejected the Libyan accusations, described diplomatic steps and continued support for NGOs, but did not reverse the embassy closure decision.
I reject this characterisation by the Libyan authorities.
Ik verwerp deze typering door de Libische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over het bericht 'Hungary ruling party drafts bill to crack down on foreign-funded organisations'

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs Klaver and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about a Hungarian bill targeting foreign-funded organisations, questioning its effects on civil society, press freedom, LGBTI groups and the rule of law. Minister Veldkamp answered that the cabinet rejects the bill as it stands, will raise concerns in Benelux and bilateral contacts, supports the EU Commission's infringement case, and reports that a majority for further Article 7 steps is not yet in sight.
The cabinet will raise the concerns about this bill within the Benelux during the General Affairs Council of 27 May, and also raises them in bilateral contacts.
Het kabinet zal de zorgen over dit wetsvoorstel in Benelux-verband uiten tijdens de Raad Algemene Zaken van 27 mei as., en brengt deze ook op in bilaterale contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de aflevering “Gaby overlijdt, maar familie kan niet rouwen door onze overheid”

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about delays in foreign death certificates for Dutch citizens dying abroad and municipalities refusing to register deaths without them. The government answered that municipalities may register deaths on lower-ranked source documents under the BRP Act, that case-by-case judgment is needed, and that guidance will be reiterated to municipalities, without new rules.
Following the broadcast and these parliamentary questions, the NVVB has already brought this to the attention of its members in its newsletter.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending en deze Kamervragen heeft de NVVB dit in haar nieuwsbrief al onder de aandacht gebracht van haar leden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Boswijk en Kahraman over het bericht 'Nigeria: christenen in deelstaat Plateau keer op keer slachtoffer militante Fulani’s.'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in Nigeria's Plateau state by Fulani militants, including the government's response, the role of religion, EU and UN action, and the ECOWAS ruling against Kano blasphemy provisions. The minister answered that the violence stems from local land and resource conflicts, that the government is cautious about framing it by religion, and that it raises the issue bilaterally, in EU and UN settings, and through existing programmes, while committing only to a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador and noting the EU Special Envoy appointment is ongoing.
The cabinet does not know who instigated the violence or what exactly motivated them.
Het is bij het kabinet onbekend wie de aanstichters waren van het geweld en wat hen exact motiveerde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Hoe christelijke donateurs in Nederland radicale Israëlische kolonisten steunen'

An MP asks the government about reports that Dutch Christian and Zionist foundations fund Israeli settlers building on the occupied West Bank, asking about legality, oversight, sanctions, tax status and prosecution. The government acknowledges the occupation is unlawful, says private relations are not prohibited but undesirable, states it does not monitor such financial flows, and declines to comment on individuals, prosecutions or tax status.

The cabinet does not conduct general supervision of financial flows abroad and therefore does not have information on where and for what purpose money from foundations such as Christenen voor Israël actually goes.

Het kabinet houdt geen algemeen toezicht op financieringsstromen richting het buitenland en beschikt daarom ook niet over informatie waar en met welke bedoeling geld van stichtingen zoals Christenen voor Israël exact naar toe gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Becker over het bericht ‘Hoe Nederlands geld naar radicale kolonisten gaat. De Palestijnen hebben geen macht’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch donations via the foundation Christenen voor Israël reach radical settlers in the West Bank, and what the government will do about it, including whether the foundation's ANBI tax status and the settlement discouragement policy apply. The minister answered that the government does not supervise financing flows abroad and cannot confirm the claims, that investigation of possible criminal offences is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the Tax Administration is bound by confidentiality on individual ANBI cases, while restating the policy that contributions to settlements are undesirable.
The cabinet does not have the necessary information to confirm this claim.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde informatie om deze bewering te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de strategische partnerschappen tussen de Europese Unie en Jordanië, Libië, Polen en Griekenland

An MP asked the government about the EU strategic partnerships with Jordan, Libya, Poland and Greece, covering the Commissioner's role, border management funding, Frontex and Europol roles, human rights conditionality, Libyan mass graves, Schengen evaluation of Poland and pushbacks. The government answered at length, largely describing EU instruments and Dutch positions, declining to publish the EUBAM Libya strategic review, and deferring some matters to Frontex, the Commission or later reports.
This review will not be made public.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht dat 15 hulpverleners zijn vermoord door het Israëlische leger

Parliamentarian Bamenga asked the government whether it considers the killing of 15 aid workers in Gaza by the Israeli army a war crime, what it is doing to investigate, whether it will impose consequences or restrict arms exports and military cooperation with Israël, and what it is doing to protect aid workers. Minister Veldkamp condemned the attack, reported the Israeli internal investigation and reprimand, said Nederland will call for an international investigation, and reviewed arms export licences and EU-Israel Association Agreement steps without ruling out further action.
In line with the Kahraman/Ceder motion, the Netherlands will call for an international investigation at the European level.
Nederland zal conform de motie Kahraman/Ceder ( 21 501-02, nr. 3107 ) in Europees verband oproepen tot een internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Christen (36) ter dood veroordeeld in Pakistan wegens godslastering: 'Koran geschonden''

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a Pakistani death sentence for blasphemy against a Christian man, and whether the government would seek his release, attend the appeal, and push for reform of blasphemy laws. The minister condemned blasphemy laws as a violation of religious freedom, said the Netherlands is coordinating with EU partners and will attend the appeal if possible, and listed existing advocacy, though he gave no concrete new commitment on reform.
The Netherlands is jointly examining with EU member state representations and the EU delegation in Islamabad what the most constructive and effective approach to this matter is.
Nederland gaat met de vertegenwoordigingen van de EU-lidstaten en met de EU-delegatie in Islamabad gezamenlijk na wat de meest constructieve en effectieve benadering is voor deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'EU to roll back Ukraine trade perks to protect its farmers'

An MP asked whether the minister knows of reports that the EU will roll back Ukraine trade concessions to protect its farmers, and whether the minister will press at the Foreign Affairs Council to avoid weakening trade liberalisation as the motion Paternotte/Kamminga requests. The minister confirms awareness, supports deeper reciprocal tariff liberalisation under the Association Agreement as more durable support, and calls for a smooth transition from the autonomous trade measures.
The cabinet supports Ukraine, including economically and in reconstruction.
Het kabinet steunt Oekraïne, ook op economisch gebied en in de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de hervatte Israëlische aanvallen op Gaza

MP Dobbe asked whether Israel unilaterally violated the Gaza ceasefire, what concrete pressure the government applied, why no sanctions or suspension of the EU Association Agreement or arms export restrictions were pursued, whether starvation and collective punishment amount to war crimes, and what the government thinks of Israeli protests. The minister answered that Nederland pressed for a return to the ceasefire through diplomatic channels, requested an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, withheld advisory documents on sanctions and export policy, and stated that Israel's humanitarian blockade conflicts with international humanitarian law.
Official advice on this concerns these elements and for that reason is not shared.
Adviezen hierover betreffen deze elementen en worden om die reden niet gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over de toenemende invloed van Iraans gesteunde milities en de positie van minderheden op de Vlakte van Nineve, Irak

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Iran-backed militias displacing Christian mayors on the Nineveh Plain in Iraq, sanctions on Rayan al-Kildani, and minority protection. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels when warranted, and declined to speculate on future sanctions targets.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate further on possible future sanctions targets.
Het kabinet wil verder niet speculeren over eventuele toekomstige doelwitten van sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen en Teunissen over het telefoongesprek met Marco Rubio

MPs Piri, Dassen and Teunissen asked Minister Veldkamp about US policy toward Ukraine and Russia under Trump, including paused military and intelligence aid, Crimea, NATO membership, sanctions, security guarantees, minerals deal, UN votes and war crimes documentation. The minister answered each question, confirming several reported developments while stating the Netherlands' own positions and noting that many matters are for the United States to decide.
Whether or not to recognise Crimea as Russian territory is up to the United States itself.
Het al dan niet erkennen van de Krim als Russisch grondgebied is aan de Verenigde Staten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat lichamen van hulpverleners van de Palestijnse Rode Halve Maan zijn teruggevonden in een massagraf in Gaza

MP Dobbe asked the government how it responds to reports that Palestinian Red Crescent aid workers were found in a mass grave in Gaza, and what it will do about accountability and sanctions against Israel. The minister condemned the attack, said the Israeli army's own inquiry led to a reprimand and removal from post, backed calls for an international investigation, and declined to commit to measures such as suspending the EU-Israel Association Agreement.
The cabinet closely follows developments in the region and continually considers how best to respond, bilaterally or in a wider setting.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in de regio nauwgezet en beziet steeds hoe op de meest effectieve wijze hierop te reageren, bilateraal of in breder verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de uitsluiting van het Afghaanse vrouwen voetbalelftal van de kwalificatie voor het WK door de Taliban

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would press FIFA to recognise and finance the Afghan women's football team excluded by the Taliban from World Cup qualifiers, and how it viewed the erosion of women's rights in Afghanistan. The government condemned the systematic repression of Afghan women, said it would not interfere in FIFA's decision-making, and noted that the timing of FIFA's plan for Afghan players was unknown.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the decision-making or policy of FIFA.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de besluitvorming of het beleid van de FIFA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport van Coptic Solidarity ‘Hidden Crimes, Public Deception’

An MP from the ChristianUnion asked the Foreign Minister how the government would respond to a Coptic Solidarity report on abductions, forced conversions and forced marriages of Coptic women and girls in Egypt, and what steps it would take with Egyptian authorities. The minister answered that the embassy is in contact with civil society, cites Egypt's National Human Rights Strategy and existing programmes against violence against women, and said he lacks data on Coptic deaths, while only in part committing to raise the issues in bilateral dialogue.
I do not have information on the number of Copts who have died in recent years as a result of specific attacks or revenge actions.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over aantallen Kopten die de afgelopen jaren zijn overleden als gevolg van specifieke aanslagen of wraakacties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds

MP Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister whether budget cuts to the Human Rights Fund (MRF) would weaken Dutch human rights work, its information position and donor coordination, and how the IOB evaluation would be followed up. The minister answered that the MRF remains the main instrument, that 2025 cuts were partly reduced by EUR 500,000, that country coverage and themes will be narrowed in the 2026 redesign, and that a full country list cannot be published for security reasons.
A complete country list with allocations per post cannot be made public, given the sensitivity of the subject and the safety of the colleagues and implementing partners involved.
Een volledige landenlijst met toekenningen per post kan, gelet op de gevoeligheid van het onderwerp en de veiligheid van betrokken collega's en implementatiepartners, niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de IOB-evaluatie van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about the IOB evaluation of Dutch human rights policy, covering export credit insurance, trade missions to high-risk countries, and human rights in bilateral consultations. The minister responded that human rights are considered within export credit risk assessments, that budget cuts limit embassy capacity, that transparency of human rights impact assessments remains primarily a matter for project owners, and that trade missions will continue to receive risk briefings without making disclosure of the MVO self-scan a condition for participation.
The cabinet will therefore not make public disclosure of the individual companies' MVO self-scan a condition for participation in trade missions to high-risk countries.
Het kabinet zal openbaarmaking van de «MVO-zelfscan» van individuele bedrijven dus niet als voorwaarde voor deelname aan handelsmissies naar hoog-risicolanden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel ‘Despair Haunts Ramadan for Palestinians Displaced in West Bank.’

An MP asked the government about displacement of Palestinians in the northern West Bank, Israeli military operations, the Palestinian Authority's role in Jenin, humanitarian aid and prospects for return. The government answered that it is concerned, calls on Israel to act within international law, notes the PA's primary security responsibility in Area A, and says Israel has stated displaced Palestinians may not return to certain camps for the coming year.
The cabinet calls on Israel to show restraint and to act within the framework of international law.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot terughoudendheid en om te handelen binnen de kaders van het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het uitbreiden van de militaire operatie in Gaza door Israël

MP Dobbe asked whether Israel's announced expansion of its military operation in Gaza is a red line for the Dutch cabinet, whether the cabinet condemns it, and what it will do. Foreign Minister Veldkamp answered that the Israeli ambassador was summoned, that the cabinet condemns statements by Israeli cabinet members on reoccupation, reaffirms that Gaza must not be reduced or reoccupied, and calls for a ceasefire, but did not specify any new concrete measure beyond diplomatic pressure.
The cabinet condemns statements by Israeli cabinet members that touch on the reoccupation of the Gaza Strip.
Het kabinet veroordeelt uitspraken van Israëlische kabinetsleden die raken aan de herbezetting van de Gazastrook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Paternotte over het overleg tussen de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken met de Indiase Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Van der Burg and Paternotte asked whether the Foreign Minister's social media post about the meeting with India's foreign minister omitted discussion of critical minerals cooperation, and how India could help limit Chinese influence on critical raw material supply chains. The minister answered that the post was only a fragment, that cooperation on economic security and diversifying dependencies was discussed, that details are confidential, and that the topic will continue to be raised with India.
The confidential nature of such conversations does not sit well with full public disclosure.
Het vertrouwelijke karakter van dergelijke gesprekken verdraagt zich niet goed met een volledige publieke weergave.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Bonaire bezorgd om militaire dreiging vanuit Venezuela’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Bonaire fears a military threat from Venezuela, including whether activity was observed, threat levels, contacts with Venezuela and Bonaire, and protective measures. The minister answered that no recent Venezuelan military activity near Bonaire has been observed, that there is no reason to assume a heightened threat, that routine intelligence monitoring and regional Defence presence continue, and that Parliament will be informed if the situation changes.
If the situation in Venezuela leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, I will, also on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, inform your House about it.
Indien de situatie in Venezuela leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Piri over het bericht ‘Netanyahu ondanks arrestatiebevel van strafhof naar Orban in Hongarije’

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary breached its Rome Statute duty by not arresting Netanyahu after hosting him despite an ICC warrant, and what consequences and actions the government would take. The minister replied that Hungary remains bound until any withdrawal takes effect, that the matter is for the ICC to decide under Article 87(7), that the government respects ICC independence and will not prejudge it, and that it has already raised the issue with Hungary and in the Foreign Affairs Council.

As the cabinet already reported in its letter of 9 October 2024, all States Parties to the Rome Statute are obliged under the Statute to consider requests for cooperation regarding the arrest and surrender of suspects to the International Criminal Court (ICC).

Zoals het kabinet reeds meldde in de Kamerbrief van 9 oktober 2024, zijn alle verdragspartijen bij het Statuut van Rome op basis van het Statuut verplicht om verzoeken tot samenwerking ten aanzien van de aanhouding en overlevering van verdachten aan het Internationaal Strafhof (ISH) in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Journalisten die verslag deden onder de ruim 1.100 gearresteerden in Turkije'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and attacks on journalists covering protests in Turkey, account blocking, and what the government is doing on press freedom, including Media Freedom Coalition action and emergency visas. The minister answered that press freedom is important, that Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (Council of Europe, bilateral talks, existing funding) are ongoing, that emergency visas are possible only case by case under the Visa Code, and that the requested separate answers before the 10 April debate could not be provided.
Unfortunately, that last part did not succeed.
Dat laatste is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Piri over het vervolg ten aanzien van de zaak van Tent of Nations

MPs Ceder and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations land case, delayed court rulings ordering removal of unlawful roads, and Palestinian protection in Area C. The minister confirmed the roads are unlawful, condemned COGAT's failure to enforce, said Netherlands raises the case regularly, and described the Oslo-based security division of powers while stating Israel's occupation-law duties remain.
COGAT has so far taken no action following these rulings, which I condemn.
COGAT heeft tot op heden geen actie ondernomen naar aanleiding van deze uitspraken, hetgeen ik afkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Terwijl Hongaarse parlement Pride verbiedt, radicaliseert Orbán: zijn critici betitelt hij als ‘bedwantsen’’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about Hungary's 2025 anti-LGBTIQ+ legislation banning Pride and restricting assembly, its compatibility with EU fundamental rights, the suspension of EU cohesion funds, and possible Article 7 steps. The minister replied that the Commission must first assess legal compatibility, that the Netherlands has voiced concern bilaterally and in Council of Europe and EU fora, and that the Article 7 majorities are not currently in sight.
The Netherlands calls on the Commission to do this expeditiously and to take action if it finds that EU law has been infringed.
Nederland roept de Commissie op om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over steun aan Oekraïne

Paternotte (D66) asked the defence and foreign affairs ministers about Dutch medical, training and drone support for Ukraine, including field hospitals, blood plasma, Sanquin knowledge-sharing and an aquadrone. The government answered that it has supplied medical equipment and 33 field hospitals, declined a hospital 'adoption' model and in-country training for now, and said it would not acquire the aquadrone.
We do not intend to organise the support in an 'adoption' form.
Wij zijn niet voornemens om de steun te organiseren in een «adoptie»-vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel 'Hongarije neemt wet aan die Pride-mars verbiedt'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government shares concern about Hungary's law banning Pride marches, its fines and facial recognition, what message the Netherlands conveys to Hungary, and whether the minister will join the Budapest Pride. The government calls the Hungarian laws very worrying, says the Commission must assess EU law compliance and urges action, reports a BeNeLux statement at the Council of Europe and conveyed concerns to the ambassador, and says the minister will not attend Pride though participation is still being considered.
The Netherlands will call on the Commission to do this expeditiously and take action if it finds that Union law has been breached.
Nederland zal de Commissie oproepen om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het rapport ‘Gaza and West Bank Interim Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment’

An MP from DENK asked the government about the World Bank/EU/UN damage and needs assessment for Gaza and the West Bank, covering casualties, reconstruction funding, humanitarian access, and Dutch aid. The minister answered that the government deplores the suffering, has pledged EUR 82 million in extra humanitarian aid plus EUR 20 million for reconstruction, condemns blockades of aid, and is in diplomatic talks with Israel and partners.
The cabinet has no overview of financial support by other countries for the reconstruction of the Gaza Strip.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van financiële steun door andere landen voor de wederopbouw van de Gazastrook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Duitsland scherpt reisadvies voor VS aan’

An MP from Volt asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that EU citizens are being denied entry to or detained in the United States, including a French scholar refused for criticising Trump, and whether the Netherlands will coordinate with Germany and France, condemn the cases, or tighten its travel advice. The minister said the details are unknown and declined to judge the cases, noted the Netherlands has no signals of Dutch travellers at risk, and pointed to the travel advice already adjusted on 25 March, committing only to update it if the situation changes.
I do not know the details of this case and therefore cannot make any statements about it or draw conclusions.
Ik ken de details van deze zaak niet en kan er daarom geen uitspraken over doen of conclusies uit trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Duitsland scherpt reisadvies voor VS aan, Franse wetenschapper met kritiek op Trump geweigerd’

MP Dassen (Volt) asked the Foreign Minister to answer earlier written questions on a report that Germany tightened its US travel advice and a French scientist critical of Trump was refused entry, urgently before the end of the week. The minister replied that the questions will be answered as soon as possible and in any case within the usual three-week period.
The questions will be answered as soon as possible and in any case within the usual response period of three weeks.
De vragen worden zo spoedig mogelijk en in ieder geval binnen de gebruikelijke beantwoordingstermijn van drie weken beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het Duitse reisadvies voor de Verenigde Staten

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether the government is aware of Germany's tightened US travel advice warning of arrest and deportation, whether any Dutch nationals have been detained or deported, and whether the Netherlands will also tighten its advice. The minister answered that no cases of Dutch nationals in trouble are known to the ministry, that consular assistance would be given if needed, and that the Dutch advice was adjusted on 25 March to cover stricter entry controls, without raising concerns with US authorities.
Due to the privacy of those involved, I cannot make any further statement about this.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen kan ik hier verder geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de actuele situatie in Georgië

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the protests in Georgia, political prisoners, EU sanctions, aid to civil society, and a Dutch shell company linked to pro-government broadcaster Imedi TV. The minister said about 40 protesters are jailed, that the Netherlands keeps pushing for EU individual sanctions though some member states oppose them, that no extra MATRA funds are available for 2025 due to budget cuts, and that FIOD investigation is possible only if signals of illegality exist.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that Dutch constructions finance foreign news channels that spread disinformation.
Het kabinet acht het onwenselijk dat Nederlandse constructies buitenlandse nieuwskanalen, die desinformatie verspreiden, financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over de arrestatie van burgemeester van Istanbul Imamoglu

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu, a rival of President Erdogan, and the related diploma revocation and protest restrictions are unlawful, politically motivated and restrictions on free speech, and what the Netherlands will do bilaterally and in the EU. The minister expresses serious concern, conveys it to Turkish officials, notes the EU postponed thematic consultations, and points to MATRA rule-of-law support, without committing to specific new measures.
I have serious concerns about the arrest of mayor İmamoğlu and others, including mayors of Istanbul district municipalities and journalists.
Ik heb grote zorgen over de arrestatie van burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen, waaronder burgemeesters uit deelgemeenten van Istanbul en journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen, Boswijk, Paternotte, Teunissen en Ceder over de aanhouding van de burgemeester van Istanbul

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the detention of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu and about a hundred others appears politically motivated, whether it should have consequences, and whether the Netherlands will raise it with Turkey and push for EU measures. The minister supports the EU statement calling for transparency and rule of law, says he raised concerns by phone with his Turkish counterpart and via the ambassador, and notes the EU has postponed thematic consultations with Turkey while it considers whether further measures are appropriate.
It is crucial that the legal process against mayor İmamoğlu and others takes place with transparency.
Het is cruciaal dat het juridische proces tegen burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen in transparantie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de mogelijke herbenoeming van de VN Speciaal Gezant mevrouw Albanese

Two MPs from SGP and PVV-aligned Stoffer ask the foreign minister about the possible reappointment of UN Special Rapporteur Albanese, her social media statements, and Dutch involvement in appointments. The minister answers that such rapporteurs act in personal capacity, that Dutch objections were raised with her, that the cabinet does not support her reappointment, and that the decision rests with the UN Human Rights Council.
The cabinet does not support her possible reappointment.
Het kabinet steunt haar eventuele herbenoeming niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Wal, Van der Werf, Nordkamp, Dassen en Olger Van Dijk over de (dreigende) afhankelijkheid van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht van Starlink

MPs asked whether the Dutch armed forces risk dependence on Starlink, whether alternative European satellite systems exist for command, communication, positioning and ISR, and whether the Netherlands will invest in autonomous capacity. The minister replied that Defence is not dependent on Starlink, that it spreads suppliers and is building sovereign ISR and PNT capacity over time, but withheld details of specific systems and command systems on operational and national security grounds.
No statements are made about specific alternatives for Defence in connection with operational interests and national security.
Over specifieke alternatieven voor Defensie worden geen uitspraken gedaan in verband met operationele belangen en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over mogelijke beïnvloeding van Nederlandse media, NGO’s en onderzoeksinstituten

An MP from FVD asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister and the Foreign Affairs Minister about possible USAID and EU (EIB) financing of Dutch media, NGOs and research institutions, and the risk of foreign influence on opinion-making and elections. The government answered that it has no insight into USAID funding or its conditions, that media independence is governed by self-regulation and press freedom, and that it sees no reason for a study of foreign financing, while noting a broader concern about state interference in knowledge institutions.
There is currently no insight from the government into funding from USAID to Dutch, or Netherlands-oriented, media companies or NGOs.
Er is momenteel vanuit de overheid geen zicht op financiering vanuit USAID aan Nederlandse, c.q. op Nederland gerichte mediabedrijven of NGO’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de noodzaak voor het opstellen van een Amerikastrategie

An MP from the CDA asks whether the government will draft a United States strategy like its China and Russia strategies, given strained relations with Washington over Ukraine and NATO. The minister replies that the US is a key ally, stresses continued constructive engagement and European burden-sharing, but declines to write a separate US strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over de situatie in de Democratische Republiek Congo en de rol van de Europese Unie

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, the effects of the US freeze of USAID, the EU-Rwanda raw materials memorandum, sanctions and MONUSCO. The ministers answered that the Netherlands funds humanitarian aid, calls for a ceasefire and Rwandan withdrawal, supports EU discussions on suspending the MoU and sanctions, and will send a separate letter on the humanitarian situation and MONUSCO.
The Netherlands raises Rwanda's support for M23 and its violation of DRC sovereignty bilaterally, through the EU and through the International Contact Group for the Great Lakes.
Nederland spreekt Rwanda bilateraal, via de EU, en via de International Contact Group for the Great Lakes (ICG) aan op zijn steun voor M23 en zijn schending van de soevereiniteit van de DRC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over de geheime deportatie van 48 Oeigoeren naar China door de regering van Thailand

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported secret deportation of Uyghurs from Thailand to China and what the Dutch government had done to prevent it. The minister confirmed the deportation, said Thailand breached non-refoulement, described diplomatic outreach to Thai and Chinese authorities and EU and UN statements, and said the Dutch embassy in Beijing would monitor the situation.

From the Dutch embassy in Bangkok, the Dutch Permanent Representation to the UN in Geneva and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in The Hague, active outreach was made to the Thai authorities up to the day of deportation.

Vanuit de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok, de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging bij de VN in Genève en vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in Den Haag is actief outreach gedaan naar de Thaise autoriteiten tot op de dag van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een nieuw uitgesproken fatwa

MP Wilders asked the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government would act against a new fatwa by a convicted Pakistani cleric calling for his killing and whether it would press Pakistan to cooperate with enforcement of a prior Dutch sentence. The government condemned the fatwa, said it had conveyed its view to Pakistani authorities, and stated that Dutch authorities depend on other states' cooperation for cases abroad, while not announcing new concrete action.

As reported in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions from MP Wilders, the cabinet is making maximum efforts to get the Pakistani authorities to cooperate with the requests concerning the persons convicted in the Netherlands.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen van het lid Wilders, spant het kabinet zich maximaal in om de Pakistaanse autoriteiten te laten meewerken aan de verzoeken met betrekking tot de in Nederland veroordeelde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Dobbe en Boswijk over het bericht 'Goudkoorts blokkeert de weg naar vrede in Sudan'

MPs Ceder, Dobbe and Boswijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about gold trade fuelling the Sudan conflict, arms diversion, Russian involvement, EU sanctions and humanitarian response. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, points to existing EU conflict-minerals and forced-labour rules, the CSDDD and arms embargoes, and says it is pushing for EU engagement, a contact group and humanitarian exemptions, without committing to new concrete measures on gold imports.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to act in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht dat Nederlandse bedrijven ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over verdachte Russische schepen in onze wateren

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers about suspicious Russian ships in Dutch waters, the shadow fleet, espionage around North Sea infrastructure and European sales of tankers to Russia. The government describes sanctions listings, IMO and port-state measures, NATO and regional cooperation, and promises a confidential briefing on the legal analysis of additional powers while declining to detail planned measures.

As promised in the NATO Defence Ministerial committee debate of 5 February 2025, you will be informed through a confidential technical briefing about the outcomes of the legal analysis into additional options to intervene in maritime espionage and sabotage activities.

Zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat NAVO Defensie Ministeriële op 5 februari 2025, zal u middels een vertrouwelijke technische briefing worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van de juridische analyse
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Boswijk over het artikel 'Rebels Backed by Rwanda Announce Capture of Key City in Eastern Congo'

MPs Bamenga and Boswijk asked about the M23 advance in eastern DRC, the humanitarian situation, Dutch and EU responses, and the EU-Rwanda critical minerals memorandum. The government answers that Dutch humanitarian funding continues, that Rwanda is being pressed bilaterally and in the EU to halt support for M23, and that the minerals MoU is under discussion for possible suspension.
Due to the confidentiality of this process, the cabinet cannot make further statements on this.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit proces kan het kabinet hier verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichten ‘Oppermachtig Rwanda is in Congo vooral op zoek naar kostbare grondstoffen’ en 'EU speelt gevaarlijk dubbelspel met Rwanda in Congo'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports on Rwanda's role in eastern Congo, including the Rwandan army's control over M23, humanitarian aid for displaced people, sanctions, the ambassador's summoning, and the EU-Rwanda raw materials MoU. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the UN view of Rwandan support to M23, has pressed Rwanda bilaterally and in the EU, backs sanctions and a suspension of the MoU, and funds humanitarian aid and responsible mineral supply chains.
The Netherlands shares the UN's view on Rwandan support to M23, as also shown in reports of the UN Group of Experts.
Nederland deelt de visie van de VN over de Rwandese steun aan M23, zoals ook aangetoond in rapporten van de VN Group of Experts .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitlevering van drie veroordeelde Pakistanen

An MP asked whether three Pakistani nationals convicted in the Netherlands for serious offences against him had been extradited, what concrete steps had been taken with Pakistan, and insisted on nothing less than extradition. The government answered that Pakistan has been formally asked to extradite, that the matter is raised repeatedly at all levels, but it declined to give details of diplomatic contacts and said the response is up to Pakistan.
As to which specific efforts have been made, given the confidential nature of diplomatic communications with foreign authorities, we will make no further statements.
Over welke inspanningen precies zijn gepleegd, doen wij gezien de vertrouwelijke aard van het diplomatieke verkeer met buitenlandse autoriteiten, geen verdere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over bezoeken van De Eritrese ambassadeur voor de Europese Unie en de Benelux-landen aan Nederlandse steden

SP MPs asked whether local authorities were consulted about visits by Eritrea's ambassador to Amersfoort and Amsterdam, whether the visits constitute foreign interference, and whether the ambassador will be addressed. The government said municipalities were not informed in advance, that unlawful conduct would prompt firm action, and that Eritrean diplomats were previously expelled for coerced diaspora tax collection.
Municipalities Amersfoort and Amsterdam indicated that they were not informed in advance of the meetings and therefore they were not discussed within the local security triangle.

Gemeente Amersfoort en gemeente Amsterdam hebben aangegeven dat zij niet op voorhand op de hoogte waren van de bijeenkomsten en dat hier dus ook niet binnen de lokale veiligheidsdriehoek over is gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Israëlische gijzelaars in VN-gebouwen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether hostages released from Gaza were held in UN shelters, including UNRWA facilities, and what oversight and information-sharing exists. The government answered that it cannot confirm control of the buildings, that it contacted Israel and UNRWA, that UNRWA cannot verify the claims, and that it supports a full investigation while stating that UN organisations have no intelligence or policing capacity to monitor sites.
The cabinet fully supports the call to leave no stone unturned.
Het kabinet steunt de oproep volmondig om de onderste steen boven te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over een mogelijke wapenleverantie aan Israël door een schip onder Nederlandse vlag

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch-flagged vessel Nordic carried military goods from India to Israel, and what policy applies to Dutch-flagged ships transporting arms to Israel. The government confirmed the ship flies the Dutch flag, said it has no specific policy on arms transport by Dutch-flagged ships beyond sanctions, and reported very limited transit of military goods to Israel via Rotterdam, with the last transit notification in 2023.

The Netherlands has no specific policy on the transport of weapons by Dutch transport companies and/or ships sailing under the Dutch flag to or abroad, including to Israel, except where it falls under a sanctions measure.

Nederland voert geen specifiek beleid ten aanzien van het vervoer van wapens door Nederlandse transportbedrijven en/of schepen varend onder Nederlandse vlag naar of in het buitenland, dus ook niet naar Israël, behalve indien dat valt onder een sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over deelname aan de derde vergadering van staten die partij zijn bij het Verdrag inzake het verbod op kernwapens

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands is not sending an observer delegation to the TPNW meeting and whether NATO nuclear sharing and Volkel bases explain non-accession. The minister confirmed non-attendance, said nuclear sharing within NATO remains the reason for not joining, declined to disclose US weapon numbers or locations, and reaffirmed commitment to NPT-based disarmament.
For security reasons and under alliance agreements, no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen en op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over de Nederlandse aanwezigheid bij de vergadering van het Verdrag inzake het verbod op kernwapens

MPs Piri and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands, a non-signatory to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, would attend the TPNW states-parties meeting as an observer, as requested by a parliamentary motion. The Minister answered that the Netherlands has no added value from attending, given its strong diplomatic position and existing NPT exchanges, and does not intend to attend.
No. As explained in the cabinet's response to the Van Dijk/Sjoerdsma motion, the cabinet does not consider renewed participation in a TPNW states-parties meeting meaningful.

Nee. Zoals toegelicht in de reactie van het kabinet op de motie Van Dijk/ Sjoerdsma (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2497 ), acht het kabinet hernieuwde deelname aan een vergadering van statenpartijen van het TPNW niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitspraken van Donald Trump met betrekking tot het etnisch zuiveren van Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Trump's call to permanently remove Palestinians from Gaza amounts to ethnic cleansing and whether the government will condemn it, and how it squares with the constitutional duty to advance international law. The minister answered that Gaza belongs to the Palestinians, that forced displacement is excluded under the G7 principles and international law, maintained the two-state position without recognising Palestine now, and committed to keep parliament informed on humanitarian access and reconstruction.
Are you willing, if there are signals that this is hindered in any way, to inform the House of Representatives immediately?
Bent u bereid om, bij signalen dat dit op welke manier dan ook wordt gehinderd, direct de Tweede Kamer daarover te informeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Van Zanten over het bericht 'Vernietiging Armeens erfgoed in Nagorno-Karabach: 'Doelbewust uitwissen geschiedenis''

Two BBB MPs asked whether the government would summon the Azerbaijani ambassador, urge Azerbaijan to stop destroying Armenian heritage in Nagorno-Karabakh, prosecute perpetrators, protect remaining Armenians and compensate displaced people, and add the conflict to Dutch education. The government answered that it is concerned, urged compliance with Hague conventions and peace talks, but did not commit to summoning the ambassador and deferred prosecution and compensation to the two states.
It is up to Armenia and Azerbaijan to ensure investigation and prosecution of crimes within this framework.
Het is aan Armenië en Azerbeidzjan om binnen dit kader zorg te dragen voor opsporing en vervolging van misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat westerse scheepseigenaren miljarden verdienden met de verkoop van olietankers aan de Russische schaduwvloot
