MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister how Western shipowners could profit billions from selling old tankers to Russia's shadow fleet, how many such ships are sanctioned, and whether sellers face liability. The minister called the sales worrying, said only 19 of the 230 ships are sanctioned, noted that proving sanctions evasion in advance is difficult, and referred enforcement to prosecutors while promising to press for further EU measures.
It is up to the relevant enforcement bodies to determine whether companies have carried out sufficient due diligence.
Het is aan de relevante handhavingsentiteiten om vast te stellen of bedrijven voldoende due-dilligence hebben uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op het lid Ceder over de acute medische situatie van Palestijnen in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the medical crisis in Gaza, including the raid on Kamal Adwan hospital, aid access, starvation, and cold-related deaths. The minister answered at length, acknowledging severe impediments to aid and the collapse of the medical system, but said the government could not verify several claims and pointed to diplomatic pressure on Israel and the January 2025 ceasefire.
The cabinet cannot verify how much aid can be provided at which hospital at which time.
Het kabinet kan niet verifiëren hoeveel hulp op welk moment in welk ziekenhuis kan worden geboden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de beschieting van het Wereldvoedselprogramma door Israëlische troepen

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the government about the Israeli shooting at a clearly marked WFP convoy in January 2025, whether such attacks breach international humanitarian law, and whether the Netherlands signalled concern to Israel. The minister answered that attacks on humanitarian workers violate IHL, that a court and Israel itself must establish the facts before a breach can be judged, and that the Netherlands raised concerns with Israel and urged compliance.
The cabinet does not have all the relevant facts.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle relevante feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kahraman en Boswijk  over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2025 van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, Nieuw Sociaal Contract and CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2025 persecution ranking, covering Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, Pakistan, Syria, Algeria and related issues. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and commits to continued engagement, but declined to support an international UN inquiry into violence in Nigeria as unlikely to win broad support.
The cabinet currently considers it unlikely that there will be broad support for establishing a UN-mandated international commission of inquiry into religious violence in Nigeria.
Het kabinet acht het op dit moment onwaarschijnlijk dat er brede steun zal zijn voor het oprichten van een VN-gemandateerde internationale onderzoekscommissie voor religieus geweld in Nigeria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Piri over de erkenning van het recht op een gezonde leefomgeving in het Europese Verdrag van de Rechten van de Mens

MPs Gabriëls and Piri asked whether the Netherlands will support recognising a right to a healthy environment in the European Convention on Human Rights, given other EU states' constitutional recognition and UN resolutions. The minister replied that Dutch law already protects the environment through the Constitution, Omgevingswet and related statutes, that the Netherlands is still studying the Council of Europe's CDDH report, and that a national position will be sent to Parliament later.
Your House will be informed about this position in due course by letter to Parliament, in accordance with motion 32 735 no. 373.
Uw Kamer wordt t.z.t. over deze inzet geïnformeerd per Kamerbrief conform motie 32 735 nr. 373.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Meulenkamp over het bericht ‘Ondanks weren vissersschepen: ‘Nederlandse vishandel spekt Russische oorlogskas’

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch fish trade, including transit of Russian whitefish, funds Russia's war economy and why Russian fish is not under EU sanctions. The government answered that Russian fish is a small share of Russian exports, that EU sanctions exclude food for food-security reasons, that the government supports exploring an EU import ban on Russian whitefish, and that consumers cannot reliably tell whether fish is Russian-caught.
The central government does not have hard figures on the value or earnings for Russia of Russian-origin whitefish transshipped in Dutch ports in transit by trading parties in the global food chain.

Over de waarde en/of de verdiensten van Rusland van uit Rusland afkomstige witvis die in Nederlandse havens «in transit» wordt overgeslagen door handelspartijen in de wereldvoedselketen beschikt de Rijksoverheid niet over harde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Uyghurs detained in Thailand face deportation, persecution in China.’

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs detained in Thailand face deportation to China, including deaths in detention, and what pressure Netherlands can exert. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Thailand not to deport the group and to improve detention conditions, and is coordinating with like-minded countries and UNHCR, but gives no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands has urged the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the group, end the detention, and respect non-refoulement.
Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de groep niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de Nederlandse steun aan projecten in de Palestijnse gebieden

An MP asked why certain Dutch-funded reconciliation projects in the Palestinian territories are hidden or anonymised on the aid portal, and whether the documents will be published. The minister answered that anonymity protects participants in sensitive reconciliation work, that the government refuses to publish the withheld documents, and that financial oversight follows the usual contractual and reporting routine.
To enable the organisations concerned to carry out reconciliation projects, it has been decided not to make this information public.
Om de betreffende organisaties in staat te stellen om verzoeningsprojecten uit te voeren wordt ervoor gekozen om deze informatie niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse Syriëgezant spreekt met interim-bestuur in Damascus’

Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch Syria envoy's talks with the interim Damascus authorities and about safeguarding evidence of crimes under the Assad regime, including the fate of Sednaya prison records and the death of Mazen al-Humada. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the UN evidence bank (IIIM) and the Commission of Inquiry, pursues the ICJ case against Syria, and has no investigative power in the al-Humada death, which lies with local authorities.
Foreign Affairs has no investigative powers and cannot play a direct role in finding the perpetrators; that authority lies with the local authorities.
Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen opsporingsbevoegdheid en kan geen directe rol spelen in het vinden van de daders, die bevoegdheid ligt bij de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Vermeer over het bericht “Bijna vijftig strijders en zes jihadisten uit buitenland benoemd tot officieren in Syrië”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ukraine would send food and aid to Syria, questioning how this fits with Dutch support for Ukraine and Dutch budget constraints. The minister answered that the aid runs through the WFP Grain from Ukraine Initiative funded by donors, not by Ukraine, and that Ukraine's support continues.
Ukraine manages the initiative but does not itself make any financial contribution.
Oekraïne beheert het initiatief maar levert zelf geen financiële bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Piri over de onlangs verschenen rapporten van Amnesty, Human Rights Watch en Artsen Zonder Grenzen over de situatie in Gaza

MPs Dassen and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about reports by Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch and Doctors Without Borders alleging genocide and related crimes by Israel in Gaza, including whether the evidence meets the ICJ 'only reasonable inference' test, the water access findings, arms embargo and EU Association Council steps. The Minister answered that the government is generally reluctant to qualify situations as genocide, that it awaits ICJ rulings, that it urges Israel to expand humanitarian access and will raise this in the Association Council, and referred to a separate letter for most substantive points.
The Netherlands is as a rule reluctant to qualify situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend om situaties als genocide te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Klaver en Boswijk over de voorgenomen krimp van EU-vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland

MPs Paternotte, Klaver and Boswijk asked whether the planned Commission cut of EU delegation staff abroad, and the Dutch cuts, weaken EU diplomatic reach. The minister declined to comment on leaked documents, said the HR/VP decides on delegations, and said the Dutch cuts stay with specifics to be sent in spring.
For this reason, the cabinet does not wish to make substantive statements about the leaked document to which POLITICO refers.
Het kabinet wenst om die reden geen inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over het gelekte document waarnaar POLITICO verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over klimaatvluchtelingen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister whether the legal adviser's call for more attention to rights of climate refugees fits the government's 'strictest asylum policy ever' pledge, and about Dutch positions on new rights and on Vanuatu's proposal for climate damage claims. The minister answered that the Dutch submission to the ICJ only notes existing human rights may apply, that no new rights or lead role are planned, and that climate damage claims lack a legal basis, pointing to collective UN-based funding mechanisms instead.
The Netherlands does not intend to give substance to this in its foreign policy.
Nederland is niet voornemens om hier invulling aan te geven in haar buitenlandbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder en Kahraman over het artikel 'Aramese christenen in Syrië vrezen voor hun bestaan en erfgoed: 'Massale uittocht moet worden voorkomen'' en 'Israël waarschuwt voor gevaren v

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about reports on threats to Aramaic Christians in Syria, changes to Syrian school curricula, a curfew in Homs and Israeli warnings about the interim authorities. The minister replied that the situation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises minority protection and an inclusive transition in EU and regional fora, and that Nederland supports the UN evidence bank and the Commission of Inquiry, while stating that no concrete signs of specific minority danger exist and that the curriculum remains unchanged pending new commissions.
At follow-up contacts the cabinet will continue to stress the importance of a role in the political process for all population groups, including Christians.
Het kabinet zal bij vervolgcontacten het belang van een rol in het politieke proces voor alle bevolkingsgroepen, waaronder christenen, blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over het bericht «Sancties omzeild bij project van scheepsbouwer Damen in Rusland»

MPs Klaver and Piri asked whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's components reached Russia despite sanctions, what enforcement is underway, and how transit and dual-use exports via third countries are controlled. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that enforcement is handled by the supervisor, OM and courts, and described general export licensing, due diligence and cooperation measures.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de protesten in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about the post-election protests in Mozambique, police violence, Rwandan troops funded by EU money, and Dutch trade interests. The minister said the Netherlands condemns violence against civilians via the EU and bilaterally, denies that Rwandan troops are involved in repression, and sees no reason for independent investigation.
In my view there is no reason for an independent investigation.
Tot een onafhankelijk onderzoek bestaat naar mijn mening geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de 54ste bijeenkomst van het WEF

An MP asked why the Dutch cabinet sends a relatively large delegation to the WEF annual meeting in Davos, what sessions it will attend, and whether any agreements will be made without prior parliamentary approval. The minister answered that three ministers will attend, that no agreements or treaties will be concluded there, and that no decisions requiring parliamentary consent are taken, though the programmes were not yet finalised.
During the WEF annual meeting no political decisions are taken or international agreements made for which approval of the House of Representatives is required.
Tijdens de jaarlijkse vergadering van het WEF worden er geen politieke besluiten genomen of internationale afspraken gemaakt, waarvoor instemming van de Tweede Kamer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland door net opgerichte bedrijven

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about sanctions evasion against Russia by newly founded small firms, as flagged by a CBS and University of Groningen study, and about due diligence and compliance obligations for exporters. The minister responded that evasion is a government priority, that the expanded anti-circumvention clause and best-efforts and due diligence duties apply, that enforcement data is not yet available, and that a letter on chip manufacturers' compliance was sent on 26 November 2024.
Countering sanctions circumvention is a priority for the cabinet.
Het tegengaan van sanctie-omzeiling is een prioriteit voor het kabinet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over weigering door Algerijnse ambassade om door rechter toegewezen ontslagvergoeding te betalen

De Roon (PVV) asks why the Algerian embassy refuses to pay a €140,000 dismissal award ordered by a Dutch court and whether the Minister can do more, including about officials attending Algerian receptions. Minister Veldkamp replies that the Netherlands can only mediate, that diplomatic immunity from execution prevents enforcement, that the Algerian government has refused payment, and that the diplomatic mediation role has ended.
The ministry has taken the received complaint from the former employee of the Algerian embassy about non-compliance with the Dutch court's ruling by the Algerian authorities seriously.

Het ministerie heeft de ontvangen klacht van de voormalig medewerker van de Algerijnse ambassade over niet-naleving van de uitspraak van de Nederlandse rechter door de Algerijnse autoriteiten zonder meer serieus genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Omtzigt over de situatie van Aramese christenen in Maaloula (Syrië)

Two MPs asked the government about reports of threats, forced expulsion and property seizures against Aramean Christians in Maaloula, Syria, by HTS-linked groups, and about Dutch efforts to protect minorities and HTS's status. The minister says the government has no information confirming sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians there, lists existing accountability and diplomatic efforts, and reviews HTS's terrorist listing and citizenship revocation rules without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet has no information confirming that sectarian incidents against Aramean Christians in Maaloula have taken place since the fall of the Assad regime.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die de berichten bevestigt dat er sinds de val van het Assad-regime sektarische incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden tegen Aramese christenen in Maaloula.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Van Campen over het bericht 'Moldavië kondigt noodtoestand af vanwege wegvallen Russisch gas'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she views Moldova's declared state of emergency over the loss of Russian gas, Russia's role, and what the Netherlands can do to support Moldova's energy security and reduce dependence on Russia. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off is destabilising, that the Netherlands is considering short-term EU support, and cited past and ongoing Dutch and EU energy and resilience assistance, without committing to new specific measures.
The Netherlands is currently considering, within the EU, how it can provide additional short-term support to Moldova.
Nederland beziet momenteel in EU verband op welke manier het Moldavië extra kan ondersteunen op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Van der Lee en Boswijk over de situatie van Oeigoeren in Thailand

MPs from D66, VVD, GroenLinks-PvdA and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the detention in Thailand of over 48 Uyghurs fleeing China, and whether Thailand's threatened deportation breaches non-refoulement. The minister replied that the Netherlands urges third countries to respect non-refoulement, raises the case with UNHCR and Thai authorities privately rather than publicly, and answered every question on substance.
For now, the considered approach is not to publicly address UNHCR and to continue regular contacts with UNHCR on this matter.
Vooralsnog is de afweging om UNHCR niet publiekelijk aan te spreken en in te blijven zetten op de regelmatige contacten met UNHCR hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Feministisch Buitenlandbeleid

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the feminist foreign policy handbook, mandatory training, gender focal points, staffing and budget cuts, diversity quotas, the definition of feminism, and SRGR and gender spending targets. The minister answers that the handbook and training are voluntary or aspirational, no extra staff are being hired, staffing cuts will take effect from 2026, and quotas follow government-wide rules.
No, consulting the handbook is done on a voluntary basis.
Nee het raadplegen van de handreiking gebeurt op vrijwillige basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht dat scheepsbouwer Damen schepen opknapt die Russisch gas vervoeren

Two MPs from D66 and CDA asked ministers whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's maintenance of Russian LNG-transport vessels breaches EU sanctions and how the government will tighten measures against Russian LNG imports. The ministers answered that sanctions prohibit servicing vessels linked to Russian entities unless they are used to evade sanctions, that enforcement follows signals of breaches, that the Netherlands pushes for an EU roadmap to phase out Russian gas and LNG, and that it will press for stronger measures in the next sanctions package, but they gave no case-specific details.

The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but in general supplying parts and/or carrying out maintenance (technical assistance) to vessels of Russian persons and entities or vessels used in Russia is prohibited.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen, maar in zijn algemeenheid geldt dat het leveren van onderdelen en/of uitvoeren van onderhoud (technische bijstand) aan schepen van Russische personen en entiteiten of schepen die in Rusland gebruikt worden verboden is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘China intimideert Nederlandse media en correspondenten’

MPs Martens-America and Van der Burg asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Foreign Affairs about reports of Chinese intimidation of Dutch media and correspondents, and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that the government will evaluate its intensified foreign interference approach in 2025, supports PersVeilig, raises concerns with Chinese authorities, and will study the China Knowledge Network report's recommendations, without committing to specific new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman, Omtzigt, Ceder over de opmars van de HTS in Syrië

MPs Kahraman, Omtzigt and Ceder asked the ministers about HTS's rise in Syria, including foreign support, its terrorist listing, contacts, minority rights, sanctions, humanitarian aid and paths to peace. The minister answered that the government lacks information on who backs HTS, HTS is treated as terrorist via the UN/EU listing, no contacts exist, and many questions are deferred to the upcoming debate or ongoing EU reviews.
The cabinet does not have independent information with which these reports can be confirmed or denied.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie waarmee deze berichten bevestigd of ontkend kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Hamas’s extensive network in Europe exposed in a new series of reports’

An MP from the SGP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers how to respond to reports that Hamas-linked actors operate in Europe, including whether they should be placed on the national and EU terrorism sanctions lists and how disinformation and Hamas-linked networks should be monitored. Minister Van Weel answered that the matter was passed to competent authorities, explained the legal criteria for listing and the limits on acting, and said the government will pursue further EU measures and criminalise glorification of terrorism.
In the interest of how the intelligence services operate, no statements are made about this in public.
In het belang van de werkwijze van de inlichtingendiensten worden hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat Viktor Orbán premier Netanyahu wil uitnodigen in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether Hungary's announced invitation to Netanyahu and its stated intention to ignore ICC arrest warrants undermines the Court, and whether the Netherlands would raise this at the Assembly of States Parties. The Minister answered that the Rome Statute does not prohibit such invitations, that the government leaves Orbán's statements to him, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged all states parties to cooperate with the Court, without committing to a formal step against Hungary.
The authority of the ICC is firmly established and the obligations under the Rome Statute are clear.
Het gezag en de autoriteit van het ISH zijn stevig gevestigd en de verplichtingen onder het Statuut van Rome zijn helder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Turkije.

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish strikes in northeast Syria that cut water and power, possible violations of international law, and the removal of elected Kurdish mayors in southeast Turkey, including sanctions and support for human rights groups. The minister acknowledged Turkey's security concerns and urged respect for international law and civilian infrastructure, said the government raises concerns with Turkish authorities, and declined to summon the ambassador or back EU sanctions.
The cabinet chooses to raise its concerns about replacing mayors with so-called trustees in talks with Turkish authorities, both via the EU and bilaterally.
Het kabinet kiest ervoor haar zorgen over het vervangen van burgemeesters door zogenoemde «trustees» op te brengen in gesprekken met de Turkse autoriteiten, zowel via de EU als bilateraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Israëlische ongewenste inmenging

An MP asked the government to share the NCTV investigation into alleged Israeli undue interference, to explain its scope and method, to investigate other Israeli interventions and incidents, and to say whether the ambassador was summoned. The government declined to share the findings publicly, citing security interests, said it would share further information through appropriate channels, and confirmed it raised the matter with the Israeli ambassador.
This information cannot be shared publicly because it could harm our security interests.
Deze informatie kan niet in het openbaar worden gedeeld omdat dit onze veiligheidsbelangen kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bezoek van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uit Iran aan Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Foreign Minister why he met the Iranian Foreign Minister in the Netherlands, whether Iran was confronted on repression, its regional role, support for Russia and nuclear ambitions, and what concrete outcomes resulted. The minister defends the meeting as necessary diplomacy for regional de-escalation and says the government's concerns on these issues are consistent, but declines to give details of the conversation or outcomes, citing diplomatic effectiveness.
However, for the sake of the effectiveness of the Netherlands' diplomatic efforts, no details can be given about the conversation itself.
Omwille van de effectiviteit van de Nederlandse diplomatieke inzet kunnen echter geen details worden gegeven over het gesprek zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Paternotte over VN-onderzoek in Libanon

MPs Dobbe and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about the November 2024 Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire and compliance, promoting justice and independent international monitoring in Lebanon, and whether the Netherlands would back a UN Human Rights Council special session on violations by all parties. The minister described the ceasefire terms and monitoring mechanism, said Nederland would raise investigating alleged violations of humanitarian law at the Foreign Affairs Council, and declined for now to initiate a special session because Lebanon had not requested one.

In accordance with the Paternotte et al. motion, I will stress at the Foreign Affairs Council of Monday 16 December 2024 the importance of thorough investigation into alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
26 ) zal ik tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van maandag 16 december 2024 het belang van gedegen onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het briefadvies van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken over Israëlisch-Palestijns conflict

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister 14 questions about the AIV advisory report on Dutch policy on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, including suspending the EU-Israel association agreement, halting bilateral cooperation, recognising Palestine and a national anti-antisemitism action plan. The minister answered all questions collectively by pointing to the government's separate reaction to the AIV advice, sent before the Middle East committee debate.
These parliamentary questions are answered by means of the cabinet's response to the AIV advice, which is sent to the House at the same time as this answer.
Deze Kamervragen worden beantwoord middels de kabinetsreactie op het AIV-advies die tegelijkertijd met deze beantwoording aan de Kamer wordt verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het snelgroeiende geweld tegen christenen in India

SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the rising violence against Christians in India, its causes, the role of anti-conversion laws, disinformation, caste, and EU action. The minister condemned violence against religious minorities, said Nederland raises freedom of religion in bilateral, EU and UN dialogues including the upcoming EU-India human rights dialogue, but said causes are not clear-cut and gave general answers on several questions.
The Netherlands will continue to do so, including by pushing for this topic to be raised at the next EU-India Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland zal dit blijven doen, onder meer door in te zetten op agendering van dit onderwerp in de eerstvolgende EU-India Mensenrechtendialoog
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht 'Tankervloot die Iran miljarden opleverde via Suriname beheerd'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch-based law firm helped Iran's oil industry evade US sanctions, asking about Dutch/EU sanctions breaches, measures against shadow fleets, and cooperation with the US and Suriname. The minister answered that it is not Nederland's role to enforce US sanctions, that suspected breaches of Dutch/EU sanctions are investigated without commenting on individual cases, and that the Netherlands cooperates closely with the US on sanctions.
When there are signals of possible sanctions violations, investigation is always carried out and further (criminal) follow-up is given where necessary.
Bij signalen van mogelijke overtreding van sancties wordt altijd onderzoek gedaan en hier wordt waar nodig verdere (strafrechtelijke) opvolging aan gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Hirsch en Nordkamp over de handhaving van de internationale rechtsorde ten aanzien van Israël

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel, journalist access to Gaza, and Israel's halt on visas for international NGO staff. The minister answered that two military export licences were granted since 7 October 2023, 28 dual-use licences in 2024, that F-35 parts and engines are no longer exported to Israel after the court ruling, and that Israel should allow journalists and aid workers access but no sanctions or consequences were announced.
The Netherlands calls on Israel to facilitate the work of aid organisations, including by improving visa issuance.
Nederland roept Israël op om het werk van hulporganisaties te faciliteren, inclusief middels verbetering van visumverlening.

Antwoord op het lid Van Baarle over het advies ‘Legal consequences arising from the policies and practices of Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem’ van het Internationaal Gerechtshof

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister, in 47 numbered questions, how the government will respond to the ICJ advisory opinion on Israel's policies and practices in the occupied Palestinian territory, including East Jerusalem, covering settlements, the embassy move, water, discrimination, apartheid and accountability. The Minister answered that the ICJ opinion is authoritative and Nederland respects its interpretation, that the government will analyse whether to adapt its policy framework and discouragement policy, and that prosecution of international crimes is a matter for the independent Openbaar Ministerie.
The Court's advisory opinion is an important guideline, and the Netherlands takes its international obligations seriously.
Het advies van het Hof is een belangrijke leidraad, en Nederland neemt zijn internationale verplichtingen serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over humanitaire consequenties detentie reddingsschip van Artsen zonder Grenzen Geo Barents door Italië

MP Koekkoek (Volt) asked the ministers about the humanitarian consequences of Italy's detention of the Geo Barents rescue ship and the Libyan coast guard's conduct. The government replied that Italy's detention is a domestic legal matter for Italian courts and the European Commission, that the EU supports the Libyan coast guard with monitoring and training, and that a complaint filed with the Commission in July 2023 is still pending.
This concerns an assessment by the Italian authorities based on Italian laws and regulations.
Het gaat hier om een afweging van de Italiaanse autoriteiten op basis van Italiaanse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de rechtszaak van Nederland tegen Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked for the written claim Netherlands, Australia, Canada and Germany filed against Afghanistan over violations of the Women's Convention, asked whether it affects asylum procedures for Afghan women, and asked about grant rates and the risks of tightened IND assessment criteria. The minister said the claim is at the negotiation stage and the strategy is confidential, that there is no legal link to asylum decisions which rest on the Afghanistan country report and individual assessment, and gave grant-rate figures (about 95% overall, 75% since July 2024 on small numbers).
The progress and strategy of the negotiations is confidential in the interest of the process.
De voortgang en strategie van de onderhandelingen is in het belang van het proces vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Houwelingen over Oekraïne als atoommacht

The MP Van Houwelingen asked the Foreign Minister whether Zelensky threatened nuclear weapons development, whether Ukraine is pursuing nuclear weapons, and related questions on consequences for the Netherlands and the likelihood of Russian nuclear retaliation. The minister answered that Zelensky explicitly denied pursuing nuclear weapons, that the government has no indication of Ukrainian nuclear efforts, and declined to speculate on hypothetical scenarios.
The cabinet has no indication whatsoever that Ukraine is attempting to develop or acquire nuclear weapons.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele aanwijzing dat Oekraïne poogt om kernwapens te ontwikkelen of in handen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bezoek van de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties aan de top van de BRICS-landen

Parliamentarian Boswijk (CDA) asks why UN Secretary-General Guterres attended the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, and planned to meet Putin despite the ICC arrest warrant, and whether his attendance undermines the UN's relevance. Minister Veldkamp replies that the SG normally attends such summits, that the Netherlands and EU objected and preferred lower-level representation, that the UN should have justified the contact under its 2013 guidelines, and that the objection has been communicated to the SG.
The Netherlands, like the EU and other like-minded countries, clearly communicated this objection to the SG.
Dit bezwaar heeft Nederland, net als de EU en andere gelijkgezinden, duidelijk aan de SG kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Paternotte over de aanbesteding van rechtsbijstand aan Nederlandse ter doodveroordeelden

MPs Ellian and Paternotte asked why the tender for legal aid to Dutch nationals facing the death penalty abroad was split into lots, why a English organisation could win, and whether a Dutch organisation should be required. Minister Veldkamp answered that the split aims at more expertise and redundancy, that local foreign lawyers are essential for death penalty cases, and that the Dutch-language support role lies with consular staff and Dutch-speaking subsidy partners.
Specific knowledge, experience and a network relating to that local legal area and good communication channels in the detention country were the primary considerations in this tender.
Specifieke kennis, ervaring en een netwerk met betrekking tot dat lokale rechtsgebied en een goede communicatielijn in het betreffende detentieland, hebben voorop gestaan bij deze aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Werf over de aanval op Nederlandse apparaten door Chinese staatshackers

MPs Kathmann and Van der Werf asked the government about a Chinese state-linked hacking botnet that infected Dutch consumer devices, including its motives, consequences, affected parties and EU legislative remedies. The government answered that the botnet was untargeted, that no critical infrastructure or state secrets are known to have been affected, that NCSC and DTC issued general advice, and that the Cyber Resilience Act would strengthen device security.
As far as is known, the infected systems in the Netherlands were not part of the central government or vital infrastructure.
Voor zover bekend waren de in Nederland besmette systemen geen onderdeel van de Rijksoverheid of vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het kidnappen van Turkse burgers in Kenia

MPs Paternotte and Podt asked about the abduction of seven Turkish refugees in Nairobi, risks of refoulement and political punishment in Turkey, transnational repression of Gülen movement members, and whether a new country report on Turkey would be requested. The minister condemned the refoulement, said the ambassador raised it with Kenya, noted Gülen-linked profiles are treated as a risk profile in asylum policy, and committed to a new Algemeen Ambtsbericht Turkije by end of February 2025.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over recente ontwikkelingen in Israël-Palestina

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government how it views Israeli laws threatening UNRWA's operations in the occupied Palestinian territories, whether the Netherlands should join partner statements against them, and about humanitarian access, the Israeli 'General Plan' and possible responses. The government answered that the laws are worrying, that Israel as occupying power must ensure alternatives to UNRWA services and humanitarian access, and that it is too early to speculate on consequences while it presses Israel through bilateral, EU and UN channels.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van Campen over het bericht «Europese miljarden voor bestrijding migratie in Afrika komen nauwelijks goed terecht: «school zonder elektriciteit kreeg blender cadeau»»

MPs Kamminga and Van Campen asked the ministers whether the EUR 4.5 billion EU Trust Fund for Africa spent on curbing migration had real impact, following a European Court of Auditors report on poor spending. The minister answered that the government does not share the report's conclusion of negligible impact, accepts the auditors' recommendations, will press the Commission to implement them, and says there is no ready-made formula for migration control.
The Netherlands will firmly urge the European Commission to implement this and will ask the Commission to inform the member states about it.
Nederland zal er bij de Europese Commissie stevig op aandringen dat dit ook gebeurt en zal de Europese Commissie vragen de lidstaten hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over Israëlische beschietingen tegen VN-vredesmacht UNIFIL

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli shelling of UNIFIL peacekeeping positions, including a tank round hitting a watchtower and fire on a bunker, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, summon the Israeli ambassador, and whether a Dutch soldier was hurt. The minister condemned the attacks, said they are a serious violation of international humanitarian law and called for an immediate halt, confirmed no Dutch soldier was injured, and declined to summon the ambassador at this time, relying on diplomatic pressure instead.
The cabinet continues to hold Israel to account diplomatically and politically for its responsibility to protect UNIFIL soldiers and respect the UNIFIL mandate.
Het kabinet blijft Israël diplomatiek en politiek aanspreken op zijn verantwoordelijkheid om UNIFIL-militairen te beschermen en het mandaat van UNIFIL te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de massadeportatie van Krim-Tataren door de Sovjet-Unie in 1944 als genocide erkennen

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands will recognise the 1944 Soviet deportation of Crimean Tatars as genocide, citing Estonia's parliamentary recognition and other countries' positions. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government is cautious about labelling events genocide, that international courts and UN findings are leading, and that he will not ask the CAVV for further advice, though he acknowledges the suffering.
In light of the above, the Dutch government takes a cautious stance when qualifying certain events as genocide.
In het licht van het bovenstaande stelt de Nederlandse regering zich terughoudend op bij het kwalificeren van bepaalde gebeurtenissen als genocide.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over het bericht dat Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven die subsidie ontvangen om Oekraïne te helpen met de wederopbouw tegelijkertijd zakendoenin Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Paternotte and Van der Burg asked whether Dutch farm firms receiving Ukraine reconstruction subsidies also trade with Russia, and whether RVO checks this and should exclude such firms. The government says it does not comment on individual firms, that unsanctioned trade with Russia is not currently grounds for exclusion, and that it is studying adding such an exclusion to the Ukraine Partnership Facility subsidy scheme and considering further EU sanctions on agricultural goods.
In addition, the cabinet is examining whether unsanctioned trade with Russia can be added as a ground for exclusion from the subsidy scheme for the Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF).
Daarnaast onderzoekt het kabinet of ongesanctioneerde handel met Rusland als uitsluitingsgrond toegevoegd kan worden aan de subsidieregeling voor de Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)
Antwoord op van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat “stokoude, slecht verzekerde tankers met Russische olie meermaals per dag langs de Nederlandse kust varen”

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about reports that old, poorly insured tankers carrying Russian oil pass the Dutch coast hundreds of times, raising pollution risk, possible sabotage use, liability, legal options, sanctions effectiveness and oil refining loopholes. The minister replied that the Netherlands cannot block such vessels in international waters and relies on port state control, IMO and IOPC Fund measures, EU sanctions listings and continued work on sanctions evasion, while giving only general answers on future sanctions proposals.
It is not in the interest of the negotiations or the Dutch negotiating position to go further into detail on concrete proposals.
7 Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelingen en de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie om verder in detail te gaan over concrete voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitlatingen van de secretaris generaal van de NAVO

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the NATO Secretary General's claim that Ukraine will inevitably join NATO, 'we decided in Washington', is accurate and who 'we' refers to, including whether the Netherlands is part of it. The minister answered that 'we' means all NATO allies, that the Bucharest 2008 statement and the Washington 2024 summit declaration reaffirmed Ukraine's path to NATO membership, and that the Netherlands agreed to that declaration.
The 'we' in this statement refers to all NATO allies together.
De «we» in deze uitspraak verwijst naar alle NAVO-bondgenoten gezamenlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over bericht ‘Waarschuwingen en veroordelingen na nieuwe Georgische anti-lhbti-wetgeving’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs how the government responds to Georgia's new anti-LGBTI law and whether it will summon the Georgian ambassador, factor the law into Georgia's EU candidate status, press Georgia on rights protection, and reconsider its candidacy. The minister condemned the law, said it had raised concerns in talks and publicly, outlined EU-level steps including the Equal Rights Coalition, and stated that the EU accession process has de facto stalled, though no summoning of the ambassador was committed.
In the run-up to the legislative process, the Netherlands repeatedly made clear in talks with the Georgian authorities that it finds the adoption of LGBTIQ+ laws very worrying.
Nederland heeft in de aanloop naar het wetgevingsproces in gesprekken meermaals aan de Georgische autoriteiten duidelijk gemaakt dat Nederland de aanname van lhbtiq+-wetten zeer zorgelijk vindt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Brug en Van Campen over bericht ‘Georgië neemt omstreden wet aan tegen lhbtqia+-rechten’ en het bericht ‘Beroemde trans vrouw vermoord in Georgië na invoering wet tegen lhbtqia+-re

MPs Van der Burg and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister about Georgia's new anti-LGBTQ+ law and the reported murder of a trans woman after its adoption. The minister condemned the law as undermining fundamental rights and EU values, said EU accession has effectively stalled, and said the government would await the murder investigation and keep pressing Georgian authorities.
Regarding the horrific murder of Kesaria Abramidze, the cabinet is awaiting the investigation into it.
Met betrekking tot de gruwelijke moord op Kesaria Abramidze wacht het kabinet het onderzoek hiernaar af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Integrated Political Crisis Response (IPCR)

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked the Foreign Minister who represents the Netherlands in the EU's IPCR crisis mechanism, whether any binding IPCR decisions were taken this year, and whether the Chamber can receive IPCR minutes since 2020. The minister answered that Netherlands is usually represented at official level, that IPCR produces no binding decisions, and that the Operational Conclusions carry a Limité classification so they cannot be published, though they will be made available for confidential inspection.
The minutes of the IPCR round tables, the Operational Conclusions, carry the distribution code Limité.
Antwoord 3 De notulen van de IPCR ronde tafels, de Operational Conclusions , hebben een verspreidingscode Limité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over het persbericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the government about a broadcast report that Russia systematically spies on Dutch waters, and how the North Sea is monitored, whether responses are proportionate, joint NATO measures, intensification, and tougher measures in coastal areas and ports. The minister answered that a range of agencies monitor the North Sea, that Navy escorts Russian vessels, that an action plan on North Sea infrastructure is being expanded with sensors and satellite capacity, and that a bill on espionage offences is pending, while declining to pre-announce specific responses.
The cabinet does not make public statements in advance about how the Dutch government will act in specific incidents, to prevent malicious parties from anticipating Dutch conduct.

Het kabinet doet publiekelijk op voorhand geen uitspraken over hoe de Nederlandse overheid handelt bij specifieke voorvallen, om te voorkomen dat kwaadwillende partijen in hun handelen kunnen anticiperen op Nederlandse handelwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Palestine to seek end to ‘unlawful’ Israeli occupation within 12 months at UN

MP Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the Palestinian plan for a UN General Assembly resolution demanding Israel end its unlawful occupation within twelve months, how the Netherlands views this in light of the ICJ advisory opinion, and whether voting against would undermine Dutch credibility, and asked for answers before the vote. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ICJ opinion requires Israel to end its unlawful presence while the Netherlands calls on Israel to comply, explained that the Netherlands abstained for several reasons with reference to an explanation of vote, said the government values the ICJ opinion, and stated that answers could not be given within the shortened deadline.
It has not proven possible to answer the questions within a shortened deadline.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om de vragen binnen een verkorte termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over het bericht ‘Russen maken microchips met oude ASML-machines voor wapens’

MPs Van der Burg and Kamminga asked the ministers whether Russia is obtaining ASML spare parts and machines despite sanctions and what can be done about intermediaries. The government said it cannot confirm the reported shipment numbers or the number of machines in Russia, cites confidentiality, and says it works with the EU sanctions envoy and other partners to counter circumvention, while acknowledging that listing intermediaries takes time.
The cabinet cannot provide insight into the number and type of ASML machines in Russia.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in het aantal en het soort ASML-machines in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht "Doodsbedreigingen en anonieme berichten: hoe Chinese studenten in Nederland worden geïntimideerd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Education minister and Foreign Affairs minister about reports that Chinese students in the Netherlands are threatened and intimidated, and what is being done. The minister agreed such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to a broad approach against unwanted foreign interference, university responsibility for safety, a raised issue with the Chinese embassy, and ongoing work on academic freedom and self-censorship.
The cabinet considers every form of unwanted foreign interference completely unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt elke vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Chinese luchtvaartmaatschappijen stunten met goedkope vliegtickets op de Europese markt omdat zij over Rusland kunnen blijven vliegen.’

D66 MPs asked whether Chinese and other non-EU airlines flying over Russia gain cost advantages over EU carriers, whether this poses a safety risk, and whether the government will restrict such overflights or seek EU or ICAO action. The minister confirmed these airlines use Russian airspace and an unfair advantage is possible, but said EU law does not allow banning them, that non-discriminatory charges are barred under the Chicago Convention, and that ICAO cannot impose such sanctions.
However, it turns out that it is legally not possible to prohibit airlines from countries that may still operate via Russian airspace from conducting flights to and from the European Union (EU).

Het blijkt echter juridisch niet mogelijk om luchtvaartmaatschappijen uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren te verbieden om vluchten van en naar de Europese Unie (EU) uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Taliban restrictions on women's rights in Afghanistan, EU and UN engagement, sanctions and visas for Taliban members, and whether aid can be misused. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the restrictions, co-holds Afghanistan liable under CEDAW, keeps conditional aid and monitoring, and sees no case for a full aid stop.

The Netherlands, bilaterally and within the EU, strongly condemned this law and called on the Taliban to respect human rights and especially women's and girls' rights in line with international treaty obligations.

Nederland heeft bilateraal en in EU verband deze wet ten sterkste veroordeeld en de Taliban opgeroepen mensenrechten en vrouwen- en meisjesrechten in het bijzonder in lijn met internationale verdragsverplichtingen te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Boswijk over het wegschrijven van verwijzingen naar genderbeleid en SRGR in antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen

MPs Dobbe and Boswijk asked whether the ministry's edits to earlier written answers, which removed or softened references to Dutch gender policy, SRGR and investment in women's rights, changed policy. The minister answers that the edits are textual only, that women's rights, gender equality and SRGR remain part of Dutch foreign policy priorities, and that development policy details will follow later.
The mentioned changes are textual and do not represent a change in policy.
De genoemde wijzigingen zijn tekstueel en houden geen wijziging van beleid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘West funding Putin’s soldiers with growing Russian fuel purchases'

An MP asked whether EU and Dutch imports of Turkish-refined Russian oil undermine sanctions and whether the minister would press Turkey, sanction Turkish refineries and investigate Dutch buyers. The minister answered that the data are unverified, that Turkish refining of Russian crude does not breach EU sanctions, and that no Dutch-buyer investigation or refinery listing is planned, while the cabinet keeps pushing economic pressure on Russia.
Turkish companies and the refineries involved that buy crude oil products of origin, refine them into oil products and then sell them do not thereby violate EU sanctions.
Turkse bedrijven en betrokken raffinaderijen die van oorsprong ruwe aardolieproducten inkopen, deze raffineren tot aardolieproducten en vervolgens verkopen, overtreden daarmee geen EU-sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over de uitspraak dat Oekraïne Nederlandse F-16’s in mag zetten in Rusland

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Ukraine may use Dutch F-16s on Russian territory, including the decision process, escalation risks, sanctions, frozen assets and peace talks. Minister Brekelmans confirmed Ukraine may use them within international law, declined to disclose cabinet deliberations or escalation analyses, and gave general, largely non-specific answers on sanctions and peace efforts.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are secret.
De beraadslagingen van de Ministerraad zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over het onderzoek van Trollrensics over desinformatienetwerken tijdens de EU verkiezingen

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a Trollrensics report on disinformation networks targeting the 2024 European elections, including whether AIVD, MIVD and NCTV confirm it, whether similar campaigns occurred in the Netherlands, the role of Dutch hosting infrastructure, and whether the DSA suffices against platforms like X. The minister answered that the network was not observed in the Netherlands, that the services cannot publicly confirm investigations, that DSA enforcement by the European Commission is ongoing, and that a broader Dutch disinformation strategy is underway.
The cabinet cannot publicly disclose where the intelligence and security services are or are not conducting investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen naar waar de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten al dan niet onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de situatie van Nederlanders in Libanon

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the number of Dutch nationals still in Lebanon, contact with them, and evacuation options as commercial routes closed. The minister said no exact count is possible since there is no registration obligation, announced active repatriation flights with military and commercial means, and said evacuation by the state is not currently needed.
An exact number cannot be given, partly because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad.
Een exact aantal is niet te geven, mede omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Afkicken van Russisch gas blijkt lastiger dan gedacht: één lng-tanker per maand werden er plots twee'

MPs Klaver and Kröger asked whether the 14th sanctions package has increased Russian LNG imports into the EU and the Netherlands, how sanctions are enforced, and whether the government will press for tighter measures. The minister answered that Russian LNG imports into the Netherlands have doubled monthly since July, that this reflects rerouting rather than new purchases, that enforcement and sanctions are limited until March 2025, and that stronger EU-wide measures depend on a forthcoming Commission roadmap.
This concerns commercially confidential information on which I cannot make statements.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Brussels considers sanctions on Slovakia over backsliding on rule of law.’

Dutch MP Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Brussels is considering sanctions on Slovakia over rule-of-law backsliding, including abolition of the special prosecutor's office and dismantling of public broadcasting, and about parallels with Hungary and Russian influence. The minister answered that the government monitors Slovakia closely, that it is primarily for the Commission to assess Union-law breaches, and that the government urges swift, effective EU action using existing rule-of-law instruments, without taking a new national position.
It is primarily for the Commission, in its role as guardian of the EU Treaties, to assess whether Slovakia has breached Union law and to act against it where necessary.
Het is primair aan de Commissie om, in haar rol als hoedster van de Verdragen, te beoordelen of Slowakije het Unierecht schendt en hier indien nodig tegen op te treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Teunissen over aanvullende sancties tegen de grootste Israëlische landinname op de Westelijke Jordaanoever sinds de Oslo-akkoorden en de erkenning van vijf illegale nederzettin

Opposition MPs Ouwehand and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands did not condemn Israel's largest land seizure on the West Bank since Oslo and the legalisation of five illegal settlements, and pressed on EU sanctions against violent settlers, the minister's stance, and the UN resolution 2334 on settlements. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the land seizure and legalisations as contrary to international law, raises concerns bilaterally, supports EU sanctions on settler violence, and rejects claims of a softer line while preferring non-public diplomacy.
The Netherlands condemns both this land confiscation and the legalisation of the five illegal outposts, including under Israeli law.
Nederland veroordeelt zowel deze landconfiscatie als de legalisatie van de vijf, ook onder Israëlisch recht, illegale buitenposten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over aandringen bij de Deense regering op het vrijlaten van walvissenredder Paul Watson

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would press Denmark to free whale activist Paul Watson, who faces possible extradition to Japan, and asked about Japan's whaling and the IWC. The minister answered that extradition is a matter for Danish authorities, that the Dutch embassy is monitoring the case, and that the Netherlands opposes whaling and will press for an EU resolution at the IWC.
It is up to the Danish authorities whether or not to act on this and to make statements about it.
Het is aan de Deense autoriteiten om hier al dan niet uitvoering aan te geven en om daar uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Hirsch over de veroordeling van milieuactivisten in Cambodja

Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the ministers whether they will condemn and press for the release of ten Mother Nature environmental activists convicted in Cambodia, and whether the shrinking civil society space is unacceptable. Minister Veldkamp answers that UN experts found due process was not respected, that the embassy in Bangkok monitors the case and raises human rights in bilateral and UPR settings, and that a decision on civil society policy under the new cabinet will follow later.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the matter and speak out where possible and appropriate.
Nederland zal de kwestie blijven volgen en zich uitspreken waar dat mogelijk en passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de behandeling van Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported collective punishment and mistreatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli prisons, including administrative detention, unlawful combatant classification of Gaza detainees, lack of access for ICRC and family, and alleged abuse at Sde Teiman. The minister acknowledged concern, said the Netherlands raises detention standards with Israel and supports independent investigation, and reported diplomatic outreach to secure access for the ICRC, without committing to a new formal condemnation.
The cabinet takes reports of alleged violations of international law, including international humanitarian law, extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt signalen van vermeende schendingen van het internationaal recht, inclusief het humanitair oorlogsrecht, uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over de dreigende dood van miljoenen zwerfhonden in Turkije

An MP asked the ministers whether Turkey's proposed law, expected to kill millions of stray dogs, should be opposed, and whether the Dutch humane approach (capture, sterilisation, vaccination, registration) could be promoted with Turkey. The government confirmed awareness, said humane solutions should be sought where possible, and said Turkey's approach is an internal matter, though the Dutch approach will be shared with Turkish authorities where relevant.
The concrete approach applied by Turkey is an internal Turkish matter.
De concrete benadering die door Turkije wordt toegepast is een Turkse interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Israëlische aanval op een school in Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli strike on a school in Gaza, reported casualties, Israel's alleged targeting rules, EU statements, and steps to hold Israel to international humanitarian law. The minister said the government lacks verified casualty figures, condemned violations regardless of perpetrator, supports ceasefire negotiations and humanitarian aid, and noted funding for ICC and OHCHR evidence-gathering, but declined to judge the lawfulness of specific strikes.
The cabinet does not have verified information on the specific numbers of civilian casualties.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde informatie over de specifieke aantallen burgerslachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over het artikel ‘After Polynesia and New Caledonia, Baku will help Bonaire in its fight against colonialism’

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Azerbaijan, through the Baku Initiative Group, is using anti-colonial narratives to destabilise Bonaire, and whether Bonaire seeks to change its status. The minister said the organisations have no known ties to the Bonaire government, no request to revise Bonaire's position was received, the matter is not discussed in international fora, and no additional measures against disinformation are needed.
I am not aware of the information held by the French intelligence services.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de informatie waar de Franse inlichtingendiensten over beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het nieuwe Oxfam-rapport Water War Crimes van 17 juli

An MP asked the government about an Oxfam report alleging Israel uses water deprivation as a weapon in Gaza, citing per-capita water access figures, ICJ provisional measures and Dutch water diplomacy. The minister acknowledged the severe shortage, urged Israel to comply with ICJ measures and said Nederland will keep raising the issue bilaterally, while stating that consequences for Israel are not yet linked to the failure to improve access.

The Netherlands sees diplomatic engagement with Israel, both bilaterally and multilaterally, together with the funding and support for aid organisations mentioned in answer 8, as currently the most effective way to achieve results.

Nederland ziet diplomatieke inzet richting Israël, zowel bilateraal als multilateraal, in samenhang met de onder antwoord 8 genoemde financiering en steun aan hulporganisaties, op dit moment als de meest effectieve manier om resultaten te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Paternotte over het nieuws dat de Israëlische regering Noorse diplomaten gaat uitwijzen na de Noorse erkenning van Palestina

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked Foreign Minister Veldkamp about Israel's decision to withdraw accreditation from Norwegian diplomats after Norway recognised Palestine, including whether it obstructs ICC proceedings and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister called the Israeli decision unwise, said he had raised concerns bilaterally with Israel's foreign minister, and gave substantive but largely non-committal answers on Israel's compliance with international law.
It is not for me to explain why Israel has taken this step.
Het is niet aan mij om uit te leggen waarom Israël hiertoe is overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de annexatie van Palestijns grondgebied op de Westelijke Jordaanoever door Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's annexation of about 270 hectares in the West Bank, including whether it violates international law, Smotrich's remarks, the two-state solution, bilateral sanctions and the implementation of the Piri motion. The minister answered that Israel's settlement policy violates international law, condemned the decision, reviewed EU-Israel association agreement steps, rejected national sanctions in favour of EU action, and reported EU sanctions on violent settlers.
No, I am not in favour of national measures.
Nee, ik ben geen voorstander van nationale maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk, Paternotte en Rooderkerk over de stijgende invoer van Russisch gas

MPs asked whether EU imports of Russian gas are rising, whether this creates dependence and vulnerability, whether cheap Russian gas undermines alternatives, and what measures the EU could take. The minister acknowledged a slight rise in early 2024 but said Russian shares have fallen sharply since 2021, outlined EU phase-out steps and Dutch proposals for a roadmap, while declining to provide a list of affected projects because the government lacks access to market parties' data.
Such an overview cannot be provided, because the Dutch government has no insight into the projects of market parties and their economic feasibility.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven, omdat de Nederlandse overheid geen inzage heeft in de projecten van marktpartijen en de economische haalbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de situatie in Bangladesh

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development how the Netherlands will support a peaceful, democratic transition in Bangladesh after the fall of Sheikh Hasina, investigate alleged human rights violations during protests, and protect garment workers. The government answered that it supports human rights defenders, backs a UN OHCHR inquiry, supports monitoring, and works with ILO, IFC and partners on garment-sector labour conditions.
The Netherlands intends to continue this support during this important transition period in Bangladesh.
Nederland is voornemens deze steun voort te zetten in deze belangrijke tijd van transitie in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Bulgaria's new anti-LGBTQ law is official. Opponents beg EU to take action.’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a Bulgarian law banning 'propaganda' of non-traditional sexual orientation and gender identities in and around schools breaches EU non-discrimination principles, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that the European Commission is primarily responsible for assessing compliance with EU law, that the Netherlands will raise concerns bilaterally and at EU level, has already voiced concerns publicly, and funds LGBTQ+ organisations including in Bulgaria.
The Netherlands will, together with like-minded member states, raise concerns about the amendment bilaterally and at EU level.
Nederland zal, in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, zorgen over de wetswijziging bilateraal en in EU-verband aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Rajkowski over het zonder veiligheidsonderzoek toelaten door Hongarije van Russische en Wit-Russische «gastarbeiders» tot het Schengengebied

Two MPs asked whether Hungary's extension of its National Card work permit to Russian and Belarusian workers without security screening violates Schengen and sanctions rules, and what risks this poses for the Netherlands. The government answered that individual entry bans still apply, that Hungary must still carry out border checks, that the Commission has asked Hungary for information and the Netherlands is awaiting its assessment, and that the risk of intelligence officers using this route is taken seriously.

EU Commissioner for Home Affairs Ylva Johansson requested by letter on 1 August that Hungary's Minister of Internal Affairs provide text and explanation at short notice on the extension of the National Card to Belarusian and Russian nationals.
Eurocommissaris voor Binnenlandse Zaken Ylva Johansson heeft op 1 augustus jl. per brief aan de Hongaarse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken Hongarije verzocht op korte termijn tekst en uitleg te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het opzeggen van het verdrag inzake clustermunitie door Litouwen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he knew of Lithuania's withdrawal from the Convention on Cluster Munitions, whether he shared the coalition's concerns, and whether he would urge Lithuania to reverse its decision. The minister confirmed the withdrawal, said the Netherlands regrets it, and reported that the government has already raised concerns with Lithuania, which points to its security situation, while noting that the withdrawal takes effect after a six-month period following notification to the UN.
The cabinet has already had contact with Lithuanian authorities about the withdrawal from the convention.
Het kabinet heeft reeds contact gehad met Litouwse autoriteiten over het opzeggen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van president Poetin

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the cabinet knows of statements by President Putin aiming to restore the old Soviet borders, following a German government reply denying such statements. The minister declined to share any such statements, saying the cabinet sees increasingly aggressive Russian rhetoric and that Russia's aggression against Ukraine reflects a broader pattern of undermining neighbours' sovereignty.

No. What is clear is that President Putin feels close to the ideology of the 'Russian World' and the cabinet sees increasingly aggressive rhetoric from Russian government representatives, including President Putin.
