Nee. Wel is duidelijk dat president Poetin zich verwant voelt met de ideologie van de «Russische Wereld» en het kabinet ziet dat er sprake is van steeds agressievere retoriek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over het bericht ‘Influencers zamelen via Nederland geld in voor uitrusting Russische militairen’

Two D66 MPs asked whether crowdfunding via Dutch platform Boosty for equipping Russian soldiers constitutes sanctions evasion, about the corporate ownership chain, and what the government will do to deter sanctions evasion via the Netherlands. Minister Veldkamp replied that the government cannot comment on individual cases, that sanctions enforcement is for courts, supervisors or the prosecutor, and that the government raises signals with authorities and works through existing coordination platforms, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet cannot publicly comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek in hoeverre Chinese auto’s een veiligheidsrisico opleveren voor de nationale veiligheid

Boswijk (CDA) asked about the status of the motion requiring a national security analysis of Chinese electric vehicles, whether the Netherlands was present at a US meeting on Chinese software in cars, and whether the Netherlands and EU should adopt US restrictions. The government said the risk analysis has started with interdepartmental working groups and results are expected by year end, declined to discuss the confidential meeting, said US measures are not yet known and the Netherlands will make its own assessment, preferring EU-level action.
By the end of the year, the House will be informed about the first results of these working groups.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de eerste resultaten van deze werkgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over het proces tegen Jimmy Lai, hoofdredacteur van de voorheen grootste vrije krant in Hongkong

MPs Paternotte, Van der Burg and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about delays in the trial of Jimmy Lai, the erosion of rights in Hong Kong under the 1984 Sino-British Declaration and the ICCPR, and whether the Netherlands would join calls for his release, the Council of the EU agenda, and the matter being raised. The minister answered that Netherlands shares concern and speaks out with the EU and like-minded states, attends the trials, but will not issue a separate statement or put the case on the Foreign Affairs Council agenda for now.
At this moment I therefore do not intend to put this case on the agenda of the Foreign Affairs Council.
Op dit moment ben ik daarom niet van plan deze zaak op de agenda van de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over het bericht 'Anti-Palestijnse desinformatie in de Kamer: ‘Dit is niet hoe het hoort te gaan’'

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the ministers about a Groene Amsterdammer report that former minister Van Leeuwen suspended UNRWA funding unilaterally, whether he consulted advisers, his deleted social media posts, and UNRWA's role. Minister Klever answered that the decision was within his responsibility, no advisory memo was prepared, no evidence has been provided that UNRWA funds were used in the 7 October attack, and that the deleted posts were not managed by the ministry, though most questions were answered only in part and some were declined as not appropriate to account for.
A Minister is entitled to ask civil servants for advice before decision-making (and to decide whom to ask), but is not obliged to do so.
Een Minister is bevoegd om voorafgaand aan besluitvorming advies aan ambtenaren te vragen (en te beslissen aan wie), maar is daartoe niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun voor een verklaring over UNRWA

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should sign a statement of over 100 countries recognising UNRWA's critical role for Palestinian refugees, and why it had not, and whether the government still backs the European Council's view that UNRWA's services are essential. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not sign because it disagreed with points such as UNRWA being irreplaceable, which conflicts with its wish to diversify aid channels, but stressed UNRWA's important role in Gaza; the government does stand behind the European Council conclusions.
The Netherlands could not agree with all points in the statement and therefore decided not to sign it.
Nederland kon zich niet op alle punten vinden in de verklaring en heeft daarom besloten niet mee te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Houwelingen over de status van het Duitse onderzoek naar de aanslag op Nord Stream

An FVD MP asked the Dutch Foreign Minister whether the German investigation into the Nord Stream attack will stay secret, when it will conclude, and what the Netherlands will do to find the perpetrators. The minister replied that the German government has said preliminary results will not be published to protect the investigation, that the Netherlands cannot speak for Germany and is waiting for the German findings, and that it will not speculate on the cause of the explosions.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of the investigation by the German authorities.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek van de Duitse autoriteiten af.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Wilders, Pool en De Roon over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that a German court issued an international arrest warrant against a Ukrainian suspected in the Nord Stream sabotage, and whether Ukraine might be behind it and what Dutch intelligence knew. The government declined to speculate on the German investigation's outcome, did not disclose intelligence details, and said Parliament would be informed through the usual channels.
The cabinet does not state publicly anything about the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our intelligence services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze inlichtingendiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over Nord Stream 2

MPs Kahraman and Omtzigt asked the government about the Nord Stream sabotage, prior consultations with Ukraine and Russia, MIVD warnings, Gasunie write-offs, and internal memos. The ministers answered that they await the German investigation, that no Dutch-Ukrainian consultations on Nord Stream are known for 2020-2021, that no specific government-level Nord Stream talks with Russia took place, and declined to comment on intelligence matters while promising an inventory of documents by end of September 2024.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Roon en Pool over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that President Zelensky knew of and approved the Nord Stream sabotage were accurate, and what the consequences would be. The government answered that it does not speculate on the cause of the explosions and will await the outcome of the German investigation.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and is awaiting the results of the German investigation.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘dat de Nederlandse Kustwacht de sancties tegen Rusland niet uitvoert’

An MP asked whether the Dutch Coast Guard has for over a year refused to enforce new EU sanctions against Russia, whether this undermines the sanctions packages, and what capacity and enforcement steps are planned. The minister denies any refusal, explains that capacity limits led to prioritising packages 1 to 10 and interim arrangements for package 11, and outlines reorganisation, extra analysts and EU-level tools.
There is no question of the Coast Guard refusing.
Er is geen sprake van weigering door de Kustwacht.
Antwoord op het lid Boswijk over de Ukraine Recovery Conference en de Oekraïense State Emergency Services

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Netherlands joining a gender-responsive recovery alliance for Ukraine, and about support for Ukrainian State Emergency Services and their mostly female first responders. Minister Klever confirmed Dutch membership, described existing gender-focused funding, said non-military aid focuses on humanitarian relief and the economy, and committed EUR 10 million via WHO for mental health support that also benefits SESU work.
The Netherlands funds humanitarian organisations worldwide and also provides targeted support for humanitarian action specifically in Ukraine.
Nederland financiert humanitaire organisaties wereldwijd en geeft daarnaast gerichte steun voor humanitaire actie specifiek in Oekraïne
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kamminga en Van der Burg over het bericht 'Burkina Faso volgende Afrikaanse land dat homoseksualiteit strafbaar wil maken'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that Burkina Faso plans to criminalise homosexuality and what the Netherlands is doing in response, including aid, contacts with the regime and Sahel policy. The ministers answered at length, saying the legal consequences are still unclear, that the embassy raised the issue and supports civil society indirectly, and that public statements are currently judged counterproductive, while committing to raise the issue at EU-AU level.
The cabinet will work to achieve this.
Het kabinet zal zich daarvoor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de omstreden verkiezingsuitslag in Venezuela

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister which countries recognise opposition candidate González as winner of the disputed Venezuelan election, whether US claims of 'irrefutable evidence' are accepted, why the Netherlands and EU have not explicitly recognised the opposition win, and what sanctions or support are planned. Minister Veldkamp answered that many states use careful wording, that the Netherlands and EU avoid explicit recognition to support a negotiation process, and that new EU sanctions are not currently on the table.
At this moment, the introduction of additional European restrictive measures is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is het instellen van aanvullende Europese restrictieve maatregelen niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over de implementatie van de sanctiepakketten tegen Rusland

MPs Omtzigt and Kahraman asked the ministers about the implementation of the EU sanctions packages against Russia, including whether the Coast Guard enforces them, and whether any sanctions go unenforced or incompletely implemented. The minister answered at length that all sanctions are nationally implemented via the Sanctieregeling, that the government aims for strict compliance, that the Coast Guard was agreed to prioritise packages 1 to 10 given limited capacity with alternatives found for later packages, and that implementation is a national matter with no formal notice from the Commission.
The cabinet's starting point is strict compliance with all sanctions, and the cabinet therefore does not share the view that there are measures that are not enforced.
Uitgangspunt van het kabinet is het strikt naleven van alle sancties, en het kabinet deelt dus ook niet het beeld dat er maatregelen zijn die niet gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Francesca Albanese

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese's remarks on 7 October, Netanyahu (including a Hitler comparison), and the 'Jewish lobby', and whether she can still be impartial. The minister answered that such remarks are unacceptable, that special rapporteurs act in a personal capacity, and that the Netherlands raised the matter with her in May and will do so again where needed.
Where necessary, the Netherlands will raise its concerns about the impact of certain statements again.
Waar nodig zal Nederland zorgen over de impact van bepaalde uitlatingen opnieuw opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Werf en Paternotte over het bericht dat producten van in Nederland gevestigde fabrikanten nog steeds worden aangetroffen in Russische wapens

MPs Boswijk, Van der Werf and Paternotte asked the government about reports that microchips from Dutch manufacturers such as NXP and Nexperia still appear in Russian weapons, and how this can happen despite sanctions. The minister confirms the scale of the problem, explains that diversion occurs through intermediaries in third countries, and outlines EU sanctions measures and Dutch enforcement efforts while withholding recent trade data for sensitivity reasons.
Because of the sensitivity, the cabinet makes no public statements about its current information position on Russian imports of sanctioned goods.
Omwille van de gevoeligheid doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de huidige informatiepositie rondom Russische import van gesanctioneerde goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over de olieramp door een Houthi-aanval op olietanker Chios Lion

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the potential environmental damage from a Houthi attack on the tanker Chios Lion, its effect on Operations Prosperity Guardian and Aspides, and whether the EU or Netherlands should send a cleanup vessel. The minister replied that the risk of damage was limited, no military obstruction exists, Aspides has no mandate for oil cleanup, and no EU contribution appears necessary.
Cleaning up an oil spill does not fall within the mandate of EU operation Aspides.
Het opruimen van een olievlek behoort niet tot het mandaat van EU-operatie Aspides.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de extreem lange wachttijden voor EU-ingezetenen bij de Europese grensovergangen

An MP asked the government about very long waiting times at EU external border crossings affecting EU residents, and whether it would raise the issue with the relevant countries, assess their capacity, and press for improvements in Europe. The government answered that the delays are a seasonal summer peak, that embassies received few complaints, that it sees no reason for bilateral action, and that systematic checks are necessary for Schengen security.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to raise the perceived long waiting times with the authorities concerned.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om de gepercipieerde lange wachttijden op te brengen bij de betreffende autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de vertraging in de rechtszaak rondom Tent of Nations

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the postponed court case concerning Tent of Nations and whether the government would change its stance toward Israel and continue Dutch support for Palestinian land rights. The minister answered that a new hearing is set for 12 September 2024, that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Israeli authorities, and that existing policy against settlements and land confiscation continues.
The Netherlands recently expressed its concerns to the Israeli authorities about the length of the legal process and the failure to reach a decision.
Nederland heeft recentelijk zijn zorgen uitgesproken bij de Israëlische autoriteiten over de duur van het juridische proces en het uitblijven van een besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bloedbad bij studentenprotesten in Bangladesh

Hirsch asked the ministers about the deadly crackdown on student protests in Bangladesh, its impact on stability, communication shutdowns, the bilateral relationship, and what Netherlands and EU steps are being taken. The government condemned the violence, described the situation and the EU's suspension of PCA talks, and said it is pressing for a peaceful democratic transition and independent investigation.
The Netherlands and the EU immediately strongly condemned the violence by the Bangladeshi authorities against peaceful demonstrators and called for the protection of peaceful demonstrators.
Nederland en de EU hebben het geweld van de Bangladeshi autoriteiten richting vreedzame demonstranten onmiddellijk sterk veroordeeld en opgeroepen tot bescherming van vreedzame demonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de Nederlandse diplomatieke betrekkingen met Afghanistan

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would reopen an embassy in Afghanistan, whether it had explored joint presence with Germany, how diplomats are protected, and which countries are present and what the Doha process achieved. The minister answered that reopening is not currently opportune given security and political considerations, that the Taliban's inclusion must not imply recognition, and that the Netherlands was not invited to the third Doha conference and is disappointed civil society was excluded.
At this moment the cabinet does not consider it opportune to open a diplomatic representation on the ground.
Op dit moment acht het kabinet het niet opportuun om een diplomatieke vertegenwoordiging ter plekke te openen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over het bericht 'Zeker 29 doden bij Russische aanval op Oekraïne, kinderziekenhuis in Kyiv geraakt'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and foreign ministers how the Netherlands responds to a Russian strike that hit a children's hospital in Kyiv, including whether Dutch care for injured Ukrainian children could be arranged. Minister Agema answered that Dutch care is provided through the EU Medevac route, that care is first sought within Ukraine, and that the national patient-allocation centre will screen and match patients once Ukraine requests evacuations.

Once the Ukrainian government requests medical evacuations, the National Patient Distribution Centre (LCPS) will immediately arrange screening and matching of patients with care capacity in the Netherlands.

Zodra de Oekraïense regering verzoekt om medische evacuaties, zal het Landelijk Centrum Patiëntenspreiding (LCPS) per omgaande zorgdragen voor screening en matching van patiënten met de zorgcapaciteit in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat een medeweker van de Nederlandse ambassade in Jemen is gearresteerd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Houthi authorities arrested an embassy employee in Yemen, and what is known about the reason, place of detention and contact with the employee's family and the embassy. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the employee was taken on 9 June to an unknown location without a warrant or charge, and that diplomatic means are being used for release, but declined further detail citing safety.
Given the safety of this employee and his family and the effectiveness of the effort, it is not possible to elaborate further on this.
Gelet op de veiligheid van deze medewerker en zijn familie en de effectiviteit van de inzet is het niet mogelijk hier nader over uit te wijden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Piri over het bezoek van Viktor Orbán aan Moskou

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Hungarian PM Orbán's visit to Putin in Moscow is appropriate for the EU Council presidency holder, and whether the Hungarian ambassador should be summoned. The minister answers that the visit is a strictly bilateral matter, the rotating presidency has no external competence, and the government has already publicly distanced itself without seeing a need to summon the ambassador.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to summon the Hungarian ambassador.
Het kabinet acht het daarmee niet nodig de Hongaarse ambassadeur te ontbieden.

m: Motie van het lid Crijns c.s. over maximaal inzetten op de bestrijding van illegale handel in tabaksproducten
Asks the government to do its utmost to fight illegal trade in tobacco products and to inform the Chamber periodically on progress.
requests the government to do its utmost to combat illegal trade in tobacco products and to periodically inform the Chamber on progress
verzoekt de regering zich maximaal in te zetten om de illegale handel in tabaksproducten te bestrijden, en de Kamer periodiek te informeren over de voortgang
Amendement van het lid Dekker over middelen voor een Tegenspraak Fonds
Shifts 41.4 million euro per year within the research budget to a new Tegenspraak Fonds funding dissenting researchers, with public disclosure of proposals and decisions.
The submitter proposes making 41.4 million euro available annually for this fund.
Indiener stelt voor om jaarlijks € 41,4 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen voor dit fonds.
Motie van het lid Dekker over het vormen van een coalitie van landen om duurzame vredesonderhandelingen met Rusland te bewerkstelligen
Asks the government to take the lead in forming a coalition with countries such as Germany, Italy, Hungary and Slovakia to bring about sustainable peace negotiations with Russia.
calls on the government to take the lead in forming a coalition with countries such as Germany, Italy, Hungary and Slovakia
roept de regering op om het voortouw te nemen in het vormen van een coalitie met landen als Duitsland, Italië, Hongarije en Slowakije
Motie van het lid Dekker over het inschakelen van onafhankelijke deskundigen om de bedoelingen van Rusland met het conflict in Oekraïne te doorgronden
Asks the government to seriously engage independent experts to understand Russia's intentions in the conflict in Ukraine.
calls on the government to seriously make efforts to understand Russia's considerations and intentions, engaging independent experts
roept de regering op zich serieus in te spannen om de overwegingen en bedoelingen van Rusland te doorgronden en hierbij onafhankelijke deskundigen in te schakelen
Motie van het lid Dekker over een eigen realistisch buitenlandbeleid voor Oekraïne en Rusland
Asks the government to develop an independent, realistic foreign policy on Ukraine and Russia that puts the Dutch interest first, separate from the Atlantic consensus.
calls on the government to develop, apart from the current Atlantic consensus, regarding the Russia-Ukraine problem
roept de regering op om, los van de huidige Atlantische consensus, met betrekking tot de Rusland-Oekraïneproblematiek
Motie van het lid Dekker over het EU-verbod op Russische televisiezenders opheffen voor Nederland
Motion asks the government to lift the EU ban on Russian television channels for the Netherlands and to ensure a democratic process.
requests the government to lift the EU ban on Russian television channels for the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering het EU-verbod op Russische televisiezenders op te heffen voor Nederland
Motie van het lid Dekker over stoppen met wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne en aansturen op vredesonderhandelingen met Rusland
Asks the government to stop arms deliveries to Ukraine and to pursue peace negotiations with Russia.
calls on the government to stop arms deliveries to Ukraine and to pursue peace negotiations with Russia
roept de regering op te stoppen met wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne en aan te sturen op vredesonderhandelingen met Rusland
Motie van het lid Dekker over onderzoek naar de relatie tussen Oekraïne en FTX en in de tussentijd nieuwe geldtransfers naar Oekraïne stopzetten
Asks the government to investigate the relationship between Ukraine and FTX and to halt new money transfers to Ukraine until taxpayer money is shown not to disappear.
requests the government to launch an investigation into the relationship between Ukraine and FTX and to halt new money transfers to Ukraine
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek in te stellen naar de relatie tussen Oekraïne en FTX en nieuwe geldtransfers naar Oekraïne stop te zetten
Motie van het lid Wassenberg c.s. over een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om het aantal proeven op niet-humane primaten verder te verlagen
Asks the government to commission independent experts in 2023 to study how animal testing on non-human primates can be reduced further without harming necessary research.
requests the government to commission during 2023 a study into the possibility of further reducing the number of tests on non-human primates
verzoekt de regering om in de loop van 2023 de opdracht te geven tot een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om het aantal proeven op niet-humane primaten verder te verlagen
Amendement van het lid Dekker over middelen voor een nieuw Tegenspraak Fonds
Shifts 37.5 million euro within the research budget from Matching Horizon Europe to create a Tegenspraak Fonds for dissenting scientists, with published funding decisions.
This amount is cut from the budget for Matching Horizon Europe.
Dit bedrag wordt gekort op het budget voor Matching Horizon Europe.
qa: Antwoord op van het lid Dekker over de NAVO-verplichtingen

An MP from FVD asked why briefings on NATO obligations for cabinet members were classified and not shared with parliament, who organised them, and what the NATO Resilience Objectives are and whether the government is bound by them. The Minister answered that the briefings were classified Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, that the drafters set the classification, that some briefings have been declassified on request, that the commitments are politically binding, and that the NATO Resilience Objectives are a non-public document, with some questions answered only by reference.
The NATO Resilience Objectives are set out in an underlying document that is not public.
De NAVO Resilience Objectives zijn weergegeven in een onderliggend document dat niet openbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over mogelijke beïnvloeding van Nederlandse media, NGO’s en onderzoeksinstituten

An MP from FVD asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister and the Foreign Affairs Minister about possible USAID and EU (EIB) financing of Dutch media, NGOs and research institutions, and the risk of foreign influence on opinion-making and elections. The government answered that it has no insight into USAID funding or its conditions, that media independence is governed by self-regulation and press freedom, and that it sees no reason for a study of foreign financing, while noting a broader concern about state interference in knowledge institutions.
There is currently no insight from the government into funding from USAID to Dutch, or Netherlands-oriented, media companies or NGOs.
Er is momenteel vanuit de overheid geen zicht op financiering vanuit USAID aan Nederlandse, c.q. op Nederland gerichte mediabedrijven of NGO’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over het bericht dat krakers zich een bewoond appartement in Amsterdam hebben toegeëigend

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security why squatters who took over an occupied student flat in Amsterdam were not evicted and punished immediately, and whether this sets a precedent. The Minister replied that police capacity delayed intervention, that the investigating judge authorised eviction on 29 January and the flat was cleared that day, and that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service while damages may be claimed in civil proceedings.
I do not comment, as is customary, on any possible criminal prosecution in this case. That is a responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik uit mij, zoals te doen gebruikelijk, niet over een eventueel strafrechtelijk vervolg in deze zaak. Dat is een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over het Nivel rapport inzake oversterfte en Covid-vaccinaties

An MP asked whether a Nivel report supports a claim that unvaccinated people aged 76-80 had 39 percent mortality in 2021, and why Nivel closed its X account. The Staatssecretaris answered that the report cannot support that figure because vaccination status was not reliably registered and timing varied, giving instead the 3- and 12-month mortality rates from the report, and said organisations may freely open or close accounts on X.
According to the researchers, based on the Nivel study this question cannot be answered.
Op basis van het onderzoek van het Nivel is deze vraag volgens de onderzoekers niet te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Dekker over de militaire steun aan Oekraïne

MPs Baudet and Dekker asked for an overview of Dutch military aid to Ukraine, its legal conditions, possible violations of the laws of war, Ukraine's compliance with agreements, Dutch troop involvement, and disclosure of related documents under Article 68 of the Constitution. The government answered that deliveries are donations reported in periodic letters, that no signals of misuse exist, that each delivery is vetted under EU arms export criteria with end-user certificates, and that operational security limits full public disclosure.
Operational security nonetheless remains the overriding consideration in deciding whether to inform the House publicly.
De operationele veiligheid blijft echter te allen tijde leidend in de afweging uw Kamer in het openbaar te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over de bedreiging van de academische vrijheid aan Nederlandse universiteiten

Member Dekker asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether academic freedom at Dutch universities is threatened, citing lecturer Laurens Buijs, who reports social exclusion and job loss after criticising COVID policy and diversity policy at the UvA. The Minister says such exclusion is unacceptable in principle, leaves the individual case to the UvA and its independent investigation, and denies that academic freedom is not safeguarded.
The executive board has since set up an independent committee to investigate the report.
Het college van bestuur heeft inmiddels een onafhankelijke commissie ingesteld om de melding te onderzoeken.

m: Amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. over de goedkeuring van bestuursbesluiten in de zin van artikel 2:164/274 BW door de meerderheid van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders
Requires that board decisions under the company-law approval rules be approved by a majority of non-executive directors in one-tier companies.
This amendment therefore provides that board decisions under articles 2:164/274 of the Civil Code must be approved by a majority of the non-executive directors
Dit amendement regelt derhalve dat bestuursbesluiten in de zin van artikel 2:164/274 BW goedgekeurd moeten worden door de meerderheid van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8, over het opnemen van streefcijfers voor de participatie van vrouwen in raden van bestuur en raden van commissarissen in de code Ta
Amends the Civil Code so that companies must set gender balance targets (30% each sex) for management and supervisory boards, with reporting duties.
In a balanced distribution of seats on the management board and supervisory board, at least 30% of seats are held by women
Bij een evenwichtige verdeling van de zetels van het bestuur en de raad van commissarissen wordt ten minste 30% van de zetels bezet door vrouwen
Amendement van het lid Kalma over de verruiming van het spreek- en adviesrecht van dochtermaatschappijen
Removes the requirement that a majority of employees of a group be employed in the Netherlands for works council speaking and advisory rights.
This amendment aims to widen the speaking and advisory rights of employees
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd om het spreek- en adviesrecht voor werknemers te verruimen

Amendement van het lid Weekers c.s. waarin wordt geregeld dat ook het doen van (bindende) voordrachten voor (her)benoeming van bestuurders tot de exclusieve taak van de niet-uitvoerende bestuurders za
Assigns to non-executive directors the exclusive task of making binding nominations for the appointment or reappointment of board members in one-tier company boards.
making nominations for the appointment of a director
het doen van voordrachten voor benoeming van een bestuurder
Amendement van het lid Kalma c.s. over mannen en vrouwen in raden van bestuur en raden van commissarissen
Proposes that company boards and supervisory boards aim for at least 30% of each gender when appointing members, with exemptions for certain companies.
as far as possible account is taken of a balanced distribution of seats between men and women
zoveel mogelijk rekening gehouden met een evenwichtige verdeling van de zetels over mannen en vrouwen
Motie Kalma/Halsema over een eigen onderzoeksagenda
Asks the Presidium to propose a standing annual parliamentary research agenda, including ex post implementation studies, to strengthen the House's information position against the government.
which helps strengthen its information and knowledge position relative to the government
die haar informatie- en kennispositie ten opzichte van de regering helpt versterken
Motie Halsema c.s. over opnemen van PM-post personele noden van Kamerleden, fracties en Kamer
Asks the Presidium to add a provisional budget item for the personnel support needs of MPs, parliamentary groups and the House while a study is pending.
requests the Presidium, pending the outcome of this study, to include a provisional item in the budget
verzoekt het Presidium daartoe in afwachting van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek, een PM-post op te nemen op de begroting
Motie Anker c.s. over de parlementaire hoffelijkheidstroffee
Asks the Presidium to take charge of the parliamentary courtesy trophy and its regulations and oversee its annual award.
requests the Presidium to take charge of the parliamentary courtesy trophee and its regulations
verzoekt het Presidium zich te ontfermen over de parlementaire hoffelijkheidstrofee en het bijbehorend reglement
Motie van de leden Zeedijk en Inge van Dijk over bij de bredere voortgangsbrief over de Nationale Technologiestrategie onderzoeken hoe de innovatiesubsidies gestroomlijnd kunnen worden
Asks the government to examine, in the progress letter on the National Technology Strategy, how innovation subsidies can be streamlined and prioritised.
requests the government, in the broad progress letter on the National Technology Strategy, also to examine how to streamline innovation subsidies
verzoekt de regering om bij de brede voortgangsbrief over de Nationale Technologiestrategie ook te onderzoeken hoe innovatiesubsidies te stroomlijnen
Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over een nieuw mededingingsinstrument op basis van de principes van de New Competition Tool ook in Nederland introduceren
Asks the government to introduce a New Competition Tool in the Netherlands giving the market authority ACM new powers to intervene in poorly functioning markets.
requests the government to introduce a new competition instrument based on the New Competition Tool principles in the Netherlands too
verzoekt de regering om een nieuw mededingingsinstrument op basis van de principes van de New Competition Tool ook in Nederland te introduceren
Motie van de leden Zeedijk en Dassen over voor het einde van het jaar rapporteren over doel en opzet van de coalition of the willing voor de Europese semicon-industrie
Asks the government to report to the House before year-end on the aims and design of the coalition of the willing for the European semiconductor industry.
requests the government to report to the House before the end of the year on the objective and design of this coalition of the willing
verzoekt de regering voor het einde van het jaar de doelstelling en opzet van deze coalition of the willing aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over verkennen op welke manier het Rijnlandse denken beter verankerd kan worden
Asks the government to explore how the Rhineland model of corporate governance can be better anchored in rules for listed companies.
requests the government to explore how Rhineland thinking can be better anchored
verzoekt de regering te verkennen op welke manier het Rijnlandse denken beter verankerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Martens-America c.s. over de lessen van de Beethovenaanpak gebruiken voor vernieuwing van het innovatie- en industriebeleid en de regionale economische ontwikkeling
Asks the government to apply lessons from the Beethoven approach to renewing innovation, industrial and regional economic policy.
requests the government to take the lessons of the targeted Beethoven approach and use them to renew innovation and industrial policy
verzoekt de regering de lessen van de gerichte Beethovenaanpak mee te nemen en te gebruiken voor de vernieuwing van ons innovatie- en industriebeleid
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over het "buy now, pay later"-model niet invoeren in fysieke winkels en maatregelen nemen tegen een ongelijk speelveld tussen onlinewinkels en fysieke winkels
Asks the government to ensure buy-now-pay-later is not introduced in physical shops and to address the uneven playing field between online and physical retailers.
requests the government to ensure the buy-now-pay-later model is not introduced in physical stores
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat het «buy now, pay later»-model niet wordt ingevoerd in fysieke winkels
Motie van het lid Zeedijk c.s. over een kwantitatieve vergelijking van de publieke innovatiesubsidies per sector in de VS en Azië
Asks the government to quantitatively compare public innovation subsidies per sector in the US and Asia and to examine adjusting state aid rules.
requests the government to make a quantitative comparison of public innovation subsidies per sector in the US and Asia
verzoekt de regering een kwantitatieve vergelijking te maken van de publieke innovatiesubsidies per sector in de VS en Azië
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de toepasbaarheid van resultaatfinanciering (zoals Social Impact Bonds) bij het verstrekken van subsidies en opdrachten

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about applying results-based financing such as Social Impact Bonds to subsidies and contracts, including the value of UK evidence, expertise-building, knowledge partnerships, a results fund, legislation like SIPPRA, and results-based subsidies. The minister acknowledged potential benefits and risks, deferred several questions to other ministers, and committed only to considering lessons from experience.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Zeedijk over steun aan het maatschappelijk middenveld wereldwijd

MPs Hirsch and Zeedijk asked the minister about pressure on civil society worldwide, its role in supply chains and development, and whether the Civic Space Fund will be maintained. The minister largely agreed with the concerns and described existing business-NGO cooperation, but on the Civic Space Fund and the motion-based questions referred to a letter on new policy and gave no concrete commitment.
On the new policy I have informed you in the letter Future cooperation with civil society organisations in development aid.
Over het nieuwe beleid heb ik u geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief Toekomst samenwerking met maatschappelijke organisaties in ontwikkelingshulp
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Zeedijk over het bericht «Hulpverlening aan Gaza dreigt verder in knel te komen: Israël verbiedt UNRWA»

MPs Kamminga and Zeedijk asked the minister about Israel's legislation banning UNRWA and its effects on humanitarian aid in Gaza and on Dutch funding. The minister answered that the laws threaten UNRWA's operations and aid in Gaza, that no other organisation can easily replace it, and that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 19 million remains unchanged for 2022–2025.
The cabinet's position on the annual contribution remains unchanged.
Het kabinetsstandpunt met betrekking tot de jaarlijkse bijdrage blijft onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Joseph over de berichten ‘ACM-beschuldiging van stilzwijgende kartel zit bank hoog’ en ‘Protestacties lijken ING niet te raken’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ACM findings on tacit collusion and weak competition in the Dutch savings market, including bank share buybacks, savings rates, account fees, cybersecurity costs, liquidity and credit to SMEs. The minister largely accepts the ACM diagnosis, announces studies on unbundling and fee issues, and defers many questions to banks and DNB, declining to act directly on buybacks.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who have no current account with them.
Ik ga onder meer onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de trend dat Nederlandse banken stoppen met de ondersteuning van contactloos betalen via eigen apps

MPs Six Dijkstra and Zeedijk asked the government about banks such as ING and the Volksbank dropping their own contactless payment apps in favour of Google Pay, and the consequences for privacy, digital sovereignty, and consumer choice. The Minister of Finance answered that banks set their own policy, that supervision of privacy falls under the AVG and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, that the DMA obliges Apple and Google to allow alternative payment apps, and that no general open contactless payment protocol is needed for now.
Banks conduct their own policy and decide for themselves whether they offer contactless payment via their own app or in another way.
Banken voeren hun eigen beleid en bepalen zelf of zij contactloos betalen aanbieden via een eigen app of op een andere manier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk-Raeven en Hertzberger over de Kamerbrief 29338-276 over het Nationaal Versterkingsplan van Micro-chiptalent als reactie op het advies van speciaal gezant microchipindustrie Dhr. H.

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about how the Nationaal Versterkingsplan Microchip-talent allocates funds across regions, including consultation with regions, the Beethoven-motion compliance, selection of regions, training numbers, and whether Twente, Groningen and Limburg receive fair shares. The Minister answered all 17 questions, explaining that regional plans exceeded the budget and failed to show delivery to industry, that allocation follows industry hiring practices concentrated in Brainport, and that revised plans are due by 29 September.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Palmen over de artikelen 'Zeventig plekken in Limburg erbij voor woonwagenbewoners, maar die zijn er lang niet allemaal blij mee: ‘Lijkt op chantage'' en 'Rechter oordeelt dat G

MPs Zeedijk and Palmen asked the minister about press reports on new caravan pitches in Limburg and a court ruling that The Hague discriminates against caravan dwellers, and about antiziganism, the value of caravan camps, federal monitoring and a standplaatsenbeleid vision with municipalities. The minister answered that antiziganism and structural obstacles slow pitch creation, that the government is monitoring development and supporting municipalities, and that a 2018 policy framework was delivered in response to the Ombudsman.
The stigma must therefore be combated, because discrimination is not permitted.
Het stigma dient dan ook bestreden te worden, omdat discriminatie niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Zeedijk over het Convenant Rijk en regio investeringen in ondernemingsklimaat microchipsector

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Rijk-regio convenant on investments in the microchip sector in the Brainport region, covering signing status, private contributions, talent funding, housing, energy and nitrogen capacity. The minister answered that the convenant is pending parliamentary and provincial approval, that the €1.6bn 2022 package excluded talent funding, and that several details (distribution, private contributions, risk allocation, housing shares) remain to be agreed later.
The agreements in the convenant are, for the central government, subject to approval by the Staten-Generaal.
De afspraken in het convenant zijn voor het Rijk onder voorbehoud van instemming door de Staten-Generaal
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Zeedijk over de Nationale Circulaire Plastic

MPs Olger van Dijk and Zeedijk asked the government about the planned recyclate blending norm for plastics, its EU alignment, competitive effects, recyclate supply and certification. The minister answered that the norm bill is still under review after consultation, that the EU is advancing product-specific recyclate requirements, and that EUR 267 million in subsidies is available, while many questions were deferred to a new cabinet or later regulations.
The decision to be based on this is for the new cabinet.
Het hierop te baseren besluit is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de Chinese cyberaanvallen op Nederlandse Kamerleden

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the government about Chinese cyberattacks on Dutch MPs and on journalists, activists and businesses, including the APT31 group, and whether state secrets or information from Dutch politicians were obtained. The government answered that it cannot discuss the methods and knowledge of the intelligence services in public, referred to the public threat reports, and said it shares concerns and raised them with Chinese authorities.
The working methods and level of knowledge of the intelligence and security services are not discussed in public.
Er wordt in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Zeedijk over het artikel 'Intrekken exportvergunning nieuwe tegenslag ASML'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about reports that export licences for ASML lithography machines to China were withdrawn, including whether US pressure was involved, how many licences were issued, and the defence risks. The minister declined to comment on individual licences, said licensing is assessed case by case on end-use risk, confirmed only a few licences for advanced semiconductor equipment to China have been granted, and gave no details on US contacts.
The cabinet does not comment on individual licences.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de Nederlandse deelname aan de IPCEI-regeling voor cloudtechnologie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Dutch participation in the IPCEI scheme for next-generation cloud technology, including the cloud value chain, market concentration, sovereignty, and governance of the EUR 70 million. The minister answered that the scheme serves European innovation and autonomy, that Dutch projects were selected through criteria and monitored by RVO, and that a purely Dutch sovereign cloud service is not the aim.
The cabinet informed parliament on 21 September 2021 about the planned Dutch participation in the IPCEI CIS and the decision to make EUR 70 million available for Dutch projects.

Het kabinet heeft op 21 september 2021 (Prinsjesdag) uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen Nederlandse deelname aan het Important Project of Common European Interest Next Generation Cloud Infrastructure and Services (IPCEI CIS) en de beslissing hiervoor 70 miljoen euro ten behoeve van Nederlandse projecten beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder en Grinwis over de oproep voor effectievere ondersteuning van mensen met hoge energiekosten via het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

MPs Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder and Grinwis asked about the G4 call to support high-energy-cost households via the Temporary Emergency Energy Fund (TNE) and whether a publicprivate route can be revived this winter. The State Secretary answers that private co-financing fell short, so the route is not responsible; instead €30 million goes via the Municipal Fund to existing local services, with no direct income support, citing legal and state-aid risks.
It has been established that it is not feasible to realise a public-private construction this coming winter.
Er is geconstateerd dat het niet haalbaar is om aankomende winter een publiek-private constructie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht “Arbeidsmigrant heeft vaker ongeluk op de werkvloer. Weinig aandacht voor arbeidsveiligheid”

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about the higher accident rate among migrant workers, flexible employment, language barriers, unclear responsibility between employment agency and employer, and enforcement by the Labour Inspectorate. The government acknowledges the disproportionate accident rate, points to planned measures such as a reporting obligation for temp agencies and the Arbovisie 2040, and promises a full response to the Safety Board report by year-end.
As promised at the parliamentary committee debate on labour migration on 11 September, a response to the OVV report on the safety of migrant workers will follow before the end of the year.

Zoals toegezegd bij het commissiedebat Arbeidsmigratie op 11 september jongstleden zal er voor het einde van het jaar een reactie komen op het rapport van de OVV over de veiligheid van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden van Baarle en Ergin over het rapport ‘Tussen Minaret en Ministerie’ Ministerie’

Two DENK MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers how the government will restore trust among mosque boards and Muslim communities after the 'Tussen Minaret & Ministerie' report, and whether it will apologise, ban discriminatory policy, appoint a national coordinator against anti-Muslim hatred and hold structured dialogue. The government answered that rebuilding trust is needed and it is pursuing dialogue, a discrimination test in the Beleidskompas, and periodic talks with Muslim organisations, but it declined a separate anti-Muslim-hatred coordinator in favour of a single coordinator for all discrimination grounds.

Nevertheless, the cabinet considers it desirable that the other grounds of discrimination be housed in a single institute, so that fragmentation of attention and approach to these grounds is prevented.
Desalniettemin acht het kabinet het wenselijk dat de overige discriminatiegronden bij één instituut belegd worden, zodat versnippering van de aandacht en aanpak van deze gronden voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toekenning van de extra middelen voor het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked how the €50 million amendment for the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie would be implemented, how many of the 227,000 applications could now be honoured, what budget remains, and whether the amendment would be carried out in 2025 respecting parliament's budget right. The government replied that adding public money to the private-public fund is legally and financially risky, so it is exploring whether the €50 million can go to a planned public energy fund under the Social Climate Fund instead, and that nearly all of the €56.3 million has been paid out.
It is being explored whether the €50 million can be added to the available funds for the planned public energy fund supporting households with their energy bills.
Er wordt verkend of de € 50 miljoen kan worden toegevoegd aan de beschikbare middelen voor het te ontwikkelen publieke energiefonds voor de ondersteuning van huishoudens op de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over verduurzaming van huurwoningen en energiearmoede, zie 'Energiearmoede steeg vorig jaar fors door stopzetten steunmaatregelen'

An MP asked the government about agreements with private landlords on home insulation, annual insulation numbers for housing corporations and private landlords, how to speed up renovation, phase-out timing for low energy labels, tenants' options to push landlords, progress on a motion about nature permits, and funding for an energy-poverty fund. The minister answered that no performance agreements exist with private landlords, that a 2012 covenant missed its target, outlined planned minimum energy requirements from 2029, a support package for private landlords, and that the public energy fund could be operational by late 2026 with funding subject to a new cabinet.
The cabinet has decided, subject to approval by the European Commission, to use €174.5 million from the SCF funds for a public energy fund to be set up.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, onder voorbehoud van goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie, uit de middelen voor het SCF € 174,5 miljoen in te zetten voor het in te richten publiek energiefonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikkers over het aantal mannen in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary whether the falling number of male childcare workers is caused by parental distrust, and what is being done to attract men. The state secretary replied that men's share has risen from 4.5 percent in 2010 to 6.4 percent in 2024, that existing safeguards protect children, and that no new specific action is planned beyond the existing recruitment campaign.
First, I want to point out that there is no decline in the number of men in childcare, but rather an increase.
Allereerst wil ik benoemen dat er geen sprake is van een teruglopend aantal mannen in de kinderopvang, maar juist een stijgend aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Burg over ‘anti-emancipatoire beïnvloeding’

MPs Becker and Van der Burg asked about foreign lobby and funding aimed at influencing Dutch public and political debate on anti-emancipatory themes, including US, Russian and Islamic-linked funding, and what the government will do. The government answered that lobbying is legitimate but that incitement and discrimination are not, pointed to the Nationale Extremismestrategie, said it has no legal basis to map funding flows from most countries, noted the pending Wtmo law as a possible tool, and said it is willing to raise the issue in the EU.
The ministries have no legal basis for processing personal data in addressing problematic conduct and unwanted foreign financing.
De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikkers en De Kort over het artikel ‘Gemeente Amsterdam gaat groep bijstandsgezinnen ‘zomaar’ extra geld geven’

MPs Bikkers and De Kort asked the State Secretary about Amsterdam giving unconditional monthly gifts to welfare families in a Kansfonds research project, questioning fairness, the Participatiewet, and the Gemeentewet. The State Secretary answered that the research fits within Participatiewet limits, is privately funded, is temporary, and that the government wants simpler municipal poverty schemes while noting gifts up to EUR 1,200 per year may be exempted.
Because the municipality of Amsterdam does not pay out the gift and the gift is part of a temporary study, there is no question of income policy.
Doordat gemeente Amsterdam de gift niet uitkeert en de gift onderdeel is van een tijdelijk onderzoek, is er geen sprake van inkomenspolitiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Kröger over “het sluiten van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie”

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about the closure of the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie after a rush of applications, technical problems, and the mandatory DigiD requirement. The State Secretary acknowledged the frustration and access problems, but said no additional public or third-party funds were available, the fund had to close, and a DigiD was required to verify income.
To prevent administrative risks, the central government can only contribute funds when third parties also contribute more than one third of the total sum.
Het Rijk kan om bestuurlijke risico's te voorkomen enkel middelen inleggen wanneer derde partijen ook meer dan één derde van de totale som financieel bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Klikken over uitkeringsfraude? Dat kan in steeds meer gemeenten, maar ook kritiek neemt toe'

MPs Van Kent and Van Nispen (SP) asked whether municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for welfare benefits should be curbed, given reports of harm to citizens and social trust. The State Secretary defended municipal discretion over hotlines, said they yield useful signals and that investigations include hearing rights, and rejected a ban while answering several questions only in general terms.
So I will not introduce a ban on the hotlines.
Ik ga dus geen verbod invoeren op de meldpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op gebedsrituelen op het Cobbenhagenlyceum

An MP asked the government whether a Tilburg secondary school's refusal to allow prayer during breaks violates religious freedom and equal treatment law. The State Secretary answered that the school denies any prayer ban, that a special school may require adherence to its denominational principles under the Awgb, and that the Inspectorate and courts, not the government, would assess compliance, so no new measures are planned.
These bodies will assess case by case whether the school's policy is indeed in line with the law.
Deze instanties zullen van geval tot geval beoordelen of het beleid van de school inderdaad in overeenstemming is met de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Financiële les op school moet toenemende schulden bij jongeren tegengaan'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about rising youth debt, financial literacy in schools, BNPL regulation, and the link between unpaid health insurance and benefit timing. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing financial education subsidies and debt-prevention measures, said BNPL rules will tighten with the CCDII implementation, and committed to a study on harmonising payment dates.
The Ministry of SZW will therefore commission a study in the coming months into harmonising payment dates.
Het Ministerie van SZW gaat daarom in de komende maanden een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar het harmoniseren van betaalmomenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het opzetten van een kaasfabriek in Marokko met Nederlandse subsidies voor deradicalisering

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked about alleged misuse of Dutch deradicalisation and integration subsidies by Rotterdam foundations, including funding a cheese factory in Morocco, and about the status of prosecution, recovery claims, and radicalisation oversight. The minister answered that the OM prosecuted fraud by the foundations via penal orders, that information sharing with Rotterdam was limited to what the OM judged appropriate, that recovery is limited by a five-year term, and described current prevention policy and evaluation tools.
The OM is currently in discussion with the municipality to determine which information can be shared.
Momenteel is het OM met de gemeente in gesprek om te bezien welke informatie wel kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over ‘schuldhulpverlening’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the limited effectiveness of debt relief, the role of municipalities, the lack of a central national approach, and measures to reduce problematic debt. The government replied that its policy agenda (basisdienstverlening, Nationaal Programma Armoede en Schulden, extra funding) will be detailed in spring 2025, and largely pointed to existing measures and municipal responsibility.
The cabinet sees it as its responsibility to work on reducing the number of people with problematic debts.
Het kabinet ziet het als haar verantwoordelijkheid om in te zetten op het terugdringen van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers about the handling of earlier written questions on the risk of female genital mutilation and incitement to it in a religious context, including OM prosecution, KMAR indicators, online monitoring, reporting channels and prevention campaigns. The government answered that the OM did not appeal, that prosecutions have not increased, that online monitoring is not actively done by the ministry, that reporting goes to police or Veilig Thuis, and that a campaign was evaluated as successful and extended, with a further advice-duty study completed and information promised for 2025.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities relating to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about enforcement and prevention of female genital mutilation (FGM), including whether the OM appealed a case, whether online calls for FGM are monitored, and whether reporting points and campaigns exist. The government answered that no appeal was lodged, enforcement is police and platform responsibility, reporting channels such as Veilig Thuis exist, and prevention campaigns and a parental declaration are in place, though no evaluation of some measures has been done.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities related to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Tseggai en Lahlah over het bericht 'Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los', en het verzoek van het lid Timmermans om een brief te o

MPs Timmermans, Tseggai and Lahlah asked the cabinet whether it still stands by its statement that no opinions of people with a migration background would be recorded, given the Becker motion requiring research into people with a migration background, and how this fits with the non-discrimination principle. The cabinet answered that the SCP research will cover the whole population without distinguishing by migration background, that it sees no break in cabinet policy, and that it will consider how to provide the requested information within legal frameworks.
The cabinet observes no break in the unity of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet constateert geen breuk in de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over Wereldstotterdag

An MP asked the cabinet about stuttering in the labour market, including a reported case of a UWV Werkbedrijf job-seeker told not to stutter, the banenafspraak target group register, and public campaigns. The government acknowledged the difficulties, pointed to a broader equal-opportunities approach, a future vision for the banenafspraak, the Whispp speech technology pilot, and no planned public campaigns.
At this moment there are no planned public campaigns.
Op dit moment zijn er geen voorgenomen publiekscampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de toenemende discriminatie tegen moslims

An MP asked ministers about rising discrimination against Muslims, citing an EU survey showing 55% of Dutch Muslims report discrimination, and about school discrimination, national anti-discrimination policy, and training measures. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a forthcoming national study on Muslim discrimination, outlined the division of responsibilities across ministries, and referred to existing programmes and a future action plan without committing to new binding measures.
On the basis of the findings of the study, it will be considered which specific additional measures can be taken to prevent discrimination against Muslims.
Op grond van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien welke specifieke maatregelen aanvullend getroffen kunnen worden om moslimdiscriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Incassobureaus overtreden de wet: ‘Zorgelijk’’

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked about reports that debt collection agencies break the law, how many were inspected, and what the government will do for affected debtors and whether enforcement can start earlier. The government answered that the Inspectorate visited 11 agencies but cannot disclose violation details, that the inspectorate is independent and will keep a information-and-encouragement approach until 2025, and that the minister cannot direct enforcement.
It is up to the Inspectorate JenV to publish, if legally possible, how it shapes its supervision of debt collection agencies and which violations it finds.
Het is aan de Inspectie JenV om (indien juridisch mogelijk) te publiceren over hoe zij het toezicht op incassodienstverleners vormgeeft en welke overtredingen zij daarbij constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Welzijn over de vermogensgrenzen voor lokale kwijtscheldingen

MPs Lahlah and Welzijn asked about the asset limits for local tax exemptions after a Council of State ruling that municipalities must follow national rules even when they want to allow beneficiaries a savings buffer. The minister acknowledged the wish for a buffer, noted the existing €2,000 allowance, and said a study on raising the asset limit is underway, with the Chamber to be informed before the budget debate.
I am now having a study carried out, partly in response to the amended motion by Palmen and Mohandis, into the questions in that motion and the policy issues.
Ik laat nu, mede naar aanleiding van de Nader gewijzigde motie van de leden Palmen en Mohandis 5 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de vragen uit deze motie en de beleidsvraagstukken
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het rapport ‘Onbekend talent op de arbeidsmarkt: Monitor ‘Toegankelijkheid, inclusie en de arbeidsmarkt 2025’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a monitor report showing low labour participation of people with disabilities, their absence from small firms and management roles, and low awareness of support schemes. The State Secretary acknowledges the gap, lists existing initiatives (Breed Offensief, Banenafspraak, Werkcentra, handreiking beschut werk) and promises a further agenda on inclusive employment before summer 2026, but places primary responsibility for change on employers and does not commit to new binding measures.
I would like to work on a positive and realistic picture of the opportunities and possibilities of people with disabilities in the workplace.
Ik wil graag werken aan een positief en realistisch beeld over de kansen en mogelijkheden van mensen met een beperking op de werkvloer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over ‘het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie’

An MP asks the State Secretary about the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund, including whether it is enough to prevent energy poverty, how much aid households get, and whether those without a prior application can get help. The State Secretary answers that a broader approach is in place, that €30 million goes to municipalities via a decentralised grant rather than per-household aid, that a public energy fund is planned, and that municipalities decide who qualifies.
It is currently not known whether these scenarios accurately reflect the actual situation in 2025.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend of deze scenario’s de werkelijke situatie in 2025 goed weergeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het artikel “William uit Aadorp werd ziek door werk bij Defensie, toch wordt zijn claim afgewezen”

An MP asks whether the TSB occupational disease compensation scheme still requires a sensitisation test, how many claims were filed and refused, and how previously rejected applicants are informed of the rule change. The State Secretary confirms a diagnosis from a doctor is generally accepted, explains that the sensitisation test is needed to link an allergen to the workplace and is covered by a temporary pilot, reports about 900 claims with 34% of assessed claims granted, and states that previously rejected applicants were already contacted in writing.
Yes, I am aware of this article.
Ja, ik ben bekend met dit artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Noodpakket vaak te duur voor mensen in armoede, ze hebben die spullen nu al dagelijks nodig'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the state secretary whether government emergency-preparedness campaigns on emergency kits are fair to low-income households and how resilience policy will reach the most vulnerable. The state secretary answered that the campaign is voluntary and low-cost, that alternatives such as shared kits and local support are being examined, and that a broad evaluation will not specifically cover emergency kits.
The emergency kit is not specifically named for that reason because it involves tailored provision.
Het noodpakket wordt om die reden niet specifiek benoemd omdat sprake is van maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Becker over het bericht ‘Islamisering van het Westen’

An MP asked the government about a Turkish religious authority's call for a worldwide jihad, whether mosque organisations linked to it should distance themselves, and whether government support should be withdrawn if they do not. The government condemned the calls, said ISN assured it rejects them, and stated that organisations inciting violence should not receive state support, while promising further information on a foreign-funding ban and an investigation into organisations threatening the democratic legal order.

Organisations that act in violation of the law or generally accepted social values, such as discriminatory conduct or expressing extremist and hate-inciting calls, should under no circumstances receive government support.

Organisaties die in strijd handelen met de wet of algemeen maatschappelijk aanvaarde waarden, zoals discriminerend handelen of het uiten van extremistische en haat zaaiende oproepen, horen onder geen beding overheidssteun te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over ‘correspondentie inzake versterkte gebedsoproepen buurtonderzoek’

The MP asks the State Secretary to release the full correspondence and any neighbourhood study concerning the government's trajectory on amplified call-to-prayer (versterkte gebedsoproepen). The State Secretary declines to release the full correspondence for now, citing business-sensitive information about the contractor relationship and promising to publish the rest after the trajectory ends, and states that the dialogues are not a neighbourhood study so none can be released.
The full correspondence on the trajectory surrounding the amplified call-to-prayer cannot yet be shared by me at this stage.
De volledige correspondentie over het traject rondom de versterkte gebedsoproepen kan ik in deze fase nog niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht '2325 schuldeisers, tienduizenden gedupeerden en miljoenen euro’s verdwenen: dit is het verhaal van Groupcard'

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how the government responds to reports that the curator found serious governance and administrative failures at Groupcard, leaving municipalities and thousands of beneficiaries out of pocket, and what will prevent repetition and provide compensation. The state secretary acknowledges the seriousness, says the state is not a creditor, and places contracting and compensation responsibility with municipalities, while sharing guidance on tax and benefit treatment of compensation payouts.
It is the responsibility and competence of municipalities to shape municipal poverty policy.
Het behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid van gemeenten om vorm te geven aan het gemeentelijk armoedebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over correspondentie Catshuissessie moslimdiscriminatie

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs to release the full correspondence received after a Catshuis session on Muslim discrimination, including messages from participants who described feeling ill and felt politicians present facilitated anti-Muslim hatred. The State Secretary refused, arguing the messages were shared in confidence and publication would undermine citizens' trust in contacting ministers.
Therefore I do not consider it desirable to make the correspondence you requested public.
Daarom acht ik het niet wenselijk om de door u gevraagde correspondentie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de toepassing van de kostendelersnorm

The MP asks the State Secretary about uneven municipal use of discretion (maatwerk) under the kostendelersnorm, including national guidelines, monitoring, financial neutrality, complaints, and fairness for vulnerable groups. The State Secretary answers that maatwerk is governed by article 18 of the Participatiewet and that municipalities bear responsibility, declines to monitor or create new national guidelines, points to ongoing revision work and a study due March 2026, and says complaints go through existing objection and appeal routes.
There are no signals known to me that municipalities deviate from this.
Er zijn bij mij geen signalen bekend dat gemeenten hiervan afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht: 'Circis doceert al 40 jaar Nederlands aan nieuwkomers: 'Taaleisen mogen écht verder omhoog''

An MP from the VVD asks the Secretary of State about reports that integration learners are increasingly tested at A2 rather than B1 and whether the Wet Inburgering 2021 has become easier, including the Z-route that allows completion without an exam. The government admits some learners drop to A2, defends the B1 target and the Z-route, announces a plan to allow up to 200 language hours at the workplace, and promises a naturalisation test consultation and further talks with teachers.
Exact figures on the language levels achieved by cohorts of integration learners under the Wi2021 cannot yet be provided.
Exacte cijfers over het behaalde taalniveaus van (cohorten) inburgeraars onder de Wet inburgering 2021 (Wi2021), zijn nog niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Gesol met kinderopvang verdient geen schoonheidsprijs'

MP Inge van Dijk asks the State Secretary about reported concerns that free childcare plans, combined with staff shortages and a planned DAEB (services of general economic interest) regime, could reduce availability, deter investment and sidestep sector consultation. The State Secretary answers that the DAEB is needed to avoid unlawful state aid, commits to an independent study and impact analysis this autumn, and confirms the new system is postponed to 2029 with continued sector involvement.
The cabinet has decided it does not want to run the risk of unlawful state aid and informed the House of this by letter on 15 September.
Het kabinet heeft besloten het risico op ongeoorloofde staatssteun niet te willen lopen en heeft uw Kamer daar op 15 september per brief over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de oproep van de Kinderombudsman inzake kinderarmoede
