An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the Children's Ombudsman's call for an integrated approach to child poverty, including structural support, national guidelines for municipalities, child participation, debt prevention and monitoring. The government answered that it shares the integrated approach, points to ongoing exploratory work with VNG and Divosa, and promises updates in the NPAS progress report in early 2026.
Progress will be reported to the House in the first NPAS progress report in early 2026.
Over de voortgang wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd in de eerste voortgangsrapportage van het NPAS begin 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht ‘Van Mediamarkt-bonnen tot ‘spookcursisten’: zo werkte ingenieuze miljoenenoplichting’

An MP asked the State Secretary how malicious language schools could receive millions in public funds for years without oversight, and what is being done about inspections, affected learners and prevention. The State Secretary acknowledged the fraud under the old loan system, described intensified inspections and new controls, and stated that the new system and existing oversight bodies are sufficient, though no figures on affected learners are available.
I have no insight into the numbers. Those affected have mostly not reported themselves.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de aantallen. Gedupeerden hebben zich veelal niet gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht dat bijna 1 op de 3 mensen in armoede problematische schulden heeft

An MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about CBS data showing nearly one in three people in poverty have problematic debts, and about the policy response and the reach of debt relief. The State Secretary acknowledges the figures, attributes the rise partly to resumed tax collection and business payment deferral ending, and points to the National Programme on Poverty and Debt, debt-relief reforms and early-warning measures, without accepting that current policy is ineffective.
The cabinet considers it important to help people with financial worries and to reduce the consequences of poverty and debt problems.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om mensen met geldzorgen te helpen en de gevolgen van armoede- en schuldenproblematiek te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Ergin over de voortgangsbrief Actieagenda Integratie en Open en Vrije Samenleving

An MP from DENK asked the state secretary about the need to regulate amplified calls to prayer, the planned baseline survey and data collection on mosques, and whether other religious denominations are covered. The state secretary answered that a survey of municipalities is underway to map experienced problems, that proposals will follow in early 2026, that municipalities hold the data and regulatory powers, and that the survey also covers other religious amplified sounds.
This data, including the number of mosques using amplified calls to prayer and how often, should be known to the municipalities where those mosques are located.

Deze gegevens, waaronder het aantal moskeeën dat gebruikmaakt van de versterkte gebedsoproep en de frequentie daarvan, zouden bij de gemeenten waarin de betreffende moskeeën zijn gevestigd bekend moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over tegengaan van versnippering in regelgeving en hulp bij armoede en schulden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reducing fragmentation in rules, counters and access to help for poverty and debt, including a pilot with a single coordinator, work incentives in debt relief, relapse prevention, use of experiential experts, and monitoring of bureaucracy. The government answered that it pursues integrated debt and poverty policy, simplification of income support and minimum-income rules, a national debt-help entry point, and aftercare, while declining a dedicated monitoring of regulatory burden and promising a progress report in Q1 2026 on possible pilots.
The cabinet is pursuing simplification of the income support system, easier access to help, simpler poverty policy and a strengthened debt assistance service.

Het kabinet zet in op het vereenvoudigen van het stelsel van inkomensondersteuning, het eenvoudiger maken van de toegang tot hulp, het eenvoudiger maken van het armoedebeleid en het versterken van de schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Bedrijf achter lokale cadeaupassen failliet: ‘Tienduizenden mensen geld kwijt’’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Groupcard, the firm behind local gift cards used by municipalities, covering questions on affected municipalities, procurement, oversight by DNB, recovery of funds and whether poverty policy should be outsourced. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for their own poverty policy and procurement, that the curator is investigating causes and that DNB cannot comment on individual institutions, while giving little concrete detail.
I do not have an overview of the municipalities affected by this bankruptcy and of the amounts involved.
Ik heb geen overzicht van gemeenten die door dit faillissement geraakt zijn en om welke bedragen het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de Z-route inburgering

An MP asks the state secretary about the share of integration trainees placed in the Z-route (around 29 percent in 2024, against an expected maximum of 15 percent), whether eligibility is loosened, how eligibility is checked, and whether the route allows avoidance of language requirements. The state secretary confirms the figures, denies loosening of criteria, describes the intake and feasibility test, and commits to further monitoring and to examining municipal application in the upcoming evaluation.
I therefore closely monitor this development.
Ik houd daarom deze ontwikkeling nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel 'Uitslag proefprocedure: gemeente mag bij beslag op bijstand niet maandelijks afdragen'

An MP asks the government to respond to a court ruling that municipalities may not pay garnished welfare benefits monthly to bailiffs, and questions why monthly deductions are still used given the extra costs. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case, states that holiday allowance is normally paid annually, that municipalities must weigh interests carefully, and that the VNG guidance will be discussed and possibly revised.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to a judicial ruling in an individual case.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op een rechterlijk oordeel in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht “Vluchtelingen die niet op tijd inburgeren mogen geen boete krijgen, zegt Raad van State”

An MP asked the State Secretary how the Council of State ruling that fines for late integration by refugees breach EU law affects the Civic Integration Act 2021, which alternatives are being developed, and when the House will be informed. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, stated DUO has stopped imposing and collecting such fines and loans for asylum status holders, and said a stick behind the door is still needed, with a letter to the House expected in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House further in October.
Ik verwacht de Tweede Kamer in oktober nader te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Het uitbesteden van schuldhulpverlening kan burgers juist chaos opleveren: 'Na anderhalf jaar was geen enkele schuld afgelost''

MP Ceder asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Trouw report that outsourcing debt assistance to private firms causes delays and unequal access, including Nationale ombudsman concerns and possible malpractice. The State Secretary largely rejected the link between outsourcing and stagnation, said responsibility stays with municipalities, pointed to the basic service agreements, and saw no reason to increase budgets or commission comparative research.
The Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment does not keep data per municipality on how debt assistance is organised.
Het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid houdt geen gegevens bij per gemeente van hoe de schuldhulpverlening is ingericht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Dral en Bikkers over het bericht 'Gokken, alcohol, drugs: verslavingsproblemen nemen toe bij noodlijdende ondernemers'

MPs Kisteman, Dral and Bikkers asked the ministers whether the government is aware of rising addiction among distressed entrepreneurs, whether there are regional or sectoral differences, and what measures and municipal support are planned. Minister Karremans answered that addiction among entrepreneurs is not registered separately and no national figures exist, pointed to existing debt-support programmes and municipal efforts, and committed to exploring with municipalities and other partners how support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Yes. I will explore with municipalities, trade organisations and care partners whether, and if so how, support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Ja. Ik ga samen met gemeenten, brancheorganisaties en zorgpartijen verkennen of, en zo ja, hoe de ondersteuning van ondernemers met meervoudige problematiek structureel versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht 'School voor asielzoekers en statushouders sluit: ‘Terug naar de eenzaamheid’

An MP asked the State Secretary about the closure of a Deventer school for asylum seekers and status holders, the Iedereen aan Boord initiative, and whether language lessons should start from day one for asylum seekers. The government answered that it supports early language and labour-market integration, cites existing programmes (VrIP, Meedoenbalies, basic Dutch training), and states that municipalities decide which initiatives to partner with.
The possibilities for services aimed at guiding asylum seekers from reception towards work are being investigated.
De mogelijkheden voor dienstverlening met het oog op toeleiding naar werk voor asielzoekers vanuit de opvang, worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het publiceren van lijst met vermeende fraudeurs door de gemeente Zaanstad

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the municipality of Zaanstad publishing a list of people owing Participatiewet debts, including whether the privacy regulator's advice was obtained only after publication and whether the measure is proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the list concerns established debts of people unreachable by the municipality, that the municipality's legal review found a legal basis, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the competent supervisor and is investigating, and that no national guidelines are needed beyond existing GDPR proportionality rules.
It is up to the AP as supervisor to form a judgment on whether privacy legislation and the protection of personal data were sufficiently observed.
Het is aan de AP als toezichthouder om een oordeel te vormen of de privacywetgeving en de bescherming van persoonsgegevens voldoende in acht zijn genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over het onderzoek ‘Met een schone lei beginnen. Onderzoek naar schulden bij slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting’ en het bericht ‘Slachtoffers uitbuiting blijven vaak met

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about a study on debts of victims of sexual exploitation and whether victims of trafficking are actually compensated through criminal or civil proceedings and the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The Secretary of State answered that the Netherlands meets its Council of Europe obligations, cited figures on compensation measures and Schadefonds applications, acknowledged obstacles such as courts declaring victim claims inadmissible, and pointed to planned improvements and a forthcoming Meerjarenagenda Slachtofferbeleid.
The Judiciary has no information on the full amount awarded or how many applications were rejected.
De Rechtspraak heeft geen informatie over het volledige toegekende bedrag of hoeveel aanvragen zijn afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Zaanstad publiceert lijst met vermeende bijstandsfraudeurs'

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Zaanstad's publication of a list of alleged welfare fraudsters was proportionate, and what steps preceded it, including privacy and child-harm concerns. The State Secretary answered that all prior attempts at contact were exhausted, that the approach fits current law, that the municipality requested AP advice, and that national privacy frameworks are unnecessary because such weighing is case-specific.
I consider it desirable that such a step is taken with care and that account is taken of the consequences of publication for the people concerned.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat het zetten van een dergelijke stap zorgvuldig gebeurt en dat daarbij rekening wordt gehouden met de gevolgen van publicatie voor de mensen die het aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het incasso- en invorderingsstelsel

Ceder (ChristenUnie) asks the State Secretaries about the debt collection system, including the VNG proposals, follow-up to earlier motions, the cost of government collection, and the Wet kwaliteit incassodienstverlening (WKI). The government says it is implementing measures such as a collective payment plan and a duty of care for bailiffs, promises further research and an evaluation, and reports on registrations and possible unregistered collectors.
I see a lot of overlap between the VNG's proposals and the cabinet's ambitions.
Ik zie veel overlap in de voorstellen van de VNG en de ambities van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haage over EHBO-certificering in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary about replacing the list of approved child first-aid certificates in childcare with end-attainment criteria, and whether quality can be guaranteed. The State Secretary confirmed the list will be dropped to reduce regulatory burden, that no government quality control or practical verification will apply, and that an alternative sector proposal for stricter certifier requirements will not be adopted, though the sector may introduce its own keurmerk.
This concerns a change at the level of a ministerial regulation, for which the law does not provide for parliamentary involvement.
Het betreft een wijziging op het niveau van een ministeriële regeling, waarvoor de wet niet in parlementaire betrokkenheid voorziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over “het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie slecht bereikbaar voor huishoudens'”

SP MPs Van Kent and Dijk asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was hard to reach, with queues and overloaded systems, and whether applicants in need could be excluded. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems and regretted that eligible households were turned away, but said the fund was closed due to its limited budget, that the Rijk will not add money, and that a future public energy fund will be developed under the Social Climate Fund.
I deeply regret when residents have called upon it in vain, or were too late, while they do belong to the target group.
Ik betreur ten zeerste als bewoners tevergeefs een beroep hebben gedaan, of te laat waren, terwijl zij wel tot de doelgroep behoren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over “de aanhoudende problemen van gedupeerde Groningers met het kwijtraken van toeslagen of kwijtschelding en extra belastingheffingen als gevolg van de schadevergoe

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked why Groningen residents still lose benefits, allowances or remission and face extra tax after receiving damage compensation, and what steps will be taken. The government answers that fiscal consequences should be avoided, that IMG and NCG can compensate where unavoidable, that several measures and ongoing talks are underway, and that communication and some rules (e.g. Participatiewet exemptions) are being improved, while declining to answer in time for the debate.
As already indicated in the letter of 28 October 2024, we have also taken a number of measures to prevent fiscal consequences as much as possible.
Zoals al in de brief van 28 oktober 2024 aangegeven, 3 hebben wij hiernaast nog een aantal maatregelen getroffen om fiscale gevolgen zo veel mogelijk te voorkomen, waaronder:
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de stijging van jongeren en mannen in de bijstand

MP Paulusma asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the rise in young people and men on social assistance, including a possible labour-market mismatch, the 2026 municipal fund cut and the Borstlap advice. The State Secretary acknowledges the rise, cites several possible causes, points to existing and planned measures such as Participatiewet in balans and Van school naar duurzaam werk, and says a fuller policy review will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
The cabinet wants to help as many people who can work into work as possible.
Het kabinet wil zoveel mogelijk mensen die kunnen werken aan het werk helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Gemeenten willen kwetsbare jongeren leefgeld geven, maar botsen met de wet’

An MP asked the state secretary whether a municipal pilot giving vulnerable young people living allowances (the Bouwdepot approach) should be allowed and scaled up, and why the government discourages it. The state secretary supports the goal but says such benefits must stay within the Participatiewet, arguing that municipalities cannot fund income support outside the law and that the existing law already offers individual support; the law would need no change, and guidance for municipalities is planned.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht “Ouders ‘gaan volledig uit hun plaat’ bij kinderopvang: ‘We moeten een streep trekken’”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of aggressive parents towards childcare staff and what measures exist, including withdrawing childcare allowance and a blacklist. The state secretary said signals are limited, noted that providers can terminate contracts and report serious cases, and rejected further national measures, blacklists and allowance withdrawal as too far-reaching.
Given these possibilities, I currently see no reason to take further measures from central government.
Gegeven deze mogelijkheden zie ik op dit moment geen reden om verdere maatregelen vanuit de rijksoverheid te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de Duitse “Ergebnisse der Sondierungen von CDU, CSU und SPD”

The MP asks how the Dutch government would ensure fast, priority support to work for benefit recipients able to work, whether recipients who refuse work are identifiable and face consequences, and how it views German plans to cut benefits for repeated work refusal. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Participatiewet, points to existing reintegration measures and pending bills, and states that a 100% benefit reduction for refusal already exists, so the German-style measure would have little additional effect.
For everyone under the Participatiewet who is not exempt from work obligations, there is an obligation to make efforts to find, accept and keep generally accepted work.

Voor iedereen die valt onder de Participatiewet en die niet is vrijgesteld van de arbeidsverplichtingen, geldt dat men zich moet inspannen om algemeen geaccepteerde arbeid te vinden, te aanvaarden en te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over antwoorden op Kamervragen over risico op hogere prijzen in nieuw kinderopvangstelsel van 17 februari 2025

An MP asked the State Secretary whether childcare is a Service of General Economic Interest under EU state-aid rules, and whether the planned new childcare financing system, with direct government payments to providers, complies with those rules. The State Secretary answered that the new system does create state aid in principle, that it must be made compatible via the DAEB exemption decision with reporting to the European Commission, and that the 2027 start date is not affected.
This means that the new financing system in principle involves state aid.
Dit leidt ertoe dat er in het nieuwe financieringsstelsel in beginsel sprake is van staatssteun.
Antwoord op n van de leden Welzijn en Lahlah over "het bericht dat het aantal gemeentelijke meldpunten (kliklijnen) voor uitkeringsfraude blijft stijgen."

MPs Welzijn and Lahlah asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the rising number of municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for benefit fraud and whether they fit a trust-based view of citizens, citing Rotterdam's experience with many unfounded accusations. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on their own enforcement instruments, that a hotline is one enforcement tool, that complaints are checked before any action, and that exact figures on hotlines and reports are not available.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over de financiële achteruitgang van mensen met een beperking door kabinetsbeleid

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the state secretaries about financial losses for people with disabilities, including higher Wlz own contributions and lower take-home pay for sheltered-work staff from tax changes and an expired CAO. The government says the Wlz increase follows from the minimum wage rise, that the tax changes cause losses of up to about 15 euro per month, and that it is talking with the VNG about financing sheltered work, but that it is not a party to the CAO negotiations.
The cabinet is not a party to the CAO negotiations for the group working at social development companies and therefore takes a cautious stance on the CAO Aan de slag.
Het kabinet is geen partij in de cao-onderhandelingen voor de doelgroep die werkt bij sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven en stelt zich daarom terughoudend op ten aanzien van de cao Aan de slag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de beantwoording van de prejudiciële vragen door de Hoge Raad over wat dient te worden verstaan onder ‘eerste aflossing’

An MP asks the State Secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs how the government will handle the Supreme Court's answers on what counts as a 'first repayment' in out-of-court debt arrangements, and how this affects debt assistance practice. The government acknowledges the ruling's likely impact, says Recofa guidelines may be revisited, and rejects an AMvB, citing judicial discretion and flexibility.
We will continue to monitor how this ruling develops in practice, for both an out-of-court debt arrangement and the statutory route.
Wij blijven monitoren hoe deze beantwoording zich in de praktijk verder ontwikkelt, voor zowel een buitengerechtelijke schuldregeling als het wettelijke traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ''Het gaat heel ver dat bewindspersonen en politici zich online tegen individuele burgers keren''

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs whether the government's distancing from a public figure's remarks on children's names was based on accurate facts, and whether it would apologise since the quoted words were taken out of context. The state secretary stood by the principle that parents may freely choose names, declined to apologise, said the government did not act to have the article removed, and answered each question briefly.
I have since spoken with the person concerned. We established that we share the message that people in the Netherlands must always have the freedom to choose a name they want.
Ik heb inmiddels met betrokkene gesproken. We hebben vastgesteld dat we de boodschap delen dat mensen in Nederland altijd de vrijheid moeten hebben om een naam te kiezen die zij willen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over "de beantwoording van ingezonden vragen d.d. 6 december 2024” (n.a.v. bericht ‘Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los’)

MP Ergin asked when the SCP was commissioned to update the SIM survey, whether the commissioning letter will be shared, how the government will implement the Becker motion, and how it responds to criticism from the NCDR and mosque federations. The State Secretary answered that the formal request was sent on 4 October 2024 and the assignment confirmed on 27 November 2024, that the letter cannot be shared due to procurement and budget details, and that the SIM2025 was already planned and is carried out independently by the SCP.
The assignment letter to the SCP contains financial information about the available budget and therefore cannot be sent in full to the House for procurement reasons.
De opdrachtbrief aan het SCP bevat financiële informatie over het beschikbare budget en kan derhalve om aanbestedingstechnische redenen niet integraal worden toegestuurd aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Alarm om stijgende kosten kinderopvang: ouders straks tot duizend euro meer kwijt’

Paulusma (D66) asked the state secretary about a report that parents face up to a thousand euros more in childcare costs in 2026 because maximum hourly rates will not be indexed, and about effects on low incomes, participation and labour supply. The state secretary disputed the single-figure claim, gave illustrative calculations showing the parent contribution share rising for low and middle incomes in 2026 while higher subsidy rates offset it for higher incomes, and said effects on usage and work hours cannot be predicted precisely.
I intend to send the draft decree containing the 2026 reimbursement percentages to the House before the summer for the pre-consultation procedure.
Ik ben voornemens het ontwerpbesluit met daarin de vergoedingspercentages voor 2026 nog voor de zomer aan uw Kamer te zenden voor de voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het risico op hogere prijzen in het nieuw kinderopvangstelsel

An MP asks the State Secretary how the planned childcare financing reform, including a 2.9 billion euro investment, can avoid price increases for parents, whether price regulation is possible, and how state aid rules apply. The government answers that a phased increase in subsidies is planned, that tariff regulation is rejected for now pending studies, and that the reform's state aid status is still being worked out with the European Commission.
I expect to be able to share these studies with your House, with a cabinet response, in September.
Ik verwacht dat ik deze onderzoeken voorzien van een kabinetsreactie in september met uw Kamer kan delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Lahlah en Postma over private financiële middelen met betrekking tot een energiefonds

MPs asked why private funding for an energy fund for low and middle income households could not be secured and what efforts were made, including the gap with the amount sought and the future of the Noodfonds infrastructure. The government explains that energy suppliers have agreed to an energy fund for 2025 but the state will carry more than two thirds of the funding to avoid state aid risks, and that the fund will open once the energy sector's contribution is settled.
The Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
De Kamer wordt hier zo snel mogelijk nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de nieuwe Rapportage Integratie en Samenleven 2024

An MP asked the state secretary for a government reaction to the 2024 CBS integration report before a committee debate, and whether he still stands by his statement that a large part of Muslim youth does not share Dutch norms and values. The state secretary replied that the questions came too late for a written answer, that he reflected on his statements during the committee debate and still stands by them, and that the report will inform the Actieagenda Integratie due in 2025.
In the committee debate I reflected on my statements, which I still stand by.
In het WGO heb ik een reflectie gegeven op mijn uitspraken, waar ik nog steeds achter sta.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over kinderopvang voor speciaal onderwijs

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of out-of-school care for children in special education and whether a statutory obligation similar to that for primary schools should be extended to special schools. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted that a legal obligation is complex and costly, and committed to discussing the option with the sector and developing a guidance document.
We will discuss and explore the possibilities of a statutory obligation as one of the options with the field.
We zullen de mogelijkheden van een wettelijke verplichting als een van de opties bespreken en verkennen met het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over “het artikel Re-integratie (ex-)gedetineerde personen komt niet goed van de grond”

An MP asked the state secretaries about the Leiden study finding that debt support for detained and ex-detained persons is weak, and asked about regional debt-support coordination, benefit continuity, health insurance suspension and debt-restructuring credit during detention. The government answered that debt support is a municipal duty, that it is working on improving the detention plan and a workload measurement, that a regional debt-support model is being explored with a letter due before year end, and that several commitments will be reported in later letters.
Municipalities have the statutory duty to provide debt assistance to their residents, including when they are in detention.
Gemeenten hebben de wettelijke taak om schuldhulpverlening te bieden aan hun inwoners, ook wanneer deze in detentie verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los’

An MP asks whether a parliamentary motion to study Dutch citizens with a migration background as a distinct group, and its possible stigmatising effects, can be justified, and asks the government to reconsider. The government replies that the SCP survey covers the entire population, that its scope is not being narrowed or changed, and that it sees no reason to reconsider.
The cabinet notes that the motion has caused considerable upheaval in society. The cabinet will carry out the implementation of the motion very carefully.
Het kabinet constateert dat de motie veel commotie te weeg heeft gebracht in de samenleving. Het kabinet zal de uitvoering van de motie heel zorgvuldig ter hand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de eerdere vragen 2024Z18293

An MP asks the state secretary for an exhaustive list of the Dutch norms and values he referred to, and of the groups said not to accept or respect them, and asks how his claim that a large part of Muslim youth does not share these values fits with his claim that most Dutch Muslims are well integrated. The secretary declines to give an exhaustive list, says most people participate, and argues that the apparent contradiction is not one since most Muslim youth take part while intolerant conduct occurs within that group too.
It is not possible to give an exhaustive enumeration here, because society is constantly in motion and integration is not static.
Het is niet mogelijk om hier een limitatieve opsomming van te geven, want de samenleving is continue in beweging en integratie is niet statisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Na geweld in Amsterdam laait politieke discussie over integratie weer op’

An MP from DENK asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about his remark, made after violence in Amsterdam, that Muslim youth largely do not share Dutch norms and values, and asks for evidence, a list of the norms at issue, and a retraction. The State Secretary confirms the remark on behalf of the cabinet, cites research on antisemitism among some Muslim youth while stressing it also occurs among other groups, and says he does not blame all Muslim youth but will keep speaking out on the problem.
I do not make this observation a reproach toward all Islamic youth.
Ik maak met deze constatering geen verwijt richting alle islamitische jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het rapport 'Re-integratiedienstverlening in het kader van de Participatiewet'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary about the Labour Inspectorate report on re-integration services under the Participation Act, including high caseloads, the role of private parties, and data sharing with employers. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible and free in their priorities, acknowledged caseload pressures, pointed to ongoing measures such as the banenafspraak and sheltered work funding, and said the VUM data programme will be reported on in the next Stand van de Uitvoering.
I inform you periodically about the progress of VUM via the Stand van de Uitvoering, most recently on 22 January 2024.
Ik informeer u periodiek over de voortgang van VUM via de Stand van de Uitvoering, voor het laatst op 22 januari 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over nieuwkomer dierenartsen

MPs Podt and Bamenga asked about the NVWA's onboarding team for refugee veterinarians, recognition of foreign veterinary diplomas, remediation pathways, language training and similar programmes. The government confirmed the team contributes to NVWA staffing shortages, explained the recognition process and the legal limits on restricted veterinary licences, and described existing language subsidies and cooperation efforts, but did not commit to new funding or a specific new initiative.
The committee debate is no longer scheduled for 6 November.
Het Commissiedebat is niet langer gepland op 6 november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "de boodschappenproblematiek die niet wordt opgelost met de Participatiewet in balans”

The SP MP Van Kent asked the State Secretary why the draft Participatiewet in balans amendment on gifts in kind was changed without being highlighted, and how gifts of groceries affect benefits and reporting duties. The State Secretary confirmed the change was dropped after consultation due to unclear rules, explained that in-kind gifts still require individual assessment and reporting, and committed to a further round of talks with municipalities.
The omission of this change from the bill submitted to your House was explained further on page 142 of the explanatory memorandum.
Het niet opnemen van deze wijziging in het voorstel dat bij uw Kamer is ingediend, is wel nader toegelicht op pagina 142 van de memorie van toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht «Bijstand veel voorkomende bron van schulden»

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about an ESB article finding that welfare benefit debts are widespread (286,000 people, 1.4 billion euro) and linked to strict enforcement and weak prevention. The State Secretary largely accepts the authors' conclusions, clarifies the figures, and points to prevention measures, the Participatiewet in balans and Handhaving sociale zekerheid bills, and the Team Preventie follow-up, without committing to a new prevention programme.
In short, I think it is important that we are lenient where possible and strict where necessary, with more discretionary room for professionals in implementation.
Ik vind het kortom van belang dat we zacht zijn waar het kan, en streng zijn waar nodig, met meer beslisruimte voor professionals in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Grinwis over de uitvoeringsaspecten van het nieuwe kinderopvangstelsel

The MPs Maatoug and Grinwis asked whether the current childcare allowance system, which leaves parents bearing repayment risk, should be replaced by direct financing, and what deadlines, choices and information the implementation requires. The State Secretary agrees the current system is fundamentally flawed, says a reform letter will come in autumn with a bill planned for 2025, and lists the information the implementing agency needs.
The childcare allowance will be replaced by a new financing system in which the payment is transferred directly to childcare organisations.
De kinderopvangtoeslag wordt vervangen door een nieuw financieringsstelsel waarbij de vergoeding direct wordt overgemaakt naar kinderopvangorganisaties
